Exceptional hands-on expertise in Java, distributed systems, enterprise APIs and SaaS architecture. Experience leading major initiatives across multiple teams and bringing them into reliable production use. Demonstrated production AI delivery, including evaluation, security, operational performance and economic trade-offs. Deep understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, modern delivery practices, containers, Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code. Strong judgment in security, scalability, reliability, observability and architectural modernisation. Evidence of influencing product direction and translating technical investments into customer or business outcomes. Ability to mentor Principal-level engineers and influence executive decisions without relying on reporting authority. Preferred Skills (Good to Have) Salesforce ecosystem products, DevSecOps, release orchestration, code analysis, security or data protection. Experience with regulated enterprise customers and globally distributed engineering teams. Major product achievements or other evidence of external-grade technical impact; patents, publications and open-source contributions are useful but not mandatory. What success looks like Within 90 days, establish a shared view of the most important cross-product technical opportunities, risks and decision boundaries. Within six months, lead agreed milestones for a strategic platform initiative and demonstrate evidence of improved customer, engineering or business outcomes. Strengthen Principal-level technical leadership and establish a practical, prioritised investment agenda with Product and Engineering. Why join AutoRABIT

title: Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer
description:
Role summary 
Build and operationalize the Fabric pipeline designed by the architect: ingestion from multiple sources, Spark-based transformation logic, Gold layer tables (both MLV and DirectQuery-served), and ongoing maintenance/optimization through go-live and stabilization. This is a sustained build-and-run role, following an existing architecture rather than designing it from scratch.
 Key responsibilities 
- Build and maintain Spark notebooks for BronzeSilver transformations, including parsing semi-structured (JSON) and NoSQL-sourced data
- Implement entity-resolution/join logic across sources (structured relational + semi-structured + NoSQL)
- Build and schedule Materialized Lake Views and/or DirectQuery views per the architecture's real-time/analytical split
- Set up and maintain Data Pipeline orchestration (ingestion, transform, refresh scheduling, dependency chains)
 - Monitor and tune performance: table optimization/vacuuming, small-file compaction, Direct Lake troubleshooting
- Maintain and extend the mirroring/ingestion connections (Oracle mirroring, OFSC API polling, MongoDB connector) as data volume or requirements evolve
- Support integration testing with the AI agent layer (Fabric Data Agent and/or direct SQL/MCP tool queries)
- Document pipeline logic and hand over runbooks for BAU support
 
 Must-have skills 
- Strong hands-on PySpark and Spark SQL comfortable writing production transformation logic, not just tutorials
- Working experience with Microsoft Fabric: Lakehouse, notebooks, Data Pipelines, Delta tables
- Experience with Delta Lake concepts: schema evolution, optimize/vacuum, change data feed
- SQL proficiency (T-SQL for Warehouse/SQL analytics endpoint work)
- Experience with API-based data ingestion (REST APIs, JSON parsing, pagination/polling patterns)
- Comfortable working from an architecture document and translating design decisions into working code
 
 Nice-to-have 
- Materialized Lake Views experience specifically
- Experience with MongoDB or other NoSQL Spark connectors
- Power BI / semantic model exposure (helpful for testing Gold layer outputs, not core to the role)
 - DP-203 or DP-700 (Fabric Data Engineer) certification.

title: Senior Atlassian Admin
description:
About Rightsline: 
 At Rightsline, we are redefining how the global media and entertainment industry manages and monetizes intellectual property. Since 2012, Rightsline has been trusted by some of the worlds most influential studios, broadcasters, and content owners to simplify the complex world of rights and royalties through powerful, intelligent technology. 
 Our cloud-based, fully integrated platform provides a single source of truth for managing rights, royalties, contracts, and financial workflows across markets, territories, and distribution channels. By bringing together data, automation, and collaboration in one configurable ecosystem, we enable organizations to unlock the full value of their content portfolios while operating with greater transparency, efficiency, and control. 
 At Rightsline, we combine deep industry expertise with cutting-edge technology to solve complex challenges at scale. Our teams work at the intersection of technology, media, and innovation—building solutions that power the business of content worldwide. 
 Joining Rightsline means becoming part of a collaborative, forward-thinking environment where your ideas, expertise, and contributions directly shape the future of rights and royalties management. If you are passionate about building impactful technology and working alongside talented global teams, Rightsline offers the platform to grow, innovate, and make a meaningful difference. 
 What You Will Own: 
 Instance Configuration & Governance Own all shared configuration in our company-managed Jira Cloud instance: custom fields, screens and screen schemes, field configurations, workflows and workflow schemes, work types and hierarchy levels, priorities, resolutions, and permission and notification schemes. Apply and enforce the discipline company-managed Jira requires establish whether an object is shared before changing it, and when it is, copy it, scope the copy to the project, and change the copy. Most instance damage comes from skipping this step. Own and maintain all the Atlassian sister products like Confluence, Jira Service Desk, and Jira Product Discovery Maintain naming conventions that make configuration ownership obvious at a glance, and run a recurring audit that catches projects drifting back onto shared objects. Keep the custom-field estate from growing unchecked: reuse before creating, scope through field contexts rather than editing shared ones, and retire fields no longer in use. Own project creation and decommissioning, and grant permissions to project roles rather than named individuals so access survives staffing changes. 
 Workflow, Automation & App Administration Translate how teams actually work into workflow, status, and board configuration and propose the lighter alternative when a request is better solved by a convention than by new configuration. Publish workflow changes safely, including migrating in-flight work when statuses change, and keep board column mappings in step so nothing lands in an unmapped state. Build and maintain Jira Automation rules, scoped correctly so one team's rule does not surface in another team's menus. Administer our Marketplace apps including their own scoping settings, and evaluate new apps before they become permanent. 
 Confluence & Process Documentation Own Confluence spaces, permissions, templates, and page hierarchy. Partner with engineering leads to get our delivery process written down and kept current: status definitions with owners and exit criteria, work-type guidance, Definition of Ready and Definition of Done, and branch-naming requirements. Company-managed Jira cannot hold per-project helper text, so Confluence is where this lives. Write short, durable runbooks for recurring requests, and train team leads to self-serve the routine changes. 
 Reporting, Data & Integrations Protect the conventions our delivery metrics depend on — the estimation field, status names, issue-key format, and what counts as a defect. Breaking one of these produces wrong numbers rather than an error message, so you are the last line of defence. Own the data contract behind our delivery-analytics platform (Plandek): which fields and statuses it reads, and what a rename would cost. Write JQL that answers non-trivial questions, build filters and dashboards, and run bulk changes safely. Use the Jira Cloud REST API for work with no UI path — bulk version creation, field inventories, and pulling issue changelogs for time-in-status and flow metrics. Changelog data cannot be reached through CSV export, so this is a working requirement rather than a bonus. Maintain the Jira–Git integration that drives status transitions, along with the Zendesk, Salesforce, and Sentry connectors. 
 Access, Compliance & Support Produce access-review and change-management evidence for SOC 2: who holds admin rights, who holds elevated issue permissions, and what changed when. Own Atlassian onboarding and offboarding, licence allocation, and seat cost management. Be the first and last stop for “Jira is broken” — diagnosing with the tooling (permission helper, automation audit logs) rather than reasoning from first principles, since most reports resolve to a handful of known causes. Collaborating with cross-functional teams Ensure compliance with ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2 frameworks 
 What You Bring: 5+ years administering Atlassian Cloud, including hands-on ownership of a company-managed (not only team-managed) Jira instance where multiple projects share configuration. This is our most important requirement: team-managed-only experience does not transfer, because the whole difficulty of this role is shared configuration. Atlassian Certified Professional (Jira Administration or Jira Service Management). ScriptRunner (Groovy), or comparable depth administering Marketplace apps. Jira Service Management, Atlassian Guard / Access, or Atlassian Analytics. Experience with a delivery-metrics platform (Plandek, LinearB, Jellyfish, Sleuth) and the Jira data hygiene it requires. Having led a team-managed to company-managed migration, or a Server / Data Center to Cloud migration. Familiarity with SOC 2 or comparable audit evidence collection. Exposure to AI-assisted development tooling and how its activity should be represented in Jira. Demonstrated ownership of workflows, screen and field configuration schemes, issue type schemes, and permission schemes — you have built them, published them, and migrated existing issues through a status change. Jira Automation at a competent level: multi-step rules, smart values, branching, and correct rule scoping. Confluence administration: spaces, permissions, and templates. Strong JQL, plus filters, dashboards, and safe bulk operations. Scripting against the Jira REST API in Python, JavaScript, or equivalent, including token authentication, pagination, and changelog extraction. Judgment about blast radius — before changing anything you check what else depends on it, and you can be trusted with an instance twenty teams rely on. Willingness to push back: declining the request that would add a field nobody fills in or a status nobody exits, and proposing the lighter alternative. Clear written communication, a habit of documenting as you go, and experience working effectively with colleagues across time zones. 
 Work Environment & Expectations: Noida/NCR based Demonstrates flexibility to work in required shifts. Regular overlap with US-based engineering leadership, targeting 4 hours daily. Compliance with security and remote working policies 
 Compensation & Growth: Competitive compensation aligned to market standards with strong career growth opportunities. 
 Life at Rightsline India: At our India operations, we foster a culture of inclusiveness, accountability, and innovation. We believe in empowering our teams to take ownership, drive impact, and contribute meaningfully to global success. We offer a structured yet flexible work environment that balances performance with employee well-being. Our benefits framework for India includes: Provident Fund, Gratuity, and all statutory benefits in compliance with applicable Indian labour laws Comprehensive Group Medical Insurance covering employees and their eligible dependents Group Personal Accident Insurance for enhanced financial security In-office meal benefits, including sponsored breakfast, lunch, and evening snacks Hybrid work model with clearly defined collaboration days Flexible working hours, role-dependent Structured and transparent leave policy Career growth and advancement opportunities within a rapidly scaling global SaaS organization Continuous learning, upskilling, and leadership development support Quarterly employee engagement initiatives, along with celebrations and recognition programs 
 You will work alongside a globally connected team with strong leadership support and collaborative cross-functional exposure. We encourage proactive thinking, ownership, and initiative—ideas are welcomed, and execution is supported. As a people-first organization, we are committed to building a high-performance culture where growth, accountability, and innovation go hand in hand. 
 Hiring Process: HR Screening Technical / Functional Interview Assessment (As applicable) Leadership Round Offer Rollout 
 Information Security & Compliance Responsibilities: Adhere to ISMS policies and procedures Protect confidential and customer data Report security incidents Participate in compliance trainings and audits 
 Data Privacy & Confidentiality: Employees must ensure proper handling of sensitive data in line with company policies and applicable laws. 
 Access & Control Responsibilities: Follow role-based access control principles Safeguard credentials Ensure authorized system usage 
 Equal Opportunity Statement: Rightsline is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

Company Overview 
 AutoRABIT is an enterprise platform for Salesforce DevSecOps that enables organizations to manage AI-accelerated Salesforce development with greater security, governance, visibility, and control. Its integrated product suite supports the complete Salesforce DevSecOps lifecycle through AutoRABIT ARM for CI/CD and release management, CodeScan for static code analysis and application security, Vault for data backup and recovery, and Guard for security posture management. The platform helps enterprises automate deployments, improve code quality, protect critical Salesforce data, monitor access risks, and strengthen compliance. AutoRABIT official website 
 Purpose-built for complex enterprise Salesforce environments, AutoRABIT helps development teams increase productivity, accelerate delivery, and innovate without compromising security or reliability. Its metadata-aware capabilities, scalable platform, flexible hosting options, and integrations provide organizations with the structure and control required to manage Salesforce changes across teams, environments, and global operations. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, AutoRABIT serves customers worldwide and offers employees the opportunity to contribute to products at the intersection of Salesforce, DevSecOps, security, governance, and AI-enabled development. AutoRABIT platform overview 
 Job Role 
 Own the technical direction and delivery outcomes of a major product area or substantial cross-team initiative. This is a hands-on individual contributor role combining deep engineering ability with customer understanding and product judgment. You will shape solutions with Product and Engineering, implement critical components and remain accountable for how they perform after release. 
 Key Responsibilities Product and technical direction. Understand customer workflows, adoption barriers and relevant market alternatives with Product and customer-facing teams. Develop evidence-based recommendations on what to improve, simplify or avoid building. Translate agreed priorities into architecture, delivery increments and measurable outcomes. Hands-on delivery. Lead design, coding, review, testing and rollout of complex Java services and platform capabilities. Build critical components and reference implementations. Make trade-offs explicit and help teams deliver secure, maintainable software rather than leaving execution at the design stage. Production AI judgment. Develop AI-enabled capabilities where they offer meaningful customer value. Define evaluation cases, security boundaries, human approvals where needed, failure handling and acceptable cost and latency. Select conventional engineering approaches when they solve the problem more reliably. Reliability and modernisation. Improve performance, scalability, observability, security and tenant isolation within the assigned scope. Address technical debt through staged investments linked to customer or delivery impact. Resolve systemic causes of production problems and improve prevention. Cross-team influence. Align interfaces, dependencies and engineering practices across participating teams. Mentor senior engineers and explain decisions clearly. Partner with Product on priorities, Engineering Managers on delivery capacity and the Distinguished Engineer or CTO on company-wide architecture. Document decision ownership and escalate unresolved cross-product trade-offs. Responsibility to adhere to set internal controls. Pride of Ownership 
 We value pride of ownership. Understand the customer, the product and the market need; form a clear, evidence-based opinion about how the product can improve; and work with others to turn that opinion into results. Strong coding skills and effective use of AI matter, but accountability continues after a feature is shipped. Be willing to challenge assumptions, listen to feedback and change your view when the evidence changes. 
 Experience & Desired Skills 
 Required Skills (Mandatory) 12+ years delivering enterprise software, with demonstrated Principal-level ownership of significant initiatives; scope and outcomes carry more weight than tenure alone. Deep hands-on Java, Spring Boot, API, microservices and distributed-systems expertise. Strong enterprise SaaS engineering experience, including security, performance and operational reliability. Practical AWS or Azure architecture, containers, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD experience. Experience delivering AI-enabled software or developer productivity capabilities into production and evaluating their effectiveness. Practical familiarity with relevant AI approaches such as LLMs, RAG, agents or MCP; sound engineering judgment matters more than a particular framework. Evidence of influencing product decisions, leading cross-team implementation and mentoring senior contributors. Clear communication with technical and business stakeholders across regions. Preferred Skills (Good to Have) Salesforce metadata, APIs or release workflows; DevSecOps, CI/CD, data protection or developer-tool products. Modernisation of complex enterprise platforms and work in regulated or security-sensitive settings. Significant proprietary product achievements, open-source contributions, publications or patents demonstrating technical influence. What success looks like Within 90 days, understand the assigned product area, agree outcome measures and identify its most consequential technical constraints. Within six months, deliver agreed milestones for a substantial initiative and demonstrate improvement against its baseline. Build durable capability in the team through reusable components, documented decisions and mentoring. Why join AutoRABIT 
 You will shape important product decisions while remaining close to implementation. This role offers ownership of meaningful customer outcomes and the opportunity to strengthen the technical foundations of AutoRABIT products. 
 Experience: 12+ Years 
 Compensation: 75 - 90 Lakhs per annum  
 Location: Hyderabad 
 Work Mode: Hybrid - 3 days Work from Office 
 Work Timings : IST timings - General Flexible Shift

Key Skills: Continuous Integration,Spring Boot,Java,Continuous Integration,AWS,Cd,Salesforce,Spring

title: Lead  IT Infra
description:
Dear Candidate, 
 We have an exciting opportunity at our company Tata Business Hub for a Lead IT Infra Role, and based on your experience and skill set, we believe this role could be a great fit for you. 
 Company Details : Tata Business Hub is a digital first B2B organization setup by TATA Group to holistically address the needs of Emerging Businesses. We value the pivotal role of emerging businesses in our Nations economic growth and prosperity, and believe in empowering them to be deeply aware, widely connected and digitally integrated. Offering a host of economical and highly relevant business capabilities, Tata Business Hub aims to be the catalyst, propelling emerging businesses into new frontiers of growth and performance. 
 At Tata Business Hub, our ambition is vast- We want to become the pre-eminent company that works for MSMEs in India 
 Grow their business Solve their challenges Optimize their processes 
 Role Summary Responsible for managing enterprise IT infrastructure, Microsoft 365, AWS cloud platforms, network security and IT operations, while ensuring effective IT procurement, vendor coordination and billing management. Key Responsibilities 1. Microsoft 365 & SharePoint Manage Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, SSO, Active Directory and Azure integrations. Develop and maintain SharePoint customizations, SPFx/React JS applications and Power Platform solutions. Manage Microsoft 365 security policies using Defender and Intune. Troubleshoot Office 365, email, network, firewall and cloud service issues. 2. Infrastructure & Cloud Manage DNS, email routing, Azure services, web applications, APIs and storage. Deploy and manage AWS services, instances, AMIs and SaaS infrastructure. Configure and optimize AWS, Azure and internal cloud environments. Implement automation, patching, backup and disaster recovery solutions. Monitor cloud usage, capacity, performance and costs. 3. Network & Security Manage enterprise network and security infrastructure, including firewalls, IPS, proxy, web/email filtering and next-generation security solutions. Configure firewall policies, authentication services, load balancers and SD-WAN. Maintain knowledge of MPLS, BGP, OSPF, TACACS and related network technologies. Identify, investigate and resolve major incidents and security vulnerabilities. 4. Identity, Endpoint & IT Support Manage Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID, Azure AD Connect, ADFS and Hybrid Exchange. Implement SSO, MFA, access controls and endpoint security. Manage BYOD, ActiveSync and mobile device support. Provide technical support, problem management and infrastructure troubleshooting. Drive ITSM, SLA adherence and service improvement. 5. IT Procurement & Vendor Management Coordinate IT procurement for hardware, software, cloud services, licenses and infrastructure. Raise and track purchase requisitions, POs, quotations and delivery schedules. Coordinate with vendors, Procurement, Finance and internal teams for timely delivery. Maintain records of contracts, licenses, warranties, renewals and IT assets. Support vendor evaluations, commercial negotiations and cost optimization. 6. IT Billing & Cost Control Validate vendor invoices against POs, contracts, SOWs and agreed rates. Verify quantities, taxes, rental charges, licenses, cloud consumption and discounts. Track recurring IT bills, AMC, connectivity, cloud and managed services. Resolve billing discrepancies and coordinate corrections, credit notes and adjustments. Maintain billing trackers and support monthly cost reconciliation and budget reporting. 7. Documentation & Compliance Maintain infrastructure documentation, configuration records and asset details. Follow IT security, change management, audit and compliance requirements. Ensure timely closure of vulnerabilities, audit observations and operational issues. 
 Qualifications & Skills Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or related field. 8-12 years of experience in M365, cloud infrastructure, network security and IT operations. Strong knowledge of AWS, Azure, GCP, Active Directory, Exchange, networking and security technologies. Proficiency in PowerShell and infrastructure automation. Experience in IT procurement, vendor management and invoice validation. If you're a motivated individual with a keen eye for quality and a desire to drive excellence in every project, we invite you to apply and join our team. 
 Looking forward to hearing from you.

When Tier 1 specialists encounter issues beyond initial troubleshooting, our Tier 2 engineers’ step in to own the resolution. We go deeper — into SIP traces, network captures, platform configurations, and engineering-level diagnostics — to deliver the answers our customers and teammates need. The Technical Support Engineer is a mid-level, high-impact position requiring strong technical aptitude and independent problem-solving. IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU, CONTINUE READING BELOW. What you will do Serve as the primary escalation point for Tier 1 Technical Support Specialists, receiving and owning complex cases that require advanced technical investigation. Perform in-depth troubleshooting on call quality, call completion, SIP registration, call flow builds, features, and network-related issues across the platform. Analyze SIP traces, packet captures (PCAPs), and platform logs to diagnose and resolve voice and network issues. Independently resolve complex issues and collaborate with Tier 3 engineers, Voice Engineering, and Advanced Operations Support (AOS) on issues requiring escalated technical expertise. Manage and drive cases to resolution, ensuring timely updates to customers and adherence to SLA commitments. Follow up with customers and Tier 1 agents to confirm resolution and ensure a high level of satisfaction. Document customer issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions thoroughly within the ticketing system. Identify trends, recurring issues, and systemic problems; escalate patterns to management and Tier 3 for root cause analysis. Contribute to the development of internal knowledge base articles (IKBs) and training materials for Tier 1 upskilling. Participate in on-call rotation for after-hours and weekend support coverage. Mentor and coach Tier 1 team members on advanced troubleshooting methodologies and platform knowledge. What you will bring Proficient knowledge of Networking (Layer 2 & 3 topology, networking hardware, cabling, WAPs, routing protocols such as OSPF/BGP). Strong working knowledge of VoIP technologies (QoS, SIP Flow, Codec Negotiations, RTP, DTMF, PCAP analysis). Experience troubleshooting within an IP/VoIP environment, including SIP registration, call routing, and call quality diagnostics. Familiarity with the Broad Works/BroadSoft hosted voice platform. Strong communication skills — both written and verbal — with the ability to manage difficult customer conversations professionally. Highly detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to: Manage multiple complex escalations simultaneously while maintaining quality and accuracy. Work independently and collaboratively across teams. Mentor junior team members and share knowledge proactively. Thrive in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment with tight SLA requirements. What is required for application? Required 2+ years of experience in technical support or network engineering role. CCNA, Network+, or equivalent networking certification, or equivalent demonstrated experience. Hands-on experience with SIP, TCP/IP, VoIP, and LAN/WAN troubleshooting. Preferred Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a technical field. Hands-on experience with Cisco and other networking equipment. Experience reading and interpreting SIP traces and PCAP files. description:
Job Title: Product Manager Flick Tools Company: Flick Network
 Location: Remote, India
 Employment Type: Full-time About Flick Network Flick Network is a technology company operating across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Malaysia, Nigeria and other markets. We are an accredited Peppol Access Point, helping businesses comply with government e-invoicing mandates by connecting enterprise ERP systems to national e-invoicing networks. We are now building Flick Tools , a simple, all-in-one business management product for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs). The platform will bring quotations, invoicing, billing, payments, customer management and basic accounting together, with e-invoicing compliance built in. Role Overview We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager to own Flick Tools end to end. You will understand SMB customer needs, research the market, define the product roadmap and translate business requirements into clear product specifications. Working closely with the founders, design and engineering teams, you will shape a product that small businesses find easy to use and are willing to pay for. This is a product ownership role, not just a coordination role. Key Responsibilities Define and own the product vision, roadmap and feature priorities. Conduct customer interviews and market research with SMB owners, accountants and bookkeepers. Analyse competitors such as Zoho Invoice, QuickBooks, Xero, Tally and other relevant products. Prepare Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), user stories and acceptance criteria. Collaborate with design and engineering teams to develop intuitive user experiences and deliver product features. Improve customer onboarding, self-service signup, activation and conversion. Work with sales and marketing teams on product pricing, packaging and go-to-market strategy. Define and monitor product metrics, including activation, retention, conversion and churn. Make evidence-based product decisions using customer feedback, market research and product data. Required Skills and Qualifications 35 years of experience in product management, with ownership of a product or major feature area from concept to launch. Experience with SMB-focused or self-service SaaS products. Relevant experience in billing, invoicing, accounting or business management software. Familiarity with products such as Zoho, QuickBooks, Xero, Tally, Vyapar or similar platforms is preferred. Understanding of customer acquisition funnels, onboarding, activation, free trials or freemium business models. Strong customer research, analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work with engineering teams and understand APIs, data models and integrations. Excellent written communication and documentation skills. Ability to work independently, take ownership and make data-driven decisions. Good to Have Exposure to e-invoicing and tax compliance, including UAE FTA, ZATCA, Peppol, Indian GST e-invoicing or Malaysia's MyInvois. Experience serving SMB customers in India or GCC markets. Experience in POS, inventory management or payments products. Experience with SaaS pricing and packaging. Startup or early-stage product-building experience. What We Are Looking For We want a self-driven product owner who takes initiative, understands customer problems, thinks strategically and pays attention to detail. You should be comfortable turning ideas into actionable product decisions and working closely with founders and engineering teams to build a product from the ground up. Application Process Please submit your updated CV along with a short note (maximum one page) answering the following question: If you were building an invoicing and billing product for a five-person business with no accounting software, what would you ship first, and why? We value your product thinking, customer understanding and ability to prioritise.

title: Project Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 We are looking for a Project Manager (PM) for high-rise construction using aluminum formwork (such as Mivan technology) is responsible for orchestrating a fast-paced, repetitive construction cycle to ensure the project meets tight deadlines, safety standards, and quality requirements. The primary roles and responsibilities are categorized below: 
 1. Strategic Planning & Lifecycle Management: 
 Cycle Time Optimization : Establish, monitor, and enforce the typical 4 to 7-day structural cycle per floor enabled by aluminum formwork. 
 Sequential Planning : Determining the most efficient sequence of activities, including the simultaneous casting of walls and slabs to streamline the process. 
 Resource Allocation : Identifying and allocating necessary manpower (often semi-skilled for this technology), materials, and equipment from start to finish. 
 2. Technical & Quality Supervision: Formwork Design Integration : Working with architects and engineers early in the design phase to ensure building layouts are compatible with modular aluminum panels. 
 Precision Control : Monitoring the installation of formwork to ensure dimensional accuracy, which is critical for high-rise alignment and reducing the need for plastering. 
 Pour Monitoring : Overseeing the concrete pouring process to prevent overloading panels and ensure proper curing for high-quality finishes. 
 3. Operational Logistics & Maintenance: 
 Inventory Management : Managing the procurement, on-site storage, and inventory of hundreds of precision-engineered aluminum components. 
 Formwork Reusability : Implementing cleaning and maintenance protocols after every cycle (removing residue, applying release agents) to extend the lifespan of panels for 1,000+ uses. 
 On-site Logistics : Coordinating the delivery and movement of formwork accessories like wall ties, pins, and wedges to prevent idle time. 
 4. Safety & Compliance: 
 Site Safety Protocols : Enforcing strict safety measures for high-rise environments, including the use of PPE and proper load distribution for formwork supports. 
 Personnel Training : Organizing training for laborers on assembly, striking (disassembling), and handling techniques to prevent injuries and equipment damage. 
 Regulatory Adherence : Ensuring all construction activities comply with local building codes and national safety standards (e.g., OSHA). 
 5. Financial & Stakeholder Management: 
 Budgeting & Cost Control : Tracking expenses meticulously to offset high initial formwork costs through labor and time savings. 
 Stakeholder Communication : Acting as the primary liaison between clients, consultants, and on-site teams to report progress and resolve conflicts.

title: Quantity Surveyor
description:
Position Title: Quantity Surveyor 
 Department: Quantity Surveying / Cost Estimation
 Reports To: Project Manager / Senior Quantity Surveyor
 Location: Valasaravakkam
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Job Role: The Quantity Surveyor (QS) will be responsible for managing all aspects of the cost and quantity management for interior and civil projects, including estimation, budgeting, procurement, contract administration, and cost control to ensure projects are completed within budget, to the desired quality standards, and on time. 
 Key Responsibilities: Cost Estimation & Budgeting: Prepare accurate and detailed cost estimates for interior and civil works, including material, labor, and equipment costs. Assist in preparing project budgets and ensure that financial targets are met throughout the project lifecycle. Prepare Bills of Quantities (BoQ) for tendering and procurement processes. Conduct market research to stay updated on material and labor price fluctuations. 
 2. Tendering & Procurement: Review tender documents and specifications to ensure all quantities are accounted for and accurately costed. Assist in the tendering process, including evaluating bids from subcontractors and suppliers. Ensure proper procurement of materials, labor, and services as per the project requirements. 
 3. Contract Management: Prepare, review, and negotiate contract terms and conditions with subcontractors, suppliers, and clients. Assist in the management of contracts by ensuring that the terms are adhered to and any variations are properly documented and approved. Monitor and track the progress of works and compare them with budgeted costs, identifying any discrepancies and taking corrective action as necessary. 
 4. Cost Control & Reporting: Monitor ongoing costs against the initial budget and provide regular cost reports to management and clients. Identify cost overruns or potential savings and take proactive steps to mitigate financial risks. Prepare periodic progress reports, including cost updates and forecasts for the completion of works. 
 5. Site Measurements & Verification: Conduct site visits to measure and verify works, ensuring that the quantities match the actual construction progress. Ensure proper documentation of site records, including measurements and as-built drawings. 
 6. Value Engineering & Cost Optimization: Suggest alternatives to optimize costs without compromising the quality or schedule of the project. Identify opportunities for cost savings through design changes, alternative materials, or construction methods. 
 7. Dispute Resolution: Assist in resolving disputes related to contract variations, claims, or discrepancies in quantities and costs. Provide detailed justification and documentation for claims and change orders to clients or contractors. 
 8. Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with the project team (Project Manager, Engineers, Architects, and other stakeholders) to ensure smooth project execution and cost control.

title: Distinguished Engineer
description:
Company Overview 
 AutoRABIT is an enterprise platform for Salesforce DevSecOps that enables organizations to manage AI-accelerated Salesforce development with greater security, governance, visibility, and control. Its integrated product suite supports the complete Salesforce DevSecOps lifecycle through AutoRABIT ARM for CI/CD and release management, CodeScan for static code analysis and application security, Vault for data backup and recovery, and Guard for security posture management. The platform helps enterprises automate deployments, improve code quality, protect critical Salesforce data, monitor access risks, and strengthen compliance. AutoRABIT official website 
 Purpose-built for complex enterprise Salesforce environments, AutoRABIT helps development teams increase productivity, accelerate delivery, and innovate without compromising security or reliability. Its metadata-aware capabilities, scalable platform, flexible hosting options, and integrations provide organizations with the structure and control required to manage Salesforce changes across teams, environments, and global operations. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, AutoRABIT serves customers worldwide and offers employees the opportunity to contribute to products at the intersection of Salesforce, DevSecOps, security, governance, and AI-enabled development. AutoRABIT platform overview 
 Job Role 
 Provide technical leadership across AutoRABIT products and shared platform capabilities. Combine exceptional hands-on engineering with a strong view of customer needs, product differentiation and long-term technical direction. Your mandate is to improve the companys ability to build products customers trust and choose, and to translate that direction into working software. 
 Key Responsibilities Company-level product direction. Work with Product, the CTO, VP of Engineering and customer-facing leaders to identify the technical capabilities that matter most to customer value and product differentiation. Use customer evidence and market understanding to shape investment options, build-versus-buy decisions and long-term platform direction. Cross-product architecture. Guide architecture across product boundaries, shared services and integrations. Simplify dependencies, clarify interfaces and reduce systemic risks. Define staged modernisation plans that protect existing customers while enabling future capabilities. Establish decision principles with accountable product and engineering owners. Hands-on execution. Personally design and implement critical components, reference solutions and technically demanding capabilities. Lead complex initiatives through validation and rollout. Resolve the highest-impact systemic engineering problems without becoming the default owner of every difficult implementation task. Production AI leadership. Guide reliable AI-enabled capabilities and engineering practices. Establish evaluation methods, tenant and data boundaries, safe tool execution, oversight, observability and cost controls appropriate to each use case. Demonstrate where AI improves outcomes and where simpler approaches are preferable. Engineering capability. Mentor Principal Engineers, architects and senior technical leaders. Establish reusable practices for secure, reliable and maintainable delivery. Improve the quality of engineering decisions across teams and build leadership capacity that persists beyond your direct involvement. Executive influence and accountability. Communicate technical trade-offs in terms of customer impact, investment and risk. Partner with the CTO on enterprise direction and the VP of Engineering on execution. Agree decision rights for cross-product initiatives and make outcomes visible to leadership and the teams delivering them. Responsibility to adhere to set internal controls. Pride of Ownership 
 We value pride of ownership. Understand the customer, the product and the market need; form a clear, evidence-based opinion about how the product can improve; and work with others to turn that opinion into results. Strong coding skills and effective use of AI matter, but accountability continues after a feature is shipped. Be willing to challenge assumptions, listen to feedback and change your view when the evidence changes. 
 Experience & Desired Skills 
 Required Skills (Mandatory) 15+ years delivering complex enterprise software, with sustained evidence of company-wide or multi-product technical impact. Exceptional hands-on expertise in Java, distributed systems, enterprise APIs and SaaS architecture. Experience leading major initiatives across multiple teams and bringing them into reliable production use. Demonstrated production AI delivery, including evaluation, security, operational performance and economic trade-offs. Deep understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, modern delivery practices, containers, Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code. Strong judgment in security, scalability, reliability, observability and architectural modernisation. Evidence of influencing product direction and translating technical investments into customer or business outcomes. Ability to mentor Principal-level engineers and influence executive decisions without relying on reporting authority. Preferred Skills (Good to Have) Salesforce ecosystem products, DevSecOps, release orchestration, code analysis, security or data protection. Experience with regulated enterprise customers and globally distributed engineering teams. Major product achievements or other evidence of external-grade technical impact; patents, publications and open-source contributions are useful but not mandatory. What success looks like Within 90 days, establish a shared view of the most important cross-product technical opportunities, risks and decision boundaries. Within six months, lead agreed milestones for a strategic platform initiative and demonstrate evidence of improved customer, engineering or business outcomes. Strengthen Principal-level technical leadership and establish a practical, prioritised investment agenda with Product and Engineering. Why join AutoRABIT 
 You will influence the future of AutoRABIT’s platform while remaining an active builder. The opportunity is to create lasting product advantage, simplify difficult engineering problems and grow the people who will deliver the next generation of capabilities.

description:
External job description This is a contract role for 6 months
 The My HR Live Support (MHLS) team is currently seeking to hire an MHLS Sr. Advisor to support our Tier 2 Specialty Operation. The MHLS Tier 2 Specialty Team primarily provides customer service to Amazon employees through phone, chat, ticketing, and cases related to payroll, disability, policies, among others. This role will act as a point of contact for the team, offering immediate assistance on complex issues and handling challenging contacts. The Sr. Advisors provide case consultations and overall resolution and support for all types of leaves of absence and disability life events to our Amazon employees. They are highly skilled in answering questions, obtaining the right information from SOPs and knowledge centers, providing direct support through different live and written channels, understanding the employees situation, applying appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances; and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. The Sr. Advisor will also escalate trends to management to address any training or quality gaps identified. 
 The ideal candidate will possess exceptional communication and organizational skills, a keen attention to detail, the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment, strong relationship-building and influencing abilities, robust analytical and critical thinking skills, and a customer service focus that aligns with Amazon's global standards. 
 Key job responsibilities 
 • Respond to inquiries about disability and leave events, time-off, payments, and work-related situations available to employees. 
 • Inbound and Outbound phone, chat and case support through the Specialized Support Queues. 
 • Serve as a point of contact for employees to provide holistic case management services, including medical documentation review to adjudicate compliance with corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon. 
 • Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employees changing needs. 
 • Address and respond to sensitive situations in benefit of employee experience and attempt to de-escalate complex cases. 
 • Manage own workload effectively to meet productivity goals and escalate when significant changes or gaps in assigned workload arise. 
 • Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event. 
 • Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication and documentation occurs, even when information is limited. 
 • Use good judgement and rationale to balance process adherence with employee’s needs to analyze and decide on disability, leave and benefits requests. 
 • Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp-back plan for employees returning to the workplace. 
 • Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to starting a leave or returning back to work. 
 • Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing. 
 • Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy. 
 • Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation. 
 • Consult, coordinate and partner with our third-party administrator, local HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits team members and other support units as appropriate. 
 Basic qualifications Bachelor's degree Knowledge of Microsoft Office including PowerPoint, Excel, and Word Minimum of 1 year experience in customer service or Human Resource management or Case management or Leave & Disability management role Preferred qualifications 3+ years of case management experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field Experience identifying and resolving complex issues Experience handling confidential information Ability to build strong relationships and influence others while working in a cross functional environment Experience providing guidance to employees or managers on leave of absence, disability plan, accommodation, human resources, benefits, or employee matters

title: Service Delivery Manager - Performance & Continuous Improvement
description:
Service Delivery Manager Performance & Continuous Improvement Intelligent Command Centre (ICC) & Transformation Lead all towers 
 Tower: Cross-tower: Performance, Governance & Continuous Improvement Location: Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub) Reports to: HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida Role type: People manager Scope: Intelligent Command Centre, SLA and KPI governance, continuous improvement portfolio, transition PMO support and hub quality management 
 ABOUT THE HUB Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards. 
 ROLE PURPOSE You are the hub's performance and improvement engine. You will build the Intelligent Command Centre that gives leaders one real-time view of service health across every tower. You will also run the continuous improvement system that moves the hub from stable operations to best-in-class service. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Transition and shared services set-up Design the hub's performance framework: a KPI tree, SLA definitions, data sources and a reporting cadence shared by all towers. Capture and certify the pre-transition baselines for each country, so the hub can prove its value against the starting point. Support the transition PMO with readiness scorecards, go/no-go dashboards and hypercare tracking for every wave. Set up the Intelligent Command Centre, covering architecture, data pipelines, dashboards and alerting. 2. Process ownership and service delivery Run the ICC day to day, with real-time SLA, volume, backlog and escalation monitoring across R2P, R2H, Q2R and A2W. Lead the hub's governance rhythm: daily stand-ups, weekly tower reviews, monthly service reviews and quarterly business reviews with stakeholders. Own the hub-wide customer voice programme, including CSAT and NPS surveys, closing the loop with respondents, and reporting insight. Run hub-level capacity and productivity analytics to support resourcing decisions. 3. Governance, risk and controls Own the hub quality management system, covering process documentation standards, internal quality audits and control testing across towers. Maintain the hub risk register and the tracking of issues and actions. Build data governance for performance reporting so that there is one version of the truth. 4. Continuous improvement and digital Build and govern the hub-wide continuous improvement backlog. Prioritise by value and effort, and agree ownership with each GPO. Lead improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma and process mining. Track benefits through to realised savings. Run the hub's automation and AI pipeline, from idea intake to business case, delivery and benefits tracking. Build a continuous improvement culture through training, recognition and a simple way for every employee to raise ideas. 5. People leadership, performance and culture Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave. Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state. Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings. Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots. Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day. Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers. 
 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE First 90 days: hub KPI framework, baseline method and ICC design signed off. By go-live: ICC live with real-time dashboards for the first transition wave, and the governance rhythm running. Within 1218 months: continuous improvement portfolio delivering measurable, validated benefits, with hub-wide dashboards trusted by global stakeholders. 
 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS Hub-wide SLA adherence: 95% across towers Validated CI benefits: Annual savings and hours released against target Automation hours released: Increased year on year Reporting timeliness and accuracy: 100% on schedule Hub CSAT / NPS: At or above target Audit and quality findings: Closed within agreed timelines CI participation: % of employees who submitted or delivered an improvement Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines. 
 TECHNICAL SKILLS Performance management and command-centre design for multi-tower shared services. Lean Six Sigma methods, including DMAIC, value-stream mapping and root-cause analysis. Data analytics and visualisation (Power BI or Tableau). SQL or data-modelling skills are an advantage. Process mining (Celonis, Signavio or similar) and automation pipeline management (RPA, AI). ITIL service level management and quality management systems. Benefits realisation and business case development. 
 LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES Customer-centric leadership Builds teams from zero Drives change and adoption Sound judgement under pressure Influences without authority across countries Data-led decision making Coaches and develops talent Holds a high bar on control 
 EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS Essential 15+ years of experience, including 7+ years in shared services performance, excellence or transformation roles. Has built and run an ICC, command centre or equivalent governance function. Has deployed continuous improvement frameworks across multi-tower shared services centres. Lean Six Sigma Black Belt. Master's degree in Business, HR, Engineering or a related field. Preferred Transition PMO experience Process mining certification Change management certification (Prosci or equivalent) 
 KEY STAKEHOLDERS Hub Director, all tower GPOs, Global HR leadership, HR technology and data teams, Finance, Internal Audit, transformation partners.

title: Service Delivery Manager - Talent Acquisition
description:
Service Delivery Manager Talent Acquisition Global Process Owner, Talent Acquisition Operations (R2H) 
 Tower: Recruit to Hire (R2H) Location: Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub) Reports to: HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida Role type: People manager Scope: Requisition management, sourcing support, interview scheduling, offer management, pre-employment checks and onboarding 
 ABOUT THE HUB Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards. 
 ROLE PURPOSE You own the recruitment and onboarding engine for every country moving into Noida. You will replace fragmented local practices with one standard, compliant and fast hiring process. Hiring managers should get the talent they need quickly, and every candidate should get a consistent, high-quality experience. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Transition and shared services set-up Map current recruitment and onboarding practice in each country, including steps, tools, vendors, volumes and cycle times, and set the baseline. Design the R2H target operating model. Define what moves to the hub, what stays with in-country recruiters and business partners, and what goes to vendors or RPO partners. Lead country-by-country transition, covering knowledge transfer, template and offer-letter harmonisation, and stabilisation after cutover. Set up the hub's scheduling, offer and onboarding desks, with capacity models tied to hiring forecasts. 2. Process ownership and service delivery Act as Global Process Owner for R2H. Own the standard process from requisition to day one, including approval rules and local variations. Manage recruitment and background-check vendors across markets. Scorecard them on time-to-fill, quality of hire, diversity and cost. Map the candidate journey from end to end, remove friction points, and lift offer acceptance and employer-brand scores. Deliver a consistent onboarding experience. New joiners should have their systems, equipment and paperwork ready on day one. Act as the escalation point for hiring managers and TA partners on service issues. 3. Governance, risk and controls Work with Legal, Compliance and country HR to keep every step compliant with local labour law, right-to-work rules and data privacy law. Own controls over offer approvals, compensation within band, and the retention and deletion of candidate data. Embed BV's DEI standards in sourcing, shortlisting and vendor contracts, and report on them regularly. 4. Continuous improvement and digital Drive full ATS adoption and automate scheduling, offer generation and e-signature. Introduce AI-enabled tools for screening and scheduling, with fairness and privacy safeguards. Use funnel analytics to find where time is lost, and fix causes at their source. 5. People leadership, performance and culture Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave. Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state. Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings. Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots. Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day. Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers. 
 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE First 90 days: TA baseline, R2H operating model and vendor strategy agreed. By go-live: scheduling, offer and onboarding desks live for the first wave of countries. Within 1218 months: measurable cuts in time-to-hire and higher candidate NPS across the regions in scope. 
 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS Time to offer / time to fill: Reduced against the country baseline Offer TAT: 95% Candidate NPS: +40 Hiring manager satisfaction: 4.3 / 5 Day-one readiness: 98% of joiners fully set up Vendor SLA adherence: 95% Cost per hire: Reduced against baseline 
 Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines. 
 TECHNICAL SKILLS End-to-end recruitment operations at volume, including high-volume and multi-country hiring. Management of recruitment vendors, RPO partners and background-screening providers. ATS and onboarding platforms (Workday Recruiting, SuccessFactors RCM/ONB, iCIMS or similar). Candidate experience design, journey mapping and employer-brand metrics. Recruitment compliance covering labour law, right to work and GDPR for candidate data. Recruitment analytics and capacity forecasting. 
 LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES Customer-centric leadership Builds teams from zero Drives change and adoption Sound judgement under pressure Influences without authority across countries Data-led decision making Coaches and develops talent Holds a high bar on control 
 EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS Essential 15+ years in HR, including 8+ years leading talent acquisition operations. Has led a TA transition into shared services or an RPO model. Has managed hiring volumes of 3,000+ per year across several countries. Master's degree in HR, Business or a related field. Preferred Experience in the testing, inspection and certification (TIC), engineering or professional services sectors Lean Six Sigma Green Belt Experience deploying AI recruitment tools 
 KEY STAKEHOLDERS Hub Director, Global TA leadership, hiring managers, country HR, Legal and Compliance, recruitment and screening vendors, IT relevant.

description:
Job Description Structural Packaging Designer (AutoCAD) 
 Company: YUTO Printing & Packaging (India) Pvt. Ltd.
 Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh
 Department: Engineering / Packaging Design
 Experience: 2+ Years 
 Job Summary We are looking for a skilled Structural Packaging Designer with experience in AutoCAD and the printing and packaging industry. The candidate will be responsible for developing packaging structures, preparing KLDs (Key Line Drawings), creating prototypes, and optimizing packaging designs to meet customer requirements, cost targets, and production feasibility. 
 Qualifications & Experience Diploma / B.Tech in Printing & Packaging, B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, or any relevant graduate qualification preferred. Minimum 2 years of experience in structural packaging design using AutoCAD. Experience in folding cartons, rigid boxes, and corrugated boxes within the printing and packaging industry is preferred. Key Responsibilities Develop packaging KLDs using AutoCAD based on customer specifications and requirements. Design and develop structural packaging solutions for folding cartons, rigid boxes, and corrugated boxes. Create physical prototypes using a sample maker and validate structural integrity, dimensions, fit, and functionality. Modify and optimize existing packaging designs to reduce costs, minimize material consumption, and improve production feasibility. Coordinate with internal teams, including Engineering, Design, Production, and Quality, to ensure smooth execution of packaging projects. Ensure packaging designs meet customer requirements and manufacturing standards. Review packaging dimensions, folding sequences, and structural details before prototype approval. Support the development of new packaging solutions and continuous improvement initiatives. Skills Required Proficiency in AutoCAD, including 2D/3D design and rendering. Knowledge of packaging materials such as paperboard, corrugated board, and rigid board. Understanding of Adobe Illustrator artwork alignment and its application to structural packaging designs. Knowledge of packaging structures, dielines, folding mechanisms, and material utilization. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills. Ability to coordinate with cross-functional teams and meet project deadlines. Preferred Candidate Profile Candidates with hands-on experience in structural packaging design, prototype development, and packaging optimization in the printing and packaging industry will be preferred.

title: Warehouse Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities: 
 Company: Ajfan International
 Job Title: Warehouse Manager
 Job Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu
 Experience: 15-20 Years
 Industry Preference: FMCG / Retail 
 Job Summary: Ajfan International is looking for an experienced and result-oriented Warehouse Manager to oversee warehouse operations in Chennai. The ideal candidate should have 15-20 years of experience in FMCG warehouse management, with strong expertise in inventory control, warehouse planning, logistics coordination, team management, and process optimization. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Manage end-to-end warehouse operations, including receiving, storage, inventory management, order processing, picking, packing, and dispatch. Oversee the receipt, inspection, and proper storage of incoming goods, ensuring accuracy against purchase orders and invoices. Maintain accurate inventory records and ensure regular stock reconciliation and physical stock audits. Monitor stock levels, expiry dates, batch numbers, and product traceability, particularly for food and FMCG products. Implement FIFO/FEFO practices to minimize stock ageing, expiry, damage, and wastage. Ensure timely and accurate order fulfilment and dispatch to retail outlets, distributors, and other business locations. Coordinate with procurement, sales, accounts, logistics, and retail operations teams for smooth supply chain activities. Optimize warehouse space utilization, storage systems, material handling, and manpower deployment. Ensure proper documentation of goods received, goods issued, stock transfers, returns, damaged goods, and dispatches. Monitor warehouse operating costs and implement measures to improve productivity and reduce operational expenses. Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, housekeeping, fire safety, and workplace safety standards, wherever applicable. Manage warehouse systems, ERP/WMS software, and reporting processes to maintain accurate and real-time stock visibility. 
 Required Qualifications: 
 15-20 years of overall experience , with substantial hands-on experience in FMCG warehouse management. Proven experience managing large-scale warehouses, high-volume inventory, and distribution operations. Strong knowledge of warehouse management systems, inventory control, stock reconciliation, and supply chain processes. Experience with ERP systems, WMS, MS Excel, and warehouse reporting tools. title: Service Delivery Manager - HR Administration
description:
Service Delivery Manager HR Administration Global Process Owner, HR Administration & Employee Lifecycle (A2W) 
 Tower: Administer to Work (A2W) Location: Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub) Reports to: HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida Role type: People manager Scope: Employee data management, lifecycle events (joiners, movers, leavers), HR documentation, time and attendance, and records management 
 ABOUT THE HUB Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards. 
 ROLE PURPOSE You own HR administration and employee data for every country moving into Noida. You will replace manual, country-specific administration with one digital, standardised lifecycle process. The goal is employee data that stays accurate, compliant and trusted, because every other tower depends on it. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Transition and shared services set-up Map current joiner, mover and leaver processes, document practices and time-and-attendance set-ups in each country, and set the baseline. Design the A2W target operating model, covering data ownership, maker-checker rules, local document requirements and handoffs to R2P and R2H. Lead country-by-country transition, including data cleansing before migration, knowledge transfer and stabilisation. Retire legacy manual and fragmented time-and-attendance tools as each country moves across. 2. Process ownership and service delivery Act as Global Process Owner for A2W. Own lifecycle process standards for internal moves, promotions, demotions, transfers, contract changes and exits. Own employee master-data quality through validation rules, regular audits and data-quality dashboards. Run offboarding that is compliant and humane, covering final documents, access removal, knowledge transfer and exit feedback. Integrate time and attendance with payroll, with near-real-time sync and a minimum of manual touchpoints. Act as the escalation point for lifecycle and data issues. 3. Governance, risk and controls Own controls on data changes, including maker-checker, audit trails and privileged-access reviews. Keep records retention and data privacy compliant with GDPR and local law in every country. Hold audit-ready evidence for all lifecycle transactions. 4. Continuous improvement and digital Digitise HR administration end to end through automated document generation, e-signature and digital personnel files. Automate high-volume transactions with RPA and workflow tools. Use workforce data and predictive analytics to support planning in the business. 5. People leadership, performance and culture Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave. Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state. Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings. Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots. Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day. Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers. 
 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE First 90 days: A2W operating model, data-quality baseline and document-digitisation plan agreed. By go-live: lifecycle administration live in Noida for the first wave, with controls running. Within 1218 months: e-signature and digital files adopted across the countries in scope, with data accuracy at target. 
 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS Transaction accuracy: 99% Transaction SLA adherence: 95% Employee data quality index: 98% Digital document / e-signature adoption: 90% of in-scope documents Time-and-attendance to payroll exceptions: Reduced against baseline Cost per transaction: Year-on-year reduction Audit outcome: No high-rated findings Targets are indicative. They will be finalized in the hub SLA framework and country baselines. 
 TECHNICAL SKILLS HR administration and employee lifecycle management across several countries. Core HRIS (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central), including data model and security roles. Data governance and data-quality management. Document management, e-signature (DocuSign or Adobe Sign) and digital records. Time and attendance platforms and their integration with payroll. Workflow automation and RPA. LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES Customer-centric leadership Builds teams from zero Drives change and adoption Sound judgement under pressure Influences without authority across countries Data-led decision making Coaches and develops talent Holds a high bar on control 
 EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS Essential 15+ years in HR, including 7+ years leading HR administration in shared services. Has led the transition and standardisation of lifecycle processes across several countries. Has delivered HR document digitisation or a time-and-attendance transformation. Coordinate with department heads and project managers to forecast manpower requirements and ensure timely deployment. HR Operations & Administration Independently manage day-to-day HR functions for corporate office employees and project site personnel. Maintain employee records, attendance, leave, payroll inputs and HR documentation. Develop, implement and monitor HR policies, SOPs and employee service standards. Coordinate employee mobilization, deputation, site transfers and demobilization as per project requirements. Coordinate with contractors and project teams to monitor contract labour documentation and statutory compliance. Maintain statutory records and support audits, inspections, registrations and renewals. Liaise with statutory authorities, labour consultants and external agencies whenever required. 4. Coordinate with department heads to establish measurable performance expectations and KPIs. Identify employee training, competency development and skill enhancement requirements. Support succession planning, career development and retention of key employees. 5. Employee Relations & Engagement Act as a bridge between management, corporate employees and project site teams. Address employee grievances, workplace concerns, disciplinary matters and conflicts professionally. Promote employee engagement, accountability, collaboration and a positive organizational culture. Ensure consistent implementation of workplace policies, professional conduct and POSH requirements. 6. HR Strategy, MIS & Management Support Prepare periodic HR MIS reports covering manpower strength, recruitment, attrition, attendance, statutory compliance and HR costs. Monitor manpower utilization and support workforce cost optimization across projects. Work closely with senior management on HR planning, policy improvements and organizational growth. Develop scalable HR systems and processes suitable for a growing multi-location EPC organization. Required Qualifications MBA / PGDM in Human Resource Management, MSW (HR) or equivalent postgraduate qualification. 712 years of relevant HR experience, preferably including at least 3 years in EPC, engineering, construction, infrastructure or industrial project organizations. Prior experience managing HR operations across multiple project sites and states is highly desirable. Practical exposure to project-site manpower management and statutory labour compliance is essential. Required Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws, statutory compliance and contract labour management. Proven experience in technical recruitment and manpower planning. Ability to independently manage corporate and project-site HR operations. Strong interpersonal, communication, negotiation and conflict-resolution skills. Ability to coordinate effectively with engineers, project managers, site teams, contractors and senior management. Proficiency in MS Excel, HR MIS, payroll systems and HRMS software. Strong organizational skills, problem-solving ability and attention to detail. High integrity, confidentiality, ownership and a solution-oriented approach. Good command of English, Hindi and Gujarati ; ability to communicate with employees across different states will be an advantage. Willingness to travel to project locations as required. Role & responsibilities 

 Preferred candidate profile We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked in EPC companies, industrial construction organizations, engineering companies or multi-site project environments , and understand the practical HR challenges of managing both office-based professionals and project-site workforces. title: Order Processing Executive
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION 
 ORDER PROCESSING EXECUTIVE 
 Experience Required: 23 Years in Order Processing / IT Hardware Industry 
 Location: Bangalore 
 Job Type: Full-time 
 An order processing executive manages incoming customer purchases from entry to final 
 shipment. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Order Entry and Verification: Receive and input purchase details, prices, and customer 
 information accurately into the company's software. 
 Inventory Coordination: Check stock levels to confirm product availability before fulfilling 
 requests. 
 Shipping and Logistics: Work with the warehouse team to ensure goods are picked, packed, 
 and labeled correctly for on-time delivery. 
 Customer Support: Answer buyer questions regarding delivery times, tracking, and order 
 status. 
 Issue Resolution: Handle returns, order cancellations, and payment discrepancies quickly. 
 1.Receiving Inventory 
 Unload incoming goods from suppliers or manufacturers. 
 Inspect items for damage and verify quantities match the purchase order. 
 Log the items into the inventory management system. 
 2.Storing Inventory 
 Move goods to short- or long-term storage in the warehouse. 
 Organize products logicallyoften placing fast-moving items in easily accessible locations 
 Label products with barcodes or tags for fast tracking. 
 3.Processing Orders 
 Begin when a customer places an order online or in-store. 
 Verify payment confirmation and check real-time stock availability. 
 Generate a digital packing slip for the warehouse. 
 www.tecqnio.com 
 
 
 
 4. Picking 
 Workers or warehouse robots use the packing slip to locate items. 
 Retrieve the correct sizes, colors, and quantities from shelves. 
 Use barcode scanners to reduce human error. 
 5. Packing 
 Select appropriate boxes, mailers, and padding (like bubble wrap) to protect goods. 
 Keep package weight and size as low as possible to reduce shipping costs. 
 Seal the box and apply the shipping label. 
 6. Shipping 
 Hand off the packed boxes to a logistics carrier (like a postal service or freight line). 
 Provide tracking information to the customer. 
 Dispatch the shipment on a transport vehicle. 
 7. Processing Returns 
 Handle items sent back by customers due to size, defects, or preference. 
 Inspect returned goods to see if they can be restocked. 
 Issue refunds or exchanges and update inventory logs.

 The Sales Support Manager is the primary interface between the Sales Team, Customers, and the Technical Services function for all non-infrastructure product lines. 
 The role is responsible for ensuring that customer technical queries, complaints, development requests, qualification activities, certifications, approvals, and tender requirements are properly captured, tracked, followed up, communicated, and closed.

 Customer Query Management & Closure Serve as the single point of contact for all customer technical and product-related enquiries received through the Sales team. Log, track, prioritize, and monitor all customer requests through closure. Route all technical requirements to the Technical Services Manager for technical evaluation and response. Ensure timely communication of approved responses back to customers and the Sales team. Maintain visibility of open items, pending actions, response commitments, and closure status. Escalate overdue or unresolved issues appropriately. 
 Sales Team Support 
 Act as the primary support resource for all technical-commercial coordination required by the Sales team. Ensure all technical support requests flow through a structured process. Support customer reviews, business discussions, technical-commercial meetings, and project updates. Coordinate internal follow-up required to meet customer commitments. Provide Sales personnel with clear and timely status updates on all open items. 
 Customer Call Reports & Action Management

Maintain centralized trackers for all customer commitments. Follow up internally to ensure agreed actions are completed on time. Report ageing and overdue actions to management. Customer Complaint Coordination 
 Coordinate customer complaint management activities from receipt to closure. Work through the Technical Services Manager to obtain investigation findings, corrective actions, and status updates. Ensure timely communication with customers regarding progress and resolution. Maintain complaint history, lessons learned, and closure records. 
 Qualification, Trial & Development Program Coordination 
 Track customer evaluation programs, sample requests, trials, and qualification activities. Coordinate progress reviews with the Technical Services Manager. Monitor qualification milestones and approval status. Ensure timely completion of actions required for customer approvals. 
 Aerospace, Defence, Certification & Tender Support
