Support Aerospace and Defense customer approval processes and supplier-registration activities. Ensure milestone dates and submission deadlines are achieved. 
 Documentation & Information Management 
 Maintain customer-facing records relating to certifications, approvals, technical submissions, customer requirements, and actions. Ensure Sales teams have access to the latest approved product and technical information received from Technical Services. Maintain organized records of customer correspondence and project status. 
 Reporting & Governance 
 Maintain dashboards and trackers covering: Customer queries, Complaints, Trials and qualifications, Certification activities Tender submissions, Open customer actions, Approval programs. Provide periodic management reports on status, risks, delays, and support requirements. Drive accountability for closure of customer commitments. 

 Education 
 Bachelors degree in engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, Polymer, Composites, Aerospace, Industrial or equivalent). MBA preferred. 
 Experience 
 7–12 years of experience in sales support, customer support, project coordination, product management, application support, or technical-commercial roles. Experience working with industrial customers in composites, aerospace, defense, automotive, transportation, manufacturing, chemicals, or advanced materials industries. Strong experience managing customer-facing projects involving multiple internal stakeholders.

Good written English and basic copywriting ability. Understanding of LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp and Google Business Profile. title: Marketing Executive
description:
Company Name: Eye-Q Eye Hospitals 
Job Title: Marketing Executive 

Job Description: 
As a Marketing Executive at Eye-Q Eye Hospitals, you will play a key role in promoting our services and enhancing our brand visibility. You will be responsible for developing and implementing marketing strategies to attract new patients and retain existing ones. Your duties will include conducting market research, analyzing consumer behavior, and identifying trends to optimize marketing efforts. You will collaborate with various teams to create promotional materials, manage social media accounts, organize events, and establish partnerships with local organizations and healthcare providers. 

Key Responsibilities: 
- Develop and execute comprehensive marketing plans to increase patient footfall. 
- Conduct market research to identify opportunities for growth and areas for improvement. 
- Create engaging content for various platforms, including social media, website, and newsletters. 
- Monitor and analyze campaign performance and make data-driven adjustments. 
- Collaborate with the design team to produce high-quality marketing collateral. 
- Organize health camps, seminars, and other outreach activities to promote eye health. 
- Maintain relationships with referral sources and community partners. 
- Participate in the development of budgets and forecasts for marketing initiatives.

Skills and Tools Required: 
- Strong understanding of marketing principles and digital marketing strategies. 
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
- Proficiency in social media marketing and content creation. 
- Familiarity with analytics tools to measure campaign performance (e.g., Google Analytics, social media insights). 
- Experience with graphic design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Canva) is a plus. 
- Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment. 
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 
- Knowledge of the healthcare industry, particularly ophthalmology, is preferred. 

Join Eye-Q Eye Hospitals as a Marketing Executive and contribute to our mission of providing the best eye care services while promoting eye health awareness in the community.
 Roles and Responsibilities 
About the Role: 
As a Marketing Executive at Eye-Q Eye Hospitals, you will play a pivotal role in driving the hospital's marketing initiatives. You will be responsible for developing and implementing marketing strategies to enhance brand awareness and attract new patients. Your creativity and analytical skills will be essential in tailoring campaigns that resonate with our target audience.

About the Team: 
You will join a dynamic and collaborative marketing team that is passionate about promoting eye healthcare. The team consists of professionals with diverse backgrounds in marketing, communications, and healthcare. You will have the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues and contribute to a supportive and innovative work environment.

You are Responsible for: 
- Creating and executing marketing campaigns across various channels, including digital and print media. 
- Analyzing market trends and patient feedback to refine marketing strategies. 
- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure cohesive messaging and branding. 
- Managing social media accounts and engaging with the online community to enhance brand presence. 
- Tracking and reporting on campaign performance metrics to gauge effectiveness and inform future strategies.

To succeed in this role – you should have the following: 
- A degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field. 
- Proven experience in marketing, preferably within the healthcare sector. 
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills to engage effectively with various stakeholders. 
- Familiarity with digital marketing tools and analytics platforms. 
- A creative mindset with the ability to think strategically to drive brand initiatives.

Job Description - 
 Purchase Manager 

 Employee Name: Santosh pawar
 Company: Anjali T. Precision
 Position: Purchase Manager
 Department: Purchase
 Reporting To: Plant Head / Operations Head
 Location: Nighoje & Chikhali Unit 
 Employement Type: Full Time
 ______________________________________________________________________________________ 

 Position Summary 
The Purchase Head is responsible for leading and managing the organization's end-to-end procurement function by developing strategic sourcing plans, ensuring uninterrupted availability of raw materials, bought-out parts, consumables, tooling, capital equipment, services, and indirect materials required for manufacturing operations. The role is accountable for driving procurement excellence through effective supplier management, cost optimization, inventory planning, commercial negotiations, statutory compliance, and cross-functional collaboration.
The incumbent shall establish robust procurement processes, strengthen supplier relationships, improve procurement efficiency, and ensure the achievement of Quality, Cost, and Delivery (QCD) objectives. The Purchase Head is also responsible for leading the purchase team, monitoring departmental KPIs, implementing digital task management practices, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational performance and business profitability.

 Key Roles & Responsibilities 
 1. Procurement Strategy & Planning 
 Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with the company's business objectives and operational requirements. Prepare annual procurement plans, sourcing strategies, and departmental budgets. Ensure uninterrupted availability of raw materials, bought-out parts, consumables, tooling, capital equipment, maintenance spares, and indirect materials. Establish procurement plans based on production forecasts, inventory levels, and customer demand. Drive strategic sourcing initiatives to improve procurement efficiency and supply chain reliability. Support business expansion through effective procurement planning and supplier development. 
 2. Vendor Development & Supplier Management 
 Identify, evaluate, qualify, and approve new suppliers based on Quality, Cost, Delivery, and Technical Capability. Build long-term strategic relationships with key suppliers. Conduct supplier audits, capability assessments, and performance reviews. Monitor supplier performance using predefined KPIs and implement corrective actions where required. Lead supplier development initiatives to improve quality, delivery performance, responsiveness, and cost competitiveness. Resolve supplier-related quality, delivery, and commercial issues in coordination with internal stakeholders. 
 3. Purchase Operations & Material Procurement 
 Oversee procurement of all direct and indirect materials required for manufacturing operations. Ensure timely release and follow-up of Purchase Orders (POs). Monitor order acknowledgements, supplier commitments, and delivery schedules. Coordinate with PPC, Production, Stores, Quality, Maintenance, NPD, and Finance to ensure smooth material flow. Ensure critical materials are available to avoid production interruptions. Monitor procurement lead times and expedite urgent material requirements whenever necessary. Ensure adherence to approved procurement procedures and authorization matrices. 
 4. Commercial Negotiation & Cost Management 
 Lead commercial negotiations for pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, warranty conditions, and contractual obligations. Develop and implement annual cost reduction and value engineering initiatives. Analyse market trends, commodity prices, and raw material fluctuations to support strategic sourcing decisions. Identify opportunities for supplier consolidation and procurement optimization. Achieve cost savings without compromising product quality or delivery performance. Monitor procurement budgets and control overall purchasing expenditure. 
 5. Contract Management & Compliance 
 Finalize supplier contracts, annual rate agreements, and long-term supply agreements. Ensure all commercial agreements comply with company policies and statutory regulations. Maintain procurement documentation in accordance with ISO 9001, IATF 16949, and internal quality management systems. Ensure compliance with applicable legal, environmental, and ethical procurement standards. Support internal, customer, and external audits by maintaining complete procurement records and documentation. 
 6. Inventory & Supply Chain Coordination 
 Monitor inventory levels and procurement schedules to maintain optimum stock levels. Coordinate closely with Stores to minimize excess inventory while preventing stock-outs. Review slow-moving, non-moving, and obsolete inventory and initiate corrective actions. Collaborate with PPC and Production to align procurement with manufacturing schedules. Improve inventory turnover through effective procurement planning. 
 7. Cross-Functional Coordination 
 Work closely with PPC, Production, Stores, Quality Assurance, Finance, NPD, Maintenance, HR, and Operations to ensure smooth procurement operations. Support new product development by sourcing new materials, components, and suppliers. Participate in cross-functional meetings to resolve supply chain challenges. Ensure effective communication between suppliers and internal departments. 
 8. Team Leadership & Performance Management 
 Lead, mentor, and develop the Purchase Department team. Allocate responsibilities and monitor workload distribution. Establish departmental objectives, KPIs, and performance targets. Conduct periodic performance reviews and provide coaching for continuous improvement. Identify training needs and support employee skill development. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning. 
 9. MIS, Reporting & Performance Monitoring 
 Prepare and present daily, weekly, and monthly procurement reports to management. Monitor procurement KPIs and supplier performance metrics. Analyse procurement data to identify cost-saving opportunities and operational improvements. Prepare monthly purchase budget reports and cost-saving analysis. Track procurement lead times, supplier delivery performance, and purchasing efficiency. Maintain accurate procurement records and dashboards for management review. 
 10. Digital Task Management & Reporting 
The Purchase Head shall ensure disciplined implementation of digital task management and performance reporting across the Purchase Department.
 Responsibilities 
 Use Microsoft Planner daily to plan, assign, monitor, and review all departmental procurement activities. Review all assigned tasks at the beginning of each working day and ensure timely completion within defined deadlines. Assign and delegate procurement activities to Purchase Managers, Purchase Engineers, Buyers, and departmental team members through Microsoft Planner. Monitor task progress, follow up on pending activities, and ensure timely closure of all assigned tasks. Update task status with appropriate remarks, supporting documents, and completion evidence. Conduct daily Planner review meetings with the purchase team to monitor operational progress. Escalate overdue or delayed procurement activities to the Operations Head along with corrective action plans. Fill and review the Daily Progress Report in the designated Google Sheet before the end of every working day. Ensure all completed work, pending purchase orders, supplier follow-ups, delivery delays, commercial issues, and action plans are accurately recorded. Maintain complete transparency, accountability, and digital tracking of all procurement activities. 
 11. Continuous Improvement 
 Drive Lean Procurement and continuous improvement initiatives. Identify opportunities to automate procurement processes and improve operational efficiency. Standardize procurement procedures and documentation. Reduce procurement cycle time and improve supplier responsiveness. Promote innovation, value engineering, and strategic sourcing practices to enhance business competitiveness.

title: Service Delivery Manager - Payroll
description:
Service Delivery Manager Payroll Global Process Owner, Payroll & Reward Operations (R2P) 
 Tower: Reward to Pay (R2P) Location: Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub) Reports to: HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida Role type: People manager Scope: Multi-country payroll, benefits administration, compensation changes, payroll accounting and tax filings 
 ABOUT THE HUB Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards. 
 ROLE PURPOSE You own payroll and reward delivery end to end for every country moving into Noida. You will move payroll from dozens of local vendors and in-country teams to a controlled, consolidated model. Employees must be paid accurately and on time, in every cycle and in every country, throughout the transition and after it. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Transition and shared services set-up Lead the payroll transition roadmap country by country, sequenced by risk, complexity, headcount and vendor contract dates. Run knowledge transfer from country payroll teams and vendors. This covers desk procedures, statutory calendars, pay elements and local exceptions. Plan and run parallel payroll runs for each country. Set clear go/no-go criteria based on variance thresholds, and use hypercare after cutover. Deliver the global payroll vendor consolidation programme. Rationalise the vendor portfolio, support selection, and manage exit and onboarding without disrupting pay. Design the target operating model for R2P, covering the split of work between hub, vendor and country HR, with RACI, handoffs and cut-off calendars. 2. Process ownership and service delivery Act as Global Process Owner for R2P. Own process standards, the global pay calendar, the design of allowed variations, and change control. Deliver zero critical payroll errors per cycle through pre-payroll reconciliations, input validation, dual approval and post-pay checks. Monitor data flows between the HRIS, time-and-attendance, payroll engines and the general ledger. Resolve interface breaks before cut-off. Manage payroll vendors against contractual SLAs, with monthly scorecards, quarterly business reviews and service credits where needed. Act as the escalation point for pay issues. Run root-cause analysis on every off-cycle payment and track the fix through to closure. 3. Governance, risk and controls Build and maintain the R2P control framework, including key controls, segregation of duties, access reviews and evidence standards. Lead annual and ad-hoc audit readiness with Internal Audit, Tax and Finance. Close findings within the agreed timelines. Track statutory and regulatory change in every in-scope country. Implement change before its effective date. Protect employee pay data in line with GDPR and local privacy law. 4. Continuous improvement and digital Standardise pay elements and processes across countries. Reduce local exceptions to the minimum required by law. Automate reconciliations, variance analysis and exception reporting using RPA and analytics. Drive employee self-service for payslips, tax documents and pay queries to reduce inbound contacts. 5. People leadership, performance and culture Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave. Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state. Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings. Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots. Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day. Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers. 
 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE First 90 days: R2P operating model, country wave plan and control framework signed off. By go-live: first wave of countries live in Noida after successful parallel runs. Within 12–18 months: vendor consolidation on track, zero critical errors sustained, and a clean audit outcome. 
 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS Indicative target Payroll accuracy: 99.5% of payslips error-free; zero critical errors On-time payment: 100% of payrolls paid on the scheduled date Off-cycle payments: Reduced quarter on quarter; every case root-caused Statutory compliance: Zero penalties; 100% filings on time Vendor SLA adherence: 98% against contracted SLAs Cost per payslip: Year-on-year reduction against baseline Audit outcome: No high-rated findings 
 Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines. 
 TECHNICAL SKILLS Deep multi-country payroll expertise covering gross-to-net, statutory deductions, tax and social security, and year-end. Payroll vendor and aggregator management (for example ADP, Ramco, Alight, or in-country providers), including contract and SLA governance. Payroll controls, SOX-style frameworks and audit management. Integration of HRIS (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors) with time and payroll systems, including interface monitoring. Payroll accounting, GL reconciliation and working knowledge of benefits administration. Parallel-run design, cutover planning and hypercare. 
 LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES Builds teams from zero Customer-centric leadership Drives change and adoption Sound judgement under pressure Influences without authority across countries Data-led decision making Coaches and develops talent Holds a high bar on control 
 EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS Essential 15+ years in HR operations, including 8+ years leading multi-country payroll. Has led at least one payroll transition or vendor consolidation into a shared services centre. Has run payroll for 10,000+ employees across several jurisdictions. Master's degree in HR, Finance, Business or a related field. Preferred Payroll certification (CPP, FPC, CIPP or equivalent) Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or above Experience across Europe, Middle East, Africa or APAC payroll 
 KEY STAKEHOLDERS Hub Director, Global Reward and Payroll leadership, Finance and Tax, Internal Audit, country HR leads, payroll vendors, HRIS team, IT relevant.

title: Accountant
description:
PHITECH SOLUTIONS 
High-Voltage Testing Equipment & Services | Nashik, Maharashtra
 JOB DESCRIPTION: ACCOUNTANT 
 Job Title Accountant Company Phitech Solutions LocationPlot No. 12B, Survey No. 166/5 , Shree Gajanan Industrial Area, Vilholi, Nashik 422010, Maharashtra, India. Job Type Full time Reports To Director / Finance Head Experience 2 to 5 years in accounts (manufacturing or service company is a plus) About Us 
Phitech Solutions is a Nashik-based company that makes and services high-voltage testing equipment. We help power utilities, laboratories and manufacturers with repair, retrofitting and replacement of their equipment, GIS/AIS maintenance, SF6 gas services and testing instruments. We have over 16 years of field experience, a team of 30+ people, and clients in India and abroad, including Turkey and Malaysia.
As we grow, we need a careful and honest accountant who can keep our money records clean and on time.
 What You Will Do 
 Your main job is to keep our books correct and make sure all taxes and payments are done on time. 
 Record daily entries for sales, purchases, expenses, receipts and payments in Tally (or similar software).
 Make sales invoices, quotations and credit/debit notes as per project and customer details.
¢ Check supplier bills and match them with purchase orders and goods received before payment.
¢ Follow up with customers for pending payments and keep a list of what is due and from whom.
¢ Pay suppliers, vendors and service providers on time and keep their accounts matched.
¢ Prepare and file GST returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B), and do GST input credit matching.
¢ Calculate, deduct, pay and file TDS. Help with Professional Tax and other statutory dues.
¢ Do bank reconciliation every month and track cash and bank balances.
¢ Handle import and export paperwork with our CA or agents, including foreign payments and invoices.
¢ Keep track of stock records and costs with the store and purchase team.
¢ Help prepare monthly salary and keep records of advances and expenses of site teams.
¢ Prepare monthly reports such as profit and loss, expense summary, and payment due lists for management.
¢ Work with our CA and auditor for audit, income tax, and year-end closing.
¢ Keep all bills, vouchers and files in order, on paper and on computer.
 What We Are Looking For 
¢ B.Com or M.Com (or any commerce degree). Additional courses in accounting or taxation are welcome.
¢ Good working knowledge of Tally ERP / Tally Prime and MS Excel.
¢ Clear understanding of GST, TDS and basic accounting rules.
¢ Able to read and understand bills, invoices and bank statements without mistakes.
¢ Basic English and Hindi (Marathi is a plus) to talk with clients, vendors and the team.
¢ Honest, careful with numbers, and able to meet deadlines.
¢ Able to work well with the sales, purchase, store and site teams.
 Good to Have 
¢ Experience in a manufacturing, electrical or engineering company.
¢ Knowledge of import/export, customs and foreign currency payments.
¢ Knowledge of costing and project-wise accounting.
 Skills We Value 
¢ Attention to small details.
¢ Keeping company information private.
¢ Good time management when many tasks come together.
¢ Willingness to learn and improve processes.
¢ Clear and polite communication.
 What You Get 
¢ A stable job in a growing company with a respected name in the power industry.
¢ A friendly team of engineers, technicians and professionals.
¢ Chance to learn about import, export and project-based accounting.
¢ Salary based on your skills and experience (to be discussed at interview).
 How to Apply 
Send your updated resume to admin@phitech.in / info@phitech.in with the subject line "Application for Accountant", or fill the form on the Careers page at www.phitech.in/career.html.
You can also call us on +91 9111579212 or +91 7827073388.

 Manage bank reconciliation, payment planning and vendor payment schedules. Prepare receivables ageing, payables ageing and outstanding reports. Provide financial analysis and reports to management for decision-making.

You will lead a team of Quality Analysts and Team Leads, own the quality metrics, and work directly with client stakeholders. As customer conversations move from human agents to voice bots and AI, you will also help shape how we audit them.

title: Service Delivery Manager - Performance & Continuous Improvement
description:
Service Delivery Manager Performance & Continuous Improvement Intelligent Command Centre (ICC) & Transformation Lead all towers 
 Tower: Cross-tower: Performance, Governance & Continuous Improvement Location: Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub) Reports to: HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida Role type: People manager Scope: Intelligent Command Centre, SLA and KPI governance, continuous improvement portfolio, transition PMO support and hub quality management 
 ABOUT THE HUB Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards. 
 ROLE PURPOSE You are the hub's performance and improvement engine. You will build the Intelligent Command Centre that gives leaders one real-time view of service health across every tower. You will also run the continuous improvement system that moves the hub from stable operations to best-in-class service. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Transition and shared services set-up Design the hub's performance framework: a KPI tree, SLA definitions, data sources and a reporting cadence shared by all towers. Capture and certify the pre-transition baselines for each country, so the hub can prove its value against the starting point. Support the transition PMO with readiness scorecards, go/no-go dashboards and hypercare tracking for every wave. Set up the Intelligent Command Centre, covering architecture, data pipelines, dashboards and alerting. 2. Process ownership and service delivery Run the ICC day to day, with real-time SLA, volume, backlog and escalation monitoring across R2P, R2H, Q2R and A2W. Lead the hub's governance rhythm: daily stand-ups, weekly tower reviews, monthly service reviews and quarterly business reviews with stakeholders. Own the hub-wide customer voice programme, including CSAT and NPS surveys, closing the loop with respondents, and reporting insight. Run hub-level capacity and productivity analytics to support resourcing decisions. 3. Governance, risk and controls Own the hub quality management system, covering process documentation standards, internal quality audits and control testing across towers. Maintain the hub risk register and the tracking of issues and actions. Build data governance for performance reporting so that there is one version of the truth. 4. Continuous improvement and digital Build and govern the hub-wide continuous improvement backlog. Prioritise by value and effort, and agree ownership with each GPO. Lead improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma and process mining. Track benefits through to realised savings. Run the hub's automation and AI pipeline, from idea intake to business case, delivery and benefits tracking. Build a continuous improvement culture through training, recognition and a simple way for every employee to raise ideas. 5. People leadership, performance and culture Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave. Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state. Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings. Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots. Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day. Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers. 
 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE First 90 days: hub KPI framework, baseline method and ICC design signed off. By go-live: ICC live with real-time dashboards for the first transition wave, and the governance rhythm running. Within 1218 months: continuous improvement portfolio delivering measurable, validated benefits, with hub-wide dashboards trusted by global stakeholders. 
 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS Hub-wide SLA adherence: 95% across towers Validated CI benefits: Annual savings and hours released against target Automation hours released: Increased year on year Reporting timeliness and accuracy: 100% on schedule Hub CSAT / NPS: At or above target Audit and quality findings: Closed within agreed timelines CI participation: % of employees who submitted or delivered an improvement Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines. 
 TECHNICAL SKILLS Performance management and command-centre design for multi-tower shared services. Lean Six Sigma methods, including DMAIC, value-stream mapping and root-cause analysis. Data analytics and visualisation (Power BI or Tableau). SQL or data-modelling skills are an advantage. Process mining (Celonis, Signavio or similar) and automation pipeline management (RPA, AI). ITIL service level management and quality management systems. Benefits realisation and business case development. 
 LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES Customer-centric leadership Builds teams from zero Drives change and adoption Sound judgement under pressure Influences without authority across countries Data-led decision making Coaches and develops talent Holds a high bar on control 
 EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS Essential 15+ years of experience, including 7+ years in shared services performance, excellence or transformation roles. Has built and run an ICC, command centre or equivalent governance function. Has deployed continuous improvement frameworks across multi-tower shared services centres. Lean Six Sigma Black Belt. Master's degree in Business, HR, Engineering or a related field. Preferred Transition PMO experience Process mining certification Change management certification (Prosci or equivalent) 
 KEY STAKEHOLDERS Hub Director, all tower GPOs, Global HR leadership, HR technology and data teams, Finance, Internal Audit, transformation partners.

title: Business Development Manager, Dementia Care
description:
**Location**

: Bangalore (field-based, city-wide travel)

**Type**

: Full-time, permanent

**Experience**

:
5 to 8 years in healthcare sales or business development

**About Kareverse**

Kareverse helps families care for their ageing parents at home in Bengaluru. Each family gets a named care manager, regular home visits, weekly check-ins, 24/7 emergency response and doctor reviews.

We are now building a focused dementia support service for families living with memory loss. About 9 in 10 people with dementia in India are never formally diagnosed, and families who do get a diagnosis often leave the clinic with little help at home. We want to close that gap.

**Role summary**

You will build Kareverse's referral network with hospitals, memory clinics and doctors across Bengaluru, and turn it into a steady flow of families who need dementia support at home.

* Meet neurologists, psychiatrists, geriatricians and memory clinics to explain how Kareverse supports their patients after diagnosis
* Work with hospital discharge teams, social workers and care coordinators so families going home get connected to us
* Set up formal referral tie-ups with hospitals and clinics, including simple agreements on how patients are referred and followed up
* Speak with families who are referred, understand their situation and explain our dementia support plans
* Work closely with our care managers and clinical team for a smooth start of care
* Track every lead, referral source and conversion in our CRM
* Report weekly on referrals, conversions and what doctors and families are asking for
* Bring back feedback that helps us shape the service and pricing

**What we are looking for**

**Must have**

* 5 to 8 years in healthcare sales or business development, with at least 3 years calling on hospitals, clinics or doctors in Bengaluru
* Existing relationships with neurologists, psychiatrists, geriatricians or hospital discharge teams
* A track record of meeting referral or sales targets
* Comfort speaking with worried families, with patience and care
* Good spoken English and Kannada; Hindi or Tamil is a plus
* Own two-wheeler or car for daily field travel

**Good to have**

* Experience in home healthcare, elder care, rehab or neuro / CNS pharma sales
* Understanding of dementia, memory loss or other long-term conditions
* Experience setting up hospital tie-ups at an early-stage company
* Graduate degree; MBA, healthcare management or life sciences background is a plus

**Pay and benefits**

* Competitive fixed salary and performance-based variable pay
* A chance to build the dementia care business from the start and grow into a lead role as the team grows
* Work directly with senior leadership, C-suite executives and IIM graduates.
* Real ownership from day one: you will build our referral partner network.
* Meaningful work that helps families take better care of their ageing parents.

title: Cyber Security Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
This hybrid day shift role for a Cyber Security Analyst focuses on assessing and managing technology risk across enterprise systems while supporting business operations. The analyst will apply deep risk management experience to safeguard critical assets strengthen control environments and reduce exposure to evolving cyber threats. Experience in check processing domains is beneficial for understanding financial transaction risks and ensuring secure compliant operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Assess enterprise technology environments to identify cyber risks and control gaps applying risk management practices to prioritize remediation efforts that protect critical systems and data.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive risk registers that clearly document vulnerabilities threat scenarios impact ratings and mitigation plans to support transparent risk decisions by stakeholders.
* Conduct detailed risk assessments for new and existing applications infrastructure changes and third party services to ensure cyber risk is evaluated before deployment or integration.
* Collaborate with security engineering and operations teams to define practical risk reduction actions translate findings into clear requirements and ensure mitigation steps align with business needs.
* Monitor security alerts risk indicators and incident trends to detect emerging risk patterns and provide timely recommendations that strengthen defenses and reduce recurrence.
* Coordinate periodic control testing and validation activities to verify that implemented risk treatments are effective measurable and aligned with internal standards and regulatory obligations.
* Prepare concise risk reports and dashboards for management that highlight key risk drivers residual exposure levels and the progress of remediation initiatives across technology domains.
* Support policy and standard development by providing input based on observed risks and incidents ensuring that documented expectations are practical and aligned with recognized security frameworks.
* Advise project teams during system design and change initiatives to embed appropriate security controls ensuring risk considerations are addressed early and reducing the need for costly rework.
* Engage with business stakeholders to explain cyber risk in clear terms enabling informed decisions that balance protective measures with operational efficiency and customer impact.
* Apply knowledge of payment and transaction flows especially in check processing environments to identify fraud and operational risks and propose control enhancements that secure financial operations.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by documenting lessons learned from assessments and near miss events recommending updates to risk methodologies tools and processes for better outcomes.
* Maintain accurate and current documentation of risk management activities methodologies and outcomes to support audits compliance reviews and organizational learning.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate five to seven years of professional experience in cyber security roles focused on risk management including practical exposure to risk assessment mitigation planning and control evaluation.
* Possess strong knowledge of core risk management concepts such as likelihood analysis impact determination control effectiveness and residual risk calculation within technology environments.
* Apply familiarity with industry security frameworks and standards using them as references for designing and assessing controls across applications networks and data handling processes.
* Exhibit analytical skills to interpret complex technical information security alerts and vulnerability data translating them into understandable risk statements and prioritized actions.
* Utilize excellent communication abilities to prepare clear documentation risk reports and stakeholder updates that support decision making and foster shared understanding of cyber exposures.
* Bring working knowledge of financial or payment processing domains including check processing to enhance understanding of transaction risks and to guide secure process and system design.

title: Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
description:
**Job Position:**
Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst serves as a senior member of the Cyber Threat Intelligence program and is responsible for independently collecting, analyzing, enriching, and disseminating actionable intelligence on emerging cyber threats, adversary activity, and evolving attack trends. This role transforms complex technical and strategic threat information into actionable insights that support security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, and enterprise risk decisions.
  
  
The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in cyber threat intelligence tradecraft, threat actor tracking, infrastructure analysis, and intelligence production. They operate with minimal supervision, lead complex intelligence investigations, provide authoritative threat assessments, and serve as a trusted advisor to technical teams and leadership. Success requires strong analytical thinking, sound judgment, technical curiosity, and the ability to communicate intelligence effectively across a broad range of stakeholders.
  
  
Your Opportunity
  
  
NXP is a global player in Semiconductor industry, and security is an essential and integral part of our business.
  
  
Job Responsibility
  
  

* Monitor and assess emerging cyber threats, adversary activity, malware campaigns, and vulnerability exploitation trends.
* Track threat actors and analyze their capabilities, targeting, infrastructure, and tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
* Conduct technical investigations using threat intelligence, open-source intelligence (OSINT), and infrastructure analysis techniques.
* Correlate intelligence from multiple sources and assess potential impact to the organization.
* Lead indicator of compromise (IOC) collection, enrichment, validation, and lifecycle management activities.
* Maintain intelligence records, indicators, and threat artifacts within the organization’s Threat Intelligence Platform (TIP).
* Develop and disseminate actionable threat advisories, intelligence reports, and emerging threat notifications.
* Support intelligence-sharing efforts with internal stakeholders and trusted external partners.
* Produce tactical, operational, and strategic intelligence products for technical and business audiences.
* Deliver intelligence briefings to security teams, leadership, and other stakeholders.
* Provide threat-informed recommendations that improve organizational awareness and preparedness.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on adversary activity, emerging threats, and cyber risk trends.
* Provide intelligence support during cybersecurity investigations and incident response activities.
* Perform adversary-focused analysis to support incident scoping, attribution, and impact assessments.
* Partner with Security Operations, Vulnerability Management, and Risk teams to provide threat context and intelligence insights.
* Identify intelligence gaps, emerging risks, and opportunities to strengthen defensive capabilities.

Job Qualification
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in Cyber Threat Intelligence, Threat Research, Incident Response, Security Operations, or related cybersecurity disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience tracking threat actors, malware campaigns, adversary infrastructure, and emerging cyber threats.
* Experience producing tactical, operational, and strategic intelligence products for technical and executive audiences.
* Proven ability to independently conduct investigations, develop actionable intelligence, and brief stakeholders.
* Familiarity with nation-state actors, sophisticated cybercriminal groups, and supply chain threats.
* Experience in intelligence-driven hunting to identify suspicious network activity and potential risks.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong understanding of threat intelligence tradecraft, intelligence lifecycle methodologies, and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
* Knowledge of cyber threat intelligence frameworks and methodologies including MITRE ATT&CK, ATT&CK Navigator, Diamond Model, Cyber Kill Chain, STIX/TAXII, Intelligence Lifecycle, and Structured Analytic Techniques.
* Experience with Threat Intelligence Platforms such as Anomali, ThreatQ, ThreatConnect, OpenCTI, MISP, or similar platforms.
* Proficiency with intelligence and OSINT tools such as Maltego, VirusTotal, Shodan, Censys, DomainTools, PassiveTotal, GreyNoise, URLScan, SecurityTrails, or similar investigative platforms.
* Knowledge of threat actor clustering methodologies used to track adversary campaigns, intrusion sets, and threat group activity.
* Experience conducting infrastructure analysis involving domains, DNS, passive DNS, IP addresses, ASNs, WHOIS records, certificates, hosting providers, and internet-facing assets.
* Familiarity with STIX/TAXII, YARA, Sigma, Snort, Suricata, malware analysis concepts, and intelligence automation techniques.
* Experience with Python, data mining, Elasticsearch, ELK Stack, Databricks, large-scale data analysis, and threat intelligence correlation workflows.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Strong analytical thinking, sound judgment, and technical curiosity.
* Strong communication and technical writing skills.
* Ability to communicate intelligence effectively to technical, business, and leadership stakeholders.
* Ability to operate with minimal supervision and lead complex intelligence investigations.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Industry certifications such as GCTI, CTIA, GCIH, GCFA, CISSP, or equivalent cybersecurity and threat intelligence certifications.

title: Product Security Engineer, Agentic AI
description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.
  
  
Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).
  
  
This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
  
  
In this role, you will
  
  

* Own security architecture and threat modeling for the agentic AI offering as a core part of the product roadmap, from early design through general availability and sustaining engineering.
* Build guardrails, sandboxing, and hardening directly into the product: agent tool-calling, prompt handling, and data access paths engineered in, not audited after the fact.
* Participate in design reviews and sprint planning alongside the engineers building agent orchestration, integrations, and platform features; security is planned and estimated like any other engineering work, not a separate gate.
* Write and maintain the product’s living threat model, using frameworks including OWASP’s LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, updated every release rather than once a year.
* Review teammates’ code and architecture for security issues, including tool-calling risk, prompt injection, excessive agency, and data exfiltration, as a standard part of the team’s engineering process.
* Build the product’s governance and access control features, including agent identity, least-privilege permissions, and audit logging, as shippable capabilities of the product itself rather than side tooling.
* Own production security for the shipped product in managed services: monitoring, incident response, and vulnerability management for live deployments.
* Publish reference architectures and paved-road patterns that let pre-sales and delivery teams field the product safely, extending OAE’s mission of arming field teams with field-ready IP.
* Contribute to product roadmap and prioritization decisions from a security and reliability lens, the same way any senior engineer on the team would.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience as a product or platform engineer with a security specialization, or as a security engineer who has shipped production features as part of a product engineering team, with strong coding proficiency (for example, Python or Go).
* We are looking for a CISSP certification with a specialization in Agentic AI. We care about what you have built and what you can do; self-taught practitioners and career changers are welcome.
* A genuine AI builder: you have shipped agents, tools, or automations with large language models as part of a real product and can walk through the hard parts.
* Experience building real backends and infrastructure, not just demos: APIs, data pipelines, authentication and secrets management, hosting and deployment (containers, Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD), and systems integration, made reliable with observability, evaluations, and graceful failure handling.
* Deep knowledge of the AI threat landscape, including frameworks such as OWASP’s LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, with practical experience addressing prompt injections, excessive agency, and related agentic AI risks.
* Experience securing or auditing agentic frameworks and tool-calling or MCP-style integrations operating in sandboxed environments.
* Proven ability to design scalable cloud infrastructure, API gateways, proxy architecture, and access controls for enterprise systems.
* Comfortable working within a product team’s sprint cadence, design review process, and release cycle, contributing as a shipping engineer rather than an embedded auditor.
* Enough software and security foundation to build and secure production systems, with sound judgment on data handling and safe AI usage.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience as a product or feature engineer who happens to specialize in security, rather than a security specialist who occasionally writes code.
* Experience with AI governance, data loss prevention, monitoring and logging, or guardrail tooling for AI usage at product scale.
* Experience building and hosting AI solutions in the cloud.
* A security background in application security, cloud security, or data protection.
* Experience with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel.
* Track record building developer-first security tools and platform controls that preserve engineering velocity.
* Experience mentoring engineers or driving technical alignment across security, platform, and product teams.
* Experience enabling field or partner teams, such as pre-sales, delivery, or professional services, to safely adopt a shipped product.

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.*

title: Associate psychotherapist
description:
**Company Description**
Evolve Well-Being is a mental health organization dedicated to making high-quality, human-centered mental healthcare more accessible and meaningful. The team offers individual, couple, and group psychotherapy using an integrative, trauma-informed, and culturally responsive approach. Evolve supports people across life stages with concerns such as anxiety, depression, trauma, grief, relationship difficulties, identity, self-worth, and life transitions. The organization is building a broader ecosystem that combines clinical practice, research, education, community-based interventions, and technology to translate psychological knowledge into everyday, practical care. Evolve is committed to viewing people as complex, evolving individuals deserving holistic care, and to expanding access to thoughtful mental health support over time.

**Role Description**
The Associate Psychotherapist will provide individual, couple, and group psychotherapy, including intake assessments, ongoing treatment, and periodic reviews of progress. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting sessions, maintaining ethical and accurate clinical documentation, collaborating with supervisors and peers, and participating in case discussions and team meetings. The role also involves contributing to psychoeducational workshops, groups, and mental health programmes, as well as supporting the development of resources and tools that extend care beyond the therapy room. This is a full-time role based in Bengaluru with a hybrid work arrangement, combining in-person sessions and meetings with some work-from-home flexibility. The Associate Psychotherapist is expected to uphold trauma-informed, culturally responsive, and developmentally appropriate practice aligned with Evolve’s values.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Psychology and Mental Health, with the ability to integrate different therapeutic approaches in a thoughtful, client-centered way.
* Demonstrated skills in Counseling and Relationship Counseling, including working with individuals, couples, and groups on a range of emotional and relational concerns.
* Relevant academic background in Psychology, Clinical Psychology, Counseling, Social Work, or a closely related field; additional training in Medicine or mental health-related disciplines is an advantage.
* Experience or interest in trauma-informed, culturally responsive, and evidence-informed psychotherapy, with sensitivity to diverse identities and life experiences.
* Excellent communication, listening, and documentation skills; ability to maintain professional boundaries and adhere to ethical guidelines.
* Capacity to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team, engage in supervision and reflective practice, and contribute to programmes, workshops, and community-based interventions.
* Comfort working in a hybrid setup in Bengaluru, including in-person clinical work and remote tasks, with reliable access to private space and secure technology for online sessions.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**Note: Looking for immediate joiners.**

**Location options: Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad**

**Mandatory Tech Stack Experience:**

* **AWS Bedrock**
* **Agentcore**
* **Python**

**Role Overview**

A Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) works directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to design, build, deploy and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDEs write production-grade software and own outcomes end to end, from prototype through enterprise-scale deployment.

The role combines the technical rigor of a software engineer with the urgency and ownership needed to deliver measurable business outcomes. FDEs also create reusable architectures, patterns and engineering practices that help the wider FDE practice scale.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Embed with customer engineering teams: Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture and operational constraints. Turn ambiguous business problems into scalable, AI-enabled production systems.
* Build production AI applications: Design and develop production-grade software for AI and agentic workflows, including multi-agent orchestration, retrieval pipelines, workflow automation and decision intelligence. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, APIs and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, observability, cost and security.
* Own production: Take systems from design through production rollout and ongoing operations. Troubleshoot incidents across AI models, distributed systems, data pipelines and application services. Put in place monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, testing, CI/CD, rollback and resiliency mechanisms that keep AI systems healthy at scale.
* Accelerate customer transformation: Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption across customer workflows. Build reusable patterns, accelerators and reference architectures for future engagements.
* Raise the bar: Mentor engineers and contribute to engineering best practices for AI and forward deployment. Feed reusable components and learnings back into products and services.

**Core technical skills (must have):**

**Python**
: Strong, production-grade Python: clean code, testing, APIs and integration with enterprise systems.

**Agentic AI on AWS:**
 Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems on Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore, including prompt engineering, tool calling and agent orchestration with a framework (e.g. Strands Agents, LangGraph, LangChain).

**RAG & retrieval**
: Building retrieval pipelines: embeddings, chunking and vector search (e.g. Bedrock Knowledge Bases, OpenSearch, pgvector).

**Core AWS services**
: Working knowledge of serverless and container services, storage, security and networking on AWS (e.g. Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, S3, DynamoDB, IAM).

Production engineering: Taking AI systems to production: CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, evaluations and guardrails for AI output.

**Good to have:**

* Infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform, AWS CDK) and containers (Docker).
* LLM evaluation and tracing tools (e.g. Bedrock Guardrails, RAGAS, Langfuse, OpenTelemetry).
* MCP (Model Context Protocol), agent-to-agent (A2A) patterns, or other frameworks such as CrewAI or LlamaIndex.
* API frameworks such as FastAPI, SQL, and event-driven services (e.g. Step Functions, SQS, EventBridge).
* A second language such as TypeScript/Node.js or Java.
* Amazon SageMaker, and model fine-tuning or customization on Bedrock.
* Experience in regulated industries (banking, capital markets, insurance): security reviews, audit and data-residency controls.
* AWS certifications: AI Practitioner, Machine Learning Engineer – Associate, Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional, or Generative AI Developer – Professional.

**Basic qualifications:**

* 5+ years of professional software development experience (excluding internships).
* 5+ years of programming in at least one software programming language.
* 5+ years leading design or architecture of new and existing systems (design patterns, reliability and scaling).
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience building production AI or ML applications, including agentic workflows.
* 5+ years across the full software development life cycle: coding standards, code reviews, source control, build processes, testing and operations.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable working in customer-facing environments.

title: Office Admin
description:
**JD - Office Administrator**

**About Us**

We are a fast-growing, pre-Series A technology start-up headquartered in the United States, with our core operations and engineering team based in Bengaluru, India. We build cutting-edge software products for clients across the US and are scaling our team rapidly. Our culture is energetic, transparent, and driven-we move fast, own our work, and take pride in building things that matter.

As we grow, we are looking for a sharp, self-driven Office Administration Manager to be the backbone of our India operations-someone who understands the nuances of a cross-border start-up environment and can wear multiple hats with ease.

**Role Overview**

This is a dual-function, high-ownership role combining Human Resources, Office Administration, and cross-border compliance. You will be the go-to person for all people operations in India, acting as the bridge between our Bengaluru team and US leadership. This role demands someone with a strong sense of urgency, exceptional organizational skills, and the ability to operate independently while staying aligned with the broader business goals.

Key Responsibilities

**Office Administration**

* Own vendor management: office supplies, internet, utilities, equipment leases, AMCs, and service contracts
* Process expense claims, petty cash, and coordinate with the finance team on India-side invoicing and payments
* Assist with GST documentation, TDS certificates, and coordination with the CA/accounting firm
* Support the US finance team with India-related reports, reconciliations, and intercompany documentation
* Manage office facilities, upkeep, and ensure a productive and safe work environment
* Executive & Cross-border Support
* Coordinate meetings, travel, and logistics across India and US time zones
* Serve as a communication bridge between India staff and US-based leadership
* Be available and responsive during US business hours as the business requires

**Human Resources**

* Maintain HR records, HRMS data, and ensure documentation is always audit-ready
* Drive employee engagement, culture initiatives, and internal communications
* Manage leaves, attendance, and coordinate with the payroll vendor
* Administer benefits-health insurance, PF, ESIC, gratuity, and other statutory benefits

**What We Are Looking For**

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* 3–4 years of progressive experience in Office Administration, or a combined generalist role
* Prior experience in a startup, tech company, or cross-border organization strongly preferred
* Fluency in English-written and spoken (non-negotiable)
* Proficiency with tools such as MS Office/Google Workspace, HRMS platforms, and productivity tools (Slack, Notion, or equivalents)
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

**The Right Mindset**

* Go-getter attitude-you don't wait for direction, you take ownership and drive outcomes
* Comfortable with ambiguity and able to build processes from scratch in a fast-paced environment
* Excellent communication skills-professional, clear, and proactive in keeping stakeholders informed
* High integrity and discretion when handling confidential employee and business information
* Flexible on hours-willing to work early mornings or late evenings to overlap with US teams when needed
* Collaborative team player who thrives when working across cultures and time zones

Good to Have

* MBA  or postgraduate degree
* Knowledge of SaaS or product-led tech startup environments

**Compensation & Benefits**

* We offer competitive compensation in line with Bengaluru market standards for this role and experience level, benchmarked against the tech startup ecosystem. The package includes:
* Fixed CTC commensurate with experience-negotiable for the right candidate
* Health insurance (self + family)
* Direct access to founders and leadership-high visibility, high impact role
* Learning and development budget
* A work culture that values ownership, respect, and results over hierarchy

title: Lead Design Engineer - Rail Bridges
description:
**Joining Arup**
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. Arup is a UK-headquartered independent firm of designers, planners, engineers, consultants, and technical specialists offering a wide range of professional services. With 90 offices in 35 countries, their 19,000+ staff make a positive difference in the world through their work.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Infrastructure is ageing globally, with a growing pipeline of renewals and bridge upgrade projects. This role sits at the heart of a new Bangalore-based team that will work in close partnership with UK colleagues to deliver high-quality, cost-effective solutions and help Arup become a market leader in rail renewals. This is an exciting opportunity for you to lead and shape a new rapidly growing team in Arup. You will lead the Railway Bridges and Civil Structures capability within the Arup Bangalore Rail team, acting as the UK-facing single point of contact for bridge renewals and ageing assets work. You will be responsible for technical excellence, quality, efficient project delivery and the development of a high-performing team that supports UK and local rail renewals programmes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Lead the design, assessment, refurbishment and strengthening of railway bridges, culverts, retaining walls and associated civil structures across concept, feasibility, detailed design and construction support stages.
  
  

* Lead the design of bridges and civil structures through optioneering, feasibility, selection of options, preliminary design, outline design, detailed design, delivering construction information and supporting clients and contractors through the construction phase of a project.
* Lead structural assessments of ageing assets, including appraisal of condition information, identification of intervention needs and development of practical renewal or life-extension solutions.
* Oversee the preparation and review of calculations, technical reports, specifications, drawings and BIM-enabled deliverables to a consistently high standard.
* Provide technical leadership on UK rail standards and design governance, including the application of Eurocodes and relevant Network Rail requirements.
* Plan, resource and coordinate delivery across the Bangalore structures team, ensuring work is delivered safely, on programme, to budget and in accordance with project quality requirements.
* Act as the primary interface with UK project managers, discipline leads and bridge renewals teams, ensuring strong communication, effective integration and responsive delivery.
* Lead internal design reviews and checking activities, support robust technical assurance and drive continuous improvement in quality and efficiency.
* Mentor, coach and develop engineers and technicians, creating a strong technical culture and supporting long-term capability growth in Bangalore.
* Support business development through technical input to bids, methodologies, work winning conversations and delivery approaches that improve competitiveness in the renewals market.
* Promote digital delivery, repeatable design approaches and innovation that improve productivity and support blended UK-India delivery.

**If this role right for you?**

* Degree in Civil or Structural Engineering; a master’s degree is advantageous.
* Minimum of 12 years post-graduate experience in the design, assessment and renewal of bridges and civil structures, ideally within rail infrastructure.
* Strong understanding of structural behavior, assessment methodologies, strengthening techniques and the management of existing assets.
* Experience using structural analysis tools such as MIDAS, SOFiSTiK, GSA, Strand7, SAP2000 or similar.
* Working knowledge of Eurocodes and experience applying standards used by Network Rail and/or other comparable rail authorities.
* Good working knowledge of design development tools such as Bentley Microstation is essential.
* Proven track record of leading technical delivery, managing interfaces and mentoring others within multidisciplinary project environments.
* Experience of working with international consultants and, ideally, familiarity with UK rail design workflows namely GRIP governance, leading IDC, IDR workshops, standards and approval expectations.
* Strong communication, collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
* Chartered status, or equivalent progression toward professional recognition, is strongly preferred.

Not ready to apply just yet, or have a few questions? Contact (Monalisa Ginu -Monalisa.Ginu@arup.com). Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.
  
  
**Reward And Benefits**
We offer a competitive salary at all levels, and one of the best benefits packages in our sector. Core benefits include Provident Fund contribution, NPS option, Mediclaim cover (incl. family), Term Life and Accident Insurance, Employee Assistance Prog. scheme for the family to safeguard your physical and mental wellbeing. In addition, all permanent employees are eligible for the Global Profit Share scheme. Subject to scheme rules employees can receive two Profit Share payments per year, which are dependent on the firm’s financial performance.
  
  
**Different people, shared values.**
At Arup, we believe when talented people collaborate, great things are possible. Arup hires people with proven skills and open minds. We are taking deliberate action to create an inclusive culture that is grounded in our purpose to shape a better world.
  
  
At Arup, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and any other protected characteristic. Our internal employee networks - BAME, Culture, Disability, LGBTQ+ and Women - provide a space for you to express your views and to make a positive difference - discover more about life at Arup here.
  
  
At Arup, we are committed to making all stages of our recruitment process accessible to candidates with disabilities. Please speak to our recruitment team and we will work with you to make reasonable adjustments to ensure you can perform at your best throughout your application.
  
  
At Arup, we appreciate that everyone’s circumstances are different and having the freedom to flex the way we work is essential to our wellbeing. If flexibility matters to you let us know when you apply, and we will discuss how this could work in your role.
  
  
**What happens next?**
If this could be the next step in your journey, please apply online. All applications will be considered, and we will try our very best to respond to you within 72 hours of receiving your application.
  
  
Stay safe online - Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process
  
  
We may close the role earlier than the advertised date should we receive a large number of applications, so please ensure you apply early.

* Experience turning requirements and ambiguous problems into designs, prototypes, and production-ready solutions

* Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly, collaborate across teams and time zones, and support other engineers through feedback and knowledge sharing

title: SAP PM CS
description:
Job Description: SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven
**SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant**
with
**5 to 12 years**
of expertise across SAP Customer Service (CS), Service Management (SM), and S/4HANA Service.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, and implementing end-to-end Service Management processes in an
**SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition (PCE) / RISE with SAP**
environment. You will bridge business requirements and functional architecture, manage cloud service governance, enable AI-driven service insights, and drive continuous optimization across the full service lifecycle.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Implementation
* Design, configure, and deploy S/4HANA Service Management processes across the entire service lifecycle: Engage, Sell, Contract, Plan, Schedule, Execute, Invoice, and Analyze.
* Map end-to-end business requirements to standard S/4HANA Service capabilities, including service quotations, service orders, service contracts, spare parts logistics, resource planning, billing, and analytics.
* Drive adoption of the latest S/4HANA PCE release innovations (e.g., service team determination, advanced execution processes, Fiori applications, and AI-powered service intelligence).
* S/4HANA Private Edition (PCE) Governance
* Operate effectively within the SAP S/4HANA PCE Shared Responsibility Model between the client and SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS).
* Liaise with SAP for system-level operational tasks (e.g., infrastructure management, backups, maintenance, and upgrade administration).
* Lead client-side functional responsibilities, including business process configuration, functional validation, regression testing, and process governance based on SAP’s PCE Roles and Responsibilities framework.
* Service Order & Contract Management
* Configure and maintain service contract structures, recurring service billing plans, and auto-renewal mechanisms.
* Enable flexible billing scenarios, including Resource-Related Billing (RRB), Time & Material (T&M), and Fixed-Price billing models.
* Leverage modern platform features such as service contract template cloning and mass contract change capabilities.
* Service Planning, Execution & Logistics Integration
* Set up and optimize workforce planning, resource allocation, dispatching, and field service workflows.
* Configure plant and storage location parameters within service transactions to support multi-plant and multi-location service execution.
* Direct cross-module functional integration between service transactions and procurement (MM), inventory management, shipping, plant maintenance (PM), and follow-on financial postings.
* Data Migration, Testing & Integration
* Oversee data preparation, cleansing, transformation, and validation for service master data, active service contracts, and open service orders.
* Utilize the SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and standard transition tools tailored for service artifacts.
* Coordinate functional and technical integrations across CRM, SAP Field Service Management (FSM), SAP CS, core logistics, and Finance (FI/CO).
* AI, Analytics & Continuous Process Improvement
* Implement embedded AI capabilities (e.g., Joule-assisted summaries, intelligent confirmations, and predictive service insights).
* Design custom Fiori dashboards, operational reports, and KPIs to monitor service performance and profitability.
* Guide business stakeholders through continuous improvement initiatives and the adoption of periodic SAP release features.
* Stakeholder Management & Documentation
* Facilitate requirements-gathering workshops, author detailed functional specifications (FS), and map target-state business process flows.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams spanning Logistics, Procurement, Finance, and Sales.
* Create training collateral, deliver end-user training, and lead hypercare support during deployment phases.

**Required Skills & Technical Expertise**

* Experience: 5–12 years of hands-on experience in SAP CS / SM / S/4HANA Service functional consulting.
* Core Module Competency: Comprehensive knowledge of S/4HANA Service (PCE) core functionality (Service Orders, Service Contracts, Resource-Related Billing, Invoicing, and Execution Logistics).
* Cloud Architecture: Clear operational understanding of the SAP PCE operating model, RISE with SAP frameworks, and cloud service boundary matrices.
* User Experience & Extensibility: Proficiency with modern SAP Fiori apps, standard OData APIs, and functional extensibility options.
* Integration Touchpoints: Strong cross-functional integration experience with PM, SD, MM, FI/CO, and SAP FSM.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Practical project experience with RISE with SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition implementations or migrations.
* Hands-on knowledge of SAP upgrade governance and release management protocols in PCE environments.
* Official SAP Certification in S/4HANA Service or related SAP functional modules.

**Soft Skills**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong consulting mindset with a proven ability to translate business strategy into technical solution designs.
* Proactive problem-solving capabilities and experience leading cross-functional delivery teams.
