title: Bridge Engineer - Rails
description:
**Joining Arup**
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. Arup is a UK-headquartered independent firm of designers, planners, engineers, consultants, and technical specialists offering a wide range of professional services. With 90 offices in 35 countries, their 19,000+ staff make a positive difference in the world through their work.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Infrastructure is ageing globally, with a growing pipeline of renewals and bridge upgrade projects. This role sits at the heart of a new Bangalore-based team that will work in close partnership with UK colleagues to deliver high-quality, cost-effective solutions and help Arup become a market leader in rail renewals.You will deliver technical design and assessment work for railway bridges and civil structures, supporting a growing Bangalore team that works closely with UK colleagues on renewals and ageing assets projects. This role is ideal for an engineer who combines strong fundamentals in bridge engineering with an interest in the challenge of working on existing assets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Undertake structural analysis and design for railway bridges and civil structures, including new interventions, modifications, strengthening and renewals.
* Experience designing bridges and civil structures through optioneering, feasibility, selection of options, preliminary design, outline design, detailed design, delivering construction information and supporting clients and contractors through the construction phase of a project.
* Carry out assessments of existing assets, interpret inspection information and support the development of practical remediation or renewal options.
* Prepare technical calculations, technical reports, specifications, sketches, drawings and digital deliverables in collaboration with engineers and technicians.
* Support coordination with other disciplines including track, stations, telecoms, power and wider rail systems teams to deliver integrated solutions.
* Able to work under limited supervision and use initiative and independent judgement.
* Contribute to design reviews, checking processes and quality assurance activities to maintain high technical standards.
* Deliver allocated work packages to programme and budget, proactively managing interfaces, risks and information needs.
* Support site-related queries, construction-stage technical input and responses to design issues as they arise.
* Contribute ideas that improve efficiency, digital delivery and repeatability across bridge renewals and ageing assets work.

**If this role right for you?**

* Degree in Civil or Structural Engineering and progression toward membership of a relevant professional body such as ICE or IStructE.
* Minimum of 8 years post-graduate experience in the design, assessment or construction of bridges and civil structures.
* Good appreciation of structural behavior and confidence developing technical solutions for both new and existing assets.
* Experience with structural analysis software such as MIDAS, GSA, Strand7, SAP2000, LEAP or similar.
* Experience using Projectwise and Bentley Microstation software.
* Ability to produce clear technical reports and robust design calculations.
* Knowledge of Eurocodes and, ideally, familiarity with standards applied by Network Rail and/or other rail clients.
* Strong collaborative skills and experience working within multidisciplinary teams.
* A proactive approach to learning, quality and client service.

Not ready to apply just yet, or have a few questions? Contact (Monalisa Ginu -Monalisa.Ginu@arup.com). Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.
  
  
**Reward And Benefits**
We offer a competitive salary at all levels, and one of the best benefits packages in our sector. Core benefits include Provident Fund contribution, NPS option, Mediclaim cover (incl. family), Term Life and Accident Insurance, Employee Assistance Prog. scheme for the family to safeguard your physical and mental wellbeing. In addition, all permanent employees are eligible for the Global Profit Share scheme. Subject to scheme rules employees can receive two Profit Share payments per year, which are dependent on the firm’s financial performance.
  
  
**Different people, shared values.**
At Arup, we believe when talented people collaborate, great things are possible. Arup hires people with proven skills and open minds. We are taking deliberate action to create an inclusive culture that is grounded in our purpose to shape a better world.
  
  
At Arup, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and any other protected characteristic. Our internal employee networks - BAME, Culture, Disability, LGBTQ+ and Women - provide a space for you to express your views and to make a positive difference - discover more about life at Arup here.
  
  
At Arup, we are committed to making all stages of our recruitment process accessible to candidates with disabilities. Please speak to our recruitment team and we will work with you to make reasonable adjustments to ensure you can perform at your best throughout your application.
  
  
At Arup, we appreciate that everyone’s circumstances are different and having the freedom to flex the way we work is essential to our wellbeing. If flexibility matters to you let us know when you apply, and we will discuss how this could work in your role.
  
  
**What happens next?**
If this could be the next step in your journey, please apply online. All applications will be considered, and we will try our very best to respond to you within 72 hours of receiving your application.
  
  
Stay safe online - Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process
  
  
We may close the role earlier than the advertised date should we receive a large number of applications, so please ensure you apply early.

title: Study Abroad Consultant – Junior
description:

Employment Type: Full-Time

Salary: Hike on previous CTC, based on experience and skills

About Clini Launch Research Institute

Clini Launch Research Institute is committed to empowering students through quality education, career guidance, and professional development. We are looking for an enthusiastic and empathetic Study Abroad Consultant to guide students aspiring to pursue higher education abroad.

Role Overview

The Study Abroad Consultant will be the first point of contact for prospective students and their parents, helping them explore international education opportunities. The role involves student counselling, lead management, university and course selection, application support, and visa documentation assistance.

Freshers and candidates with relevant internships or experience in inside sales, pre-sales, EdTech, or visa processing are welcome to apply.

Key Responsibilities

1. Student Counselling and Pre-Sales

- Handle inbound enquiries and outbound calls from prospective students.

- Understand students’ academic backgrounds, career goals, and budgets to recommend suitable countries, courses, and universities.

- Explain admission procedures, application timelines, entrance exams, and visa requirements.

- Build strong relationships with students and parents through effective communication.

2. Lead and Pipeline Management

- Maintain accurate records of student interactions, follow-ups, and application status in the CRM.

- Follow up with prospective students through calls, emails, and WhatsApp.

- Convert enquiries into active applicants and achieve assigned targets.

3. Application and Documentation Support

- Assist students with Statements of Purpose (SOPs), Letters of Recommendation (LORs), and resumes.

- Review academic and financial documents for completeness.

- Coordinate with universities and internal teams regarding applications and admission updates.

4. Visa Guidance and Coordination

- Assist senior counsellors with student visa documentation and application preparation.

- Stay updated on university admission requirements, application deadlines, and relevant visa guidelines.

- Ensure timely follow-ups and proper documentation throughout the admission process.

Eligibility Criteria

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in any discipline.

- 0–1 year of experience in study abroad consulting, inside sales, pre-sales, customer support, or visa processing.

- Freshers with relevant internships and strong communication skills are encouraged to apply.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

- Strong interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

- Basic knowledge of MS Office and CRM tools.

- Ability to work in a target-driven environment with attention to detail.

What We Offer

- Structured training and mentorship from experienced professionals.

- Career growth opportunities based on performance.

- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.

- A collaborative and growth-oriented work environment.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resumes using the contact details below.

Contact Person: Shweta

Phone: 6364897536

Email: shweta.phadtare@clinilaunchresearch.in

Salary: Hike on previous CTC, depending on experience and skills.

Work Location: Ozone Manay Technology Park, Near Kudlu Gate, HSR Layout, Bengaluru.

Join Clini Launch Research Institute and help students take the next step toward their international education goals.

title: Systems Administrator, Hybrid Cloud and AI Infrastructure
description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.
  
  
Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).
  
  
This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
Lenovo seeks a Systems Administrator to own end-to-end deployment, support, and administration of hybrid cloud and AI infrastructure primarily for the Bangalore lab, across the network, compute, storage, operating system, and container orchestration (Docker and Kubernetes) layers, plus the NVIDIA technology stack.
  
  
You are a dedicated support resource for the Lab Operations Manager and you keep hybrid cloud and AI infrastructure operational in Bangalore at the scale the AI Lab Consolidation requires. You coordinate remotely with the Morrisville-based Systems Administrator, GPU/AI Infrastructure, Network Engineer on shared standards, escalations, and cross-site incident response, and you provide secondary technical support back to Morrisville. The role sits within Lenovo SSG’s Hybrid Cloud and AI Infrastructure Services (HCAIS) Offering Architecture Engineering organization.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Infrastructure Deployment and Administration
  
  

* Network: deploy, support, and administer lab networking for the Bangalore site.
* Compute: deploy, support, and administer physical and virtual compute infrastructure across the Bangalore lab.
* Storage: deploy, support, and administer lab storage systems across block and file tiers.
* Operating Systems: install, patch, and administer operating systems across Bangalore lab infrastructure.

Hybrid Cloud Platform Administration
  
  

* VMware: deploy, support, and administer VMware virtualization infrastructure (vSphere, ESXi, vCenter).
* Azure: support hybrid cloud integration and workloads extending Bangalore lab infrastructure to Microsoft Azure.
* Nutanix: deploy, support, and administer Nutanix hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI).
* Red Hat OpenShift: deploy, support, and administer Red Hat OpenShift container platform environments, extending the lab’s container orchestration footprint.

Container Orchestration
  
  

* Docker: deploy and administer Docker container runtime environments.
* Kubernetes: own full production Kubernetes administration, including cluster operations, role-based access control (RBAC), cluster networking, and version upgrades.

NVIDIA Platform Administration
  
  

* NVIDIA Technology Stack: administer NVIDIA drivers, the CUDA toolkit, InfiniBand fabric, Run:AI orchestration, and ClearML across the Bangalore lab’s GPU infrastructure.
* Configuration Validation: validate lab configurations against NVIDIA reference architecture (Lenovo Validated Design) certification requirements.

Lab Operations and Smart Hands
  
  

* Equipment Support: provide on-site, hands-on technical support for capital equipment requested by the Bangalore Professional Services / LMS team.
* Day-to-Day Support: provide day-to-day administration, support, and engineering functions for the network, compute, and storage layers in the physical Bangalore lab.
* Rack and Stack: perform rack-and-stack, structured cabling, imaging, and smart-hands support for lab hardware alongside higher-level administration duties.

Cross-Site Support and Coordination
  
  

* Morrisville Secondary Support: provide secondary technical support for NVIDIA technology stack capital equipment hosted in Morrisville.
* Remote Coordination: coordinate remotely with the Morrisville-based Systems Administrator, GPU/AI Infrastructure, Network Engineer, and Junior Systems Administrator on shared standards, escalations, and incident response across a roughly 12-hour time zone gap.
* NVIDIA Relationship: maintain a working relationship with NVIDIA field contacts, coordinating remotely with the Morrisville-based team.

**Required Qualifications**
Required Experience
  
  

* 4+ years of systems administration experience with hands-on breadth across network, compute, storage, and operating system layers, plus a GPU/AI infrastructure specialization.
* Hybrid Cloud Platforms: hands-on experience with hybrid cloud platforms such as VMware (vSphere/ESXi/vCenter), Microsoft Azure, Nutanix HCI, or Red Hat OpenShift.
* Hybrid Cloud or AI Certification: NVIDIA NCP-AI or equivalent in Microsoft or Red Hat OpenShift.
* Production Kubernetes Administration: demonstrated experience with cluster operations, RBAC, cluster networking, and version upgrades in a production environment.
* Docker: hands-on experience administering Docker container runtime environments.
* Hands-on NVIDIA administration: demonstrated experience administering NVIDIA drivers and the CUDA toolkit.
* Physical Infrastructure: comfortable with hands-on hardware work, including rack-and-stack, structured cabling, and smart hands, in addition to higher-level administration.

Core Professional Skills
  
  

* Incident Response: able to own after-hours incident response for a shared, multi-team infrastructure environment.
* Independent Ownership: comfortable working as the senior on-site infrastructure owner in Bangalore, remotely coordinating with the Morrisville-based team across a significant time zone gap.
* Physical Presence: this role requires physical, on-site presence in Bangalore and cannot be performed remotely from elsewhere.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Multi-Tenant Lab Experience: experience supporting a multi-tenant shared lab environment serving distributed teams.
* Experience with DCIM, IPAM, or monitoring tooling comparable to the lab’s stack (Hyperview-class DCIM, BlueCat / Infoblox-class IPAM, NVIDIA DCGM monitoring).
* InfiniBand Fabric: working familiarity with InfiniBand fabric in a multi-node GPU environment.
* GPU Orchestration: experience with Run:AI, ClearML, or a comparable GPU orchestration and MLOps toolset.

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.*

title: Senior Analyst
description:
Work Your Magic with us!
  
  
Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.
  
  
**Your Role**

* Develop and maintain infrastructure automation and configuration-as-code solutions using PowerShell and Ansible Automation Platform.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather user requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
* Manage project timelines and deliverables to ensure successful implementation.
* Troubleshoot and optimize existing systems and processes.
* Design, develop, and maintain automation solutions using Ansible Automation Platform for Windows-based infrastructure.
* Create and manage Ansible playbooks, roles, inventories, workflows, and job templates to support standardized and scalable operations.
* Integrate Ansible Automation Platform with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and other enterprise tools.
* Automate configuration management, patching, provisioning, compliance tasks, and operational workflows across large-scale Windows server environments.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, security, and application teams to implement reliable and reusable automation patterns.
* Ensure automation solutions are properly documented, tested, and aligned with enterprise governance and security standards

**Who You Are**

* You bring proven hands-on experience with Ansible Automation Platform (AAP) in enterprise environments, including the development and administration of playbooks, roles, inventories, workflows, job templates, credentials, and execution environments.
* You have strong proficiency in PowerShell and Azure DevOps/Git, with a solid understanding of infrastructure-as-code principles and experience automating Windows server environments using WinRM/SSH and reusable playbook design.
* You have experience integrating Ansible Automation Platform into enterprise DevOps toolchains and CI/CD pipelines, and you are familiar with automation governance, role-based access control, credential handling, and workflow orchestration in AAP.
* You hold a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or bring equivalent professional experience in infrastructure automation and software engineering.
* You are familiar with cloud platforms such as Azure or similar, and have working knowledge of networking concepts, REST APIs, ServiceNow, Active Directory, and configuration management tools such as Terraform.
* You communicate clearly, document your work thoroughly, and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams in a remote or hybrid working environment; experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies or Event-Driven Ansible is a plus.
* You have experience managing or supporting large-scale Windows server environments (10,000+ servers globally) and are comfortable working with reporting tools such as SQL, Grafana, or similar platforms.

**What we offer:**
We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
  
  
Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

Environment.

title: BUK TESCO Bank - Core Banking Infrastructure Engineer - BA4
description:
As a Service Engineer at Barclays TESCO Bank, where you will play a key role in the supporting applications end-to-end, enhancing capabilities, and delivery continuous improvement of core banking platforms. You will be responsible for ensuring the resilience, performance, and integrity of critical systems while contributing to strategic change and operational excellence within the technology function.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you will need experience in:
  
  
  

* Application Support & Service Delivery Leading and Providing end-to-end L2/L3 support for core banking applications, ensuring adherence to service level agreements (SLAs) and operational KPIs. Proactively monitoring system health, managing incidents and service requests, and ensuring high availability of business-critical services.
* Driving End to End Automation

Lead the implementation of end-to-end CI/CD automation using Gitlab, Jenkins and Nexus, reducing manual effort while improving deployment consistency, Security and release efficiency.
  
  
  

* Containerisation, Kubernetes & EKS Engineering

Hands on proficiency in containerisation, including Docker and Kubernetes/EKS, with the ability to troubleshoot workloads, optimise cluster performance, and design/maintain Helm charts.
  
  
  

* Maintenance & Continuous Improvement Supporting ongoing maintenance activities including defect resolution, patching, and platform upgrades. Driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance application stability, performance, and scalability in line with Barclays’ strategic technology objectives.
* Change, Release & Environment Management Managing application changes through the Barclays change governance framework, ensuring controlled and compliant deployments across environments. Supporting release activities with minimal disruption to production services.
* Incident, Problem & Root Cause Analysis Leading incident triage, performing root cause analysis, and implementing permanent fixes. Contributing to problem management processes to reduce recurring incidents and improve system resilience.
* Stakeholder Collaboration & Demand Support Working closely with business users, development teams, and infrastructure partners to manage demand, prioritise enhancements, and support delivery of the application backlog and strategic initiatives.
* Operational Excellence & Process Optimisation Identifying opportunities to streamline processes, automate repetitive tasks, and implement best practices to improve operational efficiency and user experience.
* Risk, Compliance & Controls Ensuring compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and audit standards. Supporting risk management activities including controls monitoring, incident reporting, and documentation (e.g., RCSAs, records inventory).
* Environment & Infrastructure Coordination Collaborating with infrastructure, database, and middleware teams to manage application environments, capacity planning, and performance tuning.
* Business Continuity & Resilience Supporting disaster recovery planning, failover testing, and continuity processes to ensure minimal disruption to critical banking services.
* Domain Banking & Financial Systems
* Technical Skills AWS, GitLab, Jenkins, Terraform and Ansible, Kubernetes, Nexus, Python or PowerShell or Any scripting Language Windows/RHEL
* Good-To-Have: Datadog , Snyk or SonarQube, ServiceNow/JIRA/Confluence, Java , Safe Agile, Knowledge Fiserv suite of applications

**You May Also Require The Following Skills And Experience**
Strong understanding of ITIL practices (Incident, Problem, Change Management)
  
  
Experience working within regulated financial services environments.
  
  
Ability to manage competing priorities in a high-pressure production support environment.
  
  
Effective communication and stakeholder management skills
  
  
Continuous learning mindset to adapt to evolving banking technologies and platforms.
  
  
You may be assessed on the key skills needed for success in this role, including application support, incident and problem management, risk and controls, system reliability, and technical expertise in banking platforms.
  
  
This role is based in our Bengaluru office.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
* Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Platform Specialist
description:
**Summary**
At Apple, we work every day to create products that enrich people’s lives. We want to help people in every part of their lives that we can, including making the world’s best content easily and beautifully available to the hundreds of millions of people around the globe who use Apple products. Our Advertising Platforms organization enables a thriving ecosystem for content creators, publishers, and developers by helping them monetize their work while enabling users to discover high-quality content seamlessly across Apple devices. With the continued growth of Apple Ads within the App Store where a significant majority of app downloads originate from search this platform has become a critical channel for app discovery and performance marketing for iOS developers globally.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Apple Ads - Platform Specialist with a real passion for customer excellence to join our Search Ads team to help businesses with promotion and discovery across Apple Services. Operating as both a strategic account manager and a consultative seller across the pre- and post- sale lifecycle. Highly adaptable, self-directed, you are an autonomous problem solver who can independently troubleshoot complex campaign performance issues, architect bold growth strategies and constructively challenge clients to rethink their potential. Effectively partners with performance advertisers in the mobile and app developer ecosystem, you have very strong communication and interpersonal skills, you are highly analytical, resourceful, customer-focused, team-oriented, and can work independently to meet revenue and business objectives. You have a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in the mobile and app developer space with performance-type advertisers and agencies.
  
  
**Description**
Manage relationships with clients and agencies in the performance marketing space
  
  
Maintain a high level of outreach via email, phone and meetings to ensure a strong business pipeline
  
  
Develop a strategy for long-term success across your portfolio of clients & prospects

title: Content Manager (Social, influencer and in house content Production)
description:
Content Manager (Social, influencer and in house content Production)

Location: Bangalore

Work Mode: Work from office

Employment Type: Full-time

Collaboration: Works closely with the Brand, Creative, Marketing, E-commerce, Influencer

and Monrow Studio teams.

About Monrow

We create stylish, comfortable footwear designed specifically for Indian feet. As we continue

to grow, content is becoming one of the biggest engines through which we build the

Monrow brand.

We are looking for a Content Manager who can take complete ownership of this engine.

This is a highly hands-on role. You will be involved in everything from finding the idea →

planning the shoot → getting the right people → shooting → editing → publishing → analyzing

performance → improving the next piece of content.

If you enjoy creating things rather than just managing people who create them, this role is

for you.

What You Will Own:

1. Social Media - End to End

● Own Monrow's social media content calendar and execution.

● Plan, create, shoot, edit and publish content across Instagram and other relevant

platforms.

● Develop a strong mix of Reels, carousels, static posts, Stories and other social-first

formats.

● Identify trends, formats, hooks, conversations and content opportunities relevant to

Monrow.

● Understand what makes content work on social media and continuously experiment

with new formats.

● Write captions, hooks, scripts and briefs wherever required.

● Monitor content performance and use data and learnings to improve future content.

● Ensure consistent quality, frequency and brand consistency across all social content.

2. Overall Brand Content

Own Monrow's broader content ecosystem beyond social media, including:

● Brand and campaign content

● SEO / GSO content

● Website content

● Influencer and creator content

● Product and launch content

● Fashion and lifestyle content

● Content for marketing campaigns and other brand initiatives

You will be expected to think beyond individual posts and understand how different content

pieces work together to build the Monrow brand.

You should also be able to identify opportunities where one shoot or content idea can be

repurposed across multiple channels and content formats.

3. Monrow Studio - End-to-End Ownership

Monrow Studio is our in-house content studio, and you will be responsible for making it

a high-output content engine for the brand.

You will own the entire studio content cycle, including:

● Planning the studio's content calendar and shooting schedule.

● Identifying what content needs to be produced based on launches, campaigns, social

requirements and brand priorities.

● Scouting and coordinating with models, creators and influencers for shoots.

● Developing shoot concepts, references, shot lists, scripts and content requirements.

● Coordinating with photographers, videographers, stylists, creators and internal teams.

● Being present on shoot days and ensuring that the shoot runs smoothly.

● Ensuring that all required shots and content assets are captured.

● Managing the post-production and editing pipeline.

● Organizing and maintaining the content produced from the studio.

● Ensuring content is delivered on time and is actually deployed across the relevant

channels.

● Continuously improving the studio's output, processes and quality.

You should be comfortable being the person responsible for making things happen on shoot

day, rather than simply handing over a brief and waiting for the output.

4. Content Production

This is a hands-on content role.

You should be comfortable:

● Shooting videos and photographs using a smartphone.

● Creating social-first videos independently.

● Understanding framing, composition, lighting, camera movement and visual

storytelling.

● Editing short-form videos for social media.

● Using tools such as CapCut, VN, Premiere Pro, Canva or equivalent.

● Creating content that feels native to social media rather than simply looking like an

advertisement.

● Directing people on camera and getting the required performance/content from

them.

● Being comfortable appearing on camera yourself when required for content creation.

You don't necessarily need to be a professional photographer or videographer. But you must

have a strong understanding of how good social content is shot and produced.

5. Influencer & Creator Content

● Identify creators and influencers who are relevant to Monrow's target audience.

● Support creator scouting, outreach and coordination.

● Develop content briefs and ensure creators understand the objective and brand

direction.

● Coordinate content production and timelines.

● Review creator content before it goes live.

● Build learnings around what creator formats, personalities and content styles work for

Monrow.

● Maintain a consistent pipeline of creator-led content.

What We Are Looking For

Must-Have Skills

● Excellent command of English - written and spoken.

● Strong understanding of social media and what makes content work (at least 1-2 year of experience)

● Ability to independently plan and produce 30–50+ pieces of content every month

across social media, Monrow Studio, influencer content and other content engines.

● Strong visual and creative instinct.

● Good knowledge of shooting and editing videos and photographs on a smartphone.

● Ability to write strong hooks, captions, scripts and content briefs.

● Strong understanding of short-form video and social-first storytelling.

● Comfortable working with models, creators, influencers and other talent.

● Strong project management and coordination skills.

● Ability to manage multiple content projects simultaneously.

● Basic understanding of content analytics and the ability to turn performance data

into actionable learnings.

● Strong understanding of fashion, lifestyle, social media and digital culture.

The Most Important Skill: Ownership

We are looking for someone with a Brand Owner mentality.

You should be someone who:

● Doesn't wait to be told what to do.

● Spots content opportunities proactively.

● Takes an idea from thought to execution.

● Figures things out when resources are limited.

● Takes responsibility for the final output, not just their part of the process.

● Cares about whether the content actually works, not just whether it was posted.

● Can look at something and say, "This isn't good enough. Let's make it better."

● Understands that working in a growing brand means sometimes doing things

outside a conventional job description.

Candidate Preference:

Monrow is a women's footwear brand, and this role involves hands-on fashion and lifestyle

content creation, including working with and directing on-camera talent and, where

relevant, appearing in content us.

Being closely connected to the consumer, product and visual world we are creating is

therefore valuable for this role.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means building a consistent, high-quality and high-output content

engine for Monrow.At the end of every month, we should be able to see:

More content → Better content → Stronger brand presence → Better learnings → Better content

again.

You will ultimately become one of the key owners of how Monrow looks, sounds and shows

up on the internet.

This role is NOT for someone who:

● Only wants to make content calendars.

● Wants to outsource all production.

● Is uncomfortable getting hands-on with shooting and editing.

● Needs detailed instructions for every task.

● Looks at content purely as a checklist of posts.

● Isn't comfortable working in a fast-moving environment.

This role is for someone who:

Sees something → Gets an idea → Makes it happen.

If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Email your resume and answers to the mandatory screening questions to: talent@monrow.in

1 - How do you balance brand voice with creativity when creating content for different

platforms?

2 - What’s your process for generating fresh content ideas that align with business goals?

3 - Suppose we have to make 100 pieces of content per month starting December. What will be your strategy to ensure that we are able to deliver that, while maintaining quality and consistency. Detailed answers would be appreciated.

title: Ads Creative Strategist
description:
**About BabyBillion**

BabyBillion is a children’s learning app offering engaging videos and age-appropriate content for kids aged 2–8. We help parents make screen time more meaningful through a safe, ad-free experience that children enjoy and parents can trust.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for an
**Ads Creative Strategist**

You’ll own the creative process from ideation and scripting to final ad review, working closely with AI video editors and the performance marketing team to create, test and scale winning creatives that drive customer acquisition at a lower cost.

* Ability to provide clear creative direction and actionable feedback to video editors.
* Familiarity with performance metrics such as CTR, conversion rate and CAC, and the ability to use insights to improve creatives.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced startup environment.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with consumer apps, subscription products, EdTech, parenting or children’s brands.
* Familiarity with AI video creation tools and their creative possibilities and limitations.
* Demonstrated success in improving customer acquisition through performance-driven ad creatives.

**What Success Looks Like**

A consistent pipeline of compelling, high-quality Meta ad creatives that convert parents into paying customers while helping BabyBillion acquire customers more efficiently.

**Interested?**
Apply with your resume and portfolio of relevant ad scripts or video creatives.

title: E-commerce Specialist
description:
E-Commerce Specialist – D2C & Online Channels

Company: Flavours of Calicut | DGZ Holdings

Location: bangalore

Experience: 2–4 Years

Employment Type: Full-time

Industry: FMCG / Food & Beverages

Compensation: Competitive, based on experience

About the Role

We are looking for an E-Commerce Specialist – D2C & Online Channels to take ownership of our digital commerce presence and help drive the next phase of online growth.

The role will primarily focus on strengthening and growing our D2C business through Shopify, while also managing and expanding our presence across e-commerce marketplaces, quick-commerce platforms and other relevant online sales channels.

This is not just a listing or catalogue-management role. We are looking for someone who understands how products get discovered, convert and grow online and can proactively identify opportunities to improve sales and performance.

Key Responsibilities

\* Own and continuously improve our Shopify D2C website, including products, collections, merchandising, offers, bundles and overall customer journey.

\* Identify opportunities to grow D2C traffic, conversion, average order value, repeat purchases and organic sales.

\* Manage, optimise and expand product presence across relevant e-commerce and marketplace channels.

\* Activate or reactivate listings and identify new online channel opportunities for the brands.

\* Manage product catalogues, titles, descriptions, keywords, images, pricing, offers and other product-page elements.

\* Improve product discoverability, search visibility and conversion across online channels.

\* Support and coordinate product listings, availability, promotions and brand presence across quick-commerce platforms.

\* Monitor sales, inventory, pricing, ratings, reviews, returns and overall channel performance.

\* Coordinate with external agencies and platform partners, review their recommendations and ensure opportunities are being properly utilised.

\* Work closely with marketing, design, sales, warehouse and operations teams for campaigns, launches and fulfilment.

\* Track key e-commerce and D2C metrics and provide clear weekly/monthly insights and recommendations.

\* Monitor competitors, category trends and emerging online opportunities and proactively recommend actions.

What We’re Looking For

\* 2–4 years of hands-on experience in e-commerce, D2C, marketplaces or digital commerce.

\* Strong practical experience with Shopify and marketplace seller platforms.

\* Good understanding of catalogue optimisation, marketplace SEO, product content and conversion.

\* Understanding of e-commerce advertising and performance metrics; hands-on experience is an advantage.

\* Experience or familiarity with quick commerce will be an advantage.

\* Strong working knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets and ability to analyse sales and performance data.

\* Experience in FMCG, food, consumer brands or other high-SKU businesses is preferred.

\* Strong ownership, attention to detail and problem-solving ability.

\* A commercial mindset — someone who goes beyond managing tasks and actively looks for ways to grow online sales and improve performance.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means building a stronger D2C business, improving the quality and performance of our online presence, activating new opportunities across e-commerce and quick commerce, and giving the business clear visibility into what is working and what we should do next to grow.

Why Join Us?

Flavours of Calicut is part of DGZ Holdings, a growing food business building consumer brands across India and international markets.

Our e-commerce function is moving from founder-led execution towards a dedicated internal capability. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership, build the function and directly contribute to the next phase of our online growth.

Interested candidates can share their updated CV with our People & Culture team.

description:

**Preferred qualifications:**

* PhD in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Operation Research, or a related field.
* Experience with mathematical optimization (e.g., LP, IP, MIP, NLP).

**About The Job**
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
  
  
As a key member of a small and versatile team, you design, test, deploy and maintain software solutions.
  
  
Within Google Cloud, the AI and Infrastructure (AI2) organization is at the forefront of creating AI/ML capabilities. We are responsible for designing and managing the software, hardware, and Machine Learning (ML) systems infrastructure that power essential Google services such as Search and YouTube, as well as Google Cloud products.
  
  
As a PhD Software Engineer within AI2, your specialized research expertise will be instrumental in solving complex, real-world problems on an unprecedented scale. You will engage in innovative projects spanning areas like AI/ML, networking, data storage, security, and distributed systems.
  
  
The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.
  
  
We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain advanced optimization models (e.g., mixed integer programming).

* Experiment and prototype for foundational tech stacks comparison and selection.
* Implement, deploy, and rollout features following safe rollout practices.
* Interact with users, partner teams for feature scoping, rollout support, and training.

title: Business Analyst, Support, Supply Chain
description:
**Description**
We are seeking a highly analytical and business-savvy Business Analyst to join our Supply Chain SSD team. In this role, you will be the analytical engine behind decisions impacting SSD business, the tip of the speed spear.
  
  
You will partner closely with Program Managers, Operations, Supply Chain, and Tech teams to identify inefficiencies, surface insights from large and complex datasets, and translate them into actionable recommendations. The ideal candidate is someone who lives and breathes data, has strong SQL chops, can build dashboards that tell a story, and brings sharp business acumen to identify and solve hard, ambiguous problems. We are looking for a hands-on operator - someone who does not wait for clean data or perfect requirements, but rolls up their sleeves, digs into the problem, and drives it to closure.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
∙ Deep-dive analytics: Independently scope, design, and execute complex analyses on inventory placement, network flow, regional demand patterns, fill rates, and outbound shipping cost drivers. Translate raw data into clear, actionable business insights.
  
  
∙ Dashboard and reporting ownership: Build, automate, and maintain self-serve dashboards (QuickSight, Tableau, or similar) that give stakeholders real-time visibility into key placement, inventory health, and network performance metrics.
  
  
∙ SQL and data engineering: Write efficient, production-grade SQL on large datasets (Redshift, Hive, Athena). Build and maintain ETL pipelines, data marts, and reusable datasets that scale across the team.
  
  
∙ Problem identification: Proactively find gaps, anomalies, and improvement opportunities in placement logic, replenishment patterns, and inventory positioning — often before stakeholders ask. Frame these as business problems with quantified impact.
  
  
∙ Drive business decisions: Partner with Program Managers and Category teams to size opportunities, run A/B tests or controlled experiments, and recommend changes to placement strategy, sourcing policies, or network design.
  
  
∙ Goal and metric ownership: Own the definition, tracking, and reporting of team-level metrics and weekly/monthly business reviews (WBR/MBR). Investigate variances and root-cause performance misses.
  
  
∙ Stakeholder communication: Present findings to senior leadership in crisp, data-backed narratives — both written documents and verbal reviews. Influence decisions without authority.
  
  
∙ Tooling and automation: Identify manual, repetitive workflows and automate them using SQL, Python, or scripting. Continuously raise the bar on team productivity.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
* Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of data pipelining and extraction using SQL
* Knowledge of SQL and Excel at a moderate or advanced level
* Experience with data mining tools like SQL, SAS, SPSS, or similar

title: Staff Software Engineer, Frontier Security Team
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
  
  
We are hiring a Staff Software Engineer for our Frontier Security AI team. Snowflake's Frontier Security AI teams develop production-grade LLM applications, intelligent agents, AI infrastructure, and evaluation systems for enterprise customers — products that must meet a high bar for quality, security, reliability, and efficiency while operating over sensitive data at large scale. In this role, you will lead the design and development of our Agentic Harness and agent evaluation platform, working across product, infrastructure, applied AI, security, and modeling teams to take new capabilities from prototype to dependable customer value.
  
  
**AS A STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:**

* Architect and build the Agentic Harness that executes complex, multi-step AI workflows across models, tools, data, and services.
* Design stable interfaces for tool execution, context construction, state management, memory, permissions, retries, fallbacks, and human review.
* Own agent quality end to end by building evaluation harnesses, representative datasets, automated graders, experiment pipelines, and release gates.
* Convert ambiguous reports such as "the agent feels worse" into measurable failure modes, reproducible tests, and durable fixes.
* Analyze production agent trajectories to identify failures in reasoning, retrieval, tool use, context, orchestration, and application code.
* Close the loop between production incidents, root-cause analysis, evaluation coverage, and regression prevention.
* Develop offline and online measurements for task completion, correctness, groundedness, safety, latency, reliability, and cost.
* Build simulation and replay infrastructure for golden-set tests, adversarial scenarios, model comparisons, and large-scale experiments.
* Improve agent efficiency through model routing, prompt and semantic caching, context compaction, tool-result management, and token optimization.
* Productionize new model capabilities as secure, observable, multi-tenant services with clear operational controls.
* Establish standards for evaluation design, including sampling, ground-truth quality, grader calibration, leakage prevention, and statistical significance.
* Define technical direction across multiple teams and lead projects whose scope extends beyond a single service.
* Mentor engineers, raise the quality of architecture reviews, and remain directly involved in implementation and debugging.

**OUR IDEAL STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:**

* 9+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership of complex production systems.
* Direct experience shipping and operating LLM applications, AI agents, or model-backed workflows in production.
* Strong background in distributed systems, service architecture, high-throughput APIs, concurrency, and failure handling.
* Experience building an agent runtime, workflow engine, developer platform, evaluation system, or similar infrastructure.
* Demonstrated ability to evaluate nondeterministic systems without relying on a single aggregate score.
* Fluency in Python and strong proficiency in at least one systems or application language such as Java, Go, Rust, or TypeScript.
* Hands-on knowledge of tool calling, structured generation, retrieval, context engineering, prompt management, and model APIs.
* Experience with production observability, including structured traces, replay, metrics, logs, and incident diagnosis.
* Ability to balance agent quality with latency, reliability, security, and inference cost.
* Track record of setting technical direction and delivering results across organizational boundaries.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Clear written and verbal communication with engineering, product, and leadership audiences.

**BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:**

* Building evaluation or observability infrastructure for agentic coding, data engineering, or analytics systems.
* Designing human-evaluation programs, scoring rubrics, annotation workflows, or grader-calibration methods.
* Working with multi-agent orchestration, long-running agents, asynchronous workflows, or durable execution.

that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA.
  
  

* Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e.g., 8am in San Francisco is 8:30pm in Bengaluru).

* 4+ years across the full software development lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operations.
* 4+years of experience in cloud infrastructure and containerized workloads such as AWS, Kubernetes, or EKS.

title: Lead Software Engineer, Real Time Index Engineering(Java)
description:
FTSE Russell is a leading global provider of financial services, specialising in the creation and management of indexes, data, and analytic solutions. As part of the London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG), we support investors worldwide in making informed decisions across asset classes, investment strategies, and market segments. Our products are trusted by institutional and retail investors, asset managers, and pension funds to benchmark performance, build investment portfolios, and manage risk.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We're seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the team building the Real Time Framework (RTF), our low-latency, cloud-native platform for calculating, managing and distributing FTSE Russell's real-time indices at global scale, spanning Equity, Fixed Income and Multi-Asset coverage. Reliability, security, and data quality are non-negotiable as we modernise the platform that underpins our entire real-time franchise.

This team operates with an AI-first approach. We expect hands-on experience with AI development tooling: terminal-based agents, AI-augmented IDEs, and automated workflows. You are ultimately accountable for production quality, security, and correctness. This means owning infrastructure review, security validation, system observability, and operational guardrails.

* Operate a cloud-native, horizontally scalable, always-on platform, built as resilient and managed through infrastructure as code.
* Own data foundations for real-time market and reference data, with strong modelling, quality and auditability.
* Deliver secure APIs and streaming, event-driven distribution that make real-time index data easy to consume.
* Help bring advanced and multi-asset methodologies to market (e.g. volatility-controlled, options/futures-based, long-short).
* Modernise the operations experience: replace manual workflows with intuitive tooling and observability.
* Lead through architecture, code review and test strategy, partnering across product, operations and client-facing teams.

Tech Stack
  
  

* Development: Java, C#,, Python, SQL, OpenAPI

* IaC and CI/CD: Terraform, AWS CLI, GitLab
* AI Development: Agentic AI tooling (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code)

* Strong expertise in system design, distributed and event-driven systems, and relational data modelling.
* Solid experience building and operating cloud-native applications on AWS.
* Ability to write and maintain infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent).
* Experience designing test strategies at multiple levels of the testing pyramid.
* Proficiency with AI development tooling and a clear understanding of how to use AI to accelerate delivery while maintaining quality.
* Strong debugging skills across distributed systems.
* Basic understanding of financial services or capital markets.
* Effective collaboration and the ability to communicate technical decisions to non-technical audiences.

How We Work
  
  
The Real Time team builds and operates the platform that calculates, manages and distributes FTSE Russell's real-time indices to the global financial ecosystem. We foster a culture of engineering excellence, solving real-world problems with purpose and ambition. We're looking for skilled and passionate engineers to drive the future of modern solutions working with leading AI development tools.
  
  

* Build with purpose. Start with why. Define the problem before reaching for a solution.
* Customer driven. Work backwards from client needs and build products to address real-world problems.
* Technically courageous. Go beyond your comfort zone and push boundaries to deliver excellence.
* Learn and be curious. Continuously seek feedback, learn in formal and informal settings, actively share knowledge.

* Lead with data. Validate assumptions, stay close to the details, act decisively.
* Build responsibly, deliver incrementally. Look for the small opportunities and milestones to build ambitious solutions.
* AI-native by default. Use AI tooling as a force multiplier, frame problems clearly, validate continually, and own the output.

title: Senior Quant Developer - Algorithmic Trading
description:
**About BestEx Research**
BestEx Research is a financial technology and research firm specializing in building sophisticated execution algorithms and transaction cost modeling tools servicing multiple asset classes. The firm provides high-performance algorithmic execution services to hedge funds, CTAs, asset managers, and banks through a traditional electronic broker and in a broker-neutral Software as a Service (SaaS) model.
  
  
Its cloud-based platform, Algo Management System (AMS), is the first end-to-end algorithmic trading solution for equities and futures that delivers an entire ecosystem around execution algorithms, including transaction cost analysis (TCA), an algorithm customization tool called Strategy Studio, a trading dashboard, and pre-trade analytics in a single platform. The platform is currently live for U.S., Europe, and Canadian equities and global futures trading.
  
  
BestEx Research is disrupting a $100 billion industry by challenging the status quo of stale, black-box solutions from banks and offering next-generation execution algorithms that combine performance improvement with transparency and customization. BestEx Research uses leading-edge technology to support its low-latency, highly scalable research and trading systems, with its backend in C++, research libraries in C++/Python and R, and web-based technologies for delivering its front-end platforms.
  
  
BestEx Research's mission is to become the leader in automation and measurement of execution across asset classes globally and significantly reduce transaction costs for our clients.
  
  
Visit for more information about our mission, products, research, and services.
  
  
**Why Join Us?**
BestEx Research's Bangalore office is not an "offshore center." It's a core engineering and research hub—working on the exact same problems and projects as our U.S. team. You'll be part of the global brain trust, solving some of the hardest problems in trading, systems, and data science.
  
  
**What You'll Love:**

* Zero bureaucracy, zero silos—engineers directly collaborate with traders, researchers, and the CEO
* Direct ownership and end-to-end visibility on production systems
* Daily opportunity to learn from pioneers in HFT, low-latency systems, and algo trading
* A high-trust environment where performance speaks louder than hierarchy
* Competitive compensation in India, including equity and cash bonuses
* 5-week structured training program:

**Your Role: Build What Most Engineers Never Get to Touch**

* Market microstructure and trading mechanics
* Algorithmic execution and strategy design
* Exchange simulators and performance testing
* Market data systems and real-time analytics
* Hands-on exercises using production research data
* Continuous professional development, with refresher courses, advanced sessions, and on-demand training tailored to your growth
* Global exposure: Opportunities to collaborate with, visit, or relocate to our U.S., Singapore, or London offices, based on performance and business needs

You'll be part of a lean, focused team building ultra-low-latency trading systems, real-time exchange simulators, execution algorithms, and alpha forecasting models. Our engineers own the stack—from C++ nanosecond-sensitive infrastructure to Python-based research platforms.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of research and engineering—comfortable building systems, testing hypotheses, and working directly with data that moves markets.
  
  
**What You'll Work On**

* Architect and implement:
* Execution algorithms across global markets
* Exchange simulators and tick-level backtesting frameworks
* Smart Order Routing systems across lit and dark venues
* Models for market impact, price prediction, and volume forecasting
* High-performance trading systems optimized for throughput and latency
* Core infrastructure to support new asset classes and global markets
* Collaborate closely with global quants, traders, and senior engineers
* Analyze system performance across app, OS, and hardware layers

**Requirements**
**You Should Have**

* Bachelor's or Master's from a top-tier CS, Math, or Engineering program (IIT/NIT/BITS preferred but not required)
* 6+ years hands-on C++ experience (C++14/17/20) in performance-sensitive applications
* Strong fundamentals in data structures, OS, networks, and concurrency
* Python fluency for data analysis and prototyping (preferred but not required)
* Experience with large-scale, real-time systems (trading experience is a plus but not mandatory)
* Passion for learning—markets, systems, and modeling

**Bonus Points For**

* Deep experience with TCP/IP, multi-threading, and latency optimization
* Prior work on trading platforms, FIX engines, or exchange protocols
* SQL optimization and experience with research or market data pipelines
* Contributions to open-source C++/Python performance tools

**Benefits**
**Why This Role Is Rare**

* Exposure to real-time trading systems live in global markets
* Direct mentorship from senior algorithmic trading and software engineering veterans
* Blend of research, systems design, and algorithm development
* Equity and cash compensation
* Zero red tape, no outsourcing mentality

title: Senior Software Engineer, Compute Software
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.
  
  
Waymo is seeking versatile Software Engineers to join our Compute Software team in Bangalore. As part of a high-impact systems engineering team, you will design, build, and scale the critical software infrastructure and runtime components that connect our autonomous driving technology with next-generation custom silicon and compute platforms.
  
  
In this role, you will work across the compute system lifecycle, architecting robust C++ software, developing scaleable Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) automation harnesses, driving system qualification across hardware revisions, and optimizing software performance for autonomous vehicle platforms.
  
  
*This role follows a hybrid schedule and reports to Staff ML Compiler Engineer.*
**You Will**

* Software Architecture: Design, build, and maintain high-performance C++ software, runtime components, and diagnostic tools supporting custom silicon and compute platforms
* Test Infrastructure: Build and scale robust Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test harnesses, automated regression frameworks, and CI/CD pipelines across the compute stack (firmware, kernel, runtime, and compilers)
* Qualification and Reliability: Drive qualification workflows, automated regression suites, and release readiness verification across multiple hardware revisions and platform configurations
* System Debugging: Troubleshoot and root-cause complex software-to-hardware communication issues, concurrency bugs, and performance bottlenecks across physical lab hardware and emulation environments
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner closely with hardware design, silicon validation, compiler, and vehicle platform teams to translate technical specifications into production-grade software solutions
* Tooling & Velocity: Develop modular developer tooling, telemetry monitors, and automated workflows to accelerate qualification velocity and software reliability

**You Have**

* Education & Experience: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field (or equivalent practical experience) with 5+ years of industry experience
* C++ Proficiency: Strong proficiency in modern C++, backed by solid software engineering fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, and modular architecture)
* Systems & Infrastructure: Experience designing systems software, software testing methodologies, or scaleable test automation frameworks
* Development Environment: Hands-on experience with Linux/Unix environments, build systems, scripting (Python/Bash), and modern CI/CD / version control workflows
* Debugging & Problem Solving: Strong analytical and debugging skills, with a proven track record of diagnosing complex issues across software/system boundaries
* Adaptability: Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to learn low-level hardware interfacing, embedded systems concepts, or compiler optimizations on the job

**We Prefer**

* For the Silicon & Validation Track:

+ Experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) setups, automated lab testbeds, or embedded test environments
+ Prior experience in post-silicon validation, System-Level Testing (SLT), ASIC bring-up, or diagnostic software development
+ Exposure to hardware-software interfacing (e.g., Memory-Mapped I/O, device drivers, firmware, POSIX APIs, bare-metal/RTOS)
+ Knowledge of standard hardware communication protocols (e.g., PCIe, I2C, SPI, UART, JTAG) or compute IP blocks (DDR, DMA)

* For the Compiler & ML Track:

+ Familiarity with compiler toolchains/frameworks (e.g., LLVM, MLIR, GCC) or experience optimizing runtime performance for machine learning workloads

Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

title: Staff Cloud Infra Engineer
description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
  
  
Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
  
  
At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
  
  
When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
  
  
**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
*This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office.*
**About The Role**
You'll own a significant area of our cloud platform end to end — the Kubernetes and IaC foundations, the reliability of what runs on them, or the security controls that wrap them — across cloud regions and out to edge sites co-located with our satellite gateways.
  
  
At Staff level we expect you to take a problem that's stated loosely, turn it into a plan, and deliver it without close supervision. You'll write the design doc, get it reviewed, build the thing, and then operate it. You're not expected to set direction for the whole org — but you are expected to shape it for your area, and to be the person others come to when that area is on fire. This is a hands-on role. The majority of your week is building.
  
  
What you'll own
  
  
**Platform and Kubernetes**

* Operate and improve our multi-cluster, multi-region Kubernetes platform: cluster lifecycle, upgrades, workload isolation, networking, and resource management.
* Build and maintain infrastructure as code as a real engineering artifact — reviewed, tested, versioned, no manual drift.
* Extend our developer platform so shipping a service is fast and boring: golden paths, progressive delivery, environments that don't require a ticket.
* Own CI/CD pipelines for workloads ranging from ordinary stateless services to network functions with strict latency and availability requirements.

**Reliability and observability**

* Instrument services against SLOs and build out the metrics, logs, and tracing needed to know whether we're meeting them.
* Participate in on-call, lead incidents in your area, and write postmortems that produce real changes rather than filed documents.
* Tune alerting so engineers trust it. Drive down toil through automation, deliberately and measurably.
* Contribute to capacity planning, failure-domain design, and DR testing for a network that can't take a casual maintenance window.

**Security and compliance infrastructure**

* Implement and maintain platform security controls: least-privilege IAM, secrets management, network segmentation, image scanning, and supply-chain integrity.
* Automate the evidence that compliance requires, so audits are a query rather than a project.
* Work with Security on the requirements that come with operating inside a carrier's network.

**Technical contribution**

* Write design docs for the systems you own and take them through review.
* Review code and infrastructure changes with an eye on operability, not just correctness.
* Mentor mid-level engineers and improve the team's practices by demonstrating them.

What we're looking for
  
  
**Required**

* 7+ years in infrastructure, platform, DevOps, or SRE roles, with clear ownership of production systems that mattered.
* Strong production Kubernetes experience — not just deploying to it, but operating it: upgrades, networking, resource limits, and debugging failures that aren't in the documentation.
* Hands-on depth in AWS or GCP. Exposure to a second cloud, or to hybrid and edge infrastructure, is a real plus — our footprint isn't uniform and we need people who don't stall when the environment gets irregular.
* Solid infrastructure as code practice (Terraform or equivalent), applied where discipline actually mattered.
* Proficiency in at least one systems or automation language — Go or Python preferred — enough to build tooling, not only scripts.
* Direct production reliability ownership: you've carried a pager for something important, run incidents, and changed systems as a result.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure security: IAM, secrets, network policy, container hardening.
* Clear written communication. Design docs and postmortems are core to how this team works.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Telecom or network infrastructure exposure — 5G core, cloud-native network functions, or carrier-grade availability requirements.
* Have some experience in managing databases and applications with High Availability of 99.999%.
* Edge or on-premises infrastructure alongside public cloud, particularly sites with constrained connectivity.
* Compliance-adjacent environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or carrier security requirements).
* FinOps Cost engineering — you've meaningfully reduced cloud spend without degrading reliability.
* Working across distributed teams and time zones.

**What This Role Is Not**

* Not a people-management role. This is an IC position and we intend to keep it one.
* Not a ticket queue. You'll be given problems, not tasks, and we expect you to scope them yourself.
* Not a greenfield rewrite. You'll be improving a system already carrying live traffic, which is harder and more interesting.

Why this role is worth your time
  
  
Satellite direct-to-device is a genuinely new category, and the infrastructure patterns for it are not settled. The team is small enough that what you build is in production within weeks and visibly yours. If you're strong technically and looking for scope that would take years to get at a larger company, that's the trade we're offering.
  
  
**What We Offer**
With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range of benefits such as:
  
  

* Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
* Comprehensive benefits plans
* Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
* A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
* Once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to be part of developing and running the world’s first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network and service
* Access to a world-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
* Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends Silicon Valley, Nordic and South Asia characteristics

**EEO Statement**
