title: Principal Engineer
description:
The Foundry platform is a federation of six squads - Sizer, DES, GCM, Emulator, Layout Designer and Applied AI - each owning their mission autonomously. The Platform / Integration Principal is the technical authority that holds this federation together: you own the cross-squad contracts, define the API boundaries that allow squads to evolve independently, and set the architecture that will scale the platform from an internal tool to a customer-facing product used by System Integrators. You operate at the highest individual-contributor level in Foundry - no engineering management, pure technical leadership - and your decisions have multi-year consequences. You are the go-to authority on platform architecture, will represent Foundry in external technical discussions with SI partners, and will set the engineering standard the rest of the organisation aspires to.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the cross-squad integration contracts - Define and maintain the interface contracts between squads: the DES↔Sizer reverse-flow (cycle times back into sizing), the DES→Emulator handoff (simulation state to virtual commissioning), and the SI-partner API platform; ensure contracts are versioned, tested and backward-compatible.
* Architect the Layout Service - Design and own the Layout Service: the shared representation of a warehouse design that the Layout Designer, DES and Emulator all read from and write to; define its schema, versioning model and access patterns.
* Define the SI-partner API platform - Design the external REST/gRPC API that System Integrators (Dematic, Sistemo, Envista) use to submit solutioning requests, receive results and embed Foundry capabilities in their own tools. Set the technical-debt and scalability strategy - Identify the current architectural constraints that will limit growth; propose and sequence remediation with minimal disruption to squad delivery.
* Lead architecture review - Chair the cross-squad architecture review process; approve or challenge architectural decisions that cross squad boundaries; author and maintain the Architecture Decision Record (ADR) library.
* Represent Foundry in external technical discussions - Participate in technical discovery sessions with SI partners; understand their integration needs and translate them into platform requirements.
* Mentor Principal/Staff and Staff engineers - Raise the technical ceiling of the organisation through code review, design critique, pairing and written guidance; be the person engineers go to for the hardest problems.
* Drive hiring quality - Participate in technical interviews; define what 'principal-level' means in Foundry; help calibrate the bar.

**Minimum (required) Qualifications**

* 15+ years professional software engineering.
* Deep experience designing platform APIs at scale: REST and gRPC; multi-tenant, versioned, backward-compatible.
* Experience architecting distributed systems used by multiple consuming teams.
* Track record of cross-team architectural leadership: ADRs, design reviews, technical standards.
* Experience with B2B SaaS, partner/SI API platforms or developer-facing products.
* Strong written communication: can produce an ADR that a squad understands and can implement from.
* Mentoring experience at Staff and Principal level.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with warehouse automation, robotics, industrial IoT or AMR fleet management platforms.
* Familiarity with Rust + Erlang interoperability - the Foundry simulation and control stacks.
* Experience designing event-driven integration architectures (event sourcing, CQRS, saga patterns).
* Background in building integration platforms consumed by enterprise SI / ISV partners.
* Experience with developer experience (DX) design: SDKs, API documentation, sandbox environments.
* Familiarity with multi-agent AI architectures interacting with backend platform APIs.
* Prior Principal Engineer or Distinguished Engineer scope at a technology company.

**Technical Qualifications**

* We expect you to be proficient in or quickly learn the following. Senior roles (Band E+) are expected to be experts; Band C/D roles are expected to have working knowledge.
* Platform API: REST (OpenAPI 3.x) and gRPC (Protobuf) at scale; API versioning strategies (URL, header, content-type); backward-compatibility guarantees and sunset policies.
* Integration patterns: event-driven architecture (Kafka / Pub/Sub); saga pattern for multi-squad transactions; outbox pattern for reliable event publishing; circuit breakers and bulkheads.
* Data architecture: schema evolution (Avro / Protobuf compatibility rules); distributed schema registry; the Layout Service data model (graph-based warehouse representation).
* Languages: Java or Go (primary for platform services); Rust reading ability; Python for tooling.
* Infrastructure: GCP (GKE, Cloud Spanner for global consistency, Pub/Sub, IAM); Terraform; Backstage as the service catalog and API portal.
* Security: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC for partner authentication; fine-grained RBAC for multi-tenant access; API key lifecycle management; secrets management via GCP Secret Manager.
* Observability: distributed tracing across squad boundaries (OpenTelemetry); SLO definition and error-budget tracking; Grafana dashboards for the integration layer; OneUptime for on-call.
* Developer experience: OpenAPI-generated SDKs; Postman / API sandbox; developer-portal integration via Backstage.
* Testing: contract tests (Pact or custom); chaos engineering (fault injection in the integration layer); load testing for SI partner API endpoints.

**How We Work**

* You report to the Senior Director and operate across all squads.
* You do not manage people - you lead through technical authority and the quality of your written and spoken reasoning. You are the primary decision-maker for decisions that cross squad boundaries (one-way-door calls in our decision framework) and you chair the architecture review process.
* You are expected to be available for cross-squad unblocking quickly and to produce written ADRs for every significant architectural decision.

eReleGo Technologies Private Limited (ETPL) is a Bengaluru-based technology company building scalable digital platforms across AdTech, EdTech, SaaS ERP, and FinTech domains. The company focuses on applying advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence and data-driven systems to solve real operational problems for businesses and educational institutions.

As ETPL scales into a firm of larger size, revenue, and complexity, it is investing deliberately in building strong internal capabilities across leadership, operations, technology, people, and culture. The objective is not just rapid growth, but sustainable, future-ready growth supported by structured systems, strong talent, and accountable teams.

**About Crafter**

Crafter is a comprehensive low-code / no-code Enterprise & SaaS platform that helps organizations build custom applications, automate workflows, and streamline core business processes without extensive technical expertise.

Designed for startups, SMEs, and large enterprises seeking agility and efficiency, Crafter’s visual drag-and-drop builder and modular solutions enable businesses to rapidly create applications, manage resources, and enhance customer engagement with minimal coding.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Staff Engineer with 6 to 9 years of hands-on experience in Java and Spring Boot to provide technical leadership across one or more products within the ETPL AI portfolio. This role sits within ETPL's engineering capability and carries responsibility for backend architecture, system design, engineering quality, and the technical development of delivery teams.

The Staff Engineer will be the senior technical authority within their product engineering context - owning architectural decisions, driving best practices, and ensuring that the systems they are responsible for are scalable, maintainable, and built to support enterprise-grade deployments. The role combines deep hands-on engineering with the influence and communication skills to lead other engineers and engage meaningfully with product and business stakeholders.

This is a role for an engineer who has moved beyond individual contribution and is ready to shape how systems are designed, how teams deliver, and how technical quality is defined and maintained across a product.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide technical leadership in the design, development, and evolution of backend systems and services built on Java and Spring Boot across assigned ETPL AI products
* Own system architecture decisions for assigned product areas - ensuring scalability, modularity, security, and performance across multi-tenant enterprise deployments
* Lead and mentor a team of engineers, conducting code reviews, architectural walkthroughs, and technical discussions that raise the capability and quality of the broader team
* Translate product requirements and business logic into well-structured, maintainable technical designs - collaborating closely with product managers and senior stakeholders to ensure alignment between technical decisions and product outcomes
* Define and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and engineering governance frameworks across the product codebase
* Conduct architectural reviews and deep code audits to identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and structural risks - and lead the resolution of findings in a structured manner

* Drive the adoption of RESTful API design standards, microservices principles, and service integration patterns appropriate to ETPL's platform architecture
* Own the technical quality of the software delivery lifecycle within the product team - including requirements validation, design reviews, testing governance, deployment oversight, and post-release monitoring
* Identify, evaluate, and integrate appropriate libraries, frameworks, and tools to improve engineering efficiency, system reliability, and long-term maintainability
* Act as the escalation point for critical technical issues and production incidents within the product, leading structured root cause analysis and resolution
* Champion a culture of engineering excellence, documentation discipline, and continuous improvement within the product engineering team

**Experience And Profile**

* 6 to 9 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with strong and sustained depth in Java and Spring Boot
* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering scalable, high-performance backend systems for enterprise or SaaS products
* Experience leading or mentoring other engineers within a structured delivery team
* Proven ability to make and communicate sound architectural decisions across backend systems, APIs, and data layers
* Experience with microservices architecture, RESTful API design, and distributed systems is expected
* Prior exposure to multi-tenant platform design or enterprise product engineering is an advantage

**Skills And Attributes**

* Deep mastery of Java and Spring Boot, with strong expertise in building modular, production-grade enterprise backend systems
* Solid understanding of Spring ecosystem components - Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud - and their appropriate application in enterprise contexts
* Strong database engineering skills across relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) including schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and performance tuning at scale
* Proficiency in RESTful API design and development, with a clear understanding of API contracts, versioning, and integration standards
* Experience with microservices architecture, service decomposition, and inter-service communication patterns including REST and message queuing (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes, and with CI/CD pipeline tooling for structured, automated delivery
* Proficiency with Git and structured branching strategies for collaborative development within multi-team engineering environments
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms - AWS / Azure - and the deployment and infrastructure considerations relevant to enterprise SaaS products
* Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and test-driven development practices, with a commitment to maintaining high automated test coverage
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with structured root cause analysis — particularly under production pressure
* Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical decisions and trade-offs to both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders
* A collaborative and mentoring disposition - genuinely invested in the growth of the engineers around them, not just personal technical output

**Recruitment Process**

ETPL follows a structured, assessment-led recruitment process focused on long-term fit and capability development. Shortlisted candidates will go through:

* ETPL Aptitude Test (EAT) - to assess analytical ability, reasoning, and problem-solving
* ETPL Psychometric Test (EPT) - to understand work style, behavioral tendencies, and role alignment
* Interview Rounds - including functional and culture-fit discussions

This process ensures fairness, transparency, and clarity for both the candidate and the organization.

**What do we offer**

* Exposure to senior educators, institutional leaders, and industry practitioners
* Opportunities to learn from internal capability-building initiatives and leadership programs
* A growing organization that is investing in better systems, clearer roles, and stronger people practices
* A work environment that values learning, ownership, and long-term career growth

As a scaling company, ETPL is evolving its processes, teams, and structures. This role suits individuals who are comfortable growing alongside the organization, contributing to improvement, and building strong foundations rather than expecting everything to be fully polished from day one.

title: Digital Quality Analyst - Marketing Tech Team
description:
At Columbia, we’re as passionate about the outdoors as you are. And while our gear is available worldwide, we’re proud to be based in the Pacific Northwest, where natural wonders are our playground.
  
  
Every product we make and every task we undertake is inspired by the famous words of our founder Gert Boyle: “It’s perfect. Now make it better.” As pioneers of relentless improvement, we are constantly evolving.
  
  
We believe the outdoors is ours to protect and strive to keep our planet healthy. We believe in empowering people to experience the outdoors to the fullest.
  
  
And we believe in you.
  
  
**About The Position**
Although we're an apparel and footwear-focused company, technology is central to everything we do. Columbia Sportswear’s Digital Technology (CDT) group enables an IT infrastructure and applications across four global brands, a global supply chain, and 500+ geographically dispersed stores. These teams support in-store, mobile, and data platforms to enhance customer interface and service in an ever-evolving industry.
  
  
The Quality Analyst II has a solid understanding of technology platforms and utilizes best practices among the quality team. This person reviews test strategies, authors test plans, and authors and executes test cases. The Quality Analyst II uses a variety of testing tools and methods and updates or creates automated test cases. The role executes automated test scripts and identify process and/ technology issues.
  
  
**How You’ll Make a Difference**

* Communication, Collaboration & Leadership: Communicates status in daily meetings, fosters constructive, collaborative and effective communication with others, both internally and externally. Actively participates in design discussions, planning, and retrospective reviews. Explains and simplifies complex information to others.
* Knowledge: Ensures processes are clearly documented. Demonstrates a basic understanding of the functions and technologies of the product. Learns about multiple test techniques, tools and business context and technologies of the software used. Addresses problems, proposes solutions, and takes action to resolve, referring more complex issues to senior employees.
* Metrics: Creates and monitors status dashboards for tracking team progress
* Quality Standards: Drives analysis of post release quality and defect escapes and implements improvements based on the results of analysis. Completes straightforward projects and provides input for enhancements to improve test coverage and processes. Assesses the testability of components and features built by development teams. Works with project team to establish quality standards or metrics and identify risks.
* Test Strategy & Planning: Identifies salient test cases based on product domain knowledge and traceability to use cases, enabling on-time sprint deployments. Writes effective and efficient test scripts and test cases. Reviews of test plans are thoughtful and considerate of the customer and time frames needed for releases.
* Test Execution: Ensures thorough and complete resolution and closure of tickets once deployed to production. Assists developers in desk checks and testing. Works with the team to ensure code is tested at the appropriate level, assists in gaining efficiencies. Identifies and prevents defects early. Proactively works to identify the root cause of problems and identifies efficient ways to reproduce issues. Contributes to bug triage and prioritization processes.
* Mentorship: Provides peer level technical guidance for team members. Helps more junior team members learn, grow and contribute to the team.

**YOU ARE**

* Genuinely curious — you ask why, not just whether. You want to understand why a tag fires in a specific sequence, what the Liquid personalization token is supposed to render for a given profile, and what a consent mode change means downstream for pixel data. You treat every testability gap as a signal worth investigating, not an obstacle to work around.
* Shift-left by default. You don't wait for a build to find problems. You read acceptance criteria like an auditor — spotting what's missing, what's ambiguous, and what will create a defect if it isn't clarified before dev starts. Refinement is where your value shows up first.
* A master of async defect communication. You file bugs the way a distributed team needs you to — self-contained, structured, and immediately actionable. A QA defect in your queue is never a mystery that needs a Zoom call to decode. Your documentation is your reputation.
* Globally minded, with experience working on geographically distributed teams. You understand the discipline, cadence, and over-communication required to make a US–India collaboration genuinely cohesive — and you've built those habits in practice.
* Methodical and detail-oriented — you understand that a missed pixel fire or a broken personalization token has real downstream consequences for marketing measurement and campaign performance. You bring that care to every test case you write and every defect you file.
* A collaborative teammate, comfortable working across engineering, product, analytics, and marketing functions within a globally distributed model. You don't stay in a QA swim lane — you go where quality needs attention.

**YOU HAVE**

* Bachelor’s Degree required Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
* 4+ years’ experience
* Proficiency with Postman for API testing — structured request/response validation, test data generation, role-based access checks, and SLA timing verification.
* Experience with email QA — template render testing using Email on Acid, Litmus, or equivalent; familiarity with ESP platform testing (Zeta, Braze, Emarsys, or similar).
* Working knowledge of tag management QA — understanding what tag management systems do, how to use browser developer tools to validate tag fires, and how to read data layer objects against a specification. Experience with the Adobe Experience Platform Debugger or equivalent tag debugging tooling is strongly preferred.
* Solid understanding of agile/Scrum delivery — shift-left quality practices, sprint ceremony participation, Definition of Ready and Definition of Done as quality gates, QA sizing in sprint planning.
* Experience with Jira for defect tracking, defect lifecycle management, and sprint ticket status workflows.
* Experience testing across a multi-phase test lifecycle: QA → SIT → UAT → E2E → Production validation.
* Demonstrated experience working on a globally distributed or cross-timezone team — including a US–India GCC model, offshore delivery, or equivalent. Prior experience collaborating with remote stakeholders is strongly preferred.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills — including the ability to write async-friendly defect reports, test status updates, and QA documentation that remote teammates can act on independently without a live call.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Adobe Analytics validation — understanding how events, eVars, props, and conversion metrics are captured and how to confirm accuracy against a measurement plan (SDR).
* Familiarity with OneTrust or consent management platforms and how they gate tag firing (GDPR/CCPA context).
* Experience testing on Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) — navigating Business Manager for test data setup, order creation, and profile configuration.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipeline integration for test automation — CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent; understanding of artifact reporting and suite segmentation (smoke, regression, integration).
* Exposure to Liquid templating in ESP platforms — ability to validate personalization logic and token rendering in email templates.

title: Design & Social Media
description:
**Full job description**

**Designer**

**About Finiteloop**

Finiteloop is a technology and design studio helping organisations build, transform, and scale with engineering, AI, and design working as one integrated capability. We are looking for people who are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment designing and developing physical and digital products and experiences.
**The design studio works in digital and physical spaces and will have a wide range of opportunities to be creative and experiment**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a hands-on Designer and a social media manager who shapes experiences. You will be embedded in delivery — working alongside business enterprise leaders, engineers, AI developers, and client teams to design interfaces, identities, and experiences that are intuitive, accessible, and build physical and digital products as well as create social media content and manage social media. Some of the opportunities to work on physical products are www.stepsaside.in and www.openego.in

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Be an original works creator. Ability to implement original ideas for branding and with a highly evolved aesthetic taste. Knowledge of various styles of design and historical evolution of design, and able to deliver design across multiple styles.**
* Deliver end-to-end design across client engagements:
* Design high-fidelity mockups and prototypes using latest tools
* Conduct field research, user interviews, and usability testing before getting a single output. Collaborate with Developers and front-end engineers to ensure faithful implementation of designs.
* Build and maintain scalable design systems with reusable components and design tokens. Design AI-specific interaction patterns: data visualisations, and intelligent assistants.
* Work directly with clients across industries (maritime, FMCG, enterprise, manufacturing, automation) to translate real workflows into design solutions.
* **Develop and execute branding identities that hold across digital, physical, and time — from visual language to brand systems.**
  Ability to use tools like Photoshop, illustrator, video editing tools, Figma , Canva efficiently to create works. Any skills in animation and motion graphics is an added advantage
* **Design for digital, print and packaging is an important part of this role — the same research-grounded rigour that applies to digital touchpoints applies equally to physical ones. Every surface matters.**
* Ensure designs meet WCAG 2.1 accessibility standards.
* Contribute to Finiteloop's design thinking, frameworks, and IP that reflect how we approach experience design. Adopt other design systems when necessary.
* Good understanding of designing for Digital marketing and social media. Excellent communication design capabilities.
* **Ability to strategize and manage social media fully**
* **Do field work for research, printing and packaging and product development.**

**Required Qualifications**

* 2-3 years of design experience across digital and physical products and brand design.
* **Strong portfolio with demonstrable experience working on both physical and digital products — end-to-end UX process, high-quality visual design, branding, print, and packaging work across mediums.**
* Solid understanding of branding principles — visual identity, typography, colour systems, and brand guidelines.
* **Experience in print and packaging design;**
  understanding of production requirements, print specifications, and material considerations.
* Proficiency conducting user research, usability testing, and synthesising qualitative and quantitative data.
* Solid understanding of design systems and design thinking, design processes, atomic design principles, and library based working.
* Knowledge of WCAG 2.1 accessibility standards and inclusive design practices.
* Excellent communication skills — able to present and defend design decisions clearly to both technical teams and non-technical client stakeholders. Work on editorial design and work seamlessly with content writers.
* Able to work with minimal supervision, take ownership of the design process end to end, and drive work forward independently. Eye for detail.
* Comfortable in a consulting/studio environment — multi-client, fast-context-switching, outcome-focused. Ability to take stretch goals.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing with AI
* Familiarity with Design Systems
* Exposure to field research methodologies.
* Experience in industrial or product design — physical objects designed with the same rigour as digital ones.
* Background in Agile or iterative delivery environments; comfortable with short cycles and visible progress.

Please share any dribble or behance references / portfolio website.

Location : Bangalore, No remote work.

If you are in South Bangalore, you have a locational advantage.

**Why This Role at Finiteloop**

We are seeking a hands-on Designer who shapes experiences. You will have scope to experiment with all aspects of design. From Research to seeing your design implemented in physical products. From communication design to see it work in a digital marketing driving sales.

We are also honest about what we value. Have a look at our culture code at finiteloop.ai/culturecode and evaluate your fitment in our environment.

title: EYP-CorpStrat-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Associate Director, Strategy & Execution, Consumer Products and Retail, EY-Parthenon GDS India**
At EY, we develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We empower you in a flexible environment and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
We work together across our full spectrum of services and skills, powered by technology and AI, so that business, people and the planet can thrive together.
  
  
We’re all in, are you?
  
  
Join EY and shape your future with confidence.
  
  
**The opportunity**
The Strategy & Execution team in EY-Parthenon recognizes that CEOs and business leaders are tasked with achieving maximum value for their organizations’ stakeholders in a transformative business environment. We challenge assumptions to design and deliver strategies that improve profitability, strengthen competitiveness and create long-term value.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced strategy consulting professional to join EY-Parthenon GDS India as an Associate Director within the Consumer Products and Retail sector.
  
  
You will be based in EY GDS India and work as an integrated member of the Singapore Strategy & Execution team, primarily supporting client engagements across Singapore and the wider ASEAN region.
  
  
This is a client-facing consulting and leadership role. You will work closely with EY-Parthenon teams and clients across ASEAN to develop and deliver strategic opportunities, drawing on market, competitor and customer insights and incorporating commercial, operational, financial and implementation perspectives.
  
  
The role provides the opportunity to work on complex, cross-border engagements, develop relationships with senior stakeholders and contribute to building EY-Parthenon’s Consumer Products and Retail capabilities across Singapore, ASEAN and GDS India.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Client engagement and delivery**

* Lead client engagements, major workstreams or independent modules across strategy, commercial transformation and operational transformation assignments.
* Structure complex business problems, develop hypotheses and define robust approaches to address clients’ strategic and operational priorities.
* Lead the collection and analysis of quantitative and qualitative information, translate findings into insights and formulate practical recommendations.
* Take ownership of the quality, timeliness and commercial relevance of project deliverables.
* Work directly with client stakeholders to understand their priorities, align on project objectives and communicate emerging findings and recommendations.
* Lead or contribute to client discussions, working sessions, presentations and senior stakeholder meetings.
* Develop clear, compelling and evidence-based presentations and reports for senior client audiences.
* Work effectively with geographically dispersed engagement teams, coordinating closely with colleagues in Singapore, GDS India and other ASEAN markets.

**Strategy and transformation**
You will work across a range of strategy and transformation engagements, which may include:
  
  

* Market entry and growth strategy
* Go-to-market strategy
* Revenue growth management
* Commercial transformation
* Digital and AI-led transformation
* Commercial due diligence
* Post-merger integration
* Divestment strategy and execution
* Cost and organization transformation
* Supply chain and procurement transformation
* Sales and operations planning
* Retail commercial and operational transformation
* Turnaround strategy and rapid value creation

**Team leadership and capability development**

* Lead, coach and develop teams working across GDS India, Singapore and the wider EY-Parthenon network.
* Provide clear direction, constructive feedback and day-to-day support to team members.
* Contribute to building a strong Consumer Products and Retail capability within EY-Parthenon GDS India.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, learning and broader capability-development initiatives.
* Help strengthen collaboration and knowledge sharing between the Singapore and GDS India teams.
* Promote an inclusive, high-performing team environment focused on development, quality and client impact.

**Business and practice development**

* Support the development of ASEAN-focused proposals, credentials and other business-development materials.
* Contribute sector insights and subject-matter expertise to pursuit teams and client discussions.
* Help identify opportunities to deepen existing client relationships and support the development of new relationships.
* Contribute to the continued growth of the Strategy & Execution practice and its Consumer Products and Retail portfolio across ASEAN.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
To succeed in this role, you should be able to:
  
  

* Lead complex strategy and transformation workstreams with limited supervision.
* Combine rigorous analysis with sound commercial judgment and practical recommendations.
* Communicate complex ideas clearly and confidently to senior internal and client stakeholders.
* Build trusted working relationships across different organizations, markets and cultures.
* Manage multiple priorities and maintain high standards in a fast-paced, project-based environment.
* Lead, motivate and develop diverse teams operating across locations.
* Collaborate effectively with Singapore-based and wider ASEAN engagement teams.
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of the strategic, commercial and operational issues affecting Consumer Products and Retail businesses.
* Adapt your working approach to different client, cultural and market contexts.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor’s degree from a recognized institution. A master’s degree or MBA is preferred.
* At least six years of relevant professional experience, including significant experience in a strategy consulting firm or a closely related consulting environment.
* Demonstrated experience in the Consumer Products and Retail sector.
* Experience leading substantial workstreams, project modules or client engagements.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical and financial analysis skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing and presenting materials for senior stakeholders.
* Experience managing and developing consulting teams.
* The ability to work effectively with colleagues and clients across locations, functions and cultures.
* A willingness and ability to travel internationally in line with client and engagement requirements.

**Relevant Consumer Products And Retail Experience**
Relevant experience should include one or more of the following areas:
  
  

* Corporate, portfolio, market entry or growth strategy
* Go-to-market strategy and commercial transformation
* Revenue growth management
* Digital and AI-led business transformation
* Cost reduction and operating-model transformation
* Supply chain and procurement transformation
* Sales and operations planning
* Retail commercial or operational transformation
* Commercial due diligence, post-merger integration or value creation

**Ideally, you will also have**

* Previous experience working with clients or consulting teams in Singapore, ASEAN or other international markets.
* Experience operating as part of a cross-border or globally integrated consulting team.
* Familiarity with the business environment, consumer trends and market dynamics of Singapore and the wider ASEAN region.
* Experience supporting consulting proposals, business development and client pursuits.
* Experience building sector capabilities, coaching teams or contributing to recruitment and learning initiatives.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to establish credibility with senior client stakeholders.

**Regional exposure and ways of working**

* The role requires close collaboration with colleagues and clients across ASEAN, with reasonable flexibility to accommodate regional engagement requirements.
* Periodic travel to Singapore and other ASEAN markets will be required, depending on client and engagement needs. This may include short-duration on-site assignments at different stages of an engagement.
* The successful candidate should be comfortable working in an integrated regional team, building relationships remotely and in person, and adapting to the requirements of cross-border client engagements.
* Strong performers may be considered for future international mobility opportunities, subject to business requirements, performance, immigration requirements and applicable firm policies.

**What We Offer You**
We will fuel your ambition and potential with future-focused skills development that equips you with state-of-the-art methodologies and technology-enabled solutions. With more than 25,000 people in 150 countries, you will join an inclusive and empowering culture that values your uniqueness, prioritizes your wellbeing, and immerses you in the diverse thinking and cross-cultural experiences necessary to help deliver impact to clients across the globe and help build a better working world.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Flow Technologies:**
A global leader in, providing a broad portfolio of pumps, valves, mixing and agitation equipment, heat transfer, homogenizers, separation, water and wastewater treatment, and engineered process solutions.Our leading brands include the iconic
**Goulds Pumps**
(with more than 175 years of history),
**Anhydro, APV, Bornemann, Bran+Luebbe, C’treat, Engineered Valves, Gerstenberg Schröder, Habonim, Johnson Pump, Lightnin, Philadelphia, Plenty, PRO Cast, Rheinhütte, Seital Separation, Stelzer, Svanehøj, Tigerholm, Uutechnic, VIDAR, Waukesha Cherry-Burrell.**
**Motion Technologies:**

**Friction Technologies, KONI**
and
**Axtone.**
**Connect and Control Technologies:**
A leader in critical applications for the aerospace, defense and industrial markets, including harsh environment connectors and control components. Our leading brands include
**ITT Cannon, Enidine, Aerospace Controls**
and
**kSARIA.**
**Position Summary**
The Talent Insights & Analytics Analyst is a data-driven role responsible for consolidating, analyzing, and translating talent data into actionable insights that drive enterprise-wide decision making. This role partners closely with the Director, Enterprise Talent & Learning Strategy, HR Business Partners (HRBPs), Talent Leads, and business leaders to create a unified view of talent across the organization. The Analyst will aggregate and interpret data from multiple sources—including learning management systems (LMS), talent reviews, succession planning tools, and critical role frameworks—to provide meaningful insights on workforce capability, top talent, leadership pipelines, and development effectiveness. This role also serves as a key enabler of data visualization and digital talent analytics, leveraging tools such as Power BI to build custom dashboards, deliver proactive insights, and support the evolution of enterprise talent analytics capabilities. Success in this role requires strong analytical capability, technical fluency in reporting tools, and the ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling insights that inform talent, HR, and business strategies.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**

* Talent Data Integration & Reporting (Primary Focus)
* Compile and integrate talent data across multiple platforms and sources (e.g., LMS, talent review systems, succession planning tools, HRIS).
* Build and maintain consolidated talent dashboards and reports that provide a holistic view of workforce insights (e.g., talent segmentation, performance/potential, succession readiness).
* Leverage Power BI and other visualization tools to design dynamic, user-friendly dashboards tailored for HR and business stakeholders.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reporting outputs; proactively identify and resolve discrepancies.
* Automate and scale reporting processes to improve efficiency, accessibility, and self-service analytics capabilities.
* Talent Insights & Strategic Analysis
* Analyze talent data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities related to top talent, leadership pipelines, and workforce readiness.
* Provide proactive insights to Talent Leads, HRBPs, and business leaders to inform talent strategy decisions.
* Deliver insights on key talent topics, including:

+ Identification and tracking of high-potential and top talent populations
+ Succession plan readiness and coverage for critical roles
+ Bench strength, internal mobility, and retention trends

* Translate data into actionable recommendations that influence enterprise talent and workforce planning strategies.
* Learning & Development Analytics
* Analyze learning data from the LMS and digital learning platforms to assess engagement, completion, and program effectiveness.
* Partner with Talent & Learning stakeholders to measure the impact of enterprise learning initiatives (e.g., leadership development, early career programs, critical role development).
* Connect learning data with talent outcomes (e.g., promotion, progression, readiness) to assess effectiveness and ROI.
* Develop dashboards that provide visibility into learning journeys, utilization, and skill development trends.
* Talent Review & Succession Insights
* Support aggregation and analysis of enterprise talent review data, including performance, potential, and succession planning inputs.
* Track development plans for key talent and succession candidates, providing visibility into readiness progression.
* Enable insights into succession health, including gaps, risks, and pipeline strength for critical roles.
* Support efforts to capture and structure institutional knowledge related to critical roles, including knowledge transfer needs and continuity planning.
* Digital Analytics & Project Enablement
* Support and manage digital talent analytics initiatives, including dashboard development, reporting enhancements, and data transformation efforts.
* Partner with HRIS, IT, and data teams to improve data integration and reporting infrastructure.
* Lead or support continuous improvement projects to enhance the effectiveness and scalability of talent analytics tools and processes.
* Stay current on emerging trends in people analytics, data visualization, and HR technology to recommend forward-looking improvements.
* Support Talent Management initiatives and projects involving HRIS enhancements, system optimization, process improvements, and talent technology solutions.
* Partner with HRIS, HR Operations, IT, and business stakeholders to support talent-related systems, including performance management, succession planning, leadership development, and employee engagement processes.
* Assist with system upgrades, testing, troubleshooting, reporting, and user support to help ensure effective functionality and data integrity across Talent Management platforms.
* Coordinate project activities, maintain process documentation, and support implementation efforts for Talent Management programs and HR technology enhancements.
* Analyze talent-related data and metrics, identify process improvement opportunities, and support change management and user adoption activities related to Talent Management systems and processes.
* Stakeholder Partnership & Reporting Delivery
* Partner with HRBPs, Talent Leads, COEs, and business leaders to understand data needs and deliver tailored insights.
* Prepare executive-ready materials (dashboards, presentations, briefing packs) that clearly communicate talent insights, trends, and implications.
* Support key talent operating rhythms (e.g., talent reviews, succession discussions, quarterly business reviews) with timely, accurate data and analysis.

**Position Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Data Analytics, Business, Organizational Psychology, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3–5+ years of experience in HR analytics, people analytics, talent management, or a related data-focused role.
* Strong proficiency in Power BI (or similar tools such as Tableau) with demonstrated experience building custom dashboards and visualizations.
* Advanced Excel/Sheets skills, including data manipulation and reporting.
* Experience working with HR systems and data sources (e.g., Workday, LMS, HRIS, talent/succession platforms).
* Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and compelling visual narratives.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and integrity.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, particularly with senior HR and business leaders.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Leads a team of 7–8: 2–3 in talent acquisition, 3 in business partnering, and 1 in people processes.

title: Manager – B2B Sales & Strategic Partnerships
description:
**Company:** Loan2grow Fincap Pvt. Ltd.  
**Function:** Business Development, Sales & Partnerships  
**Location:** Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, Chennai, Mumbai or Hyderabad  
**Experience:** 5–10 years  
**Role type:** Full-time | Target-driven

About Loan2grow

Loan2grow is an NBFC fintech focused on expanding access to responsible financing and financial services for underserved and working populations. Through products such as Earnplus, we aim to make financing and financial well-being solutions more accessible to gig workers, salaried employees, contractual workers and other underserved segments.

We are expanding our B2B distribution and institutional financing business by partnering with platforms, staffing companies, MSMEs and corporates.

Role purpose

We are looking for a commercially driven professional to build and grow Loan2grow’s B2B business across two channels:

* **Platform and employer partnerships:** Enable platforms, MSMEs and corporates to provide suitable financing and financial products to their workers and employees.
* **Direct institutional financing:** Develop financing opportunities with eligible MSMEs and corporates seeking funding for their businesses.

The person will own the business development cycle end-to-end, from prospect identification and relationship building to commercial negotiations, agreement closure, onboarding and portfolio activation.

This is a hands-on, revenue-oriented role for someone who can open doors, build a strong pipeline, close partnerships and translate signed agreements into actual business.

Key responsibilities1. B2B sales and partnership development

* Identify and acquire platform, staffing, MSME and corporate partners across priority sectors.
* Build relationships with founders, promoters, business heads, CHROs, HR leaders, CFOs, finance heads and other decision-makers.
* Develop and execute a structured sales pipeline, including prospecting, lead qualification, meetings, proposals, negotiations and closures.
* Position Loan2grow’s financing and financial services in terms of business value, workforce needs and partner economics.
* Develop partnerships with organisations employing or engaging large numbers of gig, blue-collar, contractual and salaried workers.

2. Employee and workforce financing partnerships

* Identify employers and platforms where employees or workers could benefit from appropriate financing and financial products.
* Work with partner HR, payroll and operations teams to design practical onboarding and employee communication processes.
* Coordinate with internal teams to assess payroll-linked repayment, authorised deduction mechanisms and other permitted repayment arrangements.
* Drive employee awareness, eligible-user onboarding, activation, repeat usage and partner engagement.
* Monitor partner performance and develop plans to improve adoption and portfolio quality.

3. Direct institutional financing

* Identify eligible MSMEs and corporates with potential financing requirements.
* Build relationships with business owners, promoters, CFOs and finance teams.
* Understand the institution’s business model, financing purpose, cash flows, repayment capacity and funding requirements.
* Coordinate collection of business, financial, banking, ownership and other documents required for credit assessment.
* Work closely with Loan2grow’s credit, risk, compliance and operations teams to progress proposals through the assessment and sanction process.
* Manage borrower communication, commercial discussions and post-disbursement relationship development.

*Credit approvals and sanctions will remain subject to Loan2grow’s authorised credit and risk processes.*

4. Commercial negotiations and execution

* Prepare partnership proposals, business cases and commercial models.
* Negotiate pricing, revenue-sharing arrangements, service expectations and operating workflows within approved company policies.
* Coordinate agreements, implementation plans, integrations and partner onboarding.
* Ensure that signed agreements translate into operational partnerships and measurable business outcomes.

5. Pipeline management and reporting

* Maintain an accurate CRM or sales tracker covering prospects, opportunity value, stage, next action and expected closure.
* Develop monthly and quarterly business plans and sales forecasts.
* Track conversions from leads to meetings, proposals, signed agreements, activated partners and financing disbursements.
* Report pipeline risks, market feedback, competitor activity and product or process improvements to senior management.

Key performance indicators

Performance will be evaluated on business outcomes, not merely meetings or signed MoUs.

* Qualified B2B pipeline generated and maintained.
* New partnerships and institutional financing relationships acquired.
* Conversion rate from qualified leads to signed agreements and funded accounts.
* Value and volume of financing originated and disbursed, measured separately for employee financing and institutional financing.
* Number of partners activated and eligible users onboarded.
* Utilisation and transaction activity across activated partnerships.
* Portfolio quality and repayment performance of originated business, in coordination with the credit and risk teams.
* Partner retention, repeat business and revenue contribution.
* Accuracy of pipeline reporting and timely execution of agreed milestones.

Specific targets will be established with management based on the approved business plan, product economics and the initial market-development period.

Desired candidate profile

* 3–4 years of experience in B2B sales, enterprise partnerships, fintech, lending, financial services, HR-tech, workforce solutions or MSME banking.
* Demonstrated experience in acquiring clients, negotiating commercial agreements and closing revenue-generating business.
* Existing relationships with platforms, staffing firms, MSMEs, corporates or employer networks will be an advantage.
* Understanding of lending, employee financial services, payroll processes or business financing is desirable.
* Ability to understand business models, assess commercial opportunities and coordinate with credit and risk teams.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-management skills.
* Comfort with sales targets, pipeline reporting, field meetings and regular follow-ups.
* High ownership, accountability, execution discipline and willingness to build a business from the ground up.

What success looks like

Within the first 90 days, the person should have developed a prioritised target-account list, established a qualified pipeline, initiated substantive discussions with potential partners and borrowers, and progressed suitable opportunities towards closure.

Over time, success will mean building a repeatable B2B acquisition engine that generates active partnerships, sustainable financing volumes and good-quality business.

Why join Loan2grow?

* Build a growing B2B financing and financial-services business.
* Work directly with senior management on business development and market expansion.
* Develop partnerships across platforms, employers and the MSME ecosystem.
* Take end-to-end ownership of commercial outcomes and contribute directly to business growth.

How to apply

Interested candidates should share their CV along with a brief note on their B2B sales experience, the sectors and clients they have worked with, and examples of partnerships or financing business they have successfully originated and closed.

Application Question(s):

* 1. Relevant B2B sales experience

title: Branch Manager
company: Renew Plus hair and Skin Clinic
description:
1. Job Summary

The Branch Manager is responsible for managing the day-to-day operations of the hair and skin care clinic, achieving branch targets, improving patient satisfaction, coordinating staff activities, and ensuring smooth clinic operations. The role involves managing appointments, monitoring revenue and performance, improving patient footfall, and implementing strategies to increase business growth.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Branch Operations Management

* Manage the daily operations of the clinic and ensure smooth functioning.
* Ensure the clinic maintains proper cleanliness, hygiene, and professional standards.
* Monitor staff attendance, punctuality, discipline, and productivity.
* Ensure treatment rooms, equipment, and supplies are ready for daily operations.
* Coordinate with doctors, nurses, telecallers, receptionists, and other staff members.

B. Business Development and Revenue Growth

* Achieve monthly branch revenue and business targets.
* Develop strategies to increase patient footfall, consultations, and treatment conversions.
* Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve clinic visibility and local marketing.
* Focus on generating leads through local promotions, social media, referrals, posters, and banners.
* Build relationships with existing and potential patients to encourage repeat visits.

C. Lead and Appointment Management

* Monitor incoming leads and ensure timely follow-up by telecallers.
* Track appointment bookings, confirmations, walk-ins, cancellations, and no-shows.
* Ensure proper follow-up with patients who have enquired about hair and skin treatments.
* Coordinate doctor availability with appointment schedules.
* Review lead conversion rates and take corrective action when targets are not achieved.

D. Staff Management

* Assign responsibilities and monitor individual staff performance.
* Conduct regular team meetings to review targets and operational issues.
* Train and motivate staff to improve productivity and patient service.
* Identify performance gaps and implement improvement plans.
* Escalate staffing requirements and operational concerns to management.

E. Patient Experience and Service Quality

* Ensure patients receive professional, courteous, and timely service.
* Handle patient complaints and resolve concerns promptly.
* Monitor patient feedback, online reviews, and satisfaction levels.
* Ensure clear communication regarding appointments, consultations, treatments, and follow-ups.
* Maintain patient confidentiality and professional standards.

F. Marketing and Online Reputation

* Coordinate local marketing activities to increase branch visibility.
* Monitor the branch's social media presence and online reviews.
* Encourage genuine patient feedback in accordance with clinic policies.
* Work with the marketing team to improve lead quality and campaign performance.
* Track the effectiveness of promotional activities and report results.

G. Reporting and Documentation

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly branch performance reports.
* Track revenue, expenses, lead generation, appointments, walk-ins, and conversions.
* Maintain accurate operational and administrative records.
* Monitor inventory and coordinate timely replenishment of clinical supplies.
* Submit regular updates and performance reports to management.

H. Compliance and Safety

* Ensure compliance with applicable healthcare regulations and clinic policies.
* Maintain appropriate hygiene, infection control, and biomedical waste management practices.
* Ensure clinical services are delivered by qualified and authorized professionals.
* Protect patient information and maintain confidentiality.

3. Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Management, or a related field preferred.
* Previous experience in clinic management, healthcare operations, sales, or customer service.
* Experience in a dermatology, cosmetology, hair transplant, or hair and skin care clinic is an advantage.
* Strong leadership, communication, and team management skills.
* Knowledge of sales targets, lead management, and business development.
* Basic computer skills and proficiency in Excel and reporting tools.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Monthly revenue and target achievement.
* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Appointment booking and confirmation rates.
* Patient walk-in and consultation numbers.
* Lead-to-consultation and consultation-to-treatment conversion rates.
* Patient satisfaction and feedback.
* Online review management and branch reputation.
* Staff productivity and attendance.
* Operational efficiency and inventory management.

5. Required Skills and Qualities

* Leadership and decision-making.
* Business development and target orientation.
* Problem-solving and conflict resolution.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Planning, organization, and time management.
* Customer relationship management.
* Ability to motivate staff and improve branch performance.

In our water business, that means delivering efficient, resilient, and future-ready water supply and wastewater conveyance systems that support urban growth and environmental sustainability.
  
  
As a Principal Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering large-scale water and wastewater network solutions, driving technical excellence and innovation across projects.
  
  
As a Principal Engineer – Conveyance, you will act as a subject matter expert and technical lead for the planning, modelling, and design of water distribution and wastewater collection systems. You will guide teams on complex assignments while remaining actively involved in critical technical deliverables. You will collaborate within a multicultural, high‑performing engineering environment and contribute to achieving project targets related to quality, schedules, technical rigor, and client satisfaction.
  
  
Key duties include
  
  

* Provide technical leadership in the design and planning of water supply and wastewater conveyance networks.
* Lead and review development of hydraulic models (steady state and extended period simulations) for large-scale systems.
* Oversee master planning studies, including

+ Demand forecasting and load assessment
+ Land-use analysis
+ System capacity assessment and gap analysis

* Drive network optioneering and optimisation, ensuring cost-effective and sustainable solutions.
* Lead preparation and review of

+ Capital investment plans and phasing strategies
+ Implementation roadmaps for network expansion/upgrades

* Review and guide engineering design deliverables, including

+ Pipeline sizing and network layouts
+ Hydraulic calculations and system controls
+ Pumping systems and rising mains

* Provide expertise in pumping systems, including system curves, pump selection, operational strategies, and integration with networks.
* Ensure effective integration with treatment plants, reservoirs, and pump stations.
* Perform and lead technical QA/QC reviews of models, calculations, reports, and drawings.
* Support Design for Design‑Build (D for DB) and EPC projects, including constructability inputs and contractor coordination.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (process, mechanical, civil, electrical, BIM) to ensure aligned delivery.
* Prepare and review technical reports, design basis documents, and client presentations.
* Act as a key technical interface with clients and stakeholders, supporting reviews, approvals, and technical discussions.
* Support bid/proposal development, including methodology, technical inputs, and effort estimation.
* Identify and manage technical risks, providing mitigation strategies.
* Mentor engineers and support development of technical capability within the team.
* Promote adoption of digital tools, modelling best practices, and data-driven workflows.

* Design & Coordination Civil 3D, Navisworks
* Coordination/ Clash Detection Navisworks, Revizto

**Key Behaviours**

* Strong technical authority with ability to influence engineering decisions.
* Analytical thinker with strong problem-solving capability.
* Confident communicator with effective client engagement skills.
* Collaborative and proactive in multidisciplinary environments.
* High attention to quality, accuracy, and technical integrity.
* Mentorship-oriented, with focus on developing team capability.
* Committed to continuous improvement and innovation.

**Work Experience**

* Strong expertise in hydraulic modelling, master planning, and detailed design of water distribution and sewer networks.
* Proven ability to lead complex modelling studies and infrastructure planning projects.
* Hands-on experience with

+ Water distribution networks

We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Job Summary
  
  
This role is for an "Outcome Architect" rather than a traditional coder. This role sits at the intersection of robust Software Architecture and high-velocity, AI-augmented development ("Vibe Coding"). Instead of writing manual line-by-line code, you will leverage LLMs and AI tools (like Cursor and Copilot) to rapidly architect, prototype, and deploy the internal tools, automated labs, and environments used by our Global Sales Engineering (SE) teams to demonstrate the CyberArk Identity Security platform.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Outcome-Driven Architecture: Design structurally sound, modular, and scalable internal products, POC toolkits, and field utilities.
* Rapid AI Delivery: Use AI agents and LLMs to move from concept to field-ready tools at record speed, focusing heavily on logic, security, and system flow.
* Full-Stack Ownership: Build and maintain global field operations tools, APIs, and interfaces using whichever language or technical approach best fits the problem.
* Cloud & Identity Automation: Architect automated, friction-free "lab-on-demand" solutions allowing SEs to deploy complex Identity Security scenarios (PAM, Secrets Management).
* Technical Bridge: Act as the technical expert for the Sales Engineering team, translating vague field requirements into functional technical assets.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* Strong foundation in software engineering with 5+ years of experience , system design, data flow, and building resilient, secure systems.
* Expert at utilizing AI interfaces (Cursor, Copilot, LLMs) as a primary development environment to write, debug, and refactor.
* Problem solver who can easily pick up or generate the required code (Python, JS, C#, etc.) to hit the architectural goal.
* Hands-on experience designing and deploying within AWS or Azure ecosystems.
* Skilled at automating infrastructure and workflows to create seamless internal experiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Sales Engineering, DevSecOps, or Infrastructure/Tools roles.
* Deep understanding of Identity Security, Zero Trust, or Secrets Management.
* A strong curiosity about the future of autonomous AI development agents.

**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Artist & Content Creator
description:
Fellow Yellow Design Studio | Hyderabad | Full-time, in-studio

Fellow Yellow is an architecture and interior design studio in Hyderabad. We build culturally rooted storytelling spaces: restaurants, bars, cafés, showrooms, homes and public places that carry something of where they are and who they’re for. Grounded Imagination is how we describe it. Ideas that come from somewhere real, built with care.

This year the work has travelled a little further than the sites it sits on. We were part of TAD 50 and selected for GoodHomes Design Discoveries 2026. We’re now looking for someone to help us tell these stories properly, from the first sketch to the last photograph.

**The role**

We’re looking for an artist first. Someone who draws, composes, sees. Then a content creator who can take that eye onto site and into a reel. Then a brand designer who keeps everything we put out looking like us.

You’d live inside the projects and bring the story out. Not a marketing seat at the far end of the office, but part of the project room, working alongside the founders and the architects as spaces take shape.

**What you’d be doing**

* Joining site visits and capturing the process as it unfolds: materials arriving, craftspeople at work, the quiet moments between drawings and reality
* Planning final shoots with photographers and vendors, and shaping how each project is presented to the world
* Creating reels, photo sets, illustrations and posts, and looking after our Instagram and LinkedIn from planning through to publishing and conversation
* Designing the decks, case studies and presentation boards we share with clients
* Keeping the brand system consistent and improving our templates as we grow

**Who we hope you are**

* An artist at heart. You sketch, illustrate, photograph or make things, and it shows in how you compose a frame or lay out a page
* Fluent in social media. You know what works on Instagram right now, what a good reel looks like, and why some accounts grow and others don’t
* An eye for detail. Alignment, spacing, colour, a caption with one word too many. You notice, and you fix it
* Quick. Site content needs to go out while it’s fresh, and client decks don’t wait
* Fresher or a few years in, it doesn’t matter much. What you can make matters more than how long you’ve been making it
* At home in Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign and Canva, with Premiere or CapCut for reels
* Drawn to architecture, interiors and craft. You notice how a space feels, not just how it looks
* Easy to work with. You’ll be coordinating with architects, site teams, vendors and photographers, sometimes all in a day
* A writer with a voice of your own, warm and unhurried

**Nice to have**

* Your own photography or video skills
* Some motion graphics
* An architecture, fine arts, design or visual communication background

**Life at the studio**

* You’re in the room where the projects happen, from concept to handover
* The founders are directly reachable. We’re a small team and we like it that way
* Every post you make is a real place you watched come to life

**Hiring process**

1. Portfolio review
2. A short phone interview
3. A one-hour online test
4. Offer

**How to apply**

Apply here on LinkedIn with your portfolio link and any page you’ve run. Portfolio first, CV second. Sketchbooks, personal work and student projects all count. No cover letter needed. We’ll reply to everyone we shortlist.

title: Robotics Educator
description:
**Who We Are:**

An Ed-Tech startup based in Hyderabad and operational in multiple states providing learning outcomes focused curriculum and software solutions to private schools.

At EkaLavya, we believe Robotics is not about assembling kits. It is about nurturing problem-solvers, creators, innovators, and future entrepreneurs. As we expand across 30–40 partner schools this academic year, we are looking for passionate educators who can inspire students from Grade I to Grade IX through Robotics, Coding, and hands-on project-based learning.

**POSITION: ROBOTICS EDUCATOR / STEM INNOVATION MENTOR**

**Location:**
Multiple schools across assigned regions in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Compensation:**
Mentioned at the end of the Job description

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**
You will not be a traditional teacher. You will act as a mentor who helps students:

1. Build and program robots

2. Solve real-world problems through projects

3. Think like engineers and innovators

4. Develop creativity, teamwork, and presentation skills

5. Participate in inter-school Robotics Innovation Challenges

You will be responsible for delivering Robotics curriculum, conducting lab sessions, mentoring projects, assessing learning outcomes, and continuously improving the program through school-level feedback to leadership and content team

**SELECTION AND CERTIFICATION JOURNEY**

At EkaLavya, student learning outcomes are our highest priority. Since Robotics education requires a combination of technical understanding, classroom delivery skills, activity management, and student engagement, we follow a structured selection process.

The selection journey includes:

**1. Interview and Practical Assessment**

Candidates who successfully clear the interview and practical teaching assessment will receive a
**conditional offer for the Robotics Educator role.**

**2. Robotics Faculty Induction and Certification**

Before independent classroom deployment, selected candidates must successfully complete a
**structured induction and certification program**
(typically 3-7 days in hybrid mode).

The
**certification process**
will include:

* EkaLavya teaching philosophy and pedagogy
* Robotics curriculum orientation
* Grade-wise learning journey
* Robotics kit handling
* Project execution
* Lab activities
* Classroom management
* Student engagement techniques
* Practice teaching sessions

**3. Classroom Readiness and Final Appointment**

After successful completion of training and certification, appointment confirmation will be made based on:

* Technical capability
* Teaching demonstration
* Student-centric classroom approach
* Feedback from internal mentors
* Feedback from school stakeholders
* Performance during live classroom sessions

As Robotics is not a regular school subject and requires a different learning curve, we do not permanently deploy faculty members without observing their classroom readiness.

Every educator will receive continuous support, mentoring, and need-based training interventions.

**Performance will be reviewed**
during the
**initial 1-6 month period**
through multiple feedback loops to ensure success for both the educator and students

**DESIRED CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* **Preferred**
  - Diploma in Robotics, Electronics, Computer Science, AI, IoT, Automation or related fields
* Fresh graduates
  **passionate about STEM education**
  and willing to undergo intensive training
* Experienced Robotics Trainers, STEM Educators, Makerspace Facilitators
* **FRESHERS ARE WELCOME**
  - We strongly encourage applications from: Final-year students, Recent graduates, Robotics enthusiasts, Makers, Tinkerers, DIY innovators. If you are willing to learn, build, experiment, and inspire young minds, we will help you grow into an exceptional STEM educator.
* Professionals exploring a
  **career transition**
  into education
* Individuals looking to
  **restart their professional journey**
  after a career break
* Experienced professionals who have a passion for mentoring and shaping young minds

At EkaLavya, we believe great educators are created through a combination of knowledge, curiosity, patience, empathy, and the willingness to learn continuously. You do not need to come with a traditional teaching background. If you are passionate about learning, building, experimenting, and inspiring young minds, we will support your journey to become an exceptional STEM educator.

We especially value professionals who bring maturity, life experience, and the ability to create a positive classroom culture while helping students develop technical skills, confidence, creativity, and a problem-solving mindset.

Whether you are beginning your career, restarting after a gap, or bringing decades of experience if you have the passion to contribute to education and the curiosity to learn Robotics and new-age technologies, we welcome you to apply.

**GROWTH AND CROSS-FUNCTIONAL OPPORTUNITIES**

At EkaLavya, we believe professionals grow by continuously learning and contributing. Based on business requirements, individual aspirations, and skill development opportunities, team members may receive exposure beyond their core role.

Faculty members may also contribute to
**cross-functional initiatives**
based on their inclination, such as:

* Sales support
* Social media
* Content/design support
* Operations
* Marketing initiatives
* Other strategic projects

This enables team members to build broader skills while contributing to organizational growth.

**COMPENSATION AND APPOINTMENT APPROACH**

At EkaLavya, we believe that a Robotics Educator requires more than technical knowledge. The ability to engage students, create a positive classroom culture, deliver experiential learning, manage projects, and inspire young minds are equally important.

Therefore, the journey is designed in two stages:

**Stage 1: Learning, Certification and Classroom Readiness Phase**

After successfully clearing the interview and practical assessment, selected candidates will receive a conditional offer to undergo:

Robotics faculty induction

Pedagogy and classroom training

Curriculum orientation

Practical project training

Certification process

Supported live classroom exposure

During this phase, compensation will include:

**₹1.8 lakh fixed annual component and Performance-linked incentive of ₹2,000-₹5,000 every month**
(subject to defined performance parameters and feedback)

**Accomodation will be taken care of**

**A daily allowance of Rs.300 per day on all teaching days**

**Stage 2: Appointment as Independent Robotics Educator**

After successful completion of certification and demonstration of readiness through live classroom sessions, candidates will receive an official appointment letter who demonstrate:

* Technical competency
* Student-centric teaching approach
* Classroom management ability
* Alignment with EkaLavya values and culture
* Positive feedback from internal mentors and school stakeholders

The
**revised CTC at the appointment stage will be in the range of ₹3-4 lakh per annum**
, depending on experience, performance during training and classroom sessions, demonstrated capability and stakeholder feedback. This structured approach ensures that educators receive the right support to succeed while ensuring students receive the quality of learning experience they deserve.

**Apply Now**

If you believe education should move beyond textbooks and students learn best by building, creating, experimenting, and solving real-world problems, we'd love to hear from you. Please send your profiles with a note to
**ekalavya.app@gmail.com**
or
**narasimha@ekalavya.io**
