title: State Business Head
description:
**Job Description: State Business Head**

* **Location:**
  Hyderabad
* **Markets:**
  Kerala, Gujarat, Odisha (3 positions available)
* **Experience:**
  7–12 years
* **Compensation:**
  35–40 Lakhs per annum
* **Reporting To:**
  Founder's Office

**About the Role**

This role is for entrepreneurial
**State Business Heads**
who will build the business in their respective states almost like a
**Mini CEO**
. This is not a traditional marketing, operations, or business-development role. You will own the entire state business end-to-end: understanding the customer, identifying the right offerings, building partner networks, creating the occasion calendar, launching campaigns, acquiring customers, delivering the service successfully, and bringing customers back again.

The ideal candidate possesses strong commercial thinking, cultural understanding, marketing instinct, and exceptional execution capabilities.

**What You Will Own**

1. **State Business & Revenue**

* Own the growth of the business in the assigned state.
* Build annual and quarterly business plans covering: Revenue, Transactions, New customers, Repeat customers, Average Order Value (AOV), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), Retention, Product portfolio, and Partner network.
* Treat the state as your own business and continuously identify new opportunities for growth.

1. **Understand the State's Consumer Ecosystem**

* Develop a deep understanding of the state's key markets, regional traditions, festivals, seasonal and occasion-led demand, local customs, consumer preferences, life-event needs, influential local voices, and customer behaviour.
* Translate this understanding into products and campaigns relevant to customers in that state.

1. **Build Partner Network**

* Identify and develop relationships with high-potential partners and institutions.
* Responsibilities include: Partner discovery, meeting partner management and key stakeholders, partnership negotiation, offering selection, commercial arrangements, operational readiness, content collection, quality standards, and long-term relationship management.
* Build a strong pipeline of partners rather than depending on only a few.

1. **Build the State Occasion Calendar**

* Create a 365-day calendar for the state identifying opportunities around major festivals, monthly occasions, seasonal peaks, and other high-demand days.
* For every major occasion, decide the offering, partner, pricing, target customers, and marketing timelines.

1. **Product Creation**

* Work with partners, product, content, and operations teams to create compelling offerings.
* Own the product proposition, partner selection, packages, pricing, add-ons, fulfilment, personalisation options, customer communication, photos/videos, storytelling, and landing-page proposition. Convert regional occasions into compelling and authentic consumer propositions.

1. **Campaign Planning & Growth**

* Own the commercial success of every major campaign spanning Meta Ads, Google Ads, performance marketing, CAC, ROAS, CTR, conversion, creative testing, audience segmentation, landing-page conversion, remarketing, and WhatsApp marketing.
* Analyse campaign metrics to optimize propositions, partners, pricing, and creatives.

1. **Influencer & Creator Partnerships**

* Build a state-level network of regional influencers, YouTubers, Instagram creators, regional celebrities, niche content creators, and community voices.
* Develop performance-linked partnerships that drive transactions rather than mere brand awareness.

1. **End-to-End Service Execution**

* Oversee the complete customer journey from booking, order detail collection, partner coordination, and service execution, to proof/video delivery, fulfilment, customer communication, and feedback.

1. **Retention & Repeat Business**

* Build repeat behaviour by working with CRM and retention teams across WhatsApp, push notifications, email, personalization, festival reminders, past-purchase recommendations, partner recommendations, cross-sells, family occasions, birthdays, anniversaries, and recurring purchases.

1. **Consumer Insights**

* Constantly analyse customer feedback, search behaviour, customer support conversations, campaign comments, social media, competitor actions, and market trends to launch new products and improve existing offerings.

**Candidate Profile**

This role calls for builders rather than administrators. The ideal candidate:

* Has
  **7-12 years**
  of experience.
* Has built or scaled a consumer business, category, city, region, or marketplace.
* Understands digital consumer acquisition and Meta/Google performance marketing.
* Has strong commercial, analytical ability, and experience working with vendors, partners, or distributed supply.
* Can manage complex operations, understand retention/repeat purchase behaviour, and work with ambiguity to build things from zero.
* Possesses very high ownership and operates without waiting for instructions.
* Is comfortable traveling across the assigned state.
* *Preferred Background:*
  Experience in D2C, e-commerce, marketplaces, food delivery, travel, matrimony, consumer internet, regional content, or other high-frequency consumer businesses.

**Cultural Requirement**

Deep cultural understanding of the respective state is mandatory. The candidate must:

* Speak the state's language fluently and read it comfortably.
* Understand regional traditions, festivals, consumer behaviour, and cultural nuances across different districts/regions within the state.

Note: All positions will be based in Hyderabad.

title: Onboarding Systems & Operations Specialist
description:

We’re looking for a detail-oriented, analytical, and customer-focused Onboarding Systems & Operations Specialist to design and optimize digital onboarding experiences that help customers realize value faster and drive long-term product adoption. In this role, you’ll combine systems expertise, operational excellence, and data-driven decision-making to create scalable onboarding journeys that empower customers through self-service and personalized engagement. Sky tech, Financial District, Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Work Schedule**

* This role supports customers and stakeholders primarily during U.S. business hours.
* Expected working hours are 1 PM to 10:00 PM IST, with occasional flexibility required to support collaboration with U.S.-based teams and business needs.

Leverage AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality and actively experiment with emerging capabilities as they evolve.
  
  
**What You'll Bring**

* 3-5 years of experience in a Software as a Service (SaaS) environment supporting Customer Success, Onboarding, Digital Engagement, Systems Administration, or Operations functions.
* Knowledge of digital onboarding strategies, customer lifecycle management, and customer adoption programs, coupled with experience supporting customer-facing operational processes.
* Understanding of workflow automation, customer engagement practices, usage analytics, and data-driven decision-making to improve customer outcomes.
* Experience working with customer success and engagement platforms such as Gainsight, EverAfter, Salesforce, Marketo, Goldcast, or similar technologies.

title: Principal Architect - Data & AI
description:
**Overview**
Microsoft Industry Solutions – Global Center Innovation and Delivery Center (GCID) delivers end-to-end solutions by enabling accelerated adoption and productive use of Microsoft technologies. An organization of well over 1000+ exceptional people, GCID presents a significant opportunity for highly experienced services professionals to shape enterprise transformation at scale.
  
  
The Principal Architect is a senior executive level technical leader accountable for enterprise-wide architecture strategy, AI first delivery execution, and business outcomes across complex, multiyear customer engagements. This role serves as a trusted advisor to CEO, CIO, CTO, CDO, and executive leadership teams of customers, influencing digital, data, and AI transformation agendas.
  
  
In an AI first GCID organization, Principal Architects are expected to shape vision, define guardrails, and lead execution of intelligent, scalable, and secure solutions that directly drive business value, resilience, and innovation. The ideal candidate demonstrates exceptional technical breadth, strategic depth, executive presence, and the ability to operate confidently in ambiguous, high impact environments.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
AI First Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Define and drive enterprise scale AI first delivery strategies, aligned to customer business vision and executive priorities.
* Lead end-to-end technical accountability for mission critical, multiprogram engagements, ensuring strategic alignment, architectural integrity, and measurable business outcomes.
* Establish delivery models that scale intelligent automation, autonomous systems, and AI native execution across programs and portfolios.
* Act as the executive technical authority during escalations, guiding recovery, transformation, or exit strategies for high-risk or underperforming engagements.
* Partner with CIO/CTO/CDO leadership to balance innovation, governance, cost, security, and speed at enterprise scale.

Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Set enterprise architecture standards and technical guardrails across data, AI, platform, and engineering disciplines.
* Ensure production grade quality through architecture reviews, performance benchmarks, security controls, observability, and operational readiness.
* Champion modern engineering practices including DevSecOps, platform engineering, CI/CD, SRE, and AI assisted development.
* Foster a culture of technical rigor, accountability, and continuous evolution across architect and engineering communities.

Innovation & Thought Leadership
  
  

* Shape forward-looking architecture visions for customers, leveraging emerging AI, data, and platform capabilities.
* Engage in executive level discussions to influence technology roadmaps, operating models, and innovation investments.
* Lead creation of reusable assets, reference architectures, accelerators, and IP that scale across customers and industries.
* Represent GCID as a thought leader in architecture, AI adoption, and largescale transformation.

Client Engagement & Solutioning
  
  

* Act as a primary technology advisor to CEO/CIO/CTO leadership, aligning architecture decisions with long term business strategy.
* Translate business imperatives into enterprise grade architecture, blueprints and execution roadmaps.
* Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders, enabling influence at boardroom and executive steering committee levels.
* Guide customers through complex tradeoffs involving cost, risk, performance, compliance, and speed to value.

Team Management & Mentorship
  
  

* Mentor senior architects and engineering leaders, shaping next generation technical leadership.
* Lead cross functional, cross geography architect communities to scale best practices and innovation.
* Inspire a culture of ownership, excellence, and outcome driven execution.

Quality & Compliance
  
  

* Ensure all solutions meet enterprise security, compliance, reliability, and Responsible AI standards.
* Provide executive oversight to design governance, quality gates, and production readiness for critical workloads.

**Other**

* Embody our culture and values

**Qualifications**

* 22+ years of experience in software, data, and platform engineering with 15+ years in enterprise architecture and technical leadership roles.
* Proven track record of influencing and delivering transformation outcomes at CXO level.
* Deep expertise in modern delivery methodologies and gotomarket acceleration models.
* Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder influence, and decision-making skills.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience; advanced certifications preferred.

Areas of Expertise
  
  
Enterprise Data Architecture & Modern Platforms
  
  

* Define and govern enterprise wide data and analytics architectures aligned to business strategy.
* Partner with customer CIO/CDO organizations on modernization, platform consolidation, and cost optimization.
* Drive accountability for operational stability, scalability, and long term sustainability.

Data Engineering & Large Scale Data Processing
  
  

* Executive oversight of largescale batch and streaming architectures across cloud and hybrid environments.
* Define standards for performance, reliability, and operability of data platforms.
* Champion DataOps and AIOps adoption for continuous optimization.

Database Platforms, Performance & Capacity Engineering
  
  

* Provide architectural guidance on transactional, analytical, and AI-driven database workloads.
* Ensure cost efficient, predictable performance at enterprise scale.

AI First Data Engineering & Unify Your Data
  
  

* Define strategies for agentic AI driven data platforms that scale responsibly.
* Influence governance, explainability, and humanintheloop adoption at enterprise level.
* Drive operationalization of autonomous data systems in production environments.

AI & Advanced Analytics Enablement
  
  

* Shape architecture for largescale AI adoption including RAG, AI agents, and inference platforms.
* Ensure AI systems meet executive expectations for trust, transparency, performance, and value realization.
* Embed Responsible AI and governance by design patterns into all solutions.

Solutioning, Presales & Technical Leadership
  
  

* Lead executive level solutioning during complex deals, renewals, and strategic pursuits.
* Influence multiyear transformation programs from vision through execution.
* Act as a trusted advisor to internal leadership on strategic accounts and investments.

Frontier Consulting Skills
  
  

* Enterprise full stack and platform thinking across data, AI, application, and cloud layers.
* Lead rapid ideation, pilots, and scaled production deployments with executive sponsorship.
* Outcomesdriven execution focused on measurable business impact.
* Comfortable operating with CEO/CIO/CTO stakeholders in high stakes environments.

Personal Attributes
  
  

* Executive presence with ability to influence at boardroom and CXO levels.
* Strategic thinker with strong technical depth and business acumen.
* Decisive, resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity.
* Passionate about innovation, scale, and continuous learning.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
  
  
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. title: Senior Principal Agentic Engineer
description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. You ship production platform services and agentic capabilities, make the build-vs-buy calls on tooling and model access, and partner with the senior architect on the patterns that scale. LLM application patterns, knowledge, and evaluation rigorDesign production LLM patterns: prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), structured outputs, multi-model routing, and hybrid retrieval over the knowledge corpus.Own the knowledge-base strategy as a compounding deflection lever — every resolved incident becomes training data and structured retrieval input for future automation.Establish evaluation and guardrail frameworks for non-deterministic systems: automated evals, quality scoring, drift detection, and feedback loops that compound agent quality over time. Cloud-native platform — build and operateArchitect and operate Kubernetes (EKS or equivalent) at scale for container and serverless workloads supporting agentic and LLM inference traffic patterns.Write production platform services and internal tooling (Python or Go) that automate provisioning, deployment, and operational workflows — not just infrastructure configuration.Define and maintain infrastructure as code (Terraform) integrated with a major cloud's AI stack (AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, or Vertex AI), with secrets management and audit-ready posture for regulated environments. CI/CD, observability, and developer experienceBuild and maintain CI/CD pipelines tuned for agentic and AI workloads: model and agent versioning, canary rollouts, evaluation gates, and rollback.Own the observability stack (Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry plus enterprise tooling) and instrument platform health, agent-decision telemetry, and model-inference metrics.Establish SLOs, SLIs, and reliability standards for both platform and agentic system health; design self-service patterns and golden-path templates that accelerate delivery. Cross-team partnership, security, and talent developmentPartner with the Reliability Engineering team on which production patterns become agent-assisted automations, and with senior architects on the patterns that scale.Own security posture: network policies, pod security, secrets rotation, vulnerability scanning, and access controls in a regulated pharmaceutical environment.Set the engineering bar through code quality standards, architectural reviews, and role modeling; mentor senior engineers in agentic AI, LLM application patterns, and platform engineering. Influence engineering leaders to adopt automation-friendly patterns at the source, not just downstream.How you will succeedBe recognized as the senior technical authority for agentic platform engineering in your area.Demonstrate measurable, sustained improvements: rising deflection rates, reduced toil, fewer recurring incidents, faster resolution, platform uptime, and deployment velocity.Ship production platform services and agentic capabilities that tangibly move the deflection and developer-experience numbers.Scale agentic intelligence through systems, standards, and people — not individual heroics.What you should bringRequired12+ years of progressive technology experience with substantial hands-on architecture and delivery of automation, AIOps, agentic systems, or cloud-native platforms at enterprise scale.Demonstrated ownership of measurable deflection or operational-toil-reduction outcomes in a production environment — with the numbers to show it.Deep technical fluency in agentic system design: agent runtimes, multi-agent orchestration, tool integration, memory and state management. Practical experience with at least one major framework (LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or MCP).Production experience with LLM application patterns: prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), structured outputs, and multi-model routing.Deep cloud-native background: Kubernetes (EKS or equivalent) at scale, container workloads, infrastructure as code (Terraform), and at least one major cloud's AI stack (AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, or Vertex AI).Proven ability to build and ship production platform services and tooling — not just configure infrastructure. Expert-level Python (async, packaging, performance) for production services; Go also welcome.Strong CI/CD engineering experience for AI and agentic workloads: model and agent deployment, versioning, canary/blue-green strategies, evaluation gates, and rollback.Observability for AI systems: metrics, logs, traces, and agent-decision telemetry using Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry, plus at least one enterprise stack (Splunk, Datadog, or Dynatrace).Demonstrated rigor in evaluation and guardrails for non-deterministic systems — automated evals, drift detection, human-in-the-loop verification, and feedback loops.Strong security engineering foundation: network policies, secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and access controls in regulated environments.Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related field.Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to translate technical strategy for senior business and technology leadership.This is a hybrid role spanning agentic AI, LLM patterns, cloud-native platform, and developer tooling. We expect strong depth in 2–3 of these areas with the breadth and judgment to learn adjacent domains. Not every tool listed is required.PreferredWorking knowledge of operational ML: anomaly detection, event correlation, alert-noise reduction, and model/agent monitoring in production.Experience with AI observability tooling (e.g., LangSmith, Weights & Biases, custom telemetry pipelines).Hands-on experience with ServiceNow integration patterns and chat-based intake platforms (e.g., Microsoft Teams).Experience with vector databases and hybrid retrieval architectures.Experience building internal developer platforms (IDP), self-service provisioning, or platform-as-a-product tooling.Backend development skills beyond infrastructure tooling: REST/gRPC API design, database design, message queues, distributed systems patterns.Experience with policy-as-code, automated compliance checks, or shift-left security tooling.AWS cloud platform fluency, including EKS, Bedrock, SageMaker, and cost-optimization tooling.Familiarity with FinOps practices and cloud cost governance.Experience operating in highly regulated industries (life sciences, financial services, healthcare).Prior experience standing up a new engineering capability from a small founding team.Frontend experience (React, TypeScript) for internal dashboards and developer portals.Leadership expectationsActs with enterprise-first mindset, beyond individual products or teams.Drives accountability, clarity, and engineering rigor across the team.Builds trust through consistency, technical depth, and follow-through.Raises the capability of the organization, not just personal output.Leads through what they build and how they write, not through org-chart authority.Additional informationAvailability to work flexible work hours is/may be required. This team supports continuous operations and may require non-standard work hours, including some work on weekends and holidays. Appropriate adjustments in benefits will be provided for employees working non-standard hours where applicable.This is an onsite role based in Hyderabad. Candidates should be open to working different shifts when required to align with global delivery partners.At Lilly, caring is not only what we do for patients. It is how we work. We believe the people who dedicate themselves to making medicines better deserve an environment that makes their lives better too, one where they are supported, respected, and given the space to do their best work. title: Test Automation Lead – AI Testing
description:

We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
Are you passionate about leveraging technology to automate and transform business processes?
  
  
Do you have a deep understanding of AI and test automation and a desire to drive innovation in enterprise systems?
  
  
If so, the Tech Enablement and Automation team at Tech@Lilly is looking for a Lead Consultant in Test Automation to help scale our automation capabilities and quality practices across the organization.
  
  
As a Lead consultant in Test Automation, you will be responsible for driving the quality and reliability of automation solutions across the enterprise. In this role, you will work closely with Engineers and cross-functional teams throughout the full application lifecycle—ensuring that systems are thoroughly tested, resilient, and aligned with business needs from development through to production.
  
  
Are you innovative and curious about new technology that can make business processes easy and more efficient? Come join our team!
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
As a
**Lead Consultant**
you will play a pivotal role in shaping and advancing the company’s enterprise-wide quality assurance and engineering strategy for AI powered systems and solutions. You will leverage both your technical expertise and leadership capabilities to oversee the delivery of scalable, high-quality AI and automation solutions. Your responsibilities will include driving resolution of complex testing challenges, leading the implementation of critical enhancements, and spearheading modernization initiatives to ensure our AI and automation frameworks and practices are future-ready and aligned with business objectives.
  
  
**What You Will Bring**

* Deep expertise in test automation frameworks and strategies, with the ability to extend them to validate AI and ML models, data pipelines, and intelligent applications.
* Hands-on expertise with AI evaluation methodologies, model benchmarking, and quality metrics
* A strong understanding of AI testing methodologies such as model validation, bias detection, explainability testing, and performance benchmarking.
* Ability to design end-to-end automated testing solutions for AI-enabled systems involving APIs, UI, data, and model outputs.
* Proven experience collaborating with data scientists, ML engineers, and software developers to ensure test coverage and model reliability.

**How You Will Succeed**

* Lead with influence by promoting a culture of engineering excellence, responsible AI, and continuous improvement.
* Develop and maintain automation frameworks tailored for testing AI/ML workflows, including model training, inference, and integration.
* Create and execute automated regression, performance, and data validation tests to ensure the stability and quality of AI-driven systems.
* Implement AI-specific test approaches such as synthetic data generation, result explainability validation, and continuous model monitoring.
* Drive innovation by identifying opportunities to embed automation and intelligence into the testing lifecycle using GenAI tools and frameworks.
* Partner cross-functionally to define and track AI quality metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, fairness) and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines.

**What You Should Bring**

* Deep understanding of LLMs, Generative AI, RAG, and Agentic AI architectures
* Hands-on experience in AI evaluation frameworks (RAGAS, DeepEval, LLM-as-a-Judge, LangFuse)
* Expertise in Prompt Validation, Prompt Injection Testing and Adversarial Testing (Red Teaming)
* Knowledge of Data Validation, Data Quality, Data Drift, and Training/Inference Pipeline Testing
* Deep hands-on experience with a broad range of test automation tools and technologies,

+ UI and functional testing: Playwright, Cypress
+ API testing: Postman
+ Performance testing: k6, JMeter

* Strong understanding of supervised/unsupervised learning.
* Experience with ML platforms and tools and cloud AI services.
* Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI/CD tools like Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.
* Excellent analytical, debugging, and communication skills with a passion for quality and innovation.
* Define, implement, and own test strategies across enterprise-level projects and programs.
* Lead and mentor global and cross-functional QA teams, promoting best practices and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with senior leadership, product owners, architects, and development teams to ensure quality is built into all stages of the development lifecycle.
* Drive the implementation of test automation strategies and continuous testing practices.
* Identify test process improvement opportunities and lead initiatives to enhance QA&E maturity and efficiency
* Oversee risk identification, mitigation planning, and resolution related to QA deliverables.
* Excellent communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Exposure to Power BI, Splunk, or other monitoring/reporting tools for real-time visibility into test execution and system behaviour.
* Champion an “automation-first” mindset in test execution and continuous delivery strategies.
* Provide expert-level consultation on AI and automation tools, frameworks, and best-fit solutions tailored to business and technology needs.
* Align people, tools, and processes to support rapid, reusable, and scalable automation solutions across the enterprise.
* Continuously evaluate emerging tools and technologies to ensure Lilly remains at the forefront of quality engineering innovation.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 7+ years of test automation experience, including at least 2 years focused on AI/ML testing.
* Proven track record in designing and executing automated test suites for complex, distributed, or AI-based systems.
* Strong programming and problem-solving skills with experience in Python, JS/TS, or similar languages.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with AI quality tools such as DeepChecks, Great Expectations, DataFold.
* Understanding of MLOps and automated model lifecycle management.
* Certification in AI/ML, Test Automation, or Cloud Technologies (e.g., AWS Certified Machine Learning, ISTQB Advanced Test Automation Engineer).

title: Senior ASIC Verification Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is seeking a passionate, highly motivated, and creative software engineer to be part of its CPU Infrastructure team. We develop methodologies and craft tools to streamline the design/verification of NVIDIA's CPU and SOC designs. This position offers the opportunity to have real impact in a dynamic, technology-focused company impacting product lines ranging from consumer graphics to self-driving cars and the growing field of artificial intelligence. We have created a team of outstanding people stretching around the globe, whose mission is to push the frontiers of what is possible today and define the platform for the future of computing. Come, join us today!
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Set up scalable verification flows for large IP’s that caters to multiple projects and variants.
* Improve continuous integration processes across multiple branches for various IP versions and projects.
* Continuous improvement of the speed of build and simulation flows.
* Set up automated metrics and dashboards to monitor health of the infrastructure flows and resources.

* Experience with Linux shell scripting, Makeppfiles, and Perl/Python or equivalent
* Background with ASIC EDA tool flows, simulators, waveform debug tools, and equivalent
* Experience with LSF, compute farms, filers, and networks
* Experience with setup, configuration, and maintenance of Jenkins build servers

* Experience with Golang is desired but not mandatory.

title: RR Integration lead
description:
**Req ID:**
378172
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a RR Integration lead to join our team in Hyderabad, Telangana (IN-TG), India (IN).
  
  
The SAP Integration Suite / CPI Developer will design, develop, test, document, deploy, monitor, and support integrations between SAP S/4HANA and multiple SAP and non-SAP systems in a global SAP S/4HANA transformation program. The role is aligned to a Greenfield+ SAP S/4HANA RISE PCE implementation using Fit-to-Standard principles, Clean Core delivery, structured governance, formal change control, and multi-wave deployment execution.
  
  
This role will work primarily with SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration, and must also support CPI-DS / SAP Cloud Integration for Data Services for SAP IBP data integration. The developer will support integrations across procurement, supplier collaboration, HR, finance, tax, manufacturing, labeling, banking, analytics, planning, and third-party enterprise applications. The position requires strong hands-on technical skills, rigorous documentation discipline, structured testing support, cutover readiness, hypercare support, and knowledge transfer to support/COE teams.
  
  
Day-to-Day Job Duties
  
  

* Design, build, test, deploy, monitor, and support integration flows using SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration for SAP-to-SAP and SAP-to-non-SAP integration scenarios.
* Design, build, schedule, monitor, and support CPI-DS jobs for SAP IBP integration, including master data and transactional data movement between SAP S/4HANA and SAP IBP.
* Support SAP IBP integration scenarios involving planning areas, key figures, attributes, planning levels, master data, transactional data, full/delta loads, job scheduling, monitoring, error handling, and reconciliation.
* Develop integrations involving SAP S/4HANA, SAP Ariba, SAP Business Network, SuccessFactors, Concur, BlackLine, OneSource, OpenText VIM/OCR, SAP Sales Cloud, SimpleMDG, SAP IBP, SAP PLM, SAP ECTR, SAP Integrated Product Development, MES platforms, Loftware, Enlabel, SAP Document Compliance/DRC, SAP Multibank Connectivity/MBC, SAP BCM, SAC, Datasphere, Power BI, Snowflake, Workday, Dayforce/Ceridian, Oracle EBS, Oracle Demand Management, Oracle intercompany, Legal Tracker, Kiosk, CTSI, Reliance, tax/e-invoicing platforms, supplier/customer EDI partner systems, and other enterprise applications.
* Create interface design documents, source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, routing logic, error handling designs, retry logic, reconciliation approach, monitoring procedures, runbooks, and deployment documentation.
* Support synchronous, asynchronous, file-based, API-based, message-based, EDI, B2B, cXML, and event-driven integration patterns.
* Develop integrations using adapters and protocols including IDoc, OData, REST, SOAP, cXML, ANSI X12, EDIFACT, SFTP, APIs, XML, JSON, OAuth, certificates, PGP/encryption, and related message formats.
* Support SAP Ariba Managed Gateway / Cloud Integration Gateway scenarios for purchase orders, purchase order changes, goods receipts, service entry sheets, invoices, invoice status, payment remittance, supplier collaboration, and Business Network processes.
* Support EDI scenarios for supplier and customer-facing transactions, including direct supplier/customer EDI where standard network connectivity is not sufficient.
* Support banking and treasury integrations including payment files, bank statements, inbound/outbound messages, SWIFT/EBICS connectivity, bank onboarding, format validation, certificate/security setup, exception handling, and bank connectivity testing.
* Monitor CPI and CPI-DS jobs, troubleshoot failures, analyze logs, coordinate data corrections, manage retries and reloads, and resolve integration defects during SIT, UAT, mock cutover, production cutover, and hypercare.
* Support formal integration testing including SIT1, SIT2, UAT, regression testing, performance testing, security testing, cutover rehearsals, production deployment, hypercare stabilization, and handover to support/COE teams.

SAP BTP Integration Suite Capabilities
  
  

* SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration for integration flow development, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operations.
* SAP API Management for API exposure, proxy configuration, policy enforcement, and API lifecycle governance where applicable.
* Trading Partner Management and B2B capabilities where applicable for EDI and partner integration scenarios.
* SAP Event Mesh or event-driven integration concepts where applicable.
* SAP Cloud Connector, destinations, secure connectivity, OAuth, certificates, PGP/encryption, SFTP keys, principal propagation, and network/security coordination.
* Operational monitoring, alerting, retry/reprocess procedures, interface runbooks, production support handover, and COE enablement.

Testing, Validation, Cutover, and Hypercare Responsibilities
  
  

* Support test preparation by creating integration test cases, test data needs, expected results, and interface readiness criteria.
* Support SIT1, SIT2, UAT, regression testing, performance testing, and integration validation using SAP Cloud ALM or approved project tools.
* Support GxP/CSV-aware delivery where applicable, including controlled documentation, traceability, test evidence, defect resolution notes, and approval support.
* Support cutover planning, endpoint readiness, certificate/key validation, partner readiness, job scheduling, interface freeze windows, mock cutover, production cutover, and post-load reconciliation.
* Provide hypercare support including triage, root cause analysis, monitoring, reprocessing, issue closure, knowledge transfer, and support handover documentation.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with SAP IBP integration using CPI-DS in global SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
* Experience with data load performance tuning, job scheduling, dependency management, full/delta load strategies, and high-volume planning data reconciliation.
* Experience with SAP Document Compliance/DRC and statutory e-invoicing integrations across multiple countries.
* Experience with SAP Multibank Connectivity/MBC, SAP BCM, SWIFT/EBICS, bank onboarding, and bank statement/payment file integration.
* Experience in GxP/CSV-regulated environments and multi-country SAP deployments.
* Experience with monitoring dashboards, alerting, operational support transition, and COE knowledge transfer.

Degree
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Systems, or a related field. Equivalent hands-on SAP integration project experience may be considered.
  
  
Professional Competencies
  
  

* Strong ownership mindset and ability to drive assigned deliverables from design through hypercare.
* Ability to work effectively in a global delivery model across onsite, offshore, and cross-functional teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical topics to functional and business stakeholders.
* Ability to work within formal governance, documentation, validation, change control, and deliverable acceptance processes.
* Ability to prepare clear knowledge transfer materials and support transition to application support or SAP Center of Excellence teams.

EkamDor is looking for college students who are interested in social media, online communities, and emerging digital platforms to join our team as Social Media Publishing Interns.

Location: Remote

Duration: 3-6 Months

Eligibility: College Students / Freshers Only

**About the Internship**

This is a 3-6 months, execution-focused internship designed for college students who want practical experience working with social media publishing and content operations.

You will not be expected to develop social media strategies, design graphics, or create content from scratch. Our content, captions, creatives, and publishing instructions will generally be provided.

Your primary responsibility will be to ensure that approved content is published accurately and on time across our social media platforms.

Based on your performance, reliability, and contribution during the 3-6 month internship, selected interns may have the opportunity to continue with EkamDor on a paid basis.

Please note that paid continuation is performance-based and is not guaranteed.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Publish and schedule pre-approved posts, images, videos, captions, and other content.
* Follow the content calendar and publishing schedule.
* Check captions, hashtags, mentions, links, tags, and other publishing details.
* Ensure content is published in the correct format for each platform.
* Maintain a simple content calendar or publishing log.
* Monitor scheduled posts and report publishing errors or platform issues.
* Follow established publishing workflows and instructions consistently.
* Coordinate with the team to ensure content goes live correctly and on time.

**Platforms**

Instagram | Facebook | LinkedIn | YouTube | X | Reddit | Bluesky

Familiarity with X, Reddit, and Bluesky is particularly valuable for this role.

**Requirements**

* Currently pursuing a college degree or diploma.
* Open to freshers with no prior professional experience.
* Active and comfortable using social media platforms.
* Good understanding of how different social media platforms work.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to follow instructions accurately.
* Good organizational and time-management skills.
* Good written communication and basic English proficiency.
* Reliable, punctual, and responsive.
* Comfortable using Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel.
* Access to a reliable laptop and internet connection.
* Able to commit to the full 3-6 month internship.

**Good to Have**

* Active participation on X, Reddit, or Bluesky beyond basic browsing.
* Experience managing a personal, college, community, or student social media account.
* Experience with Meta Business Suite or other scheduling tools.
* Familiarity with writing short-form posts or threads.
* Basic understanding of social media analytics.
* Interest in internet culture, online communities, and emerging social platforms.

**Who We’re Looking For**

We’re looking for college students who are curious, reliable, organized, and genuinely comfortable being on the internet.

You don't need to be a social media expert, strategist, designer, or content creator.

What matters is that you understand how social platforms work, pay attention to details, follow instructions accurately, and can be trusted to make sure content goes out correctly and on time.

Interns who demonstrate strong performance, consistency, ownership, and reliability during this period may be considered for a paid opportunity with EkamDor.

Paid continuation will be based on individual performance and the company's requirements at the end of the internship.

**How to Apply**

If you are a college student looking for a practical social media internship, we’d love to hear from you.

If you have previously managed a personal, college, community, or student social media account, feel free to include relevant links or examples with your application.

Freshers are strongly encouraged to apply.

Apply through the EkamDor LinkedIn job posting.

You can also send your resume to : qaekamdor@gmail.com

title: State Business Head
description:
**Job Description: State Business Head**

* **Location:**
  Hyderabad
* **Markets:**
  Kerala, Gujarat, Odisha (3 positions available)
* **Experience:**
  7–12 years
* **Compensation:**
  35–40 Lakhs per annum
* **Reporting To:**
  Founder's Office

**About the Role**

This role is for entrepreneurial
**State Business Heads**
who will build the business in their respective states almost like a
**Mini CEO**
. This is not a traditional marketing, operations, or business-development role. You will own the entire state business end-to-end: understanding the customer, identifying the right offerings, building partner networks, creating the occasion calendar, launching campaigns, acquiring customers, delivering the service successfully, and bringing customers back again.

The ideal candidate possesses strong commercial thinking, cultural understanding, marketing instinct, and exceptional execution capabilities.

**What You Will Own**

1. **State Business & Revenue**

* Own the growth of the business in the assigned state.
* Build annual and quarterly business plans covering: Revenue, Transactions, New customers, Repeat customers, Average Order Value (AOV), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), Retention, Product portfolio, and Partner network.
* Treat the state as your own business and continuously identify new opportunities for growth.

1. **Understand the State's Consumer Ecosystem**

* Develop a deep understanding of the state's key markets, regional traditions, festivals, seasonal and occasion-led demand, local customs, consumer preferences, life-event needs, influential local voices, and customer behaviour.
* Translate this understanding into products and campaigns relevant to customers in that state.

1. **Build Partner Network**

* Identify and develop relationships with high-potential partners and institutions.
* Responsibilities include: Partner discovery, meeting partner management and key stakeholders, partnership negotiation, offering selection, commercial arrangements, operational readiness, content collection, quality standards, and long-term relationship management.
* Build a strong pipeline of partners rather than depending on only a few.

1. **Build the State Occasion Calendar**

* Create a 365-day calendar for the state identifying opportunities around major festivals, monthly occasions, seasonal peaks, and other high-demand days.
* For every major occasion, decide the offering, partner, pricing, target customers, and marketing timelines.

1. **Product Creation**

* Work with partners, product, content, and operations teams to create compelling offerings.
* Own the product proposition, partner selection, packages, pricing, add-ons, fulfilment, personalisation options, customer communication, photos/videos, storytelling, and landing-page proposition. Convert regional occasions into compelling and authentic consumer propositions.

1. **Campaign Planning & Growth**

* Own the commercial success of every major campaign spanning Meta Ads, Google Ads, performance marketing, CAC, ROAS, CTR, conversion, creative testing, audience segmentation, landing-page conversion, remarketing, and WhatsApp marketing.
* Analyse campaign metrics to optimize propositions, partners, pricing, and creatives.

1. **Influencer & Creator Partnerships**

* Build a state-level network of regional influencers, YouTubers, Instagram creators, regional celebrities, niche content creators, and community voices.
* Develop performance-linked partnerships that drive transactions rather than mere brand awareness.

1. **End-to-End Service Execution**

* Oversee the complete customer journey from booking, order detail collection, partner coordination, and service execution, to proof/video delivery, fulfilment, customer communication, and feedback.

1. **Retention & Repeat Business**

* Build repeat behaviour by working with CRM and retention teams across WhatsApp, push notifications, email, personalization, festival reminders, past-purchase recommendations, partner recommendations, cross-sells, family occasions, birthdays, anniversaries, and recurring purchases.

1. **Consumer Insights**

* Constantly analyse customer feedback, search behaviour, customer support conversations, campaign comments, social media, competitor actions, and market trends to launch new products and improve existing offerings.

**Candidate Profile**

This role calls for builders rather than administrators. The ideal candidate:

* Has
  **7-12 years**
  of experience.
* Has built or scaled a consumer business, category, city, region, or marketplace.
* Understands digital consumer acquisition and Meta/Google performance marketing.
* Has strong commercial, analytical ability, and experience working with vendors, partners, or distributed supply.
* Can manage complex operations, understand retention/repeat purchase behaviour, and work with ambiguity to build things from zero.
* Possesses very high ownership and operates without waiting for instructions.
* Is comfortable traveling across the assigned state.
* *Preferred Background:*
  Experience in D2C, e-commerce, marketplaces, food delivery, travel, matrimony, consumer internet, regional content, or other high-frequency consumer businesses.

**Cultural Requirement**

Deep cultural understanding of the respective state is mandatory. The candidate must:

* Speak the state's language fluently and read it comfortably.
* Understand regional traditions, festivals, consumer behaviour, and cultural nuances across different districts/regions within the state.

Note: All positions will be based in Hyderabad.

title: Principal Engineer (Clean Water Modelling)
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
At Jacobs, we push the limits of what’s possible to make the world smarter, more connected, and more sustainable. In our water business, that means supporting UK water companies in delivering resilient and efficient clean water networks through advanced modelling, analytics, and digital solutions.
  
  
As a Principal Engineer in Clean Water Modelling, you will play a pivotal role in delivering AMP programme outcomes, helping clients optimise network performance, enhance resilience, and meet regulatory and customer service objectives.
  
  
**Key duties include**

* Provide technical leadership in clean water network modelling across UK water utility projects.
* Lead development, calibration, and validation of hydraulic models for large-scale clean water distribution networks.
* Deliver modelling studies aligned with AMP programmes and regulatory performance requirements.
* Undertake and review

+ Demand forecasting and distribution input analysis
+ Network capacity assessments and hydraulic performance evaluations
+ Pressure management and operational optimisation studies
+ Leakage analysis and reduction strategies
+ Network resilience and outage scenario analysis

* Lead optioneering and system optimisation, including network reinforcement, rezoning, and operational improvements.
* Support development of

+ WRMP (Water Resource Management Plans) inputs
+ Investment planning and business cases (e.g., PR submissions)

* Prepare and review technical reports, modelling documentation, and analysis outputs in line with UK water industry standards.
* Ensure modelling outputs align with regulatory frameworks (OFWAT, DWI, Environment Agency).
* Establish and enforce modelling standards, QA/QC processes, and best practices.
* Perform technical assurance reviews of models, data inputs, assumptions, and outputs.
* Engage with UK water company clients, supporting model reviews, technical workshops, and decision-making discussions.
* Identify data gaps, uncertainties, and risks; define strategies for improvement and mitigation.
* Mentor and guide engineers and modellers, supporting capability development within the team.
* Drive innovation through digital tools, automation, scripting, and data-driven workflows.

**We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in
**delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects****
**.**
Here's what you'll need
  
  
**Key software tools**

* Primary Modelling Tools InfoWorks WS Pro, Synergi
* Additional Tools (Preferred) InfoWater
* GIS Platforms ArcGIS Pro, QGIS
* Data & Analytics Advanced Excel, Power BI (desirable), Python scripting (desirable)

**Key Behaviours**

* Strong technical authority in clean water modelling and network analysis.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities with attention to detail.
* Confident communicator with strong client engagement skills.
* Collaborative and proactive in a multidisciplinary and global delivery environment.
* High ownership of quality, data integrity, and technical excellence.
* Mentorship-driven mindset with focus on team capability development.

**Work Experience**

* Over 15 years of experience in clean water network modelling and planning, with strong focus on UK water utility projects.
* Deep expertise in InfoWorks WS Pro and/or Synergi for large-scale hydraulic modelling.
* Experience delivering modelling studies aligned with AMP cycles (AMP6/7/8).
* Strong understanding of

+ UK water industry standards and modelling practices
+ Regulatory frameworks (OFWAT, DWI, Environment Agency)
+ Asset management and investment planning processes

* Demonstrated experience in

+ Network optimisation and pressure management
+ Leakage analysis and reduction
+ Network resilience and scenario modelling

* Proven capability in technical leadership, QA/QC, and mentoring modelling teams.
* Experience in client engagement, technical reviews, and stakeholder discussions.
* Experience in data analysis, interpretation, and model-driven decision support.

Familiarity with digital delivery, automation, and advanced analytics is desirable
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering (or related discipline)
* Master’s degree in Water Resources / Environmental Engineering (or relevant field)

**Preferred Attributes**

* CIWEM Accreditation
* Experience working within UK frameworks or with water utility clients
* Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential for client-facing responsibilities.

Ability to work effectively within global delivery teams supporting UK clients.
  
  
**Hybrid Work Expectation**
Average office presence of 3 days per week or as per Company Policy, with travel for client/site meetings and occasional team meetings.
  
  
At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

description:
Community & Events Lead

Companionship App  ·  Job Description

**Location:**

Mumbai   |

CEO   |

5+ years   |   
**Schedule:**

Weekend-based

**₹10–12 lakh per annum**

About us

We are building a companionship service that helps people form real, lasting relationships. It starts with hosted in-person experiences and grows into an app that keeps those connections going.

We are at day one, and you would be one of the first people on the team.

The role

You will be the face of our events: you plan them, market them, fill them and run them on the ground, and you look after every member. You report to the CEO.

This is a hands-on, in-the-field role. Weekends are core working days, with time off during the week.

What you'll do

·      
**Plan and set up events:**
build them from scratch — formats, venues, budgets, suppliers and run-sheets.

·      
**Drive footfall:**
market every event through community partnerships, local outreach, WhatsApp, social media and paid ads, against a turnout target.

·      
**Run events on the day:**
venue setup, check-in, hosting, timing and wrap-up.

·      
**Welcome every member:**
call each new member before their first event, meet them at the door and introduce them to others.

·      
**Manage hosts:**
recruit, brief and schedule part-time hosts and volunteers.

·      
**Keep the community active:**
run member WhatsApp groups, reminders, RSVPs and follow-ups so first-timers come back.

·      
**Track results:**
turnout, repeat attendance, cost per attendee and member feedback, reported weekly to the CEO.

·      
**Capture content:**
photos, short videos and member stories for marketing, always with consent.

·      
**Help shape the app:**
test it with members and pass on what they say.

What you'll bring

·      
**Experience:**
a minimum of 5 years in events, event marketing, hospitality or community roles.

·      
**A proven record of filling events:**
you can show turnout numbers and explain exactly how you got people there.

·      
**Hands-on event marketing:**
community partnerships, local outreach, WhatsApp, social media and small paid campaigns.

·      
**Experience setting up events from scratch:**
venues, suppliers, budgets and run-sheets.

·      
**Warmth and patience with people:**
you remember names and stories, and people feel looked after around you.

·      
**Strong organisation:**
nothing slips on event day.

·      
**Confidence:**
on the phone and in approaching strangers.

·      
**Composure:**
calm under pressure when something goes wrong mid-event.

·      
**Languages:**
fluent English and Hindi.

·      
**Location:**
based in Mumbai and comfortable with regular weekend work.

Nice to have

·      Hospitality training or a hotel, F&B or guest-relations background.

·      Experience running WhatsApp communities or social media pages.

·      Basic photography or video skills for social content.

·      First-aid certification.

·      Marathi or Gujarati.

What we offer

·      
**A front-row seat:**
build something new, with real responsibility from the first month.

·      
**Meaningful work:**
success is measured in friendships made, not clicks.

·      
**Room to grow:**
step into a senior role as we open in more cities.

title: Lead – Partnerships & Affinity Business
description:
Lead – Partnerships & Affinity Business

AVYA / Protector IQ

Location: Mulund, Mumbai | Office-based

Employment: Full-time

Compensation: Negotiable fixed salary plus sales-linked incentives

ABOUT US

AVYA and Protector IQ bring together insurance expertise, product innovation and technology to develop protection solutions for individuals, businesses and communities.

AVYA helps people understand their risks and find suitable insurance. Protector IQ works with insurers, technology firms and institutions on insurance innovation, product intelligence and solutions for health, climate and livelihoods.

Backed by IIMA Ventures, we are looking for a commercially driven professional to grow our partnerships, affinity business and direct insurance broking business.

THE ROLE

We are building partnerships around real protection gaps in health, business continuity, climate and livelihoods. Our approach is gender-intentional: recognising how risks and access to protection differ across genders, and using those insights to develop relevant solutions for people, businesses and communities.

We want someone who asks what people need to remain financially resilient, questions whether existing products meet that need, and brings insurers and partners together around a commercially viable response. You may have tried to introduce a different approach within an insurer, broker or financial services firm and struggled to find the space to pursue it. We value that initiative and what you learned, including when an idea did not reach launch.

This is a hands-on, revenue-owning role for someone who enjoys opening doors, acquiring new clients and partners, and closing business. You will build opportunities from scratch and take them from initial outreach to placement, activation and realised revenue.

We need a new-business hunter who can also grow the relationships they win. Success will be measured by business generated and partnerships activated, alongside client retention and growth.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• Discover underserved protection needs through conversations with clients, communities and partners.

• Shape propositions with our underwriting and product team, challenge standard approaches where they fall short, and secure insurer and distribution partners.

• Take pilots from concept to launch, adoption and revenue, assessing whether they deliver meaningful protection as well as commercial results.

• Build a pipeline of affinity partners, including employers, financial institutions, healthtechs, professional associations, membership organisations and community networks.

• Source and close direct insurance broking business, acquiring individual, SME and corporate clients.

• Generate opportunities through targeted outreach, industry networks, referrals and events.

• Understand clients’ and partners’ needs and identify suitable insurance and protection solutions.

• Develop commercially viable partnership propositions with the founder and insurance team, with a knack for innovating and structuring insurance solutions.

• Liaise with insurers and the internal team on product fit, coverage structuring, quotations, negotiations and insurance placement.

• Lead pitches, proposals, commercial negotiations and closure.

• Take partnerships beyond signing: drive activation, customer acquisition, sales conversion and revenue.

• Own the commercial relationship from prospecting through conversion, servicing coordination and renewals.

• Identify and develop opportunities for Protector IQ’s consulting, product innovation and institutional services.

• Own agreed sales targets, maintain a disciplined pipeline and forecast, and follow through on revenue collection.

• Build repeatable approaches to acquiring partners and clients, laying the foundation for a larger sales team.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Curiosity about resilience, business continuity and livelihoods, and a commitment to building insurance that responds to real needs.

• Product imagination and the ability to translate an idea into a practical partnership and business proposition.

• We welcome backgrounds in insurance or financial services partnerships, affinity business, insurance broking, institutional sales, bancassurance, embedded insurance or business development.

• We welcome candidates from the wider financial sector with a strong record of acquiring partners and closing business.

• Evidence of new business you personally sourced and won, rather than experience limited to managing assigned accounts or inbound leads.

• The ability to engage decision-makers, navigate partnership sales cycles and turn relationships into paying business.

• An understanding of insurance products and an interest in developing innovative propositions. Direct broking and insurer engagement experience will be valuable.

• Strong commercial judgement, negotiation skills and disciplined follow-through.

• Comfort with revenue targets, performance-linked earnings and hands-on execution in a growing company.

• Willingness to work from our Mulund office and travel for client and partner meetings.

An existing network in insurance or financial services is valuable. Your ability to convert access and relationships into business matters most.

GROWTH INTO SENIOR LEADERSHIP

You will work directly with the founder and help shape our commercial direction. This role is intended to grow into a senior leadership position as the company scales, with increasing responsibility for business strategy, revenue and team building.

Progression will depend on sustained business results, the ability to build a repeatable sales function and readiness to recruit and lead a team.

COMPENSATION

Compensation is negotiable and will comprise a fixed salary plus sales-linked incentives.

The fixed salary is the guaranteed component. Incentives are earned on realised revenue from closed business, under an agreed incentive plan. No sales means no sales incentive; meetings, introductions, proposals or signed partnerships without revenue will not qualify for incentives.

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through LinkedIn with your CV. Tell us about something you tried to do differently in insurance or financial services: the need you saw, what you proposed, the partners you brought together and what happened. We welcome examples that did not reach launch and what you learned from them. Please also share a client or partnership you personally sourced and won, your role from initial outreach to revenue, and the results you delivered. Approximate figures are welcome where confidentiality requires.

title: Founding Ceo

first experiences, first members and repeat attendance, against clear targets.

product vision, choice of build partners, launch and adoption.

brand, partnerships, marketing and member referrals.

with venues, brands, employers and community organisations.

get the business ready for outside funding when the time comes.

with press and partners.

a minimum of 8–10 years, including P&L or general-management responsibility in a consumer business.

a startup, a new city launch or a new business line.

experience hiring and leading teams from scratch.

consumer marketing, community-led growth and unit economics.

taking a digital product from idea to launch with product and tech teams.

you care about the member experience as much as the numbers.

lead it from day one, with committed backing.

success is measured in friendships made, not clicks.

including equity for the right candidate.

title: Cloud Sales Specialist
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a strategic technology services and solutions partner of AWS, Microsoft Azure and
  
  
Google Cloud, helping enterprises modernize their technology environments and accelerate
  
  
cloud, data and AI transformation.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Cloud Specialist Sales professional to drive cloud-led
  
  
business development and Sales across NTT DATA’s enterprise client base. The role will operate
  
  
within NTT DATA India working horizontally across Client Management, Business Units,
  
  
hyperscaler alliance teams, solutioning/presales and delivery organisations.
  
  
The Cloud Specialist Seller will act as a cloud subject-matter sales leader and opportunity
  
  
orchestrator, identifying and creating cloud transformation opportunities, shaping customer
  
  
conversations, developing qualified pipelines and bringing the right NTT DATA and hyperscaler
  
  
capabilities together to progress opportunities through to closure.
  
  
The role requires someone who can operate effectively across organisational boundaries,
  
  
influence without direct authority, engage senior customer stakeholders and translate cloud
  
  
technology capabilities into measurable business outcomes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Cloud Business Development & Pipeline Creation
* Develop and execute cloud sales strategies across an assigned portfolio of enterprise customers.
* Identify opportunities across cloud migration, modernization, application transformation, infrastructure modernization, cloud-native development, managed cloud services and cloud optimization.
* Proactively create demand rather than relying solely on existing account pipeline.
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified cloud opportunities and achieve agreed

sales/revenue targets.
  
  

* Identify opportunities to expand existing NTT DATA relationships through cloud-led transformation initiatives.
* Develop account-level cloud whitespace maps covering AWS, Azure and GCP opportunities.
* Client Engagement & Consultative Selling
* Engage with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, business leaders and technology decision-makers to understand transformation priorities.
* Lead executive-level conversations around the business value of cloud, rather than selling individual cloud products.
* Understand customer technology landscapes, transformation roadmaps, business drivers and pain points.
* Position NTT DATA’s capabilities together with hyperscaler technology to develop differentiated customer propositions.
* Build trusted-advisor relationships with customers and establish NTT DATA as a strategic cloud transformation partner
* Matrix / Client Manager Collaboration

As a horizontal specialist organisation, the role will work closely with Client Managers and BU sales teams across NTT DATA.
  
  
Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Partner with Client Managers to identify and qualify cloud opportunities within strategic accounts.
* Work across multiple BUs to leverage existing customer relationships and industry expertise.
* Establish joint account plans with Client Managers and BU leadership.
* Support Client Managers with cloud-specific opportunity identification, qualification and

strategy.
  
  

* Bring specialist cloud expertise into broader account planning and customer engagements.
* Maintain clear ownership and engagement models with Client Managers to avoid channel conflict and ensure a coordinated customer experience.
* Influence stakeholders across the matrix without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Hyperscaler Alliance Engagement
* Develop strong working relationships with AWS, Microsoft and Google Cloud sales and technical teams.
* Create joint account strategies and opportunity plans with hyperscaler sellers.
* Leverage hyperscaler funding, migration programs, assessments, workshops, incentives

and partner programs to accelerate opportunities.
  
  

* Coordinate joint customer engagements involving NTT DATA and hyperscaler teams.
* Build differentiated propositions leveraging NTT DATA’s services capabilities and

hyperscaler platforms.
  
  

* Track hyperscaler ecosystem developments and translate relevant capabilities into customer opportunities.
* Opportunity Shaping & Sales Leadership
* Lead the commercial sales strategy for qualified cloud opportunities.
* Develop opportunity plans covering customer business problem, solution proposition,

stakeholders, competition, commercial model and path to closure.
  
  

* Coordinate with solution architects, presales, delivery, commercial and legal teams.
* Ensure opportunities are appropriately qualified before significant presales investment.
* Lead proposal strategy, customer presentations, workshops and executive engagements.
* Maintain accurate CRM hygiene, forecasting and opportunity reporting.
* Drive opportunities from initial qualification → solution shaping → proposal →

negotiation → closure.
  
  
C. Cloud Solution & Commercial Understanding
  
  
The successful candidate should have sufficient technical understanding to engage credibly with customers and technical stakeholders across:
  
  

* Cloud migration and modernization
* IaaS / PaaS / SaaS
* Cloud-native architectures
* Containers and Kubernetes
* Data platforms and analytics
* AI/ML and Generative AI workloads
* Cloud security
* Networking and hybrid cloud
* DevOps / DevSecOps
* FinOps and cloud optimization
* Managed cloud services

The role is not expected to be the primary technical architect, but must be able to understand customer requirements, challenge solution assumptions and connect technical capabilities to business outcomes.
  
  

* Internal Orchestration

The specialist seller will act as the single-threaded sales orchestrator for cloud opportunities, bringing together:
  
  
Client Manager → BU → Cloud Specialist → Presales/Solution Architecture → Delivery → Hyperscaler → Commercial/Finance
  
  
Responsibilities include:
  
  

* Establishing the right internal team for each opportunity.
* Creating clear roles, responsibilities and next steps.
* Driving opportunity cadence and governance.
* Removing internal blockers.
* Ensuring commercial, solution and delivery stakeholders remain aligned.

Maintaining momentum from opportunity creation through closure.
  
  
Required Qualifications:
  
  

* 8–10+ years of enterprise technology sales experience, preferably including significant cloud sales experience.
* Proven experience selling AWS, Azure and/or GCP solutions/services.
* Experience in a Systems Integrator, IT Services company, hyperscaler or technology

consulting organisation preferred.
  
  

* Demonstrated experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Experience working in a matrixed organisation is highly desirable.
* Experience selling through or alongside hyperscaler partner ecosystems preferred.

Technical & Business Skills
  
  
Strong understanding of:
  
  

* AWS / Azure / GCP cloud platforms
* Cloud transformation and modernization
* Data & AI workloads
* Cloud economics and business cases
* Enterprise architecture concepts
* Managed services
* Cloud security
* Digital transformation

Sales Competencies
  
  

* Consultative / value-based selling
* Enterprise account planning
* Opportunity qualification
* Pipeline generation
* Executive stakeholder management
* Deal shaping and negotiation
* Partner ecosystem management
* Forecasting
* Cross-functional influence
* Strong communication and presentation skills

Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
  
  
responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
  
  
unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and
  
  
application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move
  
  
confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more

title: Account Executive - Portfolio
description:
**Meet the Team**
We are seeking a dynamic, results-driven Portfolio Sales Account Executive to join our Service Provider team in Mumbai. In today’s rapidly evolving digital landscape, telecommunications and service provider networks are undergoing unprecedented transformation driven by AI, cloud adoption, 5G deployment, and critical digital infrastructure modernization. In this role, you will provide strategic account leadership to navigate these complex industry shifts, driving new business growth and expanding existing relationships with telecommunications companies, managed service providers, and digital infrastructure partners. You will own the entire sales lifecycle—from strategic prospecting and account planning to complex negotiations and closing. The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of the service provider landscape in India, a proven track record of exceeding quota in technology sales, and the ability to articulate high-value business solutions to C-level executives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive strategic sales plan for assigned account within the service provider sector to achieve and exceed annual revenue targets.
* Provide strategic account leadership to align our portfolio with customer business outcomes amidst ongoing digital infrastructure, AI, cloud, and 5G transformations.
* Orchestrate cross-functional teams and internal resources—including product specialists, solution engineers, and customer success teams—to lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
* Identify, cultivate, and close new business opportunities while simultaneously expanding our footprint within existing client portfolios.
* Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with C-level executives, procurement teams, and key technical decision-makers within major service provider organizations.
* Conduct high-impact presentations, product demonstrations, and executive briefings that effectively communicate our value proposition and technical capabilities.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date sales pipeline data, forecasts, and customer records using our CRM platform.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and regulatory changes within the Indian telecommunications and service provider industry to identify emerging opportunities.
* Participate in industry events, trade shows, and networking functions to represent the company and generate new leads.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. An MBA or postgraduate qualification is a plus.
* 7–10 years of experience in enterprise B2B sales, including at least 4 years selling technology solutions to telecommunications operators, service providers, or related organizations in India.
* Experience meeting or exceeding annual sales targets for complex, high-value technology solutions.
* Strong understanding of the Indian telecommunications and Service Provider ecosystem, including telecom operators, internet service providers, and cloud service providers.
* Working knowledge of IP/MPLS, SRv6, Agentic Operations (Agentic Ops), and Crossworks, with the ability to connect these technologies to customer needs and network transformation initiatives.
* Understanding of Data Center business and networking infrastructure, with the ability to connect Service Provider solutions with data center, cloud, and digital infrastructure requirements.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with experience engaging customers across different levels of an organization, including senior and executive leaders.
* Experience managing complex sales opportunities, including commercial negotiations, multi-year agreements, and Requests for Proposals (RFPs).
* Strong business and financial understanding, with the ability to develop and communicate value propositions and commercial proposals.
* Experience using CRM platforms and sales enablement tools to manage customer relationships, opportunities, and sales pipelines.
* Fluency in English and Hindi is required. Knowledge of regional languages spoken in Mumbai and surrounding business hubs is a plus.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with Service Provider NPE (Network Platform Engineering) or supporting SP network transformation initiatives.
* Experience in the Service Provider or Telecommunications industry, with an established understanding of customer needs and market dynamics.
* Experience supporting or leading digital transformation initiatives within large organizations.
* Experience managing complex, long-cycle sales opportunities involving multiple stakeholders.
* Knowledge of AI, cloud computing, networking, software-defined networking (SDN), and 5G technologies and their application in the Service Provider market.
* Experience building relationships with senior decision-makers across major Service Provider accounts in India.
* Experience working with Global Systems Integrators (GSIs) and other strategic technology partners is a plus.
