title: Solar Digital Monitoring & IoT Systems - Roofsol Energy
description:
**Job Description – Solar Digital Monitoring & IoT Systems**

**Company:**
Roofsol Energy Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Department:**
Technology / Digital Solutions

**Experience:**
Approximately 10 years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About Roofsol Energy**

Roofsol Energy Pvt. Ltd. operates in the solar energy sector, developing and managing solar projects across India. The company has invested in multiple solar projects under the OPEX (CAPEX-free / RESCO) business model, where continuous monitoring of generation, plant performance, equipment health, and operational efficiency is essential.

As part of its technology development strategy, Roofsol Energy intends to establish its own end-to-end solar monitoring ecosystem, including proprietary data loggers, IoT-based data acquisition systems, cloud infrastructure, and a centralized solar generation monitoring platform. The objective is to develop and own the underlying technology and Intellectual Property (IP), while ensuring reliable monitoring and management of a large portfolio of distributed solar projects across India.

**Role Overview**

Roofsol Energy is looking for an experienced technology professional to lead the conceptualization, design, development, deployment, and maintenance of an in-house solar data logging and generation monitoring system.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Strategy and Technology Development**

·      Define the technology roadmap for Roofsol Energy’s proprietary solar monitoring and data acquisition ecosystem.

·      Lead the end-to-end development of the monitoring platform, from product architecture and prototype development to commercial deployment.

·      Evaluate appropriate hardware, communication protocols, software frameworks, cloud technologies, and system architectures.

·      Develop solutions suitable for both small rooftop solar installations and large distributed solar portfolios.

**2. Data Logger and IoT Hardware Development**

·      Lead the design, development, prototyping, testing, and deployment of in-house solar data logging equipment.

·      Develop expertise in integrating inverters, energy meters, weather sensors, and other plant equipment using protocols such as Modbus RTU/TCP, RS485, Ethernet, and MQTT, as applicable.

·      Ensure reliable data acquisition, local buffering, time synchronization, remote configuration, and recovery during network or power outages.

·      Establish hardware validation, field testing, quality assurance, and lifecycle management processes.

**3. Cloud Platform and Software Development**

·      Lead the architecture and development of a centralized cloud-based solar monitoring platform.

·      Establish scalable infrastructure for collecting, processing, storing, and analyzing data from hundreds of geographically distributed solar installations.

·      Oversee the development of dashboards, plant-level monitoring screens, portfolio-level reporting, alerts, notifications, and automated performance reports.

·      Ensure integration with existing business systems, maintenance workflows, and third-party equipment where required.

·      Establish high availability, disaster recovery, backup, cybersecurity, and system performance standards.

**4. Solar Generation Monitoring and Analytics**

·      Develop real-time and historical solar generation monitoring capabilities.

·      Establish monitoring of energy generation, plant availability, equipment health, communication failures, and performance deviations.

·      Enable automated alerts for generation losses, inverter faults, abnormal operating conditions, and data gaps.

·      Support performance analysis through relevant metrics such as specific yield, Performance Ratio (PR), plant availability, and actual-versus-expected generation, where applicable.

**5. Intellectual Property and Technology Ownership**

·      Build and maintain Roofsol Energy’s proprietary technology stack, including hardware designs, firmware, software source code, system architecture, technical documentation, and associated IP.

·      Establish appropriate IP ownership, confidentiality, source-code control, licensing, and third-party technology compliance practices.

**6. Team Leadership and Vendor Management**

·      Build and lead a multidisciplinary team covering embedded systems, electronics, firmware, IoT, cloud engineering, software development, and data analytics.

·      Evaluate and manage technology vendors, hardware manufacturers, system integrators, and development partners.

**Candidate Profile**

·      Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics & Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, IoT, or a related technical discipline.

·      Approximately 10 years of relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, industrial data acquisition, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, or related technology domains.

·      Demonstrated experience in developing and deploying connected hardware and software products, preferably from concept through production and field deployment.

·      Experience with cloud infrastructure, databases, APIs, cybersecurity, remote device management, and scalable system architecture.

·      Knowledge of solar PV systems, inverter communications, energy meters, generation monitoring, and renewable energy analytics will be highly advantageous.

**Why Join Roofsol Energy?**

This is an opportunity to establish a proprietary technology platform from the ground up and take ownership of a strategic digital initiative within the renewable energy sector. The selected professional will have the opportunity to shape the company’s technology roadmap, develop in-house IP, and build a scalable monitoring ecosystem supporting a growing portfolio of solar assets across India.

**Interested candidates may share their updated CV highlighting relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, and technology ownership.**

title: Active Directory Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Cyberaube is a cybersecurity services company based in Nagpur and Pune that focuses on practical, vendor-neutral solutions instead of product reselling. The team brings over a decade of hands-on experience with leading security platforms such as QRadar, Splunk, CyberArk, Okta, and Guardium, helping clients avoid costly implementation mistakes. Cyberaube supports organizations with security talent placement, SIEM and IAM operations, data protection, and compliance with India’s DPDP Act and SEBI requirements. The company works with a diverse range of clients, including banks, hospitals, e-commerce firms, government bodies, and SaaS startups across India and beyond.

**Role Description**

* Senior Active Directory Engineer (L3) – Multi-Forest Enterprise
* Location: Pune or Nagpur (WFO)
* Experience: 7+ years
* Notice: Immediate–30 days preferred

**About the role**

We are looking for an L3 Active Directory engineer who owns the directory, not just the tickets in it. You will be the final technical escalation point for a large, multi-forest, multi-domain, multi-site Active Directory estate. When replication breaks, SYSVOL drifts or a DC fails, you read the repadmin and dcdiag output, find the root cause and fix it yourself.

**What will you do**

- Design, build and extend multi-domain and multi-forest AD: new domains, forest and external trusts, selective authentication, SID filtering and cross-forest DNS.

- Own replication health across a multi-site topology: sites, subnets, site links, costs, bridgeheads and KCC/ISTG behaviour.

- Diagnose and resolve deep replication failures: lingering objects, USN rollback, tombstone lifetime issues, and errors such as 8606, 8614, 8524 and 1722, using repadmin, dcdiag, ntdsutil and PowerShell.

- Support SYSVOL on DFSR: backlog analysis, dirty shutdown recovery, authoritative and non-authoritative restores, and FRS-to-DFSR migration where legacy domains remain.

- Manage the full DC lifecycle: promotion, demotion, forced removal, metadata cleanup, FSMO transfer and seizure, Global Catalog placement and OS upgrades.

- Run proactive DC health monitoring: define checks and alert thresholds, review Directory Service, DFS Replication and DNS logs, and act before users notice.

- Lead AD incident response for P1/P2 events and write the RCA and problem records that remove the cause, not just the symptom.

- Maintain AD backup and disaster recovery: system state backups, DSRM, and forest recovery planning and testing.

- Mentor L1/L2 engineers, write runbooks, and raise and execute change requests to ITIL standards.

**What you must have:**

- 7+ years in Windows infrastructure, including 5+ years of hands-on L3 Active Directory engineering in a large enterprise.

- Production experience in multi-forest and multi-domain environments, including setting up and troubleshooting trusts.

- Command-line fluency with repadmin, dcdiag, ntdsutil, dfsrdiag, nltest, setspn and the PowerShell ActiveDirectory module.

- A track record of resolving replication and SYSVOL/DFSR failures yourself, not escalating them.

- Experience leading AD incidents end to end, including writing the root cause analysis.

- An active Microsoft certification: Windows Server Administrator Associate (AZ-802), Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate (AZ-800 + AZ-801), or legacy MCSA/MCSE: Windows Server.

**Good to have:**

- AD CS / PKI, ADFS, Entra Connect in a multi-forest topology

- AD security hardening: tiered administration, LAPS, Kerberos/NTLM hardening, privileged group control

- Domain migrations or consolidations with ADMT or Quest

- PowerShell automation for health reporting and remediation

**THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF...**

Your Active Directory experience is mainly user and group administration, password resets and lockouts, SSO/Okta onboarding, or Entra ID and Conditional Access. Those are valuable skills, but this role is about the infrastructure underneath: domain controllers, replication, SYSVOL, trusts and forest design.

**About Position**
The ITSM Process Consultant is responsible for designing, assessing, improving, and governing IT service management processes that support reliable, efficient, and business-aligned service delivery. This role works closely with IT leadership, service owners, support teams, platform administrators, and business stakeholders to define process standards, drive ITIL-aligned practices, improve operational performance, and enable continual service improvement
  
  

* Role: ITSM Process and Reporting Consultant
* Location: All Persistent Location
* Experience: 10+ Years
* Job Type: Full-Time Employment

**What You'll Do**

* Lead the design, review, and optimization of ITSM processes aligned with business objectives, service delivery goals, and ITIL best practices.
* Assess current-state service management processes, identify gaps, inefficiencies, control weaknesses, and improvement opportunities, and define future-state process models.
* Develop and maintain process documentation including policies, procedures, workflows, process maps, RACI matrices, work instructions, and governance standards.
* Drive implementation and continuous improvement of core ITSM processes such as Incident, Problem, Change Enablement, Service Request, Service Catalog, Knowledge Management, Release Management, Configuration Management, and Asset Management.
* Lead and support solutioning activities for RFPs, solution defense, and large-scale transition and transformation programs.
* Partner closely with Presales and Sales teams to support both new and existing business opportunities.

* Establish and monitor KPIs, SLAs, OLAs, and process health metrics such as incident backlog, first-call resolution, mean time to restore service, change success rate, request fulfillment cycle time, and problem resolution effectiveness.
* Analyze performance trends, recurring incidents, service bottlenecks, and customer pain points, and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Facilitate workshops, stakeholder interviews, and process walkthroughs to gather requirements, validate operating models, and build alignment across technical and business teams.
* Support organizational change management by preparing communications, training materials, knowledge articles, and adoption plans for new or revised ITSM processes.
* Ensure ITSM processes align with enterprise governance, risk, security, and compliance requirements, including internal controls and relevant standards such as ITIL and ISO/IEC 20000 where applicable.
* Participate in service transition activities to ensure new or changed services are supported by clear operational processes, service support models, and ownership structures.
* Provide expert guidance on process integration points across service desk, infrastructure, application support, operations, vendor management, and business relationship management functions.
* Promote standardization, automation, and simplification of service management processes to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and service reliability.
* Prepare executive and operational reports that communicate process maturity, performance trends, risks, and improvement progress to leadership and stakeholders.

**Expertise You'll Bring**

* Deep understanding of ITSM process design, governance, and continual service improvement.
* Strong consulting mindset with the ability to influence stakeholders and drive process adoption.
* Excellent facilitation, workshop management, and requirements elicitation skills.
* Strong documentation skills, including the creation of SOPs, process maps, operating procedures, and governance artifacts.
* Ability to balance standardization with practical business and operational needs.
* Data-driven decision-making skills with the ability to interpret performance metrics and recommend targeted improvements.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and priorities.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across geographically distributed teams.
* Strong customer-service orientation and commitment to service quality and user experience.

title: Junior Site Inspection Engineer (Valuations)
description: Role: Junior- Site Inspection Engineer (VALUATION)About the company: We are a premier valuation, techno-economic advisory, and engineering consultancy firm led by IBBI Registered Valuers bringing over 45 years (Estb. 1982) of deep industry and field experience. The organization holds empanelment with leading public sector and co-operative banks, including State Bank of India (SBI), Bank of Maharashtra, and Cosmos Bank, while also serving prominent corporate institutions, insurance providers, and private clients.Our professional practice spans comprehensive immovable property valuations, Lender's Independent Engineer (LIE) project monitoring, and Techno-Economic Viability (TEV) studies across Maharashtra and neighboring regions. We pride ourselves on uncompromising technical rigor, integrity, and providing reliable, grounded data that financial institutions trust for critical credit and risk decisions.Position OverviewThe Site Inspection Engineer functions as our essential eyes and ears on the ground. Operating as a critical link between physical reality and formal financial reporting, the professional in this role visits residential, commercial, industrial, and agricultural properties to rigorously verify on-site conditions against legal and sanctioned documentation.The primary mission is to gather precise measurements, document construction progress, verify physical boundaries, capture compliant photographic evidence, and deliver complete, high-integrity field data that our technical desk and valuation report teams can rely on without ambiguity.Role Summary & Work ParametersPosition Title: Junior - Site Inspection Engineer (Valuation) Experience: upto 2 yearsDepartment: Field Valuation & Technical Due Diligence Location: Pune (Head Office), with regular travel across Pune district, Maharashtra, and occasional outstation visits as project assignments demand. Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent Reporting To: Senior Site Engineer / Director Working Schedule: Monday to Saturday | 10:00 AM – 6:30 PM Field Travel: Daily local site travel is required; a personal two-wheeler is essential. Key Responsibilities & Core Duties Physical Inspections & Property VerificationConduct independent, on-ground inspections of diverse asset classes including residential apartments, independent bungalows, commercial spaces, industrial plots/sheds, and agricultural parcels for bank loan underwriting, NPA/SARFAESI proceedings, insurance assessments, and private advisory. Verify physical property identification and demarcated boundaries on-site against primary documents such as Title Deeds, 7/12 extracts, Mutation Entries, City Survey (CTS) cards, Gat/Survey numbers, and municipal/Gram Panchayat layouts. Examine primary access routes, road widths, neighborhood profiles, and surrounding infrastructure connecting to the subject property. Dimensional Audits & Construction VerificationTake accurate on-site measurements of land plots, carpet areas, built-up areas, and super built-up spaces using measuring tapes and digital laser meters. Thoroughly cross-reference actual physical structures against municipal/sanctioned drawings, carefully identifying and documenting any structural deviations, illegal constructions, unauthorized floor additions, or floor space index (FSI) violations. Evaluate structural specifications, including building type (RCC frame, load-bearing, steel structure), estimated age of property, overall maintenance and upkeep, quality of finishes, utilities, amenities, and current stage of construction for ongoing projects. Photographic Documentation & ComplianceCapture comprehensive, high-resolution photographs in strict adherence to banking compliance guidelines, ensuring every photo is properly geo-tagged, time-stamped, and clearly framed. Cover all critical angles including front and rear elevations, side setbacks, approach roads, internal rooms, fixtures, structural defects, and photographs with the occupant or owner present where mandated by institution protocols. Local Market Evidence & Field IntelligenceCarry out primary ground-level market checks by consulting local real estate brokers, adjacent shopkeepers, neighborhood residents, and building maintenance offices to assess prevailing square-foot sale and rental rates. Identify recent genuine property transactions and local market trends to supply corroborated pricing benchmarks for the valuation report drafting desk. Lender's Independent Engineer (LIE) SupportAssist senior valuation engineers during periodic LIE and project monitoring assignments for infrastructure and commercial ventures. Record visual physical milestones, observe construction progress against approved project bar charts, inspect raw material stockpiles on site, and capture progress imagery for institutional lenders. Workflow Efficiency & Risk EscalationCompile all field measurements, sketches, checklists, and geo-tagged images into standard formats and submit them on the exact same day of the inspection visit to eliminate reporting delays. Immediately escalate high-risk field observations ("red flags") directly to the Director, including active boundary disputes, apparent encroachments, structural distress, locked/inaccessible units, occupant-borrower mismatches, or municipal demolition warnings. Collaborate closely with the drafting and valuation analytical team, promptly clarifying technical site queries. Candidate Qualifications & SkillsEducational Background & Technical CapabilitiesDiploma or Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or any graduate degree with an aptitude and demonstrated interest in real estate and property valuation. Working knowledge of reading and interpreting civil blueprints, architectural floor plans, sanctioned drawings, and land revenue records (7/12 extracts, property cards, and village maps). Basic competency in taking physical site measurements, calculating carpet vs. built-up areas, and preparing rough dimensional sketches on paper or digital tablets. Tools & EquipmentValid permanent two-wheeler driving licence and an owned, reliable two-wheeler in roadworthy condition. An active, updated smartphone featuring a quality camera, GPS/geo-tagging capability, and standard messaging/data applications. Prior familiarity with laser distance meters, Google Earth Pro, and mobile GPS stamping applications is highly advantageous. Interpersonal & Language SkillsStrong communication skills with practical fluency in Marathi, Hindi, and working English to comfortably interact with property owners, bank officials, local brokers, and internal office teams. Keen observational awareness, thoroughness in note-taking, and high ethical standards with zero tolerance for compromised or inaccurate field reporting. Good physical fitness and readiness for everyday field mobility across different parts of the city and surrounding districts. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)Daily Site Visit Volume: Conduct 2 to 3 detailed local inspections per working day across designated geographical clusters without compromising verification quality. Field Data Turnaround: Achieve 100% same-day submission of completed checklists, raw measurements, and geo-tagged photographs following the site visit. Data Reliability & Accuracy: Maintain an inspection accuracy rate exceeding 99%, ensuring zero discrepancies between reported site findings and formal plan documents. Proactive Escalation: Escalate 100% of discovered discrepancies, land title mismatches, or boundary issues on the day of inspection prior to report generation. Professional Benefits & Organizational SupportField Reimbursements: Comprehensive conveyance and fuel expense reimbursements for all official property inspections and field travel. Operational Allowances: Dedicated monthly mobile and data allowance to facilitate seamless communication and field data transfer. Structured Professional Mentorship: Direct, hands-on training and guidance in national valuation standards, SARFAESI valuation principles, and technical auditing under the direct mentorship of seasoned IBBI Registered Valuers. Skills: valuation,structural,reporting,construction,measurements,project,travel,data

title: SAP PM CS

with
**5 to 12 years**
of expertise across SAP Customer Service (CS), Service Management (SM), and S/4HANA Service.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, and implementing end-to-end Service Management processes in an
**SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition (PCE) / RISE with SAP**
environment. You will bridge business requirements and functional architecture, manage cloud service governance, enable AI-driven service insights, and drive continuous optimization across the full service lifecycle.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Implementation
* Design, configure, and deploy S/4HANA Service Management processes across the entire service lifecycle: Engage, Sell, Contract, Plan, Schedule, Execute, Invoice, and Analyze.
* Map end-to-end business requirements to standard S/4HANA Service capabilities, including service quotations, service orders, service contracts, spare parts logistics, resource planning, billing, and analytics.
* Drive adoption of the latest S/4HANA PCE release innovations (e.g., service team determination, advanced execution processes, Fiori applications, and AI-powered service intelligence).
* S/4HANA Private Edition (PCE) Governance
* Operate effectively within the SAP S/4HANA PCE Shared Responsibility Model between the client and SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS).
* Liaise with SAP for system-level operational tasks (e.g., infrastructure management, backups, maintenance, and upgrade administration).
* Lead client-side functional responsibilities, including business process configuration, functional validation, regression testing, and process governance based on SAP’s PCE Roles and Responsibilities framework.
* Service Order & Contract Management
* Configure and maintain service contract structures, recurring service billing plans, and auto-renewal mechanisms.
* Enable flexible billing scenarios, including Resource-Related Billing (RRB), Time & Material (T&M), and Fixed-Price billing models.
* Leverage modern platform features such as service contract template cloning and mass contract change capabilities.
* Service Planning, Execution & Logistics Integration
* Set up and optimize workforce planning, resource allocation, dispatching, and field service workflows.
* Configure plant and storage location parameters within service transactions to support multi-plant and multi-location service execution.
* Direct cross-module functional integration between service transactions and procurement (MM), inventory management, shipping, plant maintenance (PM), and follow-on financial postings.
* Data Migration, Testing & Integration
* Oversee data preparation, cleansing, transformation, and validation for service master data, active service contracts, and open service orders.
* Utilize the SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and standard transition tools tailored for service artifacts.
* Coordinate functional and technical integrations across CRM, SAP Field Service Management (FSM), SAP CS, core logistics, and Finance (FI/CO).
* AI, Analytics & Continuous Process Improvement

title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer
description:

The
**Lead Forward Deployed Engineer**
operates at the intersection of engineering, data, and customer deployment. In this hands-on, customer-facing role, you will lead complex enterprise onboardings to integrate, transform, and operationalize cybersecurity data into Qualys’ Enterprise TruRisk Management (ETM) platform. You will translate fragmented security environments into a unified risk model while bridging the gap between customer needs and core product engineering.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Customer Onboarding & Data Integration
  
  

* Strategic Execution: Lead end-to-end enterprise onboarding from strategy to production rollout, serving as the system of record for customer assets, findings, and business context.

* Data Modeling & Correlation: Design custom mapping, transformation, tagging, and asset criticality scoring; implement de-duplication and correlation logic across heterogeneous security feeds.

Data Quality & Validation
  
  

* Data Integrity: Establish scalable validation frameworks to audit and maintain asset/findings accuracy for confident risk decision-making.
* Issue Resolution: Execute controlled reprocessing and configuration adjustments to fix data quality issues without disrupting operational metrics.

Dashboards, Remediation & Workflows
  
  

* Analytics & Modeling: Build customized dashboards, trend visualizations, and risk scoring models, including complex "toxic risk combination" scenarios.
* Workflow Automation: Integrate ETM with ticketing/remediation tools (Jira, ServiceNow) and configure automated alerts, escalations, and ownership mapping.
* Executive Reporting: Develop custom reports/utilities using public APIs for board-level, operational, and regulatory audiences.

Product & Engineering Feedback Loop
  
  

* Roadmap Influence: Translate field deployment challenges and recurring integration gaps into technical requirements for product and core engineering teams.
* Customer Maturity: Guide enterprises from initial risk visibility to automated, remediation-driven action.

Required Qualifications:
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience: 8–10 years in data engineering, platform engineering, or customer-facing technical roles.
* Technical Stack:
* Strong programming proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages.
* Deep experience with REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous systems, and scalable ingestion pipelines (ETL/ELT).
* Hands-on knowledge of relational, NoSQL, search, or graph databases.
* Domain & Data Expertise:
* Strong foundation in data modeling, normalization, transformation, and correlation.
* Solid understanding of core cybersecurity domains (VM, Cloud Security, IAM, Risk Frameworks).
* Hands-on application of AI or automation to optimize data pipelines and onboarding workflows.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional client-facing, communication, and technical consultation skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Background in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Professional Services.
* Familiarity with large-scale, distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Proven ability to thrive in high-impact, fast-paced, and ambiguous production environments.

title: Integration Analyst
description:
**Who We Are:**
Since 1906, New Balance has empowered people through sport and craftsmanship to create positive change in communities around the world. We innovate fearlessly, guided by our core values and driven by the belief that conventions were meant to be challenged. We foster a culture in which every associate feels welcomed and respected, where leaders and creatives are inspired to shape the world of tomorrow by taking bold action today.
  
  
**Integrations Analyst**
*The largest and most impactful transformation in our 100+ year history is currently underway at New Balance. We have started a digital revolution, investing in exciting new capabilities for both our customers and associates. One of our primary initiatives is the reimagining of our global integration platforms that will unite our core business processes, aligning the demands of our channel sales with the real-time status of our supply chain. By unlocking new support functionality and consumer insights, this platform will allow us to anticipate and better serve the needs of our customers. We’re seeking agile thinkers who can quickly adapt in a collaborative, high-performance culture. Are you ready to join the revolution?*
**General Summary:**
As a Configuration Analyst for integrations, you will build, configure, and maintain EDI and non-EDI integration solutions on the Partner LINQ platform, contributing to New Balance’s global digital transformation. You will play a central role in migrating legacy IBM Sterling EDI and Cleo Harmony MFT integrations onto Partner LINQ — configuring mappings, orchestration flows, and business rules — helping drive New Balance to be a Top 3 Global Athletic Brand through responsive, standardized integration workflows that support consistent business growth, expand market share, and strengthen brand equity and reputation
  
  
**MAJOR ACCOUNTABILTIES:**

* Create and configure mappings, process/orchestration flows, business rules, cross-reference schemas, and lookups within the PartnerLinQ Design Studio to meet business requirements.
* Convert existing IBM Sterling maps and Cleo MFT flows to PartnerLinQ, leveraging AI Mapping Agent / template-based tooling to standardize and optimize designs for reuse.
* Perform unit testing on all integrations, coordinate with end-system teams, and support SIT and UAT cycles, producing test result reports against production sample files.
* Manage controlled promotion of tested configurations (mappings, alerts, dashboards, partnerships) from lower to production environments, validating dependencies and completeness before migration.
* Support white-glove partner onboarding: gather EDI specifications, IDs, and connection details; build mapping templates; run connection and business-rule testing.
* Support production deployments and provide post-go-live hypercare, troubleshooting transaction and mapping issues and creating SOPs / runbooks.
* Follow approved integration governance patterns, intake, documentation standards, and SLA checkpoints for all net-new and migrated integrations.

**REQUIREMENTS FOR SUCCESS:**
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience). 3 to 5 years of Hands-on experience configuring EDI/B2B integrations, ideally on PartnerLinQ or a comparable platform (IBM Sterling, Cleo), preferred.
  
  

* Working knowledge of EDI standards — X12, EDIFACT/EANCOM — and common transaction sets (850, 855, 856, 810, 820, 846)
* Mapping to/from canonical and flat-file formats
* Data transformation using XML, JSON, flat files, and XSLT
* Target systems such as D365 F&O, SAP, SQL
* Transport protocols — AS2, SFTP, API/VAN
* PartnerLinQ Business Rule Engine, Cross Reference Schema, and Artifacts Migration (plus)
* Azure Integration Services (AIS) exposure (plus)
* Git / Azure DevOps (plus)
* Sterling→PLQ or Cleo→PLQ/AIS migration experience (nice to have)
* Solid analytical, documentation, and troubleshooting skills; ability to translate business requirements into detailed configurations. Good communication, critical thinking, and collaboration skills.

title: Cloud Support Engineer, AI/ML (Night Shift)
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
  
  
**Cloud Support Engineer — AI/ML & Programmability (Night Shift)**
**Location:**
Pune, India
  
  
Snowflake's Support team is expanding. We're looking for a Cloud Support Engineer who enjoys working with data and solving a wide variety of problems, drawing on hands-on experience across operating systems, database technologies, big data, data integration, connectors, and networking.
  
  
Our mission is to make Snowflake the preferred platform for running all AI, ML, data science, and data engineering workloads. You'll join a highly productive, fast-moving team supporting Snowflake Cortex and our ML product lines — work that is central to delivering on Snowflake's AI Data Cloud mission.
  
  
Snowflake Support is committed to providing high-quality resolutions that help customers deliver data-driven business insights and results. We are a team of subject matter experts working collectively toward our customers' success, building partnerships by listening, learning, and connecting.
  
  
Snowflake's values shape how we deliver world-class Support: putting customers first, acting with integrity, owning initiative and accountability, and getting it done.
  
  
As a Cloud Support Engineer, you'll be the technical partner our customers turn to for guidance on using Snowflake effectively. You'll also be the voice of the customer to our product and engineering teams, surfacing feedback and improvements. Beyond individual cases, you'll help build knowledge across the team and contribute to strategic initiatives that improve how we work.
  
  
Depending on business needs, you may be assigned to one or more Snowflake Priority Support customers. In that capacity you'll develop deep familiarity with their use case and how they use the platform, delivering the service that enables them to get the highest levels of continuity and performance from their Snowflake implementation.
  
  
**AS A CLOUD SUPPORT ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:**

* Drive technical solutions to complex problems, providing in-depth analysis and guidance to Snowflake customers and partners via email, web, and phone
* Adhere to response and resolution SLAs and escalation processes to ensure fast resolution of customer issues
* Investigate issues using the Snowflake environment, connectors, third-party partner software, and internal tools
* Troubleshoot customer use cases built on Snowflake's Cortex and ML stack, working across Python runtimes and relevant ML libraries
* Investigate, evaluate, and compare Large Language Models to help customers get maximum value from Snowflake's AI capabilities
* Work with customers to resolve programmability-related issues, including DevOps and Kubernetes
* Document known solutions to our internal and external knowledge bases
* Report well-documented bugs and feature requests arising from customer submissions
* Partner with engineering teams to prioritise and resolve customer requests
* Participate in a range of Support initiatives
* Provide support coverage during holidays and weekends based on business needs

**OUR IDEAL CLOUD SUPPORT ENGINEER WILL HAVE:**

* 2+ years of experience in a technical support environment or a similar technical, customer-facing function
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with strong attention to detail
* In-depth knowledge of at least one major cloud provider's ecosystem
* Working knowledge of Python and relevant ML libraries
* An intermediate understanding of LLMs and their enterprise applications
* Understanding of software development principles, including object-oriented programming and version control (Git, GitHub, GitLab)
* Understanding of RESTful APIs and web services
* Familiarity with MLOps practices and tools

**NICE TO HAVE:**

* Experience in a 24x7 support environment, including technical case escalation, incident management, and on-call rotations
* Background supporting an RDBMS, and familiarity with database release management
* Understanding of machine learning foundations — neural networks, statistics, and optimisation — and of optimising model performance, scalability, and efficiency
* Production experience with frameworks such as Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras
* Working experience with Jupyter Notebooks
* Experience with development tools and IDEs (Visual Studio Code, Eclipse, IntelliJ IDEA)
* Experience with API tooling such as Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman, and API Gateway
* Experience with data visualisation tools — Tableau, Power BI, matplotlib, seaborn, or Plotly
* Understanding of big data technologies such as Hadoop or Spark
* Understanding of event-driven architectures and microservices
* Knowledge of authentication and authorisation protocols such as OAuth and JWT

**SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* This role works the 4th / night shift, typically starting at 10:00 PM IST
* Participation in pager duty rotations during nights, weekends, and holidays
* Applicants should be flexible with schedule changes to meet business needs

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
  
  
How do you want to make your impact?

* Role: Enterprise IT - Director, EGM Digital Marketing & India, SEA, Japan
* Reporting to: Vaidyanath Subbaraman
* Region: Asia
* Pay grade: Gr 6 / PG 40

Configures, localizes and operates global MarTech platforms for segment-specific campaign execution and consumer engagement to meet the segment's commercial and marketing objectives
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Translate segment B2B/B2C commercial and marketing priorities into technology requirements and delivery commitments
* Localize global MarTech capabilities for segment-specific needs (e.g., campaign workflows, compliance requirements, engagement tooling)
* Own segment digital marketing platform operations, ensuring availability, incident response, and service levels meet the segment's campaign calendar and commercial cadence
* Configure and operate global MarTech platforms provided by Consumer Growth Tech (e.g., web, social, mobile, loyalty) for segment-specific campaign execution and consumer engagement programs
* Represent segment-specific requirements to CGT Head of Digital Marketing Technology, ensuring the global platform roadmap accounts for segment use cases and local market constraints
* Develop segment digital marketing technology business cases, forecasting inputs, and adoption plans to inform CGT investment prioritization
* Govern segment-level data flows between MarTech platforms and segment consumer data sources, ensuring campaign targeting, measurement, and personalization inputs are accurate and compliant with local data privacy requirements and enterprise security and data protection protocols

**To succeed in this role, you will need the following qualifications:**

* Experience deploying and operating digital marketing technology at segment or regional level within a CPG or consumer-facing organization
* Understanding of how global MarTech platforms are configured and operated at segment level to enable end-to-end marketing execution
* Ability to operate in a matrixed structure, balancing segment-specific commercial priorities with enterprise platform standards
* Familiarity with segment market regulatory and data privacy requirements that shape how marketing technology is operated in the region
* Financial fluency in P&L dynamics, business case development, and OKR/KPIs

**Key Measure of Success**

* Campaign technology readiness — % of planned segment marketing campaigns technically enabled on schedule against the segment marketing calendar
* Segment demand fulfillment — % of segment marketing technology requests delivered against committed intake within agreed timeframes
* Segment marketing platform availability — uptime % and P1/P2 incident count across segment-facing digital marketing platforms

Please note: at this time Kenvue / KC will not be supporting candidates through a Immigration / Green Card / Permanent Residency process.
  
  
Company sponsored relocation is not provided. All interested candidates who are outside of the role’s location options must self-relocate if interested in the role.

title: Creative Marketing Specialist
description:
**Company:**
MailEasy

**Location:**
Pune, Maharashtra

**Work Mode:**
Work from Office

**Role Type:**
Internship with Full-Time Conversion Opportunity

**Full-Time CTC on Conversion:**
₹4–6 LPA

About MailEasy

MailEasy is an AI-powered productivity platform focused on simplifying and automating email workflows, CRM processes, and business communication. We build intelligent solutions that help businesses streamline operations, improve customer engagement, and grow more efficiently.

We’re looking for a
**Creative Marketing Strategist Intern**
with exceptional communication skills, a creative mindset, and a strong interest in marketing, branding, and business growth. This role is ideal for someone who can think strategically, communicate persuasively, generate innovative ideas, and turn those ideas into impactful marketing initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Marketing Strategy & Growth**

* Develop creative marketing strategies to build brand awareness and generate leads.
* Identify new opportunities to reach target audiences and potential customers.
* Experiment with different marketing channels, campaigns, and growth strategies.
* Help position MailEasy effectively in the AI and SaaS market.

**2. Content Creation & Storytelling**

* Create engaging content for LinkedIn, social media, blogs, and other marketing channels.
* Write compelling marketing copy, campaign messages, product descriptions, and promotional content.
* Develop creative storytelling approaches to communicate MailEasy’s value proposition.
* Translate complex AI and technology concepts into clear, engaging messages.

**3. Brand Building & Positioning**

* Help establish and strengthen MailEasy’s brand identity and market presence.
* Develop innovative ideas for brand awareness and audience engagement.
* Maintain consistency in brand voice, messaging, and communication.
* Research competitors and identify opportunities to differentiate MailEasy.

**4. Campaign Planning & Execution**

* Plan and execute marketing campaigns across relevant channels.
* Brainstorm and implement creative marketing initiatives.
* Collaborate with the team to launch campaigns, test ideas, and improve results.
* Take ownership of projects from ideation to execution.

**5. Market Research & Customer Understanding**

* Research industry trends, competitors, target markets, and customer needs.
* Identify potential customer segments and new marketing opportunities.
* Understand customer pain points and translate insights into effective messaging.
* Support the development of go-to-market strategies for MailEasy’s products.

**6. Performance Tracking & Optimization**

* Monitor campaign performance and audience engagement.
* Analyze results and identify areas for improvement.
* Use data and customer feedback to refine marketing strategies.
* Continuously experiment with new ideas to improve marketing effectiveness.

Mandatory Requirement: Exceptional Communication Skills

**Strong communication skills are a non-negotiable requirement for this role.**

**We are looking for someone who can communicate with clarity, confidence, and conviction.**

* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Ability to articulate ideas clearly, confidently, and persuasively.
* Strong presentation, storytelling, and professional communication skills.
* Confidence in pitching ideas, explaining strategies, and engaging in discussions.
* Ability to write compelling content that captures attention and communicates value.
* Comfort communicating with clients, stakeholders, and team members.
* A proactive personality with the confidence to express opinions, ask questions, and contribute ideas.

Candidates should be able to explain their thought process, present ideas convincingly, and communicate professionally in real-world business situations.

Who Should Apply?

* Students, recent graduates, and aspiring marketing professionals with an interest in marketing, branding, and growth.
* Creative thinkers who enjoy brainstorming and solving business problems.
* Individuals with strong communication, writing, and presentation skills.
* People who understand social media platforms, particularly LinkedIn.
* Self-driven individuals who can take initiative and work independently.
* Candidates interested in AI, SaaS, startups, technology, and digital marketing.
* Individuals who are comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.

Knowledge of digital marketing, SEO, growth marketing, content strategy, design tools, or AI-powered productivity tools is an advantage, but not mandatory.

**We value creativity, communication, initiative, and execution more than certificates.**

Internship & Full-Time Conversion

* **Initial position:**
  Creative Marketing Strategist Intern.
* **Location:**
  Pune, Maharashtra.
* **Work arrangement:**
  Full-time, work from office.
* **Full-time conversion:**
  High-performing interns may be considered for a full-time position based on performance and business requirements.
* **Full-time compensation:**
  ₹4–6 LPA upon conversion.

Interns will get hands-on exposure to real marketing challenges, opportunities to lead initiatives, and the chance to contribute directly to MailEasy’s growth.

title: Field Associate
description:
**Company Description**
SpotlightCreatives is a New Delhi–based political and digital campaign management company that integrates offline and online strategies to deliver measurable results. The organization designs engagement-focused digital media campaigns that resonate with diverse audiences, influence opinions, and build long-term trust. With a team of over 50 experienced professionals, SpotlightCreatives is known for its creativity, professionalism, and consistent record of successful campaigns. Since its founding in 2020, the company has grown from a digital marketing solutions provider into a specialist in political and electoral campaign management, leveraging data-driven insights and deep knowledge of India’s political landscape. Its campaigns have contributed to momentum in major elections, including Assembly, Parliamentary, and Municipal Corporation elections, achieving outcomes that meet and exceed client expectations.
  
**Role Description**
The Field Associate is a full-time, on-site role based in Western Up, supporting political and digital campaigns through structured fieldwork and coordinated on-the-ground activities. This role involves collecting and verifying field data, engaging with local stakeholders, and documenting grassroots insights that inform campaign strategy and content. The Field Associate will support the planning and execution of events, outreach programs, and surveys, ensuring accurate reporting and timely feedback to the central campaign team. Day-to-day responsibilities include coordinating with internal teams, maintaining detailed records of field activities, monitoring campaign performance at the ground level, and providing clear, concise updates. The role requires high levels of professionalism, adaptability, and a strong commitment to delivering reliable information that strengthens overall campaign effectiveness.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong field operations skills, including data collection, survey administration, stakeholder engagement, and local outreach coordination.
* Candidates should possess organizational and planning skills, such as time management, event support, documentation, and follow-through on assigned tasks.
* Candidates should possess communication skills, including clear verbal and written communication, the ability to build rapport with diverse communities, and professional presentation of findings.
* Candidates should possess analytical and problem-solving skills, including basic data interpretation, situational awareness, and the ability to provide actionable feedback to campaign teams.
* Candidates should possess digital literacy skills, including familiarity with mobile apps, spreadsheets, and collaboration tools used for data entry, reporting, and coordination.
* Relevant qualifications may include a bachelor’s degree in social sciences, political science, marketing, communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in fieldwork or campaign environments.
* Additional beneficial attributes include an understanding of India’s political landscape, comfort working in fast-paced environments, willingness to travel within assigned regions, and the ability to work respectfully with people from varied backgrounds.

title: Senior Leadership Role – Energy Transition & Industry Transformation
description: 1. POSITION VACANT: Senior Leadership Role – Energy Transition & Industry Transformation, New Delhi2. ORGANISATION OVERVIEW:The organisation is a leading national institution in India’s industry and policy ecosystem, working at the intersection of business, public policy, knowledge and capability development. It works closely with business leaders, Government, academia, research institutions and international partners to promote industrial growth, competitiveness, innovation and sustainable economic development. With a long-standing presence in India’s economic and industrial landscape, the organisation contributes to shaping policy, strengthening industry capabilities and facilitating platforms for collaboration and knowledge exchange.Within this broader mandate, the organisation’s energy-transition portfolio spans clean energy, decarbonisation, energy efficiency, energy security, carbon markets, green fuels, transition finance, emerging technologies, research, knowledge exchange and industry capability development.3. JOB DESCRIPTION/ RESPONSIBILITIES:The senior leader will provide strategic leadership to a major national energy-transition portfolio, helping energy companies and energy-intensive industries respond to the policy, regulatory, technology, investment and competitiveness challenges created by a rapidly changing energy landscape. The role requires a grounded understanding of industry and the ability to translate transition needs into practical interventions across policy, technology adoption, investment readiness, knowledge, partnerships and sector capability.The ideal candidate will be a grounded, highly credible energy-transition leader who understands industry realities, is trusted by senior business and Government stakeholders, can engage regulators and financial institutions constructively, and can convert transition challenges into practical solutions. The role also offers the opportunity to build and lead an overarching energy-transition knowledge, innovation and capability platform, with specialist or thematic initiatives developed in response to evolving industry priorities.The role is expected to cover the full energy-transition agenda.Key Responsibilities:(A) Industry Transition Readiness & Transformation:(1) Maintain a close understanding of the policy, regulatory, technology, investment and market challenges facing energy companies and energy-intensive industries and use these insights to shape the organisation’s priorities and interventions;(2) Design initiatives that help industry strengthen transition readiness, energy productivity, decarbonisation pathways, resilience and long-term competitiveness;(3) Accelerate industry awareness, evaluation and adoption of relevant clean-energy, efficiency, low-carbon and emerging technologies, financing approaches and business models;(4) Support enterprises in learning from leading national and international transition pathways and in navigating evolving standards, markets, regulations and investment requirements.(B) Policy Engagement & Government Advisory:(1) Set and lead the energy-transition policy agenda, identifying key policy, regulatory and market priorities shaping India’s energy transformation;(2) Engage at senior levels with Union Ministries, Government institutions, regulators and policy bodies on clean energy, decarbonisation, energy efficiency, energy security, carbon markets, green fuels, transition finance and related priorities;(3) Lead preparation of evidence-based policy recommendations, position papers, consultation responses and policy inputs to Government, grounded in research and stakeholder perspectives;(4) Anchor high-level dialogue between industry and Government on strategic energy-transition priorities and facilitate collaborative approaches to emerging challenges.(C) Energy Transition Knowledge, Innovation & Capability Platforms:(1) Lead the development and strategic direction of an overarching energy-transition platform dedicated to knowledge, innovation and capability-building, with flexibility to develop specialist or thematic initiatives under it based on emerging industry priorities;(2) Define the platform’s strategic focus, programme architecture, operating model, team and expert network, and position it as an authoritative national vehicle for industry-transition knowledge and capability;(3) Curate and disseminate national and international best practices, benchmarking, transition pathways, emerging technologies, innovations, financing models and new business approaches relevant to Indian industry;(4) Build partnerships with leading companies, technology providers, research institutions, academia, financial institutions and international centres of expertise to bring cutting-edge knowledge and solutions to industry;(5) Translate knowledge into action through pilots, capability-building, advisory initiatives, benchmarking, transition tools and other scalable interventions;(6) Build a sustainable portfolio of programmes, partnerships and revenue streams that secures the long-term institutional and financial viability of the platform and its initiatives.(D) Research, Insight & Thought Leadership:(1) Lead the energy-transition research and knowledge agenda, including sector studies, surveys, policy briefs, white papers and analyses on technology, markets, investment and implications for Indian industry;(2) Develop thought leadership on clean energy, decarbonisation, energy efficiency, green hydrogen, sustainable fuels, carbon markets, transition finance, energy security and other emerging themes;(3) Build research and knowledge partnerships with think tanks, academic institutions, technology organisations, financial institutions and international partners;(4) Position the organisation as an authoritative national voice on competitive, resilient and sustainable energy transition.(E) Industry Convening & Strategic Partnerships:(1) Conceptualise and lead flagship national and international convenings on energy transition, including leadership forums, conferences, summits and roundtables, and curate their agendas with business, Government, regulatory, technology and financial stakeholders;(2) Ensure high-quality programme management and execution of large-scale engagements, including coordination with stakeholders, speakers and partners;(3) Build strong, trusted relationships with energy companies, energy-intensive industries, technology providers, financial institutions, regulators and relevant sector organisations;(4) Facilitate structured consultations that convert sector perspectives into actionable policy, programme and knowledge priorities;(5) Build strategic partnerships with national and international institutions that strengthen the energy-transition agenda and facilitate knowledge, technology and investment exchange.(F) Team Leadership & Portfolio Delivery:(1) Steer senior industry advisory groups, expert forums, strategic projects and cross-functional initiatives with clear priorities, accountabilities and outcomes;(2) Guide internal teams in executing research, policy engagement, industry programmes, publications, consultations and flagship platforms, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery;(3) Build, lead and develop a high-performing, multi-disciplinary team with strong sector capability, accountability and execution discipline;(4) Strengthen the organisation’s institutional engagement with industry, Government, regulators and national/international partners.(G) Financial Leadership & Resource Mobilisation:(1) Share accountability with senior leadership for the financial performance and P&L of the energy-transition portfolio;(2) Develop and implement an annual revenue and resource-mobilisation plan aligned with portfolio priorities and emerging opportunities in the energy-transition ecosystem;(3) Build a diversified pipeline of programmes, projects, partnerships, research and knowledge initiatives that provides predictable, multi-year revenue visibility;(4) Prepare business cases, budgets and financial projections for significant initiatives, and oversee contribution margins, receivables, cost discipline and efficient use of resources;(5) Monitor financial performance closely, identify potential shortfalls early and initiate timely corrective action;(6) Balance financial sustainability with the quality, independence and credibility of policy, research and stakeholder-facing work.4. QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE AND COMPETENCIES:Qualifications:Master’s degree in Energy, Engineering, Economics, Public Policy or a related discipline from a reputed institution.Experience:(1) Minimum 20+ years of professional experience in energy, energy transition, industry, consulting, policy or related domains, with substantial senior leadership responsibility;(2) Senior leadership experience in industry, energy businesses, consulting, policy or knowledge institutions, or comparable organisations will be preferred;(3) Demonstrated depth of engagement with energy and/or energy-intensive industries and strong understanding of the commercial, regulatory, technology, investment and competitiveness challenges associated with the transition;(4) Proven experience engaging senior Government stakeholders, regulators, industry leaders, financial institutions and multi-stakeholder platforms;(5) Demonstrated ability to lead high-impact programmes, research/knowledge initiatives, industry platforms and large teams;(6) Experience building or scaling an institutional platform, business unit, centre, practice or comparable initiative will be strongly valued, particularly where it involved technology/innovation, knowledge partnerships and financial sustainability.Skills and Competencies:(1) Grounded sector judgement, strategic thinking, policy analysis and broad energy-transition perspective;(2) Government, regulatory and industry engagement;(3) CEO-level stakeholder management, convening and relationship building;(4) Thought leadership, research and knowledge development;(5) Institution building, technology/innovation orientation and global perspective;(6) Business development, financial acumen and resource mobilisation;(7) Strategic communication, influencing and public speaking;(8) Team leadership, development and performance management;(9) Collaboration, partnership building and execution orientation.5. The offer made to the selected candidate will be commensurate with qualifications, experience, and salary history.6. LOCATION: New DelhiThe role will involve regular travel, as required for industry engagement, stakeholder interactions and key programmes and initiatives.7. REFERENCE: SL-ET-CONF8. All applications and enquiries will be handled on a strictly confidential basis. The precise designation and identity of the hiring institution will be disclosed to selected candidates at an appropriate stage of the process.Application Link: https://www.samsstc.com/Jobs/job-description/senior-leadership-role-energy-transition-industry-transformation-confidential-new-delhi-delhi/861

FlyWings Simulator Training Centre Limited (FWSTC) is India’s most advanced aviation training institute, specializing in Safety and Emergency Procedures (SEP) for cabin and cockpit crew. Fitness Business Coaching India (FBCI) is a premium business coaching and consulting company that helps fitness coaches, nutritionists, and health professionals build, grow, and scale profitable online coaching businesses.

We help entrepreneurs improve their client acquisition, sales processes, marketing strategies, business positioning, and operational systems.

Our mentorship programs range from ₹90,000 to ₹5,00,000+.

As we expand, we're looking for a highly motivated and communication-driven
**Lead Qualification & Appointment Setting Specialist**
to join our sales team.

Important: This Is NOT a Traditional Telecalling Job

We are not hiring someone to simply make calls, read scripts, or fill our sales team's calendar.

**Your primary responsibility is to pre-qualify every incoming lead before they are connected with our sales department.**

You'll speak with fitness coaches and business owners, understand their current situation, identify their challenges, assess their investment readiness, and determine whether they're a suitable fit for our premium mentorship programs.

You must be someone who
**genuinely loves talking to people, enjoys understanding their problems, and is passionate about helping them find the right solutions.**

This role requires strong communication skills, business understanding, patience, persistence, and excellent follow-up discipline.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Lead Qualification**

* Contact incoming leads through phone calls and WhatsApp.
* Conduct structured pre-qualification conversations.
* Understand prospects' current monthly revenue, business challenges, goals, and growth expectations.
* Assess their financial readiness and ability to invest in premium mentorship programs.
* Identify serious prospects who are genuinely interested in growing their businesses.
* Ensure only qualified leads are forwarded to the sales department.

**2. Appointment Setting**

* Book strategy consultations with the sales team for qualified prospects.
* Clearly communicate the purpose and expectations of the consultation.
* Coordinate appointment timings and ensure proper scheduling.
* Confirm appointments and maximize show-up rates.

**3. Follow-Ups & Relationship Building**

* Conduct multiple follow-ups with prospects through calls and WhatsApp.
* Maintain consistent communication with interested leads.
* Re-engage prospects who haven't responded or booked their consultations.
* Build genuine relationships rather than using aggressive sales tactics.
* Ensure no qualified lead is neglected due to poor follow-up.

**4. CRM & Sales Coordination**

* Maintain accurate lead information and conversation notes in the CRM.
* Update lead statuses, qualification details, and follow-up schedules.
* Coordinate with the sales closers to ensure smooth handovers.
* Provide regular updates on lead quality, appointment bookings, and follow-up performance.

Who We're Looking For

* Someone who genuinely enjoys talking to people and building relationships.
* Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Strong listening, questioning, and interpersonal skills.
* Minimum 1 year of experience in appointment setting, inside sales, lead qualification, or a similar role.
* Comfortable making multiple calls and follow-ups daily.
* Ability to understand business problems and ask intelligent questions.
* Confident discussing revenue, business growth, and premium investments with entrepreneurs.
* Highly organized, self-motivated, disciplined, and target-oriented.
* Comfortable using CRM software, Google Sheets, and WhatsApp.
* Someone who takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions.

**Preferred:**
Experience in business coaching, consulting, premium mentorship, digital marketing agencies, or high-ticket service businesses.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Your performance will be measured by:

* Lead response time
* Number of leads contacted and qualified
* Qualified appointments booked
* Appointment show-up rate
* Follow-up completion rate
* Quality of appointments passed to the sales team
* CRM accuracy and lead management
* Contribution to overall sales conversions

**We value qualified appointments over the total number of appointments booked.**

Who Should NOT Apply

* Someone looking for a basic telecalling or scripted calling job.
* Someone who dislikes speaking with people or making follow-up calls.
* Candidates who book appointments without understanding the prospect's needs.
* Individuals who give up after one or two unsuccessful contact attempts.
* Someone who prioritizes quantity over quality.
* Candidates who are uncomfortable with accountability and performance targets.

What We Offer

* Fixed salary with performance-based incentives.
* Inbound leads generated through our marketing campaigns.
* Opportunity to work directly with fitness entrepreneurs and business owners.
* Training in business consultation, qualification, and premium sales processes.
* A performance-driven and growth-focused working environment.
* Career growth opportunities in Sales Operations, Senior Appointment Setting, and Sales Leadership.

How to Apply

Please submit your updated resume along with answers to these questions:

1. How much experience do you have in lead qualification or appointment setting?
2. How many leads or calls have you handled daily in your previous role?
3. Have you worked with high-ticket services or premium coaching programs?
4. How do you handle prospects who don't respond after multiple follow-ups?
5. Why do you believe you're a good fit for this role?

Our Hiring Philosophy

**We don't need someone who just makes 100 calls a day.**

We need someone who can turn meaningful conversations into qualified business opportunities.

Someone who listens carefully, asks the right questions, follows up consistently, and genuinely enjoys helping people.

**At FBCI, your success is not measured by how many appointments you book, but by how many of the right prospects you bring to our sales team.**

If you're a people person who loves conversations, takes ownership, and thrives in a performance-driven environment, we'd love to hear from you.

* **Apply now and become part of Fitness Business Coaching India (FBCI).**
