title: Project Director, Preconception Nutrition & Care, India
description:
**Employment Type:**
Project, Full Time
  
  
**Title:**
Project Director, Preconception Nutrition & Care, India
  
  
**Location:**
New Delhi, India
  
  
**Deadline for submission:**
October 31, 2025 (Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis and the position may be closed once a suitable candidate is identified.)
  
  
**About Us**
Nutrition International (NI) is a global organization dedicated to delivering proven nutrition interventions to those who need them most. Working in partnership with countries, donors, and implementers, our experts conduct cutting-edge nutrition research, support critical policy formulation, and integrate nutrition into a broader development agenda. For more than 30 years now, we have focused on delivering low-cost, high-impact, nutrition interventions to people in need, driven by our mission to achieve a world where everyone, everywhere, is free from malnutrition and able to reach their full potential. Our work is guided by a dedicated and talented team of experts working globally, regionally and within countries to end malnutrition worldwide.
  
  
If you are a motivated and passionate individual who shares our conviction that a better world is possible through improved nutrition, wants to leave the world a little better than they found it, and is looking to be part of a team with a clear vision, we want to hear from you. Please consider applying for the position below which is being advertised for an anticipated project.
  
  
**About The Project**
The Preconception Nutrition and Care project is an exciting new initiative in India. It aims to change how families begin: by reaching couples of reproductive ages with nutrition, health interventions and counselling before pregnancy, so that women enter pregnancy healthier and better nourished. Healthier beginnings lead to better maternal and birth outcomes. The project takes a systems-based approach. It brings together service delivery, evidence generation, learning and government partnership, so that preconception care becomes integrated into overall health system delivery. At the heart of the project is a commitment to putting the nutritional needs of women and couples at the center of design and implementation. The project aims to generate evidence and learning from implementation, and to use it to shape national dialogue on preconception nutrition and care.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Project Director will lead this work from New Delhi. You will head a small, focused team, guide a range of implementing partners and engage with state and national government. You will also be the primary voice of the project with the donor, government, research bodies and the private sector. You will work closely with Nutrition International's Maternal Newborn Health and Nutrition and Health Economics and Nutrition Financing portfolios, as well as colleagues in the Asia Regional Office and headquarters in Ottawa.
  
  
This is a rare opportunity to lead a high-visibility project, with full accountability for results, partnerships and resources. You will help set the direction for how India, and the wider region, approaches nutrition and care before pregnancy.
**In this role you**
**will be responsible to:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for donor/s, national government representatives and strategic partners to lead evidence-based negotiations on project priorities, scope, and deliverables
* Facilitate shared understanding of project scope, goals and deliverables and among project staff, partners and stakeholders
* Guide the implementation of project activities and ensure project staff and partners are executing the project according to the approved project plan
* Manage relations with partners, service providers and consultants of the project, according to Nutrition International's policies. This includes the development of terms of reference, service provided and consultant/firm selection, contracting, monitoring and end of contract processes
* Oversee and work closely with government stakeholders and partners to develop detailed annual workplans that clearly define the strategies, activities and resources (time, budget and equipment etc.) required for effective implementation of the project; and update workplans regularly to ensure the timely completion of activities and achievement of the deliverables
* Cultivate and manage strong, collaborative relationships with implementing partners, government authorities, donors and other key stakeholders. Ensure open communication channels and a shared understanding of the project's goals, responsibilities, and timelines
* Identify and engage with potential new partners that align with the project's objectives, ensuring their capacities complement the project's needs and strategies
* Ensure monitoring and learning strategies and systems are applied within the project in collaboration with the Monitoring, Data and Learning sub-unit
* Ensure a monitoring plan is developed and followed by the project team and partners. Ensure monitoring data is analyzed and used for course correction as needed
* Ensure that the project has a comprehensive staffing strategy with the appropriate composition of team members to ensure adequate oversight and quality assurance of all work within the project
* Manage project staff contracts and consultants in a timely manner and according to local legislation and Nutrition International policies
* Provide financial oversight for the full scope of the project. Maintain oversight on all sub-grants within the project and their associated budget(s) and ensure that partners establish appropriate financial procedures and tools required to be in alignment with Nutrition International requirements and standards
* Develop regular cash flow projections and monitor expenditure and review variance analysis to ensure the project operates within its budget parameters
* Ensure all project funds are managed according to established accounting policies, procedures and donor regulations
* Ensure donor stewardship with our committed donors to sustain relationships. Build and strengthen relationships with key project stakeholders and partners to ensure the project is harmonized with other donors funded project/programs and facilitates government leadership and ownership
* Establish mechanisms for regular communication within the project team, Country leadership and across partners and with Nutrition International leadership to maximize opportunities for program integration and to elevate issues or risks

**For more detailed information about the role**
, please click on the attached
**Job Description**
**Requirements**
**About you**
You will have PhD or MD degree from a recognized university in one of the following areas: nutrition, public health, reproductive health and/or a related field, with atleast 10-12 years of work experience with international NGOs, UN agencies or similar working on public health, reproductive health, nutrition related programs with at least 5 years of senior level experience in project management. You will also have demonstrated the experience in managing complex partnerships with multiple stakeholders, including government bodies, NGOs, and international organizations.
  
  
Fluency in English is essential. Knowledge of Hindi and /or local languages of project states would be an advantage.
  
  
**Benefits**
**What we offer**
Nutrition International offers a competitive market pay, including health and wellness benefits, medical insurance, accidental insurance plan, flexible work hours, four weeks of vacation (plus public holidays), and support for learning and development opportunities. We offer a collaborative and engaging work environment.
  
  
Nutrition International is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive, equitable, and accessible work environment. Upon request, accommodation due to a disability are available throughout the selection process.
  
  
Please note that all our offers are conditional subject to appropriate screening checks and satisfactory reference checks.
  
  
**How to apply?**
Nutrition International is committed to an inclusive, barrier-free work environment and encourages applications from all qualified individuals.
  
  
**To apply please**
click on "Apply for this job" /
**visit our career page and**
submit your application.
  
  
**The closing date for receiving applications**
is October 31, 2025.
**Please note that the applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis and the position may be closed once a suitable candidate is identified.**
Only short-listed candidates will receive an acknowledgment and will be called for personal interactions. The starting salary range for the position is INR 49,70,154/- per annum. We thank you for your interest, however only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
  
  
**NI is a non-smoking work environment.**

title: Electrical Design Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Electrical Design Engineer - (Building Design)**

**Location: New Delhi, Faridabad, Noida**

**Experience Required:**

* **4-15 years of experience in electrical building design.**
* **Experience in consultancy services preferred.**

**Qualification: B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in Electrical Engineering**

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking an experienced
**Electrical Design Engineer Building Design**
to join our MEP design team. The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end electrical system design, coordination, documentation, and technical review for building projects across various sectors.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Electrical Design & Engineering:**

* Perform detailed
  **electrical load calculations**
  and estimate total power requirements.
* Design and size
  **DG sets, transformers, and backup power systems**
  .
* Plan power reception from electricity supply authorities as per local by-laws.
* Space planning for
  **HT & LT panels and electrical equipment**
  in compliance with applicable codes and regulations.
* **Design electrical power distribution systems for:**
* HVAC
* Plumbing
* Firefighting
* ELV and other building services
* Develop detailed
  **single line diagrams (SLDs)**
  and schematic diagrams for LT panels and sub-panels.
* Design and plan
  **cable routing, cable tray sizing, and layouts**
  (internal & external).
* Conduct
  **voltage drop calculations**
  and size LT cables accordingly.
* Calculate
  **fault levels**
  at different stages of the electrical distribution network.
* Design
  **earthing systems and lightning protection schemes**
  .
* Design
  **internal, external, and emergency lighting systems**
  .
* Perform
  **UPS and inverter sizing**
  for emergency power requirements.

**Documentation & Tendering:**

* Prepare
  **Design Basis Reports (DBR)**
  and Detailed Project Reports (DPR).
* Develop
  **BOQs (High Side & LT Side)**
  and quantity take-off sheets (point wiring, lighting fixtures, HT cables, etc.).
* Prepare
  **technical specifications, data sheets, and tender documents**
  for electrical works.
* Review and approve shop drawings, technical submittals, and material approvals.

**Site & Coordination:**

* Conduct site visits and inspections to review execution quality and prepare snag lists.
* Coordinate with
  **HVAC, PHE, ELV, and other MEP disciplines**
  .
* Ensure compliance with
  **NBC 2016 and relevant electrical codes & standards**
  .

**Technical Skills Required:**

* Voltage drop and fault level calculations
* Cable scheduling and routing
* Earthing and capacitor bank sizing
* DG and transformer sizing
* BOQ preparation and quantity estimation
* Knowledge of NBC 2016
* Proficiency in
  **AutoCAD and Revit**

Represent the organization at government meetings, conferences, training programs, exhibitions, promotional events, and other external engagements while fostering partnerships and strengthening the organization's brand presence.

Sales and business development mindset.

Ability to communicate training and certification programs effectively.

Government/client coordination experience.

Good data management and analytical skills.

Proficiency in CRM, MS Excel, and business software.

Strong follow-up and lead-conversion abilities.

Event and training coordination skills.

Ability to work independently as well as with cross-functional teams.

Professional presentation and networking skills.

* Manage SAP HANA Cloud provisioning, access control, and connectivity.
* Ensure system health, compliance, and security tracking via Alert Notification Service and Audit Logs.

* Collaborate with functional, development, and BASIS teams to support hybrid (on-premise plus cloud) SAP landscapes.
* Lead troubleshooting of BTP-related issues and coordinate with SAP support where required.

* Develop in SAP cloud services across Integration Suite, Extension Suite, and SAP HANA Cloud.
* Demonstrate solid understanding of SAP landscape architecture and hybrid integration patterns.
* Utilize monitoring tools, audit logs, and alerting mechanisms across SAP BTP.

title: Creative Strategist
description: We are looking for a highly driven, performance-obsessed Lead Creative Strategist to own our entire creative ecosystem, from social media and content strategy to performance marketing creatives, creative testing, and scaling winning concepts.This is not a conventional social media role. We are looking for someone who understands that creative is one of the biggest drivers of paid marketing performance and knows how to turn consumer insights, cultural trends, product USPs, and performance data into creatives that convert.You will own the creative process end to end: identifying opportunities, developing concepts, building creative briefs, directing shoots, producing and editing content, analysing ad performance, identifying winning and losing creatives, and continuously feeding those insights back into the next round of creative production.Your mandate is to build a creative engine capable of developing, testing, and iterating on 50–100 creative assets per week, depending on production complexity, with a strong emphasis on speed, quality, learning, and performance.You should be equally comfortable thinking strategically, getting your hands dirty with execution, analysing Meta Ads performance, and making decisive calls on what to scale, what to iterate, and what to stop.We need someone who thrives in an intense, fast-paced, high-energy environment, takes complete ownership of outcomes, and can move from an idea to a live creative without unnecessary layers of management.The goal is simple: build a repeatable creative system that consistently produces high-performing content, improves customer acquisition efficiency, and drives profitable growth.1. End-to-End Performance Creative StrategyYou will own the strategy behind every creative we produce for paid acquisition, retargeting, organic social, and brand-building campaigns.Develop a comprehensive performance creative strategy aligned with business objectives, revenue targets, CAC goals, ROAS, and conversion rates.Identify the creative angles, messaging, formats, hooks, and visual approaches most likely to resonate with our target audience.Translate product features, benefits, ingredients, fragrances, differentiators, and consumer pain points into compelling advertising narratives.Develop creative concepts across UGC, founder-led content, product demonstrations, testimonials, problem-solution ads, educational content, product comparisons, lifestyle content, and aspirational brand storytelling.Build a systematic approach to testing different hooks, scripts, opening frames, CTAs, offers, formats, lengths, and storytelling structures.Ensure every creative has a clear hypothesis, audience, objective, and reason to exist.Develop creative strategies for prospecting, retargeting, customer acquisition, new product launches, and seasonal campaigns.Understand the relationship between creative performance, audience intent, landing pages, offers, and the overall customer journey.2. Build and Operate a High-Velocity Creative EngineBuild and manage a creative production pipeline capable of delivering approximately 50–100 creative assets per week, including variations, iterations, and new concepts.Establish a structured weekly workflow covering research, ideation, scripting, production, editing, approvals, deployment, analysis, and iteration.Develop creative calendars and production schedules that keep the team consistently ahead of upcoming campaign requirements.Turn a small number of strong concepts into multiple meaningful variations without relying on superficial changes alone.Create systems for generating new hooks, angles, scripts, storyboards, headlines, visual treatments, and ad variations at scale.Maintain an organised creative library with naming conventions, campaign tags, concept IDs, performance history, and learnings.Build a continuous feedback loop between paid marketing results and the creative production pipeline.Reduce production bottlenecks and unnecessary approval cycles while maintaining brand quality.Establish standard operating procedures, creative templates, briefing formats, and testing frameworks that allow output to scale without compromising learning quality.3. Creative Performance Analysis: Know What Works and WhyMonitor creative-level performance across Meta Ads and other relevant paid channels.Analyse metrics including spend, impressions, CPM, CTR, CPC, thumb-stop or hook rate, hold rate, video retention, landing page views, conversion rate, CPA/CAC, ROAS, and purchase volume.Identify winning creatives, emerging trends, creative fatigue, underperforming concepts, and opportunities for further testing.Understand the difference between a creative that attracts attention and one that actually generates profitable customers.Diagnose performance issues by distinguishing between weak hooks, poor messaging, low engagement, weak offers, conversion problems, and potential audience or landing-page issues.Identify which elements are contributing to success: the opening three seconds, product demonstration, offer, creator, script, visual treatment, testimonial, or CTA.Make clear decisions on which creatives to scale, iterate, test further, or discontinue.Conduct regular creative performance reviews and communicate findings to the growth and leadership teams.Convert performance data into actionable briefs for the next production cycle.4. Continuous Testing, Iteration and ScalingDesign and maintain a structured creative testing roadmap.Develop clear hypotheses for each new concept and prioritise experiments based on expected impact, learning potential, and production effort.Run controlled tests wherever practical to understand which creative variables are driving performance.Develop multiple iterations of promising concepts, exploring new hooks, openings, scripts, creators, visual formats, product demonstrations, and messaging angles.Distinguish between testing a new concept and testing a variation of an existing winner.Identify repeatable creative patterns and turn them into scalable creative frameworks.Refresh creatives proactively when performance shows signs of fatigue.Maintain a healthy pipeline of new concepts so growth does not depend on a small number of winning ads.Document learnings from both successful and unsuccessful tests to prevent repeated mistakes.Work closely with the performance marketing team to align creative testing with campaign structure, budget allocation, and scaling decisions.5. Creative Production, Shoots and Content ExecutionWrite scripts, hooks, headlines, captions, shot lists, storyboards, and detailed creative briefs.Plan and direct product shoots, UGC shoots, creator collaborations, founder-led content, and campaign productions.Brief and manage creators, editors, designers, photographers, videographers, and production partners.Ensure that shoots are planned efficiently to generate a high volume of usable assets from each production day.Identify opportunities to capture multiple concepts, formats, hooks, and variations in a single shoot.Review edits and provide precise, actionable feedback on pacing, storytelling, visual hierarchy, opening frames, subtitles, product visibility, and CTAs.Use tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro, Canva, Photoshop, or AI-assisted creative tools to create or refine assets when needed.Maintain a high standard of execution across both rapid-turnaround performance ads and more polished brand content.Manage production timelines, asset delivery, and creative quality control.6. title: Brand Manager
description:
**About Company**

DeHaat, a leading Agri-Tech startup, offers end-to-end solutions to India's farmers using AI technologies. With a presence in 12 states, 18,000+ DeHaat Centers, and 500+ FPOs, we impact 13 million+ farmers. Our AI crop advisory covers 30+ crops in regional languages & we export to 30+ countries. Founded by top institute alumni, DeHaat is fully funded, achieving consecutive
*Great Place to Work certifications*
. Recognized by NASSCOM, Forbes, ET, Niti Aayog, and Bill Gates Foundation, our 13-year journey reflects impactful innovation in the agricultural sector.

**Website:**
https://agrevolution.in/

**Role Overview:**

The Brand Manager – Agri Inputs will conceptualize and execute integrated marketing campaigns for DeHaat’s agri-input portfolio. The role involves close collaboration with business, category, agronomy, and sales teams to drive farmer awareness, retailer engagement, product adoption, and revenue growth. As a brand custodian, the incumbent will translate product benefits and agronomic insights into simple, credible, and locally relevant communication across key touchpoints. The role requires strong project management, agency coordination, and campaign measurement skills, along with a keen understanding of rural markets and farmer needs.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

• Work with the Marketing Head to conceptualize and manage integrated marketing campaigns (ATL/BTL) for DeHaat’s agri-input portfolio, including seeds, crop-protection products, crop nutrition and other relevant offerings.

• Partner with Agri-Inputs business leaders, category teams and field teams to plan and execute campaigns that drive product awareness, farmer adoption, channel engagement and revenue growth.

• Act as a brand custodian, ensuring consistent brand positioning, messaging and communication across product packaging, trade marketing, digital channels, retail touchpoints and on-ground activations.

• Develop farmer- and retailer-focused value propositions by translating product benefits, agronomic use cases and category insights into clear, credible and locally relevant communication.

• Lead end-to-end marketing initiatives across trade, digital, print and on-ground platforms, including dealer/retailer engagement, village-level activations, demonstrations, field days and seasonal campaigns, in collaboration with relevant teams.

• Work seamlessly with internal stakeholders and external creative, media, activation and production agencies to develop campaign assets and deliver high-quality execution within agreed timelines and budgets.

• Coordinate with agronomy, product, sales and field teams to ensure product claims and usage communication are accurate, responsible and aligned with approved recommendations.

• Track campaign effectiveness through relevant metrics such as reach, engagement, leads, retailer participation, product adoption and sales uplift; use primary and secondary research to recommend improvements.

• Monitor agri-input market developments, farmer needs, seasonality, competitor activity and regional communication trends to inform brand strategy and campaign planning.

**Skills/Requirements:**

• A proactive, hands-on professional who works well across cross-functional teams and builds strong relationships with business, sales, product and other stakeholders.

• Experience in brand management and integrated campaign execution, with a good understanding of ATL, BTL, trade marketing, digital, print and on-ground activations.

• Ability to convert product and category information into simple, persuasive communication for farmers, retailers and other channel partners.

• Strong project management, communication and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and measure outcomes.

• Comfortable working in a dynamic, field-oriented environment and embracing ambiguity; willingness to travel to markets and interact with sales teams, retailers and farmers as required.

• An interest in agriculture and rural markets; prior exposure to agri-inputs, FMCG, rural marketing, channel marketing or a distribution-led business will be an advantage.

**Experience and Qualifications:**

• 3–5 years of overall experience, including 2–3 years in brand management or integrated marketing. MBA/PGDM in Marketing. Relevant experience in agri-inputs, rural marketing or farmer-facing categories is desirable

title: Co-Founder
description:
About BookVidya

BookVidya is an early-stage learning venture built around one core belief: knowledge matters most when people can apply it.

We aim to help learners move beyond passive reading and book summaries towards understanding ideas, practising decisions, and applying what they learn in real-life situations.

Our vision is to make learning more practical, engaging, and useful beyond the page.

About the role

We are looking for a genuine
**Co-Founder – Growth & Distribution**
to help shape BookVidya's growth strategy, distribution systems, and go-to-market approach.

This is a founding partnership opportunity, not a conventional marketing position. You will work closely with the founding team to determine how BookVidya reaches its initial audience, earns trust, builds a learner community, and grows sustainably.

You will have meaningful input into strategic decisions and responsibility for turning growth ideas into experiments and repeatable systems.

Key responsibilities

* Develop BookVidya's growth and distribution strategy.
* Identify target audiences, user needs, and early-adopter communities.
* Design and execute organic acquisition strategies across relevant digital channels.
* Build a content distribution strategy that communicates BookVidya's value clearly.
* Explore partnerships, community-led growth, referrals, and other acquisition opportunities.
* Design experiments to acquire and retain engaged learners.
* Track relevant metrics, analyse results, and improve growth initiatives.
* Contribute to product positioning, go-to-market planning, and broader strategic decisions.
* Help establish sustainable processes for long-term growth.

What we're looking for

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
Our Company
  
  
We're Hitachi Digital, a company at the forefront of digital transformation and the fastest growing division of Hitachi Group. We're crucial to the company's strategy and ambition to become a premier global player in the massive and fast-moving digital transformation market.
  
  
Our group companies, including GlobalLogic, Hitachi Digital Services, Hitachi Vantara and more, offer comprehensive services that span the entire digital lifecycle, from initial idea to full-scale operation and the infrastructure to run it on. Hitachi Digital represents One Hitachi, integrating domain knowledge and digital capabilities, and harnessing the power of the entire portfolio of services, technologies, and partnerships, to accelerate synergy creation and make real-world impact for our customers and society as a whole.
  
  
Imagine the sheer breadth of talent it takes to unleash a digital future. We don't expect you to 'fit' every requirement – your life experience, character, perspective, and passion for achieving great things in the world are equally as important to us.
  
  
**Job Description**
**The role:**
We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Developer with 5–7 years of hands-on expertise in Salesforce platform development, customization, and integration. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing scalable solutions, implementing best practices, mentoring junior developers, and ensuring that our Salesforce environment meets evolving business needs.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Development & Customization

+ Design, develop, and implement custom solutions using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Aura components.
+ Build and maintain custom objects, workflows, validation rules, flows, and triggers.
+ Develop and maintain integrations with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs and middleware tools.

* Architecture & Design

+ Collaborate with technical architects to design scalable and secure Salesforce solutions.
+ Ensure adherence to Salesforce best practices, coding standards, and security guidelines.

* System Enhancements & Support

+ Translate business requirements into technical specifications.
+ Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in existing implementations.
+ Perform unit testing, integration testing, and deployment activities using CI/CD tools (e.g., Git, Copado, Jenkins).

* Collaboration & Mentorship

+ Work closely with business analysts, admins, and QA teams to deliver quality solutions.
+ Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers.
+ Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

**What You’ll Bring**
Required Skills & Qualifications
  
  

* 5–7 years of Salesforce development experience in enterprise environments.
* Strong expertise in:

+ Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura
+ Salesforce Flows and Process Builder
+ SOQL, SOSL queries
+ REST/SOAP API integrations

* Proficiency in Salesforce configuration, declarative development, and customization.
* Hands-on experience with DevOps tools (Git, Copado, Jenkins, Bitbucket, etc.).
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce data model, security model, and governor limits.
* Experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
* Salesforce Platform Developer I (mandatory), Platform Developer II (preferred), or equivalent certification.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud,
* Exposure to Einstein Analytics, Marketing Cloud, or CPQ is a plus.
* Knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, CSS for advanced customizations.
* Familiarity with integration platforms

**About Us**
We're a global, 1000-strong, diverse team of professional experts, promoting and delivering Social Innovation through our One Hitachi initiative (OT x IT x Product) and working on projects that have a real-world impact. We're curious, passionate and empowered, blending our legacy of 110 years of innovation with our shaping our future. Here you're not just another employee; you're part of a tradition of excellence and a community working towards creating a digital future.
  
  
Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives
  
  
Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.
  
  
We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.
  
  
How we look after you
  
  
We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.
  
  
*We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic.*
Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. As a part of BCG’s X Delivery team you will work closely with consulting teams on a diverse range of advanced topics. **You're Good At**
Web Application Development
  
  

* End to End high scale web-development experience but not just limited to architecting, design, planning, development and deployment
* Maintains a strong knowledge base of new opensource tech stacks, applications, techniques, and skills
* Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills; must be proactive and take initiative
* Create robust proprietary code and translate business logic into project requirements
* Develop code using development best practices, and an emphasis on security best practices
* Leverage technologies to support business needs to attain high reusability and maintainability of current and newly developed systems
* Provide system design recommendations based on technical requirements
* Work independently on development tasks with minimal supervision
* Write effective unit tests and integration tests to ensure high-quality software delivery

GenAI & Agentic Systems Engineering
  
  

* Designing and shipping enterprise-grade GenAI features inside full stack architectures — not standalone notebooks or demos
* Building modular AI services in Python (FastAPI / Flask / Django) that wrap LLM APIs and are exposed to the front end via REST
* Designing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines: chunking, embeddings, vector search, re-ranking and context management
* Building agentic workflows — tool and function calling, multi-step orchestration, state and memory, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and sensible fallbacks when an agent fails
* Integrating AI inference into React or Angular applications with UX patterns suited to AI (streaming responses, latency masking, citations, edit-and-retry, graceful degradation)
* Treating evaluation as engineering: defining success criteria for AI output, building test sets, and instrumenting logging, tracing, monitoring and cost/token controls
* Applying guardrails and Responsible AI practice — prompt injection defence, PII and client-confidentiality handling, output validation, and a clear audit trail
* Using AI-assisted development tooling to accelerate your own delivery, with judgement about where it helps and where it doesn't

Business Requirement Gathering and Collaboration
  
  

* Owning all or part of a software development engagement and integrating with cross-functional teams
* Establish credibility by thought partnering with demanding stakeholders / consulting teams on web development and delivery topics; drawing conclusions on a range of external and internal issues and dependencies
* Communicate insights through sophisticated synthesis and packaging of results (including PPT slides and charts) with stakeholders / consulting teams; collecting, synthesizing, learnings & inputs into new best practices and methodologies
* Executing software development approach and creating defined outcome; contributing to approach selection
* Ensure proper sign‐off before uploading materials into internal repository for reference; sanitizing confidential client content in marketing documents
* Able to build and sustain relationships with consulting MDPs to generate project work by self-leveraging regular connects
* Guides juniors on advanced software concepts and platforms, and helps in quality checks
* Contributes to team’s content & IP development
* Imparts technical trainings to team members and consulting cohort

Problem Solving
  
  

* You should be strong in solutioning with hands-on experience in software delivery, through the entire life cycle of software development. Strong problem solving skills with the ability to develop and codify knowledge and provide appropriate technical advice where required
* Comfort working with non-deterministic systems — debugging by evidence and evaluation rather than assumption

**Technical Skills**
Must have
  
  

* Experience in building high-performance web applications using -Python (Django/Flask/FastAPI), React, Angular, TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS3
* Leveraging SQL-Postgres for best performance
* On OOPs concepts, design patterns, responsive UI and Unit testing frameworks like Mockito, Junit, Jest.
* Knowledge of Material UI or And Design
* Knowledge of UI component libraries to produce high-quality production apps following a high-fidelity design and a specification
* Track record of designing, developing and supporting highly scalable, responsive web app
* Integrate UI with REST APIs to make the app production-ready
* Hands-on experience building applications on top of LLM APIs (Azure OpenAI preferred; OpenAI, Anthropic or equivalent acceptable) that have been used by real users
* Experience with at least one agent or orchestration framework (LangChain / LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, DSPy or a comparable in-house equivalent)
* Implementing tool / function calling and structured output, including schema validation and error handling
* Logging, tracing and evaluating AI output (LangSmith, Langfuse, Azure AI evaluation tooling or equivalent)

Working knowledge
  
  

* Unix command-line tools and code repo Git
* CI/CD, DevOps tools
* Cloud infra architecture design (Azure, GCP, Oracle) and deployment using Kubernetes
* UI component libraries to produce high-quality production apps following a high-fidelity design and a specification

Good to have
  
  

* Microservices, Docker, Kubernetes
* Deploying AI workloads to a major cloud platform and managing cost, latency and rate limits in production
* Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable tool-integration standards
* Multi-agent system design, including agent-to-agent handoff and supervision patterns
* File Storage and NoSql Databases like MongoDB
* Charting libraries like HighCharts, D3.js and Recharts
* Basic wireframing skills
* Hybrid Mobile app development using React Native or Ionic

What You'll Bring
  
  
**Job Requirement**

* Excellent communication skills

A key challenge involves building scalable AI-powered healthcare applications capable of processing
**2,000–5,000 medical charts within a 1–2 hour peak processing window**
, ensuring performance, reliability, accuracy, and cost efficiency.

The ideal candidate should be strong in
**Node.js, React.js, PostgreSQL, AWS Lambda, Amazon Bedrock, microservices, distributed systems, OCR, RAG, and practical AI/LLM implementation**
.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and develop scalable applications using
  **React.js, Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB**
  .
* Own
  **High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD)**
  for complex modules, microservices, and distributed systems.
* Design high-throughput architectures using
  **asynchronous processing, event-driven workflows, queues, caching, and parallel execution**
  .
* Build and optimize
  **AWS Lambda-based services**
  and integrate AI models using
  **Amazon Bedrock**
  .
* Develop and scale
  **AI/LLM workflows, OCR pipelines, Vision AI, structured data extraction, and RAG systems**
  .
* Design scalable APIs, database schemas, background processing workflows, and communication between microservices.
* Implement
  **concurrency controls, rate limiting, retries, idempotency, fault tolerance, and monitoring**
  .
* Integrate
  **AI agents, tool calling, and workflow orchestration**
  where required.
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across backend services, databases, AI models, and infrastructure.
* Take ownership of
  **development, deployment, performance optimization, and production troubleshooting**
  .

Core Technical Skills1. Full Stack Development & System Design

Strong hands-on experience with
**React.js, Node.js, Express.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and REST APIs**
.

Strong understanding of:

* **HLD, LLD, scalable architecture, and microservices**
* Distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and asynchronous processing
* Database design, query optimization, and API architecture
* Concurrency, caching, load balancing, and horizontal scaling
* Authentication, authorization, security, and fault tolerance
* Performance optimization and architectural trade-offs

The candidate must be capable of
**converting business requirements into detailed, scalable technical designs and implementing them independently**
.

2. Microservices, Distributed Systems & AWS

Strong practical knowledge of
**microservices, distributed processing, asynchronous workflows, and event-driven system architecture**
.

Hands-on expertise with:

* **AWS Lambda:**
  Serverless development, deployment, concurrency, performance optimization, and scaling.
* **Amazon Bedrock:**
  Foundation model integration and production AI workflows.
* Working knowledge of
  **AWS S3, SQS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and IAM**
  .

Experience with
**Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, or similar messaging and caching technologies**
.

Understanding of
**worker concurrency, queue-based processing, retries, idempotency, rate limiting, failure recovery, observability, and cloud cost optimization**
.

Deep expertise across every AWS service is not required.

3. AI / LLM Engineering, OCR & Document Intelligence

Hands-on experience implementing production AI applications involving:

* LLM integration, prompt engineering, and context management.
* **OCR, Vision AI, multimodal models, and PDF/image processing**
  .
* Document classification, table/form extraction, and structured JSON outputs.
* Schema validation, error handling, and hallucination reduction.
* Multi-stage AI processing pipelines and model orchestration.
* Token optimization, AI latency management, and cost reduction.
* AI evaluation, accuracy improvement, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

The candidate should understand how to build
**reliable AI features beyond simply making LLM API calls**
.

4. RAG & AI Workflow Architecture

Hands-on experience designing and implementing
**Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**
systems, including:

* Document ingestion, chunking, and embeddings
* Vector databases, semantic/hybrid search, and metadata filtering
* Retrieval optimization, reranking, and context construction
* Response grounding and RAG evaluation

Working knowledge of
**AI agents, function/tool calling, agent orchestration, state management, and contextual memory**
.

Experience with
**LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks**
is preferred.

5. Scalability, Performance & Engineering Ownership

The candidate should be capable of:

* Designing architectures for high-volume document and AI processing.
* Performing capacity planning, throughput estimation, and load testing.
* Building scalable background workers and asynchronous pipelines.
* Optimizing APIs, databases, model calls, and infrastructure.
* Troubleshooting complex production issues.
* Making architectural decisions and explaining technical trade-offs.
* Independently owning complex technical modules from requirements to deployment.

Good to Have

* Experience with
  **US Healthcare, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), medical coding, insurance claims, or HIPAA-aware applications**
  .
* Advanced AI agents, multi-agent workflows, and agent orchestration.
* Knowledge graphs, graph-based retrieval, and advanced AI memory.
* Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized deployments.
* Experience with AI evaluation frameworks and feedback-driven improvement systems.

Experience Required

* **3–5 years of professional software development experience**
  .
* Strong full-stack development experience, particularly in backend engineering.
* Strong system design, microservices, and scalable architecture knowledge.
* Hands-on experience with
  **AWS Lambda and Amazon Bedrock**
  .
* Practical experience with
  **AI/LLM integration, OCR, and RAG**
  .
* Ability to independently design, implement, and own complex technical modules.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a
**hands-on engineer and strong system thinker**
who can take ownership of architecture, development, AI integration, scalability, and production reliability.

The ideal candidate should be able to design distributed architectures, implement production-ready modules, optimize high-volume AI processing workflows, and solve complex engineering challenges independently.

* **Our highest priorities are system design, scalable backend architecture, microservices, AWS Lambda, and practical AI implementation.**

title: Application Engineering, Principal Engineer
description:
We Are
  
  
At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
  
  
You Are
  
  
You are a DDR/LPDDR Controller System Architecture Specialist who can work directly with customer architects to close real system-level memory subsystem design decisions.
  
  
You are comfortable discussing SoC integration, memory subsystem architecture, controller configuration, performance optimization, power management, validation, and interoperability topics. You can help customers evaluate technical trade-offs and guide them toward practical architecture decisions.
  
  
This is a customer-facing technical role. You will help customers integrate DDR/LPDDR controller IP into complex SoCs, identify key requirements or gaps, and translate customer feedback into actionable input for Synopsys Product Management, R&D, and roadmap planning.
  
  
What You’ll Be Doing
  
  

* Own the technical architecture engagement for DDR/LPDDR controller IP with strategic customers, from early platform requirements through architecture closure and initial deployment readiness.
* Work with customer architects and engineering teams to define suitable DDR/LPDDR memory subsystem configurations for advanced SoC platforms.
* Analyze system-level trade-offs related to memory bandwidth, latency, power efficiency, quality of service, reliability, validation, and scalability.
* Translate customer platform requirements and integration constraints into clear feedback for Synopsys Product Management, R&D, and roadmap planning.
* Support technical closure of design wins by providing architecture guidance, configuration recommendations and competitive positioning.
* Develop reusable technical material, application notes, and customer-facing guidance based on real engagement experience.
* Train FAEs and customer teams on DDR/LPDDR architecture, memory subsystem integration, performance tuning, validation expectations, and deployment best practices.

The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Improve the quality of DDR/LPDDR design wins by ensuring customer memory architectures are technically sound before commitment.
* Strengthen Synopsys DDR/LPDDR roadmap by feeding real customer memory subsystem requirements into product planning and R&D execution.
* Reduce customer integration risk by identifying architecture, performance, power, validation, and bring-up issues early.
* Help establish Synopsys as a trusted technical partner for next-generation AI, HPC, mobile, automotive, networking, and edge computing platforms.

What You’ll Need
  
  

* Bachelors and/or Masters Degree in Electrical and/or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science
* 5+ years of experience in DDR/LPDDR architecture, memory subsystem design, SoC integration, silicon validation, systems engineering, applications engineering, or customer-facing technical leadership.
* Solid understanding of DDR and/or LPDDR controller IP, including memory architecture concepts, controller configuration, scheduling, quality of service, power management, training, validation, or system integration.
* Good system-level understanding of SoC integration and ability to reason through memory bandwidth, latency, power efficiency, quality of service, reliability, validation, and software/firmware trade-offs.
* Experience engaging directly with customer architects, design teams, validation teams, and technical decision-makers.
* Ability to translate ambiguous customer requirements into clear technical recommendations, product feedback, and closure plans.
* Strong technical communication skills, including clear written analysis, structured trade-off explanation, and ability to align customer, sales, product, and engineering teams.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with Linux, firmware bring-up, or software-driven debug of DDR/LPDDR subsystems.
* Familiarity with advanced SoC architectures used in AI, HPC, automotive, mobile, networking, or compute platforms.
* Experience with memory performance analysis, traffic modeling, quality-of-service management, memory hierarchy optimization, or system-level benchmarking.
* Knowledge of advanced topics such as DDR5, LPDDR5X, LPDDR6, memory training algorithms, RAS features, chiplet-based memory architectures, or AI memory bandwidth optimization.

The Team You’ll be a Part Of
  
  
You will be part of our IP high-performance computing applications engineering team, a group of dedicated professionals who are passionate about technology and innovation. The team focuses on helping customers integrate more capabilities into SoCs faster, working collaboratively across geographic and organizational boundaries to drive revenue growth and accelerate business closure.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
  
  
Inclusion and Diversity
  
  
Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, military veteran status, or disability.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 5–7 years of relevant SAP experience in Production Planning, Quality Management and/or Digital Manufacturing.
* Hands-on experience as an SAP functional consultant, including practical experience with SAP S/4HANA. Experience with SAP Digital Manufacturing is an advantage.
* Experience working as an SAP consultant, including direct client interaction and project implementation. Experience supporting clients or delivering implementations in the European Union is an advantage.
* Strong SAP functional skills. Experience with middleware such as SAP PCo or SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), and technical skills in Java or JavaScript, will be an advantage.
* The ability to work collaboratively, share knowledge and contribute proactively to high-quality SAP consulting and support.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain solutions, progress and issues clearly to different audiences.

You’ll bring a self-driven, proactive approach and a commitment to making Topsoe’s SAP solutions as effective and reliable as possible. This is an opportunity to contribute to important production processes while working with diverse teams across locations.
  
  
**Why Join Us**
At Topsoe, you will join a team of passionate problem solvers dedicated to shaping a more sustainable future. Collaboration and respect are at the heart of our culture, where every idea is valued and can drive real change. As a global leader in advanced technology for the energy transition, we offer you the chance to make a direct impact, work on exciting international projects, and develop your leadership skills in a supportive and innovative environment. You will be part of a workplace that values high standards, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Your expertise will help us deliver meaningful solutions and drive progress together, while you enjoy opportunities for personal and professional development in a truly global setting.
  
  
**Your New Team**
You will join Global IT, Corporate Applications department, and sub-team of: Global Supply (GS) IT Services. The department is responsible for running and maintaining support for IT systems supporting Topsoe GS related processes across: Procurement, Production Planning, Manufacturing. Quality, Maintenance, Warehouse, Logistics, and HSE.
  
  
The IT system support is largely based on SAP technology. The target for the unit is to continuously serve Topsoe GS mission including supporting business productivity targets by offering secure and stable solutions, as well as continuously introduction new technology including AI, while adhering to the SAP roadmap. The SAP organization consists of ~20 deeply skilled SAP colleagues who are experts in functional and technical areas. The team is based in Denmark and India supporting the global organization.
  
  
**How You Can Apply**
If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English.
  
  
**Application deadline:**
08-11-2026.
  
  
You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying. Please also avoid the use of photos in your CV. Both of these measures are to ensure a fair and unbiased process
  
  
We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.
  
  
To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.

As part of our recruitment activities, we engage an external recruitment agency located in Poland. In connection with its support of the recruitment process, the agency may process applicants’ personal data on our behalf and in compliance with applicable data protection laws, including GDPR where relevant.
  
  
**About Us**
Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.
  
  
Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.
  
  
We offer world-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.
  
  
We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, with around 2,500 employees serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com.

title: Marketing Specialist (Performance + Growth)
description:
**About Tripmojo**

Tripmojo is an AI travel companion that plans, organises and runs your trip for you. It reads your booking emails and assembles the whole trip on its own: flights, hotels, trains, activities, documents. Mojo, our AI travel advisor, plans the gaps and answers questions in context. On the day of travel the app tracks your flight live, handles check-in, and gets you online abroad with an eSIM.

**Our products**
: auto-built trips from your inbox, the Mojo AI advisor, travel eSIMs, curated bookable activities, live flight status with automated check-in, and lounge access. Most of our users are in India, a market that travels more every year and is badly served by today's travel apps. We are a small team that ships every week, and we build with AI agents across engineering, data and operations. We expect marketing to work the same way.

**About the Role**

We need the person who turns our product into a revenue engine, with their own hands on the campaigns. This is a player-coach role and our first marketing hire: you set the structure everyone after you inherits. You will build the plan, then run it yourself. On a normal day you are in Ads Manager, the MMP dashboard and a SQL window, not only in a deck.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Paid Acquisition**

* Run Meta app and web campaigns (Advantage+ and manual structures), Google App Campaigns, Search and YouTube, and Apple Search Ads for iOS intent
* Bid on events that predict revenue, not installs

**Measurement and Attribution**

* Choose, set up and own the MMP
* Define the event taxonomy, deep links and deferred deep links
* Manage SKAN / AdAttributionKit and Play install referrer
* Implement server-side conversions: Meta CAPI, Google enhanced conversions

**Monetisation**

* Build funnels from first open to first purchase
* Own pricing, bundles and offers for eSIMs, activities and services
* Improve checkout conversion and abandoned-cart recovery
* Track CAC payback and LTV by product and channel

**Creative**

* Run weekly creative testing with a clear hypothesis log
* Use AI tools for variants, UGC scripts and localisation
* Kill fast, scale winners, document why

**Growth Roadmap You Will Own**

**Stage 1**
- Today (low scale): Find the one engine that works

**Stage 2**
- 10K to 50K DAU: Scale what is proven, add what compounds

**Stage 3**
- 100K+ DAU: Run growth as a system, not a set of campaigns

**Requirements**

* You have solved monetisation through performance marketing, several times. You can explain what you did, why it worked and what you would repeat.
* You have sold digital products and services online: apps, subscriptions, marketplaces or digital goods. You know checkout, payment drop-off and pricing tests.
* You are hands-on with an MMP, Meta and Google. You build campaigns yourself, debug a broken postback, and read attribution with healthy suspicion.
* You understand privacy-era measurement: ATT, SKAN, modelled conversions, server-side events and why platform numbers disagree.
* You are comfortable with data: SQL, cohort and LTV analysis, GA4 or BigQuery. You do not wait for an analyst.
* You have run budgets from tiny to large. You know what to do with a small test budget and what changes when it grows 50x.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with travel, fintech or commerce apps, especially selling add-ons around a core journey
* Experience across India and international markets: you know how CPMs, payment habits and creative differ
* You already use AI in your workflow for creative, analysis, reporting or automation
* You have built a creator or affiliate program: tracking, payouts and partner quality

This role is probably not for you if you want a ready team of ten on day one, prefer briefing agencies to running campaigns, or report installs and CTR as the win.

First 90 Days

* Day 30 - Measurement you trust: tracking audited across app, web and ad platforms; MMP, events and server-side conversions live; north-star conversion agreed and bidding on it; first structured tests on Meta and Google
* Day 60 - A first engine: at least one product-channel pair with a clear payback; a running creative test loop; lifecycle basics selling into upcoming trips
* Day 90 - The plan to 100K: a written growth plan (channel mix, budget curve, team shape); targets agreed for the next two quarters; a decision on full-time scope if you started as a consultant

**Compensation and Engagement Options**

**Full-time (Head of Growth)**

* Own growth and monetisation end to end
* Competitive salary plus meaningful equity
* Build and lead the marketing team as we scale

**Consultant / Fractional (Growth Partner)**

* A fixed number of days a week, still hands-on in the accounts
* Retainer with a performance-linked component
* A clear path to a full-time role if it clicks both ways

**How to Apply**

Skip the cover letter. Show us how you think on a real product we sell today: travel eSIMs are live in the Tripmojo app, and we want to grow them through Meta.

**Step 1**
- Use the product. Install Tripmojo on Android or iOS. Open the eSIM section, pick a destination, compare plans and go as far as the payment screen (no purchase needed). Note who you think this is for, when they decide to buy, and anything in the flow that would cost us conversions.

**Step 2**
- Send us a plan covering:

* Campaign objective: the objective and optimisation event you would pick, and why that event at our low starting volume
* Campaign architecture: campaigns, ad sets, audiences, geos and placements; app or web destination, and how you would handle attribution
* Creative: formats, hooks, angles and number of variants; who or what produces them (UGC, AI, motion, static) and how you test them
* Two-week budget: total spend for 14 days and how it splits across campaigns, tests and scaling
* Day-by-day rollout: what launches when, what you check on which day, and your rules to kill, hold or scale
* Evidence: back every major call with a campaign you have run before, with the numbers (CPA, ROAS, conversion rate) and what you learned
* What a good result looks like on day 14, and which metric you would watch first

**Format**
: PDF, deck or doc link, up to 8 pages or slides. Add a few lines about yourself and whether you want the full-time or consultant role. Every plan gets read by a founder.

**Email**
: contact@tripmojo.ai

**Subject**
: Growth Lead - eSIM plan

title: Performance marketing manager
description:
We’re hiring: Performance Marketing Manager

Potenza Wellness | Full-time | Delhi NCR

Potenza Wellness is a premium aesthetic dermatology, body-toning and wellness brand with clinics across Delhi NCR and Ahmedabad. We’re looking for a hands-on Performance Marketing Manager to grow qualified enquiries and booked consultations across our clinics.

This role is for someone who can connect the whole journey: campaign, lead, consultation and revenue. You’ll work closely with our clinic teams, doctors and creative team to turn strong marketing into measurable business results.

What you’ll do

\* Plan and manage performance campaigns across Meta and Google, from budget allocation to optimisation.

\* Build campaigns around our clinics, treatments, launches and target audiences.

\* Improve lead quality, enquiry-to-consultation rates and cost per booked appointment.

\* Set up and maintain tracking, pixels, conversion events, dashboards and campaign reporting.

\* Analyse performance by clinic, treatment and campaign, then act on what the numbers show.

\* Brief and test creative, messaging, landing pages and lead forms with the creative team.

\* Work with clinic teams to understand lead follow-up and identify where enquiries are being lost.

\* Manage agency or platform partners where needed and keep campaigns within budget.

\* Stay current with advertising policies for healthcare, aesthetics and wellness.

What we’re looking for

\* 4+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience.

\* Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.

\* Experience managing meaningful budgets and being accountable for outcomes.

\* A track record of improving lead quality and conversion, not just increasing clicks or enquiries.

\* Confidence with analytics, attribution, spreadsheets and reporting.

\* Clear communication and the ability to work closely with both creative and clinic teams.

\* Experience in healthcare, aesthetics, wellness, beauty or another high-consideration service business is a strong advantage.

This role may suit you if you like testing ideas, understand that a lead is only valuable when it converts, and are comfortable taking ownership from campaign setup through to clinic-level results.

To apply, send your CV and a brief summary of campaigns you’ve personally managed, including the results you can share.

title: Marketing Intern
description:
**Internship Opportunity: Marketing Coordinator Intern – Heritage Saree Brand**

**Location**
: Chittaranjan Park, South Delhi

**Duration**
: 6 months

**Employment Type**
: Full-time Internship, In-office

**Stipend**
: ₹5,000–₹7,000 per month + ₹50 per order

**Working Days**
: Monday to Friday + alternate Saturdays

**Joining**
: Immediate

**About the Opportunity**

We are looking for a creative, organised, and proactive Marketing Coordinator Intern to work directly with the founder of a heritage saree brand specialising in handprinted textiles.

This is a hands-on role offering exposure to brand marketing, content creation, product shoots, inventory management, e-commerce operations, customer service, and vendor coordination. You will also collaborate with our social media, creative production, technology, and finance teams.

The role is ideal for someone who enjoys both the creative and operational sides of building a fashion brand and is comfortable being on camera and representing the brand online.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Content Creation and Brand Representation**

- Appear in short-form videos, including product launches, styling tips, try-ons, new collections, and Q&A content.

- Develop 3–5 content ideas every week.

- Shoot raw content using a smartphone, including product styling, packaging, and behind-the-scenes videos.

- Coordinate with the social media team to share content ideas and raw footage for editing and publishing.

**2. Product Shoots and Styling**

- Plan outfits, styling, and props for launch and monthly product shoots.

- Coordinate with the creative production team to ensure product photography is completed.

- Ensure each saree is photographed from multiple angles, including details, draping, and flat lays.

**3. Vendor Coordination and Inventory Management**

- Coordinate with artisans and suppliers regarding orders, follow-ups, and delivery timelines.

- Check incoming products for print, colour, and quality-related issues.

- Maintain accurate inventory and stock records.

**4. Website and E-commerce Operations**

- Upload product listings, prices, photographs, and descriptions to the website.

- Coordinate with the technology team to report website issues and follow up on fixes.

- Ensure product information is accurate and updated.

**5. Customer Service and Order Management**

- Respond to Instagram DMs and WhatsApp enquiries within two hours during working hours.

- Confirm cash-on-delivery orders, pack products carefully, and coordinate dispatch within 48 hours.

- Share tracking details and assist with exchanges and returns.

- Follow up with customers for reviews, feedback, and product photographs.

**6. Customer Community and Pop-ups**

- Build and maintain a database of customers who have purchased through exhibitions, pop-ups, or direct enquiries.

- Assist with WhatsApp customer communication and engagement.

- Support the planning and execution of exhibitions and pop-up stalls in Delhi.

**Who We're Looking For**

- A graduate or final-year student in Fashion Design, Textile Design, Fashion Communication, or Fashion Management. A relevant fashion-related educational background is required.

- Comfortable speaking naturally in Hindi and English and appearing on camera.

- A strong creative eye for styling, colours, framing, and visual presentation.

- Basic smartphone video shooting and editing skills using apps such as CapCut, VN, or InShot.

- Familiarity with Canva for creating social media posts.

- Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.

- A genuine interest in sarees, handloom, Indian textiles, and traditional crafts.

- Willingness to handle content creation alongside orders, inventory, vendors, and customer communication.

**Additional advantages:**

- Experience with a D2C fashion brand, handloom label, boutique, or exhibitions.

- Saree draping and styling skills.

- Familiarity with Shopify, WordPress, or other e-commerce platforms.

- An interest in Rajasthan, Jaipur, or traditional block-printing crafts.

**Performance Expectations**

- Content: Coordinate with the social media team to deliver four reels and three posts per week, including at least two on-camera reels.

- Order fulfilment: Ensure orders are dispatched within 48 hours.

- Customer service: Respond within two hours during working hours and support a target of 20+ customer reviews by January 2027.

- Inventory: Maintain accurate stock records and quality-check every product.

- Sales reporting: Track website orders and share updates every Monday.

**Growth Opportunity**

Candidates who perform well throughout the six-month internship may be considered for a full-time position, with the potential to progress into a Business Manager role as the brand grows.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can share their CV along with their Instagram handle or content portfolio at:

**hr@atraski.com**

**anish.dhar@atraski.com**

Please include “
**Marketing Coordinator Intern – Fashion Brand**
” in the subject line.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short content task before the interview process.

description:

We’re on a mission to reinvent how enterprises talk to their customers. title: Chief Marketing Officer
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

India’s leading online travel company, with over 80 million+ lifetime transacted users. The company operates some of India’s most recognized travel brands, offering a comprehensive suite of travel services including flights, hotels, holiday packages, bus and rail bookings, car rentals, and fintech services.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Chief Marketing Officer will serve as the senior-most marketing leader across the group, reporting directly into top leadership and functioning as a key member of the organizational leadership team. This is a transformative, high-visibility role responsible for shaping the marketing vision and strategy for India’s most iconic consumer travel brand.

The CMO will be the architect of integrated marketing strategy spanning brand building, performance marketing, social and content marketing, mobile marketing, Customer Lifecycle Management (CLM), consumer insights, and marketing technology (MarTech).

A very important part of the responsibility will be to keep the overall cost of customer acquisition, retention, sales promotion, and other related marketing costs well within defined budgets, with an ability to optimize spending according to business and market realities, working closely with business leaders.

Additionally, this role could include managing or supporting ancillary but critical revenue-generating verticals such as advertising, as well as revenue and offers through strategic alliances with banks, tourism boards, and other relevant third parties.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Brand Strategy & Communication

* Define and evolve the brand positioning, architecture, and narrative for the company’s consumer travel brands to drive differentiated brand equity in a competitive online travel landscape.
* Oversee integrated marketing campaigns – from conceptualization through execution – across digital, social, mobile, television, outdoor, and emerging media channels.
* Ensure brand consistency, relevance, and salience across all consumer touchpoints, sustaining top-of-mind recall and emotional resonance with diverse traveller segments.

Performance Marketing & Growth

* Lead performance marketing strategy and execution across all growth businesses, driving measurable customer acquisition, engagement, re-engagement, and conversion optimization.
* Own the full-funnel marketing engine – from awareness through to booking – optimizing for ROI, cost of acquisition, and lifetime value across paid, owned, and earned channels.
* Drive mobile-first marketing strategies aligned with India’s rapidly evolving digital ecosystem and the company’s super-app positioning.

Customer Lifecycle Management & Insights

* Build and scale a best-in-class CLM function leveraging data science, segmentation, and personalization to maximize customer retention, repeat usage, and lifetime value.
* Champion a deep, insights-driven understanding of consumer behaviour, travel intent, and market dynamics to inform product, pricing, and go-to-market strategies.
* Leverage first-party data and advanced analytics to create hyper-personalized marketing experiences across the traveller journey.

MarTech, AI & Innovation

* Lead the marketing technology roadmap, ensuring the organization is leveraging cutting-edge platforms for automation, attribution, experimentation, and real-time decisioning.
* Drive the integration of Generative AI and machine learning into marketing workflows – from AI-powered content creation and dynamic personalization to conversational commerce through the company’s AI-powered platforms.
* Foster a culture of continuous test-and-learn experimentation, staying at the frontier of marketing innovation in areas such as voice commerce, vernacular engagement, and predictive analytics.

Advertising Technology, Alliances & Revenue

* The role could also encompass shaping and scaling the company’s AdTech business, exploring opportunities to grow advertising revenue through its travel media network and high-intent audience.
* This could include developing strategic alliances across the travel ecosystem and adjacent sectors, alongside co-marketing, sponsorship, and other commercial opportunities that enhance traveller experience and create incremental value for the business and its partners.

Social Media, Content & PR

* Oversee the social media and content marketing strategy, building vibrant brand communities, driving organic engagement, and leveraging influencer and creator partnerships.
* Guide the public relations and corporate communications strategy, positioning the company as a thought leader in travel, technology, and AI.
* Manage crisis communication and reputation management frameworks with agility and maturity.

Team Leadership & Organizational Development

* Lead, mentor, and inspire a large, multi-functional marketing organization spanning brand, performance, social, content, MarTech, alliances, and AdTech teams across both consumer travel brands.
* Attract, develop, and retain top-tier marketing talent; build a high-performance, collaborative culture rooted in innovation, accountability, and speed of execution.
* Serve as a trusted partner to business leaders across all Lines of Business (LOBs), bringing marketing thinking into strategic and commercial decision-making at the leadership table.

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education & Background

* MBA from a premier institution (IIM, ISB, XLRI, FMS, or equivalent international business school) is essential.
* An undergraduate degree in Engineering (from IIT, NIT, BITS, or equivalent) is strongly preferred, reflecting the analytical rigour needed for a technology-driven business.
* Total professional experience of approximately 20–25 years, with the most recent qualification from the 2002–2008 batch window.

Professional Experience

* Demonstrated track record as a senior marketing leader (VP Marketing, CMO, or equivalent) at a scaled, new-age e-commerce or consumer internet company with significant digital revenue.
* Deep expertise across both brand marketing and digital/performance marketing – the ability to speak the language of brand builders and performance marketers with equal fluency is non-negotiable.
* Proven experience in Customer Lifecycle Management (CLM), marketing analytics, and data-driven decision-making at scale.
* Hands-on experience with marketing technology stacks, attribution modelling, and marketing automation platforms.
* Exposure to and genuine interest in AI-powered marketing, including Generative AI applications in content, personalization, and conversational commerce.
* Prior experience leading marketing for a multi-brand portfolio is preferred.
* Must have operated in a scaled, high-growth digital consumer business – ideally in e-commerce, travel, fintech, or consumer technology.
* Experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder environments with cross-functional leadership exposure.
