title: New Product Development Manager
description:
We are looking for a highly driven, commercially minded 
**NPD Lead who understands the beauty and personal care industry and can take a product from an initial idea to a finished product on the shelf.**

This is an end-to-end product ownership role. You will be responsible for identifying the right products to launch, understanding consumer needs, researching the market, developing product concepts, sourcing ingredients and packaging, coordinating with manufacturers and R&D teams, managing costs and margins, deciding pricing and pack sizes, and ensuring every product is ready for launch on time.

You should understand both the creative and commercial sides of product development. You need to know what consumers want, what is trending in the market, what competitors are launching, which ingredients and formulations make sense, which packaging options are viable, what consumers are willing to pay, and whether a product can deliver attractive gross margins.

You will work closely with founders, manufacturers, formulation labs, packaging suppliers, procurement partners, and marketing teams to bring new products to market.

We are looking for someone who takes complete ownership, moves quickly, has excellent attention to detail, and can balance product quality, consumer appeal, commercial viability, and speed to market.

1. Market Research, Consumer Insights & Product Opportunity Identification

* Conduct in-depth market research across beauty, skincare, fragrance, body care, and personal care categories.
* Track emerging trends in product formats, ingredients, formulations, fragrances, packaging, textures, claims, and consumer preferences.
* Study leading Indian and international brands to understand their product portfolios, positioning, price points, pack sizes, launches, and differentiation.
* Identify gaps in the market, underserved consumer needs, and opportunities to create differentiated products.
* Analyse competitor products, customer reviews, social media conversations, marketplace reviews, and consumer feedback to understand what customers like, dislike, and want improved.
* Translate consumer insights into clear product concepts with a defined target audience, core benefit, product proposition, and reason to buy.
* Evaluate new product opportunities based on demand, competitive intensity, differentiation, market size, feasibility, and commercial potential.
* Build and maintain a prioritised product innovation pipeline.
* Recommend which products to develop, which to postpone, and which opportunities are not commercially attractive.

2. End-to-End New Product Development: From Concept to Shelf

* Develop detailed product briefs covering the product concept, target consumer, benefits, sensory experience, ingredients, formulation expectations, fragrance profile, packaging, pricing, and competitive positioning.
* Translate product ideas into actionable briefs for manufacturers, formulation labs, and R&D partners.
* Identify suitable manufacturers and development partners based on technical capabilities, category expertise, quality standards, minimum order quantities, costs, and lead times.
* Coordinate formulation development, sample creation, evaluation, feedback, and refinement.
* Manage multiple rounds of product sampling until the formulation meets the desired quality, performance, sensory experience, and commercial requirements.
* Establish product specifications and ensure that the final product matches the approved brief.
* Coordinate stability testing, compatibility testing, microbiological testing where applicable, and other required quality and safety assessments.
* Track every stage of development through clear timelines, milestones, owners, dependencies, and approval checkpoints.
* Identify potential delays or technical issues early and resolve them proactively.
* Ensure products are commercially, technically, and operationally ready before moving into mass production.

3. Formulation, Ingredients & Product Quality

* Research and evaluate ingredients based on their function, performance, safety, stability, cost, availability, and relevance to the target consumer.
* Source suitable ingredients and work with formulation chemists and manufacturers to develop the desired product experience.
* Understand the role of active ingredients, emollients, humectants, surfactants, preservatives, fragrance materials, solvents, and other relevant formulation components.
* Develop clear formulation requirements around texture, spreadability, absorption, moisturisation, fragrance intensity, longevity, washability, finish, and overall consumer experience, depending on the category.
* Evaluate ingredient alternatives when cost, availability, performance, or formulation stability becomes a constraint.
* Review formulation samples critically and provide structured feedback to R&D teams.
* Ensure ingredient selection supports product claims and complies with applicable Indian regulations and relevant quality requirements.
* Work with technical partners to investigate issues such as separation, leakage, colour changes, fragrance instability, packaging interactions, or inconsistent product performance.
* Maintain clear documentation of approved formulations, specifications, test results, and product changes.

4. Packaging Development, Sourcing & Design Execution

* Research and source suitable packaging formats, materials, components, and suppliers.
* Identify packaging options relevant to each product.
* Evaluate materials based on compatibility, durability, aesthetics, functionality, and cost.
* Work with designers and suppliers to translate the desired product experience into production-ready packaging.
* Manage packaging samples, moulds where required, colour matching, finishes, printing, decoration, labels, and artwork approvals.
* Evaluate packaging options based on visual appeal, consumer usability, product protection, manufacturing feasibility, and logistics.
* Conduct or coordinate packaging compatibility.
* Source alternative vendors and components to improve quality, reduce cost, or shorten lead times.
* Ensure packaging specifications, dimensions, materials, and artwork are approved before mass production.
* Coordinate with design, regulatory, and production teams to ensure packaging is attractive, practical, compliant, and ready for launch.

5. Sourcing, Vendor Management & Manufacturing

* Identify, evaluate, and onboard manufacturers, contract manufacturers, formulation labs, ingredient suppliers, packaging vendors, and other development partners.
* Obtain and compare quotations, minimum order quantities, payment terms, lead times, tooling costs, and production capabilities.
* Negotiate pricing, commercial terms, production timelines, and quality expectations.
* Develop strong vendor relationships while maintaining competitive sourcing standards.
* Coordinate product development, sampling, purchase orders, production planning, and delivery schedules.
* Track raw material availability, packaging readiness, manufacturing capacity, and production dependencies.
* Monitor production progress and address delays, quality deviations, or supply issues proactively.
* Establish clear quality specifications and acceptance criteria with vendors.
* Maintain backup suppliers for critical components wherever commercially practical.
* Ensure production quantities, packaging components, and finished goods are aligned with launch plans and inventory requirements.

6. Product Costing, Pricing & Gross Margin Ownership

* Build detailed product cost sheets covering formulation, ingredients, packaging, components, manufacturing, filling, assembly, labels, cartons, testing, tooling, and other relevant costs.
* Calculate landed product costs and identify opportunities to optimise the bill of materials without compromising product quality.
* Evaluate different formulation, packaging, pack size, and manufacturing options to improve commercial viability.
* Recommend the right MRP, selling price, promotional pricing, and pack architecture based on consumer willingness to pay, competitor benchmarks, brand positioning, and target margins.
* Model gross margins at different price points, order quantities, and cost scenarios.
* Evaluate the financial implications of different pack sizes, bundle configurations, refill options, and product variants.
* Understand how discounts, channel commissions, marketplace fees, GST treatment, and other relevant costs affect net realisation and profitability.
* Work with leadership and finance to establish margin targets and minimum acceptable commercial thresholds.
* Negotiate with vendors to improve costs and protect margins as volumes scale.
* Identify products that are commercially unviable before significant development or inventory investment is made.

7. Pack Size, Product Architecture & Commercial Strategy

* Recommend the right pack size, quantity, format, and price point for the target consumer.
* Evaluate trial sizes, standard sizes, premium sizes, multipacks, bundles, and refill formats where relevant.
* Assess how pack size affects perceived value, purchase intent, repeat purchase, consumption frequency, shipping economics, and gross margin.
* Develop product variants and fragrance or formulation extensions based on genuine consumer demand and operational feasibility.
* Determine whether a concept should launch as a standalone product, a bundle, a kit, or part of a wider product range.

Essential Requirements

* 3–6 years of experience in new product development, product innovation, sourcing, or product management.
* Relevant experience in beauty, skincare, fragrance, body care, cosmetics, or personal care.
* Demonstrable experience taking products through multiple stages of development, ideally from initial concept to commercial launch.
* Strong understanding of manufacturers, contract manufacturing, formulation development, packaging sourcing, and supplier management.

Strong Advantages

* Experience launching products in the Indian D2C beauty and personal care market.
* Existing relationships with Indian cosmetic manufacturers, fragrance houses, formulation labs, and packaging suppliers.

📍Full time role in Gurgaon, Haryana

title: Griffin Club - Brand and Communications Lead
description:
Inc42 is India’s
**#1 startup media & intelligence platform**
that informs, educates and empowers startup & business leaders through its incisive reporting, insightful reports, curated Events & Conferences & communities, and industry-leading executive courses & programs.
  
  
Since launching in
**January 2015**
and having risen to become the authoritative voice on India’s startup economy, we've moved markets, gotten the early scoop on billions of dollars of transactions, and told you what's happening deep inside some of the fastest-growing startups & industries alike. Our stories have been followed by the Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, Reuters, TechCrunch, and other major outlets hundreds of times. We also track over
**10,000+ startups**
and provide market research and intelligence through our in-depth research reports, and we organise some of the most sought-after conferences and Events for startup & business leaders across India.
  
  
**The Inc42 Impact**

* Inc42 stories reach over 50 Mn+ people monthly
* Published more than 55,000 stories
* Successfully conducted 125+ events
* Launched 100+ research reports
* Receives 500+ startup applications monthly
* Worked with 350+ brands

**Griffin**
is a private, invitation-only club that
**unites India’s top tech founders**
through
**curated experiences, strategic learning, and peer-driven growth**
. Designed for
**India’s unicorn and soonicorn founders**
– building at scale, Griffin offers a
**trusted space**
where founders don’t just network–they
**forge deep, meaningful relationships, share unfiltered insights, and collaborate to shape India’s next chapter of innovation**
.
  
  
From intimate salons and high-trust retreats to access to capital and exclusive opportunities, Griffin offers a
**curated path to clarity, collaboration, and personal growth**
. More than a community, it’s the inner circle powering the next wave of industry-shaping leaders.
  
  
**Why This Role Exists**
Griffin is Inc42's most valuable brand and the one it has marketed least, on purpose. There are no ads, no "join now", no discounts and no always-on feed, because scarcity of content is part of the scarcity of the club. What Griffin has instead is a room, a bar for who gets in, a set of moments that members rearrange their year for, and a voice that has never had a single owner.
  
  
We are hiring that owner. At Griffin, brand marketing
*is*
communication: how the outside learns about the bar without ever being sold a seat; how a member is spoken to on a Tuesday; how a Retreat becomes news without a single member being named; how the object a founder takes home says what the club is. You will own all of it, at both cadences, the daily and the defining.
  
  
**Your Impact In This Role and what you’ll own:**

* Griffin's voice, in practice: every word to a member, a prospective founder, a speaker, a partner, a minister's office or a listed-company founder, across WhatsApp, email, invitations, briefs, the website and the printed thing on the table. Sharp, sparse, warm, never generic.
* Marketing the door: the curation narrative and the "who gets in" beats; a consented, discreet series on what happens in the room; the waitlist and referral-only mechanic made visible; the founders' own channels; griffin.club and the Retreat site. Demand without a single paid rupee.
* Earned media: the stories that come out of Griffin's rooms, placed in tier-1 media without breaking a confidence. A Retreat, a Salon abroad, a member's milestone: you see the news in it and you know who to call.
* Brand moments: how a Salon arrives, what a Retreat leaves in the hand, the partner activations, the gifting drops and the limited editions. You design them; operations, partnerships and design produce them to your brief.
* The referral ask: designed so that being asked to refer feels like status, with the club's owner.
* The systems: message banks, invitation formats, briefing structures, a follow-up tracker, so quality does not depend on last-minute drafting. AI used intelligently for speed; human judgment on every send.
* The leading indicators: qualified applications, waitlist depth, the share of members who joined by referral, earned-media hits, and how the club is recalled by the founders who are not yet in it.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Brand Positioning
* Own Griffin's positioning, narrative, tone of voice and communication principles across all touchpoints.
* Maintain a consistent and distinctive brand identity that reflects Griffin's exclusivity, discretion and founder-first philosophy.
* Lead brand storytelling across Griffin's website, brochures, institutional presentations, event collateral and other brand assets.
* Work closely with design and creative teams to ensure that both visual identity and written communication reflect Griffin's positioning.
* Develop thoughtful organic initiatives that build brand recall, desirability and qualified interest among relevant founders.
* Founder & Member Communications
* Own communication across the member journey — prospect outreach, introductions, onboarding, ongoing engagement, important milestones and renewals.
* Develop personalised communication for founders, members and senior stakeholders through WhatsApp, email, invitations, briefs and other formats.
* Translate Griffin's work, member experiences and key moments into compelling, discreet and founder-first narratives.
* Design communication around referrals, member advocacy and Griffin's curated membership approach.
* Ensure every member interaction feels considered, personal and consistent with the stature of the collective.
* Brand Marketing, PR & Earned Media
* Identify and develop compelling stories emerging from Griffin's Salons, Retreats, institutional engagements and member milestones.
* Build relationships with relevant editors, journalists and media platforms to generate meaningful earned coverage.
* Drive Griffin's organic brand presence through its website, founder channels, selective storytelling and other relevant platforms.
* Build visibility without compromising member confidentiality, private conversations or the discretion expected of Griffin.
* Track qualified founder interest, referrals, earned media and brand visibility indicators.
* Brand Experiences & Event Communication
* Own the brand and communication experience across Griffin Salons, Retreats, private dinners, international delegations and institutional gatherings.
* Lead communication across the event journey — save-the-dates, invitations, speaker communication, agenda narratives, attendee updates and post-event engagement.
* Conceptualise brand moments including gifting, limited-edition keepsakes, welcome experiences and partner-led activations.
* Translate concepts into clear creative briefs and work with design, operations and partnerships teams to bring them to life.
* Ensure every Griffin experience reinforces the brand's premium, thoughtful and understated character.
* Government, Institutional & Strategic Communications
* Develop high-quality communication for government leadership, embassies, regulators, institutional investors, global organisations and strategic partners.
* Support Griffin leadership with institutional decks, briefing notes, formal correspondence, introductions and follow-up communication.
* Position Griffin as a credible collective representing India's leading technology founders.
* Maintain the diplomatic judgment, accuracy and discretion required when engaging with senior stakeholders in India and internationally.
* Brand & Communication Infrastructure
* Build and maintain Griffin's communication repository, including message banks, invitation formats, brand guidelines, founder introduction templates and briefing structures.
* Establish communication calendars, review processes, outreach trackers and follow-up mechanisms.
* Work cross-functionally with design, events, partnerships and Griffin leadership to ensure timely execution.
* Use AI tools intelligently to improve research, drafting and execution speed while retaining human judgment and brand consistency.

**Who You Are**

* You write with restraint. You know the difference between premium and verbose, and you know what not to say. You have a piece you did not publish and you can explain why.
* You have run communications for a senior audience: in luxury or hospitality, private banking or wealth, a premium members' organisation, or as an editor or senior journalist who became a communications lead. Not corporate press-release volume; considered communication for people who are hard to impress.
* You can make news without naming anyone. You have placed stories, you know editors, and you understand that discretion is what makes the story worth telling.
* You have designed a moment, a launch, an arrival, an object, a room, where the brand did the talking and the budget was real.
* You have taste and a bias for action: strong first drafts, the right questions, things pushed to closure without being chased.
* You are discreet by instinct and diplomatic by training. You can write to a founder, a minister and a member in the same hour and get all three right.
* Five to eight years. Ecosystem fluency, or genuine curiosity about India's founders, capital markets and policy, is a strong advantage.

title: Co-Founder
description:
About BookVidya

BookVidya is an early-stage learning venture built around one core belief: knowledge matters most when people can apply it.

We aim to help learners move beyond passive reading and book summaries towards understanding ideas, practising decisions, and applying what they learn in real-life situations.

Our vision is to make learning more practical, engaging, and useful beyond the page.

About the role

We are looking for a genuine
**Co-Founder – Growth & Distribution**
to help shape BookVidya's growth strategy, distribution systems, and go-to-market approach.

This is a founding partnership opportunity, not a conventional marketing position. You will work closely with the founding team to determine how BookVidya reaches its initial audience, earns trust, builds a learner community, and grows sustainably.

You will have meaningful input into strategic decisions and responsibility for turning growth ideas into experiments and repeatable systems.

Key responsibilities

* Develop BookVidya's growth and distribution strategy.
* Identify target audiences, user needs, and early-adopter communities.
* Design and execute organic acquisition strategies across relevant digital channels.
* Build a content distribution strategy that communicates BookVidya's value clearly.
* Explore partnerships, community-led growth, referrals, and other acquisition opportunities.
* Design experiments to acquire and retain engaged learners.
* Track relevant metrics, analyse results, and improve growth initiatives.
* Contribute to product positioning, go-to-market planning, and broader strategic decisions.
* Help establish sustainable processes for long-term growth.

What we're looking for

* Strong strategic thinking and a problem-solving mindset.
* Genuine interest in marketing, distribution, growth, or business strategy.
* Ability to move from ideas to execution and learn from experiments.
* Curiosity about user behaviour, learning, and community building.
* Initiative, ownership, consistency, and comfort with early-stage uncertainty.
* Willingness to collaborate, challenge assumptions constructively, and make decisions together.
* A genuine interest in building a venture over the long term.

Previous startup or growth experience is valuable, but we are open to candidates who can demonstrate strong thinking, initiative, and execution through projects or practical ideas.

A large personal following is not a requirement.

What this opportunity offers

* A genuine opportunity to help build BookVidya from an early stage.
* Shared strategic responsibility for growth and distribution.
* The opportunity to shape the venture's direction alongside the founding team.
* A founding partnership with equity and responsibilities to be discussed transparently and agreed upon.

**Important:**
This is an early-stage co-founder opportunity, not a guaranteed salaried position. Compensation, equity, time commitment, and other founding arrangements will be discussed with suitable candidates before any commitment is made.

How to express interest

Please share a brief introduction, relevant experience or projects, why BookVidya interests you, and how you would approach acquiring our first 100 genuinely engaged learners.

We are looking for a thoughtful partner who wants to build, experiment, and grow with us over the long term.

title: Manager - BCG Vantage
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Topic Activation path within BCG's Principal Investors and Private Equity (PIPE) Practice Area you will work in a growing global team, providing industry/functional expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, analysis and expert advisory. The team uses a variety of number of AI and advanced data analytics tools; and you will be expected to develop expertise on those. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues.
  
  
You will support commercialization efforts for the topic/sector, in conjunction with business leaders, through contributing analysis and insights to proposals, client workshops and marketing materials. Additionally, as a Manager – BCG Vantage, you will help build, own and enhance AI-enabled products, tools and knowledge assets – taking them from problem definition through build, deployment on live cases, and adoption. You will work closely with case teams and business leaders to drive real usage and impact, while helping onboard, train and enable junior colleagues on your topic/sector and on new products.
  
  
BCG’s PIPE Practice Area works with the world’s largest investment firms, serving six client asset classes: Private Equity, Hedge Funds, Infrastructure & Real Estate Funds, Family Offices, Sovereign Wealth Funds and Pension Plans. Likewise, PIPE topics cut across not only these asset classes, but also across industries (e.g., Health Care, Consumer, Technology, etc.) and sub-topics (e.g., Tech Capital, Private Credit, Environmental, Social and Governance, etc.)
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  

* 3+ years consulting experience in PIPE required; candidates with consulting experience preferred
* In lieu of consulting experience, 4+ years minimum industry experience required; 6-10+ years of industry experience strongly preferred
* Bachelor's Degree required (advanced degree preferred)
* Fluency in English;
* Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills to interact with internal and external stakeholder while working in a global collaborative team environment
* Practical fluency with GenAI and modern development tools (e.g. APIs, custom GPTs / AI Skills, coding assistants such as Claude Code or Cursor, GitHub, cloud platforms) strongly preferred; comfort learning new tools as the landscape evolves
* Demonstrated experience managing product roadmaps, backlog prioritization, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment, with comfort in data-driven decision making and familiarity with agile/scrum delivery frameworks

Who You'll Work With
  
  
As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Topic Activation path, you will collaborate with global topic leads and colleagues across BCG to bring expertise and capabilities to the service of our internal and external clients.
  
  
Our team is made up of a diverse pool of BCG Vantage positions that allow us to pursue exciting, innovative BCG Vantage careers.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

* Solving complex client problems through relevant analytical approaches and customized solutions in one or more relevant PIPE topic areas
* Communicating with senior stakeholders, demonstrating the ability to engage your audience effectively
* Demonstrating rapid learning agility across emerging technologies and analytical assets to enhance analysis, develop products, and create scalable, repeatable research and knowledge frameworks
* Managing a portfolio of projects, with strong awareness of business priorities and commercial impact
* Owning the end-to-end lifecycle of AI-enabled products and analytics assets – from problem definition and roadmap through prototyping, build, deployment on live cases, adoption tracking, and ongoing enhancement
* Training, coaching, and mentoring junior team members
* Working in an ever changing and complex environment, and comfortable with ambiguity and navigating a fast-paced environment

**Additional Information**
BCG Vantage is a powerhouse of expertise, seamlessly embedded within Practice Areas and markets to drive extraordinary impact. It equips BCG case teams and clients with cutting-edge expertise, proprietary assets, actionable data, and transformative insights that empower our case teams and enable our clients to achieve their aspirations.
  
  
With global experts across 20 Practices, covering more than 100 topics, sectors and offers, plus four focused geographic markets, BCG Vantage delivers unparalleled depth and breadth of insight & expertise. BCG Vantage consists of three career paths, each playing a crucial role in delivering value to clients, case teams and practice teams.
  
  
***Client Focus (Embedded Expertise)***

* Integrates into client-facing teams to deliver direct client impact through expertise, know-how, and proprietary tools and assets

***Topic Activation (Sector Expertise with Proprietary Tool & Data Solutions)***

* Combines deep domain insights with our know-how and proprietary assets to address targeted challenges directly with clients and project teams; co-creates insights on industry trends and functional topics, proprietary data and tools, and teams to codify IP that all enables BCG to deliver excellent business value with its clients

***Research (Practice Topic and Sector-Aligned Research and Insights)***

* Delivers actionable research and insights tailored to the client project’s needs; works with qualitative and quantitative data, conducts research and provides synthesized results from sources including commercial data, public and open source, company and industry research, macro-economic, commodities and trade data.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
  
  
BCG is an E - Verify Employer. Click here for more information on E-Verify.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
TALENT ACQUISITION MANAGER

**Faridabad, Delhi NCR | On-site | 5–10 years | Reports to Head of HR**

We're hiring a tooling engineer, a colour management specialist, a Mandarin-speaking supplier liaison, an automation manager, a UV printing engineer, a customs specialist and a supply chain head. Different industries, different talent pools, nothing in common.

Almost none of them are on job boards. The tooling engineer is employed and not looking. The colour specialist might be the only one in the city.

That's the job: finding people who aren't advertising that they're findable.

**What you'd build**

* Sourcing pipelines per domain — where each kind of specialist actually sits, and how we reach them
* A referral network through our own engineers, our vendors and our suppliers, who know the good people long before any recruiter does
* An assessment process with the hiring managers, so technical screening is real rather than keyword matching
* An employer brand that makes a specialist in Pune consider Faridabad
* A talent map we can hire from in six months, not start from scratch each time
* Hiring capability for Germany, Australia and the UK as those open

**You'd own**

* End-to-end hiring across engineering, operations, supply chain and corporate roles
* Direct sourcing and outreach — weighted to headhunting, not screening inbound
* Candidate experience through to offer and joining
* Hiring manager partnership: pushing back on unrealistic briefs and helping sharpen them

**You need**

* 5+ years in
  **specialist or technical recruitment.**
  Volume and bulk hiring is a different skill
* **Demonstrated direct sourcing**
  — you've found and closed people who weren't applying
* **Learning velocity.**
  You'll go from tooling to customs to Mandarin liaison in a month and need to sound credible to each
* Manufacturing or engineering hiring experience strongly preferred
* The confidence to tell a hiring manager their brief won't find anyone

**Tell us:**
the hardest role you've ever filled — why it was hard, and how you found the person.

title: Channel Manager, India
description:
**At AlgoSec, What you do matters!**
AlgoSec helps the world’s leading organizations secure application connectivity across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. Trusted by more than 2,300 global organizations, our platform delivers visibility, security policy management, risk reduction, and compliance automation across complex enterprise networks.
  
  
As we continue to expand our cloud and enterprise business globally, we are looking for a
**Channel Manager**
to drive incremental sales and foster the growing AlgoSec channel ECO-System. In this role, you will work closely with our partners to successfully ensure customer satisfaction and that business goals are met within the territory.
  
  
**Reporting to:**
Regional Sales Director
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai /Bangalore, India (Home office)
  
  
Direct employment
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Drive the creation of partner-initiated pipeline and New ARR across India, generating incremental opportunities beyond those originated by the direct sales organization.
* Build and execute joint business plans with AlgoSec’s strategic distributors, leveraging their reseller ecosystem, enterprise relationships and market reach to create new business.
* Identify and activate high-potential Tier 1 and Tier 2 partners, SIs and large account resellers capable of generating meaningful pipelines.
* Drive structured account mapping and whitespace exercises with RSMs, distributors and strategic partners to gain access to AlgoSec’s target enterprise accounts.
* Build sustained AlgoSec mindshare across the India cybersecurity partner ecosystem, positioning AlgoSec around application connectivity, network security policy management and automation across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Establish quarterly business plans, pipeline targets and joint GTM initiatives with strategic partners and measure their performance against pipeline and revenue outcomes.
* Enable partner sales and technical teams to independently identify, position and qualify AlgoSec opportunities within their customer base.
* Collaborate closely with RSMs from opportunity identification through closure, while maintaining clear accountability for the partner-generated component of the pipeline.
* Develop opportunities through strategic technology alliances and routes to market including Cisco, AWS/cloud marketplaces and other relevant ecosystem partners.
* Drive partner-led new-logo acquisition as well as expansion opportunities within the AlgoSec installed base.
* Manage deal registration, partner engagement and channel conflicts while maintaining appropriate partner governance.
* Regularly review partner productivity and focus AlgoSec resources on partners capable of delivering sustainable pipeline and revenue.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 7+ years of enterprise technology/channel experience, preferably within cybersecurity, network security or adjacent infrastructure software.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Management, Marketing, or related field
* through account planning with Tier 1 and Tier 2 Channels/Partners
* Experience in selling B2B SW technology. Experience in selling cybersecurity solutions directly through channels is an added advantage
* Track record of success in establishing new strategic partnerships in India region and helping partners in scaling their business revenue
* Experience using Salesforce
* Self-starter, business-driven, positive and with an energetic attitude
* Great communicator, ability to work with various organizational levels and stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to exceed quarterly quota
* Strong written and interpersonal communications and presentation skills
* English written and verbal skills at a very high level
* Willingness to travel up to 50% of the time
* Proven track record of personally building partner-initiated pipeline and delivering closed revenue through distributors, Tier 1/Tier 2 resellers and system integrators in India.
* Strong existing relationships across the Indian cybersecurity channel ecosystem, with demonstrated ability to activate partners and gain access to large enterprise accounts.

AlgoSec is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating a friendly, diverse, and inclusive company culture.

title: Business Development & Sales Intern
description:
**Business Development & Sales Intern**

**B2B Sales | AI & IT Services | Daphnis Labs**

**Location:**
New Delhi (Work From Office)

**Stipend:**
₹10,000–₹18,000/month + Performance Bonus

**Working Days**
: 6 Days/Week

**Flexibility:**
Option to work from home 1 day per week after completing the first month, subject to approval

**Experience:**
Freshers / 0–1 Year

**About Daphnis Labs**

Daphnis Labs is a technology solutions company helping businesses build, automate, and scale through AI, custom software development, SaaS, web and mobile applications, and digital transformation. We work with businesses across industries to solve real problems using technology. We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just want to learn sales — but wants to become genuinely good at it.

**The Opportunity**

This is not an internship where you simply copy-paste emails, collect random leads, or wait for instructions.

You’ll learn how to identify business opportunities, connect with founders and decision-makers, understand their challenges, and turn conversations into real business opportunities. You’ll get exposure to B2B sales, international client acquisition, AI-powered prospecting, and the complete business development process.
**Pre-Placement Offer (PPO): High-performing interns will be eligible for a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) for a full-time position at Daphnis Labs upon successful completion of the 6-month internship, based on performance, skills, and overall contribution.**

**What You’ll Actually Do**

1. Find the Right Businesses

\* Research potential clients in India and international markets.

\* Identify founders, CEOs, CTOs, and other decision-makers.

\* Understand businesses, their challenges, and where Daphnis Labs can add value.

\* Use LinkedIn, Google, AI research tools, and other prospecting platforms to discover opportunities.

2. Start Meaningful Conversations

\* Reach out through cold emails, LinkedIn messages, calls, and professional networking.

\* Write personalized messages instead of sending generic sales pitches.

\* Confidently introduce our services and communicate our value.

\* Follow up consistently and professionally to build interest.

3. Turn Leads Into Opportunities

\* Qualify prospects based on their business needs and potential fit.

\* Schedule discovery calls and meetings with interested clients.

\* Support proposals, presentations, and client discussions.

\* Maintain accurate lead records and follow-up schedules.

4. Use AI to Work Smarter

\* Use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity for prospect research, market intelligence, and outreach preparation.

\* Identify business opportunities using AI-assisted research.

\* Experiment with different outreach approaches and improve messaging based on results.

\* Explore ways to automate repetitive sales tasks without compromising personalization.

5. Own Your Results

\* Track outreach, responses, follow-ups, qualified leads, and meetings.

\* Understand what works, what doesn’t, and continuously improve.

\* Take responsibility for your pipeline and assigned targets.

**The Mindset We’re Looking For**

Sales Mindset: You enjoy conversations, understand that sales is about solving problems, and are motivated by measurable results.

Perseverance: You don’t give up after hearing “no.” You understand that rejection and follow-ups are part of sales.

Excellent Communication: You can speak and write clear, professional English and confidently engage with new people.

Confidence & Initiative: You’re comfortable approaching strangers, asking questions, and taking the first step.

Curiosity: You genuinely want to understand businesses, technology, customer psychology, and why people buy.

Ownership: You don’t need constant reminders to follow up, complete tasks, or improve your work.

Adaptability: You’re excited to learn new tools, especially AI, and find smarter ways to achieve results.

**Who Can Apply?**

\* Students, recent graduates, and freshers from BBA, MBA, B.Com, Marketing, or any relevant background.

\* Candidates with strong spoken and written English.

\* People comfortable with cold calling, outreach, and interacting with professionals.

\* Individuals interested in B2B sales, technology, startups, and AI.

\* Basic knowledge of LinkedIn, Excel/Google Sheets, and AI tools is an advantage.

\* Previous sales experience is appreciated but not mandatory.

We value communication, attitude, perseverance, and willingness to learn more than your degree.

**Compensation & Performance Rewards**

\* Month 1: ₹10,000 fixed stipend

\* Month 2: ₹12,000 fixed stipend

\* Month 3 Onwards: ₹12,000–₹18,000 based on performance

\* Additional Performance Bonus: Earn incentives for achieving defined sales milestones, qualified meetings, and successful client conversions.

Performance bonuses are additional to the monthly stipend and depend on the company’s incentive policy.

**Work Arrangement**

\* Full-time, primarily in-office role in New Delhi.

\* 6 working days per week.

\* First month: Work from office.

\* From the second month: Option for 1 work-from-home day per week, subject to approval and work requirements.

**What You’ll Gain**

\* Hands-on experience in real B2B and international sales.

\* Exposure to AI, SaaS, software engineering, and technology consulting.

\* Practical training in prospecting, outreach, negotiation, and client communication.

\* Experience with modern AI-powered sales and research tools.

\* Opportunity to contribute directly to business growth.

\* Potential full-time employment opportunity based on performance.

Good communication gets you noticed. Perseverance, curiosity, and execution will help you succeed here.

title: Business Development Head – European Fashion Market
description:
Job Description: Business Development Head – European Fashion Market

Company: Fasshinix

Department: Business Development & International Sales

Industry: Fashion, Apparel, Sourcing & Manufacturing

Experience: Minimum 3+ Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Compensation: ₹60,000 per month during probation + 1.5% incentive; ₹80,000–₹1,00,000 per month after successful completion of probation

Location: To be discussed during the interview

About Fasshinix

Fasshinix partners with fashion brands to deliver end-to-end apparel solutions, including product development, fabric sourcing, sampling, manufacturing, quality control, and production management. We are looking for a commercially driven Business Development Head to expand our presence in the European fashion market and build strong, long-term relationships with international clients.

Role Overview

The Business Development Head will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, developing strategic relationships with European fashion brands and buyers, and driving revenue growth through international business development. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of the European fashion and apparel industry, an established professional network, and a proven ability to convert prospects into profitable business partnerships.

Key Responsibilities

International Business Development: Identify, approach, and acquire new clients across the European fashion and apparel market.

Client Acquisition: Build relationships with fashion brands, apparel retailers, sourcing companies, buying houses, and procurement teams.

Market Expansion: Develop and execute strategies to expand Fasshinix’s presence in key European markets.

Lead Generation: Generate qualified leads through networking, industry research, referrals, professional platforms, and relevant industry events.

Relationship Management: Build and maintain long-term relationships with international clients and key decision-makers.

Sales & Revenue Growth: Manage the business development pipeline, negotiate commercial terms, and convert opportunities into confirmed orders.

Client Requirement Analysis: Understand European buyers’ expectations regarding product development, fabric selection, sampling, pricing, quality standards, and production timelines.

Cross-Functional Coordination: Work closely with internal sourcing, merchandising, sampling, production, and quality teams to deliver client requirements.

Market Intelligence: Monitor European fashion trends, competitor activities, sourcing requirements, and emerging business opportunities.

Reporting & Forecasting: Maintain accurate lead records, sales forecasts, client communications, and business development reports.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Minimum 3+ years of experience in business development, international sales, fashion sourcing, apparel manufacturing, garment exports, or a related industry.

Strong knowledge of the European fashion and apparel market.

An established network of European fashion brands, buyers, sourcing teams, retailers, or buying houses.

Proven experience in generating leads, acquiring clients, and converting business opportunities into revenue.

Good understanding of apparel sourcing, product development, manufacturing processes, and international buyer expectations.

Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.

Strong commercial awareness with the ability to identify profitable growth opportunities.

Professional proficiency in English and confidence in communicating with international clients.

Preferred Skills

Existing relationships with European fashion brands and apparel buyers.

Experience in garment exports, private-label apparel, OEM/ODM manufacturing, or end-to-end apparel sourcing.

Familiarity with international B2B sales cycles and export business requirements.

Ability to work independently, develop market-entry strategies, and take ownership of business growth.

Compensation & Incentives

During probation: ₹60,000 per month + 1.5% incentive.

After successful completion of probation: ₹80,000–₹1,00,000 per month.

Incentive structure, performance expectations, and other applicable benefits will be discussed during the interview.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a proactive business development professional who brings more than industry knowledge—someone with meaningful market connections, a strong commercial mindset, and the ability to turn relationships into sustainable business growth.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with a brief summary of their European market experience, existing industry network, and relevant business development achievements.

Email: HR@jobsahihai.com

Call/WhatsApp: +91 85956 25080

About FBCI

Fitness Business Coaching India (FBCI) is a premium business coaching and consulting company that helps fitness coaches, nutritionists, and health professionals build, grow, and scale profitable online coaching businesses.

We help entrepreneurs improve their client acquisition, sales processes, marketing strategies, business positioning, and operational systems.

Our mentorship programs range from ₹90,000 to ₹5,00,000+.

As we expand, we're looking for a highly motivated and communication-driven
**Lead Qualification & Appointment Setting Specialist**
to join our sales team.

Important: This Is NOT a Traditional Telecalling Job

We are not hiring someone to simply make calls, read scripts, or fill our sales team's calendar.

**Your primary responsibility is to pre-qualify every incoming lead before they are connected with our sales department.**

You'll speak with fitness coaches and business owners, understand their current situation, identify their challenges, assess their investment readiness, and determine whether they're a suitable fit for our premium mentorship programs.

You must be someone who
**genuinely loves talking to people, enjoys understanding their problems, and is passionate about helping them find the right solutions.**

This role requires strong communication skills, business understanding, patience, persistence, and excellent follow-up discipline.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Lead Qualification**

* Contact incoming leads through phone calls and WhatsApp.
* Conduct structured pre-qualification conversations.
* Understand prospects' current monthly revenue, business challenges, goals, and growth expectations.
* Assess their financial readiness and ability to invest in premium mentorship programs.
* Identify serious prospects who are genuinely interested in growing their businesses.
* Ensure only qualified leads are forwarded to the sales department.

**2. Appointment Setting**

* Book strategy consultations with the sales team for qualified prospects.
* Clearly communicate the purpose and expectations of the consultation.
* Coordinate appointment timings and ensure proper scheduling.
* Confirm appointments and maximize show-up rates.

**3. Follow-Ups & Relationship Building**

* Conduct multiple follow-ups with prospects through calls and WhatsApp.
* Maintain consistent communication with interested leads.
* Re-engage prospects who haven't responded or booked their consultations.
* Build genuine relationships rather than using aggressive sales tactics.
* Ensure no qualified lead is neglected due to poor follow-up.

**4. CRM & Sales Coordination**

* Maintain accurate lead information and conversation notes in the CRM.
* Update lead statuses, qualification details, and follow-up schedules.
* Coordinate with the sales closers to ensure smooth handovers.
* Provide regular updates on lead quality, appointment bookings, and follow-up performance.

Who We're Looking For

* Someone who genuinely enjoys talking to people and building relationships.
* Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Strong listening, questioning, and interpersonal skills.
* Minimum 1 year of experience in appointment setting, inside sales, lead qualification, or a similar role.
* Comfortable making multiple calls and follow-ups daily.
* Ability to understand business problems and ask intelligent questions.
* Confident discussing revenue, business growth, and premium investments with entrepreneurs.
* Highly organized, self-motivated, disciplined, and target-oriented.
* Comfortable using CRM software, Google Sheets, and WhatsApp.
* Someone who takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions.

**Preferred:**
Experience in business coaching, consulting, premium mentorship, digital marketing agencies, or high-ticket service businesses.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Your performance will be measured by:

* Lead response time
* Number of leads contacted and qualified
* Qualified appointments booked
* Appointment show-up rate
* Follow-up completion rate
* Quality of appointments passed to the sales team
* CRM accuracy and lead management
* Contribution to overall sales conversions

**We value qualified appointments over the total number of appointments booked.**

Who Should NOT Apply

* Someone looking for a basic telecalling or scripted calling job.
* Someone who dislikes speaking with people or making follow-up calls.
* Candidates who book appointments without understanding the prospect's needs.
* Individuals who give up after one or two unsuccessful contact attempts.
* Someone who prioritizes quantity over quality.
* Candidates who are uncomfortable with accountability and performance targets.

What We Offer

* Fixed salary with performance-based incentives.
* Inbound leads generated through our marketing campaigns.
* Opportunity to work directly with fitness entrepreneurs and business owners.
* Training in business consultation, qualification, and premium sales processes.
* A performance-driven and growth-focused working environment.
* Career growth opportunities in Sales Operations, Senior Appointment Setting, and Sales Leadership.

How to Apply

Please submit your updated resume along with answers to these questions:

1. How much experience do you have in lead qualification or appointment setting?
2. How many leads or calls have you handled daily in your previous role?
3. Have you worked with high-ticket services or premium coaching programs?
4. How do you handle prospects who don't respond after multiple follow-ups?
5. Why do you believe you're a good fit for this role?

Our Hiring Philosophy

**We don't need someone who just makes 100 calls a day.**

We need someone who can turn meaningful conversations into qualified business opportunities.

Someone who listens carefully, asks the right questions, follows up consistently, and genuinely enjoys helping people.

**At FBCI, your success is not measured by how many appointments you book, but by how many of the right prospects you bring to our sales team.**

If you're a people person who loves conversations, takes ownership, and thrives in a performance-driven environment, we'd love to hear from you.

* **Apply now and become part of Fitness Business Coaching India (FBCI).**

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:

* Qualified meetings booked and held (your headline number)
* Reply rate and booking rate by channel
* Healthy sending domains and low bounce rates

Goyal Gourav & Co. is a Chartered Accountancy firm providing professional services in audit and assurance, taxation, accounting, regulatory compliance, and business advisory. We are committed to delivering reliable, accurate, and timely financial solutions to our clients.

* Assist in income tax return preparation and filing for individuals, firms, and companies.

title: Business Operations | CEO’s Office
description:
**We’re looking for someone who wants to get into everything.**

Aidentifi is building an AI-native way of running an executive search business, and we’re looking for an unusually organised, commercially curious operator to work closely with the CEO.

This is not a traditional finance or administrative role.

You’ll work across commercial operations, resource utilisation, contracts, workflows, research, presentations and CEO priorities. Importantly, you’ll also become a
**driver and navigator of our internal operating system**
, helping us run the business through it and continuously make it better.

**What you’ll do**

* Run & improve the operating system
* Become a power user and day-to-day operator of Aidentifi’s AI driven internal operating system
* Make sure mandates, priorities, information and follow-ups move through the system properly
* Spot where processes break, information gets lost or people work around the system
* Work with our business and technology teams to improve workflows, automation and AI assistance
* Test new ways of working in the real world and help turn what works into repeatable processes
* Help us answer a simple question:
  **how should an AI-native company actually operate?**

**Business & commercial operations**

* Analyse resource utilisation, client economics and business performance
* Support proposals, contracts, commercial decisions, invoicing and collections
* Build useful dashboards, analyses and management information
* Coordinate across clients, teams and external partners
* Find operational gaps and take ownership of fixing them

**CEO’s Office**

* Help translate priorities into execution
* Keep important decisions, commitments and follow-ups moving
* Prepare presentations, analyses and briefing materials
* Research companies, industries, business ideas and investments
* Get rapidly up to speed on unfamiliar topics and turn messy information into a structured point of view
* Help prioritise what actually deserves attention

And plenty that isn't listed here.

**The breadth is intentional.**

Who we’re looking for

We want someone who is:

* Exceptionally organised and detail-oriented
* Commercially curious and comfortable with numbers
* Good at creating structure from ambiguity
* Strong with Excel and PowerPoint
* Interested in AI, technology and automation
* A clear writer and communicator
* Able to move comfortably between analysis and execution
* Fast at learning unfamiliar subjects
* High-agency and comfortable figuring things out
* The kind of person who notices when something doesn't work and wants to fix it

A
**CA/accounting, finance, consulting or similarly rigorous background**
could be particularly relevant, but this is
**not an accounting position**
. Our accounting and compliance work is handled by external professionals.

We're interested in the discipline those backgrounds can develop: numerical fluency, reliability, structured thinking and attention to detail.

Why this role is different

You'll have an unusual vantage point across the company.

You'll see the commercial side of the business, its numbers, customers, people, systems and decisions. At the same time, you'll help us figure out how
**AI, automation and good operating discipline can change the way a company actually works**
.

You won't just use the operating system.

**You'll help us learn how it should work.**

For someone early in their career who ultimately wants to become a
**BizOps leader, Chief of Staff, general manager, COO or entrepreneur**
, that's a pretty interesting place to sit.

If your reaction to something unfamiliar is:

**“Let me understand it, structure it and figure it out.”**

We'd like to hear from you.

title: Business Office Coordinator
description:
**Job Description – Business Office Coordinator**

**Company:**
Fire Remedy Systems

**Location:**
South Extension Part-I, New Delhi

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time, On-Site

**1. Company Description**

Fire Remedy Systems (FRS) is an established organization specializing in fire safety, fire detection, fire alarm, and fire-fighting solutions and Electrical/ELV & Civil works. We are looking for a responsible, organized, and computer-proficient professional to manage day-to-day office activities and provide administrative, Billing, procurement, and project documentation support.

**2. Role Description**

The Business Office Coordinator will be responsible for managing routine office operations, maintaining company records, coordinating procurement activities, supporting accounts and billing, and ensuring the timely preparation and submission of business documents. The role requires hands-on experience with office software, accounting applications, spreadsheets, email communication, and digital documentation.

The candidate must be capable of independently handling multiple office responsibilities, maintaining accurate records, coordinating with suppliers, clients, project teams, and accountants, and ensuring timely follow-up on pending tasks.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Office Administration and Documentation**

* Manage daily office operations, filing, correspondence, and document control.
* Draft professional letters, emails, quotations, purchase orders, work orders, and other business communications.
* Prepare, format, edit, and maintain documents using MS Word.
* Maintain digital and physical records of contracts, invoices, purchase orders, employee documents, and project files.
* Maintain registers, trackers, and follow-up sheets for pending approvals, payments, submissions, and other office activities.
* Scan, print, merge, convert, and organize PDF documents for official submissions.

**B. Computer and Software Proficiency**

* **MS Excel:**
  Prepare and maintain data sheets, purchase registers, expense statements, payment trackers, stock registers, reconciliation sheets, and MIS reports using formulas, sorting, filtering, and lookup functions.
* **MS Word:**
  Draft and format official letters, agreements, reports, quotations, and other business documents.
* **MS Outlook / Gmail:**
  Handle official emails, attachments, follow-ups, meeting schedules, and correspondence records.
* **PDF Software:**
  Manage document merging, splitting, conversion, compression, page arrangement, and basic editing.
* **Google Workspace / Microsoft 365:**
  Maintain shared files, spreadsheets, calendars, and digital records.
* Adapt quickly to the company's existing billing, procurement, inventory, and project handling.

**C. Billing and Payment Follow-Up**

* Prepare department billings, maintain payment schedules and follow up with clients, vendors, and internal teams regarding pending bills and payments.

**D. Procurement and Vendor Coordination**

* Obtain and compare quotations from suppliers and prepare comparative statements.
* Prepare purchase orders, work orders, material requirement sheets, and procurement trackers.
* Coordinate with vendors regarding prices, delivery schedules, payment terms, and pending supplies. Maintain vendor databases, purchase records, delivery challans, and material receipt details.
* Track material requirements and coordinate with project teams to ensure timely procurement.

**E. Project and Business Support**

* Maintain project-wise folders containing work orders, purchase orders, invoices, measurement and billing documents, and correspondence.
* Track the status of running bills, payment certificates, approvals, and outstanding amounts.
* Coordinate with clients, contractors, suppliers, and site staff for documentation and information requirements.

**4. Required Qualifications and Skills**

* Graduate or diploma holder in Commerce, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field.
* Minimum 2–4 years of relevant experience in office administration, accounts support, procurement coordination, or business operations.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Word, email applications, and PDF management tools.
* Practical knowledge of accounting software/ERP is preferred.
* Good command of written and spoken English and Hindi.
* Ability to draft professional emails and official letters independently.
* Strong numerical accuracy, data-entry skills, document management, and follow-up abilities.
* Experience in a contracting, engineering, construction, or project-based organization will be an added advantage.

**5. Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a dependable, detail-oriented, and computer-savvy professional who can independently manage routine office work, maintain accurate records, coordinate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, and ensure that assigned tasks are completed on time with minimal supervision.

The Senior Accountant (GST & Payroll) will manage end-to-end accounting activities with a primary focus on Goods and Services Tax (GST) compliance and payroll processing. * Hands-on experience with accounting and payroll software (e.g., Tally, ERP systems, Excel), and comfort working with spreadsheets and financial tools.
* Ability to support internal and external audits, maintain documentation, and ensure adherence to regulatory and organizational policies.

title: Business Operations | CEO’s Office
description:
**We’re looking for someone who wants to get into everything.**

Aidentifi is building an AI-native way of running an executive search business, and we’re looking for an unusually organised, commercially curious operator to work closely with the CEO.

This is not a traditional finance or administrative role.

You’ll work across commercial operations, resource utilisation, contracts, workflows, research, presentations and CEO priorities. Importantly, you’ll also become a
**driver and navigator of our internal operating system**
, helping us run the business through it and continuously make it better.

**What you’ll do**

* Run & improve the operating system
* Become a power user and day-to-day operator of Aidentifi’s AI driven internal operating system
* Make sure mandates, priorities, information and follow-ups move through the system properly
* Spot where processes break, information gets lost or people work around the system
* Work with our business and technology teams to improve workflows, automation and AI assistance
* Test new ways of working in the real world and help turn what works into repeatable processes
* Help us answer a simple question:
  **how should an AI-native company actually operate?**

**Business & commercial operations**

* Analyse resource utilisation, client economics and business performance
* Support proposals, contracts, commercial decisions, invoicing and collections
* Build useful dashboards, analyses and management information
* Coordinate across clients, teams and external partners
* Find operational gaps and take ownership of fixing them

**CEO’s Office**

* Help translate priorities into execution
* Keep important decisions, commitments and follow-ups moving
* Prepare presentations, analyses and briefing materials
* Research companies, industries, business ideas and investments
* Get rapidly up to speed on unfamiliar topics and turn messy information into a structured point of view
* Help prioritise what actually deserves attention

And plenty that isn't listed here.

**The breadth is intentional.**

Who we’re looking for

We want someone who is:

* Exceptionally organised and detail-oriented
* Commercially curious and comfortable with numbers
* Good at creating structure from ambiguity
* Strong with Excel and PowerPoint
* Interested in AI, technology and automation
* A clear writer and communicator
* Able to move comfortably between analysis and execution
* Fast at learning unfamiliar subjects
* High-agency and comfortable figuring things out
* The kind of person who notices when something doesn't work and wants to fix it

A
**CA/accounting, finance, consulting or similarly rigorous background**
could be particularly relevant, but this is
**not an accounting position**
. Our accounting and compliance work is handled by external professionals.

We're interested in the discipline those backgrounds can develop: numerical fluency, reliability, structured thinking and attention to detail.

Why this role is different

You'll have an unusual vantage point across the company.

You'll see the commercial side of the business, its numbers, customers, people, systems and decisions. At the same time, you'll help us figure out how
**AI, automation and good operating discipline can change the way a company actually works**
.

You won't just use the operating system.

**You'll help us learn how it should work.**

For someone early in their career who ultimately wants to become a
**BizOps leader, Chief of Staff, general manager, COO or entrepreneur**
, that's a pretty interesting place to sit.

If your reaction to something unfamiliar is:

**“Let me understand it, structure it and figure it out.”**

We'd like to hear from you.

We're Hitachi Digital, a company at the forefront of digital transformation and the fastest growing division of Hitachi Group. We're crucial to the company's strategy and ambition to become a premier global player in the massive and fast-moving digital transformation market.
  
  
Our group companies, including GlobalLogic, Hitachi Digital Services, Hitachi Vantara and more, offer comprehensive services that span the entire digital lifecycle, from initial idea to full-scale operation and the infrastructure to run it on. Hitachi Digital represents One Hitachi, integrating domain knowledge and digital capabilities, and harnessing the power of the entire portfolio of services, technologies, and partnerships, to accelerate synergy creation and make real-world impact for our customers and society as a whole.
  
  
Imagine the sheer breadth of talent it takes to unleash a digital future. We don't expect you to 'fit' every requirement – your life experience, character, perspective, and passion for achieving great things in the world are equally as important to us.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a
**Senior Oracle EBS HRMS Techno-Functional Consultant**
to join our ERP team. This role is pivotal in driving the development, customization, support, and ongoing enhancement of Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) HRMS modules, ensuring alignment with evolving business needs. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Oracle HRMS R12 and a solid understanding of end-to-end HR processes, including Payroll, Absence Management, and Core HR functionalities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and support Oracle EBS HRMS modules: Core HR, Payroll, Absence Management, Timesheet
* Collaborate closely with business and functional stakeholders to support the Hire-to-Retire process
* Develop and maintain PL/SQL procedures, functions, packages, and Fast Formulae
* Design and generate reports using XML Publisher, Oracle Reports 6i/10g, and create interactive dashboards
* Customize Oracle workflows using Oracle Workflow Builder
* Utilize standard APIs and interfaces for data processing and third-party integration
* Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize existing customizations and reports
* Participate in and contribute to at least three full-cycle Oracle HRMS implementations
* Provide ongoing support, enhancements, and upgrades to Oracle HRMS modules

**Must-Have Technical Skills**

* Proven hands-on experience with Oracle HRMS R12 modules
* Strong knowledge of Oracle Applications architecture, database design, and HRMS data models
* Proficiency in SQL, PL/SQL, and Oracle Fast Formula
* Expertise in Oracle Reports, Workflows, and XML Publisher
* Experience working with HRMS APIs, interfaces, and data migration scripts

**Desirable Skills (Nice To Have)**

* Experience with Oracle AME (Approval Management Engine)
* Workday integration experience
* OAF (Oracle Application Framework) personalization and extension skills
* Development experience using Oracle Forms 6i/10g
* Familiarity with tools such as TOAD, SQL Navigator, SQL Plus
* Prior integration experience with third-party applications/tools
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and time management skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities for effective cross-functional collaboration

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field
* Oracle certifications (preferred but not mandatory)

**About Us**
We're a global, 1000-strong, diverse team of professional experts, promoting and delivering Social Innovation through our One Hitachi initiative (OT x IT x Product) and working on projects that have a real-world impact. We're curious, passionate and empowered, blending our legacy of 110 years of innovation with our shaping our future. Here you're not just another employee; you're part of a tradition of excellence and a community working towards creating a digital future.
  
  
Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives
  
  
Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.
  
  
We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.
  
  
How we look after you
  
  
We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.
  
  
*We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic.*
Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

title: Senior Lead Technical Analyst
description:
**Overview**
**WELCOME TO**
**SITA**
We're the team that keeps airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our tech and communication innovations are the secret behind the success of the world’s air travel industry.
  
  
You'll find us at 95% of international hubs. We partner closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients, each with their own unique needs and challenges. Our goal is to find fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to make their operations run like clockwork. Want to be a part of something big?
  
  
Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
  
  
**About The Role & Team**
We are seeking a highly experienced
**Senior Lead Technical Analyst**
to drive the strategic evolution of our ServiceNow platform, with a particular focus on
**Customer Service Management (CSM)**
and
**Sales & Order Management (SOM)**
capabilities.
  
  
This role will play a critical part in building internal expertise across newly adopted ServiceNow modules, driving platform governance, shaping the roadmap, and ensuring successful business adoption across the organization. The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders, translating business objectives into scalable ServiceNow solutions while championing innovation through AI-enabled capabilities.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines deep ServiceNow expertise with strong business process transformation experience and a proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, drive organizational change, and lead enterprise-wide initiatives.
  
  
Experience within telecommunications, technology, or global enterprise environments is highly desirable.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Platform Strategy & Leadership**

* Define and drive the strategic roadmap for ServiceNow CSM and SOM capabilities.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance across ServiceNow implementation and enhancement initiatives.
* Establish governance frameworks, standards, and best practices for platform development and administration.
* Partner with architects, business leaders, and product teams to ensure platform investments align with organizational objectives.
* Evaluate emerging ServiceNow capabilities and recommend opportunities for innovation and optimization.

**ServiceNow CSM & SOM Transformation**

* Lead the implementation, configuration, and continuous improvement of ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM) and Sales & Order Management (SOM).
* Design scalable business processes and operating models that maximize value from ServiceNow investments.
* Support business stakeholders through transformation initiatives, ensuring adoption of new ways of working.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and drive automation across customer-facing and order management workflows.
* Ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution design.

**AI & Innovation**

* Lead assessment, evaluation, and implementation of AI-powered capabilities within the ServiceNow ecosystem.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI for customer experience improvements, workflow automation, and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to AI governance, risk management, compliance, and adoption frameworks.
* Stay informed on industry trends, emerging technologies, and ServiceNow AI developments.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Change Management**

* Build strong relationships with executive stakeholders and business leaders.
* Facilitate workshops and strategy sessions to define future-state processes and platform capabilities.
* Lead organizational change initiatives associated with technology transformation.
* Influence stakeholders to secure buy-in and adoption of new solutions and operating models.
* Mentor and develop internal teams, helping build long-term ServiceNow expertise within the organization.

**Governance & Continuous Improvement**

* Define and maintain platform architecture principles and governance processes.
* Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards and technology strategy.
* Monitor platform performance and recommend enhancements to improve user experience and business outcomes.
* Support vendor management, licensing optimization, and strategic technology partnerships.
* Maintain architecture documentation, standards, and technical roadmaps.

**Qualifications**
**ABOUT YOUR SKILLS**




+ Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or a related discipline.
+ Extensive experience working with the ServiceNow platform in enterprise environments.
+ Demonstrated experience implementing and/or supporting ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM) and/or Sales & Order Management (SOM).
+ Strong understanding of service management, customer operations, and order management processes.
+ Proven experience leading large-scale digital transformation initiatives.
+ Experience defining platform strategies, governance models, and architectural standards.
+ Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
+ Ability to translate complex business requirements into technical solutions and roadmaps.
+ Experience driving organizational change and business adoption of new technologies.
+ Experience working in Agile delivery environments.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* ServiceNow CSM Implementation Specialist certification.
* ServiceNow SOM implementation experience.
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD).
* Experience with ServiceNow AI, GenAI, Predictive Intelligence, Virtual Agent, or similar capabilities.
* Telecommunications industry experience.
* Experience leading global or geographically distributed teams.
* Knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks and governance practices.

**Nice to Have**

* ITSM and ITOM experience.
* Experience with telecom service delivery and customer operations.
* ServiceNow Integration Hub and Workflow Automation.
* Enterprise architecture and operating model design.
* Vendor management and contract negotiations.
* Data analytics, reporting, and KPI framework development.

**What We Offer**
We’re all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We’re really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
  
  
🏡
**Flex Week:**
Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team’s needs)
  
  
⏰
**Flex Day:**
Make your workday suit your life and plans.
  
  
🌎

Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
  
  
🌿
