title: BC Sector O And G-Cognite-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Cognite Solution Architect – Senior Manager**
**Experience Level - 15+**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Cognite Solution Architect to design industrial data solutions for upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations. You will define how operational, enterprise and engineering information is integrated, modelled and contextualized in Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), and how applications and analytical solutions consume that information. You will own solution architecture decisions, establish reusable implementation patterns and resolve complex technical issues across source systems, data models, access controls and consuming applications.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include:**
**Architecture and integration**

* Translate operational use cases into data requirements, integration designs and application-consumption patterns.
* Define how CDF fits within historian, enterprise application, engineering information and cloud architectures.
* Select source-appropriate extractors, APIs and processing patterns, considering latency, throughput, connectivity and source-system load.
* Define historical loading, incremental extraction, reconciliation and recovery approaches, including late records, corrections and supported deletions.
* Establish requirements for service identities, access capabilities, environment separation, monitoring and operational support.

**Industrial information modelling**

* Design CDF models using spaces, containers, views and instances; select direct relations or edges according to relationship semantics and query requirements.
* Reuse and extend Cognite’s Core Data Model where suitable, introducing custom domain concepts where required.
* Define stable identifiers, source crosswalks and conflict-resolution rules, including repeated tag names across sites and systems.
* Represent physical equipment, functional locations and installation history separately where required.
* Establish schema versioning, migration and consumer-compatibility requirements while preserving lineage, timestamps, units, quality indicators and relationship provenance.

**Contextualization and Oil & Gas semantics**

* Design relationships connecting equipment and assets with time series, maintenance records, documents and engineering diagrams.
* Define matching rules, confidence thresholds, exception handling and domain review for ambiguous associations; assess coverage and match accuracy separately.
* For upstream applications, model fields, wells, wellbores, production facilities, equipment, well tests and interventions, preserving distinctions between measured, calculated and allocated production.
* For downstream applications, model sites, process units, functional locations, equipment, laboratory results and maintenance activities, accounting for replacement, revisions and measurement timing.
* Validate that contextualized information supports the intended engineering workflow.
* Application enablement and technical assurance
* Define consumer data contracts covering entities, relationships, fields, freshness, permissions and query-performance expectations.
* Validate designs against representative Cognite applications, custom applications, and analytical or AI workflows.
* Develop critical prototypes and reference implementations using Python, SQL, Cognite SDKs and APIs.
* Establish deployment and environment-promotion practices using version control, automated validation and Cognite Toolkit.
* Review architecture changes, migration plans, integration code and performance bottlenecks; resolve cross-system design conflicts and mentor data engineering leads.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A relevant engineering, computer science or information systems degree, or equivalent technical experience.
* Demonstrated personal architectural contribution to a production Cognite Data Fusion implementation.
* Strong knowledge of CDF data modelling, transformations, contextualization and access controls.
* Substantial industrial data integration experience spanning representative operational, enterprise and engineering sources.
* Strong Python and SQL skills with practical Cognite SDK and REST API experience.
* Experience defining identity strategies, model evolution, deployment patterns and production support requirements.
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture, identity providers, network boundaries and CI/CD.
* Strong Oil & Gas implementation experience in at least one upstream or downstream domain, with ability to adapt relevant concepts to the other.

**Good to Have**

* Cognite implementation experience across multiple assets or sites.
* Experience spanning both upstream and downstream.
* Familiarity with historians, maintenance systems, laboratory systems, engineering repositories or well-data services.
* Experience with diagram contextualization, 3D associations and industrial knowledge graphs.
* Experience enabling Cognite applications or AI workflows using contextualized data.
* Relevant Cognite Academy training or certifications.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on architect who can defend consequential production Cognite decisions involving identity resolution, data-model design, access boundaries, recovery, schema migration and application compatibility, and demonstrate which patterns can be reused across sites and which require adaptation.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Job Title: Distinguished Engineer - Data Architect**

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a Distinguished Engineer- Data Architect to design and build the data foundation for our AI-driven security platform. In this role, you will own the architectural blueprint and core implementation of our data strategy, transforming massive streams of high-velocity network traffic logs, customer configurations, and security alerts into high-performance, ML-ready data fabrics.

As part of a lean, elite three-person Data & AI team, you will serve as the ultimate technical authority on data scale, streaming architecture, multi-tenant security, and cost-efficient storage systems.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* ****Architect the Core Data Platform:****
  Design, implement, and evolve a unified blueprint for streaming and batch data processing capable of ingesting, normalizing, and storing petabyte-scale, high-velocity security telemetry.
* ****Enable AI & Advanced Analytics:****
  Partner directly with the Lead AI Engineer to architect the underlying storage, retrieval systems, and feature stores—including optimal vector database structures and data lakehouse layers—required for low-latency AI inference and training.
* ****Enforce Zero-Trust Data Governance:****
  Architect strict multi-tenant isolation, data privacy guardrails, and compliance controls directly into the data fabric to protect sensitive customer network configurations and logs.
* ****Optimize Economics & Performance:****
  Drive infrastructure cost-efficiency and performance tuning across data processing engines, storage layers, and cloud infrastructure, balancing ultra-low latency requirements with predictable cost scaling.
* ****Lead by Example:****
  Write clean, foundational, high-performance code for critical infrastructure components, setting the standard for engineering excellence within the team.

**Required Experience & Skills:**

* ****Experience:****
  **12+ years of data engineering and architecture experience, with a proven track record of designing production systems handling massive, high-throughput streaming datasets (e.g., networking logs, telemetry, or real-time event streams).**
* ****Distributed Systems Expertise:****
  Deep, authoritative knowledge of distributed processing and streaming engines (e.g., Apache Flink, Spark, Kafka, Pulsar) and modern lakehouse architectures (e.g., Iceberg, Delta Lake).
* ****Hybrid Storage Architecture:****
  Mastery of polyglot persistence, spanning traditional relational databases, NoSQL, Columnar engines (e.g., ClickHouse, DuckDB), and Vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone).
* ****Security & Infrastructure:****
  Strong fundamentals in secure data architectures, network topography, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, containerization (Kubernetes), and cloud-native infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure).
* ****Mindset:****
  A rare combination of visionary architecture and hands-on execution. You thrive in ultra-lean teams, enjoy writing core code, and possess the pragmatism to build for immediate needs while planning for massive scale.

SonicWall is an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.
  
  
At SonicWall, we pride ourselves on recruiting a diverse mix of talented people and providing active security solutions in 100+ countries.

title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
The
**Lead Forward Deployed Engineer**
operates at the intersection of engineering, data, and customer deployment. In this hands-on, customer-facing role, you will lead complex enterprise onboardings to integrate, transform, and operationalize cybersecurity data into Qualys’ Enterprise TruRisk Management (ETM) platform. You will translate fragmented security environments into a unified risk model while bridging the gap between customer needs and core product engineering.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Customer Onboarding & Data Integration
  
  

* Strategic Execution: Lead end-to-end enterprise onboarding from strategy to production rollout, serving as the system of record for customer assets, findings, and business context.
* Pipeline & API Design: Build REST API, webhook, and scalable ingestion (e.g., S3-based ETL/ELT) pipelines to integrate diverse data sources (VM, EDR/XDR, Cloud, IAM, CMDBs, GRC).
* Data Modeling & Correlation: Design custom mapping, transformation, tagging, and asset criticality scoring; implement de-duplication and correlation logic across heterogeneous security feeds.
* Pipeline Reliability: Ensure continuous full and incremental data ingestion with automated scheduling, monitoring, and error handling.

Data Quality & Validation
  
  

* Data Integrity: Establish scalable validation frameworks to audit and maintain asset/findings accuracy for confident risk decision-making.
* Issue Resolution: Execute controlled reprocessing and configuration adjustments to fix data quality issues without disrupting operational metrics.

Dashboards, Remediation & Workflows
  
  

* Analytics & Modeling: Build customized dashboards, trend visualizations, and risk scoring models, including complex "toxic risk combination" scenarios.
* Workflow Automation: Integrate ETM with ticketing/remediation tools (Jira, ServiceNow) and configure automated alerts, escalations, and ownership mapping.
* Executive Reporting: Develop custom reports/utilities using public APIs for board-level, operational, and regulatory audiences.

Product & Engineering Feedback Loop
  
  

* Roadmap Influence: Translate field deployment challenges and recurring integration gaps into technical requirements for product and core engineering teams.
* Customer Maturity: Guide enterprises from initial risk visibility to automated, remediation-driven action.

Required Qualifications:
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience: 8–10 years in data engineering, platform engineering, or customer-facing technical roles.
* Technical Stack:
* Strong programming proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages.
* Deep experience with REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous systems, and scalable ingestion pipelines (ETL/ELT).
* Hands-on knowledge of relational, NoSQL, search, or graph databases.
* Domain & Data Expertise:
* Strong foundation in data modeling, normalization, transformation, and correlation.
* Solid understanding of core cybersecurity domains (VM, Cloud Security, IAM, Risk Frameworks).
* Hands-on application of AI or automation to optimize data pipelines and onboarding workflows.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional client-facing, communication, and technical consultation skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Background in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Professional Services.
* Familiarity with large-scale, distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Proven ability to thrive in high-impact, fast-paced, and ambiguous production environments.

title: Cloud Support Engineer, AI/ML (Night Shift)
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
  
  
**Cloud Support Engineer — AI/ML & Programmability (Night Shift)**
**Location:**
Pune, India
  
  
Snowflake's Support team is expanding. We're looking for a Cloud Support Engineer who enjoys working with data and solving a wide variety of problems, drawing on hands-on experience across operating systems, database technologies, big data, data integration, connectors, and networking.
  
  
Our mission is to make Snowflake the preferred platform for running all AI, ML, data science, and data engineering workloads. You'll join a highly productive, fast-moving team supporting Snowflake Cortex and our ML product lines — work that is central to delivering on Snowflake's AI Data Cloud mission.
  
  
Snowflake Support is committed to providing high-quality resolutions that help customers deliver data-driven business insights and results. We are a team of subject matter experts working collectively toward our customers' success, building partnerships by listening, learning, and connecting.
  
  
Snowflake's values shape how we deliver world-class Support: putting customers first, acting with integrity, owning initiative and accountability, and getting it done.
  
  
As a Cloud Support Engineer, you'll be the technical partner our customers turn to for guidance on using Snowflake effectively. You'll also be the voice of the customer to our product and engineering teams, surfacing feedback and improvements. Beyond individual cases, you'll help build knowledge across the team and contribute to strategic initiatives that improve how we work.
  
  
Depending on business needs, you may be assigned to one or more Snowflake Priority Support customers. In that capacity you'll develop deep familiarity with their use case and how they use the platform, delivering the service that enables them to get the highest levels of continuity and performance from their Snowflake implementation.
  
  
**AS A CLOUD SUPPORT ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:**

* Drive technical solutions to complex problems, providing in-depth analysis and guidance to Snowflake customers and partners via email, web, and phone
* Adhere to response and resolution SLAs and escalation processes to ensure fast resolution of customer issues
* Investigate issues using the Snowflake environment, connectors, third-party partner software, and internal tools
* Troubleshoot customer use cases built on Snowflake's Cortex and ML stack, working across Python runtimes and relevant ML libraries
* Investigate, evaluate, and compare Large Language Models to help customers get maximum value from Snowflake's AI capabilities
* Work with customers to resolve programmability-related issues, including DevOps and Kubernetes
* Document known solutions to our internal and external knowledge bases
* Report well-documented bugs and feature requests arising from customer submissions
* Partner with engineering teams to prioritise and resolve customer requests
* Participate in a range of Support initiatives
* Provide support coverage during holidays and weekends based on business needs

**OUR IDEAL CLOUD SUPPORT ENGINEER WILL HAVE:**

* 2+ years of experience in a technical support environment or a similar technical, customer-facing function
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with strong attention to detail
* In-depth knowledge of at least one major cloud provider's ecosystem
* Working knowledge of Python and relevant ML libraries
* An intermediate understanding of LLMs and their enterprise applications
* Understanding of software development principles, including object-oriented programming and version control (Git, GitHub, GitLab)
* Understanding of RESTful APIs and web services
* Familiarity with MLOps practices and tools

**NICE TO HAVE:**

* Experience in a 24x7 support environment, including technical case escalation, incident management, and on-call rotations
* Background supporting an RDBMS, and familiarity with database release management
* Understanding of machine learning foundations — neural networks, statistics, and optimisation — and of optimising model performance, scalability, and efficiency
* Production experience with frameworks such as Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras
* Working experience with Jupyter Notebooks
* Experience with development tools and IDEs (Visual Studio Code, Eclipse, IntelliJ IDEA)
* Experience with API tooling such as Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman, and API Gateway
* Experience with data visualisation tools — Tableau, Power BI, matplotlib, seaborn, or Plotly
* Understanding of big data technologies such as Hadoop or Spark
* Understanding of event-driven architectures and microservices
* Knowledge of authentication and authorisation protocols such as OAuth and JWT

**SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* This role works the 4th / night shift, typically starting at 10:00 PM IST
* Participation in pager duty rotations during nights, weekends, and holidays
* Applicants should be flexible with schedule changes to meet business needs

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
  
  
How do you want to make your impact?

title: Program and Delivery Manager - AI and Data Delivery
description:
**Eaton’s EITC division is currently seeking a Program and Delivery Manager - AI and Data Delivery.**
**What You’ll Do**
This position leads the delivery of data and artificial intelligence products for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions. The role owns the portfolio from demand intake through design, build, deployment and adoption, and is accountable for the scope, schedule, cost and quality of every initiative within it. It is a new role, created to give these functions a dedicated delivery leader as the demand for data and AI capability continues to grow.
  
  
The leader manages the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team and acts as the primary point of contact for functional leadership. Working closely with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security, the role ensures that solutions handling sensitive employee and legal information meet Eaton architecture, privacy and security standards. The position also serves as secondary owner of the AI Navigator idea-to-disposition process for ideas raised by these functions.
  
  

* Lead end-to-end data and artificial intelligence delivery for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions, covering demand intake, prioritization, execution, deployment and value realization.
* Own the delivery roadmap and release plan for every product in the portfolio, and hold delivery teams accountable to committed scope, schedule, cost and quality.
* Lead engagement with senior functional stakeholders to identify business priorities, shape demand into fundable initiatives, and secure agreement on outcomes and success measures.
* Manage the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, capability building and retention of employees and contractors.
* Act as secondary owner for AI Navigator idea-to-disposition for ideas originating in HR, Legal and Corporate Development, ensuring each idea is assessed, dispositioned and tracked to closure.
* Build and manage the financial plan for the portfolio, including annual budget, project and run forecasting, platform consumption, contractor cost control and variance reporting.
* Partner with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security so that solutions comply with architecture guardrails, data privacy obligations and information security standards applicable to employee and legal data.
* Establish and operate delivery governance, covering status reporting, risk and issue management, dependency management, change control and steering reviews.
* Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices and improve predictability, cycle time and quality through objective delivery metrics.
* Manage supplier and partner relationships, including statements of work, resource onboarding and performance against agreed service levels.
* Champion organizational change management and user adoption for AI products, and ensure realised benefits are measured and communicated to stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor degree in a technical discipline such as B.E. / B.Tech / MCA, or B.S. in Computer Science, Mathematics or Engineering. A master degree or MBA is preferred.
* 14 or more years of relevant industry experience in information technology delivery.
* 8 or more years leading program or project delivery for data, analytics or application products in a global organization.
* 4 or more years of direct people leadership of engineering teams that include employees and contract resources.

**Skills**

* Project or program management certification such as PMP, PgMP, Scrum Master or SAFe is preferred.
* Experience delivering technology for HR, Legal or Corporate Development functions, including work with confidential employee or legal data, is preferred.
* Working knowledge of data engineering and analytics platforms, including data pipelines, data warehousing and reporting on Microsoft Azure.
* Practical understanding of artificial intelligence and generative AI solution patterns, including large language models, retrieval augmented generation, prompt design and accuracy evaluation.
* Strong command of program and portfolio management disciplines covering scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality and benefits management.
* Experience running Agile delivery at scale using Scrum, Kanban or SAFe, with hands-on use of Azure DevOps or equivalent tooling.
* Understanding of enterprise application integration, application programming interfaces and workflow automation.
* Familiarity with data privacy, records retention and information security requirements that apply to employee, legal and corporate development data.
* Financial management capability covering budgeting, forecasting, vendor contracting and cost control.
* Executive communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to translate technical work into business outcomes.
* Ability to lead through influence across a matrixed, global organization and across time zones.
* Proven capability in coaching, developing talent and building inclusive, high-performing teams.
* Structured problem solving and sound decision making in conditions of ambiguity.
* Customer focus, solution orientation and a strong drive for results.

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

title: Senior Salesforce Platform Engineer – AI & Automation
description:

Pune, IndiaWork Mode: Hybrid – Monday to Wednesday in-office, Thursday and Friday remote

5+ years

InCommon helps global startups and businesses build, manage, and scale their teams in India.

We partner with growing companies to support their expansion through talent acquisition, Global Capability Centre (GCC) setup, compliance, payroll, and business operations.

Founded in 2023 and backed by Better Capital, InCommon works closely with companies to build strong teams across technology, AI, product, and leadership roles.

title: Industrial Engineer - Senior
description:
****Job Summary:****
Designs, improves, and installs integrated manufacturing or administrative systems which use people, materials, information, equipment, and energy.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities:****
Leads work studies for new and current production lines. Leads standard work methods for new and current production lines. Leads the work for specific projects to create and implement all aspects of a manufacturing processes to ensure safety requirements, manufacturing goals, business goals, and product specifications are met. Leads by applying the knowledge or use of manufacturing principles and practices to improve manufacturing equipment and processes. Maintains the application of Cummins standards and develops manufacturing standards. Leads the communications with and influences key external stakeholders, business leaders, and functional members. Works with internal and external resources on specific project assignments. Leads the advanced knowledge of manufacturing principles and practices as they are applied to Cummins. Maintains relationships and coaches key stakeholders.
  
  
****Competencies:****
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Ergonomic Fundamentals - Understands ergonomic concepts by applying Cummins ergonomic standards, guidelines, controls and tools to reduce ergonomic risk to employees while at work.
  
  
Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.
  
  
Line Balancing - Evaluates work activities performed by individuals or machines to identify opportunities to optimize operating time and distributing of the work content to meet the changes in customer demands while continuing to optimize manufacturing processes.
  
  
Manufacturing Analysis Led Design - Uses digital tools to model and simulate manufacturing processes, equipment and performance to make data driven decisions before changes are made and to drive continuous improvements.
  
  
Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.
  
  
Process Layout - Creates and/or modifies an optimized manufacturing process by incorporating knowledge of equipment, human interfaces, sequences of production steps, and facilities requirements in order to reduce process time and waste.
  
  
Work Measurement - Quantifies and evaluates the elements of work that make up a process by breaking it down into detailed steps to identify and reduce waste, and redistribute work content to optimize process flows.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
  
  
Continuous Process Improvement - Recognizes areas in which a process can be improved by properly implementing process improvement and waste reduction methodologies to reduce process cost and improve quality in current manufacturing processes.
  
  
Drawing Interpretation - Integrates product design and manufacturing equipment engineering drawings to support the design and development of an optimal manufacturing process that meets product design specifications.
  
  
Industrial Engineering Knowledge - Integrates the pillars of industrial engineering techniques by applying a comprehensive and quantitative analysis to available data to be used as decision factors for the development or improvement of manufacturing processes to contribute to the most efficient process.
  
  
****Education, Licenses, Certifications:****
College, university, or degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Math) or related field, or equivalent experience required.
  
  
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
****Experience:****
Intermediate level relevant work experience required.
  
  
**Job Description: Industrial Engineer Senior**
**Role Summary:**
We are seeking an Industrial Engineering professional with strong expertise in discrete manufacturing, industrial engineering, and data analytics. This role will transform manufacturing data into actionable insights, drive continuous improvement, and support the deployment of AI and analytics solutions across plant operations.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Analyze data from digital manufacturing systems such as CMES, Connected Factory, Maximo, Q-DAS, OEE platforms, and other plant applications to identify improvement opportunities.
* Partner with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to understand process challenges and convert them into data-driven improvement projects.
* Develop dashboards, analytics models, and performance insights to improve productivity, equipment utilization, quality, cost, and operational efficiency.
* Support AI and machine learning use cases by providing manufacturing domain expertise, validating data logic, and helping enterprise AI teams translate plant requirements into practical solutions.
* Perform data validation, root-cause analysis, and performance investigations using SQL, Python, Power BI, and other analytics tools.
* Identify bottlenecks, waste, process variation, and reliability issues, then recommend practical actions to drive measurable business improvements.
* Facilitate Industry 4.0 analytics workshops, train plant teams on analytics tools, and build capability for data-driven decision making.
* Design and support Operations Control Tower concepts by integrating data from manufacturing, maintenance, quality, and ERP systems to provide a consolidated view of operations.

****Required Skills & Qualifications****

* Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of discrete manufacturing processes, plant operations, lean manufacturing, industrial engineering methods, and continuous improvement practices.
* Hands-on experience with manufacturing performance metrics such as OEE, throughput, downtime, cycle time, productivity, quality losses, and cost improvement.
* Proficiency in data analytics tools and methods, including SQL, Python, Power BI, statistical analysis, and data visualization.
* Ability to work with large operational data sets, validate data quality, identify trends, and convert analysis into business actions.

**SAP Fiori ABAP-**
**Sr Application Developer - 11257**
Job Title: Sr Application Developer - SAP Fiori ABAP
  
  
Experience: 8+yrs exp
  
  
Location: Pune, Bangalore, Chennai, Noida, Hyderabad
  
  
Role Type: Permanent
  
  
Work Mode: Hybrid
  
  
Shift: 2 PM-11 PM IST
  
  
Design, build, and support SAP ABAP and Fiori enhancements, reports, interfaces, forms, and applications aligned to business requirements.
  
  
**Role Overview**
A technical role delivered under a strict clean-core mandate. The program has deliberately constrained its build: 79% of requirements are met by standard configuration, and the WRICEF objects will be gated behind conditions precedent — a validated requirement, a quantified benefit, and confirmation that no standard alternative exists — and extensions are delivered on SAP BTP rather than by modifying the core. This role needs judgment as well as skill: the largest technical risk on the program is over-customization, specifically rebuilding a legacy shop-floor system's bespoke lot-numbering and lot-handling logic one-for-one inside SAP. You will be expected to resist that.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Translate functional specifications from all workstreams into technical designs, honest estimates and clean-core-compliant build approaches; challenge designs better solved by configuration.Develop the report backlog using CDS views, RAP services and analytical Fiori applications in preference to classical ABAP list reports.Develop enhancements using released extension points — BAdIs, key-user and developer extensibility — rather than core modifications or implicit enhancements.Design and build interfaces between S/4HANA, SAP Digital Manufacturing, factory-automation and edge systems and the analytics layer, using SAP BTP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management, Event Mesh) plus IDoc, OData, REST and file patterns.Build custom and extended Fiori applications with SAPUI5 / Fiori Elements, including shop-floor UIs usable on hand-held devices and gloved hands, with Japanese and English language support.Build the traveler / batch-card print program and forms carrying resolved machine, tool, hardness, mold, cavity and lot detail; implement quality, hold and disposition approval workflows; build the flexible master-data maintenance application if it clears its gate.Build the composite KPI CDS layer and the post-Material-Ledger allocation engine in the agreed architecture; enforce clean-core governance — extension registry, released-API discipline, upgrade-safety review, code review — and document objects so client IT can maintain them.
**■ BATCH MANAGEMENT & TRACEABILITY EXPERIENCE — REQUIRED**
Hands-on Batch Management and end-to-end traceability experience is a mandatory requirement for this role. Batch, lot and cavity-level traceability sits at the center of this program; candidates without demonstrable hands-on experience in the following will not be shortlisted:Batch and classification data structures in S/4HANA — batch master, characteristics and classification, batch determination and status — and how to read, extend and report on them without breaking standard behavior.Batch number assignment: standard internal/external number ranges, the batch number BAdI, and the judgment to say honestly when a bespoke lot-number format genuinely cannot be met by standard next-number maintenance. Replicating legacy lot-numbering one-for-one is this program's largest over-customization risk.Batch characteristic copying and re-derivation on split and merge, including enhancement programs that update collected data each time a shop-floor control number is split.Cavity-level and sub-lot data: carrying mold, machine and cavity identity onto batch characteristics and onto planned/production orders via custom fields, and surfacing it on travelers, labels and packing documents.Traceability reporting: building forward/backward genealogy queries over batch data with CDS, integrating with the Batch Information Cockpit and Global Batch Traceability rather than rebuilding them.Interfaces that carry batch identity — SFC-to-batch one-to-one mapping with the digital manufacturing layer, vendor batch capture, batch data on delivery documents — and the handling of long (up to 40-digit) lot numbers through splits, an open design decision on this program.
**Required Qualifications**
6+ years SAP technical development with 3+ full-lifecycle implementations, including at least 1 on S/4HANA.Strong ABAP OO and ABAP on HANA: CDS views, AMDP, code pushdown and performance optimization; hands-on RAP and modern extensibility (key-user and developer extensibility, released APIs, BAdIs).Demonstrable clean-core delivery: extensions that survive upgrades, and the discipline to refuse core modifications.SAPUI5 / Fiori development including Fiori Elements, annotations, custom controls and launchpad configuration.Hands-on SAP BTP including Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management) and event-based integration; Cloud Foundry or Kyma application development is an advantage.SAP integration technologies: OData, REST, SOAP, IDoc, ALE/EDI, the Data Replication Framework and file-based interfaces; forms and print output (Adobe Forms or SmartForms) for travelers, labels and packing documents.Development against PP, QM and MM/IM/WM with a working functional understanding of what those modules do.
**Preferred Qualifications**
Bilingual English/Japanese (business level); prior delivery in Japan, including multi-language UI and print output.Integrating SAP Digital Manufacturing or an MES with S/4HANA, and machine/edge connectivity patterns (OPC UA; bridging non-standard protocols such as CC-Link via middleware or an edge gateway is a distinct advantage).Analytical CDS models consumed by SAP Analytics Cloud or SAP Business Data Cloud.SAP Build Process Automation or SAP Workflow Management.ABAP Test Cockpit, abapGit, gCTS and CI/CD for SAP.SAP certification in ABAP for S/4HANA, Fiori application development, or BTP Integration Suite.
**Language Requirement — Bilingual English/Japanese Preferred, Not Required**
Fluent professional English is required for design documentation, deliverables and steering-committee communication. Business-level Japanese is a strong advantage — many process owners, shop-floor personnel and legacy-system custodians work primarily in Japanese, and much current-state documentation exists only in Japanese — but it is not a condition of appointment. Interpretation support, bilingual design documentation and pairing with bilingual business analysts are provided, and strong candidates will be considered regardless of Japanese-language ability.
  
  
**Engagement Details**
Full-time consulting assignment across the Explore, Realize and Deploy phases. Hybrid delivery with periodic on-site presence at the Japan sites during validation workshops, integration testing, cutover and hypercare. Reports to the workstream lead, working alongside client SMEs, client IT and the corporate global SAP template and clean-core governance teams.
  
  
**Top 4 Job Requirements For This Role**
**Clean-core development discipline —**
CDS, RAP and released extension points only, with the discipline to refuse core modifications and challenge builds better solved by configuration.
**SAP BTP Integration Suite —**
Cloud Integration, API Management and event-based integration to SAP Digital Manufacturing, factory-automation systems and the analytics layer.
**Fiori and SAPUI5 delivery —**
Fiori Elements and custom applications, including shop-floor UIs usable on hand-held devices and gloved hands, with Japanese and English support.
**Batch and lot data expertise —**
batch classification, the batch number BAdI, characteristic re-derivation on split, and the judgment to resist rebuilding legacy lot logic. Required — see highlighted section below.

title: Senior Enterprise Software Engineer
description:
Wolters Kluwer is seeking a motivated and talented DevSecOps Senior Engineer to join our dynamic team. This is an exciting opportunity for an individual with hands-on experience in mature software engineering and a DevSecOps environment to further develop their skills and make a meaningful impact within a forward-thinking organization. As a DevSecOps Senior Engineer, you will play a crucial role in supporting our engineering team, contributing to the development, maintenance, and enhancement of our enterprise cloud platform.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for working closely with various stakeholders, including our experienced engineering team, Cloud Operations, Security, Compliance, and other key partners. Your primary focus will be on engineering practices to streamline our software development processes, enhance efficiency, and ensure the reliability and scalability of our cloud platform. You will gain hands-on experience with a variety of DevSecOps tools and application and platform technologies, helping to build and maintain our continuous integration and delivery pipelines, infrastructure as code, and automated deployment processes.
  
  
You will be involved in a wide range of tasks, including application and platform automation, infrastructure management, monitoring, and performance optimization. Your foundational understanding of application and platform engineering concepts, practices, and tools will be critical as you contribute to the implementation of best practices and the optimization of our platform workflows. You will have the opportunity to learn from and collaborate with seasoned professionals, gaining valuable insights and experience that will help you grow in your career.
  
  
As a DevSecOps Senior Engineer, you will be expected to actively participate in the design, development, and deployment of our cloud applications. You will work on projects that require keen attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality. Your ability to collaborate effectively with team members and communicate clearly will be essential in ensuring the successful delivery of our application and platform solutions.
  
  
This position offers a fantastic opportunity for growth and career development within a supportive and innovative environment. You will have the chance to work with state-of-the-art technologies, be part of a collaborative and high-performing team and make a significant impact on our organization’s success. If you are passionate about engineering and eager to take your career to the next level, we encourage you to apply and join our team at Wolters Kluwer.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Support architecture for complex applications ensuring they meet business requirements.
* Implement best practices in coding with support of AI
* IaC-first approach to managing cloud infrastructure using Terraform and an opinionated IaC Framework standard.
* Transform manual processes using automation.
* Perform the deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of platforms.
* Conduct work activities using SRE principles, such as resilience, metrics, capacity planning, toil, Incident management and security
* Manage cloud infrastructure and services in Azure and AWS
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (developers, operations, QA, etc.).
* Communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Implement and Manage Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
* Develop scripts and tools to improve operational efficiency.
* Build and help transform container and serverless architectures, such as AKS (Azure Kubernetes Service), EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Services), Docker and Azure Functions.
* Ensure software and platforms comply with security standards and regulations.
* Implement security best practices and conduct regular security assessments.
* Adhere to access controls and protect sensitive data.
* Document processes, procedures, and infrastructure setups.
* Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.
* Continuously improve systems, processes, and methodologies.
* Participate in project planning and execution.
* Ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
* Understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Engage with stakeholders to gather feedback and refine requirements.
* Ensure customer satisfaction through reliable and high-quality deliverables.
* Explore generative AI technologies to enhance software capabilities.
* Deploy AI models for automated content generation and predictive analytics.

**Other Duties**

* Performs other duties as assigned by management
* On call rotation responsibilities with the Service Delivery and Operations Team

**Job Qualifications & Experience**
**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field
* Minimum 1 year of experience with AI and Generative AI technologies or equivalent
* Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in the DevSecOps engineering discipline, prefer enterprise engineering experience or equivalent
* Experience with Application and Infrastructure Operations
* Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Bash, Python) for automation tasks and infrastructure management.
* In-depth knowledge of programming frameworks (e.g., .NET, JAVA) and application development.
* Extensive experience with Terraform for infrastructure as code (IaC) management, including writing and maintaining modules.
* Proficiency with CI/CD tools and practices (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions), including creating and managing pipelines.
* Comprehensive experience with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS), including designing and implementing cloud services and architecture. Azure is strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment, ensuring platform reliability and scalability.

**Thought Leadership and Soft skills:**

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a willingness to learn and contribute to team success.

Our Interview Practices
  
  
*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*
*Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.*

title: Senior Software Engineer (Development & Quality)
description:
**About Kaseya**
Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.
  
  
Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.
  
  
Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.
  
  
We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.
  
  
At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.
  
  
**Senior Software Engineer, Endpoint Agent**
(Development & Automation Testing)
  
  
**Why Kaseya?**
Join a fast-growing company transforming the IT management and cybersecurity industry. At Kaseya, we are modernizing how software is designed, built, tested, and operated by combining strong engineering fundamentals with AI-native development practices.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to shape not only our technology architecture, but also how engineering teams leverage AI to build high-quality software faster and more effectively.
  
  
Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to help develop and maintain Kaseya's endpoint management agents across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms.
  
  
This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on building secure, reliable, and scalable endpoint management capabilities. The ideal candidate is passionate about operating systems, systems programming, device management, endpoint security, and software quality.
  
  
Unlike traditional development environments where quality ownership is separated, our engineers own the full software lifecycle. You will design, develop, test, deploy, and support your solutions while building automated validation alongside the features you create. Successful candidates combine strong software engineering skills with a quality-first mindset and leverage automation to ensure reliability, maintainability, and release confidence at scale.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Design and implement new features for endpoint agents across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms.
* Develop software components supporting monitoring, automation, patching, inventory collection, remote actions, scripting, and device management.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
* Own features throughout the entire lifecycle from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support.
* Build automated tests and validation frameworks alongside feature development.
* Develop automated coverage for functional, integration, regression, resiliency, and system-level scenarios.
* Improve software quality through testability, diagnostics, telemetry, and automation.
* Investigate customer-reported issues and production escalations.
* Perform root-cause analysis and implement preventative solutions to avoid future recurrence.
* Reproduce complex issues across diverse operating system and endpoint environments.
* Improve agent stability, performance, scalability, security, and reliability.
* Develop integrations with operating system management, security frameworks, and device management APIs.
* Build telemetry and diagnostics capabilities that improve product supportability and troubleshooting.
* Collaborate with Product, Support, Cloud Platform, Security, and Engineering teams to deliver customer-focused solutions.
* Participate in design discussions, code reviews, architecture reviews, and sprint planning activities.
* Utilize AI-assisted development and testing tools to accelerate engineering productivity and improve software quality.

**What You Bring**
**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of software engineering experience developing system software, endpoint software, platform services, or related applications.
* Strong proficiency in C# and .NET, including experience building production-grade applications and services.
* Experience building automated tests and validation capabilities as part of the software development lifecycle.
* Experience developing automated test frameworks and validation tooling using technologies such as xUnit, NUnit, MSTest, Selenium, Playwright or similar testing frameworks
* Experience with Windows system programming concepts such as Win32 APIs, Windows Services, WMI, Registry operations, process management, threading, security models, or related operating system capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of operating system fundamentals, including: Processes and threads, Filesystems, Networking, Services and daemons, Security models, Privilege management, Performance and resource utilization
* Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis skills.
* Experience developing software that interacts with operating system services, APIs, or management frameworks.

leader in Identity Security

**,**

Our employees voted us “best places to work” – 10 years in a row.

**Strategic Sales Representative**

We are seeking an experienced Strategic Sales Representative, to sell our IGA Solution Suite to $5B+ organizations.  Primarily a SaaS offering, our IGA Solution Suite sits at the heart of an organization’s enterprise security.  The position requires a sales executive who is experienced in navigating multinational accounts, generally at C level.  The successful candidate will use their previous experience in SaaS, Cyber-sec or IAM/IGA to negotiate high value contracts across what is generally a lengthy sales cycle.

Using the Challenger sales methodology, quota will be achieved by engaging with approximately 10 target customers: typically, there will be a large number of POC’s, BVA’s & RFP’s as a part of the sales motion.  Route to market is selling to end users directly and also leveraging the support of our influential channel partners, including the GSI’s, such as Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG. Our Sales Executives gain a thorough understanding of prospective client's business and the industry in which they compete, the corresponding IT initiatives, identifying business drivers/needs which the company can help resolve, developing compelling business value propositions for our solutions and ultimately closing business. They will also develop and maintain trusted relationships with senior level decision makers and other key buyers within the named accounts and partners.

**The path to success:**

**In setting the right foundations, you should achieve these milestones during your 1st month with the company.**

* Established internal network & led interlock meetings with virtual teams & key stakeholders.
* Schedule weekly 1:1 meeting cadence with your Manager with TAM review agenda.
* Ensure you have a buddy assigned and meet with them at least once a week.
* Demonstrate your understanding of financial terms and how we currently measure financial success at SailPoint.
* Familiarize yourself with SailPoint's language of acronyms and technical terms so you can actively participate in meetings.
* Ask your manager to share the strategic objectives of your department followed by your team's objectives and finally where your role fits in.
* Achieved “Bosun” enablement badge.

**Continuing to build those foundations you should have achieved these milestones by the end of your 2nd month.**

* Sorted TAM accounts into Sales priority order and reset/clean pipeline.
* Set $$ amounts next to all “A” accounts & make introductions with them.
* Territory plan developed, presented and signed off by Sales Management

* Created a stakeholder map for key partners that are influencers in your “A” accounts and devised approaches to connect with them.
* Presented pipeline growth plan to Management.
* Demonstrated SFDC hygiene with regular, accurate activity and updates.
* Complete the Crew Member Value Proposition Tool and schedule time with your manager to discuss.

**Building on the foundations, you should have achieved these milestones by the end of your 3rd month.**

* Implemented an operating cadence with virtual team (meetings in place with clear purpose)

* Developed strategies to approach “A” accounts - presented to Management and approved.
* Customers from “A” accounts know who you are – relationship maps in SFDC completed.
* Achieved “1st Mate” enablement badge.

**By the end of your 4th month, in addition to the attainment and continued development of your first 3 months activities, you will have:**

* Created Account plans for all ‘A’ accounts.
* Created Opportunity plans for all ‘A’ accounts.
* Presented forecast for self-generated opportunities & expected time/path to 1st sale.
* Shown progress through sales stages for any inbound/inherited opportunities (from 5-40).
* Achieved “Sailing Master” enablement badge.

**On completing your first successful 6 months at SailPoint, in addition to the previous milestones, you will have:**

* Achieved strong correlation between engagement rate and all ‘A’ accounts.
* Achieved strong correlation between pitch rate and all ‘A’ accounts.
* “Quarter Master” enablement badge completed.
* “Captain” enablement badge completed (including stand and deliver)

Preferred but not required: Bachelor's degree or global equivalent in an IT, business or sales related field.

Business travel of approximately 50 percent yearly is expected for this position

title: Exposure Management Analyst
description:

We are seeking a cybersecurity professional with strong experience in vulnerability management, risk assessment, infrastructure security, security operations, and stakeholder engagement. The candidate should be comfortable communicating with both technical teams and executive leadership while driving measurable reductions in organizational cyber risk.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Vulnerability & Attack Surface Management**
Govern the end-to-end vulnerability lifecycle including identification, assessment, prioritization, remediation tracking, validation, and closure.
  
  
Perform vulnerability analysis using industry-standard tools.
  
  
Conduct risk-based prioritization using CVSS scores, exploitability data, business impact, threat intelligence, and asset criticality.
  
  
Track remediation activities and ensure adherence to established remediation SLAs.
  
  
Stay informed on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and industry best practices.
  
  
**Automation**
Develop and maintain automated security workflows to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual efforts.
  
  
Utilize SOAR platforms, existing tool capabilities, and integrations to streamline security operations.
  
  
**Risk & Exposure Management**
Evaluate newly disclosed vulnerabilities, zero-day threats, and critical security advisories.
  
  
Assess business risk associated with vulnerabilities and provide remediation recommendations.
  
  
Drive reduction of organizational attack surface and cyber exposure.
  
  
Manage vulnerability exception and risk acceptance processes.
  
  
Support incident response investigations involving exploited vulnerabilities.
  
  
**Reporting & Governance**
Develop executive-level dashboards and vulnerability metrics.
  
  
Prepare weekly and monthly reports highlighting risk posture, remediation trends, and SLA compliance.
  
  
Present vulnerability-related findings to technical leadership and business stakeholders.
  
  
Maintain vulnerability management policies, standards, procedures, and operational runbooks.

title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
The
**Lead Forward Deployed Engineer**
operates at the intersection of engineering, data, and customer deployment. In this hands-on, customer-facing role, you will lead complex enterprise onboardings to integrate, transform, and operationalize cybersecurity data into Qualys’ Enterprise TruRisk Management (ETM) platform. You will translate fragmented security environments into a unified risk model while bridging the gap between customer needs and core product engineering.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Customer Onboarding & Data Integration
  
  

* Strategic Execution: Lead end-to-end enterprise onboarding from strategy to production rollout, serving as the system of record for customer assets, findings, and business context.
* Pipeline & API Design: Build REST API, webhook, and scalable ingestion (e.g., S3-based ETL/ELT) pipelines to integrate diverse data sources (VM, EDR/XDR, Cloud, IAM, CMDBs, GRC).
* Data Modeling & Correlation: Design custom mapping, transformation, tagging, and asset criticality scoring; implement de-duplication and correlation logic across heterogeneous security feeds.
* Pipeline Reliability: Ensure continuous full and incremental data ingestion with automated scheduling, monitoring, and error handling.

Data Quality & Validation
  
  

* Data Integrity: Establish scalable validation frameworks to audit and maintain asset/findings accuracy for confident risk decision-making.
* Issue Resolution: Execute controlled reprocessing and configuration adjustments to fix data quality issues without disrupting operational metrics.

Dashboards, Remediation & Workflows
  
  

* Analytics & Modeling: Build customized dashboards, trend visualizations, and risk scoring models, including complex "toxic risk combination" scenarios.
* Workflow Automation: Integrate ETM with ticketing/remediation tools (Jira, ServiceNow) and configure automated alerts, escalations, and ownership mapping.
* Executive Reporting: Develop custom reports/utilities using public APIs for board-level, operational, and regulatory audiences.

Product & Engineering Feedback Loop
  
  

* Roadmap Influence: Translate field deployment challenges and recurring integration gaps into technical requirements for product and core engineering teams.
* Customer Maturity: Guide enterprises from initial risk visibility to automated, remediation-driven action.

Required Qualifications:
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience: 8–10 years in data engineering, platform engineering, or customer-facing technical roles.
* Technical Stack:
* Strong programming proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages.
* Deep experience with REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous systems, and scalable ingestion pipelines (ETL/ELT).
* Hands-on knowledge of relational, NoSQL, search, or graph databases.
* Domain & Data Expertise:
* Strong foundation in data modeling, normalization, transformation, and correlation.
* Solid understanding of core cybersecurity domains (VM, Cloud Security, IAM, Risk Frameworks).
* Hands-on application of AI or automation to optimize data pipelines and onboarding workflows.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional client-facing, communication, and technical consultation skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Background in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Professional Services.
* Familiarity with large-scale, distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Proven ability to thrive in high-impact, fast-paced, and ambiguous production environments.

title: Manager - Process Excellence & Cost Optimization
description:
**Job Purpose**
This role controls plant cost and material loss and improves workforce productivity. It does this through standard measurement systems (BOM, cost per sq ft, manpower matrices) and shop-floor automation such as production scanning, smart scheduling and live dashboards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Cost and Financial Control**

* Track monthly plant cost per sq ft against budget, and analyse and explain variances.
* Reconcile BB and COV material consumption and wastage against BOM, keeping variance within 1%.
* Build and maintain a BOM-based tracking system for general consumables, with cost variance within 5%.
* Reconcile and approve job-worker bills within the agreed billing cycle, with no delays.

**Automation and Digital Tracking**

* Implement operator-wise and team-wise production scanning (barcode for COV, QR code for BB) to measure throughput and reduce manpower cost by 10% YoY.
* Drive smart production scheduling and order-kit allocation to improve direct-worker efficiency by 20%.
* Develop an AI / Power BI tracker for media-wise material inflow versus wastage, with full traceability and variance under 1%.
* Maintain daily plant and department dashboards comparing budget and actual cost trends.

**Waste Management and Manpower Productivity**

* Develop at least two alternate or backup buyers for each saleable scrap item or category, targeting a 15% impact on sale value.
* Optimise waste disposal, including balers for cardboard, plastic and fabric, to cut waste volume by 30%.
* Build a manpower performance measurement matrix for non-sq-ft production and non-production departments.
* Support the skill matrix and skill-based operator allocation, and train supervisors and operators in method and productivity improvement (10 people per department).

**General Duties**

* Conduct time and motion studies, set standard times, and balance lines.
* Prepare monthly MIS and variance reports for management.
* Coordinate with production, stores, finance, IT and vendors.
* Lead Lean, Kaizen and 5S initiatives.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech in Industrial, Mechanical or Production Engineering. An MBA or PGDIE is preferred.
* 8–12 years in manufacturing industrial engineering, costing or productivity, including at least 3 years leading projects or a team.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong in BOM and inventory reconciliation, cost analysis, time study and production scheduling.
* Skilled in advanced Excel and Power BI, with exposure to ERP/MES and barcode or QR systems. AI or analytics knowledge is a plus.
* Analytical, detail-oriented and comfortable presenting data to senior management.
* Able to work across departments and train shop-floor teams.

title: Senior Suppliers Development Engineer
description:

title: Client Outreach Executive
description:
**Company Description**
RSE (Red Smile Entertainments) is a white-label post-production house specializing in wedding and corporate video editing for studios worldwide. Founded in 2018, the company has grown from a single editor to a dedicated team of 10 professionals serving clients across the UK, US, Canada, Australia, and the UAE. RSE works under strict NDAs, delivering all files under each client’s branding so that end viewers never know a third party was involved. The team manages wedding films, highlight reels, event coverage, and corporate videos, helping studios stay focused on production while RSE clears their editing backlog. RSE also offers free 30–60 second trial edits, giving potential partners a risk-free way to experience the service.

This is a full-time hybrid role for a Client Outreach Executive based in Gandhinagar, with flexibility for some work-from-home tasks. The Client Outreach Executive will engage with existing and prospective studio partners, introduce RSE’s post-production services, and coordinate trial edits and onboarding. Day-to-day responsibilities include responding to inquiries, scheduling and conducting calls or virtual meetings, understanding client requirements, and ensuring smooth handover of projects to the editing team. The role involves maintaining accurate records of interactions, following up on leads, gathering feedback from clients, and supporting long-term relationship building. Collaboration with the operations and editing teams will be essential to align client expectations with delivery timelines and service quality.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Communication and Customer Satisfaction skills to build trust, clarify requirements, and deliver a positive client experience.
* Account Management and Consulting abilities to understand studio workflows, recommend suitable services, and support ongoing client relationships.
* Sales skills to identify opportunities, present RSE’s value proposition, and convert leads into long-term partnerships.
* Comfort with digital tools (CRM, email, video conferencing) and basic understanding of video production or post-production workflows.
* Proactive, organized, and detail-oriented approach, with the ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously.
* Prior experience in client-facing roles in media, creative services, or B2B environments is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Interior Designer
description:

Dynamic Engineering is a multidisciplinary firm focused on delivering functional, well-designed built environments for a variety of commercial and residential clients. The company combines engineering expertise with creative design solutions to optimize space, efficiency, and user experience. Dynamic Engineering emphasizes collaboration, quality, and adherence to project timelines and budgets. Team members work closely with clients and partners to translate technical requirements into practical, aesthetic spaces that support long-term use and performance.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time Interior Designer role based in New Delhi with a hybrid work arrangement, allowing some work from home. The Interior Designer will be responsible for developing interior concepts, preparing design presentations, and collaborating with architects and engineers to align design intent with technical requirements. Daily tasks include space planning, selecting materials and finishes, coordinating FF&E (furniture, fixtures, and equipment), and preparing detailed construction drawings and documentation. The role involves site visits, coordination with contractors and vendors, and monitoring implementation to ensure designs are executed as planned. The Interior Designer will also support client meetings, gather requirements, and adjust designs based on feedback and project constraints.

* Candidates should possess strong Interior Design and Architecture skills, with the ability to integrate aesthetics and functionality.

title: Visual Content Designer & Video Editor
description:
UniVisory works with ambitious students aspiring to the world’s leading universities and helps them build stronger academic, research, innovation and admissions journeys.

We are looking for a
**Visual Content Designer & Video Editor**
who can take a powerful idea and turn it into content people stop, watch, understand and remember.

This is
**not just a graphic-design role.**

We are looking for someone with strong visual taste, storytelling ability and an instinct for creating premium content across social media, video and digital campaigns.

What You’ll Own

**Visual Storytelling**

Create high-quality social media creatives, carousels, infographics, campaign assets and other visual content across UniVisory and its education verticals.

**Video Content**

Edit short-form videos, reels, founder-led content, student stories, educational explainers, interviews and campaign videos.

Turn long-form conversations and recordings into sharp, engaging short-form content.

**Content → Creative**

Take research, insights and complex educational topics and translate them into simple, compelling visual narratives.

You should be comfortable receiving an idea rather than a frame-by-frame design brief.

**Brand & Creative Quality**

Maintain a premium, intelligent and contemporary visual identity across our brands while understanding that different verticals require different visual personalities.

**Fast-Turnaround Content**

Education and admissions move quickly. When an important development happens, we want to be able to move from
**insight → concept → creative/video → publication quickly.**

**AI-Assisted Creative Production**

Use modern AI tools intelligently for ideation, visual exploration, editing and production—without allowing the final output to look generic or AI-generated.

What We’re Looking For

You may be a strong fit if you:

• Have excellent visual taste and a strong sense of typography, composition and storytelling

• Understand how to make content work on Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube and WhatsApp

• Can edit engaging short-form video with strong pacing, hooks, captions and motion graphics

• Can simplify complex information visually

• Think independently instead of waiting for detailed instructions for every creative

• Have high attention to detail and care deeply about quality

• Can work quickly without making the work look rushed

• Are curious about AI and emerging creative tools

• Take ownership from brief to final output

Tools

Strong working knowledge of tools such as
**Figma / Adobe Photoshop / Illustrator / Premiere Pro / After Effects / CapCut**
or equivalent professional tools.

Experience with AI creative tools is strongly preferred.

Your
**portfolio and creative judgement matter more to us than the number of software tools you know.**

Experience

Ideally
**2–5 years**
in visual design, video editing, social content or a related creative role.

Experience with premium brands, education, media, startups or content-led businesses is valuable but not mandatory.

Exceptional candidates with less experience but an outstanding portfolio are welcome to apply.

What Will Make You Stand Out

Show us work where you took an ordinary idea or complex subject and transformed it into something
**simple, visually distinctive and memorable.**

We particularly value originality over templates.

Application Questions

Please answer these while applying:

**1. Portfolio**

Share a link to your portfolio containing your best graphic-design and video work.

**2. Your Best Work**

Which one piece in your portfolio best represents your creative ability? What was your role in creating it?

**3. From Idea to Creative**

If you were given this insight:

*“The SAT is becoming more reasoning-intensive, and students preparing with older methods may need to adapt.”*

How would you turn it into an engaging social-media creative or 30-second video?

Briefly describe your idea.

Selection Process

Shortlisted applicants will be given a
**small creative assignment**
based on a real UniVisory content brief.

We will evaluate:

**Visual taste · Storytelling · Originality · Content understanding · Video sense · Speed · Attention to detail**

If you believe great design is not decoration—but a way of making an idea impossible to ignore—we’d like to see your work.

**Apply with your portfolio and responses to the questions above.**

title: UI/UX Specialist – E-commerce
description:
At Malmal, we are looking for a UI/UX Specialist – E-commerce who can take ownership of our website experience and ensure it remains seamless, visually appealing and aligned with our premium brand identity.

We are looking for someone with a strong eye for design, an understanding of customer behaviour and the ability to identify and implement improvements to our existing website. The role involves continuously reviewing the website, identifying areas for improvement, making minor UI/UX changes wherever possible and coordinating with the development team for larger changes.

This is a hands-on role focused on improving and maintaining the website experience rather than designing an entire website from scratch.

Key Responsibilities

Website Experience & Usability

\* Regularly review the website across desktop and mobile to ensure a smooth and consistent shopping experience.

\* Identify usability issues, navigation challenges and areas where the customer journey can be improved.

\* Review homepage layouts, collection pages, product pages, search, filters, cart and checkout experience.

\* Ensure the website’s visual presentation is consistent with Malmal’s premium brand positioning.

UI/UX Improvements & Execution

\* Identify and recommend practical improvements to website layouts, navigation, functionality and overall user experience.

\* Implement minor UI/UX changes and website updates independently wherever feasible.

\* Prepare basic wireframes, mock-ups or design recommendations when required.

\* Coordinate with developers or the external website agency to implement larger changes and ensure timely execution.

E-commerce & Conversion Optimisation

\* Identify potential friction points in product discovery, add-to-cart and checkout journeys.

\* Work on improving the shopping experience and making the purchase journey simpler and more intuitive.

\* Use website analytics, customer feedback and performance data to identify improvement opportunities.

\* Collaborate with the e-commerce and marketing teams on landing pages, campaigns and website enhancements.

Website Quality & Maintenance

\* Conduct regular website audits to identify broken links, display issues, inconsistent layouts and mobile responsiveness problems.

\* Ensure banners, landing pages and website updates are displayed correctly.

\* Test website changes after implementation to ensure everything functions as intended.

\* Maintain consistency in typography, spacing, imagery and overall visual presentation.

What We’re Looking For

\* 1–3 years of relevant experience in UI/UX, e-commerce website management or website optimisation.

\* Strong understanding of UI/UX principles and online shopping behaviour.

\* Good visual sense and attention to detail, preferably in fashion, lifestyle, D2C or premium retail.

\* Hands-on familiarity with Figma or similar design tools.

\* Working knowledge of Shopify or another e-commerce CMS, depending on the platform used by Malmal.

\* Understanding of responsive design, mobile-first experiences and basic conversion metrics.

\* Ability to identify problems, suggest solutions and follow through on implementation.

\* Good communication and coordination skills to work with developers and internal teams.
