title: Principal Data Advisor
description:
Financial Data Advisor
  
  
**What Makes Us, Us**
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
  
  
At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
  
  
**If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!**
WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US
  
  
SimCorp DMS is a complete data management solution for pricing and reference data, provided as a Managed Service. The SimCorp DMS Advisory and change management service is a team of industry and data management experts who consistently monitor for any industry, regulatory and vendor feed changes that may affect our client’s business operations. The Advisory Service regularly informs clients of these changes, and how best to adapt.
  
  
As a Senior Data Advisor, you will be responsible to look after the client onboarding, monitoring vendor changes, maintaining the standard data model and orchestrating change management activities for the SimCorp DMS clients by liaising with internal service teams from IT and Operations. You will be directly reporting to the head of Data Advisory team
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Create and maintain data standards (lookups, mappings, conventions, and rules), data models and data ontologies (how are data objects related to each other)
* Maintain meta data information documentation regarding data models, data interpretation, data lineage and utilization along the key processes and make it available to internal and external stakeholders.
* Monitor, track and conduct assessment of all vendors related changes that impacts SimCorp DMS and Enterprise Data Manager clients.
* Facilitate Change & Control Board (CCB) governance with internal service teams to prioritize and deliver the standard and client change requests.
* Design and implement a robust client onboarding framework for a seamless DMS client onboarding
* Serve as the advisor and quality gateway regarding data and change integrations related to data.
* Support design and maintenance of an overall data test concepts and conduct regular data tests to assure data and service quality.
* Support DMS Operations on various process improvement initiatives.
* Advise clients on data needs and data usage for new requirements.
* Build and maintain in-depth know-how on industry and regulatory changes within data management.
* This is a client-centric role that involves regular interaction with our valued customers
* Continuously develop a comprehensive understanding of the latest industry and regulatory trends in the data management space and promote best practices within the SimCorp community to benefit our clients.

**What We Value**
Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest.
  
  

* Have a relevant bachelor’s degree or equivalent in finance
* Relevant experience in areas of Change Management with data vendor feeds (Bloomberg, IDC, Reuters, etc.)
* Have good knowledge of financial products and markets including derivatives, structured instruments etc.
* Have experience in requirements engineering, data modelling and full SDLC approach.
* Have a structured approach, attention to detail, service mindset, and solid organizational and interpersonal skills.
* Process management, control and design experience are beneficial skills but not mandatory.
* Have relevant experience in Data Management and Business Analysis
* Possess strong knowledge of various investment/trade lifecycle activities
* Show the ability to collaborate easily with various departments to ensure client success.
* Exhibit clear verbal and written communication to engage and inform various stakeholders

**Benefits**
Benefits Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide an excellent work & life balance: flexible work hours, a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have IP sprints where you have 3 weeks per quarter you can spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company development. There is never just only one route - we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.
  
  
**NEXT STEPS**
Please click below to apply or get in touch with
**Swati Pal**
, Talent Partner on
**Swati.pal@simcorp.com**
to learn more about the vacancy and what SimCorp offers regarding salary, benefits, and perks. Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your CV in English as soon as possible. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
  
  
**WHO WE ARE?**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

title: Lead- Data Quality & Governance
description:
**OUR STORY**
**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**
**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**
**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**
**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**
**Role Overview**
STMicroelectronics is seeking a highly organized and proactive Data Governance & Quality Lead to drive enterprise-wide data quality, governance, and process documentation initiatives across People Function.
  
  
This role will be responsible for establishing and maintaining data governance frameworks, standardizing master and transactional data across regions and systems, defining data ownership and maintenance policies, and implementing robust data quality controls. In parallel, the role will ensure that global policies, procedures, and standard operating processes (SOPs) remain accurate, current, and aligned with evolving business requirements.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong project management capabilities with process excellence, stakeholder management, and data governance expertise to enable operational efficiency, compliance, and future-ready self-service capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and implement enterprise-wide data governance standards and frameworks for People Function
* Establish data ownership, stewardship, and accountability models across teams.
* Drive harmonization and standardization of master and operational data across regions and systems.
* Process Documentation & Knowledge Governance

title: SAP PM CS
description:
Job Description: SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven
**SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant**
with
**5 to 12 years**
of expertise across SAP Customer Service (CS), Service Management (SM), and S/4HANA Service.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, and implementing end-to-end Service Management processes in an
**SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition (PCE) / RISE with SAP**
environment. You will bridge business requirements and functional architecture, manage cloud service governance, enable AI-driven service insights, and drive continuous optimization across the full service lifecycle.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Implementation
* Design, configure, and deploy S/4HANA Service Management processes across the entire service lifecycle: Engage, Sell, Contract, Plan, Schedule, Execute, Invoice, and Analyze.
* Map end-to-end business requirements to standard S/4HANA Service capabilities, including service quotations, service orders, service contracts, spare parts logistics, resource planning, billing, and analytics.
* Drive adoption of the latest S/4HANA PCE release innovations (e.g., service team determination, advanced execution processes, Fiori applications, and AI-powered service intelligence).
* S/4HANA Private Edition (PCE) Governance
* Operate effectively within the SAP S/4HANA PCE Shared Responsibility Model between the client and SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS).
* Liaise with SAP for system-level operational tasks (e.g., infrastructure management, backups, maintenance, and upgrade administration).
* Lead client-side functional responsibilities, including business process configuration, functional validation, regression testing, and process governance based on SAP’s PCE Roles and Responsibilities framework.
* Service Order & Contract Management
* Configure and maintain service contract structures, recurring service billing plans, and auto-renewal mechanisms.
* Enable flexible billing scenarios, including Resource-Related Billing (RRB), Time & Material (T&M), and Fixed-Price billing models.
* Leverage modern platform features such as service contract template cloning and mass contract change capabilities.
* Service Planning, Execution & Logistics Integration
* Set up and optimize workforce planning, resource allocation, dispatching, and field service workflows.
* Configure plant and storage location parameters within service transactions to support multi-plant and multi-location service execution.
* Direct cross-module functional integration between service transactions and procurement (MM), inventory management, shipping, plant maintenance (PM), and follow-on financial postings.
* Data Migration, Testing & Integration
* Oversee data preparation, cleansing, transformation, and validation for service master data, active service contracts, and open service orders.
* Utilize the SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and standard transition tools tailored for service artifacts.
* Coordinate functional and technical integrations across CRM, SAP Field Service Management (FSM), SAP CS, core logistics, and Finance (FI/CO).
* AI, Analytics & Continuous Process Improvement
* Implement embedded AI capabilities (e.g., Joule-assisted summaries, intelligent confirmations, and predictive service insights).
* Design custom Fiori dashboards, operational reports, and KPIs to monitor service performance and profitability.
* Guide business stakeholders through continuous improvement initiatives and the adoption of periodic SAP release features.
* Stakeholder Management & Documentation
* Facilitate requirements-gathering workshops, author detailed functional specifications (FS), and map target-state business process flows.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams spanning Logistics, Procurement, Finance, and Sales.
* Create training collateral, deliver end-user training, and lead hypercare support during deployment phases.

**Required Skills & Technical Expertise**

* Experience: 5–12 years of hands-on experience in SAP CS / SM / S/4HANA Service functional consulting.
* Core Module Competency: Comprehensive knowledge of S/4HANA Service (PCE) core functionality (Service Orders, Service Contracts, Resource-Related Billing, Invoicing, and Execution Logistics).
* Cloud Architecture: Clear operational understanding of the SAP PCE operating model, RISE with SAP frameworks, and cloud service boundary matrices.
* User Experience & Extensibility: Proficiency with modern SAP Fiori apps, standard OData APIs, and functional extensibility options.
* Integration Touchpoints: Strong cross-functional integration experience with PM, SD, MM, FI/CO, and SAP FSM.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Practical project experience with RISE with SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition implementations or migrations.
* Hands-on knowledge of SAP upgrade governance and release management protocols in PCE environments.
* Official SAP Certification in S/4HANA Service or related SAP functional modules.

**Soft Skills**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong consulting mindset with a proven ability to translate business strategy into technical solution designs.
* Proactive problem-solving capabilities and experience leading cross-functional delivery teams.

title: Agentic Full-Stack Engineer
description:
**Agentic Full-Stack Engineer**

**About Securin**

Securin is an AI-native cybersecurity company. Our Preemptive Exposure Management Platform turns exposure data into clear decisions — giving organizations the confidence to know which risks are exploitable, what to fix first, and how to act before attackers do.

**Our Engineering Values**

We build with agents and verify with humans — treating AI as a genuine collaborator, holding agent-generated code to the same review standard as human-authored code, and shipping features only when test coverage and security checks are in place. We take end-to-end ownership, write maintainable code, and bring security awareness into every decision — not as a checkbox, but as a core discipline.

**The Role**

A high-agency software engineer who uses coding agents as a force multiplier: generating design specs with AI, curating those outputs with engineering judgment, and shipping high-quality features at pace on the Securin cybersecurity platform.

**Responsibilities**

● Feature Development

Design and ship full-stack features for the Securin platform end-to-end — using AI coding agents (Claude) to generate specs and boilerplate, then curating those outputs with engineering rigor, security context, and architectural judgment before finalizing. Work with teams in the US and India to facilitate communication, operations, and design. Required to attend 1-2 US evening meetings a week to sync with India based teams.

● Agent & Automation Engineering

Build agentic workflows and automation pipelines that streamline engineering — and enforce a human-in-the-loop review process ensuring every AI-produced change is critically evaluated for correctness, security, and fit before it reaches production.

● Platform & Infrastructure

Architect and maintain cloud-native SaaS services on AWS, contributing to API design, data modeling, and microservices architecture that power real-time threat intelligence ingestion and delivery.

● Security Mindset

Apply secure-by-design principles throughout development and work alongside Securin's security researchers to translate vulnerability intelligence domain knowledge into robust platform capabilities.

**Requirements**

● 3+ years building production SaaS

● Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

● Public cloud experience required (AWS preferred, GCP or Azure acceptable)

● Deep familiarity with:

○ Containerization

○ Serverless architecture

○ Event-driven architecture

○ RESTful API design

**Culture-Forward Building with AI: What We Expect - Role-Specific**

○ Hands-on, daily use of AI coding agents is a prerequisite.

○ Must be able to critically review agent-generated code and specs for:

● Hallucinations

● Security flaws

● Architectural drift before merging.

**General**

Securin is committed to becoming an AI-native organization where GenAI is embedded into how every team works - not just as an occasional assistant, but as a core part of delivery, operations, and how our expertise compounds over time. We expect every employee to actively integrate

**GenAI tools into daily workflows -**
Automating routine tasks, accelerating research and analysis, drafting documents, and building reusable AI-powered processes for their function. You should understand the limitations of GenAI (including inaccuracies and data sensitivity boundaries), follow data classification rules, and continuously improve your AI proficiency. As you grow, we expect you to move beyond using GenAI to building with it - designing agent workflows, contributing reusable skills, and helping Securin compound its Proactive Exposure Management expertise faster than any competitor can replicate.

● Demonstrated ability to use GenAI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) for daily work - drafting, research, summarization, data analysis, code generation, or workflow automation as relevant to the role.

● Working knowledge of GenAI limitations including hallucination risk, context window constraints, and data sensitivity boundaries; ability to validate AI-generated output before acting on it.

● Familiarity with prompt engineering techniques - structuring multi-step instructions, providing context, and iterating on output quality to achieve production-grade results.

● Comfort with agentic AI workflows - using, designing, or building multi-step AI agents that execute tasks autonomously with human-in-the-loop validation.

● Awareness of AI security fundamentals - prompt injection risks, data classification rules, sandboxed execution, and responsible handling of sensitive data in AI workflows.

● Familiarity with connecting GenAI tools to internal data sources, APIs, and enterprise systems.

● Ability to contribute reusable AI skills, templates, agent configurations, or automation workflows to a shared repository for team-wide use.

● Willingness to learn and adopt new AI tools as they evolve; participation in AI adoption sprints, hackathons, and knowledge-sharing within the team.

**Location :**
Remote (For candidates outside Chennai), Hybrid model (2 days a week to office - for candidates from Chennai)

title: Senior Developer, Applications
description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world. A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.
  
  
Flex intends to spin off its Cloud and Power Infrastructure segment into a new, independent publicly traded company, Axiom, with the spin planned for Q1 2027. If the intended spin occurs, this role will support Axiom, a company focused on critical digital infrastructure and delivering end-to-end power and thermal management solutions for AI data centers and other mission-critical applications.
  
  
To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we’re looking to add a
**Senior Developer, Applications**
in
**Chennai, India.**
**What a typical day looks like:**

* Design, build new applications using .Net
* Enhance / Support existing applications using MVC, C#.NET, Web Services / Web API, Entity Framework / ADO.NET.
* Develop On-premises / Cloud (using Azure) hosting applications.
* Develop Microservices-based applications, leveraging Containers and DevOps practices.
* Database design for simple to medium sized transactional databases, write Stored Procedures and Functions in SQL Server / MYSQL
* Significantly contribute to Design and Architecture of the Applications.
* Thoroughly document the architecture / design of the applications.
* Developing web applications using Angular 17 or higher, ASP.Net and MVC .NET.
* Developing Web applications using Kendo / Telerik controls for MVC.

**The experience we’re looking to add to our team:**

* Senior .NET developer with a strong background in building: secured, scalable, high-quality and high-performance web applications on the Microsoft technology stack.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in designing and developing web application using ASP.Net and MVC.
* Hands-on experience in developing microservices-based applications.
* Experience in Test Driven Development (TDD) using unit-testing framework.
* Hands-on development experience in building Responsive Web Design user interfaces using Angular 17 or higher, HTML5, CSS3 and Angular JS.
* Minimum 4 years of experience with Oracle / SQL Server / MYSQL / PostgreSQL
* Hands-on experience in ORM like Entity Framework or N-Hibernate.
* At least three years of Experience with JavaScript / jQuery, HTML, CSS, and XML.
* Strong coding knowledge on developing applications using Web APIs / REST APIs.
* Excellent technical expertise and experience in .net design patterns.
* Thorough understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP)
* Knowledge in messaging frameworks like RabbitMQ, MSMQ, ActiveMQ, etc.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated experience in working in a team environment.
* Knowledge AWS / Azure cloud services
* Hands on experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) cloud services such as Cloud Functions, Cloud storage, Compute Engine, App Engines and GKE
* Hands on experience in Cloud native development and micro service-based architecture
* Hands on experience in leveraging Gemini Enterprise for AI based app development

**What you’ll receive for the great work you provide:**

* Health Insurance
* PTO

#CF17
  
  
Flex is an Equal Opportunity Employer and employment selection decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and abilities. We do not discriminate based on: age, race, religion, color, sex, national origin, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, pregnancy status, or any other status protected by law. We're happy to provide reasonable accommodations to those with a disability for assistance in the application process. Please email accessibility@flex.com and we'll discuss your specific situation and next steps (NOTE: this email does not accept or consider resumes or applications. This is only for disability assistance. To be considered for a position at Flex, you must complete the application process first).

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Job Summary:**

* We are seeking experienced
  **Senior Backend Engineers (Golang/Node.js)**
  with
  **8–12 years of backend development experience**
  to design, develop, and operate scalable, event-driven microservices.

**Employment Details:**

* **Employment Type:**
  Full-time
* **Number of Positions:**
  3
* **Work Mode:**
  Hybrid – 3 days per week
* **Work Location:**
  Chennai – Siruseri or Olympia Tech Park, Guindy
* **Notice Period:**
  Immediate to 7 days from the date of the offer

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Translate business requirements into clear specifications, API contracts, and implementation plans before coding.
* Design and build Go or Node.js microservices using REST, gRPC, and Kafka-based event-driven flows.
* Own non-functional requirements, including performance, reliability, observability, and security.
* Critically review AI-generated code and specifications and write tests that validate implementation against the specification.
* Mentor junior developers and improve engineering quality through code reviews.

* Experience writing design documents, RFCs, or technical specifications before implementation.
* Ability to critically review and correct AI-generated code.
* Demonstrated ability to learn new tools and workflows quickly.
* Strong written communication skills.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, or Grafana.
* OAuth2/Keycloak experience.
* Experience with AI coding tools such as Copilot or Claude, or with spec/design-doc-driven workflows.

title: IAM Developer
description:
Job Title: Identity and Access management Developer
  
  
Department: BNPP Personal finance
  
  
**About Business Line/Function**
BNP Paribas Personal Finance is financial entity specializing in consumer credit and banking as a service. Through our strong partners we distribute financial products on B2C, B2B2C and B2B models for different business lines. Inside Personal Finance, SET Iberia is an IT & Operations hub, providing IT, Data, Cybersecurity and Operations services to Personal Finance corporation, filières and subsidiaries.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
As part of the international team in Personal Finance in charge of the IAM platform for external users, the IAM engineer plays a key role in onboarding the different subsidiaries for offering to their applications delegated and secure identity and access management for their B2C, B2B2C and B2B customers.
  
  
The IAM platform in Personal Finance is based in PingIdentity products, PingFederate, PingOne, PingDirectory and PingOne 2FA deployed on premise in BNPP infrastructure.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities:
  
  

* Manage the logical segregation and environments for each Personal Finance subsidiary
* Manage users,credentialsand certificates
* Develop custom adapters / login pages for performing OIDC and SAML based authentication
* Support subsidiaries and application owners for onboarding applications in the platform, includingdesign of theldapstructure and authentication flow andsupport during integration according to BNPP standards
* Support application owners and production teams in incident resolution
* Support production teams in planning and executing patching and upgrades on the platform or the infrastructure

**Contributing Responsibilities**

* Team player
* Adhere to the standards and practices followed in the Project
* Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the team.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and deliver solutions.

Technical & Behavioral Competencies
  
  
Technical Skills
  
  

* Atleast5years of experienceinIAMdevelopmentspace.
* At least 4 years of experience with Ping suite products
* Exposure to key skills listed below is a must:
* PingFederate
* PingOne
* PingDirectory
* PingOne 2MFA
* OIDC
* SAML
* Postman
* FederatedIdentity
* OIDCIntrospection
* Configure authentication flows andPingIdentityadapters
* Manage federation of authentication with internal and external SSO providers
* Manage 2 Factor authentication for mobile and desktop users and support the subsidiaries in integration according to BNPP standards
* Manage introspection of token with other SSO providers
* Develop custom mappings oof attributes in OIDC tokens orSAML responses
* Nice to have skills:knowledge ofAPI Management solution like Axway or Apigee (optional, but a plus)

**Other Skills**
Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)
  
  

* Agile methodology exposure
* Proactive mindset
* Business / IT relationship (including IT OPS)

**Behavioral Skills**

* Strong problem-solving abilities.
* Effective communication and collaboration.
* Adaptability and willingness to learn.
* Proactive attitude and attention to detail.
* Empathy and customer focus.

**Education Level**

* Bachelor’s orMaster’s degree in Engineering, Computer Scienceor equivalent

Location: Chennai
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
  
  
Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
  
  
At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. title: API Developer
description:
**Job Description: API Developer**
**Our Team**
The API Developer designs, builds, and maintains the APIs that connect enterprise systems, digital products, and external partners. This is a hands-on engineering role responsible for producing well-designed, robust, scalable, secure, well-documented APIs that other teams can discover and reuse for communication between internal products, third-party platforms and client-facing applications.
  
  
The API platform is run both as an internal product and as a managed service. The API Developer works contract-first, publishing APIs to the enterprise catalogue and developer portal, and builds the reusable components, templates, and policies that raise the standard of every API delivered across the organisation.
  
  
Kong is the primary gateway, operating alongside Apigee, Azure API Management, and AWS API Gateway across a multi-cloud estate on Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services. The role therefore values transferable, gateway-agnostic API skills as highly as any single product.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**
**API Design and Development**

* Design and build APIs contract-first using Open API/Swagger, applying enterprise design standards, naming conventions, and versioning policy.
* Develop synchronous and asynchronous APIs across REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and event-driven patterns documented with AsyncAPI.
* Build domain and experience APIs that expose business capabilities cleanly, abstracting the complexity of underlying systems.
* Develop reusable API components, policies, plugins, and templates that other teams consume as a starting point.

**Gateway and Runtime Implementation**

* Implement and configure API proxies, routes, plugins, and policies on Kong Gateway and Kong Konnect.
* Deploy and operate gateway components on Kubernetes using the Kong Ingress Controller and GitOps workflows.
* Implement traffic management including rate limiting, throttling, caching, retries, and circuit breaking.

**Security and Access Control**

* Implement robust authentication and authorization mechanisms (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, mutual TLS, API keys patterns)
* Ensure APIs comply with regulatory and data privacy requirements (GDPR, GxP where applicable)
* Integrate with enterprise identity providers including Entra ID and Okta.

* Favour reuse and shared components over bespoke, single-purpose implementations.

**Collaboration and Ways of Working**

* Work within an agile product team with a shared backlog and defined customers.
* Partner with integration engineers, application teams, and data teams to agree interfaces and contracts.

**About You**
**Required**

* Demonstrated capability in API or backend software engineering, typically gained across five to eight years of professional experience.
* Proficiency in at least one modern backend language: Python or Node.js and TypeScript are preferred, and Java with Spring Boot is equally welcome.

* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases and the ability to write optimized queries
* Strong contract-first API design experience with Open API, including versioning and backward compatibility.
* Hands-on experience with an API gateway or management platform such as Kong, Apigee, Azure API Management, or AWS API Gateway.
* Practical experience implementing OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and TLS-based API security.
* Working knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Sound debugging skills across application, network, and gateway layers.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, including the ability to document APIs for other engineers.

**Preferred**

* Experience with GraphQL federation and gRPC or Protocol Buffers.
* Experience with Kafka, Solace, or another event streaming or brokering platform.
* Experience integrating enterprise systems such as SAP, Salesforce, Veeva, Workday, or ServiceNow.
* Experience with developer portals, API catalogues, or API productization for external partners.
* Experience delivering within a regulated environment (GxP or other), including awareness of data-protection obligations such as GDPR.
* Certifications such as Kong, AWS or Azure developer level, or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer.
* A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related discipline.

**Core Competencies**

* Design-led thinking with strong attention to interface quality
* Consumer focus and empathy for the developers who use your APIs
* Security awareness embedded in everyday engineering decisions
* Bias toward reuse, standardization, and simplification
* Pragmatic problem-solving under production pressure
* Ownership and follow-through
* Continuous learning and adaptability

**Measures of Success**

* Reduced lead time from API design to production availability

+ Agile/Scrum methodologies

+ Automated Build and Test Frameworks

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills with the ability to solve complex system-level issues.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams involving hardware, firmware, systems, and product engineering.
* Self-driven and highly organized professional with demonstrated capability to identify technical challenges, propose innovative solutions, and successfully drive implementation through completion.

title: Senior Principal Agentic Engineer
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**About Lilly**
*At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you’re driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.*
**About Tech@Lilly**
*At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Hyderabad builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve.*
**About The Technology Organization**
Technology at Lilly builds and operates mission-critical digital products and platforms that support the discovery, development, and delivery of medicines that make life better for people around the world. Our teams operate in highly regulated, high-availability environments, where operational excellence, reliability, and quality are non-negotiable.
  
  
Within Tech@Lilly, the Digital Core organization applies a product, platform, and reliability-first mindset, ensuring that operational capabilities scale sustainably across the enterprise.
  
  
**About The Team**
Tech@Lilly builds and maintains capabilities using pioneering technologies like the most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Lilly IT is that we redefine what's possible through tech to advance our purpose, creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, including data-driven drug discovery, connected clinical trials, resilient enterprise platforms, and intelligent digital operations. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver creative solutions in every area of our business.
  
  
The Digital Core team leads Lilly's transformation into the Digital and AI era. They inspire digitally empowered teams to new ways of working and accelerate innovation and agility. This team powers and advances the entire company by building and maintaining world-class technology capabilities and platforms.
  
  
Lilly Capability Centre India (LCCI), Hyderabad, is Lilly's premier Global Technology Hub, harnessing data, AI, analytics, and digital solutions to revolutionize healthcare and improve patient outcomes worldwide.
  
  
Role summary
  
  
You own the agentic resolution platform end to end — both the cloud-native substrate it runs on and the intelligent agents that run on top of it. From Kubernetes, CI/CD, and observability through agent runtime, LLM patterns, retrieval, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop boundaries, you write the production code, design the architecture, and set the engineering bar that lets automation deflect routine operational work before it ever reaches a human.
  
  
This is a senior individual-contributor role that is both strategic and deeply hands-on. You ship production platform services and agentic capabilities, make the build-vs-buy calls on tooling and model access, and partner with the senior architect on the patterns that scale. Success is measured by rising deflection, sustained toil reduction, platform availability and developer velocity, and the ability to scale agentic intelligence through systems and people — not individual effort.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Agentic resolution platform — intake to action
* Architect the agentic resolution platform end to end: intake, classification, action execution, verification, and human-in-the-loop fallback.
* Build the agent runtime and orchestration layer: agent state and memory, tool integration, multi-agent coordination patterns, and confidence-thresholded handoffs to humans.
* Define agent-decision observability, audit-ready posture, and the data contracts that let the platform consume durable fixes from upstream engineering teams.
* LLM application patterns, knowledge, and evaluation rigor
* Design production LLM patterns: prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), structured outputs, multi-model routing, and hybrid retrieval over the knowledge corpus.
* Own the knowledge-base strategy as a compounding deflection lever — every resolved incident becomes training data and structured retrieval input for future automation.
* Establish evaluation and guardrail frameworks for non-deterministic systems: automated evals, quality scoring, drift detection, and feedback loops that compound agent quality over time.
* Cloud-native platform — build and operate
* Architect and operate Kubernetes (EKS or equivalent) at scale for container and serverless workloads supporting agentic and LLM inference traffic patterns.
* Write production platform services and internal tooling (Python or Go) that automate provisioning, deployment, and operational workflows — not just infrastructure configuration.
* Define and maintain infrastructure as code (Terraform) integrated with a major cloud's AI stack (AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, or Vertex AI), with secrets management and audit-ready posture for regulated environments.
* CI/CD, observability, and developer experience
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines tuned for agentic and AI workloads: model and agent versioning, canary rollouts, evaluation gates, and rollback.
* Own the observability stack (Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry plus enterprise tooling) and instrument platform health, agent-decision telemetry, and model-inference metrics.
* Establish SLOs, SLIs, and reliability standards for both platform and agentic system health; design self-service patterns and golden-path templates that accelerate delivery.
* Cross-team partnership, security, and talent development
* Partner with the Reliability Engineering team on which production patterns become agent-assisted automations, and with senior architects on the patterns that scale.
* Own security posture: network policies, pod security, secrets rotation, vulnerability scanning, and access controls in a regulated pharmaceutical environment.
* Set the engineering bar through code quality standards, architectural reviews, and role modeling; mentor senior engineers in agentic AI, LLM application patterns, and platform engineering. Influence engineering leaders to adopt automation-friendly patterns at the source, not just downstream.

How you will succeed
  
  

* Be recognized as the senior technical authority for agentic platform engineering in your area.
* Demonstrate measurable, sustained improvements: rising deflection rates, reduced toil, fewer recurring incidents, faster resolution, platform uptime, and deployment velocity.
* Ship production platform services and agentic capabilities that tangibly move the deflection and developer-experience numbers.
* Scale agentic intelligence through systems, standards, and people — not individual heroics.

What you should bring
  
  
**Required**

* 12+ years of progressive technology experience with substantial hands-on architecture and delivery of automation, AIOps, agentic systems, or cloud-native platforms at enterprise scale.
* Demonstrated ownership of measurable deflection or operational-toil-reduction outcomes in a production environment — with the numbers to show it.
* Deep technical fluency in agentic system design: agent runtimes, multi-agent orchestration, tool integration, memory and state management. Practical experience with at least one major framework (LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or MCP).
* Production experience with LLM application patterns: prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), structured outputs, and multi-model routing.
* Deep cloud-native background: Kubernetes (EKS or equivalent) at scale, container workloads, infrastructure as code (Terraform), and at least one major cloud's AI stack (AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, or Vertex AI).
* Proven ability to build and ship production platform services and tooling — not just configure infrastructure. Expert-level Python (async, packaging, performance) for production services; Go also welcome.
* Strong CI/CD engineering experience for AI and agentic workloads: model and agent deployment, versioning, canary/blue-green strategies, evaluation gates, and rollback.
* Observability for AI systems: metrics, logs, traces, and agent-decision telemetry using Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry, plus at least one enterprise stack (Splunk, Datadog, or Dynatrace).
* Demonstrated rigor in evaluation and guardrails for non-deterministic systems — automated evals, drift detection, human-in-the-loop verification, and feedback loops.
* Strong security engineering foundation: network policies, secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and access controls in regulated environments.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related field.
* Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to translate technical strategy for senior business and technology leadership.

*This is a hybrid role spanning agentic AI, LLM patterns, cloud-native platform, and developer tooling. We expect strong depth in 2–3 of these areas with the breadth and judgment to learn adjacent domains. Not every tool listed is required.*
**Preferred**

* Working knowledge of operational ML: anomaly detection, event correlation, alert-noise reduction, and model/agent monitoring in production.
* Experience with AI observability tooling (e.g., LangSmith, Weights & Biases, custom telemetry pipelines).
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow integration patterns and chat-based intake platforms (e.g., Microsoft Teams).
* Experience with vector databases and hybrid retrieval architectures.
* Experience building internal developer platforms (IDP), self-service provisioning, or platform-as-a-product tooling.
* Backend development skills beyond infrastructure tooling: REST/gRPC API design, database design, message queues, distributed systems patterns.
* Experience with policy-as-code, automated compliance checks, or shift-left security tooling.
* AWS cloud platform fluency, including EKS, Bedrock, SageMaker, and cost-optimization tooling.
* Familiarity with FinOps practices and cloud cost governance.
* Experience operating in highly regulated industries (life sciences, financial services, healthcare).
* Prior experience standing up a new engineering capability from a small founding team.
* Frontend experience (React, TypeScript) for internal dashboards and developer portals.

Leadership expectations
  
  

* Acts with enterprise-first mindset, beyond individual products or teams.
* Drives accountability, clarity, and engineering rigor across the team.
* Builds trust through consistency, technical depth, and follow-through.
* Raises the capability of the organization, not just personal output.
* Leads through what they build and how they write, not through org-chart authority.

Additional information
  
  
Availability to work flexible work hours is/may be required. This team supports continuous operations and may require non-standard work hours, including some work on weekends and holidays. Appropriate adjustments in benefits will be provided for employees working non-standard hours where applicable.
  
  
This is an onsite role based in Hyderabad. Candidates should be open to working different shifts when required to align with global delivery partners.
  
  
*At Lilly, caring is not only what we do for patients. It is how we work. We believe the people who dedicate themselves to making medicines better deserve an environment that makes their lives better too, one where they are supported, respected, and given the space to do their best work. This is not just a policy. It is who we are.*

description:

Pune, IndiaWork Mode: Hybrid – Monday to Wednesday in-office, Thursday and Friday remote

5+ years

InCommon helps global startups and businesses build, manage, and scale their teams in India.

We partner with growing companies to support their expansion through talent acquisition, Global Capability Centre (GCC) setup, compliance, payroll, and business operations.

Founded in 2023 and backed by Better Capital, InCommon works closely with companies to build strong teams across technology, AI, product, and leadership roles.

We are a strategic advisory and investment firm working with private equity firms, combining deep industry insights, strong relationships, and proprietary technology to create value across the investment lifecycle. We are building an in-house platform engineering capability where technology and automation play a critical role in driving business impact.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Salesforce Platform Engineer – AI & Automation who combines strong Salesforce development skills with architectural thinking and hands-on ownership of enterprise system integrations.

In this role, you will own Salesforce solutions end-to-end, design integrations across multiple business systems, and use AI-powered development tools such as Claude and Claude Code to improve engineering efficiency. You will also drive development standards, CI/CD practices, automated testing, and technical collaboration across developers, QA, and business stakeholders.

This is an opportunity to build scalable systems, establish engineering best practices, and help shape an automation-first development environment.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience across configuration and development, including Apex, LWC, SOQL, APIs, and administration.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, data modelling, automation patterns, and platform design.
* Experience designing and implementing integrations across enterprise systems using REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, middleware, SQL/NoSQL databases, and third-party platforms.
* At least 1 year of experience using AI coding tools such as Claude, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or equivalent.
* Experience with AI-assisted development workflows involving code review, automated testing, and controlled deployment.
* Hands-on experience with Git-based version control, branching strategies, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines, and Salesforce deployment tools such as SFDX or Gearset.
* Ability to guide developers and QA testers, review technical deliverables, and establish engineering standards.
* Active participation in Agile practices, including sprint planning, stand-ups, backlog grooming, and retrospectives.
* Familiarity with JavaScript and Google Apps Script for Google Workspace integrations is a plus.
* Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Platform Developer I/II, Service Cloud, or Experience Cloud are preferred. Salesforce Architect certifications are an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end Salesforce solution design, development, deployment, and maintenance.
* Develop and maintain Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and SOQL queries.
* Design integration architecture across Salesforce and other enterprise systems.
* Use AI development tools to streamline requirements, coding, testing, and release workflows while ensuring code quality and production safety.
* Establish and maintain Git-based change control, code review standards, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Ensure configurations, code, and integrations are version-controlled, traceable, and auditable.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions in collaboration with the Product Manager and internal architect.
* Provide technical guidance to developers and QA teams, manage sprint execution, and support the growth of the Systems team.

**Tools & Platforms**

Candidates should be comfortable working across the following:

**● Salesforce - Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, custom objects and integrations**

**● Claude & Claude Code - primary AI development environment (enterprise license)**

**● Git-based version control - GitHub / Bitbucket, CI/CD pipelines, SFDX, Gearset or equivalent**

**● Google Workspace - Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Apps Script integrations**

**● Project management - Jira | Additional AI tooling Codex, GitHub Copilot, Agentforce**

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Open role

Full Stack Engineer

Own the backend and the first AI agents on a live consumer app, from the Node API to the React Native screen.

DawerOne · Hybrid, Indore or Gurugram office 2–4 days a month · Contract-to-hire, full-time, 6 months · 4+ years

Apply by email

**About the job**

You will join our product engineering team on a live consumer app for a North American client. The stack is Node and PostgreSQL on the backend, React Native on mobile, a managed cloud platform for deployments, payments, the web tooling around it, and the AI agents and LLM-powered features now coming into the product. Our clients are in North America and our engineering team is in Gurugram.

**You are the backend and agents owner on the team.**
You own delivery of your workstreams end to end, API through to the screen, and ship to production. The first agents on the roadmap are yours to build. A DawerOne senior lead holds architecture, priorities, and the critical engineering decisions, including mobile architecture. A second developer works alongside you on the React Native surface, a test automation engineer covers regression, payments, and notifications, and the client's product owner and QA lead are part of the day-to-day team.

About half your time goes to a second product in the same client portfolio: a Python and Flask backend on AWS with an AI layer, under the same senior lead. You do not need deep Flask or AWS expertise, but you need to be comfortable reading and changing that codebase from the start.

This is a
**contract-to-hire**
role: a
**full-time, six-month contract**
with DawerOne, converting to a permanent role on mutual fit. For a strong candidate with clear long-term alignment, we are open to full time from day one. It is
**hybrid**
: you work from home most of the month and from our
**Indore or Gurugram office 2–4 days a month**
. Indore and Gurugram are preferred, but we will consider strong candidates elsewhere in India within travelling distance of either office. Compensation is benchmarked to seniority and we share a number in the first conversation. The top of our range goes to someone who has shipped a production agent and can show it.

**Responsibilities**

**First 30 days**

* **Ship a first feature end to end**
  , API through to the screen, within the first sprint.
* **Get the automated iOS and Android build and release pipeline working.**
* **Fix the highest-impact production issues:**
  payments, media handling, and performance across the API and database.
* **Scope the first agent**
  with the senior lead and the product owner: knowledge base, guardrails, cost model, and how it is evaluated.

**Backend and payments**

* **Build and maintain the Node and PostgreSQL backend and APIs**
  , including schema design and migrations.
* **Own the payment flows:**
  checkout, fees, onboarding, and payouts.
* **Integrate third-party services:**
  push notifications, media storage, and partner APIs.
* **Build web tooling where the product needs it:**
  admin portals and operational dashboards.

**AI agents**

* **Build and deploy AI agents and LLM-powered features:**
  agentic workflows against the backend, media analysis, and assisted content flows, using LLM APIs, tool use, and MCP.
* **Run them properly in production:**
  hosting, monitoring, cost control, and evals that tell you whether the agent is actually good.

**Features and mobile**

* **Deliver new features end to end:**
  scoping with the product owner, API design with the senior lead, the mobile build, and the release.
* **Ship React Native features and bug fixes**
  alongside the mobile developer, to patterns set by the senior lead.

**Builds, infrastructure, and operations**

* **Own builds, release management, and production deployments**
  on managed platforms such as Railway, Render, or AWS, with CI/CD for mobile and services.
* **Run the operations:**
  environments and secrets, monitoring, alerting and logging, backups and restore, and infrastructure cost, with infrastructure as code where it pays for itself.
* **Debug production issues**
  across backend, database, deployments, payments, and mobile.
* **Do performance work with measurements before and after.**

**Quality and delivery**

* **Support QA**
  with the automation engineer and the client's QA lead: regression, release validation, and bug fixing.
* **Keep Jira current:**
  blockers surfaced early, status up to date, and clear written updates.
* **Build with AI coding agents as a matter of course.**
  That is how we work.

**Minimum qualifications**

**What matters most**

For us, these matter most.

* You have
  **built and deployed at least one LLM-powered feature or agent to production:**
  prompt and tool design, structured outputs, handling failures, hosting and monitoring, controlling cost, and measuring quality. You can talk honestly about what did not work.
* **Daily, fluent use of AI coding agents**
  such as Claude Code, MCP servers, or similar. This is a hard requirement. You are productive with them from day one, with no ramp-up period.
* You can
  **debug a production issue independently across layers**
  before escalating.

**Experience**

* **4 to 6 years**
  building software, with strong backend experience:
  **Node**
  with Express or NestJS,
  **REST API design**
  , and
  **PostgreSQL**
  schema design and migrations.
* **Working Python**
  and comfort reading and changing a
  **Flask**
  codebase, plus basic
  **AWS**
  familiarity: EC2 or ECS, RDS, S3, and IAM. Deep Flask or AWS expertise is not required.
* **Production React Native experience:**
  shipped features and fixed bugs in a live app on iOS and Android, and able to work to an architecture someone else has set.
* **Hands-on with builds, CI/CD, and deployments:**
  GitHub Actions or similar for services, and you have owned environments, secrets, monitoring and alerting, and backups for a production service. Fastlane or EAS for mobile is a plus.

**Ways of working**

* You
  **take ownership of outcomes**
  , ask the right questions early, and keep delivery moving without follow-up.
* **Clear written English and Jira discipline.**
  You work directly with a North American product owner and QA lead.
* Able to work
  **roughly 11 AM to 9 PM IST consistently**
  , Monday to Friday, and flexible if the window needs to move. This is a shift, not an occasional late call.
* Able to be in the
  **Indore or Gurugram office 2–4 days a month**
  .

**Preferred qualifications**

* Deeper AWS operations, Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool, Docker in production, or Flask at scale.
* Stripe or another payment provider in production.
* Consumer commerce or payments-heavy products.
* Store releases, deep links, and push providers such as OneSignal or Firebase.
* Image or media processing flows.
* Experience working in an inherited codebase while still shipping features.

**Engagement details**

* **Engagement:**
  contract-to-hire. A six-month, full-time contract with DawerOne, converting to a permanent role on mutual fit. For a strong candidate with clear long-term alignment, we are open to full time from day one.
* **Time commitment:**
  full time, split roughly half and half between the primary consumer app (Node, PostgreSQL, React Native) and backend work on a second product in the same client portfolio (Python, Flask, AWS).
* **Exclusivity:**
  this is a full-time, exclusive engagement. You cannot hold another job or contract alongside it.
* **Location:**
  hybrid, with 2–4 days a month in our Indore or Gurugram office. Indore and Gurugram preferred; strong candidates elsewhere in India are considered if they are within travelling distance of either office and can travel for office days.
* **Working hours:**
  roughly 11 AM to 9 PM IST, Monday to Friday, for daily overlap with the client's North American morning. The window may shift if the engagement demands it.
* **Start:**
  immediate joiners preferred. We do not buy out notice periods.
* **Reports to:**
  the DawerOne senior lead on the engagement.
* **Process:**
  a 30-minute screen with the hiring manager, a technical deep dive of 60 minutes or more, a 60-minute live assessment spanning a Node API, the React Native screen in front of it, and a small agentic workflow using your own AI tooling, and a 30-minute final conversation. The technical and live rounds may be combined. You hear back within two working days of applying, and we make an offer within a week of the live assessment for the right candidate.

**Who should apply**

Someone who has
**shipped a backend, a mobile feature, and an agent on products that mattered**
, and wants to own all three on one team with a senior lead who engages with the hard decisions rather than handing over a ticket list.

If you have not yet put an LLM-powered feature in front of real users, or you want to write application code and hand the deployments to someone else, this is probably not the right role yet.

**Apply**

Email us your resume. It is required. The button opens a ready-to-send email; attach your resume before sending. In the same email, answer all 6 questions below. Every answer is required; applications with unanswered questions are not accepted.

1. Which React Native apps have you built and shipped? Store links if possible.
2. Which backend technologies and databases have you worked with in production? Node is primary here; tell us how comfortable you are in Python and Flask as well.
3. Describe an LLM-powered feature or agent you built and deployed to production: what it did, how you handled failures, what it cost to run, and how you measured whether it was good.
4. How do you use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, MCP servers or similar) in your daily work? Be specific.
5. Have you worked with Stripe or another payment provider? Which flows?
6. Working hours for this role are roughly 11 AM to 9 PM IST. Can you keep those hours consistently, and are you available full time for a 6-month contract?

Apply by email

.

**converting business requirements into detailed, scalable technical designs and implementing them independently**
.

Strong practical knowledge of
**microservices, distributed processing, asynchronous workflows, and event-driven system architecture**
.

Hands-on expertise with:

  Serverless development, deployment, concurrency, performance optimization, and scaling.

  Foundation model integration and production AI workflows.

  **AWS S3, SQS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and IAM**

Experience with

.

Understanding of
**worker concurrency, queue-based processing, retries, idempotency, rate limiting, failure recovery, observability, and cloud cost optimization**
.

Deep expertise across every AWS service is not required.

3. AI / LLM Engineering, OCR & Document Intelligence

Hands-on experience implementing production AI applications involving:

* LLM integration, prompt engineering, and context management.
* **OCR, Vision AI, multimodal models, and PDF/image processing**
  .
* Document classification, table/form extraction, and structured JSON outputs.
* Schema validation, error handling, and hallucination reduction.
* Multi-stage AI processing pipelines and model orchestration.
* Token optimization, AI latency management, and cost reduction.
* AI evaluation, accuracy improvement, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

The candidate should understand how to build
**reliable AI features beyond simply making LLM API calls**
.

4. RAG & AI Workflow Architecture

Hands-on experience designing and implementing
**Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**
systems, including:

* Document ingestion, chunking, and embeddings
* Vector databases, semantic/hybrid search, and metadata filtering
* Retrieval optimization, reranking, and context construction
* Response grounding and RAG evaluation

Working knowledge of
**AI agents, function/tool calling, agent orchestration, state management, and contextual memory**
.

Experience with
**LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks**
is preferred.

* Optimizing APIs, databases, model calls, and infrastructure.

  .

* Knowledge graphs, graph-based retrieval, and advanced AI memory.
* Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized deployments.

Experience Required

  .
* Strong full-stack development experience, particularly in backend engineering.
* Strong system design, microservices, and scalable architecture knowledge.
* Hands-on experience with
  **AWS Lambda and Amazon Bedrock**
  .
* Practical experience with
  **AI/LLM integration, OCR, and RAG**
  .

**hands-on engineer and strong system thinker**

title: I&P GN - SC&E – Analyst - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
description:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.
  
  
You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.
  
  
**THE WORK**
Utilize Relevant AI Tools Across All Tasks And Deliverable Creation, Including The Creation Of Agents And Other Tools To Help Facilitate
  
  
**Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development**

* Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states.
* Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context.
* Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools.
* Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives.

**Client Engagement & Advisory Support**

* Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions.
* Prepare client-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders.
* Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams.
* Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples.

**Data & AI Foundations**

* Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems.
* Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations.
* Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows.
* Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

title: Staff Engineer ( Java )
description:
Job ID: R-2026-27-Q01-0011

Department: ETPL AI

Designation: Staff Engineer

Experience: 6-9 years

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Bangalore, India

**About ETPL**

eReleGo Technologies Private Limited (ETPL) is a Bengaluru-based technology company building scalable digital platforms across AdTech, EdTech, SaaS ERP, and FinTech domains. The company focuses on applying advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence and data-driven systems to solve real operational problems for businesses and educational institutions.

As ETPL scales into a firm of larger size, revenue, and complexity, it is investing deliberately in building strong internal capabilities across leadership, operations, technology, people, and culture. The objective is not just rapid growth, but sustainable, future-ready growth supported by structured systems, strong talent, and accountable teams.

**About Crafter**

Crafter is a comprehensive low-code / no-code Enterprise & SaaS platform that helps organizations build custom applications, automate workflows, and streamline core business processes without extensive technical expertise.

Designed for startups, SMEs, and large enterprises seeking agility and efficiency, Crafter’s visual drag-and-drop builder and modular solutions enable businesses to rapidly create applications, manage resources, and enhance customer engagement with minimal coding.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Staff Engineer with 6 to 9 years of hands-on experience in Java and Spring Boot to provide technical leadership across one or more products within the ETPL AI portfolio. This role sits within ETPL's engineering capability and carries responsibility for backend architecture, system design, engineering quality, and the technical development of delivery teams.

The Staff Engineer will be the senior technical authority within their product engineering context - owning architectural decisions, driving best practices, and ensuring that the systems they are responsible for are scalable, maintainable, and built to support enterprise-grade deployments. The role combines deep hands-on engineering with the influence and communication skills to lead other engineers and engage meaningfully with product and business stakeholders.

This is a role for an engineer who has moved beyond individual contribution and is ready to shape how systems are designed, how teams deliver, and how technical quality is defined and maintained across a product.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide technical leadership in the design, development, and evolution of backend systems and services built on Java and Spring Boot across assigned ETPL AI products
* Own system architecture decisions for assigned product areas - ensuring scalability, modularity, security, and performance across multi-tenant enterprise deployments
* Lead and mentor a team of engineers, conducting code reviews, architectural walkthroughs, and technical discussions that raise the capability and quality of the broader team
* Translate product requirements and business logic into well-structured, maintainable technical designs - collaborating closely with product managers and senior stakeholders to ensure alignment between technical decisions and product outcomes
* Define and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and engineering governance frameworks across the product codebase
* Conduct architectural reviews and deep code audits to identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and structural risks - and lead the resolution of findings in a structured manner
* Design and optimize data models, database schemas, and query performance across relational databases, particularly MySQL and PostgreSQL, to support high-volume, data-intensive operations
* Drive the adoption of RESTful API design standards, microservices principles, and service integration patterns appropriate to ETPL's platform architecture
* Own the technical quality of the software delivery lifecycle within the product team - including requirements validation, design reviews, testing governance, deployment oversight, and post-release monitoring
* Identify, evaluate, and integrate appropriate libraries, frameworks, and tools to improve engineering efficiency, system reliability, and long-term maintainability
* Act as the escalation point for critical technical issues and production incidents within the product, leading structured root cause analysis and resolution
* Champion a culture of engineering excellence, documentation discipline, and continuous improvement within the product engineering team

**Experience And Profile**

* 6 to 9 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with strong and sustained depth in Java and Spring Boot
* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering scalable, high-performance backend systems for enterprise or SaaS products
* Experience leading or mentoring other engineers within a structured delivery team
* Proven ability to make and communicate sound architectural decisions across backend systems, APIs, and data layers
* Experience with microservices architecture, RESTful API design, and distributed systems is expected
* Prior exposure to multi-tenant platform design or enterprise product engineering is an advantage

**Skills And Attributes**

* Deep mastery of Java and Spring Boot, with strong expertise in building modular, production-grade enterprise backend systems
* Solid understanding of Spring ecosystem components - Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud - and their appropriate application in enterprise contexts
* Strong database engineering skills across relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) including schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and performance tuning at scale
* Proficiency in RESTful API design and development, with a clear understanding of API contracts, versioning, and integration standards
* Experience with microservices architecture, service decomposition, and inter-service communication patterns including REST and message queuing (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes, and with CI/CD pipeline tooling for structured, automated delivery
* Proficiency with Git and structured branching strategies for collaborative development within multi-team engineering environments
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms - AWS / Azure - and the deployment and infrastructure considerations relevant to enterprise SaaS products
* Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and test-driven development practices, with a commitment to maintaining high automated test coverage
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with structured root cause analysis — particularly under production pressure
* Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical decisions and trade-offs to both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders
* A collaborative and mentoring disposition - genuinely invested in the growth of the engineers around them, not just personal technical output

**Recruitment Process**

ETPL follows a structured, assessment-led recruitment process focused on long-term fit and capability development. Shortlisted candidates will go through:

* ETPL Aptitude Test (EAT) - to assess analytical ability, reasoning, and problem-solving
* ETPL Psychometric Test (EPT) - to understand work style, behavioral tendencies, and role alignment
* Interview Rounds - including functional and culture-fit discussions

This process ensures fairness, transparency, and clarity for both the candidate and the organization.

**What do we offer**

* Exposure to senior educators, institutional leaders, and industry practitioners
* Opportunities to learn from internal capability-building initiatives and leadership programs
* A growing organization that is investing in better systems, clearer roles, and stronger people practices
* A work environment that values learning, ownership, and long-term career growth

As a scaling company, ETPL is evolving its processes, teams, and structures. This role suits individuals who are comfortable growing alongside the organization, contributing to improvement, and building strong foundations rather than expecting everything to be fully polished from day one.

To apply you can send your resume to prashant.musale@erelego.com or DM me on (LinkedIn or +91-9167464004).
