The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a Senior Manager – AI Engineer to lead strategic AI initiatives and drive the design, development, and adoption of agent-based solutions using Microsoft AI technologies. This role combines deep technical expertise with leadership to scale AI-driven transformation across enterprise functions..
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the strategy, design, and delivery of AI-powered solutions using Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and agent-based frameworks.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong expertise in Copilot Studio and enterprise-grade AI agent development.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel (Python or C#).
* Extensive experience with Azure AI Foundry and AI/ML ecosystem.
* Deep understanding of agent-based architectures, orchestration patterns, and enterprise integrations.
* Proven ability to define architecture and lead large-scale AI programs.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic thinking skills.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions within enterprise systems and workflows.
* Translate business requirements into scalable AI architectures and reusable components.
* Ensure solution performance, reliability, and alignment with enterprise security and governance standards.
* Ability to work effectively in distributed, onshore–offshore delivery models.

**Ideally, you’ll also**
The following skills are preferred and add value to the role:
  
  

* Experience with Power Platform.
* Experience with Azure Integration Services.
* Experience supporting large transformation or digital modernization programs
* Familiarity with testing tools, deployment cycles, and release management practices
* Experience working across multiple industries or complex business environments

**What We Look For**

* Total Experience: [12+ Years]
* Relevant Experience (AI/Agent-based solutions): 1+ Years
* Prior experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise delivery engagements.
* Degree in BE / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or equivalent with relevant industry experience.
* Microsoft AI certification is preferred.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior IGA Engineer
description:
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an
**IGA Engineer**
to design, build, operate, and sustain the enterprise Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) platform that serves as the control plane for how identity and access are governed across the organization. This role is responsible for developing and enhancing IGA capabilities—connectors, workflows, roles, and integrations—while keeping the platform healthy, reliable, and audit-ready, and executing the SOX ITGC controls that make it a trusted, compliant system of record for access.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role spanning both build and run: configuring and developing new capabilities, integrating target systems, and enhancing governance workflows on one side, and sustaining platform health, change management, vendor-coordinated migrations, incident resolution, and control execution on the other. The engineer turns requirements into working configuration and code, keeps the platform available, and ensures every SOX-relevant activity is performed on schedule with complete, clean evidence. The ideal candidate brings solid hands-on experience with an enterprise IGA platform (SailPoint, Saviynt, or equivalent) combined with strong ITGC/SOX discipline and an operations-and-audit mindset.
  
  
The IGA platform is a business-critical, SOX-scoped security capability. Operational lapses translate directly into two kinds of failure: disruptions that block provisioning, deprovisioning, and access reviews, and control failures that produce audit findings and compliance exposure. This position is critical to ensuring the platform is stable, well-instrumented, and rarely surprises the business.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**IGA Development & Engineering**

* Design, develop, and enhance IGA capabilities—connectors, integrations, joiner/mover/leaver (JML) and access-request workflows, roles, entitlements, certifications, and SoD rules—to meet evolving governance and business requirements.
* Build and maintain integrations between the IGA platform and target systems (HR, directories, cloud, and enterprise/SaaS applications) via APIs and connectors.
* Translate governance and access-model requirements into working configuration and code, following engineering standards and design patterns.
* Test, document, and promote changes through the appropriate environments with quality and maintainability in mind.

**Platform Operations**

* Operate, administer, and sustain the IGA platform so it runs reliably day to day, resolving sync, provisioning, and workflow failures as they arise.
* Execute platform upgrades, patches, and configuration changes through disciplined change control, with validated cutover and rollback plans.
* Maintain and enforce environment segregation between non-production and production.

**Observability, Monitoring & Reliability**

* Configure and continuously tune monitoring, logging, alerting, and dashboards for the platform, its connectors, and its governance workflows.
* Establish leading-indicator alerting (connector health, provisioning failures, job/queue depth, workflow errors) so degradations are caught before they disrupt users.
* Ensure failures generate alerts and that recurring errors are escalated into incidents per defined procedures.
* Define and track availability and health metrics for the platform and its critical workflows.

**Incident & Problem Management**

* Investigate and resolve incidents affecting the IGA platform and its governance workflows, restoring service and following the incident management process.
* Perform root-cause analysis on recurring platform issues and implement durable preventive fixes.
* Maintain runbooks and operational documentation to support consistent incident handling.

**Change & Release Management**

* Execute changes through the standard change management process—documented change requests, testing, and appropriate business/IT approvals before production migration.
* Enforce segregation of duties between developers and operations on production migrations; ensure any developer activity in production is monitored, logged, and reviewed.
* Support periodic change reviews and emergency-change post-implementation reviews.

**Vendor & Migration Coordination**

* Serve as a technical point of contact for platform and managed-service vendors during upgrades, migrations, and platform changes.
* Plan and execute migration/upgrade cutovers—scheduling, pre-checks, validation testing, rollback plans, and go/no-go decisions—and hold vendors accountable to SLAs.
* Coordinate with infrastructure and cloud teams on environment or backup dependencies.

**SOX & ITGC Compliance Execution**

* Own timely, accurate execution and evidence collection for the IGA platform's SOX control set, working within the broader IAM SOX program's governance and cadence.
* Execute access-administration controls: provisioning and account changes, terminations/deactivations, administrative and user-account revalidations, SoD/role matrix maintenance, and privileged account activity reviews.
* Execute change-management controls in line with the segregation-of-duties requirements above, and support SOC 1/SOC 2 report review and periodic governance and risk reviews.
* Investigate exceptions, assess impact, document results, and drive deficiencies to remediation; ensure no self-review on any revalidation control.
* Operate in a continuous audit-ready posture and support internal and external audit requests with complete, on-time evidence.

**Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* Use scripting to make configuration and control execution repeatable, reviewable, and auditable, reducing operational toil and tightening the loop between operations and evidence collection.
* Maintain knowledge continuity through documentation and runbooks so no single control or activity depends on one individual.

**Experience**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* 5–7 years in IAM/IGA engineering and operations, with hands-on experience configuring and developing on an enterprise IGA platform.
* Proven experience building and operating an enterprise IGA platform in production (SailPoint, Saviynt, or comparable).

**Technical Skills**

* Hands-on IGA development and administration: connectors/integrations, JML and access-request workflows, roles/entitlements, certifications, and SoD rules.
* Solid grounding in IAM fundamentals: authentication, SSO (SAML/OIDC), provisioning/SCIM, RBAC, JML, and SoD concepts.
* Experience building and integrating with target systems (HR, directories, cloud, and enterprise/SaaS applications) via APIs and connectors.
* Experience with observability and monitoring for application platforms—building meaningful alerts and dashboards, not just consuming them.
* Experience with incident and change management via ITSM tooling.
* Scripting ability (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automation of platform tasks and evidence collection.

**Compliance Skills And Experience**

* SOX compliance and ITGC control testing experience.
* Ability to think, review, document, and challenge evidence from an auditor's perspective.
* Experience managing internal and external audit engagements.
* Strong understanding of IAM processes, access controls, and evidence validation.
* Ability to assess compliance risks and identify control gaps.
* Strong documentation and communication skills for auditor interactions and compliance reporting.
* Hands-on experience executing and evidencing core ITGC control types—access provisioning/deprovisioning, periodic user and privileged access reviews/recertification, and Segregation of Duties (SoD).
* Change-management control experience—change request tracking, testing, approvals, and dev-to-prod segregation of duties.
* Experience with deficiency and exception management—investigating exceptions, assessing impact, and tracking remediation to closure.
* Discipline to execute recurring controls on cadence and sustain audit-ready evidence.
* Experience reviewing SOC 1/SOC 2 reports, including complementary user entity controls (CUECs).
* Familiarity with GRC/compliance tooling for evidence and control management.
* Experience working with enterprise IAM platforms such as AD, SailPoint/Saviynt, etc. is preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Relevant IGA platform certification or equivalent platform-specific training.
* Deeper experience developing and troubleshooting IGA connectors and integrations.
* Experience leading IGA platform migrations or major version upgrades.
* Prior experience partnering with GRC, Internal Audit, and External Audit in a regulated enterprise.
* General awareness of the cloud environment the platform runs in—enough to coordinate effectively with infrastructure and vendor teams (deep cloud engineering not required).

Why This Role Is Critical
  
  
The IGA platform is where access is governed and where a significant set of SOX ITGC controls are executed. Without dedicated engineering, operational, and compliance ownership, the platform is exposed on two fronts at once: reliability and audit.
  
  
**This Role Directly Protects The Organization From**

* Platform and workflow disruptions that block onboarding, delay deprovisioning, and stall access reviews.
* SOX control failures and audit findings—missed revalidations, broken change/SoD discipline, incomplete evidence.
* Failed or delayed platform migrations and upgrades due to a lack of internal accountability.
* Incident-handling and control-coverage gaps that threaten compliance and continuity.
* Over-dependence on premium-priced vendor and contractor support.

This position is for an engineer who builds, runs, and keeps a business-critical, SOX-scoped platform effective—someone who understands that in a regulated identity platform, engineering, reliability, and compliance are the same job.

As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Topic Activation path within BCG's Principal Investors and Private Equity (PIPE) Practice Area you will work in a growing global team, providing industry/functional expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, analysis and expert advisory. The team uses a variety of number of AI and advanced data analytics tools; and you will be expected to develop expertise on those. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues.

Additionally, as a Manager – BCG Vantage, you will help build, own and enhance AI-enabled products, tools and knowledge assets – taking them from problem definition through build, deployment on live cases, and adoption. You will work closely with case teams and business leaders to drive real usage and impact, while helping onboard, train and enable junior colleagues on your topic/sector and on new products.

Likewise, PIPE topics cut across not only these asset classes, but also across industries (e.g., Health Care, Consumer, Technology, etc.) and sub-topics (e.g., Tech Capital, Private Credit, Environmental, Social and Governance, etc.)
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  

* 3+ years consulting experience in PIPE required; candidates with consulting experience preferred
* In lieu of consulting experience, 4+ years minimum industry experience required; 6-10+ years of industry experience strongly preferred
* Bachelor's Degree required (advanced degree preferred)
* Fluency in English;
* Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills to interact with internal and external stakeholder while working in a global collaborative team environment
* Practical fluency with GenAI and modern development tools (e.g. APIs, custom GPTs / AI Skills, coding assistants such as Claude Code or Cursor, GitHub, cloud platforms) strongly preferred; comfort learning new tools as the landscape evolves
* Demonstrated experience managing product roadmaps, backlog prioritization, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment, with comfort in data-driven decision making and familiarity with agile/scrum delivery frameworks

Who You'll Work With
  
  
As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Topic Activation path, you will collaborate with global topic leads and colleagues across BCG to bring expertise and capabilities to the service of our internal and external clients.
  
  
Our team is made up of a diverse pool of BCG Vantage positions that allow us to pursue exciting, innovative BCG Vantage careers.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

* Solving complex client problems through relevant analytical approaches and customized solutions in one or more relevant PIPE topic areas
* Communicating with senior stakeholders, demonstrating the ability to engage your audience effectively
* Demonstrating rapid learning agility across emerging technologies and analytical assets to enhance analysis, develop products, and create scalable, repeatable research and knowledge frameworks
* Managing a portfolio of projects, with strong awareness of business priorities and commercial impact
* Owning the end-to-end lifecycle of AI-enabled products and analytics assets – from problem definition and roadmap through prototyping, build, deployment on live cases, adoption tracking, and ongoing enhancement
* Training, coaching, and mentoring junior team members
* Working in an ever changing and complex environment, and comfortable with ambiguity and navigating a fast-paced environment

BCG Vantage is a powerhouse of expertise, seamlessly embedded within Practice Areas and markets to drive extraordinary impact. It equips BCG case teams and clients with cutting-edge expertise, proprietary assets, actionable data, and transformative insights that empower our case teams and enable our clients to achieve their aspirations.

* Integrates into client-facing teams to deliver direct client impact through expertise, know-how, and proprietary tools and assets

***Topic Activation (Sector Expertise with Proprietary Tool & Data Solutions)***

* Combines deep domain insights with our know-how and proprietary assets to address targeted challenges directly with clients and project teams; co-creates insights on industry trends and functional topics, proprietary data and tools, and teams to codify IP that all enables BCG to deliver excellent business value with its clients

title: I&P GN - SC&E – Analyst - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
description:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.
  
  
You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.
  
  
**THE WORK**
Utilize Relevant AI Tools Across All Tasks And Deliverable Creation, Including The Creation Of Agents And Other Tools To Help Facilitate
  
  
**Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development**

* Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states.
* Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context.
* Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools.
* Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives.

**Client Engagement & Advisory Support**

* Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions.
* Prepare client-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders.
* Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams.
* Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples.

**Data & AI Foundations**

* Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems.
* Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations.
* Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows.
* Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. The office contains multifunctional business capabilities and is integral in furthering the growth and transformation of KKR. We’re looking for exceptional engineers who are passionate about innovation, thrive in collaborative environments, and want to work on some of the most interesting challenges in financial technology. **Position Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Development Lead to join our dynamic team. They will also have deep, hands-on experience implementing modern Salesforce DevOps/CI/CD and architecting enterprise integrations between Salesforce and external platforms. * Ensure compliance with KKR Information Security, Data Privacy and governance standards and policies.

**Salesforce Development**

* Architect, build, and operate integrations between Salesforce and external enterprise platforms using Data Cloud, APIs, middleware, and data pipelines, including real-time + batch patterns, strong error handling/retries, monitoring/alerting, and data reconciliation.

**Technical Expertise**

* Ensure the scalability and maintainability of Salesforce solutions.
* Stay updated with the latest Salesforce releases and features and recommend improvements.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to Salesforce implementations.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science information technology, or a related field.
* At least 12 years of technology experience with a minimum of 5 years of experience in Salesforce development.
* Proven experience with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, particularly in Case Management, Data Cloud, Agentforce, etc.
* Experience with telephony integrations and CRM Analytics is highly desirable.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce automation tools (Visualforce where needed).
* In-depth understanding of Salesforce configuration, security, data model and workflows.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce Governor limits and performance optimization techniques.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
* Hands-on knowledge of Salesforce CI/CD, including release governance, and orchestration approaches.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I & II.
* Salesforce Application or System Architect certifications.
* Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant.
* Salesforce Certified Service Cloud Consultant.
* Salesforce Einstein Analytics and Discovery Consultant (preferred).

title: Principal Software Engineer Manager
description:
**Overview**

The Cloud Delivery team within Microsoft Defender helps services and product capabilities reach cloud environments quickly and reliably. We partner with service engineering and operations teams to improve deployment pipelines, automate readiness checks, and make releases easier to validate, diagnose, and operate. We aim to reduce routine manual intervention without losing the checks and recovery paths that keep releases safe.  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

As a Principal Software Engineering Manager in Microsoft Defender, you will lead engineers and work across the organization to help build software and improve processes to make our cloud deployments safer, more reliable, and less dependent on manual intervention.

You will own people development, technical direction, and delivery through your team while contributing hands-on to architecture, code, and production troubleshooting. Working with service teams across Defender, you will advance deployment automation and engineering efficiency by reducing repetitive work and developing reusable solutions to shared operational challenges.

Responsibilities include:

* Hire, coach, and develop engineers through clear expectations, actionable feedback, performance management, and career growth opportunities.
* Set engineering priorities and deliver results through your team, balancing deployment improvements with reliability, security, and ongoing support.
* Lead architecture and design for Azure deployment automation and infrastructure tooling, addressing service dependencies, integration boundaries, and failure recovery.
* Contribute code, review designs and implementations, and troubleshoot production issues while developing engineers’ technical judgment and ownership.
* Partner with Defender service teams to automate deployment preparation and validation, reduce manual handoffs, and clarify ownership of tooling and service operation.
* Drive engineering efficiency across Defender by identifying recurring deployment and operational work, improving existing workflows, and building reusable automation where it delivers measurable benefit.
* Use deployment telemetry and incident learning to measure improvements in reliability and manual effort and guide testing, observability, and safe rollout practices.

  
**Qualifications**

**Qualifications - Required:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field
* 10+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.
* Experience managing software engineers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development.
* Experience delivering and supporting production software through an engineering team, including prioritization and dependency management. -
* Ability to explain technical decisions, risks, and alternatives to engineering partners and leaders and resolve competing requirements.

  Other Requirements

  + This position will be required to pass the Microsoft background and Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

**Qualifications:**

* Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture principles including microservices, serverless computing, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems.
* Proven expertise in API strategy, API governance, integration architecture, and enterprise modernization initiatives.
* Strong experience leading AI/ML and Generative AI solution development and enterprise adoption programs.
* Experience working in client-facing consulting, advisory, or enterprise transformation roles.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, application security, governance, compliance, DevSecOps, and operational excellence practices.
* Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

* Master’s degree preferred.

**Technical Expertise:**

* Strong expertise in Cloud Platforms including Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Deep hands-on experience in Python, FastAPI, Flask, Django, and backend service development.
* Strong Full Stack development expertise using React.js, Angular, Node.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
* Strong competency in designing and implementing REST APIs, GraphQL services, Microservices, and Enterprise Integration frameworks.

title: Technical Lead - M365 & EntraID
description:
It's about Being What's next.
**What's in it for you?**
The Technical Lead in this position will drive Global Governance & Security Step into a global role shaping how Microsoft 365 is secured, governed, and evolved across Linde. Work at the forefront of cloud security, architecture, and Copilot/AI governance to deliver scalable, enterprise services.
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
  
  
Team
  
  

Making an impact.
**What will you do?**

* You will support, configure, develop, maintain, and monitor M365 Services
* You are expected to work close to EMEA time zone (details to be provided during interview)
* And be responsible for developing, documenting and sustaining the architecture and relevant processes related to M365 services
* You will enforce the creation of technical concept documents, SOPs, and best practices for using M365's different line of products with a focus on M365 governance activities, Tenant Management, Security, and security posture
* Also, provide governance and technical direction and acts as a technical authority on topics related to M365 services
* Analyze and assess business requirements and solutions in the context of M365, keeping in mind security as a fundamental part of the solution
* And handle change management around Microsoft updates to the M365 and Entra ID
* You will support services in line with service-level agreements
* You will also work with Evergreen activities, plan, communicate, and perform the necessary steps to take a new feature or product into a sustainable service offering
* Moreover, support and sustain implementation of Microsoft Purview solutions at Enterprise level including DLP and Sensitivity labels
* Lastly, monitoring the usage of Agentic AI based on Copilot/Copilot Studio in the organization including licensing, costs, and security

Winning in your role.
**Do you have what it takes?**

* You must have a bachelor's degree with a major in computer science, information management systems, or business administration and 5 to 10 years+ of experience providing IT application support and administration, including experience leading IT projects
* Along with, 6+ years’ experience with the operation and maintenance of M365 Tenants, including roles as L3 administrator or M365 solution architect
* And 5+ years working as Administrator, Cloud Architect or global development also, 5+ years' experience with PowerShell
* Must have is excellent English skills, both verbally and written
* Also, experience creating technical concepts and driving technical implementations
* Good experience with Power BI, Azure Analytics, and in general with tools that allow creation, managing and analysing data
* Lastly, proven knowledge on Application Access Governance, including graph permissions, and Agentic AI permissions

**Why you will love working for us!**
Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet. Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals & energy, food & beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra-high-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state-of-the-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.
  
  
Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd. (LGSS) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Linde, based out of Kolkata, India. It is a Global IT Delivery Center that has been successfully delivering IT Enabled Services to the group companies of Linde, across the world for almost two decades, since 2006. Our goal is to provide and support IT services and solutions that are critical for the operation of the entire group. As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.
  
  
At Linde Global IT Delivery Center, Kolkata we offer exciting career opportunities to grow and work in leading technologies in a truly global work environment.
  
  
Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
  
  
For more information about the company and its products and services, please visit linde.com

title: Sr. Technical Architect
description:
**A career that’s the whole package!**
At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.
  
  
**Conga**
lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Sr. Technical Architect, PS
  
  
**Locations:**
Ahmedabad
  
  
**Reports to**
: Director, Professional Services
  
  
**A quick snapshot…**
Conga is seeking an experienced Technical Architect with over 12+ years of work experience who will play a key role in implementing Quote-to-Cash suite of products, including CPQ (configure/price/quote), contract management, revenue management and other related solutions. Perform hands-on design, solution architectures, architecture roadmaps, prototyping, proof-of-concepts, development tasks and integrating Conga products as required in support of current and new projects. Ensuring the solution is scalable and meets overall business requirements. Working with global teams actively for implementation. Be recognized as an expert in CPQ and/or Contract Management domain. Leading technical teams to deliver flexible and scalable solutions.
  
  
**Why it’s a big deal…**
A Technical Architect will help us design and deliver solutions for enterprise-grade customers using Conga products. The intention is to recommend the best solution for a given set of requirements and articulate the trade-offs involved in choosing one solution over another. Leading design sessions and writing design documents by managing the delivery of integrations and custom extensions will be most critical. This person should also be highly proficient and successful in managing the technical and overall scope of the client’s expectations.
  
  
**Are you the person we’re looking for?**
**Related experience.**
You should understand business requirements regarding product management and develop solution design and enhancements using different configurations, using Salesforce or Dot Net platform (APEX, Visual Force, C#, Angular / React JS or equivalent front-end technologies). Thorough unit testing with a high level of code coverage is necessary. You should have demonstrated experience of working as part of an Agile development team. Experience automated deployment process will help score more.
  
  
**Implementation and Integrations.**
The ability to drive deep-level technical discussions with prospects and help set expectations for potential project efforts is a must. A Technical Architect would interact directly with clients and end-users on a regular basis to analyze project objectives and capability requirements, including specifications for user interfaces, customized applications, and interactions with internal / external applications.
  
  
**Design and Pre-Sales Activities.**
You would be responsible for providing hands-on expert level assistance to developers for any issues. Designing and managing the execution deployment and testing ensuring a quality solution is delivered will be the key. Ability to lead a requirement gathering session, write requirements, architecture documents and manage integrations. This role will include participation in pre-sales activities as and when required.
  
  
**Education**
. A bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent.
  
  
**Here’s What Will Give You An Edge…**
**Champion of the Customer**
. You understand that customers are one of business’ most important assets and you take that seriously. With more than 11,000 customers around the globe entrusting Conga with their business we make a commitment to their success and would love to hear how you will too!
  
  
**Analytical thinker and creative problem solver.**
You can see issues holistically and follow the flow of the stack to get to the root of the matter - a key skill in this role. But where you really shine is with your ability to identify creative solutions to unique customer requirements. This is critical for ensuring our customer issues are resolved in a manner that meets or exceeds their expectations without increasing their costs.

title: Analyst, Algorithm Research & Development
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Measurement, Analytics and Control (MACH) division is KLA’s software powerhouse, responsible for developing high-performance software platforms that support semiconductor manufacturing. MACH delivers cutting-edge technologies in patterning analytics, modeling, and data science—empowering chipmakers to ramp next-gen devices faster and more efficiently. Our cross-functional team of research scientists, software engineers, apps engineers and process engineers are solving the industry’s most complex technical problems.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an intellectually curious and technically exceptional AI Engineer to join our Applied AI Research organization.
  
  
This role is designed for individuals who enjoy moving beyond application of established techniques and are motivated by solving problems that have no obvious solution. The successful candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with expertise in machine learning, statistical algorithms, deep learning, and agentic AI systems to create next-generation intelligence platforms for semiconductor manufacturing and engineering.
  
  
Unlike traditional software engineering roles, this position requires a strong research mindset. We are looking for engineers who question assumptions, derive first-principles understanding of problems, conduct systematic experimentation, and translate emerging research into practical business impact.
  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to grow into a future technical and research leader capable of influencing the direction of AI, analytics, and intelligent automation across the organization.
  
  
**Vision for the Role**
Over the next several years, this individual is expected to evolve from an AI engineer into a recognized research leader who:
  
  

* Shapes the organization's AI strategy through technical innovation.
* Drives a culture of experimentation and evidence-based decision making.
* Bridges cutting-edge AI research with real-world engineering applications.
* Identifies transformational technologies before they become mainstream.
* Inspires teams to pursue ambitious technical challenges.
* Builds an innovation ecosystem through mentorship, technical leadership, and collaboration.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Applied AI Research**

* Investigate emerging AI techniques and evaluate their applicability to semiconductor manufacturing and engineering workflows.
* Conduct hands-on research in areas such as:

+ Foundation Models
+ Agentic AI Systems
+ Scientific Machine Learning
+ Computer Vision
+ Reinforcement Learning
+ Probabilistic Modeling
+ Knowledge Representation
+ Multi-Agent Systems
+ Causal AI

* Develop novel approaches for solving difficult engineering and manufacturing problems.
* Design rigorous experimental frameworks to validate hypotheses and quantify impact.
* Translate research findings into scalable product capabilities.

**Statistical Learning & Algorithm Development**
Design and develop advanced algorithms utilizing:
  
  

* Bayesian Inference
* Probabilistic Graphical Models
* Design of Experiments (DOE)
* Time-Series Analysis
* Optimization Techniques
* Causal Inference
* Anomaly Detection
* Predictive Modeling
* Multivariate Statistics
* Graph Analytics

Responsibilities include:
  
  

* Creating explainable and scientifically sound models.
* Evaluating statistical significance of experimental outcomes.
* Building decision-support and autonomous reasoning systems.

**Deep Learning & Scientific AI**
Develop next-generation deep learning solutions for:
  
  

* Defect Management
* Yield Analytics
* Manufacturing Optimization
* Image Understanding
* Pattern Recognition
* Engineering Knowledge Discovery

Work with and innovate on:
  
  

* CNNs
* Vision Transformers
* Multimodal Models
* Graph Neural Networks
* Self-Supervised Learning
* Representation Learning
* Foundation Models
* Diffusion Architectures

Candidates should be comfortable reading research papers, reproducing published techniques, and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  
  
**Agentic AI & Intelligent Systems**
Develop intelligent autonomous systems capable of:
  
  

* Planning
* Reasoning
* Tool Usage
* Workflow Orchestration
* Long-Horizon Goal Achievement

Build sophisticated AI systems using:
  
  

* LangGraph
* Semantic Kernel
* AutoGen
* CrewAI
* OpenAI Agent Frameworks
* MCP (Model Context Protocol)

Examples include:
  
  

* AI Copilots
* Manufacturing Assistants
* Engineering Intelligence Platforms
* Autonomous Analytics Systems
* Knowledge Agents

**Software Engineering Excellence**
Develop production-grade solutions using:
  
  
**Primary Languages**

* Python
* Modern C++ (C++17/20)

**Additional Technologies**

* PyTorch
* Ray
* Spark
* Kubernetes
* Docker
* Vector Databases
* Graph Databases

The candidate should be able to transform research prototypes into scalable and maintainable products.
  
  
**Research Leadership Expectations**
Although this is an individual contributor role, the candidate is expected to actively contribute to building a research culture.
  
  
This includes:
  
  

* Leading technical reading groups.
* Reviewing and discussing recent research papers.
* Driving internal innovation initiatives.
* Mentoring junior engineers on research methodology.
* Promoting first-principles thinking.
* Encouraging experimentation and hypothesis-driven development.
* Establishing engineering rigor around benchmarking and evaluation.

Success is measured not only by feature delivery but also by the advancement of the team's collective technical capability.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
**Education**
MS or PhD preferred in:
  
  

* Computer Science
* Machine Learning
* Artificial Intelligence
* Statistics
* Applied Mathematics
* Electrical Engineering
* Related STEM discipline

**Experience**
Typically:
  
  

* BS + 5 years
* OR MS + 3 years
* OR PhD

Demonstrated experience in building production AI systems while maintaining strong interest in research and innovation.
  
  
**Ideal Candidate Profile**
The ideal candidate is someone who:
  
  

* Reads research papers for fun.
* Questions conventional assumptions.
* Enjoys tackling open-ended technical challenges.
* Can move seamlessly from theory to implementation.
* Has strong mathematical intuition.
* Is passionate about creating new knowledge, not merely applying existing solutions.
* Wants to become a future Principal Engineer, Distinguished Engineer, or AI Research Leader.

**What Success Looks Like After 3-5 Years**
This engineer will have:
  
  

* Become a recognized technical authority in AI and analytics.
* Influenced the AI roadmap for multiple products.
* Originated innovations that materially impact product differentiation.
* Built a thriving culture of experimentation and technical excellence.
* Mentored the next generation of AI engineers and researchers.
* Established KLA as a leader in AI-native semiconductor manufacturing intelligence.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
  
  
*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

description:
**Job Summary – AI Technical Lead.**

* Kumaran Systems is looking for an experienced
  **AI**
  **Lead (Technical)**

  **Equity Market Technology -Capital Markets domain.**

* The role will drive innovation in
  **Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI workflows, and intelligent automation using the Microsoft Azure cloud platform**
  .

* The candidate will
  **provide technical leadership to a team of AI engineers**
  , collaborate closely with stakeholders, data scientists, and platform teams, and translate business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable AI solutions.

* The role requires strong hands-on
  **technical expertise, solution architecture capabilities, and the ability to lead AI initiatives from Concept to Production.**

**Details of Employment:**

**Location:**
Chennai, India

**Work Location**
– Guindy Olympia Tech Park OR SIPCOT Siruseri.

**Mode of Employment**
- 3 days Hybrid in the Office.

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time, Permanent.

**Notice Period**
- 0 to 15 days from the date of the offer (
**Critical Requisition; hence the ask**
)

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI Architecture and Solution Design**

* Architect and lead the development of enterprise-grade RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, vector databases, embedding models, and retrieval strategies using Azure AI Search, FAISS, and Pinecone.
* Design and implement Agentic AI systems incorporating autonomous agents, multi-step planning, tool orchestration, reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Develop AI solutions that integrate with internal systems, including trading platforms, operations workbenches, and risk engines, to automate decision support, exception handling, and reporting.
* Establish standards for prompt engineering, AI guardrails, and evaluation frameworks, including offline evaluations, A/B testing, and automated regression testing.

**2. Azure Cloud and AI Platform Engineering**

* Lead the design, implementation, and management of AI/ML infrastructure on Microsoft Azure using Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Design scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient AI inference pipelines using caching, request batching, and token-budget optimization.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML models and AI agents, incorporating model versioning, controlled deployments, A/B testing, rollback mechanisms, and observability.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise cloud governance, data residency, and security requirements using Azure Private Endpoints, Managed Identity, Key Vault, and related security controls.

**3. AI Performance Optimization and Troubleshooting**

* Diagnose and resolve production AI performance issues, including inference latency, embedding drift, retrieval quality degradation, hallucinations, and context-window limitations.
* Monitor and optimize token consumption, API rate limits, throughput, and cost per query across production AI workloads.
* Establish AI observability through structured logging, distributed tracing across prompt processing, retrieval, and generation, and dashboards tracking latency (p50/p95/p99), retrieval recall, and answer relevance.
* Conduct root-cause analysis of AI system failures, including incorrect tool invocations, RAG retrieval failures, safety-filter false positives, and model regressions following version upgrades.

**4. Technical Leadership and Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of 4–6 AI/ML engineers, overseeing code reviews, architecture decisions, sprint planning, engineering standards, and professional development.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, data scientists, quantitative teams, and operations leaders to translate business requirements into scalable, production-ready AI solutions.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, model releases, fine-tuning techniques, agent frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, and CrewAI, and AI evaluation methodologies.
* Represent the AI engineering function in technical design reviews, architecture governance forums, and incident post-mortems.
* Drive engineering best practices and continuous improvement across AI solution design, development, deployment, monitoring, security, and operational support.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on AI/ML solutions in production environments.
* Deep hands-on experience with RAG architectures, including vector databases, embedding pipelines, chunking strategies, hybrid search (keyword + semantic), re-ranking, and retrieval evaluation.
* Proven track record of building Agentic AI systems, including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, planning loops, memory management, and fallback strategies.
* Strong proficiency in Azure Cloud services, including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search (formerly Cognitive Search), Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, AKS, and App Service.
* Experience troubleshooting AI performance issues, including inference latency optimization, token budgeting, embedding drift detection, hallucination mitigation, and cost management at scale.
* Proficiency in Python and at least one of the following: C#/.NET or TypeScript/Node.js.
* Experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or CrewAI.
* Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, including transformers, attention mechanisms, fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), RLHF, and evaluation metrics such as BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore, faithfulness, and relevance.
* Experience leading engineering teams of 4+ members in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and prepare clear technical documentation.

Resumes can be shared with
**devika.raju@kumaran.com**

title: Solutions Architect
description:
About the role

You will be the architect who wins the technical deal. Before a contract is signed, you show enterprise customers that their AI agents will work, at their scale and under their rules. You build the demos and proofs of concept, answer the architecture questions, and hand delivery a plan they can execute. This is a hands-on engineering role in front of customers. You write code most weeks and spend the rest with CIOs, platform teams and risk officers. You report to the Co-Founder and CTO.

What you will do

• Discover: run technical discovery with CIOs, platform-engineering and risk teams at banks, insurers and asset managers. Map their systems, data and controls to the agent use cases that matter.

• Demo: build tailored demos of agent workflows, using the customer's own scenarios where you can.

• Prove: scope and deliver 2 to 6 week proofs of concept. Write the code, wire up integrations and measure results against agreed success criteria.

• Design: produce reference architectures for agent deployment on AWS, Azure or GCP, covering identity, data access, observability and guardrails.

• De-risk: answer security, compliance and model-risk questionnaires (SOC 2, data residency, audit logging, human-in-the-loop controls).

• Hand off: turn every won proof of concept into a delivery plan our forward-deployed engineers can run from day one.

• Feed back: bring field patterns to product and build reusable demo assets, templates and starter agents.

What we are looking for

• 8+ years in software engineering, solutions engineering, solutions architecture or forward-deployed engineering for enterprise customers.

• Hands-on experience building LLM applications or agents: prompt and tool design, RAG, evaluation, and at least one agent framework.

• Strong Python, plus working knowledge of APIs, containers and one major cloud.

• Comfort in regulated environments, where governance, auditability and access control decide the deal.

• Consulting experience: client-facing work, scoping engagements and running workshops with enterprise stakeholders.

• Understanding of tool calling and MCP, guardrails and policy controls, access management, observability and audit trails.

title: AICTE Postdoctoral Fellowship in Neuromorphic Computing
description:
About Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham

Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is a leading multi-campus, multi-disciplinary research university in India, nationally recognised for its research output and academic excellence. The university has eight campuses across five Indian states, with its headquarters in Ettimadai, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu.

Amrita runs regular student and researcher exchange programmes with top universities in the United States, including Ivy League institutions, and with leading European universities. It is one of the fastest-growing institutions of higher learning in the country. Fellows get an international outlook, modern facilities and strong institutional support for high-impact research.

About the Fellowship

Applications are invited for a full-time, on-site
**Postdoctoral Fellowship in Neuromorphic Computing**
, offered under the
**AICTE Postdoctoral Fellowship scheme**
. The fellow will be based at Amrita’s Chennai campus.

The fellow will join an interdisciplinary research environment spanning semiconductor physics, computing and engineering. They will carry out original research in neuromorphic computing.

* Conduct original research in neuromorphic computing, including designing and running experiments and developing models
* Analyse experimental and simulation data
* Carry out hands-on laboratory work and collaborate with faculty and research teams

* Mentor graduate and undergraduate students
* Contribute to grant proposals
* Support collaborative projects with national and international partners

**Essential**

* PhD in Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics or a closely related discipline, or equivalent research experience (subject to AICTE PDF eligibility norms)

* A solid foundation in electronic devices, circuits and systems
* Competence in data analysis, including statistical methods, numerical modelling and relevant software tools
* Strong programming skills (e.g. Python, MATLAB or similar)
* Familiarity with simulation tools used in neuromorphic and device-level research
* Ability to work collaboratively in interdisciplinary teams
* Clear written and spoken communication of research findings in English
* Willingness to work on-site in Chennai and engage fully with Amrita’s research and academic community

* Experience in one or more of the following:
* neuromorphic hardware
* computational neuroscience
* AI/ML for neuromorphic systems
* VLSI

title: Technical Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
Serve as a Technical Lead for Genesys Cloud solutions within a hybrid work model applying deep expertise in quality monitoring speech analytics and APIs to optimize contact center operations in auto claims and property and casualty insurance. Drive high impact technical initiatives that improve customer experience operational efficiency and compliance for a global organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead end to end technical design and implementation of Genesys Cloud solutions to support complex contact center workflows for auto claims and property and casualty insurance operations.
* Oversee configuration and optimization of Genesys Cloud quality monitoring features to ensure thorough evaluation of agent interactions and continuous service performance improvement.
* Drive development and integration of Genesys Cloud APIs to connect customer communication channels with policy systems and claims platforms in a secure and scalable manner.
* Provide hands on guidance in tuning speech analytics models to identify customer sentiment trends and claims related issues that inform business decisions and process enhancements.
* Coordinate with claims operations and underwriting teams to translate domain requirements from auto claims and property and casualty insurance into robust Genesys Cloud technical solutions.
* Implement monitoring and alerting mechanisms around Genesys Cloud services and APIs to ensure high availability low latency and rapid incident response in a day shift environment.
* Collaborate with cross functional stakeholders to design call flows routing strategies and interaction policies that improve claim handling efficiency and customer satisfaction.
* Execute structured code reviews configuration audits and documentation updates for Genesys Cloud components to maintain regulatory compliance and technical standards alignment.
* Analyze interaction data from quality monitoring and speech analytics to propose targeted improvements in claims handling scripts workflows and agent coaching programs.
* Guide junior engineers in best practices for Genesys Cloud development integration and troubleshooting while maintaining focus on customer and business outcomes rather than formal people management.
* Conduct impact assessments and proof of concept activities for new Genesys Cloud features or API integrations that can enhance automation in claims intake and policy servicing.
* Coordinate hybrid work collaboration using secure tools and standardized processes to ensure consistent progress across onsite and remote team members without travel requirements.
* Document solution designs technical decisions and operational runbooks clearly so that support teams can manage Genesys Cloud environments effectively during day shifts.

**Qualifications**

* Apply extensive experience of seven to ten years in enterprise contact center technologies with a focus on Genesys Cloud platforms quality monitoring and speech analytics to deliver reliable solutions.
* Demonstrate strong proficiency in designing and consuming Genesys Cloud APIs including authentication data mapping and error handling patterns for insurance domain integrations.
* Bring solid understanding of auto claims processes and property and casualty insurance lifecycles to shape technical configurations that align with regulatory expectations and customer service goals.
* Utilize practical experience in hybrid work models to manage time communication and collaboration effectively across distributed technical and business teams.

title: Technology Analyst
description:
About the Role Technology Analyst (IMP NOTE - This is not a Business Analyst or Data Analyst Role)  Introduction

Oxford University Press is seeking an Analyst, DPM to support the development, enhancement, and delivery of innovative digital products that help advance learning and educational outcomes. This is an excellent opportunity for a technology-focused professional who is passionate about digital product development and enjoys working in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.

As part of the Digital Product Management team, you will play an important role in supporting the development, customization, release, and maintenance of digital products. You will work closely with colleagues across Editorial, Marketing, Customer Services, and external technology partners, helping to deliver high-quality digital solutions that support OUP's mission of advancing knowledge and learning.

The role offers exposure to product management, agile delivery, digital content management, quality assurance, customer-focused product enhancements, and educational technology. It is ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems, building innovative solutions, and contributing to the ongoing growth of digital learning products.

  Opportunity

As Analyst, DPM, you will support the delivery of digital products throughout their lifecycle, ensuring high-quality user experiences and timely product releases.

Key responsibilities include:

* Supporting the development of new products, product features, and innovative ideas, including building quick MVPs to help stakeholders visualize product concepts.
* Developing feature backlogs and user stories, agreeing priorities with stakeholders, and supporting agile delivery of product enhancements within agreed timelines.
* Managing the sourcing, ingestion, and delivery of learning content for digital products.
* Enhancing digital content by enabling engaging digital interactions and learning experiences.
* Liaising with internal and external stakeholders to ensure quality, accuracy, and timely delivery of product releases.
* Supporting product development processes and ensuring adherence to quality standards.
* Coordinating Quality Assurance (QA) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities to ensure products meet performance and security requirements.
* Supporting the timely delivery of school updates, patches, installers, and software releases, including planning, testing, release note validation, and communication activities.
* Delivering product training sessions for Customer Services, Marketing, and other internal teams as required.
* Ensuring User Manuals, FAQs, Help Videos, and related support materials are maintained, updated, and of a high standard.
* Ensuring compliance requirements, NDA obligations, and third-party processes are followed in accordance with group guidelines.
* Coordinating effectively with Editorial, Marketing, Customer Support, Finance teams, and third-party vendor partners.

  Impact

This role is critical in ensuring OUP's digital products are delivered efficiently, maintained to high standards, and continually improved to meet customer needs. By supporting product development, content delivery, quality assurance, and stakeholder collaboration, you will help drive successful product launches, improved customer experiences, and operational excellence across OUP's digital portfolio.

  About You Essential Criteria

* B.Tech or MCA in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3-4 years of IT experience.

title: WhatsApp - Software Engineer - iOS
description:
More than 3 billion people in over 180 countries use WhatsApp to stay in touch with friends and family, anytime and anywhere. In India, it is also where a great deal of everyday life gets done — people message businesses, coordinate their families, and increasingly send money as easily as they send a message.We are building a new team to take WhatsApp further in that direction. The newly established WhatsApp Services team is focused on making WhatsApp more useful for more of what people already use it for, and on building what comes next.The WhatsApp Services team is treated as a zero-to-one effort so we can move fast, take risks and build as we go — staffed and prioritized, like every other WhatsApp team, from day one. Payments on WhatsApp aren't a bet on paper: live and growing in India, with the existing WhatsApp payments engineering team moving across as the foundation.As an iOS engineer at WhatsApp you will use your start-up mindset and your full range of engineering skills to produce elegantly simple products. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible in a mobile app, while sharing our commitment to quality and attention to detail. You will set direction for a team's technical area, lead major initiatives end to end, and be one of the people the pillar relies on to make the right engineering trade-offs under real ambiguity.
  
  
WhatsApp - Software Engineer - iOS Responsibilities:
  
  

* Build and ship client features for WhatsApp on iOS, with a focus on performance, reliability and responsiveness.
* Own iOS client architecture for services surfaces — payments, commerce and the everyday money-centric flows people already come to WhatsApp for.
* Work across Swift and Objective-C with the iOS SDK, and partner with server and platform teams on API design.
* Set direction and goals for a team, lead major initiatives and drive them to completion across functions.
* Architect efficient and scalable systems that drive complex applications, and make the engineering trade-offs a 0-to-1 effort demands.
* Identify and resolve performance and scalability issues, and drive large efforts to reduce technical debt.
* Establish ownership of significant components, features or systems with expert end-to-end understanding.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers, help onboard new team members and raise the engineering bar in the team.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams in product management, design, data science and operations to build innovative application experiences.
* Partner with payments, legal, compliance and local operations partners to ship services that meet the reliability and regulatory bar expected in India.

Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8+ years of programming experience in a relevant language, or 4+ years of experience with a PhD
* Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects
* Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Experience building complex applications for the iPhone or iPad using Objective-C/C++/Swift with the iOS SDK and other frameworks
* Experience with multithreading programming and mobile memory management
* Experience shipping at a high release cadence with strong attention to craft and detail
* Experience building for the Indian market, including familiarity with UPI and India's digital payments ecosystem
* In-market experience in India, or experience at an India-based consumer technology or fintech company operating at scale
* Experience building payment systems at scale, including the reliability, correctness and regulatory requirements they carry
* Background in monetization, payments, commerce or AI/ML products
* Experience building 0-to-1 products or standing up new product areas
* Experience with global, multi-market products, particularly in emerging markets
* Experience working with teams distributed across multiple sites
* Familiarity with messaging platforms or mobile-first consumer products
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

About Meta:
  
  
Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

title: Venture Fellow - Internship
description:
Aadi Labs is a venture creation studio. We help founders turn promising ideas into working products, first customers and the foundations of real companies, and we build some of those companies ourselves, with Venture Fellows leading the work.

You will own a real function inside an early-stage venture for six months: real users, real numbers, real consequences if something does not work.

**What you will actually do**

Depending on the venture and the function you choose, that could mean running growth experiments and watching the numbers move, shipping product decisions that get tested by real users within days, writing and deploying code that goes live the same week, or designing the first experience a customer ever sees of something that did not exist a month ago. You will not be handed a six-month roadmap on day one. You will be handed a problem and the room to go solve it.

**Who this is for**

AI is already part of how you work daily. You use it to get more done than your headcount would suggest, not as a novelty you dabble in occasionally. You want responsibility earlier than a conventional internship gives you, and you are comfortable with a role that is not fully defined yet.

Prior experience in a function helps, but a real track record of building or shipping something, anywhere, counts for more than a résumé line.

**Pick your track**
— Venture Fellows lead one of five functions. You choose which one you are applying for on our site.

* **Growth**
   — positioning, acquisition and retention, with AI handling the busywork so your judgment goes toward what to test next.
* **Product**
   — the customer, the first use case, the smallest version worth shipping, prototyped with AI to move at founder speed.
* **Engineering**
   — production code, using AI coding tools to multiply your own output.
* **Design**
   — the end-to-end experience, from UX to the first impression a user gets.
* **Other**
   — sales, operations, customer success, or a function that doesn't fit neatly above.

**Logistics**
: 6 months · Remote or hybrid (Whitefield, Bangalore)

· Direct exposure to zero-to-one building, mentorship, real equity via ESOP, and a credible path to full-time or founding your own venture after.
