You have a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in the mobile and app developer space with performance-type advertisers and agencies.  
  
**Description**  
Manage relationships with clients and agencies in the performance marketing space  
Maintain a high level of outreach via email, phone and meetings to ensure a strong business pipeline  
Develop a strategy for long-term success across your portfolio of clients & prospects  
Act as a thought leader with both clients and agencies  
Work closely with your Manager & Platform Specialist team to ensure accurate execution and alignment with customer objectives  
Use internal & external data sets to understand how to best help grow your customer's business  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
Strong network and relationships across clients, agencies, and developers.  
Ability to engage and influence stakeholders across all levels from C-suite executives to day-to-day marketing planners.  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to listen actively, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and clearly articulate strategic business visions internally and externally  
Deep understanding of the mobile ecosystem and in particular the gaming, media and finance verticals (not required but a plus)  
Team-first mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment while adapting to new business opportunities.  
Highly professional demeanor with a positive and solutions-oriented attitude.  
Track record of meeting and exceeding goals.  
Experience in gaming app category preferred.  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
Bachelors Degree educated, MBA a plus  
Experience in performance media sales with at least 4 years experience using a self-serve type platform  
Managed India-based clients with domestic and export business in your previous roles  
Experienced in online, digital, or performance marketing, ideally within the mobile ecosystem and data-driven marketing environment.  
Solid expertise in performance marketing, including campaign optimization, measurement, and growth strategies.  
Excellent communication and presentations skills - both in person and virtually

title: Client Partner Manager
description:
At Apple, we work every day to create products that enrich people’s lives. We want to help people in every part of their lives that we can, including making the world’s best content easily and beautifully available to the hundreds of millions of people around the globe who use Apple products. Our Advertising Platforms organization enables a thriving ecosystem for content creators, publishers, and developers by helping them monetize their work while enabling users to discover high-quality content seamlessly across Apple devices. With the continued growth of Apple Ads within the App Store where a significant majority of app downloads originate from search this platform has become a critical channel for app discovery and performance marketing for iOS developers globally.
  
  
In this role, you will grow, lead and develop a team that is responsible for revenue generation and customer happiness across your assigned market or region. You’ll use your knowledge of developers, advertisers and agencies to create and maintain positive and productive relationships with marketers of all size and type. You’ll quickly gain the respect and support of both management and other employees by achieving business goals and demonstrating good judgment, business insight, balance, objectivity, collaboration, quiet confidence, and trustworthiness. You will also have direct management responsibility for a team of Client Partners (our client facing sales team) and the Platform Specialists.  
  
**Description**  
The Client Partner Manager (CPM) will lead the Bangalore team, responsible for sourcing, managing, and growing strategic relationships with leading clients, developers, and agencies. This role requires a strong player-coach leader who can effectively develop and inspire the team while remaining hands-on in managing and expanding relationships with our most strategic customers.  
The CPM will oversee the Client Partner team while also managing the Platform Specialist team, who is responsible for optimizing Apple Ads accounts, maximizing revenue performance, and ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction.  
This role will be responsible for driving a high-performance sales culture that consistently delivers against revenue targets, customer satisfaction (CSI) goals, and key performance metrics such as CPT and CPA. The CPM will lead by example, setting a high standard of execution and ensuring the team delivers extraordinary service and strategic value to all customers.  
The CPM will also ensure strong operational discipline across the team, ensuring the team are reporting their business through the correct channels, utilizing salesforce and other internal business management tools.  
In addition, the role will partner closely with cross-functional teams, including Marketing and Product, to provide market feedback, share customer insights, and inform product development. A strong understanding of the broader digital marketing ecosystem including attribution, viewability, measurement, and competitive dynamics is essential.  
Overall, this is an exciting opportunity to lead a best-in-class sales organization. The CPM will be responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding strategic partnerships and strengthening client retention, while ensuring the team continues to deliver market-leading service.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
Demonstrated ability to build strong team cultures and to attract, develop, and retain top talent.  
A hands-on player-coach leadership style, with the ability to both lead strategically and actively engage in key client relationships and sales opportunities.  
Strong network and relationships across clients, agencies, and developers.  
Ability to engage and influence stakeholders across all levels from C-suite executives to day-to-day marketing planners.  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to listen actively, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and clearly articulate strategic business visions internally and externally.  
Proven ability to foster collaboration and drive shared success across cross-functional teams.  
Team-first mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment while adapting to new business opportunities.  
Highly professional demeanor with a positive and solutions-oriented attitude.  
Experience in gaming app category preferred.  
Experience managing a sales team preferred  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
Bachelors Degree educated, MBA a plus  
Deep understanding of the mobile app economy and strong passion for the evolving digital marketing landscape.  
Significant experience in online, digital, or performance marketing, ideally within the mobile ecosystem and data-driven marketing environment.  
Solid expertise in performance marketing, including campaign optimization, measurement, and growth strategies.

title: Solar Digital Monitoring & IoT Systems - Roofsol Energy
description:
**Job Description – Solar Digital Monitoring & IoT Systems**

**Company:**
Roofsol Energy Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Department:**
Technology / Digital Solutions

**Experience:**
Approximately 10 years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About Roofsol Energy**

Roofsol Energy Pvt. Ltd. operates in the solar energy sector, developing and managing solar projects across India. The company has invested in multiple solar projects under the OPEX (CAPEX-free / RESCO) business model, where continuous monitoring of generation, plant performance, equipment health, and operational efficiency is essential.

As part of its technology development strategy, Roofsol Energy intends to establish its own end-to-end solar monitoring ecosystem, including proprietary data loggers, IoT-based data acquisition systems, cloud infrastructure, and a centralized solar generation monitoring platform. The objective is to develop and own the underlying technology and Intellectual Property (IP), while ensuring reliable monitoring and management of a large portfolio of distributed solar projects across India.

**Role Overview**

Roofsol Energy is looking for an experienced technology professional to lead the conceptualization, design, development, deployment, and maintenance of an in-house solar data logging and generation monitoring system.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Strategy and Technology Development**

·      Define the technology roadmap for Roofsol Energy’s proprietary solar monitoring and data acquisition ecosystem.

·      Lead the end-to-end development of the monitoring platform, from product architecture and prototype development to commercial deployment.

·      Evaluate appropriate hardware, communication protocols, software frameworks, cloud technologies, and system architectures.

·      Develop solutions suitable for both small rooftop solar installations and large distributed solar portfolios.

**2. Data Logger and IoT Hardware Development**

·      Lead the design, development, prototyping, testing, and deployment of in-house solar data logging equipment.

·      Develop expertise in integrating inverters, energy meters, weather sensors, and other plant equipment using protocols such as Modbus RTU/TCP, RS485, Ethernet, and MQTT, as applicable.

·      Ensure reliable data acquisition, local buffering, time synchronization, remote configuration, and recovery during network or power outages.

·      Establish hardware validation, field testing, quality assurance, and lifecycle management processes.

**3. Cloud Platform and Software Development**

·      Lead the architecture and development of a centralized cloud-based solar monitoring platform.

·      Establish scalable infrastructure for collecting, processing, storing, and analyzing data from hundreds of geographically distributed solar installations.

·      Oversee the development of dashboards, plant-level monitoring screens, portfolio-level reporting, alerts, notifications, and automated performance reports.

·      Ensure integration with existing business systems, maintenance workflows, and third-party equipment where required.

·      Establish high availability, disaster recovery, backup, cybersecurity, and system performance standards.

**4. Solar Generation Monitoring and Analytics**

·      Develop real-time and historical solar generation monitoring capabilities.

·      Establish monitoring of energy generation, plant availability, equipment health, communication failures, and performance deviations.

·      Enable automated alerts for generation losses, inverter faults, abnormal operating conditions, and data gaps.

·      Support performance analysis through relevant metrics such as specific yield, Performance Ratio (PR), plant availability, and actual-versus-expected generation, where applicable.

**5. Intellectual Property and Technology Ownership**

·      Build and maintain Roofsol Energy’s proprietary technology stack, including hardware designs, firmware, software source code, system architecture, technical documentation, and associated IP.

·      Establish appropriate IP ownership, confidentiality, source-code control, licensing, and third-party technology compliance practices.

**6. Team Leadership and Vendor Management**

·      Build and lead a multidisciplinary team covering embedded systems, electronics, firmware, IoT, cloud engineering, software development, and data analytics.

·      Evaluate and manage technology vendors, hardware manufacturers, system integrators, and development partners.

**Candidate Profile**

·      Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics & Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, IoT, or a related technical discipline.

·      Approximately 10 years of relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, industrial data acquisition, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, or related technology domains.

·      Demonstrated experience in developing and deploying connected hardware and software products, preferably from concept through production and field deployment.

·      Experience with cloud infrastructure, databases, APIs, cybersecurity, remote device management, and scalable system architecture.

·      Knowledge of solar PV systems, inverter communications, energy meters, generation monitoring, and renewable energy analytics will be highly advantageous.

**Why Join Roofsol Energy?**

This is an opportunity to establish a proprietary technology platform from the ground up and take ownership of a strategic digital initiative within the renewable energy sector. The selected professional will have the opportunity to shape the company’s technology roadmap, develop in-house IP, and build a scalable monitoring ecosystem supporting a growing portfolio of solar assets across India.

**Interested candidates may share their updated CV highlighting relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, and technology ownership.**

title: Videographer
description:
**Videographer**

**About Houzeo**

Houzeo is a technology-driven real estate platform headquartered in New York, with offices in Charlotte and Mumbai. Houzeo India Brokerage brings that approach to the Indian market: a more transparent, trustworthy way to buy, sell, and list property.

We believe property decisions are among the biggest a family will ever make, and that they

shouldn't come with guesswork or hidden costs. That belief shapes everything we build:

**Verified listings: every property on Houzeo is human-verified, so buyers and sellers can rely on**what they see.

**Trusted brokers: we work with a carefully vetted network of brokers and developers, backed by** Houzeo's technology, CRM, and brand.

**No hidden costs: clear, upfront terms for every customer and partner.**

**A complete ecosystem: beyond listings, we connect customers with trusted services such as** mortgage, legal, inspection, and interiors, so the whole journey is easier.

We are in the early stage of our India launch, so this is a chance to build something from the ground up. You'll work directly with developers and brokers, help shape how Houzeo earns trust in a new market, and grow with the company as it scales across cities.

Think of the scale and ambition of platforms like Square Yards and HomeBazaar: technologyled real estate players that combine listings, brokers, and services under one roof. Houzeo India Brokerage is building in that space, with a sharper focus on trust: verified listings, vetted brokers, and transparent terms

**The Houzeo Universe**

Houzeo’s product universe includes a wide range of products and services, including:

● Houzeo IntelliList Listing: This tool auto-assigns the right paperwork for a seller’s property

based on location. It’s the fastest way to list a home!

● Houzeo Showings: A digital showing scheduling app designed for sellers. Buyers and

agents can directly request showings once a seller verifies them!

● Houzeo Offers: An offer management tool to evaluate, compare and counter offers

received on a property. Sellers can request the highest and best offers within seconds.

● Houzeo DigiTransact: DigiTransact lets sellers maneuver the real estate transaction with

milestones, tasks, notifications and reminders seamlessly. No more friction!

● Houzeo Dream Homes: Aims to help home buyers find their dream homes, make an offer,

or start their mortgage pre-approval journey.

● Houzeo Mobile App: A comprehensive mobile app that lets home sellers and buyers.

● Houzeo Home Worth Calculator: A free home value calculator that helps homeowners

estimate how valuable their property is.

● Houzeo Mortgage Calculator: A mortgage payment estimator that helps potential home

borrowers understand monthly payments and amortization schedules for free.

● Houzeo Closing Costs Calculator: The most advanced closing cost estimator for helping

buyers and sellers understand what they have to pay on closing day.

About the Marketing Team

At the intersection of storytelling and strategy, you’ll find the creative crusaders who don’t just think out of the box; they reimagine it. From organic SEO to PPC magic, our team is obsessed with growth. Armed with innovation and data, we design campaigns that captivate, convert, and crush KPIs.

**About the Role: Are You the One?**

We’re looking for a videographer to shoot and edit high-quality real estate videos, including property walkthroughs, listing tours, neighborhood features, and short-form social content. You’ll own the work from planning and shooting through editing and delivery, helping us tell clear, engaging stories that make properties and home-buying topics stand out.

**Your Mission, Should You Choose to Accept It**

● Plan, shoot, and edit property walkthrough and listing videos that show each home’s

best features

● Capture interior, exterior, and aerial (drone) footage with strong composition, lighting,

and smooth camera movement

● Produce short-form vertical videos for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn

● Edit footage with color correction, sound design, music, titles, and captions

● Create neighborhood and lifestyle videos, agent or broker introductions, and

testimonial or interview-style content

● Coordinate shoot schedules, property access, and logistics with internal teams,

agents, and developers

● Maintain brand consistency across all video output

● Organize, back up, and archive raw footage and final files

● Maintain and care for all video equipment

**What You Bring**

● 2–4 years of professional videography and editing experience, ideally in real estate,

architecture, hospitality, or interiors

● A portfolio of real estate or comparable property video work

● Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro (After Effects is a

plus)

● Strong command of cameras and iPhones, gimbals, and lighting for interiors

● Understanding of exposure, white balance, and color grading in mixed-light spaces

● Ability to work independently, manage multiple shoots, and meet deadlines

● Good communication skills and a professional manner when working on project sites

Nice to Haves

Licensed drone pilot (e.g., DGCA certification in India) with aerial cinematography

experience

Familiarity with motion graphics, subtitles, and social-first video formats

Knowledge of real estate marketing and what makes a listing video effective

Basic skills in photography and voiceover recording

**What We Offer**

Videos delivered on time with minimal revision rounds

Consistently polished, on-brand footage across listings and campaigns

Strong engagement on video content across web and social channels

**Note**: This is a complete **on-site** role

Interested Candidates can share their updated cv at **vidhi.sanura@houzeo.com**

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund

* How many years of experience you hold in Videography?
* What is your current CTC?
* What is your expected CTC?
* What is your Notice Period?
* Are you comfortable working from office - Thane location?

**Company:** Osumare Marketing Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

About Osumare Marketing Solutions

Osumare Marketing Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a full-service branding and digital marketing agency specializing in performance marketing, SEO, social media management, branding, website development, creative strategy, and digital growth solutions.

We manage digital marketing campaigns for clients across multiple industries, helping businesses generate qualified leads, acquire customers, increase sales, and achieve measurable growth through data-driven marketing strategies.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced, analytical, and result-oriented Paid Ads Manager who can independently plan, execute, manage, optimize, and scale paid advertising campaigns across multiple platforms.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete performance marketing lifecycle, from understanding client business objectives and developing media plans to campaign setup, audience targeting, budget allocation, conversion tracking, optimization, reporting, and performance improvement.

The ideal candidate must have hands-on expertise in Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads, along with experience in e-commerce advertising, Google Shopping campaigns, remarketing, lead generation, and conversion-focused campaigns.

The candidate should be capable of managing multiple client accounts, handling advertising budgets responsibly, identifying performance improvement opportunities, and delivering measurable results while maintaining campaign profitability and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities1. Paid Advertising Strategy & Planning

* Develop comprehensive paid advertising strategies aligned with client objectives, target audiences, and business goals.
* Understand client products, services, target markets, sales processes, and customer acquisition requirements.
* Prepare media plans, advertising budgets, channel allocations, campaign structures, and performance forecasts.
* Identify the most suitable advertising platforms based on campaign objectives, audience behaviour, and industry requirements.
* Develop strategies for lead generation, e-commerce sales, website traffic, brand awareness, app promotion, and customer acquisition.
* Establish campaign KPIs such as cost per lead (CPL), cost per acquisition (CPA), return on ad spend (ROAS), conversion rate, and customer acquisition cost (CAC).
* Conduct competitor research, keyword research, audience research, and advertising opportunity analysis.

2. Google Ads Management

* Independently plan, set up, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns.
* Manage Search, Display, Performance Max, Shopping, YouTube, and remarketing campaigns as applicable.
* Conduct keyword research, search intent analysis, negative keyword management, and search term optimization.
* Develop effective campaign structures, ad groups, bidding strategies, and conversion-focused ad copy.
* Optimize Quality Score, click-through rate (CTR), cost per click (CPC), conversion rates, and cost per acquisition.
* Manage Google Merchant Center feeds and product advertising for relevant e-commerce accounts.
* Analyze search terms, impression share, auction insights, and campaign-level performance.
* Identify wasted advertising spend and implement corrective actions to improve efficiency.
* Stay updated on Google Ads features, automation capabilities, policies, and campaign best practices.

3. Meta Ads Management

* Plan, execute, and optimize campaigns across Facebook and Instagram.
* Manage lead generation, website conversion, sales, remarketing, engagement, and awareness campaigns.
* Develop audience strategies using interest targeting, custom audiences, lookalike audiences, and retargeting where appropriate.
* Set up campaign structures, placements, budgets, bidding strategies, and conversion objectives.
* Collaborate with creative teams to develop effective ad concepts, messaging, formats, hooks, and calls to action.
* Monitor campaign fatigue, frequency, CTR, CPM, CPL, CPA, and conversion rates.
* Conduct A/B tests for creatives, audiences, copy, landing pages, and campaign settings.
* Optimize lead quality and conversion performance rather than focusing only on lead volume.
* Identify opportunities to scale winning campaigns while controlling acquisition costs.

4. LinkedIn Ads Management

* Plan and manage LinkedIn advertising campaigns for B2B clients.
* Develop targeting strategies based on industry, company size, job title, seniority, function, and relevant professional audiences.
* Manage Lead Gen Forms, website conversion campaigns, sponsored content, and other suitable campaign formats.

* Monitor lead quality, cost per lead, engagement, and conversion performance.
* Coordinate with client sales teams to understand lead quality and improve campaign targeting.
* Optimize campaigns based on business outcomes and the quality of leads generated.

5. E-commerce & Shopping Ads

* Plan and manage paid campaigns focused on online sales and revenue growth.
* Manage Google Shopping and Performance Max campaigns for eligible e-commerce businesses.
* Coordinate product feed optimization, Merchant Center diagnostics, product categorization, and product-level performance analysis.
* Develop product segmentation and budget allocation strategies based on margins, demand, inventory, and sales performance.
* Monitor ROAS, CPA, average order value, conversion rate, and revenue contribution.
* Identify high-performing products and campaigns for scaling.
* Coordinate with website and e-commerce teams to improve landing pages, checkout experiences, and conversion rates.

6. Conversion Tracking & Analytics

* Set up and validate conversion tracking using Google Ads, Meta Pixel, Google Analytics 4, and Google Tag Manager.
* Work with developers to implement tracking for forms, purchases, calls, WhatsApp enquiries, and other relevant conversion actions.
* Understand and troubleshoot tracking discrepancies, attribution issues, and conversion measurement errors.
* Monitor campaign performance using GA4, advertising platform dashboards, and reporting tools.
* Use available CRM and sales data to evaluate lead quality, qualified leads, sales conversion, and revenue attribution.
* Ensure that campaign decisions are based on reliable data and properly configured conversion events.
* Understand attribution models, conversion windows, consent requirements, and privacy-conscious measurement practices.

7. Campaign Optimization & Scaling

* Monitor campaign performance regularly and implement data-driven optimization strategies.
* Identify underperforming keywords, audiences, ad sets, placements, creatives, and landing pages.
* Conduct structured experiments to improve campaign efficiency and conversion performance.
* Optimize budgets, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and creative combinations.
* Scale successful campaigns while maintaining target CPL, CPA, ROAS, or other agreed KPIs.
* Diagnose performance fluctuations and recommend corrective measures.
* Identify opportunities to reduce wasted spend and improve advertising account efficiency.
* Maintain a systematic testing and optimization process across client accounts.

8. Landing Page & Conversion Rate Optimization

* Evaluate landing pages for relevance, user experience, messaging consistency, and conversion potential.
* Collaborate with design, content, and web development teams to improve landing page performance.
* Recommend improvements to headlines, forms, calls to action, page structure, loading speed, and mobile experience.
* Analyze conversion funnels and identify drop-off points.
* Support landing page A/B testing and conversion rate optimization initiatives.
* Ensure consistency between advertisements, landing pages, and the client's actual offerings.

9. Budget Management & Financial Accountability

* Manage advertising budgets responsibly across multiple platforms and client accounts.
* Allocate budgets according to campaign performance, business priorities, and growth opportunities.
* Monitor daily and monthly spending to avoid overspending and budget wastage.
* Maintain accurate campaign budget forecasts and expenditure reports.
* Communicate budget requirements, scaling opportunities, and performance risks proactively.
* Ensure campaign spending aligns with client approvals and agreed commercial objectives.

10. Reporting & Client Communication

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly campaign performance reports.
* Present key metrics, performance trends, campaign insights, and optimization recommendations.
* Explain campaign performance, challenges, and corrective actions clearly to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Track campaign KPIs against agreed targets and identify gaps.
* Coordinate with account managers and client servicing teams for updates and approvals.
* Maintain documentation of campaign structures, budgets, experiments, and optimization activities.
* Provide actionable recommendations rather than merely reporting numerical results.

* Coordinate with graphic designers, copywriters, video editors, SEO specialists, social media managers, and web developers.
* Provide clear creative briefs based on audience insights, campaign objectives, and performance data.
* Ensure advertising creatives and landing pages are aligned with campaign requirements.
* Manage multiple client accounts and campaigns simultaneously.
* Take complete ownership of assigned accounts, from strategy and setup to optimization and reporting.
* Ensure timely completion of assigned tasks and maintain high standards of execution.

* Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in paid advertising or performance marketing preferred.
* Strong practical expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads.
* Working experience in LinkedIn Ads and B2B lead generation.
* Knowledge of Google Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube Ads, and e-commerce advertising.
* Experience managing multiple campaigns, advertising accounts, and budgets.
* Strong understanding of keyword research, audience targeting, bidding strategies, remarketing, and campaign optimization.
* Practical knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads conversion tracking, and Meta Pixel.
* Ability to analyze advertising data and make performance-driven decisions.
* Understanding of CPL, CPA, CTR, CPC, CPM, ROAS, CAC, and conversion rate.

Preferred Skills

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on relevant client objectives and agreed targets, including:

* Quality and business relevance of leads generated.
* Campaign efficiency and responsible budget utilization.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a professional who:

How to Apply

Candidates with relevant case studies demonstrating improvements in CPL, ROAS, conversion rates, lead quality, or customer acquisition performance will be preferred.

title: Head of Injection Moulding (Mobile Industry)
description:
HEAD OF INJECTION MOULDING

**Faridabad, Delhi NCR | On-site | 12–18 years | Reports to the founders**
**Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma — Plastics, Polymer, Mechanical or Production Engineering**
**Mobile handset industry moulding experience is mandatory — please read below before applying**

Moulding is where our product starts, and where our cost is set. A part moulded badly becomes a part printed badly, assembled badly and rejected at pack — by which point we've paid for all of it.

You'd own moulding as a function: the floor, the process, the people, the capacity and the capital. That includes
**overmoulding**
— rigid shell with soft-touch elastomer — which is a meaningful part of what we produce and a materially harder process than single-shot.

**We are only considering candidates from the mobile handset industry**

We want to be direct about this so nobody wastes their time.

We make small, cosmetically critical parts — sub-millimetre wall sections, visible surfaces with no tolerance for sink or flow marks, tight fit against a device, and cosmetic standards closer to consumer electronics than to general plastics. A part that would pass in most moulding shops gets rejected here.

The discipline that produces that output is learned in the handset supply chain, and it doesn't transfer quickly from elsewhere. Excellent moulding experience in automotive, appliance, packaging, housewares or general engineering plastics is genuinely excellent experience — it just isn't what this role needs, and we'd be setting you up to struggle.

**So:**
you should have spent meaningful time moulding handset housings, covers or cosmetic enclosures — at
**Oppo, Vivo, Xiaomi, Realme, Transsion, Foxconn, Dixon, Lava**
or in their tier-one supplier base. Adjacent consumer electronics enclosure work at the same cosmetic standard will also be considered.

**The thing that actually limits this floor**

We're high-mix. Many moulds, frequent changes, moderate volume per run. In that environment the constraint usually isn't cycle time — it's
**changeover and the scrap that follows it.**
Every tool change costs setup hours, then costs more shots before the process stabilises. Across a week of changes that's a serious share of capacity spent producing nothing.

Most moulding operations measure cycle time obsessively and changeover barely at all. We'd like someone who goes after it.

**What you'd build**

* **Changeover discipline**
  — SMED method, prepared tooling, parallel setup, and a measured changeover time that comes down
* Validated parameter sets per mould, so a setter isn't rediscovering the process each time, and a first-off routine that reaches stable quickly and records what stable looked like
* **Material handling discipline**
  — polymer dried to spec before it goes near a machine. Wet resin causes splay and cosmetic defects that get blamed on printing two stations later
* A skill matrix for setters and operators, with certification before anyone runs unsupervised, and cross-training so capacity doesn't depend on one person's attendance
* Real downtime and scrap data coded by cause, so improvement has something to aim at
* Capacity planning and the case for new machines as we grow

**You'd own**

* Moulding production across shifts, against the plan
* **Scrap and first-pass yield at the machine.**
  Your primary number
* Process capability, parameter control and changeover performance
* Machine utilisation, uptime and maintenance coordination
* **Tool condition in production**
  — shot counts, preventive maintenance schedules, spare inserts and components, and escalation to the tool room before a tool fails rather than after
* Tool repair and refurbishment decisions, with the cost case
* Moulding capacity decisions and capital proposals
* The moulding team — setters, operators, helpers, supervisors — including hiring and training
* Safety, 5S and housekeeping

**You need**

* 12+ years in
  **injection moulding**
  , with function or plant-level ownership rather than shift supervision alone
* **Mobile handset moulding experience — mandatory.**
  Housings, covers or cosmetic enclosures, at a handset OEM or in their tier-one supplier base. See the note above
* **Hands-on process capability.**
  You can set a machine, read a short shot, and tell a setter what to change and why
* Defect diagnosis: short shot, flash, sink, weld lines, warpage, splay, burn marks — cause, not just name
* **Material knowledge**
  — PC, ABS, PC/ABS, TPU, PP and filled grades; drying requirements, moisture sensitivity, masterbatch and regrind
  **Overmoulding.**
  A real part of our production and not a side skill:
* **Two-shot and insert moulding**
  — rotary platen, index and core-back methods, or mould-and-transfer. The machine and tool requirements of each, and when one suits better than the other
* **Material pairing and bond**
  — which combinations bond chemically, which need mechanical interlock, and how melt temperature, shore hardness and surface condition affect adhesion. TPU and TPE over PC and PC/ABS specifically
* **Bond strength as an invisible defect.**
  An overmoulded part can look perfect and delaminate weeks later in a customer's hand. It has to be designed and processed right, because inspection won't catch it. Peel and bond testing is part of the job, not an afterthought
* **Differential shrinkage and warpage**
  between the two materials, and first-shot dimensional stability before the second shot
* **Cycle balancing**
  — the slower shot sets the cycle, which makes process optimisation here a different problem from single-shot
* Interface flash, colour bleed and the cosmetic defects specific to two-material parts

**Tooling, in detail.**
This is not a nice-to-have for us:

* **Tool construction**
  — mould base and insert construction, steel grades and hardness, cold and hot runner systems, gate types and vestige, cooling layout and what it does to cycle and warpage, venting, ejection, slides and lifters, shut-off surfaces, surface finish and texture
* **Two-shot tool construction**
  — rotation and indexing, sealing at the material interface, second-shot shut-offs, and why these tools fail differently from single-shot ones
* **Tool condition on the floor**
  — reading flash as parting line wear, galling on slides, blocked vents causing burns, scaled water lines quietly adding seconds to cycle, ejector wear, hot runner tip and heater faults. Catching these before they become a stoppage or a scrap run
* **Trials and correction**
  — T0/T1/T2, reading trial results, steel-safe versus steel-removal corrections, shrinkage adjustment, and knowing when a correction is worth doing
* **Repair, refurbish or replace**
  , with the judgement and the cost case behind each
* **The arbitration.**
  The most valuable thing you'll do is decide whether a defect is a tool problem or a process problem. Process people blame the tool, tool rooms blame the process, and the part keeps failing while they argue. We want someone who settles it with evidence
* **Demonstrated changeover or scrap reduction with numbers.**
  We'll ask for before and after
* Team building across shifts, including developing setters
* Fluent Hindi; working English

**Good to have:**
tool room or tool design background earlier in your career, scientific moulding or DOE training, multi-cavity and high-cavitation tooling, IMD/IML, take-out robots and automation, SMED implementation, CIPET background, OEE systems.

**Where this sits alongside our Tooling Engineer:**
they own mould design review and new tool development; you own tools in production — condition, maintenance, correction and when to retire them. You'll disagree occasionally, and that's healthy.

**Tell us:**
which handset programmes or customers you moulded for, your overmoulding experience and the material pairs you've run, your average changeover time and what you did to it, your scrap rate and how it was measured,
**one defect where you proved it was the tool and not the process (or the reverse) and how you proved it**
, and the cosmetic standard you worked to.

title: Member of Technical Staff
description:
**About the Company**

Grey Machines is a decision intelligence platform: it lets you simulate a strategic decision before you make it. You ask a "what if" question in plain language, and the system builds a working model of that world from scratch, with its actors, feedback loops and delays, grounded in real data and cited evidence. It then plays out thousands of possible futures and shows the range of outcomes, what drives them, and a brief in which every number traces back to its source, in hours rather than the weeks a strategy team would take. It is built for strategy teams, investors and policy makers.

**The Problem**

Take a question like "What happens to nickel markets if Indonesia bans ore exports?" or "What does a US-Iran escalation do to oil and LNG?" Answering it well usually takes weeks: a strategy team, a financial model, expert calls and a deck.

Grey Machines answers it in hours. From one plain-language question, the system builds a model of that world from scratch: the actors, the stocks and flows, the feedback loops and the delays. It grounds the starting values in real data and cited evidence, then runs thousands of Monte Carlo futures, with convergence checks deciding when to stop. What comes back is an interactive causal loop diagram, the range of outcomes, and a written brief in which every number traces back to where it came from.

It works end to end and is in private beta. Now it has to be correct, fast and reliable at scale. That is the job.

**What You Will Build**

You will be the first engineer and the most senior technical person in the room, so the scope is all of engineering. You will make the architecture calls every later engineer builds on, and own the consequences.

- The simulation core: the ODE solver, the Monte Carlo engine, sensitivity analysis, and the convergence and health checks that decide when a result can be trusted

- The model-building pipeline: frontier LLMs build the model in stages, and deterministic validators and repair loops check every step. The real work is deciding what the LLM can be trusted with, what code has to verify, and how to fail safely.

- The data and evidence layer: values from sources such as FRED, the academic literature, the web and the documents users bring, with units, ranges and provenance that survive end to end

- The execution layer: long Monte Carlo jobs are checkpointed and resume after a restart, today on one machine. Next they need to be scheduled and run in parallel across many.

- Production: AWS, deploys, monitoring, tracing and incident response

- The frontend when it needs you: a React 19 app with Canvas 2D and D3 visualisations that make dense quantitative output readable for a strategist, not just a quant

- The engineering bar: testing, review and release discipline, and hiring the team that comes after you

**Who You Are**

- You have built systems from zero, not just shipped features into existing ones, and lived with your own architecture decisions, including the wrong ones.

- You are fluent in Bayesian probability and statistics, stochastic processes and numerical methods: ODEs, Monte Carlo and convergence diagnostics. A PhD is not required. Being able to reason about what the numbers mean is.

- You write production code fast, debug carefully and care when it is wrong. Production experience with Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL and React is required: the codebase is built on them.

- You have run LLMs in production: structured output, prompt caching, multi-stage pipelines and the failure modes that only show up there.

- You write clearly. We work remotely and asynchronously, so your design docs and code reviews are how you work.

**Strong Signals**

None of these is required. They are backgrounds that tend to fit.

- A year or two at a quantitative trading firm (Jane Street, Hudson River Trading, Tower Research, Graviton or similar)

- Your own startup, including one that did not work out. We care about what you learned.

- A maths, CS, physics or statistics degree from a school these firms hire from

- Multi-tenant SaaS or high-throughput compute pipelines

- CTO, Staff or Principal Engineer experience at an early-stage company

**What It Is Honestly Like**

We are an early-stage startup, and we would rather say so up front.

- Priorities move. Something you build this month may be thrown away next month because we learned something.

- There is no team behind you yet. You will check your own blind spots and make calls with incomplete information.

- Some weeks will feel like a drawdown. We want someone who stays steady through the good weeks and the bad ones, and treats uncertainty as part of the job.

In return you get real ownership, founder-level say in the product and the company, and a genuinely hard applied-maths problem. Fully remote, flexible hours.

**About Crafter**

Crafter is a comprehensive low-code / no-code Enterprise & SaaS platform that helps organizations build custom applications, automate workflows, and streamline core business processes without extensive technical expertise.

Designed for startups, SMEs, and large enterprises seeking agility and efficiency, Crafter’s visual drag-and-drop builder and modular solutions enable businesses to rapidly create applications, manage resources, and enhance customer engagement with minimal coding.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Staff Engineer with 6 to 9 years of hands-on experience in Java and Spring Boot to provide technical leadership across one or more products within the ETPL AI portfolio. This role sits within ETPL's engineering capability and carries responsibility for backend architecture, system design, engineering quality, and the technical development of delivery teams.

The Staff Engineer will be the senior technical authority within their product engineering context - owning architectural decisions, driving best practices, and ensuring that the systems they are responsible for are scalable, maintainable, and built to support enterprise-grade deployments. The role combines deep hands-on engineering with the influence and communication skills to lead other engineers and engage meaningfully with product and business stakeholders.

This is a role for an engineer who has moved beyond individual contribution and is ready to shape how systems are designed, how teams deliver, and how technical quality is defined and maintained across a product.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide technical leadership in the design, development, and evolution of backend systems and services built on Java and Spring Boot across assigned ETPL AI products
* Own system architecture decisions for assigned product areas - ensuring scalability, modularity, security, and performance across multi-tenant enterprise deployments
* Lead and mentor a team of engineers, conducting code reviews, architectural walkthroughs, and technical discussions that raise the capability and quality of the broader team
* Translate product requirements and business logic into well-structured, maintainable technical designs - collaborating closely with product managers and senior stakeholders to ensure alignment between technical decisions and product outcomes
* Define and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and engineering governance frameworks across the product codebase
* Conduct architectural reviews and deep code audits to identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and structural risks - and lead the resolution of findings in a structured manner
* Design and optimize data models, database schemas, and query performance across relational databases, particularly MySQL and PostgreSQL, to support high-volume, data-intensive operations
* Drive the adoption of RESTful API design standards, microservices principles, and service integration patterns appropriate to ETPL's platform architecture
* Own the technical quality of the software delivery lifecycle within the product team - including requirements validation, design reviews, testing governance, deployment oversight, and post-release monitoring
* Identify, evaluate, and integrate appropriate libraries, frameworks, and tools to improve engineering efficiency, system reliability, and long-term maintainability
* Act as the escalation point for critical technical issues and production incidents within the product, leading structured root cause analysis and resolution
* Champion a culture of engineering excellence, documentation discipline, and continuous improvement within the product engineering team

**Experience And Profile**

* 6 to 9 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with strong and sustained depth in Java and Spring Boot
* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering scalable, high-performance backend systems for enterprise or SaaS products
* Experience leading or mentoring other engineers within a structured delivery team
* Proven ability to make and communicate sound architectural decisions across backend systems, APIs, and data layers
* Experience with microservices architecture, RESTful API design, and distributed systems is expected
* Prior exposure to multi-tenant platform design or enterprise product engineering is an advantage

**Skills And Attributes**

* Deep mastery of Java and Spring Boot, with strong expertise in building modular, production-grade enterprise backend systems
* Solid understanding of Spring ecosystem components - Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud - and their appropriate application in enterprise contexts
* Strong database engineering skills across relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) including schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and performance tuning at scale
* Proficiency in RESTful API design and development, with a clear understanding of API contracts, versioning, and integration standards
* Experience with microservices architecture, service decomposition, and inter-service communication patterns including REST and message queuing (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes, and with CI/CD pipeline tooling for structured, automated delivery
* Proficiency with Git and structured branching strategies for collaborative development within multi-team engineering environments
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms - AWS / Azure - and the deployment and infrastructure considerations relevant to enterprise SaaS products
* Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and test-driven development practices, with a commitment to maintaining high automated test coverage
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with structured root cause analysis — particularly under production pressure
* Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical decisions and trade-offs to both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders
* A collaborative and mentoring disposition - genuinely invested in the growth of the engineers around them, not just personal technical output

**Recruitment Process**

ETPL follows a structured, assessment-led recruitment process focused on long-term fit and capability development. Shortlisted candidates will go through:

* ETPL Aptitude Test (EAT) - to assess analytical ability, reasoning, and problem-solving
* ETPL Psychometric Test (EPT) - to understand work style, behavioral tendencies, and role alignment
* Interview Rounds - including functional and culture-fit discussions

This process ensures fairness, transparency, and clarity for both the candidate and the organization.

**What do we offer**

* Exposure to senior educators, institutional leaders, and industry practitioners
* Opportunities to learn from internal capability-building initiatives and leadership programs
* A growing organization that is investing in better systems, clearer roles, and stronger people practices
* A work environment that values learning, ownership, and long-term career growth

As a scaling company, ETPL is evolving its processes, teams, and structures. This role suits individuals who are comfortable growing alongside the organization, contributing to improvement, and building strong foundations rather than expecting everything to be fully polished from day one.

To apply you can send your resume to prashant.musale@erelego.com or DM me on (LinkedIn or +91-9167464004).

title: Staff Engineer- Applied AI
description:
**About The Role**
AI is not a feature in Foundry - it is the operating model. AI-assisted coding and product management is baked into how the team works, and AI-assisted solutioning is baked into what we ship: LLM-based data ingestion that auto-fills the Sizer from unstructured customer files, a constraint-solver recommendation engine that suggests robot configurations, semantic search over historical sizing sheets, and a Copilot that guides users through the solutioning journey. As the Staff Engineer, Applied AI you own all of this. You run the Applied AI capability as a chapter across all Foundry squads- setting the patterns, evaluation frameworks and API contracts that each squad implements rather than centralising all AI work in one team. You are expected to be the most technically credible AI engineer in the organisation, influencing architecture decisions across squads and setting the standard for how AI features are built, measured and shipped.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build and own the recommendation engine - Design and implement the ML pipeline that recommends solution type (technology, layout, configuration) from customer inputs; own the feature store, training pipeline, model registry and serving layer.
* Build the constraint-solver intelligence - Implement the AI layer on top of the constraint solver: learned priors for solver warm-starts, anomaly detection for unusual input combinations, and automated sensitivity analysis.
* Build LLM-based data ingestion- Design the production pipeline that takes unstructured customer documents (PDFs, spreadsheets, emails) and extracts structured Sizer inputs using LLMs; handle uncertainty, partial extractions and human-in-the-loop review.
* Build the formulator engine and vector DB- Implement semantic search over historical sizing solutions and L1 data sheets; design the embedding pipeline, vector database and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) layer.
* Define AI chapter patterns- Set the shared patterns that all squads adopt: LLM API integration (streaming, function calling, structured output), prompt engineering standards, evaluation harnesses and A/B experiment frameworks for AI features.
* Build the AI evaluation framework- Implement offline and online evaluation for every AI feature: golden-set benchmarks, production-shadow evaluation, A/B experiment readout tooling and regression detection.
* Own the AI API contracts- Design the internal API contracts between the AI squad and consuming squads (Sizer, Layout, GCM); version them, document them and enforce them via contract tests.
* Mentor and grow AI capability- Pair with and review engineers across squads who are implementing AI features; run the Applied AI chapter meetings; grow the team's collective AI engineering capability.

**Minimum (required) Qualifications**

* 10–15 years professional engineering; at least 4 years in applied ML / LLM productionisation.
* Deep experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source): function calling, structured output, streaming, embeddings.
* Production RAG system experience: chunking strategies, embedding models, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector), retrieval evaluation.
* Experience building and deploying recommendation systems or ranking models.
* Strong software engineering foundations: API design, observability, testing, CI/CD.
* Track record of cross-team technical influence: setting patterns others adopt.
* Experience with ML experiment tracking and model-lifecycle management.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with optimisation / operations-research methods used in conjunction with ML (hybrid AI + OR solvers).
* Experience with agentic AI systems: tool-use, ReAct, AutoGen, LangGraph or similar.
* Domain experience in warehousing, logistics or industrial automation.
* Experience with online A/B experimentation for AI features (including metric design).
* Familiarity with structured-extraction frameworks (Instructor, Outlines, Marvin).
* Experience with feature stores (Feast, Tecton) and ML platforms (MLflow, Vertex AI).
* Prior Staff-level or principal-equivalent scope at a technology company.

**Technical Qualifications**
*We expect you to be proficient in or quickly learn the following. Senior roles (Band E+) are expected to be experts; Band C/D roles are expected to have working knowledge.*

* LLM stack: OpenAI / Anthropic API; LangChain / LlamaIndex / LangGraph for orchestration; structured output parsing (Instructor / Pydantic).
* RAG: chunking and indexing pipelines; embedding models (text-embedding-3, Cohere, BGE); vector stores (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone); hybrid search (dense + BM25).
* ML: scikit-learn, XGBoost for classical recommendation; PyTorch / HuggingFace for fine-tuning and inference; MLflow or Vertex AI for experiment tracking.
* Evaluation: RAGAS, TruLens, or custom harnesses; LLM-as-judge pipelines; A/B frameworks integrated with analytics (e.g. Mixpanel).
* Languages: Python (primary); Java or Go for production service wrappers.
* APIs: REST (FastAPI or Flask); gRPC for high-throughput internal calls; SSE / WebSocket for streamed LLM responses.
* Infrastructure: GCP (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, GCS, Pub/Sub); Docker, Kubernetes; Terraform.
* Observability: LLM call logging (token counts, latency, cost); Prometheus metrics; Grafana dashboards; structured logging with trace IDs.
* Testing: unit tests for extraction logic; golden-set regression tests; integration tests with mocked LLM responses.
* Tooling: GitHub monorepo, GitHub Actions CI, Backstage.

**How We Work**
You are the single senior AI voice across Foundry. You lead the Applied AI chapter- short, weekly craft syncs with engineers across squads who are implementing AI features and you own the AI API contracts that every squad consumes. You report directly to the Senior Director and participate in the weekly squad-of-squads sync. You are expected to influence decisions at the architecture level, not just the implementation level.

What You Bring:

title: Senior Enterprise Architect
description:
Bangalore or Hyderabad, India
  
  
Artificial intelligence is reshaping the re/insurance industry — and at Swiss Re, we're not just watching it happen. We're architecting it. If you're a seasoned Enterprise Architect with a passion for AI and a talent for turning complex strategy into scalable, production-ready reality, this is your opportunity to leave a lasting mark on one of the world's most innovative financial institutions.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior Enterprise Architect within Swiss Re's Group Enterprise Architecture function, you will be at the heart of the company's AI transformation. This is a high-impact individual contributor role with broad enterprise exposure — working at the intersection of business ambition and technology delivery. Depending on your experience and business priorities, you may focus on
**Architecture Delivery**
(shaping and driving strategic AI initiatives end-to-end) or
**Enablement & Governance**
(building the enterprise capabilities, standards, and guardrails that allow AI to scale safely and consistently) — or contribute across both. Either way, you'll be a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders and a key voice in shaping Swiss Re's AI architecture landscape globally.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Strategy, Use Cases & Target Architecture**

* Lead engagement with business areas and Domains on AI initiatives, shaping use cases, transformation roadmaps, target architectures, blueprints, and transition plans
* Contribute to Swiss Re's AI Strategy, ensuring architecture supports and accelerates the company's broader ambitions
* Design end-to-end AI solution architectures spanning business, application, data, model, integration, security, evaluation, observability, and production deployment dimensions
* Translate business strategy into coherent AI architectures, ensuring alignment between capabilities, application landscapes, data models, technology platforms, and operating models
* Drive standardization, simplification, and reuse, including rigorous assessment of build-versus-buy, model, and platform options across value, risk, scalability, performance, resilience, and total cost of ownership

**Enterprise Architecture Delivery & Production Readiness**

* Act as lead Enterprise Architect on selected large, complex programs (including AI) and take full architecture accountability for outcomes
* Provide architecture guidance from strategy and concept through implementation, production readiness, stabilization, and operational ownership
* Ensure solution designs align with approved target architectures, AI standards, principles, reference architectures, and enterprise guardrails
* Challenge design decisions to protect architectural integrity, measurable business value, and sustainable delivery
* Support program and project leadership in managing architecture risks, dependencies, trade-offs, integration, resilience, monitoring, and lifecycle management
* Maintain accurate enterprise inventories and governance records by contributing and validating information on delivered AI solutions

**Architecture Enablement, Standards & Reference Architectures**

* Provide leadership for enterprise AI architecture enablement, delivering intelligence and guidance to delivery teams, Domains, and architecture stakeholders
* Identify and act on enterprise patterns, gaps, risks, and opportunities across use cases and delivered solutions
* Define, own, and evolve AI standards, principles, reusable patterns, reference architectures, methods, and pragmatic guardrails
* Set direction for clear, actionable guidance that enables teams to make consistent, safe, and scalable architecture decisions
* Identify and promote reuse opportunities across Domains, leveraging AI inventory, GEAR, and enterprise intelligence

**Enterprise Architecture Governance, Inventory & Portfolio Insight**

* Lead and shape AI architecture governance and Design Authority, including review criteria, review gates, quality assurance, and compliance mechanisms
* Ensure AI solutions address Responsible AI, privacy, security, model risk, human oversight, auditability, regulatory, and enterprise risk considerations
* Promote consistent AI evaluation approaches covering quality, grounding, hallucination risk, robustness, latency, security, and cost
* Govern and evolve the AI inventory, using it to generate architecture insights, identify patterns and gaps, and support transparent decisions
* Provide portfolio-level insight and recommendations on deployed AI assets, reuse opportunities, architecture risks, standards adoption, and enterprise-wide implications

**Cross-Domain Collaboration & Influence**

* Collaborate closely with Domain Architects, business stakeholders, technology teams, risk and control partners, and other architecture disciplines to achieve enterprise alignment
* Resolve cross-domain dependencies and conflicts, balancing enterprise consistency with pragmatic Domain needs
* Champion a one-architecture mindset and contribute to the architecture community through knowledge sharing, mentoring, and coaching
* Build trusted relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders and act as a strategic advisor on investment decisions and transformation roadmaps
* Deliver executive-ready, fact-based insights and recommendations that drive informed decisions

**About The Team**
The Group Enterprise Architecture team at Swiss Re is a globally connected community of architects operating at the forefront of the company's most strategic and complex transformation initiatives. The team plays a pivotal role in shaping how Swiss Re harnesses technology — including AI — to create sustainable business value, drive innovation, and manage enterprise risk responsibly.
  
  
Organized across two complementary functions —
**Delivery**
and
**Enablement & Governance**
— the team works in close partnership with business Domains, technology functions, and senior leadership to define target architectures, set enterprise standards, and ensure that solutions are scalable, resilient, and aligned with Swiss Re's long-term direction. Together, the team fosters a culture of architectural excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement, with a strong commitment to responsible and inclusive innovation at enterprise scale.
  
  
**About You**
You are a strategic thinker and a pragmatic doer — someone who can hold the long view on enterprise architecture while rolling up your sleeves to guide complex delivery. You bring intellectual curiosity, strong systems thinking, and the ability to navigate ambiguity with confidence. You communicate with clarity and conviction, whether you're advising a C-suite stakeholder or mentoring a fellow architect. You thrive in collaborative, matrixed environments and take genuine pride in raising the quality of architecture across the teams you work with.
  
  
**We Are Looking For Candidates Who Meet These Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, technology architecture, or transformation roles within complex, matrixed, or global organizations, with a proven track record of leading cross-domain initiatives
* Hands-on experience designing and implementing production-grade AI solutions beyond prompt-only agents, including practical knowledge of AI/GenAI architecture patterns such as LLMs, RAG, embeddings/vector search, agents and tool use, model selection, prompt and model lifecycle management, and AI evaluation
* Deep expertise in enterprise architecture frameworks, governance models, and design authority processes, including standards, principles, reference architectures, and operating models, with demonstrated experience influencing enterprise-level decisions at senior stakeholder level
* Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, AI security and privacy patterns, observability, model monitoring, and Responsible AI controls, with the ability to evaluate AI technology choices across quality, risk, scalability, latency, resilience, reuse, and cost
* Proven ability to use architecture inventories, repositories, and portfolio information to identify patterns, gaps, reuse opportunities, and governance insights, and to translate these into clear, actionable recommendations

**These Are Additional Nice To Haves**

* Experience in re/insurance or financial services environments
* TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification
* Relevant AI, cloud, data, security, or architecture certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, CISSP, CDMP)
* Experience working in globally distributed, multicultural teams across multiple time zones
* Familiarity with regulatory and compliance frameworks relevant to AI in financial services
* Demonstrated experience mentoring architects and building architecture capability within a community of practice
* Strong facilitation skills, with experience leading design authority forums, architecture reviews, and governance boards

**Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.**
**About Swiss Re**
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
  
  
Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.
  
  
If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
  
  
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

title: System on a Chip Architect
description:
**Wireless Communications Chip Architct and System Architect**

**About The Company**

**www.omnidesigntech.com**

**Omni Design is a leading provider of high-performance, ultra-low power IP solutions across advanced CMOS nodes, enabling differentiated SoC architectures for 5G, optical networks, LiDAR, radar, automotive networking, AI acceleration, imaging, and related high-growth markets. We partner with market leaders globally and are scaling rapidly. We are seeking senior technical leadership talent to define and guide the next generation of adaptive, multi-antenna wireless platforms.**

**Job Description**

**We are seeking a Principal / Lead Wireless Communications System Architect to own the definition and architectural direction of complex wireless and multi-antenna system platforms. This individual will serve as the primary technical interface with customer system teams, lead system modeling and performance analysis, drive architectural decisions across mixed-signal and digital subsystems, and define system-level specifications that translate into silicon implementations.**

**This is a senior leadership role with substantial influence across product definition, roadmap direction, and customer engagement. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of communications theory, system decomposition across analog/digital boundaries, quantization/error propagation, MIMO signal processing architectures, and end-to-end error budgeting strategies in SDR-based environments.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Leadership and Direction: Define system architecture for next-generation multi-antenna and SDR-based communication platforms, influencing product strategy and long-term roadmap planning.**

**Customer Technical Ownership: Lead technical engagement with strategic customers, representing system trade-offs, negotiating performance specifications, and aligning joint integration plans.**

**End-to-End System Modeling: Architect and maintain MATLAB and analytical models capturing the full signal chain, including channel modeling, quantization noise allocation, SNR budgeting, interplay of RF non-linearities, and DSP algorithm design constraints.**

**Block-Level Specification Ownership: Generate precise block-level specifications for digital baseband, calibration engines, channel processing, mixed-signal converters, and RF interfacing elements; ensure internal teams understand the architectural rationale behind these specifications.**

**Cross-Domain Integration: Drive alignment between digital architecture, signal processing algorithms, mixed-signal circuit selections, ADC/DAC dynamic range decisions, LO/subsystem noise considerations, and thermal/power constraints.**

**System Verification Alignment: Collaborate with validation and silicon bring-up teams to ensure post-silicon results trace back to modeled assumptions; define measurement-level KPIs and debug methodologies when deviations arise.**

**Mentorship & Team Development: Provide architectural guidance to system engineers, signal processing developers, and hardware design teams; develop reusable models, internal best practices, and system-level methodologies.**

**Thought Leadership: Participate in internal architecture reviews, contribute to core IP innovation strategy, and represent the company in technical engagements, standards-relevant discussions, and key customer milestones.**

**Qualifications**

**Graduate degree in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, or related field; PhD strongly preferred.**

**15+years of experience in wireless communications system architecture for advanced SDR systems.**

**Demonstrated ownership of end-to-end communication signal chains, including cascaded error budgeting, quantization trade-offs, and performance modeling across RF, ADC/DAC, and DSP blocks.**

**Deep Expertise In**

**MIMO and multi-user spatial processing architectures,**

**Channel estimation,**

**SNR/phase-noise budgets and their mapping into mixed-signal design requirements**

**System-level modeling using MATLAB or Python,**

**Ability to articulate complex system decisions to both internal engineering teams and senior-level customers.**

**Proven leadership in defining specifications consumed by RTL design, mixed-signal design, verification, and system validation teams.**

**Strong customer communication skills and comfort presenting architectural trade-offs to VP- and CTO-level stakeholders.**

description:

**Location:**

**Insight at a Glance**

* 14,000+ engaged teammates globally with operations in 25 countries across the globe.
