description:
**Job Purpose**
The purpose of this role includes ensuring accurate and timely submission of periodic and ad-hoc reports related to Claims to the Regulatory Authority, handling Audits (IRDA, internal audits and other audits), preparing the claims register, bring in process improvements, automation, publishing analytical reports / Claims MIS and daily dashboard.
  
  
The purpose involves Data Support and inter-department coordination with all stakeholders including sales, finance, internal claims and actuary teams.
  
  
**Job Context & Major Challenges**
**About The Health Insurance Industry –**
While the current market sees more than 15 non-life players in the private space and 5 exclusive private players in the health insurance space trying to capture a sizable market share, the nationalized service provider (6) remains a strong competitor. In addition to this the business dynamics are such that the overall market on an annual basis which is to the tune of roughly 10,000 Crs sees close to 85 % of the business renewing with the existing service provider itself. This narrows down the opportunity of the fresh business actually being seriously fought in the market to approximately 1500 odd Crs. With the SME and the start-ups being the driving force of Indian economy, the opportunity to cater to these segments is immense and is increasing manifold year on year. The challenge here therefore remains as to how we capture a larger share of the opportunity by developing specific solutions to cater each segment of the business. Also by creating an inexpensive and standardized solution to increase the reach into the pockets of channel partners across the country to harness on their captive business and explore new opportunities with them.
  
  
Market Opportunities – With the advent of medical advancements, lifestyle changes, change in Indian socio-economic scenario and Indian healthcare space, and the insurers are facing challenges to cater to the needs of this diverse clientele. Increasingly Indian customers have started considering health insurance partners as extensions of health advisers. In this scenario it becomes extremely important to understand their psyche and then provide tailored solutions with wellness benefits which would help them meet their end objectives and bring in profitable revenue source for the company.
  
  
**About The Aditya Birla Health Insurance –**
Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited (ABHICL) was incorporated in 2015 as a 51:49 joint venture between Aditya Birla Capital Limited (ABCL) and MMI Strategic Investments (Pty) Ltd. ABHICL commenced its operations in October 2016.
  
  
ABHICL has entered the competitive health insurance market with an aim to expand the category to wider customer segments, beyond the ones that health insurance companies traditionally have marketed to. As the 6th entrant in a category with well-established players, ABHICL is creating differentiation and equity for itself though the unique business proposition of “Health Insurance for All”, a one of a kind proposition in India at the moment. This is a philosophy that is being built through every single consumer touch point and into every single backend process of the company to ensure a customer’s experience of our proposition is continuous and seamless.
  
  
ABHI’s unique offering to market includes proposition includes -
  
  

* A Comprehensive Incentivized Wellness Program that will attract the young and health conscious and will motivate, guide and reward them to stay healthy
* A Chronic Care Management Program to cater to the unmet needs of a growing Indian population of those suffering from chronic lifestyle conditions like Diabetes, Asthma, High Cholesterol and Hypertension from Day 1
* ABHICL serves as an enabler and influencer of health and healthcare choices that customers make, in addition to being a payer of healthcare expenses. Thus, ABHICL would act like a much needed catalyst to grow the prevalent health insurance landscape in India through product innovations and a wider choice of consumer relevant products.
* ABHICL’s vision has always been digital. The company has been successful in adopting paper-less approach right from identifying to on-boarding to delivering seamless experience of its customers & employees.

title: Distinguished Engineer
description:
***Company Overview***  
*AutoRABIT is an enterprise platform for Salesforce DevSecOps that enables organizations to manage AI-accelerated Salesforce development with greater security, governance, visibility, and control. Its integrated product suite supports the complete Salesforce DevSecOps lifecycle through* ***AutoRABIT ARM*** *for CI/CD and release management,* ***CodeScan*** *for static code analysis and application security,* ***Vault*** *for data backup and recovery, and* ***Guard*** *for security posture management. The platform helps enterprises automate deployments, improve code quality, protect critical Salesforce data, monitor access risks, and strengthen compliance.* ***AutoRABIT official website***  
  
*Purpose-built for complex enterprise Salesforce environments, AutoRABIT helps development teams increase productivity, accelerate delivery, and innovate without compromising security or reliability. Its metadata-aware capabilities, scalable platform, flexible hosting options, and integrations provide organizations with the structure and control required to manage Salesforce changes across teams, environments, and global operations. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, AutoRABIT serves customers worldwide and offers employees the opportunity to contribute to products at the intersection of Salesforce, DevSecOps, security, governance, and AI-enabled development.* ***AutoRABIT platform overview***  
  
***Job Role***  
*Provide technical leadership across AutoRABIT products and shared platform capabilities. Combine exceptional hands-on engineering with a strong view of customer needs, product differentiation and long-term technical direction. Your mandate is to improve the company’s ability to build products customers trust and choose, and to translate that direction into working software.*  
  
***Key Responsibilities***

* ***Company-level product direction.*** *Work with Product, the CTO, VP of Engineering and customer-facing leaders to identify the technical capabilities that matter most to customer value and product differentiation. Use customer evidence and market understanding to shape investment options, build-versus-buy decisions and long-term platform direction.*
* ***Cross-product architecture.*** *Guide architecture across product boundaries, shared services and integrations. Simplify dependencies, clarify interfaces and reduce systemic risks. Define staged modernisation plans that protect existing customers while enabling future capabilities. Establish decision principles with accountable product and engineering owners.*
* ***Hands-on execution.*** *Personally design and implement critical components, reference solutions and technically demanding capabilities. Lead complex initiatives through validation and rollout. Resolve the highest-impact systemic engineering problems without becoming the default owner of every difficult implementation task.*
* ***Production AI leadership.*** *Guide reliable AI-enabled capabilities and engineering practices. Establish evaluation methods, tenant and data boundaries, safe tool execution, oversight, observability and cost controls appropriate to each use case. Demonstrate where AI improves outcomes and where simpler approaches are preferable.*
* ***Engineering capability.*** *Mentor Principal Engineers, architects and senior technical leaders. Establish reusable practices for secure, reliable and maintainable delivery. Improve the quality of engineering decisions across teams and build leadership capacity that persists beyond your direct involvement.*
* ***Executive influence and accountability.*** *Communicate technical trade-offs in terms of customer impact, investment and risk. Partner with the CTO on enterprise direction and the VP of Engineering on execution. Agree decision rights for cross-product initiatives and make outcomes visible to leadership and the teams delivering them.*
* *Responsibility to adhere to set internal controls.*

***Pride of Ownership***  
*We value pride of ownership. Understand the customer, the product and the market need; form a clear, evidence-based opinion about how the product can improve; and work with others to turn that opinion into results. Strong coding skills and effective use of AI matter, but accountability continues after a feature is shipped. Be willing to challenge assumptions, listen to feedback and change your view when the evidence changes.*  
  
***Experience & Desired Skills***  
***Required Skills (Mandatory)***

* *15+ years delivering complex enterprise software, with sustained evidence of company-wide or multi-product technical impact.*
* *Exceptional hands-on expertise in Java, distributed systems, enterprise APIs and SaaS architecture.*
* *Experience leading major initiatives across multiple teams and bringing them into reliable production use.*
* *Demonstrated production AI delivery, including evaluation, security, operational performance and economic trade-offs.*
* *Deep understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, modern delivery practices, containers, Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code.*
* *Strong judgment in security, scalability, reliability, observability and architectural modernisation.*
* *Evidence of influencing product direction and translating technical investments into customer or business outcomes.*
* *Ability to mentor Principal-level engineers and influence executive decisions without relying on reporting authority.*

***Preferred Skills (Good to Have)***

* *Salesforce ecosystem products, DevSecOps, release orchestration, code analysis, security or data protection.*
* *Experience with regulated enterprise customers and globally distributed engineering teams.*
* *Major product achievements or other evidence of external-grade technical impact; patents, publications and open-source contributions are useful but not mandatory.*

***What success looks like***

* *Within 90 days, establish a shared view of the most important cross-product technical opportunities, risks and decision boundaries.*
* *Within six months, lead agreed milestones for a strategic platform initiative and demonstrate evidence of improved customer, engineering or business outcomes.*
* *Strengthen Principal-level technical leadership and establish a practical, prioritised investment agenda with Product and Engineering.*

***Why join AutoRABIT***  
*You will influence the future of AutoRABIT’s platform while remaining an active builder. The opportunity is to create lasting product advantage, simplify difficult engineering problems and grow the people who will deliver the next generation of capabilities.*  
  
***Experience:*** *15+ Years*  
***Compensation:*** *110 - 140 Lakhs per annum*  
***Location:*** *Hyderabad*  
***Work Mode:*** *Hybrid - 3 days Work from Office*  
***Work Timings****: IST timings - General Flexible Shift*

description:

**Experience Level - 15+**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Cognite Solution Architect to design industrial data solutions for upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations. You will define how operational, enterprise and engineering information is integrated, modelled and contextualized in Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), and how applications and analytical solutions consume that information. You will own solution architecture decisions, establish reusable implementation patterns and resolve complex technical issues across source systems, data models, access controls and consuming applications.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include:**
**Architecture and integration**

* Translate operational use cases into data requirements, integration designs and application-consumption patterns.
* Define how CDF fits within historian, enterprise application, engineering information and cloud architectures.
* Select source-appropriate extractors, APIs and processing patterns, considering latency, throughput, connectivity and source-system load.
* Define historical loading, incremental extraction, reconciliation and recovery approaches, including late records, corrections and supported deletions.
* Establish requirements for service identities, access capabilities, environment separation, monitoring and operational support.

**Industrial information modelling**

* Design CDF models using spaces, containers, views and instances; select direct relations or edges according to relationship semantics and query requirements.
* Reuse and extend Cognite’s Core Data Model where suitable, introducing custom domain concepts where required.
* Define stable identifiers, source crosswalks and conflict-resolution rules, including repeated tag names across sites and systems.
* Represent physical equipment, functional locations and installation history separately where required.
* Establish schema versioning, migration and consumer-compatibility requirements while preserving lineage, timestamps, units, quality indicators and relationship provenance.

**Contextualization and Oil & Gas semantics**

* Design relationships connecting equipment and assets with time series, maintenance records, documents and engineering diagrams.
* Define matching rules, confidence thresholds, exception handling and domain review for ambiguous associations; assess coverage and match accuracy separately.
* For upstream applications, model fields, wells, wellbores, production facilities, equipment, well tests and interventions, preserving distinctions between measured, calculated and allocated production.
* For downstream applications, model sites, process units, functional locations, equipment, laboratory results and maintenance activities, accounting for replacement, revisions and measurement timing.
* Validate that contextualized information supports the intended engineering workflow.
* Application enablement and technical assurance
* Define consumer data contracts covering entities, relationships, fields, freshness, permissions and query-performance expectations.
* Validate designs against representative Cognite applications, custom applications, and analytical or AI workflows.
* Develop critical prototypes and reference implementations using Python, SQL, Cognite SDKs and APIs.
* Establish deployment and environment-promotion practices using version control, automated validation and Cognite Toolkit.
* Review architecture changes, migration plans, integration code and performance bottlenecks; resolve cross-system design conflicts and mentor data engineering leads.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A relevant engineering, computer science or information systems degree, or equivalent technical experience.
* Demonstrated personal architectural contribution to a production Cognite Data Fusion implementation.
* Strong knowledge of CDF data modelling, transformations, contextualization and access controls.
* Substantial industrial data integration experience spanning representative operational, enterprise and engineering sources.
* Strong Python and SQL skills with practical Cognite SDK and REST API experience.
* Experience defining identity strategies, model evolution, deployment patterns and production support requirements.
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture, identity providers, network boundaries and CI/CD.
* Strong Oil & Gas implementation experience in at least one upstream or downstream domain, with ability to adapt relevant concepts to the other.

**Good to Have**

* Cognite implementation experience across multiple assets or sites.
* Experience spanning both upstream and downstream.
* Familiarity with historians, maintenance systems, laboratory systems, engineering repositories or well-data services.
* Experience with diagram contextualization, 3D associations and industrial knowledge graphs.
* Experience enabling Cognite applications or AI workflows using contextualized data.
* Relevant Cognite Academy training or certifications.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on architect who can defend consequential production Cognite decisions involving identity resolution, data-model design, access boundaries, recovery, schema migration and application compatibility, and demonstrate which patterns can be reused across sites and which require adaptation.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Platform Architect
description:

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Platform Architect
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
**Overview**
The Infrastructure Engineering team is looking for a Senior Platform Architect to lead the design and evolution of secure, scalable, and resilient enterprise infrastructure platforms that power Mastercard's critical business services. The ideal candidate is a strategic technology leader with deep expertise in enterprise architecture, infrastructure engineering, and cloud technologies. They are highly collaborative, intellectually curious, and passionate about solving complex technical challenges while driving innovation, operational excellence, and platform modernization. This individual excels at partnering across engineering, security, and product organizations to deliver scalable solutions that enable business growth and provide exceptional customer experiences.
  
  
Role
  
  

* Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of highly available, scalable, and secure enterprise infrastructure solutions across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.
* Partner with Engineering, Network, Security, Cloud, Database, Middleware, Product, and Program Management teams to develop infrastructure solutions that support business and technology strategies.
* Drive infrastructure solution delivery from initial business engagement through architecture reviews, financial approvals, procurement, implementation, operational readiness, and production deployment.
* Design resilient networking, application delivery, and security architectures utilizing enterprise technologies including load balancing, web application firewalls, API gateways, and distributed infrastructure platforms.
* Lead infrastructure modernization initiatives focused on automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), platform standardization, performance optimization, resiliency, and operational excellence.
* Develop enterprise architecture standards, technical roadmaps, and infrastructure documentation while mentoring engineering teams and promoting engineering best practices.
* Ensure infrastructure solutions meet stringent requirements for security, compliance, availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and performance across mission-critical platforms.

**All About You**
Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience
  
  

* Deep expertise in enterprise infrastructure architecture across data center, hybrid cloud, and distributed computing environments.
* Advanced knowledge of enterprise networking, application delivery, and infrastructure security, including Zero Trust principles and modern network architectures.
* Experience designing and supporting enterprise platforms utilizing VMware, cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP), load balancing, web application firewalls, API gateways, and distributed infrastructure.
* Strong expertise in infrastructure automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible), CI/CD integration, and configuration management using tools such as Git, Bitbucket, and Jenkins.
* Demonstrated ability to architect and deliver highly available, resilient, and secure infrastructure solutions while collaborating effectively across cross-functional engineering and business teams.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence technical and executive stakeholders.

**Desirable Or Additional Capabilities**

* Expertise in infrastructure performance engineering, including capacity planning, scalability testing, and performance optimization.
* Advanced experience creating technical architecture documentation and executive presentations using Microsoft Visio.
* Experience supporting mission-critical financial services platforms with stringent availability, security, resiliency, and regulatory compliance requirements.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
FEQ327R324
  
  
As a Solutions Architect part of a Global Capability Center(GCC) focused Field Engineering team, you will shape the future of the Data and AI landscape by working with the most sophisticated Data and AI teams in the world, including Fortune 500 enterprises and global AI-forward SaaS customers operating globally. In this role, you will be deeply embedded with our named strategic accounts, serving as a trusted long-term technical advisor while also collaborating with internal sales, product, and engineering teams.
  
  
You will help our customers achieve tangible data-driven outcomes through the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, helping data teams complete projects and integrate our platform into their enterprise ecosystem. You'll grow as a leader in your field, while finding solutions to our customers' biggest challenges in data engineering, analytics, AI and data science.
  
  
Reporting to the Field Engineering Manager, you will collaborate with our most strategic global prospects and customers, partner with regional field teams across geographies, work directly with product and engineering to drive the Databricks roadmap forward, and work with the broader customer-facing team to develop architectures and solutions using our platform. You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way.
  
  
**The impact you will have**

* Be the trusted technical advisor for one or more named strategic accounts — building deep, durable relationships with their data, AI/ML, and platform engineering leaders, and earning a seat at the table for their most important architectural decisions.
* Help shape and drive your customer's AI strategy — partnering with their data science, ML, and AI platform teams to design GenAI and ML architectures, evaluate build-vs-buy decisions, and turn AI ambitions into production systems deployed on Databricks.
* Partner with the sales team and provide hands-on technical leadership to help large enterprise customers understand how Databricks can help solve their business problems across the full data and AI lifecycle.
* Consult on modern Lakehouse architectures and implement proofs of concept for strategic projects spanning data engineering, data warehousing, machine learning, GenAI— including validating integrations with cloud services, in-house tools, and third-party applications.
* Work directly with the sales team to develop your book of business, define account strategies, and execute those strategies to help your customers and prospects solve their business problems with Databricks.
* Collaborate across regions with fellow Solutions Architects and account teams, supporting our customers with consistent architectural guidance across their international footprint.
* Become an expert in, promote, and recruit contributors for Databricks-inspired open-source projects (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow, Unity Catalog) across the developer community.

**What We Look For**

* 12+ years in data engineering, data science, technical architecture, or a similar pre-sales / consulting role.
* 8+ years hands-on experience with Big Data and AI technologies, including Apache Spark™, data engineering, data science, and modern AI/ML workloads.
* Strong hands-on architectural experience — able to whiteboard, design, and personally build end-to-end solutions, not just advise.
* Demonstrated experience working with large enterprise or Fortune 500 customers; experience supporting global accounts across multiple geographies strongly preferred.
* Experience working with digital-native or SaaS enterprises with mature data and AI practices is a strong plus.
* Strong consulting / customer-facing experience working with external clients across a variety of industries.
* Coding experience in Python, SQL, Scala, Java, or R.
* Experience building distributed data systems at enterprise scale.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Available to travel to customers in your region and occasionally internationally.
* Nice to have: prior experience working in or with a Global Capability Center model; Databricks Certification.

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

* Experience guiding and mentoring engineering teams through complex technical challenges.
* Ability to navigate governance frameworks and drive alignment between business objectives and technology execution.
* Strong engineering judgement with focus on pragmatic, scalable solutions.

Engineering Practices
  
  
  

* Strong understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Commitment to secure coding, code quality, and engineering best practices.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to resolve complex production issues.
* Experience with observability, monitoring, alerting, and incident management.

**Preferred Skills**

* Proficiency in containerization and orchestration technologies, including Docker and container runtime management.
* Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including deployment strategies, scaling, troubleshooting, and Helm chart management.
* Expertise in Infrastructure as Code tools such as CloudFormation and Terraform for provisioning and managing cloud infrastructure.
* Hands-on exposure to streaming and data platform technologies such as Kafka, Kafka Streams, Flink, Schema Registry, event schemas, connectors, or real-time data pipelines.

* Experience with AWS Cloud Services and cloud-native application development.

The role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To build and maintain the systems that collect, store, process, and analyse data, such as data pipelines, data warehouses and data lakes to ensure that all data is accurate, accessible, and secure.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Build and maintenance of data architectures pipelines that enable the transfer and processing of durable, complete and consistent data.

* Development of processing and analysis algorithms fit for the intended data complexity and volumes.
* Collaboration with data scientist to build and deploy machine learning models.

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..

They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..

They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.

* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Software Engineering Manager, Agentic Transformation for Graphics Systems
description: Agents are changing how all software will be built. Agentic systems can perform substantial engineering work. It is still unproven whether they can be a reliable production capability at graphics systems' quality standards. Meanwhile, teams continue shipping new features, sustaining platforms, and meeting product commitments. Graphics drivers are a difficult proving ground. They involve large codebases, complex hardware-OS interactions, strict performance demands, broad application compatibility, and formal safety obligations in automotive.NVIDIA seeks an engineering manager in India to develop a new framework for agentic software development. You will test this model against one of our most fast-paced production software stacks. You will lead a graphics systems team through this transition and continue delivering the necessary product roadmap. Afterwards, you will transform effective practices into a reusable engineering product for other teams. You will grow the people, technology, and operating model together, creating an ambitious, highly engaged team that uses agents to surpass typical capacity. Success goes beyond one team’s transformation; it establishes a production-proven system for software development in the agentic era at NVIDIA.What You’ll Be DoingDevelop and launch an end-to-end production model for agentic software development. Apply it to graphics systems, where agents perform engineering tasks from requirements and diagnosis to implementation, validation, review, and release.Define the technical strategy and transformation roadmap, turning fast paced agentic capabilities into dependable production execution and steadily growing the work agents complete end to end.Keep the team delivering its must-do graphics and display roadmap. This includes new features, platform enablement, performance, stability, and release commitments. At the same time, fundamentally evolve how that work gets done.Build an ambitious, highly engaged team that produces outstanding results, nurturing engineers and technical leaders alongside the technology and operating model.Transform the established agentic engineering system into a reusable product for other teams. Package its orchestration, skills, tools, evaluations, validators, and operating methods. Collaborate across NVIDIA to encourage adoption with measurable production outcomes.What We Need To SeeDemonstrated experience developing and delivering production software via autonomous engineering systems that include planning, tool application, retrieval, memory, evaluation, and validation, with agents handling a significant portion of actual engineering tasks.Demonstrated ability to turn a fast paced and ambiguous technical opportunity into a clear strategy, roadmap, and measurable production system while keeping an existing product roadmap on track.10+ overall years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of engineering management or technical leadership, with a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent experience.Strong technical foundations in complex production software, including systems architecture, debugging, validation, CI/CD, and release engineering.High-agency, results-focused leadership: you build an environment where people grow, enjoy doing their best work, and use technology to deliver results far beyond the team’s traditional capacity.Ways To Stand Out From The CrowdAcknowledged advancements in the field of agentic systems, shown through peer-reviewed publications, widely embraced open-source projects, public benchmarks, or other externally validated outcomes.Experience with graphics or display driver development and technologies such as Vulkan, OpenGL ES, EGL, SurfaceFlinger, HWC, Gralloc, UMD/KMD drivers, X11, or Wayland.Familiarity with NVIDIA DRIVE OS and experience developing safety-critical automotive software using standards such as ISO 26262 and ASIL.Meaningful contributions to the Linux kernel, graphics software ecosystem, developer tools, or other broadly adopted systems software.NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working with us. If you are a creative and autonomous engineering leader who wants to invent how the most demanding production software will be built in the agentic era and prove it by helping real driver teams ship, we would love to hear from you., , JR2024865

title: Lead – Forward Deployment Engineer (Python / Automation)

title: Head of Solutions & Delivery
description:
**About the Company**

Fineshift is a founder-led technology services company helping enterprise customers solve complex engineering challenges across
**DevSecOps, Monitoring & Observability, and AI**
.

As an independent, bootstrapped company, we prioritise customer outcomes, delivery accountability, and fast decision-making. We are authorised partners of GitLab, IBM, JFrog, Snyk, and AWS, working with large enterprises across banking, financial services, and manufacturing.

We are at a stage where the leaders we hire will shape our next phase of growth. This is an opportunity to build and scale a technology practice, not simply inherit one.

**About the Role**

This is the senior technology leadership position in the company, reporting directly to the CEO.

You own what we propose to our customers and what we deliver to them. That means owning the technical solution end to end — understanding the requirement, designing the approach, preparing the proposal, defending it in front of the customer, and then standing behind it when it goes into delivery.

It also means owning the commercial outcome of the technology business and deciding how the technology organisation should be structured as it grows. You will have the mandate to shape the team, the practices, and the technical standards we hold ourselves to.

We are looking for someone who wants that level of ownership, not someone who wants a defined scope.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own technical solutioning for customer requirements across all three service lines, from discovery and requirement analysis through to the final solution.
* Prepare the technical proposal in line with the solution — architecture, approach, effort estimate, assumptions, and risks.
* Review and approve any technical proposal prepared by others before it reaches a customer.
* Present and defend the solution to the customer — solution walkthroughs, demonstrations, architecture discussions, and workshops.
* Act as the senior technical presence in customer conversations, including steering meetings, quarterly reviews, and escalation discussions.
* Own customer escalations end to end, including containment, resolution, and written root cause analysis.
* Define the right structure for the technology organisation — how solutioning, delivery, and support are organised — and evolve it as the business grows.
* Set technical direction for each service line and define the standard engagements are delivered to.
* Build and mentor the technical team, including senior technical staff responsible for solution design, estimation, and customer communication.
* Grow existing accounts through upsell and cross-sell, and grow the number of engineers deployed at customer sites.
* Own the technology P&L — margin per engagement, revenue per deployed engineer, and cost of unassigned capacity.

**Must Have**

* 12+ years in technology, including at least 3 years leading a delivery or solutions practice in an IT services or systems-integration company.
* Deep expertise in one of DevSecOps, Monitoring & Observability, or AI, with working credibility in the other two.
* Strong hands-on solution design and estimation ability — able to architect an engagement and size it accurately before it is sold.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD, release management, containers and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure).
* Working knowledge of observability tooling — IBM Instana, Prometheus, Grafana, Nagios, or Icinga — along with incident management and root cause analysis.
* Familiarity with AI engagement patterns — LLM and agent applications, RAG, on-premise versus cloud trade-offs — enough to scope an engagement without a specialist in the room.
* Experience carrying a P&L or a practice margin number, not only a delivery target.
* Experience building and leading a technical team across multiple concurrent customer engagements.
* Ability to hold a technical discussion with a CIO or customer architect directly, and to handle escalations without escalating them further.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in a partner or reseller model, working alongside product vendors.
* Enterprise customers in banking, financial services, or manufacturing in India.
* Experience growing a technical practice from a small team into a larger one.
* Exposure to presales in a services environment — RFP responses, solution defence, and competitive positioning.

title: Electronic Systems Technical Specialist - Software
description:
**Job Summary**
This applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins’ products. People in these positions have involvement in identification and understanding of stakeholder requirements and developing specifications, and responsibility for design, implementation, testing and/or release of software that controls the operation of Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Investigates product software problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution, and documents results. Applies and improves the improvement of product software development processes and tools. Processes include coding, compiling and test. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and negotiates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross-BU integration and coordination. Responsible for review of less-experienced developers/testers’ work to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient designs. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across function(s) within a global business unit or managing improvement across business units. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.
  
  
**Competencies**
Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.
  
  
Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.
  
  
Product Platform Planning and Architecting - Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade-off analysis in collaboration with life-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams.
  
  
Product Software Design and Construction - Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products.
  
  
Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.
  
  
System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
  
  
Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.
  
  
Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.
  
  
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
  
  
Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
  
  
Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
  
  
Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.
  
  
Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.
  
  
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
**Experience**
Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Functional Safety (FuSa) Software Developer is responsible for developing, verifying, and maintaining safety-critical software in compliance with ISO 26262 for automotive electronic systems. The role ensures that software components meet defined ASIL requirements and supports the full safety lifecycle from concept to production.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities – Functional Safety Engineering**

* Implement software safety requirements derived from system and hardware safety requirements.
* Ensure compliance with ISO 26262 Part 6.
* Develop safety-related embedded software in C/C++.
* Implement safety mechanisms such as watchdogs, redundancy, diagnostics, and safe-state handling.
* Work with MCU-based platforms and RTOS environments.
* Develop unit and integration tests.
* Execute requirement-based testing.
* Support ASIL-compliant verification and coverage analysis.
* Participate in audits and safety reviews.
* Prepare ISO 26262 compliant work products.
* Maintain traceability between requirements, design, code, and tests.
* Support OEM and supplier safety documentation.
* Participate in requirements discussions.
* Connect with external stake holders to clarify requirements assist in system level testing.

**Technical Skills**

* Embedded C/C++ ISO 26262 (Part 6)
* AUTOSAR knowledge (preferred)
* RTOS concepts
* MISRA-C compliance

**Tools & Standards**

* Git, windchill, Eclipse, doxygen
* Unit test tools like vector cast
* Static analysis tools (Polyspace, QAC)
* Debugging tools (JTAG, Lauterbach)
* Analytical and problem-solving mindset
* Strong documentation skills
* Effective communication
* Cross-functional collaboration

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics or Embedded Systems
* 6-8 years of automotive embedded software experience
* Prior functional safety project exposure preferred

**Nice to Have**

* Functional Safety certification
* OEM project experience
* Exposure to cybersecurity-safety interaction

title: Integration Principal (SQL Expert)
description:
**INTEGRATION PRINCIPAL**
(Pune)
  
  
*Founded in 2000, Ivalua is a leading global provider of cloud-based procurement solutions.*
**Company Overview**
At Ivalua we are a global community of exceptional professionals, who believe that digital transformation revolutionises supply chain sustainability and resiliency to unlock the power of supplier collaboration.
  
  
We achieve this through our leading cloud-based spend management platform that empowers hundreds of the world's most admired brands to effectively manage all categories of spend and all suppliers to increase profitability, improve ESG (environmental, social, and corporate governance) performance, lower risk, and improve productivity. Driven by our passions and fueled by our shared ambitions, we empower and challenge each other to create meaningful experiences for our colleagues, customers, partners, and communities.
  
  
Learn more at www.ivalua.com. Follow us on LinkedIn.
  
  
**THE OPPORTUNITY**
**Context**
You will be part of the Professional Services Team whose mission is to successfully deliver our unique and configurable solution to customers and support our Partner community with high quality standards and a strong commitment to excellence and efficiency. Our team is very hands-on with a strong mindset of problem-solving while also having the ability to think holistically and provide solutions that solve the customer's long-term challenges. The Data Intelligence division within this team focuses specifically on the pillars of system integrations, advanced Power BI reporting, and end-to-end spend management data solutions.
  
  
**Role**
We are seeking a highly technical, hands‑on, and detail‑oriented Principal Integration professional to lead the
**most complex, hands‑on integration designs and builds**
across our implementation portfolio. The ideal candidate is a senior individual contributor with a strong integration background and a proven track record of designing, implementing, and optimizing mission‑critical interfaces between cloud platforms and enterprise systems.
  
  
You will act as the go‑to integration expert across projects: owning design, build, troubleshooting and optimization for the most critical and technically ambiguous data flows, while setting standards that Senior Integration Leads and project teams execute against, and mentoring other team members (without direct line management).
  
  
This role is an individual contributor position, with significant autonomy and impact.
  
  
**What You Will Do With Us**
**Integration Design & Implementation**

* End‑to‑End Integration Design: Lead the detailed design of the most complex integrations between Ivalua and ERPs, HR, finance, logistics, and other third‑party systems, ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.
* Hands‑On Build: Configure and develop integrations using Ivalua tools, APIs, ETL/EAI/middleware, file‑based interfaces and scripting where needed. Own technical implementation from design through deployment for the highest‑complexity streams.
* Standards & Reuse: Define, publish, and continuously refine integration standards, reusable patterns, and best practices (e.g., modular mappings, error handling, logging, versioning) for Senior Integration Leads and consultants to apply across projects.
* Performance & Robustness: Analyze and optimize integration performance (throughput, latency, data volumes), and design robust error handling, reconciliation and recovery strategies that serve as the reference approach for the broader team.
* Troubleshooting & Debugging: Act as the top‑level technical escalation point for integration‑related incidents that Senior Integration Leads and project teams cannot resolve, during build, SIT/UAT, go‑live and hypercare phases.

**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**

* Work with Functional & Technical Teams: Collaborate closely with Functional Consultants, Solution Architects, Data Engineers and Project Managers to align integration design with business processes and data models.
* Customer Technical Workshops: Lead or co‑lead technical workshops with customers' IT and integration teams on the most strategically significant or technically ambiguous engagements, to capture integration requirements, present solution options, and validate technical designs.
* R&D Feedback: Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams on integration capabilities, feature gaps, and improvement opportunities encountered across the portfolio.
* Pre‑Sales Support: Provide technical input on the most complex or high‑risk proposals — contributing to solution design, effort estimation, and technical due diligence for prospective clients where deep integration expertise is needed to de‑risk the deal.

**Delivery Excellence**

* Technical Specifications: Produce high‑quality, reference‑standard technical design documents (integration specification, mapping documents, sequence diagrams) and keep them up to date.
* Quality Assurance: Define the org's unit, integration, and regression testing standards and frameworks, and perform peer reviews of integration designs and implementations across projects.
* Risk & Issue Management: Identify systemic integration risks (e.g., recurring dependencies, data quality patterns, performance constraints) and partner with project teams to define and drive mitigation plans at the practice level.
* Lifecycle Support: Support cutover planning, go‑live readiness, and post‑go‑live stabilization from an integration standpoint, including monitoring and early‑life support for the most critical engagements.

**Partner & Internal Enablement**

* Technical Mentor: Informally mentor and coach Senior Integration Leads and junior integration/technical consultants by sharing best practices, code samples, troubleshooting techniques and design approaches.
* Partner Guidance: Provide technical guidance to partners' integration consultants on specific projects, clarifying Ivalua integration patterns, constraints and recommended approaches.
* Knowledge Assets: Contribute to internal knowledge base articles, how‑to guides, reference implementations, and sample configurations to accelerate future projects.

**YOUR PROFILE**
If you have the below experience and strengths this role could be for you:
  
  
**Required Skills**

* Minimum 10 years of experience in technical integration, technical consulting, or web‑based software development, ideally in SaaS or complex enterprise environments.
* Significant hands‑on experience designing and implementing integrations using ETL/EAI or other integration/middleware technologies.
* Strong practical experience with SOAP and REST APIs, including API consumption, design principles, authentication methods, and error handling.
* Solid understanding of data transfer mechanisms (e.g., SFTP, FTPS, API‑based, file‑based) and data formats such as CSV, XML, JSON (experience with cXML/EDI a plus).
* Proficient with relational databases and SQL (e.g., SQL Server or equivalent): able to write and tune complex queries, perform data analysis, and investigate performance issues.
* Demonstrated ability to independently diagnose and resolve most the complex integration problems across applications, middleware, and databases.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with attention to data integrity, security and long‑term maintainability.
* Excellent communication skills, capable of explaining technical topics to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders, and leading technical working sessions with senior client and internal stakeholders. .
* Comfortable working in a customer‑facing Professional Services or consulting environment, managing multiple workstreams and priorities.
* A Bachelor's (BS) degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a closely related technical field or foreign equivalent is required.
* Ability and willingness to travel as needed (~10–20%, depending on project needs).

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in Procurement / Source‑to‑Pay (S2P), finance, or supply chain domains.
* Experience working with or alongside Systems Integrators (SIs) or consulting partners on integration topics.
* Exposure to cloud platforms and integration services (iPaaS, API gateways, message queues, event‑driven architectures).

title: Solution Architect Voice AI
description:
About AgentCallBack

AgentCallBack provides enterprise Voice AI agents that manage inbound and outbound customer conversations at scale. Our multilingual AI agents operate 24/7, handle natural interruptions, remember prior interactions, transfer calls to human agents and integrate with CRM, ERP, contact-centre and telephony platforms.

We serve customers across healthcare, insurance, financial services, hospitality, retail, property management and other service-based industries.

About the Role

We are seeking a technically strong and customer-focused Solution Architect to design and deliver enterprise Voice AI solutions.

You will work closely with customers, sales, product and engineering teams to understand business requirements, design solution architecture, manage integrations and guide implementations from discovery through production deployment.

The ideal candidate understands enterprise applications, APIs, cloud platforms, telephony and conversational AI, and can translate complex technical concepts into clear business solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead technical discovery sessions with customers and document business, integration, security and operational requirements.
* Design end-to-end Voice AI solutions covering telephony, conversation workflows, integrations, data flows, security and human-agent transfers.
* Create solution architecture diagrams, integration specifications, call flows and implementation plans.
* Design integrations with CRM and ERP platforms such as Salesforce, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, JD Edwards and GoHighLevel.
* Integrate AgentCallBack with contact-centre and telephony platforms such as Genesys Cloud, 3CX, Yeastar, SIP trunks and PBX systems.
* Work with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication frameworks, data files and middleware platforms.
* Convert customer use cases into structured AI conversation flows, including escalation rules, exception handling and compliance requirements.
* Support demonstrations, proposals, technical presentations and responses to RFPs.
* Define the scope, success criteria and technical requirements for pilots and proofs of concept.
* Coordinate with engineering and product teams to configure, test and deploy customer solutions.
* Lead user acceptance testing, production readiness reviews and technical handover.
* Diagnose integration, call-quality, latency and workflow issues during implementation.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for security, scalability, reliability and data privacy.
* Identify reusable solution patterns and contribute to implementation templates and technical documentation.
* Provide technical guidance to customers, implementation partners and internal teams.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* 5–10 years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise integration, technical consulting or implementation.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication and enterprise data integration.
* Experience integrating CRM, ERP, contact-centre or customer-service applications.
* Working knowledge of SIP, VoIP, PBX systems, call routing and contact-centre technology.
* Experience designing cloud-based, scalable and secure enterprise solutions.
* Ability to create architecture diagrams, process flows, functional specifications and integration documents.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders and senior executives.
* Experience managing multiple customer implementations simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with conversational AI, Voice AI, speech recognition or generative AI solutions.
* Knowledge of large language models, prompt design, knowledge bases and conversational workflow development.
* Experience with platforms such as NetSuite, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, JD Edwards, Genesys Cloud, 3CX or GoHighLevel.
* Familiarity with AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.
* Understanding of call recording, consent, Do Not Call requirements and data-protection regulations.
* Experience working with customers across multiple countries, languages and industries.
* Previous experience in a SaaS company, systems integrator or enterprise software consulting environment.

Key Competencies

* Customer-focused problem solving
* Solution and systems thinking
* Strong technical ownership
* Clear communication and presentation
* Attention to detail
* Cross-functional collaboration
* Ability to work in a fast-moving startup environment

Success in This Role

Success will be measured by:

* Quality and scalability of proposed solutions
* Speed and effectiveness of customer implementations
* Successful completion of pilots and production deployments
* Integration reliability and call-flow accuracy
* Customer satisfaction and adoption
* Clear documentation and effective knowledge transfer

Why Join AgentCallBack?

* Work on practical enterprise applications of Voice AI.
* Design solutions across telephony, AI, CRM and ERP technologies.
* Work directly with global customers and senior decision-makers.
* Influence product capabilities and implementation standards.
* Join a growing Singapore-based technology company serving international markets.

title: Application Specialist SPDM
description:
At Siemens we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future. We need the most innovative and diverse talent with technical acumen to develop tomorrow’s reality. With Engineering Enterprise Apps and Engineering AI solutions, we are uniquely positioned to have an immediate impact on the transformation at our customers to leverage the full value of their simulation analyses and data and AI – and create much better products much faster.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Application Specialists team is an essential component of the Engineering Enterprise Apps & Engineering AI product management team by offering top-tier expertise in the solution portfolio as well as the key industry sectors and applications. With the team of application specialists we develop advanced workflows and best practices that boost our customers' productivity. Such workflows and best practices will directly impact our ability to accelerate sales cycles in pre-sales context, as well as being an essential instrument to achieve effective customer adoption and hence create expansion opportunities at our customers.
  
  
The work involves connecting the relevant product lines from the Simcenter portfolio, fostering advanced technical thought leadership, and maximizing the visibility and business success of the Simcenter portfolio.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As Application Specialist you stand in the center of a continuously evolving solution portfolio bringing new features & functionalities with every release, and the dynamics of an equally fast evolving market where new trends and opportunities arise as a result of emerging new technology. The challenge of the application specialist will be to understand our customers’ current and future challenges and to articulate the value of the EEA portfolio through well documented, industry-relevant, example use cases that show our customer the potential of advancing their ways of working with our EEA portfolio.
  
  
You will look across the boundaries of individual products and will be able to identify synergies and opportunities for improvement at the interface of our technologies so as to deliver a seamless experience for our end users.
  
  
**Activities also include**

* Supporting portfolio developers, business development teams, sales and pre-sales teams in customer pursuits with dedicated Proof-of-Concept development and demonstration
* Relaying customer and market needs and trends to the product management teams
* Act as a sounding board to the product management teams for new requirement / specification development
* Active stakeholder in product milestone demonstrations, technical enablement, etc
* Assisting in the development of collateral for the relevant campaigns and technical marketing initiatives
* Participating and presenting at internal and external webinars, seminars and user conferences
* Promoting the portfolio through writing blog posts, posting videos, contributing in discussion forums etc.

**Your Qualifications**
We are looking for someone who is an excellent communicator and capable of translating a value proposition and associated content at the level of different audience. You are self-organized and know how to handle incoming requests from many different angles and varying priority, while creating high-quality deliverables. You are a permanent learner – whether product, market, trends, you stay up to date and well informed.
  
  
**Specific qualifications we will be looking for :**

* Extensive expertise as application engineer in simulation ; leveraging AI, data and data management, and simulation process orchestration as tools
* Hands-on experience with Siemens’ Simcenter EEA portfolio is a plus
* Hands-on experience in engineering verification and validation processes, through simulation and/or physical testing in either automotive, aerospace or defense industry. Awareness about the value of traceable, correctly annotated data to support reuse and improve efficiency and quality of results.
* Strong written, communication and presentation skills in English
* Knowledge of applicable solutions for documenting engineering workflows (SolutionLink, …) is a plus
* Able to travel occasionally

title: Principal Engineer - DevOps
description:
**What is Contentstack?**
Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.
  
  
While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.
  
  
Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.
  
  
Learn more at www.contentstack.com.
  
  
**Who Are We?**
At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let's go!
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Work with the engineering teams to design, build, monitor and maintain the system for high availability and scalability.
* Define SLIs and SLOs with the engineering teams, track them, and use error budgets to guide reliability work and release decisions.
* Take part in design reviews and make architecture decisions that improve reliability, scalability, security and operability before systems reach production.
* Build security into the infrastructure and delivery pipelines, including access control, secrets management, network policies and image and dependency scanning.
* Work with the security team to track vulnerabilities and audit findings, and close them within agreed SLAs.
* Write production-grade software, deployment frameworks, tracers, monitors and auto remediation tools, and automate the processes.
* Follow an AI-first approach to operations. Use AI tools and agents for incident triage, log and alert analysis, runbook execution, change review and documentation, and build our own where off-the-shelf tools fall short.
* Manage cloud infrastructure as code (Terraform / Pulumi) and keep environments consistent, reviewable and reproducible.
* Lead and participate in performance, load and stress tests; identify bottlenecks, opportunities for optimization and capacity planning.
* Participate in the on-call rotation and lead incident response as needed. Write postmortems and follow through on the fixes.
* Identify repetitive operational work and engineer it away.
* Review existing processes and recommend changes or institute new processes as necessary, including the areas of monitoring, alerting, upgrades, and tuning, etc.
* Create quality project documentation of architecture designs, implementation plans, design documents, runbooks, test plans, etc.

**Mandatory Skills**

* Excellent programming skills in at least one language (Go, Python, Java, Node or similar), with production code you can walk us through. Experience with Go is a plus.
* Experience applying SRE practices: defining SLIs and SLOs, error budgets, and using them to drive design and prioritization decisions.
* Experience designing and building reliable, scalable systems on Google Cloud Platform (GKE, Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, VPC, IAM). Working knowledge of AWS or other clouds.
* Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform or Pulumi.
* Experience with Container and Cloud technologies like Docker/Kubernetes.
* Experience with CI/CD using Argo CD, Jenkins, helm charts etc.
* Experience in performance diagnostics, capacity planning, performance architecture design, performance tuning, performance monitoring.
* Experience with the use, maintenance and configuration of monitoring, metrics and logging infrastructure (Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, New Relic, etc.)
* Experience leading incident response and writing blameless postmortems, with a focus on removing the cause rather than handling the symptom.
* Comfortable working with modern nosql databases and big data platforms (MongoDB, Redis, etc.)
* Total experience of 10+ years, with a software development background and 3+ years working with GCP, Kubernetes and large-scale distributed systems.

**What Do We Offer?**
**Interesting Work |**
We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the "challenge yourself" role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you're doing it.
  
  
**Tribe Vibe**
| We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict "no a\*\*hole policy" and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected.
  
  
**Bragging Rights**
| We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!
  
  
**One Team One Dream**
| This is one of our values, and it shows. We don't believe in artificial hierarchies. If you're part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it's a great time to be joining…

They are highly collaborative, intellectually curious, and passionate about solving complex technical challenges while driving innovation, operational excellence, and platform modernization. * Develop enterprise architecture standards, technical roadmaps, and infrastructure documentation while mentoring engineering teams and promoting engineering best practices.
* Ensure infrastructure solutions meet stringent requirements for security, compliance, availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and performance across mission-critical platforms.
