title: Application Engineering, Principal Engineer
description:
We Are
  
  
At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
  
  
You Are
  
  
You are a DDR/LPDDR Controller System Architecture Specialist who can work directly with customer architects to close real system-level memory subsystem design decisions.
  
  
You are comfortable discussing SoC integration, memory subsystem architecture, controller configuration, performance optimization, power management, validation, and interoperability topics. You can help customers evaluate technical trade-offs and guide them toward practical architecture decisions.
  
  
This is a customer-facing technical role. You will help customers integrate DDR/LPDDR controller IP into complex SoCs, identify key requirements or gaps, and translate customer feedback into actionable input for Synopsys Product Management, R&D, and roadmap planning.
  
  
What You’ll Be Doing
  
  

* Own the technical architecture engagement for DDR/LPDDR controller IP with strategic customers, from early platform requirements through architecture closure and initial deployment readiness.
* Work with customer architects and engineering teams to define suitable DDR/LPDDR memory subsystem configurations for advanced SoC platforms.
* Analyze system-level trade-offs related to memory bandwidth, latency, power efficiency, quality of service, reliability, validation, and scalability.
* Translate customer platform requirements and integration constraints into clear feedback for Synopsys Product Management, R&D, and roadmap planning.
* Support technical closure of design wins by providing architecture guidance, configuration recommendations and competitive positioning.
* Develop reusable technical material, application notes, and customer-facing guidance based on real engagement experience.
* Train FAEs and customer teams on DDR/LPDDR architecture, memory subsystem integration, performance tuning, validation expectations, and deployment best practices.

The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Improve the quality of DDR/LPDDR design wins by ensuring customer memory architectures are technically sound before commitment.
* Strengthen Synopsys DDR/LPDDR roadmap by feeding real customer memory subsystem requirements into product planning and R&D execution.
* Reduce customer integration risk by identifying architecture, performance, power, validation, and bring-up issues early.
* Help establish Synopsys as a trusted technical partner for next-generation AI, HPC, mobile, automotive, networking, and edge computing platforms.

What You’ll Need
  
  

* Bachelors and/or Masters Degree in Electrical and/or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science
* 5+ years of experience in DDR/LPDDR architecture, memory subsystem design, SoC integration, silicon validation, systems engineering, applications engineering, or customer-facing technical leadership.
* Solid understanding of DDR and/or LPDDR controller IP, including memory architecture concepts, controller configuration, scheduling, quality of service, power management, training, validation, or system integration.
* Good system-level understanding of SoC integration and ability to reason through memory bandwidth, latency, power efficiency, quality of service, reliability, validation, and software/firmware trade-offs.
* Experience engaging directly with customer architects, design teams, validation teams, and technical decision-makers.
* Ability to translate ambiguous customer requirements into clear technical recommendations, product feedback, and closure plans.
* Strong technical communication skills, including clear written analysis, structured trade-off explanation, and ability to align customer, sales, product, and engineering teams.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with Linux, firmware bring-up, or software-driven debug of DDR/LPDDR subsystems.
* Familiarity with advanced SoC architectures used in AI, HPC, automotive, mobile, networking, or compute platforms.
* Experience with memory performance analysis, traffic modeling, quality-of-service management, memory hierarchy optimization, or system-level benchmarking.
* Knowledge of advanced topics such as DDR5, LPDDR5X, LPDDR6, memory training algorithms, RAS features, chiplet-based memory architectures, or AI memory bandwidth optimization.

The Team You’ll be a Part Of
  
  
You will be part of our IP high-performance computing applications engineering team, a group of dedicated professionals who are passionate about technology and innovation. The team focuses on helping customers integrate more capabilities into SoCs faster, working collaboratively across geographic and organizational boundaries to drive revenue growth and accelerate business closure.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
  
  
Inclusion and Diversity

title: Principal Data Platform Engineer
description:
**Overview**
Are you passionate about data platforms and tools? Are you an open-minded, structured thinker who is passionate about building systems at scale. Do you understand data platforms, know how to build them and want to help our users to make data actionable? If so, this role with our team at Atlassian is for you.
  
  
We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our Data Platform Team to build a world class data platform that powers crucial business decisions throughout the organization.
  
  
You will partner with analytics teams, data engineers and data scientists across various initiatives and work with them to understand the gaps and bring your findings back to the team to build these capabilities.
  
  
Working at Atlassian
  
  
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
We build analytical data platforms for Atlassian that serve both Engineering and Data Engineering to help them generate valuable insights from data.
  
  
**As a Principal Engineer On This Team You Will**

* Own the long term architecture and technical direction for core platform capabilities and be accountable for their reliability, cost efficiency and adoption
* Design and build foundational platform components that other engineering teams build on top of, across areas like ingestion, transformation, orchestration, compute and consumption
* Architect robust multi-tenant platform standards by establishing clear cross-layer contracts, tenant isolation, and SLOs to enable autonomous producers and consumers, while driving compute and storage efficiency across workloads
* Lead cross team technical initiatives and architecture reviews, influence platform strategy with senior stakeholders and act as a technical mentor and multiplier for Senior engineers
* Stay hands on. You will be in the code on the hardest problems, not just reviewing designs

**Compensation**
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* 12+ years of software or data engineering experience, with at least 6 years building data platform infrastructure
* You have built a data platform or a significant component of one and operated it in production. For example an ingestion framework, a transformation framework, a compute or query layer, an orchestration layer, a metadata or lineage service or a data quality framework
* You can describe the scale that component ran at in concrete numbers. Data volume, ingest throughput, number of pipelines or jobs, query concurrency and latency, number of onboarded teams or tenants and infrastructure cost.
* Deep understanding of big data and distributed systems challenges including partitioning, shuffle behaviour, skew, idempotency and backfills
* Experience designing both batch and streaming architectures and clear judgement on when each is the right answer
* Expert level programming skills in language such as Java, Kotlin or Python and built solutions on public cloud offerings such as Amazon Web Services
* Experience with big data processing and storage technologies such as Spark, DBT and with open table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake
* A track record of owning ambiguous cross team problems end to end and of influencing without authority
* Degree in Computer Science, EE or a related STEM discipline or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience with high performance analytical or MPP databases such as StarRocks, Druid, ClickHouse or Pinot
* Experience with change data capture and event driven ingestion at high volume
* Experience building a semantic layer or metrics store and governing shared metric definitions
* Experience with the data foundations of ML platforms, such as point-in-time correct training data, online and offline feature parity or backfilling features at scale
* Experience with data governance, access control, lineage and compliance, including regulated environments such as FedRAMP
* Experience running platform components on Kubernetes
* Experience with multi region data architectures, including replication, failover and consistency tradeoffs

Benefits & Perks
  
  
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**
**.**
**About Atlassian**
At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
  
  
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
  
  
To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
**go.atlassian.com/crh**
**.**
In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

+ P2P (Procure to Pay)
+ R2R (Record to Report)

title: Strategic Builder
description:
**Description**
**The Experience**
Customer impact from day one. Strategic clarity and Execution that sticks.
  
  
Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists — Strategic Builders who are customer-facing advisors, who define AI strategy, shape agentic solutions, and drive measurable adoption for enterprise customers. You'll work as part of a delivery team alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, translating complex business challenges into agentic AI deployments that go live and generate real value.
  
  
Engagements are focused and time-bound — typically 12 weeks or less — and may span a single strategic account or multiple customers simultaneously. Your impact isn't just getting to deployment. It ensures customers realise lasting, scalable value from the solutions your team builds.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Full Lifecycle Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer engagement across the complete value lifecycle — Identify → Commit → Deploy → Consume — owning outcomes at every stage, not just discovery or deal closure
* AI Strategy & Architecture: Define the customer's Agentic AI strategy and roadmap. Lead design workshops, agent design sessions, and jobs-to-be-done analysis. Architect solutions spanning Salesforce's agentic AI platform, Data Cloud, and enterprise systems, with responsible AI governance baked in from the start.
* Deployment Oversight & Program Management: Manage engagement delivery end-to-end timelines, stakeholder communication, risk escalation, and progress reporting. You are the operational backbone of your delivery team, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
* Adoption & Consumption: Own adoption, consumption, and expansion metrics within your engagement scope. Identify blockers early and develop strategies to drive measurable value realization
* Delivery Team Coordination: Partner closely with the Forward Deployed Engineers on your team to align strategy with technical execution. Keep the team focused, unblocked, and on track to hit delivery milestones.
* AI-Supported Development: You'll be developing real customer solutions supported by leading-edge AI tools: Including
* Cursor, Claude, and our coding products like Vibes, to accelerate development.
* Customer Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary customer-facing contact, building trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders and present proposals, decisions and outcomes in terms of business value, not just technical detail.
* AI Readiness: Assess customer readiness for AI adoption and guide change management and process transformation to maximise the benefits of intelligent agents
* Product Feedback Loop: Synthesise field insights and translate them into actionable product feedback that influences Salesforce's Agentic AI platform roadmap.

**You're Our Person If...**

* 10-15 years of total experience with relevant 5 years into Data & AI in strategic solutioning, technical advisory, or delivery leadership or program management for enterprise cloud or SaaS technology
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* Prior customer-facing delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or technical advisory) - this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have
* Demonstrated understanding of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including Agentic AI capabilities and Data Cloud
* Working knowledge of one or more programming languages: Python, JavaScript, Java, or Apex
* Proven ability to lead and own complex, ambiguous engagements end-to-end — from discovery through to measurable outcomes
* Experience leading AI/LLM solution design, including agentic AI strategy, conversation design, and responsible AI practices
* Strong project and program management skills — ability to run multiple workstreams, manage stakeholder expectations, and keep delivery on track in ambiguous environments
* Ability to travel 25% of the time to customer sites

**Even Better If...**

* Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce platform, and Salesforce CRM (Sales, Service, Marketing)
* Experience designing and deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., public sector, financial services, healthcare)
* Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Data Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist, Application Architect) or similar platform certifications such as Microsoft, Oracle, or similar platforms.
* Background in change management, organisational design, or enterprise transformation
* Experience with AI/ML concepts beyond LLMs, including NLP, RAG architectures, and model evaluation frameworks
* A get-things-done mindset with strong bias for action — comfortable operating in unstructured fast moving environments

title: Principal Architect
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced Principal Architect to lead architectural planning, design, coordination, and execution for residential, commercial, industrial, and institutional construction projects. The candidate will be responsible for developing architectural concepts, preparing detailed drawings, coordinating with civil and structural engineering teams, and ensuring compliance with applicable building regulations and quality standards.

The role requires strong design capabilities, project coordination skills, technical expertise, and the ability to manage projects from concept development through construction and final handover.

Key Responsibilities

Architectural Design and Planning

* Develop architectural concepts, layouts, elevations, sections, and detailed designs.
* Prepare master plans, space-planning layouts, and building design proposals.
* Ensure functionality, aesthetics, sustainability, and cost-effectiveness in designs.
* Review design requirements and incorporate client and business needs.
* Ensure compliance with applicable building codes, zoning regulations, and local authority requirements.

Drawing Preparation and Documentation

* Prepare and review architectural drawings using AutoCAD, Revit, or other relevant software.
* Develop detailed working drawings, construction drawings, and design specifications.
* Prepare architectural details, schedules, material specifications, and finishing details.
* Review shop drawings and technical submittals from contractors and vendors.
* Maintain updated drawings and documentation throughout the project lifecycle.

Civil and Structural Coordination

* Coordinate with civil engineers, structural consultants, MEP consultants, and contractors.
* Ensure architectural drawings align with structural, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and fire-safety requirements.
* Identify and resolve design clashes and site-related technical issues.
* Review site conditions and recommend practical design modifications.
* Ensure proper coordination between design intent and construction execution.

Project Execution and Site Supervision

* Conduct regular site visits to monitor construction progress and architectural quality.
* Verify that work is executed according to approved drawings and specifications.
* Review material samples, finishes, mock-ups, and workmanship.
* Resolve technical queries and issue clarifications to site teams.
* Monitor project milestones, quality standards, and design-related deliverables.
* Support inspections, snag-list preparation, rectification, and final handover.

Cost, Quality, and Compliance

* Coordinate with quantity surveyors and project managers to optimize project costs.
* Review material selections and suggest cost-effective alternatives without compromising quality.
* Ensure adherence to approved designs, safety standards, and applicable regulations.
* Support preparation and review of BOQs, specifications, and tender documents.
* Monitor design changes and assess their impact on cost and timelines.

Team and Stakeholder Management

* Lead and mentor architects, junior architects, draftsmen, and design coordinators.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal project teams.
* Review design submissions and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Manage design approvals and maintain clear communication with stakeholders.
* Provide technical guidance and support during critical project decisions.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Architecture (B.Arch) from a recognized institution.
* Registration with the Council of Architecture (India), where applicable to the role.
* Typically 10–15+ years of relevant architectural design and project experience.
* Experience managing large-scale residential, commercial, industrial, or institutional projects.
* Demonstrated experience in design coordination and construction-stage execution.

Technical Skills

* AutoCAD and Revit/BIM.
* SketchUp, 3ds Max, Lumion, or other visualization tools.
* Architectural planning, detailing, and construction documentation.
* Knowledge of building materials, construction methods, and finishing works.
* Familiarity with structural and MEP coordination.
* Knowledge of NBC, local building bylaws, fire-safety requirements, and applicable development-control regulations.
* Understanding of BOQs, tender documentation, project scheduling, and cost control.

Key Competencies

* Design leadership and technical decision-making.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and coordination abilities.
* Attention to detail and quality consciousness.
* Team leadership and project management.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely completion of architectural drawings and design deliverables.
* Accuracy and completeness of construction documentation.
* Reduction in design errors, clashes, and rework.
* Compliance with approved drawings and applicable building regulations.
* Quality of architectural finishes and execution.
* Effective coordination with civil, structural, and MEP teams.
* Adherence to project budgets and schedules.
* Client satisfaction and successful project handover

title: Microsoft-Pure AI-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**AI Business Solutions –AI Engineer Senior Manager:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a Senior Manager – AI Engineer to lead strategic AI initiatives and drive the design, development, and adoption of agent-based solutions using Microsoft AI technologies. This role combines deep technical expertise with leadership to scale AI-driven transformation across enterprise functions..
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the strategy, design, and delivery of AI-powered solutions using Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and agent-based frameworks.
* Drive enterprise-wide adoption of intelligent agents built using Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel (Python or C#).
* Define architecture standards, best practices, and reusable frameworks for scalable AI solutions.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to identify AI use cases and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Mentor team members and ensure high-quality delivery across AI initiatives.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong expertise in Copilot Studio and enterprise-grade AI agent development.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel (Python or C#).
* Extensive experience with Azure AI Foundry and AI/ML ecosystem.
* Deep understanding of agent-based architectures, orchestration patterns, and enterprise integrations.
* Proven ability to define architecture and lead large-scale AI programs.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic thinking skills.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions within enterprise systems and workflows.
* Translate business requirements into scalable AI architectures and reusable components.
* Ensure solution performance, reliability, and alignment with enterprise security and governance standards.
* Ability to work effectively in distributed, onshore–offshore delivery models.

**Ideally, you’ll also**
The following skills are preferred and add value to the role:
  
  

* Experience with Power Platform.
* Experience with Azure Integration Services.
* Experience supporting large transformation or digital modernization programs
* Familiarity with testing tools, deployment cycles, and release management practices
* Experience working across multiple industries or complex business environments

**What We Look For**

* Total Experience: [12+ Years]
* Relevant Experience (AI/Agent-based solutions): 1+ Years
* Prior experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise delivery engagements.
* Degree in BE / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or equivalent with relevant industry experience.
* Microsoft AI certification is preferred.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Overview:

Senior Fullstack Software Engineer (Java & React)
  
Why HealthEdge?
  
The U.S. healthcare industry is a massive and essential sector, valued at $4.4 trillion. It offers
  
around 1.8 million job openings in the healthcare tech industry annually. This reflects the
  
industry's vast opportunities and the growing need for technological advancements.
  
Specifically, the U.S. health insurance industry, where HealthEdge operates, is valued at $1.1
  
trillion. This sector is known for its stability and sustainability, often remaining resilient during
  
economic downturns and other challenging events.
  
Impact and Scale: HealthEdge serves over 81 million lives by ensuring their health insurance
  
claims are processed quickly and accurately. With more than 130 customers and over 100 third  
party integrations, HealthEdge tackles unique problems at an extraordinary scale daily. We
  
support 48 out of 50 states in the U.S.
  
Innovative Transformation: Founded in 2005, HealthEdge is transitioning from a monolithic
  
application architecture to a modern microservices-based architecture. This involves building
  
new services using microservices and migrating legacy services to modern architecture, one
  
step at a time.
  
Unique Challenges and Opportunities: Working at HealthEdge offers a unique opportunity to
  
gain unmatched experience. Migrating such a large-scale product with hundreds of customers
  
and processing millions of transactions daily presents challenges that are rare in the industry.
  
At HealthEdge, you'll be part of an exciting journey to revolutionize the health insurance industry
  
through innovative technology solutions. We hope you're as excited as we are to take on this
  
challenge and make a significant impact in the healthcare sector.
  
Your Role
  
HealthEdge is looking for a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer who is passionate about solving
  
real-world business problems to join our team. As a Senior member of the team, you will be
  
working on developing solutions that help our customers integrate with our product suite. You
  
will be working as a problem solver with plenty of unique assignments within the department.
  
You will be a key member involved with design discussions, coding on both the backend and
  
frontend, and working heavily with the database and J2EE/integration technologies.
  
Your impact:
  

* Work as part of an agile team to implement new features according to the requirements

while adhering to the best coding development standards.
  

* Conduct detailed designs and lead design whiteboarding and creation of solution

architecture.
  

* Lead in work-breakdown of tasks.
* Lead peer reviews of design and code.
* Coordinate release management and bug triaging.
* Lead technical discussions with HealthEdge customers to find the best possible

solutions.
  

* Conduct bug fixing, implement configuration migration processes, and other UAT

readiness technical tasks.
  

* Perform data loads for UAT readiness and during UAT as requested by the UAT plan.
* Support resolution of UAT identified issues and their triage.
* Contribute to authoring the Implementation Operational Information and companion

spreadsheet for feeds.
  

* Perform configuration migration processes and other PROD readiness technical tasks.
* Perform data loads for PROD readiness.
* Perform all job functions consistent with HealthEdge policies and procedures, including

those which govern handling PHI and PII.
  
Backend Requirements:
  

* Minimum of 6 years of development experience in Java/J2EE technologies.
* Hands-on experience with XML, Web Services (SOAP, WSDL, etc.), JMS, Spring and SQL.
* Experience in complex data analysis, data migrations, and system integration of

software products into complex IT environments.
  

* Experience in writing/understanding quality database queries or stored procedures that

are reliable, scalable, and reusable.
  

* Development experience on the Linux operating system and WebLogic Application

Server.
  

* Experience working with integration middleware or enterprise system bus (ESB)

technologies such as iWay, Spring, or Apache Camel and OSGI containers like Apache
  
Karaf.
  

* Experience with Design Patterns and Enterprise Integration Patterns, including file

transfers, messaging, routing, transforming, enriching, etc.
  

* Experience with source control software (Bitbucket), unit testing (JUnit), and build

automation/CI (Jenkins).
  
Frontend Requirements:
  

* Proficiency in React.js and its core principles.
* Knowledge of React Hooks, Props, Redux, and Reducer framework.
* Experience with useQuery and useMutation APIs.
* Familiarity with Context API.
* Strong understanding of TypeScript.
* Knowledge of Kendo UI is a plus.

Other Details:
  

* BS/BA in CS or related field.
* Excellent analysis, consulting, and communication skills.
* Previous experience in customer-facing roles on professional services engagements.
* Experience in the health insurance industry (Payors) preferred.
* Experience with agile development methodology such as SCRUM or Kanban.
* Travel for this position is typically less than 10%.

title: Sr. Developer
description:
**Job Summary**

Sr Developer position for a global organization working on NICE ContactEngine NICE Engage and NICE Cxone platforms in a hybrid model. Role focuses on designing developing and optimizing contact center solutions that enhance customer experience. The position values automotive industry exposure and promotes inclusive collaborative problem solving.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and develop scalable configurations and integrations on NICE ContactEngine to automate customer communication journeys and improve interaction efficiency across multiple channels.
* Implement robust call recording and quality management solutions using NICE Engage to ensure compliant high quality customer interactions that align with regulatory and organizational standards.
* Configure and customize NICE Cxone components including routing flows reporting views and dashboards to optimize contact center performance and operational transparency.
* Collaborate with product owners business analysts and operations teams to translate user stories and functional needs into detailed technical designs and implementation tasks.
* Create reusable components scripts and configuration patterns that standardize solution delivery across projects and reduce future implementation effort.

* Coordinate and execute unit testing integration testing and user acceptance support to ensure that each release delivers stable and reliable functionality.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation for configurations integrations and support procedures so that knowledge is easily shared within the team and support functions.

* Employ good understanding of hybrid working practices including remote collaboration tools secure access methods and distributed team communication.
* Maintain awareness of contact center trends workforce engagement concepts and digital channel innovations to propose incremental enhancements over time.

title: AI Automation Developer
description:
About RSS AI Solutions

RSS AI Solutions is a UK-based business technology and automation company helping businesses improve their operations through artificial intelligence, data analytics, workflow automation, CRM systems and digital solutions.

We are expanding our AI automation services and looking for a skilled, creative and motivated AI Automation Developer based in India to join our growing team.

The successful candidate will help us design, develop, test and deploy AI-powered solutions for businesses across the UK.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and develop AI-powered automation workflows using n8n, Make, Zapier and similar tools.
* Build AI agents and chatbots for customer support, lead generation, enquiries and business operations.
* Integrate AI models and APIs, including OpenAI, into websites, CRM platforms and other business systems.
* Automate routine business processes such as email follow-ups, document collection, appointment scheduling and CRM updates.
* Develop custom integrations using Python, JavaScript, REST APIs and webhooks.
* Build and maintain automation workflows connecting tools such as Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, email systems and CRM software.
* Troubleshoot, test, monitor and improve automation reliability.
* Work with the RSS AI Solutions team to turn business requirements into practical AI solutions.
* Prepare basic technical documentation for completed projects.
* Assist in developing reusable AI automation products that can be deployed for multiple clients.

Required Skills

* Practical experience with **n8n workflow automation**.
* Good understanding of Python or JavaScript.
* Experience working with REST APIs, JSON and webhooks.
* Understanding of AI agents, chatbots, prompt engineering and LLM integrations.
* Ability to integrate third-party business applications.
* Basic knowledge of databases, CRM systems and workflow logic.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
* Good written English communication skills.

Preferred Skills (Not Mandatory)

* Experience with OpenAI API, LangChain or similar AI frameworks.
* Experience with WhatsApp Business API and AI customer-service solutions.
* Knowledge of Vtiger, Zoho, HubSpot or other CRM platforms.
* Familiarity with HTML, CSS, PHP or website integrations.
* Experience deploying applications to cloud hosting or VPS environments.
* Understanding of authentication, API security and responsible handling of customer data.
* Experience building AI-based SaaS products or internal business tools.

Projects You May Work On

You will help RSS AI Solutions develop solutions such as:

* **AI Customer Support Agents:** Chatbots that answer enquiries, collect lead information and escalate complicated cases.
* **AI CRM Automation:** Automated lead capture, follow-up reminders, document collection and sales pipeline updates.
* **Restaurant AI Solutions:** Order-enquiry automation, booking assistance and customer communication workflows.
* **Business Process Automation:** Automated emails, reporting, spreadsheet processing and operational tasks.
* **AI-Powered Business Tools:** Reusable automation systems and software products for UK businesses.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

* Can develop working automation solutions, not just demonstrate theoretical AI knowledge.
* Enjoys learning and experimenting with new AI technologies.
* Can independently investigate problems and propose practical solutions.
* Is reliable, organised and comfortable working remotely.
* Wants to grow with a developing UK-based technology company.

Benefits

* 100% remote work from India.
* Flexible part-time working arrangement.
* Opportunity to work on real UK business projects.
* Exposure to modern AI and automation technologies.
* Potential for increased responsibilities and a longer-term role based on performance.

Recruitment Process

Shortlisted applicants may be invited to:

* Attend an initial online interview.
* Demonstrate a previous n8n workflow, AI chatbot or automation project.
* Complete a short, clearly scoped practical technical assessment.
* Attend a final discussion regarding availability, responsibilities and compensation.

How to Apply

Please send your CV and examples of previous automation or AI projects to:

**info@rssaisolutions.co.uk**

**Email Subject:** Application – AI Automation Developer

In your application, briefly describe your experience with n8n, APIs, Python/JavaScript and AI integrations.

**Company:** RSS AI Solutions  
**Website:** https://rssaisolutions.co.uk

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - Web & iOS
description:
***Company Overview***  
*AutoRABIT is an enterprise platform for Salesforce DevSecOps that enables organizations to manage AI-accelerated Salesforce development with greater security, governance, visibility, and control. Its integrated product suite supports the complete Salesforce DevSecOps lifecycle through* ***AutoRABIT ARM*** *for CI/CD and release management,* ***CodeScan*** *for static code analysis and application security,* ***Vault*** *for data backup and recovery, and* ***Guard*** *for security posture management. The platform helps enterprises automate deployments, improve code quality, protect critical Salesforce data, monitor access risks, and strengthen compliance.* ***AutoRABIT official website***  
  
*Purpose-built for complex enterprise Salesforce environments, AutoRABIT helps development teams increase productivity, accelerate delivery, and innovate without compromising security or reliability. Its metadata-aware capabilities, scalable platform, flexible hosting options, and integrations provide organizations with the structure and control required to manage Salesforce changes across teams, environments, and global operations. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, AutoRABIT serves customers worldwide and offers employees the opportunity to contribute to products at the intersection of Salesforce, DevSecOps, security, governance, and AI-enabled development.* ***AutoRABIT platform overview***  
  
***Job Role***  
*AutoRABIT is hiring Senior Full Stack Engineers with demonstrated experience building both enterprise web applications and native iOS mobile applications.*  
  
*You will help develop a new product that automates the software delivery lifecycle for Salesforce teams. The platform connects customer Salesforce organizations, source control systems, and issue trackers to plan, build, validate, and deploy changes through a governed pipeline. AI agents perform delivery tasks within controls designed to ensure secure and reliable software releases.*  
  
*Our technology stack includes Java and Spring Boot backend services, an Angular and TypeScript web application, Python services supporting automation and AI agents, and native iOS mobile development.*  
  
***This is a true full stack engineering role requiring hands on experience across backend services, web applications, and iOS mobile development.*** *Candidates must be comfortable working across multiple technologies, writing production code, and using AI coding tools as part of their daily development workflow.*  
  
***Key Responsibilities***  
***Full Stack & Backend Development***

* *Design, build, test, and deploy features across backend services, web applications, and mobile experiences.*
* *Develop secure, scalable, multi tenant backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL.*
* *Build responsive, accessible web applications using Angular and TypeScript.*
* *Develop and maintain REST APIs that support web and mobile applications.*
* *Extend Python services supporting delivery automation and AI powered workflows.*
* *Design and evolve APIs using OpenAPI specifications and generated client integrations.*
* *Ensure security, performance, reliability, and tenant data isolation across the platform.*

***iOS Mobile Development***

* *Design, develop, and maintain native iOS applications using Swift and modern iOS development frameworks.*
* *Build intuitive, responsive, and reliable mobile experiences that integrate with AutoRABIT's backend services.*
* *Develop mobile interfaces using SwiftUI and established iOS architecture patterns.*
* *Integrate iOS applications with REST APIs, authentication services, and enterprise systems.*
* *Implement secure mobile authentication, session management, and data handling.*
* *Troubleshoot mobile application performance, compatibility, and reliability issues.*
* *Participate in mobile testing, debugging, deployment, and App Store release processes.*
* *Ensure consistency and functionality across web and mobile user experiences.*

***AI & Automation***

* *Contribute to AI powered automation supporting software development and delivery workflows.*
* *Work with Python services and AI agent integrations that automate development tasks.*
* *Use AI assisted coding tools to improve productivity while maintaining engineering quality.*
* *Evaluate AI generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.*
* *Collaborate with Engineering and Product teams to identify AI enabled product opportunities.*

***Engineering Quality & Collaboration***

* *Build integrations with Salesforce, GitHub, Bitbucket, Jira, Slack, and other enterprise platforms.*
* *Implement secure authentication, authorization, encryption, and credential management.*
* *Develop and maintain automated unit, integration, and end to end tests.*
* *Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, Docker based builds, and AWS deployments.*
* *Troubleshoot production issues across backend, web, and mobile applications.*
* *Participate in code reviews and maintain engineering standards.*
* *Maintain technical documentation and collaborate with Product, Engineering, QA, and DevOps teams.*
* *Follow established security, compliance, and software development practices*

***Responsibility to adhere to set internal controls.***  
  
***Pride of Ownership***  
*We value pride of ownership. Understand the customer, the product and the market need; form a clear, evidence-based opinion about how the product can improve; and work with others to turn that opinion into results. Strong coding skills and effective use of AI matter, but accountability continues after a feature is shipped. Be willing to challenge assumptions, listen to feedback and change your view when the evidence changes.*  
  
***Experience & Desired Skills***  
***Required Skills (Mandatory)***

* *5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production applications.*
* ***Demonstrated professional experience developing and releasing native iOS mobile applications.***
* ***Strong hands on experience with Swift, SwiftUI, Xcode, and the iOS development lifecycle.***
* *Experience integrating mobile applications with REST APIs, authentication systems, and backend services.*
* *Strong Java development experience using Spring Boot, Spring Security, REST APIs, and modern enterprise development practices.*
* *Strong Angular and TypeScript experience building modern web applications.*
* *Working proficiency in Python, including maintaining and extending existing Python services.*

* *Strong understanding of PostgreSQL, database design, migrations, indexing, and query optimization.*
* *Experience designing and integrating REST APIs using OpenAPI specifications.*

* *Experience with automated testing across backend, web, and mobile applications.*
* *Familiarity with Docker, AWS cloud services, and CI/CD pipelines.*

* ***Hands on experience using AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor as part of regular software development.***
* *Experience working in Agile or Scrum development environments.*
* *Strong problem solving, communication, and collaboration skills.*
* *Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.*

***Preferred Skills (Good to Have)***

* *Experience developing software within the Salesforce ecosystem.*

* *Experience with UIKit alongside SwiftUI.*

* *Experience with AI and LLM engineering, including agent frameworks, API integrations, tool use, Model Context Protocol, or prompt engineering.*
* *Experience developing applications in highly regulated or security sensitive environments.*

***Why join AutoRABIT***  
*This is an opportunity to help build an innovative enterprise software platform that combines modern web technologies, native mobile development, and AI powered automation.*  
  
*You'll work across the full technology stack, contribute to meaningful product decisions, and help deliver secure, scalable applications that improve how enterprise Salesforce teams develop and release software.*  
  
*We're looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex technical challenges, embrace AI as a practical development tool, and are excited to build exceptional software across web and mobile platforms.*

title: Principal Data Scientist
description:
**Overview**
**Overview**
Does the challenge of scaling a fast-growing company with the latest in data science and AI methodologies and tooling excite you?
  
  
Using your business instincts and creativity, you will leverage your business, data science, analytics and AI acumen to support a highly strategic, mission-critical initiative for Service Collection. If you love blazing new innovative trails, making the complex simple and driving decision-making speed across business units with data insights, then read on!
  
  
Atlassian is looking for a Principal Data Scientist to be the wizard who will uncover valuable insights from large amounts of data which will help the business improve our products. We're looking for someone with superb business instincts, comfort with executive stakeholders, proficiency in statistical analyses, expertise in AI/LLM, experience partnering with cross-functional teams and mentoring junior data scientists.
  
  
**Working at Atlassian**
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities**

* Influence strategy & important decisions around Service Collection by blending end-to-end business acumen with advanced data science methodologies
* Define, set and report on department level KRs to the Service Collection R&D team
* Build and implement measurement frameworks, machine learning models and other tooling leveraging various data science methods to accelerate Atlassian’s growth and influence our product roadmap.
* Envision, scope, and lead high impact projects by collaborating with Engineering, Product Management and Design, Data Engineering and Research and Insights teams.
* Foster a world-class Data Science culture by leading training on technical concepts, driving continuous learning and mentoring Data Scientists on the team

**Compensation**
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Experience applying your Data Science skills to identify and lead projects which have had impact on business strategy and performance
* 9+ years of experience in Data Science or related fields. (Preferred - 10+ years experience with a post-graduate degree in a quantitative discipline like Statistics, Mathematics, Econometrics, Computer science)
* Expertise in applying a broad variety of ML methods including LLM to solve business problems and a strong sense of when to apply them to the problem at hand

At ADI you will work alongside the brightest minds to collaborate on solving complex problems that matter from autonomous vehicles, drones and factories to augmented reality and remote healthcare.
  
  
ADI fosters a culture that focuses on employees through beneficial programs, aligned goals, continuous learning opportunities, and practices that create a more sustainable future.
  
  
**About Analog Devices**
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
**Associate Industrial Engineer (P1)**
**Job Description Summary**
Analog Devices is seeking an Associate Industrial Engineer to join the Central Industrial Engineering team. This early-career role will support factory performance improvement initiatives across multiple wafer fabrication sites through capacity modeling, data analytics, reporting automation, cycle time reduction, and scheduling optimization. Working alongside experienced Industrial Engineers at local facilities, this position will contribute to the development of cross-site analytical tools and decision-support systems that maximize factory output and enable future expansion planning.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support development and maintenance of cross-site capacity models, factory loadings, and utilization analyses.
* Assist with cycle time improvement initiatives through bottleneck analysis, WIP management, and line balancing activities.
* Analyze factory performance data and identify opportunities to increase throughput, productivity, and equipment utilization.
* Develop and automate reports, dashboards, and analytical tools using SQL, Python, Power BI, and other business intelligence tools.
* Support validation of manufacturing scheduling data, forecasting models, and factory planning assumptions.
* Participate in scenario analysis and what-if modeling to evaluate capacity, output, and resource requirements.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, IT, and Equipment Engineering to support improvement projects.
* Document methodologies, analytical models, and standard work processes.
* Present findings and recommendations to technical and operations teams.
* Build knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing systems, Industrial Engineering methodologies, and factory scheduling concepts.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Systems Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Data Analytics, or related engineering discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Internship, co-op, or academic project experience in manufacturing, operations research, data analytics, or process optimization.
* Familiarity with SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytical tools.
* Coursework in statistics, simulation, optimization, data science, or manufacturing systems.
* Exposure to semiconductor manufacturing or other high-volume manufacturing environments.

**Work Experience**

* 0–2 years of Industrial Engineering or analytical experience.
* Demonstrated ability to work with large datasets and perform quantitative analysis.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively within geographically distributed teams.

*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. description:
**Description**
Are you passionate about applying machine learning and advanced statistical techniques to protect one of the world's largest online marketplaces? Do you want to be at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that improve Amazon's customers experience? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where diverse perspectives drive breakthrough solutions?
  
  
If yes, we invite you to join the Amazon Customer Fulfillment & Prime analytics team. We're seeking an exceptional scientist who can revolutionize how we delight our customers. As a key member of our team, you'll develop and deploy machine learning systems that analyze millions of customer interactions daily, ensuring state of art experience for customers across 10 countries. Your work will directly impact the shopping experience for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Ability to work independently across the end-to-end ML lifecycle: feature engineering, modeling, and MLOps to productionize models.
* Strong foundation in machine learning and statistical modeling.
* Experience deploying ML solutions into a production environment.
* Apply machine learning and statistical techniques to create scalable abuse-detection solutions that identify fraudulent customer behavior, rings of accounts, identity change, holistic customer risk, and marketplace manipulation schemes.
* Innovate with the latest GenAI technology to build highly automated solutions for efficient customer promotions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop comprehensive ML/statistical models that scale to millions of customers across 10+ countries.
* Willing to travel to Mexico (MX) and Brazil (BR).

You'll be working closely with business partners, science and engineering teams to create end-to-end scalable machine learning solutions that address real-world problems. You will build scalable, efficient, and automated processes for large-scale data analyses, model development, model validation, and model implementation.

* 6+ years of machine learning/statistical modeling data analysis tools and techniques, and parameters that affect their performance experience

* Master's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM), or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)

* Knowledge of machine learning concepts and their application to reasoning and problem-solving
* Experience in Python, Perl, or another scripting language
* Experience in a ML or data scientist role with a large technology company
* Experience in defining and creating benchmarks for assessing GenAI model performance
* Experience working on multi-team, cross-disciplinary projects
* Experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data-driven business decisions
* Experience effectively communicating complex concepts through written and verbal communication

title: BC Sector O and G-Data Scientist-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS | PRINCIPAL DATA SCIENTIST**
**Oil & Gas | Senior Manager**
**Job Title Principal Data Scientist – Senior Manager**
**Experience Level 15+ Years**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Principal Data Scientist to solve complex modelling problems across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas. You will formulate operational challenges, establish defensible scientific approaches, develop critical modelling components, and define the evidence required for reliable deployment across wells, fields, equipment, process units, and sites.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include**
:
  
  
**Scientific formulation and advanced modelling**

* Formulate operational problems as predictive, diagnostic, causal, or prescriptive tasks, defining targets, objective functions, constraints, decision variables, acceptance criteria, and evaluation methods.
* Assess data sufficiency, measurement quality, sampling bias, confounding, identifiability, and operating coverage to determine whether available evidence supports the intended outcome.
* Select statistical, machine learning, simulation, or hybrid approaches suited to noisy measurements, heterogeneous assets, sparse labels, rare events, censored histories, and distribution shifts.
* Apply probabilistic or hierarchical modelling, uncertainty quantification, survival analysis, semi-supervised learning, transfer learning, or domain adaptation where appropriate.
* Develop methods for multivariate forecasting, state estimation, change detection, degradation modelling, and industrial time-series analysis while distinguishing process dynamics from measurement artefacts.
* Combine learned models with engineering equations, mass and energy balances, simulation outputs, or physical constraints, evaluating accuracy, plausibility, extrapolation behaviour, and uncertainty propagation.
* Connect predictions with constrained optimization, assessing feasibility, sensitivity, robustness, and decision quality under uncertainty; design experiments or causal analyses when observational evidence is insufficient.

**Upstream applications**

* Define modelling approaches for production forecasting, well surveillance, artificial-lift performance, drilling analytics, and production-system optimization.
* Separate the effects of reservoir behaviour, operating constraints, equipment condition, interventions, formation changes, and operating practices when interpreting performance.
* Collaborate with reservoir engineers and geoscientists on property prediction, uncertainty analysis, and simulation-assisted modelling.
* Determine whether models can transfer between wells or fields and define the data, recalibration, adaptation, and validation required.

**Downstream applications**

* Define modelling approaches for product-quality prediction, yield modelling, equipment degradation, blending, and process or energy optimization.
* Account for feedstock composition, throughput, catalyst age, equipment condition, process configuration, and control-system behaviour.
* Combine data-driven methods with engineering relationships, process simulations, and mass and energy balances.
* Connect predictive models with operating, planning, blending, or optimization workflows within defined physical and operational constraints, validating across feedstock changes, campaigns, grades, and configurations.

**Model assurance and generalization**

* Establish standards for baselining, benchmarking, feature-ablation studies, calibration, sensitivity analysis, robustness, and out-of-distribution evaluation.
* Challenge apparent improvements caused by leakage, weak baselines, inappropriate metrics, selective testing, or inadequate engineering interpretation.
* Distinguish models that reproduce historical associations from models capable of evaluating proposed operating changes.
* Define applicability limits, uncertainty treatment, monitoring requirements, fallback behaviour, and recalibration or retraining criteria.
* Assess predictive performance separately from recommendation feasibility and quality, and establish adaptation and validation strategies across assets, sites, configurations, and operating regimes.

**Technical leadership and scalable delivery**

* Remain hands-on in experiments, model development, prototyping, and troubleshooting.
* Resolve failures across data preparation, measurement quality, engineering assumptions, model formulation, software implementation, and production behaviour.
* Develop reusable modelling components, adaptation strategies, technical standards, and reference implementations; design reproducible experiments whose conclusions can be reviewed and defended.
* Evaluate emerging techniques through controlled comparisons with established methods and review production implementations for consistency with the intended scientific approach.
* Conduct scientific reviews, challenge modelling decisions, mentor Lead Data Scientists, and collaborate with engineering, data, ML engineering, and product teams to integrate validated models into operational workflows.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A degree in a relevant engineering, scientific, or quantitative discipline.
* Substantial hands-on experience developing and deploying Oil & Gas analytical solutions.
* Deep expertise in at least one upstream or downstream area, with working knowledge across both segments.
* Advanced expertise in at least one relevant applied modelling specialization.
* Strong foundations in statistics, machine learning, mathematical modelling, industrial time series, scientific computing, experimental design, and uncertainty assessment.
* Strong Python and SQL skills, including scientific prototyping, implementation of critical modelling components, and review of production code.
* Experience integrating engineering knowledge into model formulation and validation, together with reproducible experimentation, production ML, model generalization, and deployment across varied operating conditions.
* Evidence of personally resolving a difficult methodological problem and establishing an approach adopted by others.
* Experience conducting technical reviews and guiding multidisciplinary data science teams.
* Ability to defend technical decisions using quantitative evidence and clearly communicate assumptions, trade-offs, limitations, and operational implications.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience across both upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A master’s degree, PhD, or relevant applied research experience.

* Deep hands-on experience with real-world ML projects, either through academic research, internships, or industry roles.

title: Staff Engineer- Applied AI
description:
**About The Role**
AI is not a feature in Foundry - it is the operating model. AI-assisted coding and product management is baked into how the team works, and AI-assisted solutioning is baked into what we ship: LLM-based data ingestion that auto-fills the Sizer from unstructured customer files, a constraint-solver recommendation engine that suggests robot configurations, semantic search over historical sizing sheets, and a Copilot that guides users through the solutioning journey. As the Staff Engineer, Applied AI you own all of this. You run the Applied AI capability as a chapter across all Foundry squads- setting the patterns, evaluation frameworks and API contracts that each squad implements rather than centralising all AI work in one team. You are expected to be the most technically credible AI engineer in the organisation, influencing architecture decisions across squads and setting the standard for how AI features are built, measured and shipped.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build and own the recommendation engine - Design and implement the ML pipeline that recommends solution type (technology, layout, configuration) from customer inputs; own the feature store, training pipeline, model registry and serving layer.
* Build the constraint-solver intelligence - Implement the AI layer on top of the constraint solver: learned priors for solver warm-starts, anomaly detection for unusual input combinations, and automated sensitivity analysis.
* Build LLM-based data ingestion- Design the production pipeline that takes unstructured customer documents (PDFs, spreadsheets, emails) and extracts structured Sizer inputs using LLMs; handle uncertainty, partial extractions and human-in-the-loop review.
* Build the formulator engine and vector DB- Implement semantic search over historical sizing solutions and L1 data sheets; design the embedding pipeline, vector database and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) layer.
* Define AI chapter patterns- Set the shared patterns that all squads adopt: LLM API integration (streaming, function calling, structured output), prompt engineering standards, evaluation harnesses and A/B experiment frameworks for AI features.
* Build the AI evaluation framework- Implement offline and online evaluation for every AI feature: golden-set benchmarks, production-shadow evaluation, A/B experiment readout tooling and regression detection.
* Own the AI API contracts- Design the internal API contracts between the AI squad and consuming squads (Sizer, Layout, GCM); version them, document them and enforce them via contract tests.
* Mentor and grow AI capability- Pair with and review engineers across squads who are implementing AI features; run the Applied AI chapter meetings; grow the team's collective AI engineering capability.

**Minimum (required) Qualifications**

* 10–15 years professional engineering; at least 4 years in applied ML / LLM productionisation.
* Deep experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source): function calling, structured output, streaming, embeddings.
* Production RAG system experience: chunking strategies, embedding models, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector), retrieval evaluation.
* Experience building and deploying recommendation systems or ranking models.
* Strong software engineering foundations: API design, observability, testing, CI/CD.
* Track record of cross-team technical influence: setting patterns others adopt.
* Experience with ML experiment tracking and model-lifecycle management.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with optimisation / operations-research methods used in conjunction with ML (hybrid AI + OR solvers).
* Experience with agentic AI systems: tool-use, ReAct, AutoGen, LangGraph or similar.
* Domain experience in warehousing, logistics or industrial automation.
* Experience with online A/B experimentation for AI features (including metric design).
* Familiarity with structured-extraction frameworks (Instructor, Outlines, Marvin).
* Experience with feature stores (Feast, Tecton) and ML platforms (MLflow, Vertex AI).
* Prior Staff-level or principal-equivalent scope at a technology company.

**Technical Qualifications**
*We expect you to be proficient in or quickly learn the following. Senior roles (Band E+) are expected to be experts; Band C/D roles are expected to have working knowledge.*

* LLM stack: OpenAI / Anthropic API; LangChain / LlamaIndex / LangGraph for orchestration; structured output parsing (Instructor / Pydantic).
* RAG: chunking and indexing pipelines; embedding models (text-embedding-3, Cohere, BGE); vector stores (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone); hybrid search (dense + BM25).
* ML: scikit-learn, XGBoost for classical recommendation; PyTorch / HuggingFace for fine-tuning and inference; MLflow or Vertex AI for experiment tracking.
* Evaluation: RAGAS, TruLens, or custom harnesses; LLM-as-judge pipelines; A/B frameworks integrated with analytics (e.g. Mixpanel).
* Languages: Python (primary); Java or Go for production service wrappers.
* APIs: REST (FastAPI or Flask); gRPC for high-throughput internal calls; SSE / WebSocket for streamed LLM responses.
* Infrastructure: GCP (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, GCS, Pub/Sub); Docker, Kubernetes; Terraform.
* Observability: LLM call logging (token counts, latency, cost); Prometheus metrics; Grafana dashboards; structured logging with trace IDs.
* Testing: unit tests for extraction logic; golden-set regression tests; integration tests with mocked LLM responses.
* Tooling: GitHub monorepo, GitHub Actions CI, Backstage.

**How We Work**
You are the single senior AI voice across Foundry. You lead the Applied AI chapter- short, weekly craft syncs with engineers across squads who are implementing AI features and you own the AI API contracts that every squad consumes. You report directly to the Senior Director and participate in the weekly squad-of-squads sync. You are expected to influence decisions at the architecture level, not just the implementation level.

title: Member of Technical Staff
description:
**About the Company**

Grey Machines is a decision intelligence platform: it lets you simulate a strategic decision before you make it. You ask a "what if" question in plain language, and the system builds a working model of that world from scratch, with its actors, feedback loops and delays, grounded in real data and cited evidence. It then plays out thousands of possible futures and shows the range of outcomes, what drives them, and a brief in which every number traces back to its source, in hours rather than the weeks a strategy team would take. It is built for strategy teams, investors and policy makers.

**The Problem**

Take a question like "What happens to nickel markets if Indonesia bans ore exports?" or "What does a US-Iran escalation do to oil and LNG?" Answering it well usually takes weeks: a strategy team, a financial model, expert calls and a deck.

Grey Machines answers it in hours. From one plain-language question, the system builds a model of that world from scratch: the actors, the stocks and flows, the feedback loops and the delays. It grounds the starting values in real data and cited evidence, then runs thousands of Monte Carlo futures, with convergence checks deciding when to stop. What comes back is an interactive causal loop diagram, the range of outcomes, and a written brief in which every number traces back to where it came from.

It works end to end and is in private beta. Now it has to be correct, fast and reliable at scale. That is the job.

**What You Will Build**

You will be the first engineer and the most senior technical person in the room, so the scope is all of engineering. You will make the architecture calls every later engineer builds on, and own the consequences.

- The simulation core: the ODE solver, the Monte Carlo engine, sensitivity analysis, and the convergence and health checks that decide when a result can be trusted

- The model-building pipeline: frontier LLMs build the model in stages, and deterministic validators and repair loops check every step. The real work is deciding what the LLM can be trusted with, what code has to verify, and how to fail safely.

- The data and evidence layer: values from sources such as FRED, the academic literature, the web and the documents users bring, with units, ranges and provenance that survive end to end

- The execution layer: long Monte Carlo jobs are checkpointed and resume after a restart, today on one machine. Next they need to be scheduled and run in parallel across many.

- Production: AWS, deploys, monitoring, tracing and incident response

- The frontend when it needs you: a React 19 app with Canvas 2D and D3 visualisations that make dense quantitative output readable for a strategist, not just a quant

- The engineering bar: testing, review and release discipline, and hiring the team that comes after you

**Who You Are**

- You have built systems from zero, not just shipped features into existing ones, and lived with your own architecture decisions, including the wrong ones.

- You are fluent in Bayesian probability and statistics, stochastic processes and numerical methods: ODEs, Monte Carlo and convergence diagnostics. A PhD is not required. Being able to reason about what the numbers mean is.

- You write production code fast, debug carefully and care when it is wrong. Production experience with Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL and React is required: the codebase is built on them.

- You have run LLMs in production: structured output, prompt caching, multi-stage pipelines and the failure modes that only show up there.

- You write clearly. We work remotely and asynchronously, so your design docs and code reviews are how you work.

**Strong Signals**

None of these is required. They are backgrounds that tend to fit.

- A year or two at a quantitative trading firm (Jane Street, Hudson River Trading, Tower Research, Graviton or similar)

- Your own startup, including one that did not work out. We care about what you learned.

- A maths, CS, physics or statistics degree from a school these firms hire from

- Multi-tenant SaaS or high-throughput compute pipelines

- CTO, Staff or Principal Engineer experience at an early-stage company

**What It Is Honestly Like**

We are an early-stage startup, and we would rather say so up front.

- Priorities move. Something you build this month may be thrown away next month because we learned something.

- There is no team behind you yet. You will check your own blind spots and make calls with incomplete information.

- Some weeks will feel like a drawdown. We want someone who stays steady through the good weeks and the bad ones, and treats uncertainty as part of the job.

In return you get real ownership, founder-level say in the product and the company, and a genuinely hard applied-maths problem. Fully remote, flexible hours.

Put in place monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, testing, CI/CD, rollback and resiliency mechanisms that keep AI systems healthy at scale.

**Python**
: Strong, production-grade Python: clean code, testing, APIs and integration with enterprise systems.

 Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems on Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore, including prompt engineering, tool calling and agent orchestration with a framework (e.g. Strands Agents, LangGraph, LangChain).

**RAG & retrieval**
: Building retrieval pipelines: embeddings, chunking and vector search (e.g. Bedrock Knowledge Bases, OpenSearch, pgvector).
