title: Principal Engineer
description:
***Company Overview***  
*AutoRABIT is an enterprise platform for Salesforce DevSecOps that enables organizations to manage AI-accelerated Salesforce development with greater security, governance, visibility, and control. Its integrated product suite supports the complete Salesforce DevSecOps lifecycle through* ***AutoRABIT ARM*** *for CI/CD and release management,* ***CodeScan*** *for static code analysis and application security,* ***Vault*** *for data backup and recovery, and* ***Guard*** *for security posture management. The platform helps enterprises automate deployments, improve code quality, protect critical Salesforce data, monitor access risks, and strengthen compliance.* ***AutoRABIT official website***  
  
*Purpose-built for complex enterprise Salesforce environments, AutoRABIT helps development teams increase productivity, accelerate delivery, and innovate without compromising security or reliability. Its metadata-aware capabilities, scalable platform, flexible hosting options, and integrations provide organizations with the structure and control required to manage Salesforce changes across teams, environments, and global operations. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, AutoRABIT serves customers worldwide and offers employees the opportunity to contribute to products at the intersection of Salesforce, DevSecOps, security, governance, and AI-enabled development.* ***AutoRABIT platform overview***  
  
***Job Role***  
*Own the technical direction and delivery outcomes of a major product area or substantial cross-team initiative. This is a hands-on individual contributor role combining deep engineering ability with customer understanding and product judgment. You will shape solutions with Product and Engineering, implement critical components and remain accountable for how they perform after release.*  
  
***Key Responsibilities***

* ***Product and technical direction.*** *Understand customer workflows, adoption barriers and relevant market alternatives with Product and customer-facing teams. Develop evidence-based recommendations on what to improve, simplify or avoid building. Translate agreed priorities into architecture, delivery increments and measurable outcomes.*
* ***Hands-on delivery.*** *Lead design, coding, review, testing and rollout of complex Java services and platform capabilities. Build critical components and reference implementations. Make trade-offs explicit and help teams deliver secure, maintainable software rather than leaving execution at the design stage.*
* ***Production AI judgment.*** *Develop AI-enabled capabilities where they offer meaningful customer value. Define evaluation cases, security boundaries, human approvals where needed, failure handling and acceptable cost and latency. Select conventional engineering approaches when they solve the problem more reliably.*
* ***Reliability and modernisation.*** *Improve performance, scalability, observability, security and tenant isolation within the assigned scope. Address technical debt through staged investments linked to customer or delivery impact. Resolve systemic causes of production problems and improve prevention.*
* ***Cross-team influence.*** *Align interfaces, dependencies and engineering practices across participating teams. Mentor senior engineers and explain decisions clearly. Partner with Product on priorities, Engineering Managers on delivery capacity and the Distinguished Engineer or CTO on company-wide architecture. Document decision ownership and escalate unresolved cross-product trade-offs.*
* *Responsibility to adhere to set internal controls.*

***Pride of Ownership***  
*We value pride of ownership. Understand the customer, the product and the market need; form a clear, evidence-based opinion about how the product can improve; and work with others to turn that opinion into results. Strong coding skills and effective use of AI matter, but accountability continues after a feature is shipped. Be willing to challenge assumptions, listen to feedback and change your view when the evidence changes.*  
  
***Experience & Desired Skills***  
***Required Skills (Mandatory)***

* *12+ years delivering enterprise software, with demonstrated Principal-level ownership of significant initiatives; scope and outcomes carry more weight than tenure alone.*
* *Deep hands-on Java, Spring Boot, API, microservices and distributed-systems expertise.*
* *Strong enterprise SaaS engineering experience, including security, performance and operational reliability.*
* *Practical AWS or Azure architecture, containers, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD experience.*
* *Experience delivering AI-enabled software or developer productivity capabilities into production and evaluating their effectiveness.*
* *Practical familiarity with relevant AI approaches such as LLMs, RAG, agents or MCP; sound engineering judgment matters more than a particular framework.*
* *Evidence of influencing product decisions, leading cross-team implementation and mentoring senior contributors.*
* *Clear communication with technical and business stakeholders across regions.*

***Preferred Skills (Good to Have)***

* *Salesforce metadata, APIs or release workflows; DevSecOps, CI/CD, data protection or developer-tool products.*
* *Modernisation of complex enterprise platforms and work in regulated or security-sensitive settings.*
* *Significant proprietary product achievements, open-source contributions, publications or patents demonstrating technical influence.*

***What success looks like***

* *Within 90 days, understand the assigned product area, agree outcome measures and identify its most consequential technical constraints.*
* *Within six months, deliver agreed milestones for a substantial initiative and demonstrate improvement against its baseline.*
* *Build durable capability in the team through reusable components, documented decisions and mentoring.*

***Why join AutoRABIT***  
*You will shape important product decisions while remaining close to implementation. This role offers ownership of meaningful customer outcomes and the opportunity to strengthen the technical foundations of AutoRABIT products.*  
  
***Experience:*** *12+ Years*  
***Compensation:*** *75 - 90 Lakhs per annum*  
***Location:*** *Hyderabad*  
***Work Mode:*** *Hybrid - 3 days Work from Office*  
***Work Timings****: IST timings - General Flexible Shift*

***Location:*** *Hyderabad*

title: Quantitative Researcher(unpaid)
description:
**Role:**
Quantitative Researcher (Contract)

**Company:**
Meridian Capital

**Location:**
100% Remote (India)

**Format:**
3-Month Live Project

**About Meridian Capital**

Meridian Capital is a proprietary algorithmic trading firm actively operating in the Indian stock market. We execute our strategies through a fully automated, end-to-end systematic trading platform designed to identify and exploit market inefficiencies with zero manual intervention required for trade execution.

**The Role & Challenge**

We are seeking a sharp, highly analytical, and results-driven Quantitative Researcher for a specialized 3-month contract. Your primary objective will be to audit, stress-test, and extensively optimize the mathematical and logical foundation of our current trading algorithm to maximize our market edge.

This engagement is strictly performance-oriented and structured around two core phases:

* **Phase 1 (The 2-Week Sprint):**
  Within the first 14 days of engagement, evaluate our existing quantitative logic and deliver at least one profitable, mathematically robust model that we can immediately deploy into live trading environments.
* **Phase 2 (Ongoing Optimization):**
  For the remainder of the 3-month contract, shift focus toward developing advanced quantitative metrics, refining statistical models, and continuously optimizing the system for peak performance and risk mitigation.

**Target Performance Metrics**

Optimization efforts must be engineered to achieve or exceed the following benchmarks:

* **Sharpe Ratio:**
  > 1.5
* **Sortino Ratio:**
  > 1.8
* **Win Rate:**
  45% or greater
* **Monthly Return:**
  Minimum 5% consistent growth

**Compensation & Profit Sharing**

This role is highly leveraged toward performance, rewarding the specific alpha you generate directly.

* **Fixed Stipend:**
  ₹5,000 per month (paid upon initial verification of a profitable, working algorithm).
* **Performance Share (30%):**
  You will receive 30% of all trading profits generated by the firm. This profit share activates the moment your quantitative logic is deployed in our live algorithm and remains in effect for the entire duration of your engagement with Meridian Capital.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* Strong academic foundation in Mathematics, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, Computer Science, or a heavily quantitative engineering discipline.
* Proven, hands-on experience in statistical modeling, backtesting frameworks, and algorithmic trading logic.
* Deep, intuitive understanding of risk-adjusted return metrics (e.g., Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, Maximum Drawdown).
* Ability to rapidly prototype, stress-test, and deploy mathematical logic tailored for financial markets under tight deadlines.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian stock market dynamics, market micro-structure, and historical market data handling.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proficiency in Python, R, or C++ for extensive quantitative analysis and data manipulation.
* Prior experience building, auditing, or optimizing end-to-end systematic trading strategies from scratch.
* A pragmatic, objective mindset that prioritizes live-market applicability and robust execution over theoretical perfection.

As part of its technology development strategy, Roofsol Energy intends to establish its own end-to-end solar monitoring ecosystem, including proprietary data loggers, IoT-based data acquisition systems, cloud infrastructure, and a centralized solar generation monitoring platform. The objective is to develop and own the underlying technology and Intellectual Property (IP), while ensuring reliable monitoring and management of a large portfolio of distributed solar projects across India.

**Role Overview**

Roofsol Energy is looking for an experienced technology professional to lead the conceptualization, design, development, deployment, and maintenance of an in-house solar data logging and generation monitoring system.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Strategy and Technology Development**

·      Define the technology roadmap for Roofsol Energy’s proprietary solar monitoring and data acquisition ecosystem.

·      Lead the end-to-end development of the monitoring platform, from product architecture and prototype development to commercial deployment.

·      Evaluate appropriate hardware, communication protocols, software frameworks, cloud technologies, and system architectures.

·      Develop solutions suitable for both small rooftop solar installations and large distributed solar portfolios.

**2. Data Logger and IoT Hardware Development**

·      Lead the design, development, prototyping, testing, and deployment of in-house solar data logging equipment.

·      Develop expertise in integrating inverters, energy meters, weather sensors, and other plant equipment using protocols such as Modbus RTU/TCP, RS485, Ethernet, and MQTT, as applicable.

·      Ensure reliable data acquisition, local buffering, time synchronization, remote configuration, and recovery during network or power outages.

·      Establish hardware validation, field testing, quality assurance, and lifecycle management processes.

**3. Cloud Platform and Software Development**

·      Lead the architecture and development of a centralized cloud-based solar monitoring platform.

·      Establish scalable infrastructure for collecting, processing, storing, and analyzing data from hundreds of geographically distributed solar installations.

·      Oversee the development of dashboards, plant-level monitoring screens, portfolio-level reporting, alerts, notifications, and automated performance reports.

·      Ensure integration with existing business systems, maintenance workflows, and third-party equipment where required.

·      Establish high availability, disaster recovery, backup, cybersecurity, and system performance standards.

**4. Solar Generation Monitoring and Analytics**

·      Develop real-time and historical solar generation monitoring capabilities.

·      Establish monitoring of energy generation, plant availability, equipment health, communication failures, and performance deviations.

·      Enable automated alerts for generation losses, inverter faults, abnormal operating conditions, and data gaps.

·      Support performance analysis through relevant metrics such as specific yield, Performance Ratio (PR), plant availability, and actual-versus-expected generation, where applicable.

**5. Intellectual Property and Technology Ownership**

·      Build and maintain Roofsol Energy’s proprietary technology stack, including hardware designs, firmware, software source code, system architecture, technical documentation, and associated IP.

·      Establish appropriate IP ownership, confidentiality, source-code control, licensing, and third-party technology compliance practices.

**6. Team Leadership and Vendor Management**

·      Build and lead a multidisciplinary team covering embedded systems, electronics, firmware, IoT, cloud engineering, software development, and data analytics.

·      Evaluate and manage technology vendors, hardware manufacturers, system integrators, and development partners.

**Candidate Profile**

·      Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics & Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, IoT, or a related technical discipline.

·      Approximately 10 years of relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, industrial data acquisition, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, or related technology domains.

·      Demonstrated experience in developing and deploying connected hardware and software products, preferably from concept through production and field deployment.

·      Experience with cloud infrastructure, databases, APIs, cybersecurity, remote device management, and scalable system architecture.

·      Knowledge of solar PV systems, inverter communications, energy meters, generation monitoring, and renewable energy analytics will be highly advantageous.

**Why Join Roofsol Energy?**

This is an opportunity to establish a proprietary technology platform from the ground up and take ownership of a strategic digital initiative within the renewable energy sector. The selected professional will have the opportunity to shape the company’s technology roadmap, develop in-house IP, and build a scalable monitoring ecosystem supporting a growing portfolio of solar assets across India.

**Interested candidates may share their updated CV highlighting relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, and technology ownership.**

title: Right Shore, Revenue Planning Analyst
description:
**Right Shore Revenue Planning Analyst**
Full Time | Hybrid
  
  
Location: Airoli, Navi Mumbai, India | Pune, Maharashtra, India
  
  
Team: Right Shore Sales Operations
  
  
Reports to: Right Shore Sales Operations Team Leader
  
  
Dotted line to: Manager, Revenue Planning Programs & Strategy
  
  
**Our Company**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As Right Shore Revenue Planning Analyst, you are the dedicated data owner for Teradata’s revenue planning process. You sit within the Right Shore Sales Operations team and work day to day with the Manager, Revenue Planning Programs & Strategy to run the data engine behind the annual planning cycle and the year-round change process that keeps the plan accurate.
  
  
This is a data management and processing role. You build and manage the planning templates, consolidate and reconcile submissions from across the business units, keep account and assignment data clean, and take real ownership of the final business build files that hand off into Salesforce, downstream tools and IT processes. You are the last set of eyes before planning data leaves the process — accuracy is the job.
  
  
The planning calendar moves, priorities shift, and questions arrive without warning. This role suits someone who adapts quickly, can go deep into the detail of the planning process when something does not reconcile, and takes personal pride in a clean file.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the final business build files: Assemble, validate and own the definitive build files for territory, account assignment, headcount and quota that feed Salesforce, downstream tools and IT processes. Run the pre-handoff checks, resolve exceptions, and sign off on what goes out.
* Build and manage planning templates: Develop, version, distribute and support the planning templates used by business unit teams; track submissions, chase gaps, and consolidate returns into a single reconciled dataset.
* Maintain account data quality: Keep account data accurate and audit-ready — account hierarchy, duplicate records, ARR category changes, ownership and assignment accuracy — through scheduled audits, exception reports and remediation.
* Process territory and assignment changes: Process and validate territory, account and people assignments in Salesforce, including Enterprise Territory Management and hierarchy changes, ensuring every change is traceable and correctly reflected.
* Support the annual revenue planning cycle: Work to the calendar and cadence set by the Manager, Revenue Planning Programs & Strategy — preparing datasets, running the consolidation, and turning around iterations at pace during planning crunch.
* Maintain headcount, coverage and quota datasets: Keep the planning datasets current and reconciled across planning, Salesforce and Finance views, and maintain the change history behind them.
* Process in-year change requests: Handle mid-year changes to territories, account assignments and quotas — validating the request, applying the change, and keeping the audit trail intact.
* Produce planning status and exception reporting: Deliver recurring completeness, status and data-quality reporting so the Manager and business unit teams always know where the cycle stands and what needs attention.
* Go deep when required: Trace a number back to source, unpick a discrepancy across systems, or rebuild a broken file under time pressure — and explain clearly what went wrong and what you changed.
* Document the work: Maintain data definitions, file specifications, run instructions and change logs so the process is repeatable and does not depend on one person’s memory.

**Who You'll Work With**

* Manager, Revenue Planning Programs & Strategy — your day-to-day business partner and dotted-line manager
* Right Shore Sales Operations Team Leader — your direct manager
* UNIT Sales Operations Managers (SOMs) and business unit teams
* Revenue Operations, IT and Salesforce delivery teams
* FP&A and People/HR planning partners

**Minimum Requirements**

* 3–5 years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, sales planning, or a data management role supporting a sales organization.
* Advanced Excel is essential — complex interconnected workbooks, pivot tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, nested formulas, template design, data consolidation and validation across large datasets.
* Proficiency in Salesforce. com, including territory and account hierarchy management, assignment processing, data quality management, and running and interrogating reports.
* Exceptional attention to detail, with the discipline to check your own work and the instinct to notice when a number looks wrong.
* Demonstrated ownership of a data deliverable end to end — not just producing it, but being accountable for its accuracy downstream.
* Ability to work to a fixed planning calendar and absorb shifting priorities without losing the thread.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, with the confidence to flag a problem early and ask the question that unblocks the work.
* Comfort collaborating across time zones with US and EMEA stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in business or a related field (finance, statistics, analytics, reporting).

**What You'll Bring**

* Ownership of the Build File: You treat the final build file as yours. You know what depends on it, you check it before anyone else has to, and you do not hand over work you are not confident in.
* Adaptability: Planning priorities change quickly. You re-sequence, absorb new requirements, and keep moving without needing the plan re-explained.
* Depth on Demand: You can drop into the mechanics of the planning process when something does not reconcile, and follow the data until you find the cause.
* Data Quality Instinct: A low tolerance for dirty data, and the habits — reconciliation, validation, exception reporting — that keep it clean rather than fixing it after the fact.
* Process Discipline: You follow the standard, document what you do, and leave the process better than you found it.
* Practical AI fluency: Comfort using a leading AI assistant (Claude preferred; ChatGPT or Gemini also relevant) to speed up data preparation, reconciliation, documentation and repetitive processing work — with the judgement to verify the output.
* Power BI experience or certification would be an added advantage.
* Familiarity with sales planning or incentive compensation platforms (Anaplan, Lative, Xactly, Varicent or equivalent) would be an added advantage.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: Quantitative Researcher(unpaid)
description:
**Role:**
Quantitative Researcher (Contract)

**Company:**
Meridian Capital

**Location:**
100% Remote (India)

**Format:**
3-Month Live Project

**About Meridian Capital**

Meridian Capital is a proprietary algorithmic trading firm actively operating in the Indian stock market. We execute our strategies through a fully automated, end-to-end systematic trading platform designed to identify and exploit market inefficiencies with zero manual intervention required for trade execution.

**The Role & Challenge**

We are seeking a sharp, highly analytical, and results-driven Quantitative Researcher for a specialized 3-month contract. Your primary objective will be to audit, stress-test, and extensively optimize the mathematical and logical foundation of our current trading algorithm to maximize our market edge.

This engagement is strictly performance-oriented and structured around two core phases:

* **Phase 1 (The 2-Week Sprint):**
  Within the first 14 days of engagement, evaluate our existing quantitative logic and deliver at least one profitable, mathematically robust model that we can immediately deploy into live trading environments.
* **Phase 2 (Ongoing Optimization):**
  For the remainder of the 3-month contract, shift focus toward developing advanced quantitative metrics, refining statistical models, and continuously optimizing the system for peak performance and risk mitigation.

**Target Performance Metrics**

Optimization efforts must be engineered to achieve or exceed the following benchmarks:

* **Sharpe Ratio:**
  > 1.5
* **Sortino Ratio:**
  > 1.8
* **Win Rate:**
  45% or greater
* **Monthly Return:**
  Minimum 5% consistent growth

**Compensation & Profit Sharing**

This role is highly leveraged toward performance, rewarding the specific alpha you generate directly.

* **Fixed Stipend:**
  ₹5,000 per month (paid upon initial verification of a profitable, working algorithm).
* **Performance Share (30%):**
  You will receive 30% of all trading profits generated by the firm. This profit share activates the moment your quantitative logic is deployed in our live algorithm and remains in effect for the entire duration of your engagement with Meridian Capital.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* Strong academic foundation in Mathematics, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, Computer Science, or a heavily quantitative engineering discipline.
* Proven, hands-on experience in statistical modeling, backtesting frameworks, and algorithmic trading logic.
* Deep, intuitive understanding of risk-adjusted return metrics (e.g., Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, Maximum Drawdown).

* Proficiency in Python, with demonstrated experience in data analysis, scripting, and dashboard or tool development

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to challenge traders constructively
* A proactive problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment

description:

As a Digital Media Specialist, you will be responsible for supporting clients across campaign setup, troubleshooting, optimization and platform-related requests. You will work closely with clients and internal stakeholders to resolve issues, identify opportunities for improvement and ensure campaigns are delivered effectively.
  
  
This is a role for someone who is comfortable taking ownership, asking questions, sharing their perspective and finding solutions rather than simply following instructions. You will have the opportunity to deepen your digital advertising expertise while developing your consulting, communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
**We hope you are ready to change the game! Be ready to:**

* Own client requests from end-to-end, ensuring questions, issues and escalations are handled effectively, efficiently and with a strong customer focus.
* Set up, manage and optimize digital advertising campaigns in the Adform platform, ensuring campaign configurations align with client objectives and KPIs.
* Troubleshoot campaign and platform issues, investigate root causes, gather the information required for efficient resolution and collaborate with the relevant technical or product teams when needed.
* Provide guidance and consultancy to clients, helping them understand Adform functionality, campaign setup options, targeting, tracking, reporting and optimization opportunities.
* Apply data-driven thinking when analyzing campaign performance, identifying delivery or performance issues and recommending appropriate optimizations.

* Have 1–2+ years of relevant experience in digital advertising, ad operations, campaign management, technical support, customer success or a similar role.

* Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and enjoy investigating issues rather than stopping at the first apparent answer.
* Be accountable for your work and comfortable taking ownership of tasks, decisions and outcomes.
* Have a growth mindset - you are curious, willing to learn and comfortable stepping outside your current area of expertise.

* Have strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to understand different perspectives, manage expectations and build effective working relationships.
* Have a customer-centric mindset and care about delivering a high-quality experience, not just closing a ticket.
* Be highly organized, able to prioritize competing requests and manage your time effectively.
* Be a collaborative team player who is willing to support others and contribute to the success of the wider team.
* Be fluent in English, both written and spoken.

* Previous experience working with a DSP, ad server, SSP or other digital advertising technology platform.
* Hands-on experience with campaign trafficking, campaign optimization or digital media operations.
* Familiarity with concepts such as impressions, clicks, conversions, CTR, CPM, CPA, tracking pixels, tags and programmatic buying.
* Experience working with ticketing/help desk systems or other structured support environments.
* Experience analyzing campaign performance through reporting and data analysis tools, including spreadsheets.
* Experience working with multiple stakeholders across technical, commercial, product or customer-facing teams.

**Our promise to you:**

* A dynamic, inspiring, and international environment filled with ambitious and caring colleagues
* Premium health insurance with ₹10,00,000 coverage for you and your family
* 24 paid vacation days to enjoy life outside of work

title: Valuation Governance, Associate, Tech & Ops
description:
**About This Role**
**Team Overview**
BlackRock Data Services (BDS) is entrusted with maintaining all data integral to the investment decision process, for BlackRock the Investment Manager and its BlackRock Solutions (BRS) business, in our proprietary Aladdin® end-to-end investment platform. BDS closely partners with teams, such as Portfolio Management, Global Capital Markets, Relationship Management, Portfolio Compliance, Risk Analytics, Regulatory Reporting, and others, to ensure their business data needs are met accurately, timely, and efficiently.
  
  
The BDS philosophy is anchored on BlackRock’s cornerstone principles: Innovation, Fiduciary focus, Passion for Performance, and the unified purpose of One BlackRock. Through that lens, we seek to build value for our clients by understanding their needs, the markets, and using technology to build best in class solutions. BDS has presence across 12 offices in 8 countries, servicing more than $17 trillion in AUM on Aladdin for BlackRock and BRS clients spanning 6 continents and all spectrums of the financial markets.
  
  
The Private Valuation Team within BDS supports the investment valuation function for private, illiquid investments acting as the interface between the investment professionals, external valuation providers, accounting outsource providers, auditors, and Global Fund Services. The team focuses on adding value by providing valuation oversight and coordination of valuations and supporting documentation.
  
  
**Role Responsibility**

* Prepare valuation documentation for private equity, private debt and other alternative investments.
* Support monthly and quarterly valuation cycles.
* Manage workflow of data to 3rd party valuation firms; working with investment teams to ensure all relevant information is incorporated into valuations.
* Provide high quality client service externally and internally. Address inquiries, perform controls, problem solve, and mitigate risks for clients and internal BlackRock partners.
* Initiate and help drive platform and process innovations to support fast-growing business needs, minimize risk, improve quality, and navigate the changing markets.
* Review and tie out of valuation templates received from third party service providers. Communicate any comments and coordinate sign off in coordination with Investment, Pricing and Fund Administration teams.
* Review legal documents to establish rights associated with new securities purchased.
* Prepare materials to be provided to the Valuation Committee and presenting findings to Pricing Committees and other management as necessary.
* Liaison with independent auditors and valuation firms. Provide support for valuations and answer questions as necessary in a controlled and efficient manner.
* Perform a review of fair value reporting provided by underlying managers and Co-Investment sponsors.
* Operate as part of a global team.

**Experience**

* Bachelor's degree is required, with preference to Accounting or Finance.
* 5-10 years meaningful experience, private investment valuation experience preferred.
* Solid understanding of ASC 820 and IFRS 13, familiarity with PWERM, OPM, and Current Value valuation techniques
* Ability to work with and manage financial data and build summarized reports.
* Experience building, testing and implementing valuation models.
* Natural standout colleague able to work in an innovative, ambitious, and fast paced environment while maintaining attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills combined with agile critical thinking and a problem-solving attitude.
* Ability to quickly learn the intricacies of complex financial instruments.
* Working knowledge of Bloomberg, Reuters, Interactive Data and MS Office Suite as well as SQL, Unix commands, PERL, etc. is an advantage.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Gen AI Engineer (Microsoft Foundry)

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Principal Data Scientist to solve complex modelling problems across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas. You will formulate operational challenges, establish defensible scientific approaches, develop critical modelling components, and define the evidence required for reliable deployment across wells, fields, equipment, process units, and sites.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include**
:
  
  
**Scientific formulation and advanced modelling**

* Formulate operational problems as predictive, diagnostic, causal, or prescriptive tasks, defining targets, objective functions, constraints, decision variables, acceptance criteria, and evaluation methods.
* Assess data sufficiency, measurement quality, sampling bias, confounding, identifiability, and operating coverage to determine whether available evidence supports the intended outcome.
* Select statistical, machine learning, simulation, or hybrid approaches suited to noisy measurements, heterogeneous assets, sparse labels, rare events, censored histories, and distribution shifts.
* Apply probabilistic or hierarchical modelling, uncertainty quantification, survival analysis, semi-supervised learning, transfer learning, or domain adaptation where appropriate.
* Develop methods for multivariate forecasting, state estimation, change detection, degradation modelling, and industrial time-series analysis while distinguishing process dynamics from measurement artefacts.
* Combine learned models with engineering equations, mass and energy balances, simulation outputs, or physical constraints, evaluating accuracy, plausibility, extrapolation behaviour, and uncertainty propagation.
* Connect predictions with constrained optimization, assessing feasibility, sensitivity, robustness, and decision quality under uncertainty; design experiments or causal analyses when observational evidence is insufficient.

**Upstream applications**

* Define modelling approaches for production forecasting, well surveillance, artificial-lift performance, drilling analytics, and production-system optimization.
* Separate the effects of reservoir behaviour, operating constraints, equipment condition, interventions, formation changes, and operating practices when interpreting performance.
* Collaborate with reservoir engineers and geoscientists on property prediction, uncertainty analysis, and simulation-assisted modelling.
* Determine whether models can transfer between wells or fields and define the data, recalibration, adaptation, and validation required.

**Downstream applications**

* Define modelling approaches for product-quality prediction, yield modelling, equipment degradation, blending, and process or energy optimization.
* Account for feedstock composition, throughput, catalyst age, equipment condition, process configuration, and control-system behaviour.
* Combine data-driven methods with engineering relationships, process simulations, and mass and energy balances.
* Connect predictive models with operating, planning, blending, or optimization workflows within defined physical and operational constraints, validating across feedstock changes, campaigns, grades, and configurations.

**Model assurance and generalization**

* Establish standards for baselining, benchmarking, feature-ablation studies, calibration, sensitivity analysis, robustness, and out-of-distribution evaluation.
* Challenge apparent improvements caused by leakage, weak baselines, inappropriate metrics, selective testing, or inadequate engineering interpretation.
* Distinguish models that reproduce historical associations from models capable of evaluating proposed operating changes.
* Define applicability limits, uncertainty treatment, monitoring requirements, fallback behaviour, and recalibration or retraining criteria.
* Assess predictive performance separately from recommendation feasibility and quality, and establish adaptation and validation strategies across assets, sites, configurations, and operating regimes.

**Technical leadership and scalable delivery**

* Remain hands-on in experiments, model development, prototyping, and troubleshooting.
* Resolve failures across data preparation, measurement quality, engineering assumptions, model formulation, software implementation, and production behaviour.
* Develop reusable modelling components, adaptation strategies, technical standards, and reference implementations; design reproducible experiments whose conclusions can be reviewed and defended.
* Evaluate emerging techniques through controlled comparisons with established methods and review production implementations for consistency with the intended scientific approach.
* Conduct scientific reviews, challenge modelling decisions, mentor Lead Data Scientists, and collaborate with engineering, data, ML engineering, and product teams to integrate validated models into operational workflows.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A degree in a relevant engineering, scientific, or quantitative discipline.
* Substantial hands-on experience developing and deploying Oil & Gas analytical solutions.
* Deep expertise in at least one upstream or downstream area, with working knowledge across both segments.
* Advanced expertise in at least one relevant applied modelling specialization.
* Strong foundations in statistics, machine learning, mathematical modelling, industrial time series, scientific computing, experimental design, and uncertainty assessment.
* Strong Python and SQL skills, including scientific prototyping, implementation of critical modelling components, and review of production code.
* Experience integrating engineering knowledge into model formulation and validation, together with reproducible experimentation, production ML, model generalization, and deployment across varied operating conditions.
* Evidence of personally resolving a difficult methodological problem and establishing an approach adopted by others.
* Experience conducting technical reviews and guiding multidisciplinary data science teams.
* Ability to defend technical decisions using quantitative evidence and clearly communicate assumptions, trade-offs, limitations, and operational implications.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience across both upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A master’s degree, PhD, or relevant applied research experience.
* Expertise in system identification, robust optimization, physics-informed learning, simulation surrogates, or uncertainty propagation.
* Experience with distributed scientific computing, scalable inference, cloud ML platforms, and production MLOps.
* Experience combining validated numerical models with knowledge graphs, specialized language models, or agentic decision-support workflows.
* Publications, patents, open-source contributions, or reusable technical assets demonstrating applied scientific contribution.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact modelling and decision-support challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations.
* A role with hands-on technical authority, scientific leadership, and the opportunity to establish reusable methods and standards for multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data science, ML engineering, product, and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem, and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on technical authority who can explain a difficult Oil & Gas problem they personally solved, why established approaches were insufficient, how the alternative was formulated and validated, where it can and cannot generalize, and how the resulting approach enabled other data scientists to deliver reliable solutions.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* Define how CDF fits within historian, enterprise application, engineering information and cloud architectures.
* Select source-appropriate extractors, APIs and processing patterns, considering latency, throughput, connectivity and source-system load.
* Define historical loading, incremental extraction, reconciliation and recovery approaches, including late records, corrections and supported deletions.
* Establish requirements for service identities, access capabilities, environment separation, monitoring and operational support.

**Industrial information modelling**

* Design CDF models using spaces, containers, views and instances; select direct relations or edges according to relationship semantics and query requirements.
* Reuse and extend Cognite’s Core Data Model where suitable, introducing custom domain concepts where required.
* Define stable identifiers, source crosswalks and conflict-resolution rules, including repeated tag names across sites and systems.
* Represent physical equipment, functional locations and installation history separately where required.
* Establish schema versioning, migration and consumer-compatibility requirements while preserving lineage, timestamps, units, quality indicators and relationship provenance.

**Contextualization and Oil & Gas semantics**

* Design relationships connecting equipment and assets with time series, maintenance records, documents and engineering diagrams.
* Define matching rules, confidence thresholds, exception handling and domain review for ambiguous associations; assess coverage and match accuracy separately.
* For upstream applications, model fields, wells, wellbores, production facilities, equipment, well tests and interventions, preserving distinctions between measured, calculated and allocated production.
* For downstream applications, model sites, process units, functional locations, equipment, laboratory results and maintenance activities, accounting for replacement, revisions and measurement timing.
* Validate that contextualized information supports the intended engineering workflow.
* Application enablement and technical assurance
* Define consumer data contracts covering entities, relationships, fields, freshness, permissions and query-performance expectations.
* Validate designs against representative Cognite applications, custom applications, and analytical or AI workflows.
* Develop critical prototypes and reference implementations using Python, SQL, Cognite SDKs and APIs.
* Establish deployment and environment-promotion practices using version control, automated validation and Cognite Toolkit.
* Review architecture changes, migration plans, integration code and performance bottlenecks; resolve cross-system design conflicts and mentor data engineering leads.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A relevant engineering, computer science or information systems degree, or equivalent technical experience.
* Demonstrated personal architectural contribution to a production Cognite Data Fusion implementation.
* Strong knowledge of CDF data modelling, transformations, contextualization and access controls.
* Substantial industrial data integration experience spanning representative operational, enterprise and engineering sources.
* Strong Python and SQL skills with practical Cognite SDK and REST API experience.
* Experience defining identity strategies, model evolution, deployment patterns and production support requirements.
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture, identity providers, network boundaries and CI/CD.
* Strong Oil & Gas implementation experience in at least one upstream or downstream domain, with ability to adapt relevant concepts to the other.

**Good to Have**

* Cognite implementation experience across multiple assets or sites.
* Experience spanning both upstream and downstream.
* Familiarity with historians, maintenance systems, laboratory systems, engineering repositories or well-data services.
* Experience with diagram contextualization, 3D associations and industrial knowledge graphs.
* Experience enabling Cognite applications or AI workflows using contextualized data.
* Relevant Cognite Academy training or certifications.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on architect who can defend consequential production Cognite decisions involving identity resolution, data-model design, access boundaries, recovery, schema migration and application compatibility, and demonstrate which patterns can be reused across sites and which require adaptation.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Job Title: Distinguished Engineer - Data Architect**

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a Distinguished Engineer- Data Architect to design and build the data foundation for our AI-driven security platform. In this role, you will own the architectural blueprint and core implementation of our data strategy, transforming massive streams of high-velocity network traffic logs, customer configurations, and security alerts into high-performance, ML-ready data fabrics.

As part of a lean, elite three-person Data & AI team, you will serve as the ultimate technical authority on data scale, streaming architecture, multi-tenant security, and cost-efficient storage systems.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* ****Architect the Core Data Platform:****
  Design, implement, and evolve a unified blueprint for streaming and batch data processing capable of ingesting, normalizing, and storing petabyte-scale, high-velocity security telemetry.
* ****Enable AI & Advanced Analytics:****
  Partner directly with the Lead AI Engineer to architect the underlying storage, retrieval systems, and feature stores—including optimal vector database structures and data lakehouse layers—required for low-latency AI inference and training.
* ****Enforce Zero-Trust Data Governance:****
  Architect strict multi-tenant isolation, data privacy guardrails, and compliance controls directly into the data fabric to protect sensitive customer network configurations and logs.
* ****Optimize Economics & Performance:****
  Drive infrastructure cost-efficiency and performance tuning across data processing engines, storage layers, and cloud infrastructure, balancing ultra-low latency requirements with predictable cost scaling.
* ****Lead by Example:****
  Write clean, foundational, high-performance code for critical infrastructure components, setting the standard for engineering excellence within the team.

**Required Experience & Skills:**

* ****Experience:****
  **12+ years of data engineering and architecture experience, with a proven track record of designing production systems handling massive, high-throughput streaming datasets (e.g., networking logs, telemetry, or real-time event streams).**
* ****Distributed Systems Expertise:****
  Deep, authoritative knowledge of distributed processing and streaming engines (e.g., Apache Flink, Spark, Kafka, Pulsar) and modern lakehouse architectures (e.g., Iceberg, Delta Lake).
* ****Hybrid Storage Architecture:****
  Mastery of polyglot persistence, spanning traditional relational databases, NoSQL, Columnar engines (e.g., ClickHouse, DuckDB), and Vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone).
* ****Security & Infrastructure:****
  Strong fundamentals in secure data architectures, network topography, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, containerization (Kubernetes), and cloud-native infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure).
* ****Mindset:****
  A rare combination of visionary architecture and hands-on execution. You thrive in ultra-lean teams, enjoy writing core code, and possess the pragmatism to build for immediate needs while planning for massive scale.

Our team is very hands-on with a strong mindset of problem-solving while also having the ability to think holistically and provide solutions that solve the customer's long-term challenges. **Role**
We are seeking a highly technical, hands‑on, and detail‑oriented Principal Integration professional to lead the
**most complex, hands‑on integration designs and builds**
across our implementation portfolio. The ideal candidate is a senior individual contributor with a strong integration background and a proven track record of designing, implementing, and optimizing mission‑critical interfaces between cloud platforms and enterprise systems.
  
  
You will act as the go‑to integration expert across projects: owning design, build, troubleshooting and optimization for the most critical and technically ambiguous data flows, while setting standards that Senior Integration Leads and project teams execute against, and mentoring other team members (without direct line management).
  
  
This role is an individual contributor position, with significant autonomy and impact.
  
  
**What You Will Do With Us**
**Integration Design & Implementation**

* End‑to‑End Integration Design: Lead the detailed design of the most complex integrations between Ivalua and ERPs, HR, finance, logistics, and other third‑party systems, ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.
* Hands‑On Build: Configure and develop integrations using Ivalua tools, APIs, ETL/EAI/middleware, file‑based interfaces and scripting where needed. Own technical implementation from design through deployment for the highest‑complexity streams.
* Standards & Reuse: Define, publish, and continuously refine integration standards, reusable patterns, and best practices (e.g., modular mappings, error handling, logging, versioning) for Senior Integration Leads and consultants to apply across projects.
* Performance & Robustness: Analyze and optimize integration performance (throughput, latency, data volumes), and design robust error handling, reconciliation and recovery strategies that serve as the reference approach for the broader team.
* Troubleshooting & Debugging: Act as the top‑level technical escalation point for integration‑related incidents that Senior Integration Leads and project teams cannot resolve, during build, SIT/UAT, go‑live and hypercare phases.

**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**

* Work with Functional & Technical Teams: Collaborate closely with Functional Consultants, Solution Architects, Data Engineers and Project Managers to align integration design with business processes and data models.
* Customer Technical Workshops: Lead or co‑lead technical workshops with customers' IT and integration teams on the most strategically significant or technically ambiguous engagements, to capture integration requirements, present solution options, and validate technical designs.
* R&D Feedback: Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams on integration capabilities, feature gaps, and improvement opportunities encountered across the portfolio.
* Pre‑Sales Support: Provide technical input on the most complex or high‑risk proposals — contributing to solution design, effort estimation, and technical due diligence for prospective clients where deep integration expertise is needed to de‑risk the deal.

**Delivery Excellence**

* Technical Specifications: Produce high‑quality, reference‑standard technical design documents (integration specification, mapping documents, sequence diagrams) and keep them up to date.
* Quality Assurance: Define the org's unit, integration, and regression testing standards and frameworks, and perform peer reviews of integration designs and implementations across projects.
* Risk & Issue Management: Identify systemic integration risks (e.g., recurring dependencies, data quality patterns, performance constraints) and partner with project teams to define and drive mitigation plans at the practice level.
* Lifecycle Support: Support cutover planning, go‑live readiness, and post‑go‑live stabilization from an integration standpoint, including monitoring and early‑life support for the most critical engagements.

**Partner & Internal Enablement**

* Technical Mentor: Informally mentor and coach Senior Integration Leads and junior integration/technical consultants by sharing best practices, code samples, troubleshooting techniques and design approaches.
* Partner Guidance: Provide technical guidance to partners' integration consultants on specific projects, clarifying Ivalua integration patterns, constraints and recommended approaches.
* Knowledge Assets: Contribute to internal knowledge base articles, how‑to guides, reference implementations, and sample configurations to accelerate future projects.

**YOUR PROFILE**
If you have the below experience and strengths this role could be for you:
  
  
**Required Skills**

* Minimum 10 years of experience in technical integration, technical consulting, or web‑based software development, ideally in SaaS or complex enterprise environments.
* Significant hands‑on experience designing and implementing integrations using ETL/EAI or other integration/middleware technologies.
* Strong practical experience with SOAP and REST APIs, including API consumption, design principles, authentication methods, and error handling.
* Solid understanding of data transfer mechanisms (e.g., SFTP, FTPS, API‑based, file‑based) and data formats such as CSV, XML, JSON (experience with cXML/EDI a plus).

title: Platform Engineering Lead
description:
We are seeking an experienced Platform Engineering Lead to join the Enterprise Data Platform team in Pune. The role focuses on leading the design and delivery of scalable, cloud-native data and platform capabilities, driving strategic technology decisions, and enabling teams to build secure, high-performing platforms that accelerate innovation across the organization.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
  

* Lead the design and delivery of distributed, event-driven, and data-intensive systems into production environments.
* Drive platform engineering initiatives across cloud-native services, infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, and secure-by-design architecture.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to engineering teams, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and best practices.
* Influence architecture, security, product, and delivery stakeholders to drive pragmatic technology outcomes.
* Navigate governance frameworks and regulatory requirements in a complex enterprise environment.
* Champion automation-first mindset and production-grade engineering practices across platform delivery.
* Build and promote reusable self-service platform capabilities, onboarding models, and integration frameworks.
* Oversee observability, alerting, incident handling, resilience, and continuous improvement for business-critical platforms.
* Ensure solutions meet Barclays standards for Security, Data Privacy, Resilience, and Operational Risk.

**Required Skills**
Platform & Data Engineering
  
  
  

* Proven software engineering experience designing and delivering distributed, event-driven, or data-intensive systems into production.
* Strong engineering judgement and automation-first mindset enabling robust, scalable, and efficient technology solutions.
* Strong expertise in cloud-native services, infrastructure as code, and scalable platform patterns.
* Deep understanding of CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and secure-by-design architecture principles.
* Experience with production-grade engineering practices driving reliable and secure platform delivery at scale.
* Knowledge of platform resilience, recovery strategies, and operational excellence.

Technical Leadership
  
  
  

* Demonstrated technical leadership experience in regulated or complex enterprise environments.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with ability to influence architecture, security, product, and delivery stakeholders.
* Experience guiding and mentoring engineering teams through complex technical challenges.
* Ability to navigate governance frameworks and drive alignment between business objectives and technology execution.
* Strong engineering judgement with focus on pragmatic, scalable solutions.

Engineering Practices
  
  
  

* Strong understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Commitment to secure coding, code quality, and engineering best practices.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to resolve complex production issues.
* Experience with observability, monitoring, alerting, and incident management.

**Preferred Skills**

* Proficiency in containerization and orchestration technologies, including Docker and container runtime management.
* Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including deployment strategies, scaling, troubleshooting, and Helm chart management.
* Expertise in Infrastructure as Code tools such as CloudFormation and Terraform for provisioning and managing cloud infrastructure.

The role is based out of Pune.

To build and maintain the systems that collect, store, process, and analyse data, such as data pipelines, data warehouses and data lakes to ensure that all data is accurate, accessible, and secure.

* Collaboration with data scientist to build and deploy machine learning models.

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..

They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..

They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. title: Data Architect - 13+ years exp, Snowflake, dbt, Python
description:
**Meet the Team**
Be part of the Cisco IT Data team, where technology, innovation, and collaboration drive real business value. Our team is at the forefront of designing and delivering scalable, secure, and advanced solutions that enable data-driven decision-making for Cisco's global business. We believe in a culture of curiosity, creativity, and continuous learning, where team members are empowered to experiment and bring new ideas to life.
  
  
As a
**Data Architect**
, you will be the senior technical authority responsible for defining the architecture, standards, and strategic direction of Cisco's enterprise data platforms. You will design scalable, secure, and future-ready data architectures that power advanced analytics, machine learning, and real-time data products. Partnering with engineering, analytics, and business leaders, your designs will directly shape how Cisco stores, governs, integrates, and unlocks value from data across the enterprise.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define and own the enterprise data architecture vision, standards, and multi-year roadmap across ingestion, storage, transformation, discovery, and governance.
* Design scalable, secure, and highly available data architectures—including data lakes, lakehouses, data warehouses, and real-time streaming systems—leveraging modern cloud-native technologies.
* Define and lead target-state architecture and migration strategies that modernize legacy data infrastructure onto cloud-native platforms (e.g., GCP, Snowflake) to improve scalability and reduce operational cost.
* Establish architectural standards, reference patterns, and best practices for data modeling, integration, metadata management, and platform security across teams.
* Establish enterprise data modeling standards and governance/lineage frameworks that improve data quality, discoverability, and compliance across multiple business domains.
* Design API- and event-driven integration architectures that enable real-time data access across the enterprise, improving data delivery speed and reliability.
* Partner closely with data engineers, analytics teams, platform engineers, and business leaders to translate strategic priorities into robust, well-governed data solutions.
* Lead architecture decisions for platform modernization, evaluating and selecting technologies (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Airflow, DBT, Informatica, Kubernetes) to optimize efficiency, cost, and scale.
* Define data governance, lineage, quality, and compliance frameworks, ensuring they are embedded across platform design and operations.
* Provide architectural oversight and design reviews, ensuring solutions meet reliability, scalability, performance, and security requirements.
* Champion conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling practices that support both operational and analytical workloads.
* Mentor engineers and architects, fostering a culture of technical excellence, sound design thinking, and knowledge sharing.
* Act as a key technical advisor to leadership, influencing architecture decisions, technology investments, and strategic direction across the data organization.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 13+ years of professional experience in data architecture, data engineering, or large-scale data platform design.
* Deep expertise designing enterprise data architectures—data lakes, lakehouses, and data warehouses—at scale.
* Strong proficiency with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Snowflake) and modern, cloud-native data architectures.
* Expert-level data modeling skills (conceptual, logical, and physical) across relational, dimensional, and NoSQL paradigms.
* Proven experience defining data integration, ingestion, and API/microservices patterns for enterprise-scale systems.
* Strong knowledge of data pipeline orchestration tools (Airflow, DBT, Informatica) and cloud-native storage (Snowflake, BigQuery).
* Hands-on understanding of CI/CD, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* Solid programming or scripting skills (Python, SQL, Java, or similar) to support architecture validation and prototyping.
* Demonstrated success leading large, complex architecture initiatives and influencing across teams in Agile/Scrum environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing real-time/streaming data architectures (Kafka, Pub/Sub) and large-scale ETL/ELT processes.
* Deep knowledge of data governance, security, lineage, and compliance frameworks.
* Experience architecting platforms to support AI/ML and advanced analytics workloads.
* Proven ability to optimize cost, performance, and scalability in cloud-based data environments at scale.
* Relevant architecture certifications (e.g., cloud architect, data architecture).
* Exceptional communication, influencing, stakeholder management, and mentorship abilities at the organizational level.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

description:

3–5 Years

Full-Time

About the Role

Cosentus is looking for a
**Senior Full Stack & AI Platform Engineer**
with strong expertise in
**system design, scalable architecture, microservices, full-stack development, and AI-powered applications**
.

We are looking for a hands-on engineer who can independently design complex systems, develop application modules, integrate modern AI technologies, and take complete ownership from architecture through production.

A key challenge involves building scalable AI-powered healthcare applications capable of processing
**2,000–5,000 medical charts within a 1–2 hour peak processing window**
, ensuring performance, reliability, accuracy, and cost efficiency.

The ideal candidate should be strong in
**Node.js, React.js, PostgreSQL, AWS Lambda, Amazon Bedrock, microservices, distributed systems, OCR, RAG, and practical AI/LLM implementation**
.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and develop scalable applications using
  **React.js, Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB**
  .
* Own
  **High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD)**
  for complex modules, microservices, and distributed systems.
* Design high-throughput architectures using
  **asynchronous processing, event-driven workflows, queues, caching, and parallel execution**
  .
* Build and optimize
  **AWS Lambda-based services**
  and integrate AI models using
  **Amazon Bedrock**
  .
* Develop and scale
  **AI/LLM workflows, OCR pipelines, Vision AI, structured data extraction, and RAG systems**
  .
* Design scalable APIs, database schemas, background processing workflows, and communication between microservices.
* Implement
  **concurrency controls, rate limiting, retries, idempotency, fault tolerance, and monitoring**
  .
* Integrate
  **AI agents, tool calling, and workflow orchestration**
  where required.
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across backend services, databases, AI models, and infrastructure.
* Take ownership of
  **development, deployment, performance optimization, and production troubleshooting**
  .

Core Technical Skills1. Full Stack Development & System Design

Strong hands-on experience with
**React.js, Node.js, Express.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and REST APIs**
.

Strong understanding of:

* **HLD, LLD, scalable architecture, and microservices**
* Distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and asynchronous processing
* Database design, query optimization, and API architecture
* Concurrency, caching, load balancing, and horizontal scaling
* Authentication, authorization, security, and fault tolerance
* Performance optimization and architectural trade-offs

The candidate must be capable of
**converting business requirements into detailed, scalable technical designs and implementing them independently**
.

2. Microservices, Distributed Systems & AWS

Strong practical knowledge of
**microservices, distributed processing, asynchronous workflows, and event-driven system architecture**
.

Hands-on expertise with:

* **AWS Lambda:**
  Serverless development, deployment, concurrency, performance optimization, and scaling.
* **Amazon Bedrock:**
  Foundation model integration and production AI workflows.
* Working knowledge of
  **AWS S3, SQS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and IAM**
  .

Experience with
**Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, or similar messaging and caching technologies**
.

Understanding of
**worker concurrency, queue-based processing, retries, idempotency, rate limiting, failure recovery, observability, and cloud cost optimization**
.

Deep expertise across every AWS service is not required.

3. AI / LLM Engineering, OCR & Document Intelligence

Hands-on experience implementing production AI applications involving:

* LLM integration, prompt engineering, and context management.
* **OCR, Vision AI, multimodal models, and PDF/image processing**
  .
* Document classification, table/form extraction, and structured JSON outputs.
* Schema validation, error handling, and hallucination reduction.
* Multi-stage AI processing pipelines and model orchestration.
* Token optimization, AI latency management, and cost reduction.
* AI evaluation, accuracy improvement, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

The candidate should understand how to build
**reliable AI features beyond simply making LLM API calls**
.

4. RAG & AI Workflow Architecture

Hands-on experience designing and implementing
**Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**
systems, including:

* Document ingestion, chunking, and embeddings
* Vector databases, semantic/hybrid search, and metadata filtering
* Retrieval optimization, reranking, and context construction
* Response grounding and RAG evaluation

Working knowledge of
**AI agents, function/tool calling, agent orchestration, state management, and contextual memory**
.

Experience with
**LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks**
is preferred.

5. Scalability, Performance & Engineering Ownership

The candidate should be capable of:

* Designing architectures for high-volume document and AI processing.
* Performing capacity planning, throughput estimation, and load testing.
* Building scalable background workers and asynchronous pipelines.
* Optimizing APIs, databases, model calls, and infrastructure.
* Troubleshooting complex production issues.
* Making architectural decisions and explaining technical trade-offs.
* Independently owning complex technical modules from requirements to deployment.

Good to Have

* Experience with
  **US Healthcare, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), medical coding, insurance claims, or HIPAA-aware applications**
  .
* Advanced AI agents, multi-agent workflows, and agent orchestration.
* Knowledge graphs, graph-based retrieval, and advanced AI memory.
* Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized deployments.
* Experience with AI evaluation frameworks and feedback-driven improvement systems.

Experience Required

* **3–5 years of professional software development experience**
  .
* Strong full-stack development experience, particularly in backend engineering.
* Strong system design, microservices, and scalable architecture knowledge.
* Hands-on experience with
  **AWS Lambda and Amazon Bedrock**
  .
* Practical experience with
  **AI/LLM integration, OCR, and RAG**
  .
* Ability to independently design, implement, and own complex technical modules.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a
**hands-on engineer and strong system thinker**
who can take ownership of architecture, development, AI integration, scalability, and production reliability.

The ideal candidate should be able to design distributed architectures, implement production-ready modules, optimize high-volume AI processing workflows, and solve complex engineering challenges independently.

* **Our highest priorities are system design, scalable backend architecture, microservices, AWS Lambda, and practical AI implementation.**
