title: Senior Project Manager
description:
**Senior Project Manager | Solutionara Private Limited**  
Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh (On-site, Sector 62 GDC) | Experience: 8–12 years | Full-time, Permanent  
Compensation: ₹16 LPA – ₹26 LPA (CTC)

**About Solutionara**

Solutionara is a U.S.-based IT Consulting and Technology Services firm with a Global Delivery Center (GDC) in Noida, India. We are a fast-scaling firm that operates with high ownership, lean teams, and disciplined execution, and we are evolving toward an AI-enabled delivery model focused on enterprise integration, digital transformation, and scalable technology solutions for global clients.

**The Role**

We are seeking an experienced, technically proficient, client-facing Senior Project Manager to own complex technology engagements and deliver committed business outcomes. This is more than project coordination, status reporting, or Agile ceremony management. You will translate client objectives and agreed scope into executable delivery plans, drive cross-functional teams toward measurable outcomes, proactively resolve risks and dependencies, and maintain strong client confidence throughout the engagement lifecycle.

You will be the primary delivery counterpart for assigned client engagements, working closely with Solution Architects, Technical Leads, Developers, Integration and Data Engineers, QA, DevOps, Business Analysts, client stakeholders, and external vendors.

**Success is measured by delivered and accepted outcomes, predictable execution, quality, and stakeholder confidence — not simply by activities completed or reports produced.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **End-to-end delivery:** Own projects/workstreams from initiation and planning through engineering, testing, deployment, stabilization, and closure. Translate SOWs and client commitments into delivery plans with milestones, owners, timelines, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* **Client-facing leadership:** Lead client delivery meetings, milestone reviews, governance discussions, and executive status presentations. Communicate project health transparently and manage challenging conversations on risks, changing priorities, and missed commitments.
* **Technical coordination:** Coordinate delivery involving enterprise applications, cloud platforms, APIs, middleware, data platforms, digital portals, and legacy modernization. Understand architecture, interfaces, data flows, and deployment requirements well enough to identify risks and challenge assumptions.
* **Governance, risk & dependencies:** Maintain project plans, WBS, milestone trackers, RAID logs, decision registers, dependency trackers, and delivery dashboards. Escalate material risks early with facts, impact assessments, and recommended options; lead recovery planning for at-risk engagements.
* **Outcome-based delivery:** Track progress against committed deliverables and business outcomes, not just task completion. Validate completion with evidence and convert unclear status updates into specific commitments, owners, and next actions.
* **Scope & commercial awareness:** Track effort and utilization against plan, identify scope expansion, prepare change-impact assessments, and escalate changes through approved governance. (This role does not carry sales targets, account revenue, contracting, or P&L ownership.)
* **Quality, release & acceptance:** Coordinate SIT, regression, UAT, defect management, go-live readiness, cutover, rollback planning, hypercare, and transition to support.
* **Reporting & executive communication:** Prepare concise, decision-oriented updates for clients and Solutionara leadership; translate technical challenges into business impact.
* **PMO maturity:** Improve delivery governance, templates, reporting standards, and playbooks using Jira, Asana, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools.
* **AI-enabled delivery:** Use approved AI and automation tools responsibly to improve planning, documentation, reporting, and risk identification — validating outputs for accuracy and confidentiality.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.
* 8–12 years of experience in project management, technical delivery management, or enterprise technology delivery.
* Demonstrated experience independently managing client-facing IT consulting or technology delivery engagements.
* Experience managing distributed, cross-functional teams across engineering, QA, DevOps, architecture, and business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile, Scrum, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Practical experience with project plans, milestone tracking, RAID management, dependency registers, scope control, and executive reporting.
* Experience managing client expectations, escalations, project changes, and delivery recovery plans.
* Strong written and verbal English communication, including client-facing presentations.
* Ability to operate independently, create structure in ambiguity, and drive accountability across stakeholders.
* Willingness to work on-site at our Noida GDC and collaborate with US-based client and leadership teams as required.

**Preferred Experience**

* Enterprise Integration (Dell Boomi, MuleSoft, Workato, APIs, EDI/B2B), Enterprise Applications (ERP, CRM, JDE, WMS), Cloud & DevOps (AWS, Azure, CI/CD), Data Platforms (CDP, PIM, DAM, analytics), Digital Applications (customer/dealer portals, commerce), or Modernization Programs.
* Managing US or international clients through onsite-offshore delivery models.
* Coordinating multiple vendors, client SMEs, and geographically distributed teams.
* Supporting complex enterprise releases, cutovers, and hypercare.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum, or other recognized project management certification.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted project management and productivity tools.

Prior experience with every listed platform is not required — we value sufficient technical understanding and learning agility to manage complex technology delivery.

**Ideal Candidate**

A hands-on, technically aware, client-oriented delivery leader who can explain not only what was done, but what was delivered, how success was validated, and what risks were overcome. Proactive rather than reactive, transparent rather than overly optimistic, and able to maintain client confidence even when challenges arise.

**Why Join Solutionara?**

* Work on enterprise technology transformation initiatives for global clients.
* Gain exposure to cloud, integration, data platforms, application modernization, and AI-enabled delivery.

We build analytical data platforms for Atlassian that serve both Engineering and Data Engineering to help them generate valuable insights from data.
  
  
**As a Principal Engineer On This Team You Will**

* Own the long term architecture and technical direction for core platform capabilities and be accountable for their reliability, cost efficiency and adoption
* Design and build foundational platform components that other engineering teams build on top of, across areas like ingestion, transformation, orchestration, compute and consumption
* Architect robust multi-tenant platform standards by establishing clear cross-layer contracts, tenant isolation, and SLOs to enable autonomous producers and consumers, while driving compute and storage efficiency across workloads
* Lead cross team technical initiatives and architecture reviews, influence platform strategy with senior stakeholders and act as a technical mentor and multiplier for Senior engineers
* Stay hands on. You will be in the code on the hardest problems, not just reviewing designs

**Compensation**
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* 12+ years of software or data engineering experience, with at least 6 years building data platform infrastructure
* You have built a data platform or a significant component of one and operated it in production. For example an ingestion framework, a transformation framework, a compute or query layer, an orchestration layer, a metadata or lineage service or a data quality framework
* You can describe the scale that component ran at in concrete numbers. Data volume, ingest throughput, number of pipelines or jobs, query concurrency and latency, number of onboarded teams or tenants and infrastructure cost.
* Deep understanding of big data and distributed systems challenges including partitioning, shuffle behaviour, skew, idempotency and backfills
* Experience designing both batch and streaming architectures and clear judgement on when each is the right answer
* Expert level programming skills in language such as Java, Kotlin or Python and built solutions on public cloud offerings such as Amazon Web Services
* Experience with big data processing and storage technologies such as Spark, DBT and with open table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake
* A track record of owning ambiguous cross team problems end to end and of influencing without authority
* Degree in Computer Science, EE or a related STEM discipline or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience with high performance analytical or MPP databases such as StarRocks, Druid, ClickHouse or Pinot
* Experience with change data capture and event driven ingestion at high volume
* Experience building a semantic layer or metrics store and governing shared metric definitions
* Experience with the data foundations of ML platforms, such as point-in-time correct training data, online and offline feature parity or backfilling features at scale
* Experience with data governance, access control, lineage and compliance, including regulated environments such as FedRAMP
* Experience running platform components on Kubernetes
* Experience with multi region data architectures, including replication, failover and consistency tradeoffs

title: DevOps and MLOps Engineer
description:
Hyperworks Imaging is a cutting-edge technology company based out of Bengaluru, India since 2016. We are seeking an ambitious junior ML researcher who wants to do more than fine-tune off-the-shelf models. In this role, you will build, train and deploy new LLMs, SLMs, VLMs and AI agents from the ground up — designing architectures, running training experiments, and shipping models into production systems that power the AI assistants of the future.

We are seeking a high-ownership DevOps & MLOps Engineer with 2–3 years of hands-on experience to own and manage our hybrid cloud infrastructure across Azure (Primary Preference) and AWS (Secondary). In this role, you will be responsible for multi-environment cloud provisioning (Dev, Staging, Production), automated wildcard subdomain routing, API Gateways, centralized logging stacks, database reliability, cloud cost governance, and text-to-speech (TTS) AI pipelines across multiple internal applications.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Cloud Infrastructure & Automation (IaC)

* Manage secure multi-environment (Dev/Staging/Prod) provisioning on Azure and AWS using Terraform modules.
* Standardize container build workflows and infrastructure state management.

2. Networking, Subdomain Routing & Gateways

* Automate wildcard subdomains, CNAME mappings, and ingress routing.
* Manage API Gateways (Azure APIM, AWS API Gateway, NGINX, Traefik, Kong).
* Handle SSL/TLS lifecycles via Cloudflare, Azure Key Vault, or AWS ACM.

3. AI, Speech & Storage Pipelines

* Maintain low-latency TTS integration pipelines (AWS Polly, Azure Speech Services).
* Optimize AWS S3/Azure Blob Storage lifecycle rules, access controls, and CDN delivery.

4. Database Administration & Performance

* Manage, tune, and scale PostgreSQL and Redis databases.
* Configure PgBouncer, read-replicas, automated snapshots, and point-in-time recovery.

5. Cost Governance & Observability

* Audit/optimize Azure/AWS spending (Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, rightsizing).
* Maintain centralized logging (ELK, Loki, CloudWatch) and metrics dashboards (Prometheus, Grafana).

6. Security, CI/CD & MLOps

* Enforce Zero-Trust IAM, secrets management (Azure Key Vault, AWS Secrets Manager), and OAuth/JWT auth.
* Manage CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) for Node.js/Python microservices.
* Deploy ML inference endpoints (MLflow, BentoML, SageMaker, Azure ML).

**CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS**

* Experience Level: 2–3 Years
* Educational Requirement: B.Tech / B.E. / B.S. in Computer Science, IT, or related technical field

**Must Have Skills:**

* Experience: 2–3 years of proven hands-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Platform, or Systems Engineering in a fast-paced environment.
* Hybrid Cloud: Direct experience managing workloads on AWS (Primary) and exposure to Azure as well.
* Infrastructure as Code: High proficiency in writing declarative, modular Terraform code.
* Database Management: Practical experience with PostgreSQL and Redis administration, query tuning, and automated backup strategies.
* Networking & Gateways: Hands-on setup of API Gateways, wildcard DNS routing, and SSL certificate management.
* Audio & Cloud Storage: Experience integrating cloud Speech/TTS APIs (AWS Polly / Azure Speech) and handling cloud object storage (S3 / Azure Blob).
* Cost Optimization: Demonstrated track record of auditing and reducing cloud expenditure across AWS or Azure.
* Logging & Monitoring: Setup and management of centralized logging (Loki, ELK, or CloudWatch) and metrics collection (Prometheus + Grafana).
* Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise with Docker and automated pipeline creation via GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (Nice-To-Have)**

* Certifications: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, or HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate.
* MLOps Frameworks: Prior exposure to model deployment frameworks (MLflow, BentoML, TorchServe, Azure ML, or AWS SageMaker).
* Backend Debugging: Ability to read and debug Node.js or Python backend code.

title: Financial Controller - Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
You are a strategic thinker passionate about driving solutions in financial control. You have found the right team.
  
  
As a Financial Controller within the firm, your key mandate is to validate integrity of the PL & Balance sheet by running various checks and balances.
  
  
Financial Controller function is accountable for the integrity of the books and records of the Firm / Lines of Business. The function enables governance of systemic and manual controls, specifically as it impacts the General Ledger & processing systems. As a Financial Controller, your key mandate is to validate integrity of the PL & Balance sheet by running various checks and balances. You will partner & collaborate with multiple Controllers groups, Middle offices, Operations and Technology groups within the firm, to prepare and review financial statements across various JP Morgan legal entities and geographies. Your role will involve working with diverse teams to research, escalate, and resolve exceptions to the general ledger and other interfacing systems, ensuring the integrity of our ledger and risk management systems.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  

* Partner with groups within the firm to prepare and review financial statements across different JPMorganChase legal entities and geographies.
* Work with various teams to research, escalate, and clear exceptions to the general ledger and other interfacing systems in a timely manner to ensure the integrity of ledger and risk management systems.
* Perform monthly general ledger reconciliation and substantiation process.
* Adhere to various regulatory reporting requirements when performing the reporting and month-end close process.
* Support various lines of business with business-wise performance reporting and their query resolution.
* Ensure appropriateness of reference data for account hierarchies.
* Perform various reconciliations (account level, system, inter-company, etc.) to ensure financial and reporting integrity.
* Participate in user acceptance tests during projects on system implementation/changes and other business initiatives.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related business field (2 years experience).
* Basic knowledge of industry standards and regulations for US GAAP and/or IFRS standards.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* CA/MBA with 1 year of relevant experience (controller experience is preferred).
* Strong accounting and finance skills, with the ability to analyze numbers and good knowledge of banking products (e.g., securities, derivatives, etc.).
* Ability to understand and comprehend data flows and their impacts across the ledger, risk management systems, and reporting systems, along with their interrelationships and dependencies.
* Excellent MS Excel (data manipulation, macros, VLOOKUPs, pivot tables), MS Access, and MS PowerPoint skills, as well as strong verbal and written communication.
* Ability to adapt to changing or conflicting priorities and excel during periods of enhanced demand, such as trading or month-end deadlines.
* Basic understanding of transformation/visualization products such as Alteryx, Tableau, UI Path, and other intelligent solutions (skills in these areas will be an added advantage).

Morgan and Chase brands. **About Kinaxis**
Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!
  
  
In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.
  
  
Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
  
  
Location
  
  
Bangalore
  
  
**About The Role**
As Kinaxis expands and scales its operations across different regions, we are creating a new Centre of Excellence (COE) role within our Industry Principal organisation to support the global field teams. The
**COE**
**Industry Principal**
serves as a trusted supporting resource to Kinaxis’ internal teams, offering experience in
**supply chain management**
and
**value-based**
selling capability, and bring consultative selling discipline to every pursuit.
  
  
The
**COE**
**Industry Principal**
sits within Pre-Sales, acting as the backbone of our enterprise engagements. The COE Industry Principal will research and analyses customers business performance and their industries, and uses a consultative, value-based approach to create executive friendly content to be used by the Kinaxis teams for technology transformation engagement.
  
  
Your mission is to work with our global field teams to help customers see, quantify, and believe in the measurable value of Kinaxis’ entire ecosystem.
  
  
You’ll partner with Account Executives, senior Industry Principals, Business Consultants, and Industry Marketing to sharpen our industry content, discovery workshops, develop ROI and TCO models, and translate operational improvements into credible financial outcomes.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Research and analyse prospect and customer business performance and provide improvement opportunity insights to be enabled by Kinaxis capabilities.
* Provide input and help with Strategic Value Assessment (SVA) activities for prospects including, quantify ROI and business impact using customer data, industry benchmarks, and financial modelling tools (e.g., APQC, Finlistics).
* Work with Senior Industry Principals map current-state and future-state processes.
* Help develop board-ready business cases, value scorecards, and executive presentations that support investment decisions.
* Help the field team rebuild and maintain key enablement assets, including the industry pitch deck, Industry AI narrative, customer story, and value realisation framework.
* Help Senior Industry Principals to coach and enable Sales on value-based discovery and industry AI storytelling (Command of the Message, MEDDPICC, etc.).
* Help to continuously improve our Industry Principal services and value based selling methodology.

What we are looking for
  
  

* Batchelor degree with 3+ years in Value Engineering, Solution Consulting, or Business Analysis within enterprise software.
* Strong working knowledge of natural language AI platforms (ChatGPT, Copilot, …)
* Strong prompting skills, understand the output of AI models, be able to validate AI outcome, and source checking.
* Strong financial and analytical skills for building ROI, TCO, and payback models.
* Proven ability to create deliverable content from discovery workshops and translate insights into Kinaxis proposition
* Exceptional presentation, analytical, and creative content creation
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, consultative sales environment helping teams across multiple regions.

**Desirable**

* Master’s degree / MBA, and degree / certification in prompt engineering
* Familiarity with, MEDDPICC, or equivalent structured enterprise-sales methodologies.
* Experience with advance planning systems (APS) and/or related solutions such as ERP, TMS, FMS platforms.
* Ability to collaborate with Marketing to craft data-backed customer narratives and case studies.

**#Associate #Intermediate**
**Work With Impact:**
Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
  
  
**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:**
Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.
  
  
**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:**
Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
  
  
People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:
  
  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs, training, and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .
  
  
Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.
  
  
Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
Arena Investors, LP ("Arena") is a global investment management firm that seeks to generate attractive risk adjusted, consistent and uncorrelated returns by employing a fundamentals based, asset-oriented financing and investing strategy across the entire credit spectrum in areas where conventional sources of capital are scarce.  Arena specializes in off-the-run, stressed, distressed, illiquid and esoteric special situation transactions through originations and acquisitions of asset-oriented investments across a wide array of asset types (including but not limited to private direct corporate credit, commercial real estate bridge lending, and commercial and consumer assets).

Quaestor Advisors, LLC ("Quaestor") is an affiliated Special Servicer, which provides mid- and back-office services, including asset management, to Arena Investors and external clients.

Quaestor is looking to expand the team through the addition of an experienced Accounts Receivable Specialist. In this role, this individual will work within the Corporate Accounting team.  Ideal candidates will be organized, self-motivated, resourceful and able to work effectively with all internal functional groups.

Responsibilities:

* Own the end‑to‑end Accounts Receivable (AR) roll‑forward, ensuring accurate recognition and tracking of billings, cash receipts, expense recoveries, and customer balances in accordance with accounting policies and internal controls
* Perform monthly reconciliations of AR balances to the general ledger and supporting schedules, investigating and resolving variances to ensure completeness and accuracy of financial reporting
* Produce and present quarterly Key Performance Indicators to senior members of the Arena team
* Partner closely with Operations, Asset Management, Treasury, and Accounting to support the billing and collections cycle, proactively managing timing, data integrity, and issue resolution to ensure timely recovery of amounts due to the management company
* Act as a key point of contact for stakeholder inquiries, researching and resolving stakeholder balance questions, unapplied cash, and aging items with a focus on clear communication and timely closure
* Review and monitor daily cash activity, coordinating with Treasury Accountant to ensure accurate and timely recording of receipts and transfers in NetSuite, including oversight of AR‑related wire activity
* Process and review cash transfers, ensuring appropriate documentation, approvals, and accounting treatment
* Prepare and analyze monthly balances and management reporting, providing clear insights into overdue balances, collection risks (e.g. balances due from non-performing borrowers), and trends for Finance leadership
* Support the month‑end close process by ensuring balances are accurate, well‑supported, and compliant with internal accounting standards
* Identify opportunities to enhance processes, controls, and reporting across the AR function, partnering with stakeholders to implement improvements that drive efficiency, accuracy, and scalability

**Requirements**

* Demonstrate ability to operate effectively in a fast‑paced, deadline‑driven accounting environment, with a strong focus on accuracy, controls, and ownership of outcomes
* Very strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with senior department leaders across Asset Management, Finance, Operations, and Treasury
* Solid accounting foundation is a must, given the complexity associated with the firm's intricate interactions with a multitude of counterparts. An understanding of general ledger integration, reconciliations, and financial reporting is a must
* Proactive mindset with the ability to identify issues, assess root causes, and implement practical process improvements
* Qualified CA preferred.
    
    
  This job description is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, and duties may change.

Work with a dynamic, global team in a high-visibility role that provides advice to the Commercial organization on risk appetite, risk limit utilization and market risk mitigation strategies, and risk assessments and insights to senior management

title: Assistant Manager / Manager MEP QS - Corporate Office Ulsoor Bangalore
description:
Job Description: Manager – MEP Quantity Surveying (QS)
  
  
Position: Manager – MEP Quantity Surveying
  
  
Experience Required: 8 to 10 Years
  
  
Domain Focus: Hospitality Projects (Luxury Hotels, Resorts, High-End Commercial Developments)
  
  
Location: [Specify Location / Head Office / Site]
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
The Manager – MEP Quantity Surveying will lead and oversee end-to-end commercial management, cost control, procurement, contract administration, and estimation for all Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Firefighting (MEP/HVAC) services across hotel and resort developments. This role requires extensive expertise in high-specification hotel systems, central plant works, energy-efficiency solutions, value engineering, and managing high-value subcontracts from pre-conception through final account closure.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Pre-Contract & Estimation
* BOQ & Cost Preparation: Review MEP tender drawings, technical specifications, and design documents to prepare preliminary estimates, detailed Bill of Quantities (BOQ), and cost plans for HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing, Firefighting, ELV, and BMS systems.
* Value Engineering: Identify opportunities for design optimization and cost reduction without compromising hotel brand standards, luxury finishes, or MEP operational performance.
* Budgeting & Cost Modeling: Establish accurate benchmark metrics (e.g., MEP cost per key, cost per square foot) across different hotel categories (luxury, boutique, mid-scale).
* Procurement & Tendering
* Tender Management: Draft detailed scopes of work, commercial terms, and tender packages for specialized MEP packages.
* Commercial Evaluation: Lead technical-commercial comparative statements, rate analysis, and negotiation processes for MEP subcontractors and major equipment vendors (chillers, boilers, pumps, transformers, generators, ELV systems).
* Vendor Selection: Prequalify and recommend competent MEP contractors and specialized vendors suitable for hospitality-grade quality and timelines.
* Post-Contract & Commercial Management
* Valuation & Certification: Review and certify monthly interim payment applications, variation claims, and extra work orders submitted by MEP contractors against site progress and contract conditions.
* Cost Control & Reporting: Maintain live cost tracking logs, issue monthly project cost reports, monitor budget variances, and provide accurate estimates at completion (EAC).
* Change Order Management: Rigorously evaluate variations, claims for delay/disruption, and price escalations in alignment with contract terms.
* Contract Administration & Closure
* Contract Administration: Draft formal letters, notices, and contractual correspondence related to progress, delays, and variation approvals.
* Final Accounts: Negotiate and settle final accounts with MEP contractors, ensuring all testing/commissioning certificates, operation manuals, as-built drawings, and warranties are handed over smoothly.
* Subcontractor Performance: Evaluate vendor performance during project execution to ensure compliance with quality standards, schedule timelines, and safety guidelines.

**Candidate Qualifications & Technical Skills**

* Education: Bachelor’s Degree / Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering. Professional certification in Quantity Surveying (e.g., MRICS, AIQS) is highly desirable.
* Experience: 8 to 10 years of progressive experience in Quantity Surveying and Commercial Management, with at least 4–5 years dedicated to MEP execution and QS for large-scale hospitality projects (5-star hotels, luxury resorts, mixed-use developments with hotel towers).
* Technical Proficiency:
* In-depth knowledge of MEP systems specific to hotels: central chiller plants, boilers, heat pumps, water treatment plants (WTP/STP), acoustic insulation, guestroom automation systems (GRMS), high-voltage substations, and kitchen/laundry MEP connections.
* Mastery of measurement standards (e.g., NRM, SMM7, IS 1200) and FIDIC / bespoke standard contracts.
* Hands-on proficiency with QS and estimation software (e.g., CostX, AutoBlock, MS Excel, AutoCAD) and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or Candy).

Key Competencies & Soft Skills
  
  

* Strong negotiation, analytical, and contract negotiation capabilities.
* Clear cross-functional communication with MEP design consultants, project management consultants (PMC), hotel operators, and site execution teams.
* Proactive risk identification and solution-driven problem solving under tight timelines.

title: Advanced Engineer - SAP CO
description:
**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Lifestyle**
We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. As a member of HARMAN Lifestyle, you connect consumers with the power of superior sound.
  
  

* Contribute your talents to high-end, esteemed brands like JBL, Mark Levinson, Revel, Denon, and Bowers & Wilkins
* Unite your passion for audio innovation with high-tech product development
* Create pitch-perfect, cutting-edge technology that elevates the listening experience

**What You’ll Be Part Of**
As an SAP CO professional, you will be an individual contributor supporting HARMAN’s SAP S/4HANA transformation program, with a strong focus on Controlling (CO), COPA (Profitability Analysis), and COPC (Product Costing). You will contribute to designing, implementing, and supporting solutions that enable accurate product costing, profitability and margin analysis, cost allocation, month-end close, and financial reporting. You will partner closely with Finance, Supply Chain, IT, and other business stakeholders to ensure seamless integration across SAP FI, MM, SD, PP, and PS. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving complex business challenges, working across functions, and delivering scalable SAP solutions that support business and financial objectives.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Lead the design, configuration, implementation, and support of SAP Controlling (CO) solutions, with a primary focus on COPA (Profitability Analysis), COPC (Product Costing), Material Ledger, Actual Costing, and Cost Object Controlling within an SAP S/4HANA environment.
* Act as the subject matter expert for product costing and profitability analysis, ensuring accurate standard cost calculations, variance analysis, cost allocations, margin reporting, financial reconciliation, and month-end closing activities.
* Continuously partner with colleagues across Finance, Accounting, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, IT, and other business functions to ensure that end-to-end costing, profitability, reporting, and FI/CO integration requirements are effectively designed and delivered.
* Guide the development and optimization of SAP CO processes and solutions, including cost center accounting, project accounting, activity types, allocations, settlements, Material Ledger, group valuation, transfer pricing, and integration with FI, MM, SD, PP, and PS.
* Actively support the establishment of scalable S/4HANA Finance and Controlling best practices, including Universal Journal-based reporting, process optimization, reconciliation controls, advanced analytics, and automation.

**What Makes You A Strong Fit**

* A thorough understanding of SAP Controlling (CO) processes, including COPA (Profitability Analysis), COPC (Product Costing), cost center accounting, project accounting, cost element accounting, allocations, settlements, variance analysis, and month-end closing.
* 5–9 years of SAP CO experience, with deep hands-on expertise in COPA and COPC, along with experience supporting SAP S/4HANA (must-have) transformation and implementation projects.
* Demonstrable knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, Universal Journal (ACDOCA), Material Ledger, Actual Costing, Group Valuation, product costing, profitability reporting, and FI/CO integration.
* Proficiency in integrating SAP CO with FI, MM, SD, PP, and PS, with the ability to analyze end-to-end cost and profitability impacts across purchasing, inventory, manufacturing, sales billing, and project-related transactions.
* Well-versed in manufacturing costing processes, financial and controlling reporting, data reconciliation, and translating financial data into actionable business insights, with strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* We see AI as an important part of how work gets done. While tools may vary, a baseline familiarity with using AI to support efficiency, problem-solving, and quality is expected.

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* A bachelor’s and/or master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, or a related field, with additional advanced education or relevant SAP training being a plus.
* Experience supporting large-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation programs, particularly involving COPA, COPC, Material Ledger, Actual Costing, and Group Valuation.
* Experience with consolidation and reporting solutions such as OneStream.
* Professional certifications in SAP (FI, CO), Project Management (PMP), and Accounting (CPA) are preferred.

**Things To Know**

* You are based in Bangalore and are comfortable working in a hybrid environment that requires working from the Bangalore office three days per week.
* You are comfortable working later hours in India, as needed, to provide sufficient overlap with U.S. time zones and collaborate effectively with U.S. based teams and stakeholders.
* You are fluent in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills, and are comfortable communicating with business and technical stakeholders across global teams.

**What You Can Expect**

* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others).
* Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs.
* Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being.
* Tuition reimbursement support.
* Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available.
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development.

**You Belong Here**
HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.
  
  
**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology**
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
  
  
Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.
  
  
If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!
  
  
**Important Notice: Recruitment Scams**
Please be aware that HARMAN recruiters will always communicate with you from an '@harman.com', ‘@careers.harman.com’ or ‘harmanglobal.avature.net’ email address. We will never ask for payments, banking, credit card, personal financial information or access to your LinkedIn/email account during the screening, interview, or recruitment process. If you are asked for such information or receive communication from an email address not ending in one of the above email domains about a job with HARMAN, please cease communication immediately and report the incident to us through: harmancareers@harman.com.
  
  
HARMAN is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. HARMAN strives to hire the best qualified candidates and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse marketplaces and communities of our global colleagues and customers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. HARMAN attracts, hires, and develops employees based on merit, qualifications and job-related performance.(www.harman.com)

Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. Based in Bengaluru with over 4,500 associates, it powers innovations across omnichannel retail, AI/ML, enterprise architecture, supply chain, and customer experience. For more information, visit Lowes India
  
  
**About The Team**
The Market Intelligence (MI) team of ESS provides external market, supplier, competitor and technology intelligence to support better sourcing and category decisions. We work proactively with category teams to identify opportunities, risks and market shifts early, translating intelligence into actionable insights.
  
  
**I. Job Summary**
The primary purpose of the Market Intel Analyst role is to execute and support Market Intelligence projects. The individual is expected to work in conjunction with Enterprise Strategic Sourcing category leaders & teams and with Market Intel leaders. This position is focused on providing market research, reports/analytics, insights and intelligence as required.
  
  
**II. Roles & Responsibilities**
**Core Responsibilities:**

* Owns specific Market Intelligence trackers/dashboards – category, supplier, regional, etc. Ensures they are refreshed on time and insights are delivered to respective stakeholders.

* Supports data modelling and enrichment exercises required for Market Intelligence and benchmarking.

* Follows up with stakeholders and communicates key market, supplier and category insights/changes.
* Supports configuration and enhancement of Market Intelligence tools and solutions.

**III. Years Of Experience**
2 - 4 years
  
  
**IV. Education Qualification & Certifications**
**Required Minimum Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree
  
  
**V. Skill Set Required**
**Primary Skills (Must have)**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Science, or related field, or equivalent years of experience in lieu of education requirement, if applicable

* Proficiency in market research and data analysis
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
* Proficiency in data collection, collation, analysis, and visualization
* Proficiency in collaboration and communication
* Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Power BI
* Working knowledge of procurement and sourcing tools
* Basic knowledge of AI and its applications in research and analysis

* Exposure to sourcing and procurement
* Cost optimization experience

description:

**About Lowe’s**
Lowe’s is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week in the United States. With total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion, Lowe’s operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com
  
  
Lowe’s India, the Global Capability Center of Lowe’s Companies Inc., is a hub for driving our technology, business, analytics, and shared services strategy. Based in Bengaluru with over 4,500 associates, it powers innovations across omnichannel retail, AI/ML, enterprise architecture, supply chain, and customer experience. From supporting and launching homegrown solutions to fostering innovation through its Catalyze platform, Lowe’s India plays a pivotal role in transforming home improvement retail while upholding strong commitment to social impact and sustainability. For more information, visit Lowes India
  
  
**About The Team**
Internal Audit is an independent assurance/advisory function reporting functionally to the audit committee of the Board and administratively to the Finance function (CFO). IA is responsible for planning, executing, and reporting operational, compliance, financial, and technology audits.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Senior Auditor - SOX will work closely with the Lead Auditor and Audit Senior Manager to support Internal Audit’s SOX Oversight program, including SOX planning activities, independent testing of business process controls, business access controls and applicable IT/application controls, review of management testing, and related reporting and administrative activities. The Senior Auditor will plan and execute assigned SOX procedures; conduct interviews and walkthroughs with process owners; identify key risks and controls; develop and execute test procedures; evaluate control design and operating effectiveness; and prepare and review workpapers that support conclusions reached. The role will use data analysis, process analysis, technical accounting/SOX knowledge, and critical thinking to identify control deficiencies and communicate results clearly to management. The Senior Auditor will coordinate with Management, external auditors, and the U.S. SOX oversight team as appropriate, support quarterly SOX procedures and continuous improvement initiatives, and provide day-to-day guidance and review support to Staff Auditors. While primarily focused on SOX oversight activities, the Senior Auditor may also support SOX modernization/readiness assessments, operational audits of Finance and Accounting processes, issue follow-up, and other departmental initiatives.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**Core Responsibilities:**
SOX Evaluation and Data Integrity
  
  

* Develops SOX work plans and testing procedures for assigned processes and controls in accordance with Lowe’s Audit Methodology and the Company’s SOX 404 assessment approach
* Performs process walkthroughs and risk assessments to understand financial reporting processes, identify key risks and controls, and evaluate whether control design appropriately addresses identified risks
* Independently executes testing of in-scope SOX controls, including business process controls, business access controls, and applicable IT/application controls, and documents results in accordance with workpaper standards
* Reviews management testing, supporting documentation, and control evidence assigned, and identifies and documents control design or operating effectiveness deficiencies based on the analysis performed
* Evaluates testing results, performs data analysis where applicable, and prepares clear summaries of control exceptions, deficiencies, root causes, and risk exposure for review by the Lead Auditor and Audit Senior Manager

**Project Management**

* Coordinates with process owners, Management, internal teams, and external auditors to obtain required information and ensure SOX testing milestones and reporting timelines are met
* Applies working knowledge of SOX, internal controls over financial reporting, accounting, and auditing concepts to execute assigned procedures efficiently and with appropriate professional judgment
* Supports quarterly SOX activities, issue follow-up, remediation validation, and SOX modernization or readiness assessments, as assigned
* Continuously develops knowledge of SOX requirements, auditing standards, business processes, audit tools, and data analytics techniques to improve quality and efficiency
* Efficiently manages multiple assignments and completes testing and documentation within established deadlines
* Provides day-to-day guidance to Staff Auditors, reviews assigned workpapers and testing documentation, and supports their development while escalating significant matters to the Lead Auditor or Audit Senior Manager

**Project Communication**

* Ensures control exceptions, root causes, risk exposures, and management action plans are clearly, accurately, and promptly documented
* Communicates SOX testing status, exceptions, and other matters of concern in a timely and professional manner to the audit team and relevant stakeholders
* Develops and maintains effective working relationships with process owners, Management, external auditors, and SOX stakeholders through consistent and open communication

**Business Influence**

* Provides practical insights and recommendations on control enhancements and process improvement opportunities while maintaining an appropriate level of independence
* Drives for results by meeting project deadlines, maintaining high-quality workpapers, and supporting timely completion of SOX program objectives

**Collaboration With Others**

* Works cross-functionally to organize testing activities, evidence, and review processes and to support an efficient SOX workflow
* Promotes a collaborative environment by sharing knowledge, coaching less experienced auditors, and working effectively with peers, managers, Management, and external audit stakeholders

**Self-Development**

Pebl is looking for a Senior Manager of Global Payments to manage a team of accounts payable specialists to support global payment operations. Based in Bangalore, the role will be highly visible to the leadership team and have strategic as well as tactical and operational opportunities.
  
  
This role requires a commercially minded, data-driven operator who can balance payment processing efficiency, fraud and risk mitigation and regulatory requirements while partnering closely with Payroll, Finance, Treasury and Product. As Pebl’s most senior payments operator, you are accountable for ensuring timely and accurate money movement and reconciliation. Along with Treasury, Procurement and Finance, you will be a part of leadership cohorts that will design and build Pebl’s global payments strategy.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**

* Own the full payments lifecycle

* Maintain and ensure consistent application of AP policies and controls across subsidiaries.

* Drive a “customer” oriented payments journey, ensuring speed, reliability, and ease of use across all touchpoints.

* Hold internal business partners accountable to performance SLAs, cut off deadline, accuracy, speed and reliability over payment needs

* Ability to work with a wider global team and across different time zones if required.

* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail, Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to prioritize and juggle with a variety of tasks

title: Lead Associate Demand
description:
**About The Company**
**Who are we?**
Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary.
  
  
We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit.
  
  
Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in.
  
  
We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us.
  
  
From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.
  
  
Working at Myntra is challenging but fun - we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.
  
  
**Lead Associate Demand**
About the Role
  
  
We are looking for a sharp, data-driven, and user-centric Manager – Storefront Planning & Analytics to own and elevate the Myntra Club storefront (combining Below-The-Line/BTL initiatives and the dedicated in-app shopping experience).
  
  
In this role, you will stand at the intersection of consumer trends, UX design, data analytics, and growth strategy. You will track what’s buzzing in the branded and premium fashion segments, partner with UI/UX teams to build an elite "experience-meets-commerce" ecosystem, and work closely with category leads to curate compelling stories, events, and IPs that drive engagement and revenue.

* Communication & Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a proven track record of synthesizing data into stories for senior stakeholders.

detecting potentially illicit activity targeting First Citizens India client accounts and escalating illicit activity
  
  
to be investigated, when appropriate. This newly set up team will play a crucial role in safeguarding the
  
  
customers and organization from fraud risks by supporting end to end fraud detection, prevention and
  
  
investigation processes.

This position analyzes transactions in multiple payment channels to detect suspicious or high-risk activity.
  
  
This role will help to detect emerging fraud trend, reduce losses and enhance controls. This role offers
  
  
high visibility and direct impact giving the opportunity to shape fraud strategies and contribute to safer
  
  
banking environment.
  
  
Determines the appropriate course of action to mitigate risks and stop further loss, protecting
  
  
compromised accounts to prevent any subsequent fraudulent transactions.

transactions to identify high risk situations, fraudulent activity, and internal control
  
  
breakdowns. Effectively communicates analysis output.
  
  

* Fraud Prevention - Investigates potential risks, fraud, and internal control breakdowns

identified by transaction analysis. Determines the appropriate course of action to stop
  
  
further loss. Ensures compliance with Bank regulations throughout loss prevention
  
  

* Business Support - Serves as a resource for associates and clients to discuss and resolve

fraudulent activity and provides support in resolving complex fraud issues. Protects
  
  
compromised accounts to prevent subsequent fraudulent transactions. Communicates
  
  
effectively with associates, clients, operations, and peer bank contacts on fraud prevention
  
  
activity and techniques.
  
  

* Reporting - Tracks metrics based on analysis and case information for reporting purposes.

Conveys emerging trends.

* Fraud Detection & Investigation – Ability to analyze transactional data and detect patterns indicative of fraud activity across various payment channels (ACH, wires etc.)
* Risk Assessment – Evaluate fraud risks and apply appropriate decision-making frameworks to prevent losses while minimizing customer impact.

* Communication & Reporting – Strong verbal and written communication skills to document findings and communicate with internal team’s customers and regulatory bodies when required
* Collaboration & Stakeholder management – Ability to work effectively with cross functional teams including compliance, legal, operations and technology partners.
* Time management & Prioritization – Capable of managing multiple fraud alerts and cases simultaneously in a fast-paced high-volume environment.

**Technical Skills**
Fraud detection tools and platforms – Typically, 4 to 6 years of experience in Fraud
  
  
Detection/Investigations or closely related field, including: experience conducting complex investigations
  
  
with platforms like actimize, Falcon, SAS fraud management systems, FICO, NICE or equivalent
  
  
platforms. Data analysis & Interpretation - Proficiency in analyzing large datasets to identify anomalies
  
  
trends and fraud patterns using tools like excel, SQL or SAS. Dashboarding & Reporting tools – Familiarity
  
  
with BI tools such as tableau, power BI or other internal dashboards for fraud reporting and insights.
  
  
Business process Understanding – Ability to map and improve fraud related operational process to drive
  
  
efficiency and enhance controls. Knowledge of regulatory compliance – Awareness of fraud related compliance standards, SAR reporting and internal audit readiness

* Partners: Stake holders and cross functional teams

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Amazon
description:
**Description**
Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS) builds the systems that host and run the comprehensive e-commerce product catalog. We power the online shopping experience for customers worldwide, enabling them to find, discover, and purchase anything they desire. Our scaled, distributed systems process hundreds of millions of updates across billions of products, including physical, digital, and service offerings.
  
  
You will be part of Catalog Support Programs (CSP) team under Catalog Support Operations (CSO) in ASCS Org. CSP provides program management, technical support, and strategic initiatives to enhance the customer experience, owning the implementation of business logic and configurations for ASCS. We are establishing a new centralized Business Intelligence team to build self-service analytical products for ASCS that provide relevant insights and data deep dives across the business. By leveraging advanced analytics and AI/ML, we will transform catalog data into predictive insights, helping prevent customer issues before they arise. Real-time intelligence will support proactive decision-making, enabling faster, data-driven decisions across the organization and driving long-term growth and an enhanced customer experience.
  
  
We are looking for a creative and goal-oriented BI Engineer to join our team to harness the full potential of data-driven insights to make informed decisions, identify business opportunities and drive business growth.
  
  
This role requires an individual with excellent analytical abilities, knowledge of business intelligence solutions, as well as business acumen and the ability to work with various tech/product teams across ASCS. This BI Engineer will support ASCS org by owning complex reporting and automating reporting solutions, and ultimately provide insights and drivers for decision making.
  
  
You must be a self-starter and be able to learn on the go. You should have excellent written and verbal communication skills to be able to work with business owners to develop and define key business questions, and to build data sets that answer those questions.
  
  
As a Business Intelligence Engineer in the CSP team, you will be responsible for analyzing petabytes of data to identify business trends and points of customer friction, and developing scalable solutions to enhance customer experience and safety. You will work closely with internal stakeholders to define key performance indicators (KPIs), implement them into dashboards and reports, and present insights in a concise and effective manner. This role will involve collaborating with business and tech leaders within ASCS and cross-functional teams to solve problems, create operational efficiencies, and deliver against high organizational standards. You should be able to apply a breadth of tools, data sources, and analytical techniques to answer a wide range of high-impact business questions and proactively uncover new insights that drive decision-making by senior leadership. As a key member of the CSP team, you will continually raise the bar on both quality and performance. You will bring innovation, a strategic perspective, a passionate voice, and an ability to prioritize and execute on a fast-moving set of priorities, competitive pressures, and operational initiatives. There will be a steep learning curve, adding a fair amount of business skills to the individual.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Work closely with BIEs, Data Engineers, and Scientists in the team to collaborate effectively with product managers and create scalable solutions for business problems
* Create program goals and related metrics, track progress, and manage through obstacles to help the team achieve objectives
* Identify opportunities for improvement or automation in existing data processes and lead the changes using business acumen and data handling skills
* Ensure best practices on data integrity, design, testing, implementation, documentation, and knowledge sharing
* Contribute to supplier operations strategy development based on data analysis
* Lead strategic projects to formalize and scale organizational processes
* Build and manage weekly, monthly, and quarterly business review metrics
* Build data reports and dashboards using SQL, Excel, and other tools to improve business efficiency across programs
* Understand loosely defined or structured problems and provide BI solutions for difficult problems, delivering large-scale BI solutions
* Provide solutions that drive the team's business decisions and highlight new opportunities
* Improve code quality and optimize BI processes
* Demonstrate proficiency in a scripting language, data modeling, data pipeline design, and applying basic statistical methods (e.g., regression) for difficult business problems

A day in the life
  
  
A day in the life of a BIE-II will include:
  
  

* Working closely with cross-functional teams including Product/Program Managers, Software Development Managers, Applied/Research/Data Scientists, and Software Developers
* Building dashboards, performing root cause analysis, and sharing actionable insights with stakeholders to enable data-informed decision making
* Leading reporting and analytics initiatives to drive data-informed decision making
* Designing, developing, and maintaining ETL processes and data visualization dashboards using Amazon QuickSight
* Transforming complex business requirements into actionable analytics solutions.

**About The Team**
This central BIE team within ASCS will be responsible for building a structured analytical data layer, bringing in BI discipline by defining metrics in a standardized way and establishing a single definition of metrics across the catalog ecosystem. They will also identify clear sources of truth for critical data. The team will build and maintain the data pipelines for critical projects tailored to the needs of ASCS teams, leveraging catalog data to provide a unified view of product information. This will support real-time decision-making and empower teams to make data-driven decisions quickly, driving innovation. This team will leverage advanced analytics that can shift us to a proactive, data-driven approach, enabling informed decisions that drive growth and enhance the customer experience. This team will adopt best practices, standardize metrics, and continuously iterate on queries and data sets as they evolve. Automated quality controls and real-time monitoring will ensure consistent data quality across the organization.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
* Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
* Experience developing and presenting recommendations of new metrics allowing better understanding of the performance of the business
* Experience writing complex SQL queries
* Bachelor's degree in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, finance or equivalent quantitative field
* Experience applying basic statistical methods (e.g. regression, t-test, Chi-squared) as well as exploratory, deterministic, and probabilistic analysis techniques to solve complex business problems.
* Experience gathering business requirements, using industry standard business intelligence tool(s) to extract data, formulate metrics and build reports.
* Track record of generating key business insights and collaborating with stakeholders.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively present data insights to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior management

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
* Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
* Master's degree in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, finance or equivalent quantitative field
* Proven track record of conducting large-scale, complex data analysis to support business decision-making in a data warehouse environment
* Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into data-driven solutions and vice versa
* Relentless curiosity and drive to explore emerging trends and technologies in the field
* Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design
* Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis, as well as exploratory, deterministic, and probabilistic analysis techniques
* Experience in designing and implementing custom reporting systems using automation tools
* Knowledge of how to improve code quality and optimizes BI processes (e.g. speed, cost, reliability)

title: Analyst, Algorithm Research & Development
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Measurement, Analytics and Control (MACH) division is KLA’s software powerhouse, responsible for developing high-performance software platforms that support semiconductor manufacturing. MACH delivers cutting-edge technologies in patterning analytics, modeling, and data science—empowering chipmakers to ramp next-gen devices faster and more efficiently. Our cross-functional team of research scientists, software engineers, apps engineers and process engineers are solving the industry’s most complex technical problems.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an intellectually curious and technically exceptional AI Engineer to join our Applied AI Research organization.
  
  
This role is designed for individuals who enjoy moving beyond application of established techniques and are motivated by solving problems that have no obvious solution. The successful candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with expertise in machine learning, statistical algorithms, deep learning, and agentic AI systems to create next-generation intelligence platforms for semiconductor manufacturing and engineering.
  
  
Unlike traditional software engineering roles, this position requires a strong research mindset. We are looking for engineers who question assumptions, derive first-principles understanding of problems, conduct systematic experimentation, and translate emerging research into practical business impact.
  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to grow into a future technical and research leader capable of influencing the direction of AI, analytics, and intelligent automation across the organization.
  
  
**Vision for the Role**
Over the next several years, this individual is expected to evolve from an AI engineer into a recognized research leader who:
  
  

* Shapes the organization's AI strategy through technical innovation.
* Drives a culture of experimentation and evidence-based decision making.
* Bridges cutting-edge AI research with real-world engineering applications.
* Identifies transformational technologies before they become mainstream.
* Inspires teams to pursue ambitious technical challenges.
* Builds an innovation ecosystem through mentorship, technical leadership, and collaboration.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Applied AI Research**

* Investigate emerging AI techniques and evaluate their applicability to semiconductor manufacturing and engineering workflows.
* Conduct hands-on research in areas such as:

+ Foundation Models
+ Agentic AI Systems
+ Scientific Machine Learning
+ Computer Vision
+ Reinforcement Learning
+ Probabilistic Modeling
+ Knowledge Representation
+ Multi-Agent Systems
+ Causal AI

* Develop novel approaches for solving difficult engineering and manufacturing problems.
* Design rigorous experimental frameworks to validate hypotheses and quantify impact.
* Translate research findings into scalable product capabilities.

**Statistical Learning & Algorithm Development**
Design and develop advanced algorithms utilizing:
  
  

* Bayesian Inference
* Probabilistic Graphical Models
* Design of Experiments (DOE)
* Time-Series Analysis
* Optimization Techniques
* Causal Inference
* Anomaly Detection
* Predictive Modeling
* Multivariate Statistics
* Graph Analytics

Responsibilities include:
  
  

* Creating explainable and scientifically sound models.
* Evaluating statistical significance of experimental outcomes.
* Building decision-support and autonomous reasoning systems.

**Deep Learning & Scientific AI**
Develop next-generation deep learning solutions for:
  
  

* Defect Management
* Yield Analytics
* Manufacturing Optimization
* Image Understanding
* Pattern Recognition
* Engineering Knowledge Discovery

Work with and innovate on:
  
  

* CNNs
* Vision Transformers
* Multimodal Models
* Graph Neural Networks
* Self-Supervised Learning
* Representation Learning
* Foundation Models
* Diffusion Architectures

Candidates should be comfortable reading research papers, reproducing published techniques, and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  
  
**Agentic AI & Intelligent Systems**
Develop intelligent autonomous systems capable of:
  
  

* Planning
* Reasoning
* Tool Usage
* Workflow Orchestration
* Long-Horizon Goal Achievement

Build sophisticated AI systems using:
  
  

* LangGraph
* Semantic Kernel
* AutoGen
* CrewAI
* OpenAI Agent Frameworks
* MCP (Model Context Protocol)

Examples include:
  
  

* AI Copilots
* Manufacturing Assistants
* Engineering Intelligence Platforms
* Autonomous Analytics Systems
* Knowledge Agents

**Software Engineering Excellence**
Develop production-grade solutions using:
  
  
**Primary Languages**

* Python
* Modern C++ (C++17/20)

**Additional Technologies**

* PyTorch
* Ray
* Spark
* Kubernetes
* Docker
* Vector Databases
* Graph Databases

The candidate should be able to transform research prototypes into scalable and maintainable products.
  
  
**Research Leadership Expectations**
Although this is an individual contributor role, the candidate is expected to actively contribute to building a research culture.
  
  
This includes:
  
  

* Leading technical reading groups.
* Reviewing and discussing recent research papers.
* Driving internal innovation initiatives.
* Mentoring junior engineers on research methodology.
* Promoting first-principles thinking.
* Encouraging experimentation and hypothesis-driven development.
* Establishing engineering rigor around benchmarking and evaluation.

Success is measured not only by feature delivery but also by the advancement of the team's collective technical capability.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
**Education**
MS or PhD preferred in:
  
  

* Computer Science
* Machine Learning
* Artificial Intelligence
* Statistics
* Applied Mathematics
* Electrical Engineering
* Related STEM discipline

**Experience**
Typically:
  
  

* BS + 5 years
* OR MS + 3 years
* OR PhD

Demonstrated experience in building production AI systems while maintaining strong interest in research and innovation.
  
  
**Ideal Candidate Profile**
The ideal candidate is someone who:
  
  

* Reads research papers for fun.
* Questions conventional assumptions.
* Enjoys tackling open-ended technical challenges.
* Can move seamlessly from theory to implementation.
* Has strong mathematical intuition.
* Is passionate about creating new knowledge, not merely applying existing solutions.
* Wants to become a future Principal Engineer, Distinguished Engineer, or AI Research Leader.

**What Success Looks Like After 3-5 Years**
This engineer will have:
  
  

* Become a recognized technical authority in AI and analytics.
* Influenced the AI roadmap for multiple products.
* Originated innovations that materially impact product differentiation.
* Built a thriving culture of experimentation and technical excellence.
* Mentored the next generation of AI engineers and researchers.
* Established KLA as a leader in AI-native semiconductor manufacturing intelligence.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
  
  
*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*
