title: Technical Lead
description:
**Job Summary – AI Technical Lead.**

* Kumaran Systems is looking for an experienced
  **AI**
  **Lead (Technical)**
  to lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable, production-ready AI/ML solutions within its
  **Equity Market Technology -Capital Markets domain.**

* The role will drive innovation in
  **Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI workflows, and intelligent automation using the Microsoft Azure cloud platform**
  .

* The candidate will
  **provide technical leadership to a team of AI engineers**
  , collaborate closely with stakeholders, data scientists, and platform teams, and translate business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable AI solutions.

* The role requires strong hands-on
  **technical expertise, solution architecture capabilities, and the ability to lead AI initiatives from Concept to Production.**

**Details of Employment:**

**Location:**
Chennai, India

**Work Location**
– Guindy Olympia Tech Park OR SIPCOT Siruseri.

**Mode of Employment**
- 3 days Hybrid in the Office.

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time, Permanent.

**Notice Period**
- 0 to 15 days from the date of the offer (
**Critical Requisition; hence the ask**
)

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI Architecture and Solution Design**

* Architect and lead the development of enterprise-grade RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, vector databases, embedding models, and retrieval strategies using Azure AI Search, FAISS, and Pinecone.
* Design and implement Agentic AI systems incorporating autonomous agents, multi-step planning, tool orchestration, reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Develop AI solutions that integrate with internal systems, including trading platforms, operations workbenches, and risk engines, to automate decision support, exception handling, and reporting.
* Establish standards for prompt engineering, AI guardrails, and evaluation frameworks, including offline evaluations, A/B testing, and automated regression testing.

**2. Azure Cloud and AI Platform Engineering**

* Lead the design, implementation, and management of AI/ML infrastructure on Microsoft Azure using Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Design scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient AI inference pipelines using caching, request batching, and token-budget optimization.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML models and AI agents, incorporating model versioning, controlled deployments, A/B testing, rollback mechanisms, and observability.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise cloud governance, data residency, and security requirements using Azure Private Endpoints, Managed Identity, Key Vault, and related security controls.

**3. AI Performance Optimization and Troubleshooting**

* Diagnose and resolve production AI performance issues, including inference latency, embedding drift, retrieval quality degradation, hallucinations, and context-window limitations.
* Monitor and optimize token consumption, API rate limits, throughput, and cost per query across production AI workloads.
* Establish AI observability through structured logging, distributed tracing across prompt processing, retrieval, and generation, and dashboards tracking latency (p50/p95/p99), retrieval recall, and answer relevance.
* Conduct root-cause analysis of AI system failures, including incorrect tool invocations, RAG retrieval failures, safety-filter false positives, and model regressions following version upgrades.

**4. Technical Leadership and Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of 4–6 AI/ML engineers, overseeing code reviews, architecture decisions, sprint planning, engineering standards, and professional development.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, data scientists, quantitative teams, and operations leaders to translate business requirements into scalable, production-ready AI solutions.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, model releases, fine-tuning techniques, agent frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, and CrewAI, and AI evaluation methodologies.
* Represent the AI engineering function in technical design reviews, architecture governance forums, and incident post-mortems.
* Drive engineering best practices and continuous improvement across AI solution design, development, deployment, monitoring, security, and operational support.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on AI/ML solutions in production environments.
* Deep hands-on experience with RAG architectures, including vector databases, embedding pipelines, chunking strategies, hybrid search (keyword + semantic), re-ranking, and retrieval evaluation.
* Proven track record of building Agentic AI systems, including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, planning loops, memory management, and fallback strategies.
* Strong proficiency in Azure Cloud services, including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search (formerly Cognitive Search), Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, AKS, and App Service.
* Experience troubleshooting AI performance issues, including inference latency optimization, token budgeting, embedding drift detection, hallucination mitigation, and cost management at scale.
* Proficiency in Python and at least one of the following: C#/.NET or TypeScript/Node.js.
* Experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or CrewAI.
* Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, including transformers, attention mechanisms, fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), RLHF, and evaluation metrics such as BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore, faithfulness, and relevance.
* Experience leading engineering teams of 4+ members in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and prepare clear technical documentation.

Resumes can be shared with
**devika.raju@kumaran.com**

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
As a Software Engineering Manager within MS TECH Order Fulfillment, you will provide strategic product and technical leadership, along with hands-on expertise, to build industry-leading products. You are a systems thinker capable of driving large-scale transformations that maximize value for Ford, our Dealers, and our customers. The role combines high-level strategy, including product vision, AI/ML use-case portfolio, data strategy, and technical roadmaps, with disciplined execution to deliver scalable, resilient, secure, explainable, and highly available solutions in a global environment.
  
  
**Technical Leadership & Vision**

* Serve as the primary technical authority for the Order Generation product suite, defining the evolution of the technology stack, data architecture, AI/ML capabilities, and architectural patterns.
* Lead cross-functional teams through complex integrations, managing dependencies across the broader Order Fulfillment ecosystem to ensure seamless data flow and system interoperability.
* Translate high-level business requirements into actionable technical strategies that align with Ford enterprise standards.

**AI/ML Product Strategy & Innovation**

* Define and execute an AI/ML and data analytics product strategy that converts priority business requirements into a sequenced portfolio of intelligent capabilities and measurable outcomes.
* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI/ML opportunities across forecasting, order generation, decision support, anomaly detection, optimization, and workflow automation using value, feasibility, risk, data readiness, and adoption criteria.
* Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of AI/ML products from discovery, business-case development, experimentation, and MVP validation through industrialization, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, Product, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Legal, Privacy, and business teams to ensure solutions are technically sound, usable, compliant, and aligned with responsible AI principles.
* Establish outcome-based product metrics, experimentation methods, model performance targets, and adoption measures; use evidence and customer feedback to guide investment and roadmap decisions.
* Monitor emerging technologies, including generative AI, agentic AI, foundation models, advanced analytics, optimization, and intelligent automation, and determine where they can create differentiated business value.
* Drive build, buy, or partner assessments and develop scalable patterns for reusable AI/ML services, data products, model APIs, and decision intelligence capabilities.

**Product Strategy & Delivery**

* Partner with business stakeholders to define and execute a multi-year product vision and roadmap focused on optimized order forecasting and generation.
* Champion an iterative, Agile delivery model, prioritizing the delivery of Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) and maintaining a high-velocity release cadence.
* Apply Human-Centered Design (HCD) principles to ensure technical solutions solve real-world problems for Dealers and customers.
* Create launch and adoption plans that include operational readiness, user training, change management, benefit tracking, and feedback loops.

**Data, Model & MLOps Excellence**

* Ensure AI/ML solutions are supported by trusted, governed, discoverable, and fit-for-purpose data, with clear ownership, lineage, quality controls, and access patterns.
* Guide the implementation of robust MLOps and LLMOps practices covering reproducible experimentation, model registry, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, rollback, and auditability.
* Define controls for model quality, explainability, bias and fairness evaluation, privacy, security, human oversight, and responsible use throughout the product lifecycle.
* Balance predictive accuracy with interpretability, latency, cost, reliability, and business usability when selecting models and architectures.

**Engineering & Operational Excellence**

* Enforce rigorous engineering standards, including Test-Driven Development (TDD), robust CI/CD pipelines, and DevSecOps practices.
* Drive a culture of Full Lifecycle Ownership, where the team is responsible for the design, security, deployment, and operational health of its services.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for system health, code quality, delivery velocity, model performance, data quality, adoption, and realized business value.

**Architectural Design**

* Architect and oversee the development of cloud-native, microservices-based systems designed for global scale, multi-tenancy, and high-performance transactional processing.
* Design interoperable data and AI architectures that support batch and real-time inference, event-driven workflows, APIs, observability, and secure integration with enterprise platforms.

**People Leadership & Talent Development**

* Cultivate a high-performing, diverse team of Software Engineers, Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and ML Engineers through active coaching, mentorship, and career pathing.
* Foster a culture of psychological safety and continuous learning, utilizing blameless retrospectives and regular feedback loops to drive team growth.
* Identify and close skill gaps within the team to keep pace with emerging technologies and industry trends.

**Strategic Collaboration**

* Act as a bridge between the product team and domain experts in Cloud Infrastructure, Data & AI, Cybersecurity, Responsible AI, SRE, and DevOps to reduce portfolio complexity.
* Influence stakeholders across the organization to adopt modern engineering practices, responsible AI controls, reusable data products, and standardized service contracts.

**Technical Execution (Hands-on)**

* Maintain deep technical fluency in the team’s primary languages, frameworks, cloud services, data platforms, and AI/ML toolchain, including Java, Spring Boot, GCP/Azure, Vertex AI, and modern MLOps platforms.
* Lead from the front by participating in architecture and code reviews, resolving complex technical blockers, reviewing model and data design decisions, and occasionally prototyping high-risk or emerging technology concepts.
* Experience: 10+ years of progressive software engineering, digital product, data, or AI/ML solution delivery experience, with a significant portion in engineering and product leadership roles.
* AI/ML Product Leadership: Demonstrated experience strategizing, developing, launching, and scaling AI/ML-based products that address business requirements and deliver measurable operational or customer outcomes.
* Product Strategy: Experience defining product vision, business cases, roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, MVPs, go-to-market or launch plans, adoption strategies, and value-realization metrics for data and AI products.
* Education: Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.
* Certifications: Industry certifications relevant to software engineering, cloud, data, or AI/ML, or a commitment to obtain them within 6 months. GCP Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Machine Learning Engineer, or equivalent certification is a plus.
* Cloud Expertise: 4+ years of experience delivering production solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including cloud-native application and data/AI services.
* Technical Depth: Expertise in microservices, cloud-native architectures, event-driven architectures, APIs, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), distributed systems, and secure enterprise integration.
* AI/ML & Analytics: Strong working knowledge of supervised and unsupervised learning, time-series forecasting, optimization, anomaly detection, feature engineering, model evaluation, experimentation, and production inference patterns.
* Data Engineering: Experience with data architectures, data pipelines, data quality, governance, metadata and lineage, feature stores, batch and streaming data, and analytics platforms.
* MLOps / LLMOps: Hands-on experience establishing or governing CI/CD/CT for models, experiment tracking, model registry, automated validation, deployment, observability, drift monitoring, retraining, and lifecycle controls.
* Responsible AI: Experience applying secure and responsible AI practices, including privacy, transparency, explainability, bias and fairness assessment, human oversight, access controls, risk management, and auditability.
* Technology Stack: Hands-on experience with Java, Angular, Python, SQL, Terraform, Postgres, APIGEE, Kubernetes, Docker, serverless technologies, and containerization. Experience with Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, or equivalent cloud services is strongly preferred.
* Engineering Excellence: Thorough knowledge of multi-threading, concurrency, parallel processing, DevSecOps, test automation, and monitoring tools such as Dynatrace or Google Cloud Monitoring.
* Developer Experience: Experience increasing developer productivity by integrating AI agents, coding assistants, reusable platform capabilities, or AI skills into the development lifecycle.
* Leadership Qualities: Proven ability to lead large-scale transformations, apply systems thinking, create psychologically safe teams, influence complex decisions, and earn the respect of strong individual technical talent through competence and mentorship.
* Communication & Business Acumen: Ability to communicate complex technical and AI concepts to executives and business partners, align diverse stakeholders, manage trade-offs, and connect product investments to business outcomes.

description:
**Job Description**
**Quant Modeling (AI/ML) Lead - Hyderabad**
**About Control Management**
Control Managers are responsible for having a deep understanding of the business, its underlying processes and the compliance and operational risk and control environment. Subject matter expertise/innovative tools and technology.
  
  
Control Management maintains a strong and consistent control environment across the firm. With Control Managers appointed for each Line of Business, Function and Region, there is a comprehensive coverage and joint accountability model with the business executive that promotes early operational risk identification and assessment, effective design and evaluation of controls and sustainable solutions to mitigate operational risk.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Quant Modeling team is an integral part of the Controls Room within Control Management, focused on building AI and data science solutions that strengthen control monitoring, analytics, and decision support. The team develops, trains, fine-tunes, and evaluates deep learning and NLP models, including transformer-based and domain-specific architectures, while also building agentic AI systems that support multi-step reasoning, workflow orchestration, tool use, and data integration.
  
  
**Ideal Candidate**
This role is ideal for a hands-on candidate who can build and train NLP/deep learning models, run experiments, fine-tune and evaluate solutions, and design agentic AI systems that apply reasoning, tool use, orchestration, and data integration to practical control management use cases.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Deep learning model training and experimentation: Design and execute hands-on experiments to train and fine-tune deep learning models, including transformer-based models, embedding models, and domain-specific NLP architectures.
* NLP model and custom architecture development: Develop NLP solutions for text classification, information extraction, semantic search, and retrieval-augmented generation, while experimenting with neural network layers, attention mechanisms, pooling strategies, classification heads, and task-specific modules.
* Model optimization, loss function design, and evaluation: Improve model performance through hyperparameter tuning, custom loss functions, systematic error analysis, and benchmarking using technical and business-aligned metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, F1, robustness, and latency.
* Agentic AI system design and architecture: Design and implement multi-agent systems that support multi-turn reasoning, tool use, dynamic decision-making, agent decomposition, memory management, and multi-agent coordination for control management problems.
* Agent orchestration, tooling, and data integration: Build orchestration logic for agent routing, state management, workflow coordination, and integration with tools and data sources that agents use to retrieve information, validate data, and take action.
* LLM behavior, evaluation, and monitoring: Shape agent behavior through prompt design and reasoning patterns, and implement evaluation, observability, and monitoring for accuracy, reliability, reasoning traces, tool calls, and decision auditing.
* Reusable agentic AI patterns and governance: Build reusable agent templates, patterns, and documentation that accelerate delivery, while supporting traceability, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, safeguards, and operational procedures.
* Training data strategy for NLP and deep learning: Partner with control managers, domain SMEs, data owners, and technology teams to understand workflows, decision points, and actionable outcomes; source relevant structured and unstructured data; and curate, label, and validate training and evaluation datasets.
* People management aligned to delivery above: Lead and develop a team delivering these systems by setting priorities, coordinating work across model, agent, tool, and orchestration streams, providing technical guidance, and ensuring quality, reliability, documentation, and delivery standards.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* 15+ years of experience building production or near-production software, data, ML, or backend systems.
* Strong hands-on Python skills, including debugging, testing, and writing maintainable production code.
* Hands-on experience building, training, fine-tuning, evaluating, and deploying AI/ML, NLP, or deep learning models.
* Strong understanding of LLMs, transformers, embeddings, and generative AI concepts.
* Hands-on experience with at least one LLM or agentic AI framework.
* Experience building LLM-based or agentic AI systems with tool use, orchestration, state management, routing, and multi-step reasoning.
* Experience integrating APIs, tools, data services, and enterprise systems into AI/ML or software solutions.
* Experience implementing agent memory, context management, and multi-turn conversation patterns
* Strong independent problem-solving skills and ability to work through ambiguity.
* Clear communicator and effective cross-functional collaborator.

* Production/enterprise experience building or deploying agentic systems
* Familiarity with production monitoring, logging, error handling, and operational support.

title: Cloud Sales Specialist
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  
NTT DATA is a strategic technology services and solutions partner of AWS, Microsoft Azure and

Google Cloud, helping enterprises modernize their technology environments and accelerate

cloud, data and AI transformation.

We are looking for an experienced Cloud Specialist Sales professional to drive cloud-led

business development and Sales across NTT DATA’s enterprise client base. The role will operate

within NTT DATA India working horizontally across Client Management, Business Units,

hyperscaler alliance teams, solutioning/presales and delivery organisations.

The Cloud Specialist Seller will act as a cloud subject-matter sales leader and opportunity

orchestrator, identifying and creating cloud transformation opportunities, shaping customer

conversations, developing qualified pipelines and bringing the right NTT DATA and hyperscaler

capabilities together to progress opportunities through to closure.

The role requires someone who can operate effectively across organisational boundaries,

influence without direct authority, engage senior customer stakeholders and translate cloud

technology capabilities into measurable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Cloud Business Development & Pipeline Creation
* Develop and execute cloud sales strategies across an assigned portfolio of enterprise customers.
* Identify opportunities across cloud migration, modernization, application transformation, infrastructure modernization, cloud-native development, managed cloud services and cloud optimization.
* Proactively create demand rather than relying solely on existing account pipeline.
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified cloud opportunities and achieve agreed

sales/revenue targets.

* Identify opportunities to expand existing NTT DATA relationships through cloud-led transformation initiatives.
* Develop account-level cloud whitespace maps covering AWS, Azure and GCP opportunities.

  

* Client Engagement & Consultative Selling
* Engage with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, business leaders and technology decision-makers to understand transformation priorities.
* Lead executive-level conversations around the business value of cloud, rather than selling individual cloud products.
* Understand customer technology landscapes, transformation roadmaps, business drivers and pain points.
* Position NTT DATA’s capabilities together with hyperscaler technology to develop differentiated customer propositions.

* Build trusted-advisor relationships with customers and establish NTT DATA as a strategic cloud transformation partner
* Matrix / Client Manager Collaboration

As a horizontal specialist organisation, the role will work closely with Client Managers and BU sales teams across NTT DATA.

Key responsibilities include:

* Partner with Client Managers to identify and qualify cloud opportunities within strategic accounts.
* Work across multiple BUs to leverage existing customer relationships and industry expertise.
* Establish joint account plans with Client Managers and BU leadership.
* Support Client Managers with cloud-specific opportunity identification, qualification and

strategy.

* Bring specialist cloud expertise into broader account planning and customer engagements.
* Maintain clear ownership and engagement models with Client Managers to avoid channel conflict and ensure a coordinated customer experience.
* Influence stakeholders across the matrix without relying on direct reporting authority.

  

* Hyperscaler Alliance Engagement
* Develop strong working relationships with AWS, Microsoft and Google Cloud sales and technical teams.
* Create joint account strategies and opportunity plans with hyperscaler sellers.
* Leverage hyperscaler funding, migration programs, assessments, workshops, incentives

and partner programs to accelerate opportunities.

* Coordinate joint customer engagements involving NTT DATA and hyperscaler teams.
* Build differentiated propositions leveraging NTT DATA’s services capabilities and

hyperscaler platforms.

* Track hyperscaler ecosystem developments and translate relevant capabilities into customer opportunities.

  

* Opportunity Shaping & Sales Leadership
* Lead the commercial sales strategy for qualified cloud opportunities.
* Develop opportunity plans covering customer business problem, solution proposition,

stakeholders, competition, commercial model and path to closure.

* Coordinate with solution architects, presales, delivery, commercial and legal teams.
* Ensure opportunities are appropriately qualified before significant presales investment.
* Lead proposal strategy, customer presentations, workshops and executive engagements.
* Maintain accurate CRM hygiene, forecasting and opportunity reporting.
Drive opportunities from initial qualification solution shaping proposal

negotiation closure.

C. Cloud Solution & Commercial Understanding

The successful candidate should have sufficient technical understanding to engage credibly with customers and technical stakeholders across:

* Cloud migration and modernization
* IaaS / PaaS / SaaS

  

* Cloud-native architectures
* Containers and Kubernetes
* Data platforms and analytics
* AI/ML and Generative AI workloads
* Cloud security
* Networking and hybrid cloud
* DevOps / DevSecOps
* FinOps and cloud optimization
* Managed cloud services

The role is not expected to be the primary technical architect, but must be able to understand customer requirements, challenge solution assumptions and connect technical capabilities to business outcomes.

**7. Internal Orchestration**
=============================

The specialist seller will act as the single-threaded sales orchestrator for cloud opportunities, bringing together:

Client Manager BU Cloud Specialist Presales/Solution Architecture Delivery Hyperscaler Commercial/Finance

Responsibilities include:

* Establishing the right internal team for each opportunity.
* Creating clear roles, responsibilities and next steps.
* Driving opportunity cadence and governance.
* Removing internal blockers.
* Ensuring commercial, solution and delivery stakeholders remain aligned.

Maintaining momentum from opportunity creation through closure.

Required Qualifications:

* 8–10+ years of enterprise technology sales experience, preferably including significant cloud sales experience.
* Proven experience selling AWS, Azure and/or GCP solutions/services.
* Experience in a Systems Integrator, IT Services company, hyperscaler or technology

consulting organisation preferred.

* Demonstrated experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Experience working in a matrixed organisation is highly desirable.
* Experience selling through or alongside hyperscaler partner ecosystems preferred.

Technical & Business Skills

Strong understanding of:

* AWS / Azure / GCP cloud platforms
* Cloud transformation and modernization
* Data & AI workloads
* Cloud economics and business cases
* Enterprise architecture concepts
* Managed services

* Cloud security
* Digital transformation

Sales Competencies

* Consultative / value-based selling
* Enterprise account planning
* Opportunity qualification
* Pipeline generation
* Executive stakeholder management
* Deal shaping and negotiation
* Partner ecosystem management
* Forecasting
* Cross-functional influence
* Strong communication and presentation skills

**Workplace type****:**

  

**About NTT DATA**  
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune

Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through

responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with

unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and

application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move

confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more

than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as

established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each

year in R&D.

NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. title: Principal Data Platform Engineer
description:
**Overview**
Are you passionate about data platforms and tools? Are you an open-minded, structured thinker who is passionate about building systems at scale. Do you understand data platforms, know how to build them and want to help our users to make data actionable? If so, this role with our team at Atlassian is for you.
  
  
We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our Data Platform Team to build a world class data platform that powers crucial business decisions throughout the organization.
  
  
You will partner with analytics teams, data engineers and data scientists across various initiatives and work with them to understand the gaps and bring your findings back to the team to build these capabilities.
  
  
Working at Atlassian
  
  
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
We build analytical data platforms for Atlassian that serve both Engineering and Data Engineering to help them generate valuable insights from data.
  
  
**As a Principal Engineer On This Team You Will**

* Own the long term architecture and technical direction for core platform capabilities and be accountable for their reliability, cost efficiency and adoption
* Design and build foundational platform components that other engineering teams build on top of, across areas like ingestion, transformation, orchestration, compute and consumption
* Architect robust multi-tenant platform standards by establishing clear cross-layer contracts, tenant isolation, and SLOs to enable autonomous producers and consumers, while driving compute and storage efficiency across workloads
* Lead cross team technical initiatives and architecture reviews, influence platform strategy with senior stakeholders and act as a technical mentor and multiplier for Senior engineers
* Stay hands on. You will be in the code on the hardest problems, not just reviewing designs

**Compensation**
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* 12+ years of software or data engineering experience, with at least 6 years building data platform infrastructure
* You have built a data platform or a significant component of one and operated it in production. For example an ingestion framework, a transformation framework, a compute or query layer, an orchestration layer, a metadata or lineage service or a data quality framework
* You can describe the scale that component ran at in concrete numbers. Data volume, ingest throughput, number of pipelines or jobs, query concurrency and latency, number of onboarded teams or tenants and infrastructure cost.
* Deep understanding of big data and distributed systems challenges including partitioning, shuffle behaviour, skew, idempotency and backfills
* Experience designing both batch and streaming architectures and clear judgement on when each is the right answer
* Expert level programming skills in language such as Java, Kotlin or Python and built solutions on public cloud offerings such as Amazon Web Services
* Experience with big data processing and storage technologies such as Spark, DBT and with open table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake
* A track record of owning ambiguous cross team problems end to end and of influencing without authority
* Degree in Computer Science, EE or a related STEM discipline or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience with high performance analytical or MPP databases such as StarRocks, Druid, ClickHouse or Pinot
* Experience with change data capture and event driven ingestion at high volume
* Experience building a semantic layer or metrics store and governing shared metric definitions
* Experience with the data foundations of ML platforms, such as point-in-time correct training data, online and offline feature parity or backfilling features at scale
* Experience with data governance, access control, lineage and compliance, including regulated environments such as FedRAMP
* Experience running platform components on Kubernetes
* Experience with multi region data architectures, including replication, failover and consistency tradeoffs

Benefits & Perks
  
  
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**
**.**
**About Atlassian**
At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
  
  
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
  
  
To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
**go.atlassian.com/crh**

description:
Come join Analog Devices (ADI) – a place where Innovation meets Impact. For more than 55 years, Analog Devices has been inventing new breakthrough technologies that transform lives. At ADI you will work alongside the brightest minds to collaborate on solving complex problems that matter from autonomous vehicles, drones and factories to augmented reality and remote healthcare.
  
  
ADI fosters a culture that focuses on employees through beneficial programs, aligned goals, continuous learning opportunities, and practices that create a more sustainable future.
  
  
**About Analog Devices**
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
**Associate Industrial Engineer (P1)**
**Job Description Summary**
Analog Devices is seeking an Associate Industrial Engineer to join the Central Industrial Engineering team. This early-career role will support factory performance improvement initiatives across multiple wafer fabrication sites through capacity modeling, data analytics, reporting automation, cycle time reduction, and scheduling optimization. Working alongside experienced Industrial Engineers at local facilities, this position will contribute to the development of cross-site analytical tools and decision-support systems that maximize factory output and enable future expansion planning.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support development and maintenance of cross-site capacity models, factory loadings, and utilization analyses.
* Assist with cycle time improvement initiatives through bottleneck analysis, WIP management, and line balancing activities.
* Analyze factory performance data and identify opportunities to increase throughput, productivity, and equipment utilization.
* Develop and automate reports, dashboards, and analytical tools using SQL, Python, Power BI, and other business intelligence tools.
* Support validation of manufacturing scheduling data, forecasting models, and factory planning assumptions.
* Participate in scenario analysis and what-if modeling to evaluate capacity, output, and resource requirements.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, IT, and Equipment Engineering to support improvement projects.
* Document methodologies, analytical models, and standard work processes.
* Present findings and recommendations to technical and operations teams.
* Build knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing systems, Industrial Engineering methodologies, and factory scheduling concepts.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Systems Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Data Analytics, or related engineering discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Internship, co-op, or academic project experience in manufacturing, operations research, data analytics, or process optimization.
* Familiarity with SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytical tools.
* Coursework in statistics, simulation, optimization, data science, or manufacturing systems.
* Exposure to semiconductor manufacturing or other high-volume manufacturing environments.

**Work Experience**

* 0–2 years of Industrial Engineering or analytical experience.
* Demonstrated ability to work with large datasets and perform quantitative analysis.

title: Lead Product Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Lead Product Engineer to drive our product from first idea to live release and beyond. You will combine hands-on engineering with product ownership: owning the requirements, leading several engineering teams, and making sure what we build is technically sound and matches what customers and the business need.  
This role sits at the centre of product and engineering. You will turn business goals into a clear roadmap and technical plan, shape the architecture, guide teams through design, development, testing and release, and stay hands-on where it matters, through code reviews, prototypes and solving the hardest technical problems. You are accountable for quality, timelines and outcomes.

Key responsibilities  
1. Product development from start to finish

* Shape the product vision and roadmap with leadership, based on business goals, customer feedback and market research.
* Lead each product or feature through its full lifecycle: discovery, requirements, design, development, testing, release and post-launch review.
* Define the minimum viable product (MVP) and plan releases in phases.
* Decide what gets built, what waits and what is dropped, using clear prioritisation (value, effort, risk).
* Review released features against goals and plan improvements.
* 2. Requirements ownership
* Act as the single owner of product requirements and the product backlog.

* Gather requirements from customers, sales, support, operations and leadership; resolve conflicts between them.
* Write clear epics, user stories and acceptance criteria that teams can build and test against.
* Keep the backlog refined, prioritised and ready at least two sprints ahead.
* Manage scope changes through a controlled change process and explain their impact on time and cost.
* Accept or reject completed work against the agreed acceptance criteria.

3. Managing multiple teams4. Technical oversight5. Delivery and stakeholder management

* Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams: development, QA, UI/UX, DevOps and business analysis.
* Plan sprints and releases across teams; manage dependencies, shared resources and handoffs.
* Run or oversee Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives.
* Set clear goals for each team, track progress, and remove blockers quickly.
* Coach team members, give regular feedback, and support hiring and onboarding.
* Build a culture of ownership, quality and open communication.
* Work with architects and tech leads on solution design, technology choices and technical debt.
* Make sure non-functional needs are planned in: performance, security, scalability and reliability.
* Understand APIs, integrations, databases and cloud basics well enough to judge trade-offs.
* Ensure quality through code review practices, test coverage and CI/CD standards.
* Own delivery timelines, budget and risks; raise issues early with options.
* Report progress, risks and results to leadership and stakeholders in plain language.
* Coordinate go-live with support, training, marketing and operations teams.
* Track product metrics and use data to guide decisions.Qualifications and skills

* Strong hands-on coding skills in at least one modern back-end stack (such as Java, Node.js) and working knowledge of a front-end framework (React or Angular).
* Experience designing scalable systems: microservices, REST or GraphQL APIs, relational and NoSQL databases.
* Practical experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP), Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines.
* Hands-on experience with Agile (Scrum or Kanban) and tools such as Jira, Confluence, ClickUp or Azure DevOps.
* Clear written and spoken communication in English; able to explain technical decisions to non-technical people.

Pay: ₹729,000.00 - ₹1,130,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Customer Relationship Management Consultant
description:
Customer Care Transformation Consultant

**Engagement:**
 Monthly contract. Full-time on the client through diagnostics, then a delivery role as the program moves into training and monitoring.

About the role
  

OriginBluy is running a Customer Care Gold Standard program for a large utility that serves more than 23 lakh households through 60+ walk-in service centres and an inbound call centre.

The consultant is our person on the ground: they diagnose how service works today, help define the Gold Standard, and stay through training and monitoring until the client’s own managers can hold the standard.

They report to the Principal Coach and work directly with the client’s customer care leadership, centre managers and call centre teams.

What you’ll do

**Diagnose**

* Run mystery shopping at walk-in centres: brief and calibrate the shoppers, score visits and consolidate the findings
* Select and listen to recorded calls with a focus on outliers (best, worst, repeat and escalated calls) and find the root cause of each: behaviour, process, system or policy
* Interview centre managers, call centre team leads and functional heads
* Pull together existing SOPs, scripts, QA formats and MIS into one baseline

**Define**

* Map the end-to-end customer journey for the top contact reasons, both walk-in and call
* Draft the Gold Standard: interaction standards, scripts, SOPs, escalation paths and the scorecard
* Build the cost-benefit case with client Finance: contact volumes, repeat rates, cost per contact
* Run dry runs of the new standard with a pilot group and refine it

**Deliver and sustain**

* Co-deliver CSE and manager workshops with the trainer
* Administer the Ready-for-floor certification test
* Run post-training mystery shopping and call audits, produce centre-wise scores and prepare packs for leadership reviews
* Coach centre managers and TLs to observe, score and coach against the standard

What you bring

**Must have**

* **10–15 years in customer service operations**
  , including all three of the following:
* **Inbound call centre:**
   managed or ran operations or quality for an inbound voice operation, ideally 50+ seats. Hands-on with call quality monitoring, AHT, first-contact resolution, CSAT and repeat-call analysis.
* **Walk-in service centres:**
   managed a network of customer service centres or branches. Knows queue and token management, counter processes, document-heavy service requests and how to manage a multi-location network.
* **Transformation projects:**
   led at least two service transformation or process improvement projects end to end. This could be SOP standardisation, a service redesign, a contact-centre turnaround, or harmonising processes after a merger, with results you can show.
* Comfortable with data: builds analyses in Excel, works with call logs and MIS, and can turn numbers into a business case
* Can run a good interview and a good workshop. Credible with a functional head and comfortable with a frontline executive.
* **Fluent in Gujarati, Hindi and English**
   (spoken; written Gujarati preferred)
* Willing to travel extensively within Gujarat

**Good to have**

* Experience in utilities, city gas distribution, power distribution, telecom, banking or insurance, meaning large regulated consumer bases with high volumes of service requests
* Familiarity with regulator-defined service standards and complaint timelines (e.g., PNGRB, state electricity regulatory commission norms)
* Lean, Six Sigma (Green Belt or above) or COPC exposure
* Experience with outsourced or agency staffing models in contact centres
* Training delivery or facilitation experience

What success looks like in the first 90 days

* A credible baseline from mystery shopping and call audits that the client’s leadership accepts
* A Gold Standard draft built from the client’s own best interactions, signed off by the client owner
* A cost-benefit case that the client’s Finance team has validated
* Strong working relationships with centre managers and call centre TLs, so that they see the program as support rather than an audit

Personal attributes

* Good at reading and getting on with people on the shop floor; earns trust quickly with frontline teams
* Rigorous with evidence: separates what they saw from what they were told
* Discreet with client data and with individual performance information
* Self-directed and able to run the program on the ground without close supervision

title: Lead Solutions Architecture Engineer
description:
Overview:

**Atlassian Architect**

Job Description

**Department:**

Business Technology – Atlassian Products

**Reports To:**

Manager, Atlassian Products

**Location:**

India – Bangalore (On-site)

**Level:**

Individual Contributor – Senior/Principal

**About HealthEdge**
====================

HealthEdge is a leading healthcare SaaS company delivering modern, cloud-native solutions that transform how health plans operate. With a global workforce spanning the US, India, Philippines, Mexico, and the UK, our Business Technology team powers the tools and platforms that keep HealthEdge running at scale. Atlassian – Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence – is the connective tissue of how work gets planned, tracked, and executed across the entire organization.

**Role Overview**
=================

The Atlassian Architect is the highest-level individual contributor on the Atlassian Products team, responsible for defining platform architecture, setting technical standards, and solving the most complex problems in HealthEdge's Atlassian environment. This is not an administration role – it is a design and engineering role. You will own the decisions that shape how the platform is built, governed, and extended, and your work will directly influence how thousands of employees across the company plan, collaborate, and deliver. As HealthEdge moves fully to Atlassian Cloud Enterprise, the Architect will also shape the platform's AI readiness — ensuring the architecture supports Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo at enterprise scale.

You will serve as the technical authority for the Atlassian Products team – providing architectural guidance, mentoring Senior and regular Administrators, leading complex solution delivery, and acting as the primary point of escalation for problems that require deep platform expertise. You will also own strategic initiatives including instance governance, automation frameworks, API integrations, and migration or consolidation efforts.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Platform Architecture & Standards**
-------------------------------------

* Own the Atlassian platform architecture across Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Confluence, and Atlassian Access – defining how these tools are structured, governed, and extended at scale
* Establish and maintain technical standards for project design, workflow architecture, permission models, field configuration, and Confluence space taxonomy across the organization
* Design scalable, maintainable solutions that balance user needs with platform health – avoiding configuration sprawl and technical debt
* Evaluate new Atlassian capabilities, product roadmap changes, and Marketplace apps – assessing fit, risk, and adoption strategy
* Produce and maintain architectural documentation including design decisions, standards references, and solution blueprints

**Complex Solution Design & Delivery**
--------------------------------------

* Lead discovery and solution design for the most complex stakeholder requests – those that require cross-project thinking, advanced automation, or architectural changes
* Translate ambiguous business requirements from engineering, IT, product, and business functions into well-structured, scalable Atlassian solutions
* Deliver end-to-end implementation of high-complexity configurations, including multi-project workflow frameworks, advanced JSM service architectures, and cross-tool integrations
* Partner with the Manager, Atlassian Products to define and manage the platform improvement roadmap, sequencing initiatives by impact and feasibility

**Automation & Scripting**
--------------------------

* Design and implement advanced automation frameworks using native Jira/JSM automation and ScriptRunner (Groovy) for complex workflow logic, validators, post-functions, and listeners
* Build and maintain REST API integrations between Atlassian tools and external systems including identity platforms, ITSM tools, and business applications
* Establish automation standards and reusable patterns that the broader admin team can follow and extend
* Review and quality-assure automation and scripting work produced by Senior Administrators, providing technical guidance and improvement feedback

**Migrations & Consolidations**
-------------------------------

* Lead or architect Atlassian migration and consolidation projects, including instance-to-instance migrations, Server/Data Center to Cloud transitions, and post-merger platform integrations
* Perform pre-migration assessments including configuration audits, data mapping, and risk analysis
* Design migration runbooks and execute or oversee technical migration steps with appropriate rollback planning
* Ensure data integrity, permission continuity, and minimal disruption to end users throughout migration events

**Enterprise Governance & Security**
------------------------------------

* Own Atlassian Access configuration including SSO, SCIM provisioning, authentication policies, IP allowlisting, and audit log management
* Design and enforce the organization-wide governance model for Atlassian – covering project creation standards, permission scheme governance, license management, and app approval processes
* Lead license optimization efforts, identifying consolidation opportunities and ensuring spend is aligned with actual usage
* Support security and compliance requirements including access reviews, data residency considerations, and audit evidence related to Atlassian platforms
* Serve as the technical lead for any Atlassian-related security incidents, misconfigurations, or compliance findings

**Team Mentorship & Technical Leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Serve as the informal technical lead for the Atlassian Products team – the person Senior and regular Administrators bring their hardest problems to
* Mentor Senior Administrators on advanced configuration, automation, and solution design, actively developing their technical depth
* Conduct technical design reviews for significant platform changes proposed by team members
* Contribute to hiring by participating in technical assessments for Atlassian Administrator and Senior Administrator candidates
* Represent the Atlassian Products team in cross-functional technical forums and architecture discussions

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

**Required**
------------

* 7+ years of deep, hands-on Atlassian platform experience with expert-level proficiency in Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing Atlassian architectures for large, complex organizations (thousands of users, dozens of teams)
* Expert-level proficiency in ScriptRunner (Groovy) scripting for advanced workflow customization, automation, and platform extensions
* Strong REST API experience with Atlassian platforms — building integrations, automating administrative tasks, and extending platform capabilities
* Proven experience leading Atlassian migrations or consolidation projects, including Cloud migrations
* Deep understanding of Atlassian Cloud security and governance including Atlassian Access, SSO/SCIM, and enterprise-scale permission management
* Ability to communicate architectural decisions clearly to both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

**Preferred**
-------------

* Atlassian certifications strongly preferred – ACP-120, ACP-420, ACP-620, or Atlassian Certified Expert (ACE) designation
* Familiarity with how Atlassian platform architecture affects AI indexing quality and Rovo answer relevance
* Experience with advanced Marketplace apps at architectural scale (Insight/Assets, Advanced Roadmaps, ScriptRunner, Elements Connect, Tempo)
* Exposure to enterprise ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and applying them within JSM at an architectural level
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and DevOps tooling that integrates with Atlassian (AWS, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines)
* Experience in a healthcare, SaaS, or other regulated industry environment
* Background in post-merger IT platform integration or multi-instance Atlassian consolidation

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within 90 days, you have completed a thorough assessment of the current Atlassian environment, identified the top architectural gaps and technical debt priorities, and established yourself as the go-to technical authority on the team. Within six months, you have delivered at least one significant platform improvement, established or formalized key governance standards, and are actively mentoring the admin team. Within a year, the Atlassian platform at HealthEdge reflects clear architectural ownership — well-governed, well-documented, and built to scale — and you have meaningfully elevated the technical capability of everyone around you.

**About the Team**
==================

You'll join a dedicated Atlassian Products team that is central to how HealthEdge operates at scale. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role for someone who wants to be the definitive technical expert on a platform that touches every part of the business. You'll have the backing of an engaged manager, a growing team of administrators to mentor, and a real mandate to shape how the platform evolves. If you want to do the most technically interesting Atlassian work of your career, this is that role.

**Geographic Responsibility: This position is located in Bangalore**
  
**Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent**  
**FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt**

* **The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.**
* **Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.**

title: L2 Managed Service Engineer
description:
Role Summary

The Level 2 Managed Service Engineer for the End-to-End Observability team is responsible for advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, Datadog configuration, incident escalation, and continual service improvement across the observability stack. This role serves as the primary escalation point for L1 engineers and is expected to independently resolve, or drive resolution of, moderately complex incidents spanning application, infrastructure, network, APM, Synthetics, logs, and RUM data across both 3-tier and cloud-native environments.

Key Responsibilities

· Act as the first escalation point for incidents triaged by L1 engineers that require deeper investigation.

· Perform root cause analysis (RCA) by correlating APM traces, infrastructure metrics, network telemetry, logs, Synthetics results, and RUM data.

· Configure and fine-tune advanced Datadog capabilities: custom metrics, log pipelines, monitors with composite/anomaly detection, SLOs, and dashboards aligned to service ownership.

· Guide and review Datadog APM instrumentation coverage across services; identify monitoring gaps and recommend improvements.

· Independently identify whether an issue originates in the application tier, infrastructure, network, or a third-party dependency, in both 3-tier and cloud-native (microservices/containerized) environments.

· Lead or actively participate in major incident bridge calls, providing observability data to speed up resolution.

· Own problem management: identify recurring incidents, drive permanent fixes, and track them to closure.

· Mentor and coach L1 engineers on triage techniques, Datadog usage, and escalation quality.

· Contribute to automation of routine monitoring tasks (alert enrichment, auto-remediation triggers, ticket auto-creation).

· Support capacity and performance trend analysis using historical Datadog data.

· Review and refine monitors to reduce noise and false positives (alert tuning).

· Ensure adherence to SLAs/OLAs and maintain quality of incident documentation and RCA reports.

· Participate in client/stakeholder calls to explain incidents, trends, and improvement plans.

Required Skills and Experience

Observability Platform Skills

· 3 to 6 years of experience in Managed Services, NOC, SRE, or application/infrastructure support roles, with at least 1-2 years working hands-on with Datadog.

Understand the customer, the product and the market need; form a clear, evidence-based opinion about how the product can improve; and work with others to turn that opinion into results. title: Microsoft-Pure AI-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**AI Business Solutions –AI Engineer Senior Manager:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a Senior Manager – AI Engineer to lead strategic AI initiatives and drive the design, development, and adoption of agent-based solutions using Microsoft AI technologies. This role combines deep technical expertise with leadership to scale AI-driven transformation across enterprise functions..
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the strategy, design, and delivery of AI-powered solutions using Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and agent-based frameworks.
* Drive enterprise-wide adoption of intelligent agents built using Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel (Python or C#).
* Define architecture standards, best practices, and reusable frameworks for scalable AI solutions.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to identify AI use cases and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Mentor team members and ensure high-quality delivery across AI initiatives.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong expertise in Copilot Studio and enterprise-grade AI agent development.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel (Python or C#).
* Extensive experience with Azure AI Foundry and AI/ML ecosystem.
* Deep understanding of agent-based architectures, orchestration patterns, and enterprise integrations.
* Proven ability to define architecture and lead large-scale AI programs.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic thinking skills.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions within enterprise systems and workflows.
* Translate business requirements into scalable AI architectures and reusable components.
* Ensure solution performance, reliability, and alignment with enterprise security and governance standards.
* Ability to work effectively in distributed, onshore–offshore delivery models.

**Ideally, you’ll also**
The following skills are preferred and add value to the role:
  
  

* Experience with Power Platform.
* Experience with Azure Integration Services.
* Experience supporting large transformation or digital modernization programs
* Familiarity with testing tools, deployment cycles, and release management practices
* Experience working across multiple industries or complex business environments

**What We Look For**

* Total Experience: [12+ Years]
* Relevant Experience (AI/Agent-based solutions): 1+ Years
* Prior experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise delivery engagements.
* Degree in BE / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or equivalent with relevant industry experience.
* Microsoft AI certification is preferred.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Strategic Builder
description:
**Description**
**The Experience**
Customer impact from day one. Strategic clarity and Execution that sticks.
  
  
Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists — Strategic Builders who are customer-facing advisors, who define AI strategy, shape agentic solutions, and drive measurable adoption for enterprise customers. You'll work as part of a delivery team alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, translating complex business challenges into agentic AI deployments that go live and generate real value.
  
  
Engagements are focused and time-bound — typically 12 weeks or less — and may span a single strategic account or multiple customers simultaneously. Your impact isn't just getting to deployment. It ensures customers realise lasting, scalable value from the solutions your team builds.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Full Lifecycle Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer engagement across the complete value lifecycle — Identify → Commit → Deploy → Consume — owning outcomes at every stage, not just discovery or deal closure
* AI Strategy & Architecture: Define the customer's Agentic AI strategy and roadmap. Lead design workshops, agent design sessions, and jobs-to-be-done analysis. Architect solutions spanning Salesforce's agentic AI platform, Data Cloud, and enterprise systems, with responsible AI governance baked in from the start.
* Deployment Oversight & Program Management: Manage engagement delivery end-to-end timelines, stakeholder communication, risk escalation, and progress reporting. You are the operational backbone of your delivery team, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
* Adoption & Consumption: Own adoption, consumption, and expansion metrics within your engagement scope. Identify blockers early and develop strategies to drive measurable value realization
* Delivery Team Coordination: Partner closely with the Forward Deployed Engineers on your team to align strategy with technical execution. Keep the team focused, unblocked, and on track to hit delivery milestones.
* AI-Supported Development: You'll be developing real customer solutions supported by leading-edge AI tools: Including
* Cursor, Claude, and our coding products like Vibes, to accelerate development.
* Customer Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary customer-facing contact, building trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders and present proposals, decisions and outcomes in terms of business value, not just technical detail.
* AI Readiness: Assess customer readiness for AI adoption and guide change management and process transformation to maximise the benefits of intelligent agents
* Product Feedback Loop: Synthesise field insights and translate them into actionable product feedback that influences Salesforce's Agentic AI platform roadmap.

**You're Our Person If...**

* 10-15 years of total experience with relevant 5 years into Data & AI in strategic solutioning, technical advisory, or delivery leadership or program management for enterprise cloud or SaaS technology
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* Prior customer-facing delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or technical advisory) - this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have
* Demonstrated understanding of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including Agentic AI capabilities and Data Cloud
* Working knowledge of one or more programming languages: Python, JavaScript, Java, or Apex
* Proven ability to lead and own complex, ambiguous engagements end-to-end — from discovery through to measurable outcomes
* Experience leading AI/LLM solution design, including agentic AI strategy, conversation design, and responsible AI practices
* Strong project and program management skills — ability to run multiple workstreams, manage stakeholder expectations, and keep delivery on track in ambiguous environments
* Ability to travel 25% of the time to customer sites

**Even Better If...**

* Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce platform, and Salesforce CRM (Sales, Service, Marketing)
* Experience designing and deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., public sector, financial services, healthcare)
* Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Data Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist, Application Architect) or similar platform certifications such as Microsoft, Oracle, or similar platforms.
* Background in change management, organisational design, or enterprise transformation
* Experience with AI/ML concepts beyond LLMs, including NLP, RAG architectures, and model evaluation frameworks
* A get-things-done mindset with strong bias for action — comfortable operating in unstructured fast moving environments

Analog Devices is seeking an Associate Industrial Engineer to join the Central Industrial Engineering team. Working alongside experienced Industrial Engineers at local facilities, this position will contribute to the development of cross-site analytical tools and decision-support systems that maximize factory output and enable future expansion planning.

* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, IT, and Equipment Engineering to support improvement projects.
* Document methodologies, analytical models, and standard work processes.
* Present findings and recommendations to technical and operations teams.
* Build knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing systems, Industrial Engineering methodologies, and factory scheduling concepts.

* Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Systems Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Data Analytics, or related engineering discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Internship, co-op, or academic project experience in manufacturing, operations research, data analytics, or process optimization.
* Familiarity with SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytical tools.
* Coursework in statistics, simulation, optimization, data science, or manufacturing systems.
* Exposure to semiconductor manufacturing or other high-volume manufacturing environments.

**Work Experience**

* 0–2 years of Industrial Engineering or analytical experience.
* Demonstrated ability to work with large datasets and perform quantitative analysis.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

title: Lead Product Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Lead Product Engineer to drive our product from first idea to live release and beyond. You will combine hands-on engineering with product ownership: owning the requirements, leading several engineering teams, and making sure what we build is technically sound and matches what customers and the business need.  
This role sits at the centre of product and engineering. You will turn business goals into a clear roadmap and technical plan, shape the architecture, guide teams through design, development, testing and release, and stay hands-on where it matters, through code reviews, prototypes and solving the hardest technical problems. You are accountable for quality, timelines and outcomes.

Key responsibilities  
1. Product development from start to finish

* Shape the product vision and roadmap with leadership, based on business goals, customer feedback and market research.
* Lead each product or feature through its full lifecycle: discovery, requirements, design, development, testing, release and post-launch review.
* Define the minimum viable product (MVP) and plan releases in phases.
* Decide what gets built, what waits and what is dropped, using clear prioritisation (value, effort, risk).
* Review released features against goals and plan improvements.
* 2. Requirements ownership
* Act as the single owner of product requirements and the product backlog.

* Gather requirements from customers, sales, support, operations and leadership; resolve conflicts between them.
* Write clear epics, user stories and acceptance criteria that teams can build and test against.
* Keep the backlog refined, prioritised and ready at least two sprints ahead.
* Manage scope changes through a controlled change process and explain their impact on time and cost.
* Accept or reject completed work against the agreed acceptance criteria.

3. Managing multiple teams4. Technical oversight5. Delivery and stakeholder management

* Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams: development, QA, UI/UX, DevOps and business analysis.
* Plan sprints and releases across teams; manage dependencies, shared resources and handoffs.
* Run or oversee Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives.
* Set clear goals for each team, track progress, and remove blockers quickly.
* Coach team members, give regular feedback, and support hiring and onboarding.
* Build a culture of ownership, quality and open communication.
* Work with architects and tech leads on solution design, technology choices and technical debt.
* Make sure non-functional needs are planned in: performance, security, scalability and reliability.
* Understand APIs, integrations, databases and cloud basics well enough to judge trade-offs.
* Ensure quality through code review practices, test coverage and CI/CD standards.
* Own delivery timelines, budget and risks; raise issues early with options.
* Report progress, risks and results to leadership and stakeholders in plain language.
* Coordinate go-live with support, training, marketing and operations teams.
* Track product metrics and use data to guide decisions.Qualifications and skills

* Strong hands-on coding skills in at least one modern back-end stack (such as Java, Node.js) and working knowledge of a front-end framework (React or Angular).
* Experience designing scalable systems: microservices, REST or GraphQL APIs, relational and NoSQL databases.
* Practical experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP), Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines.
* Hands-on experience with Agile (Scrum or Kanban) and tools such as Jira, Confluence, ClickUp or Azure DevOps.
* Clear written and spoken communication in English; able to explain technical decisions to non-technical people.

Pay: ₹729,000.00 - ₹1,130,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
