title: Software Engineering Manager - Cloud Services
description:
**Software Engineering Manager – Cloud Services**
Hyderabad, India (Hybrid – 3 days in office)
  
  
**About Nasuni**
Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams—and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world’s unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits. As a Vista-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is transforming how enterprises manage file data with a next-generation, AI-ready platform—turning massive file stores into secure, actionable, and AI-ready data for intelligent automation, analytics, and global collaboration.
  
  
**Why Work at Nasuni (Hyderabad / India)**
With Vista Equity Partners’ backing, our Hyderabad team benefits from access to a global ecosystem of software leaders—cross-portfolio learning, leadership programs, and AI innovation communities—combining the pace of a fast-growing company with the scale and resources of a global technology investor. You’ll innovate at the intersection of cloud, AI, and enterprise data infrastructure, collaborate with talented teams, and build modern platforms trusted by enterprises worldwide. Join us in Hyderabad and help shape the future of intelligent, AI-ready data management.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Nasuni is hiring a
**Software Engineering Manager – Cloud Services**
to lead the team responsible for building and operating cloud-native services that strengthen our platform’s ransomware detection and data protection capabilities.
  
  
These services process large volumes of system data, prepare it for machine learning workflows, and integrate detection capabilities into production systems that help enterprises protect and recover critical file data.
  
  
This role is ideal for a
**hands-on engineering leader**
who combines:
  
  

* strong Python and distributed systems experience
* AWS cloud architecture expertise
* the ability to lead engineers and deliver reliable cloud services

This role focuses on
**engineering leadership and delivery execution**
, not cybersecurity research or machine learning model development.
  
  
**Level & Scope Definition**
**In This Role You Will**

* Lead and develop a team of approximately 5 software engineers.
* Own delivery of cloud-native services supporting ransomware detection infrastructure.
* Provide technical direction for Python-based distributed systems.
* Partner with Product, Security, Cloud Platform, and SRE teams.
* Ensure systems meet reliability, scalability, and security requirements.

You will remain
**technically engaged**
, participating in architecture discussions and reviewing critical code paths, while focusing primarily on
**team leadership, delivery predictability, and system reliability**
.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead a team of software engineers building cloud-native services within Nasuni’s Cloud Services platform.
* Design and evolve Python-based services that collect and process system data used for ransomware detection workflows.
* Architect scalable systems leveraging AWS services such as S3 and event-driven data pipelines.
* Ensure cloud services meet high standards for security, reliability, and observability.
* Drive Agile execution including sprint planning, estimation discipline, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
* Establish disciplined engineering practices using delivery metrics and data-informed planning.
* Conduct performance management and coach engineers for technical and career growth.
* Review system designs and provide technical direction grounded in deep system understanding.
* Collaborate with Security, Platform, and SRE teams to strengthen detection and recovery capabilities.
* Leverage modern engineering tools—including AI-assisted development workflows—to improve team productivity while maintaining strong validation and quality standards.

**Qualifications**
**Must-Have Qualifications**

* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* 2+ years of direct engineering management experience.
* Strong Python development experience in production systems.
* Hands-on experience designing or operating AWS-based distributed systems.
* Experience building scalable backend services or data-processing systems.
* Experience leading Agile software development teams.
* Ability to understand complex system data flows and architect improvements across services.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building data pipelines that support machine learning workflows.
* Experience integrating ML-driven detection capabilities into production systems.
* Familiarity with AWS S3 and object storage architectures.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.
* Experience working in security, ransomware protection, or data protection domains.
* Familiarity with file systems or SMB protocols.

**Ideal Qualifications**

* Experience building anomaly detection or security telemetry systems.
* Experience operating high-availability SaaS infrastructure.
* Demonstrated ability to balance hands-on technical engagement with team leadership.
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve development productivity.

**Experience Guidelines**

* 8–15 years total software engineering experience
* 2–5 years engineering management experience
* 3+ years AWS production system experience

**Why Work at Nasuni – Hyderabad?**
**Benefits**
As part of our commitment to your well-being and growth, Nasuni offers
**competitive benefits**
designed to support every stage of your life and career:
  
  

* Competitive compensation programs
* Flexible time off and leave policies
* Comprehensive health and wellness coverage
* Hybrid and flexible work arrangements
* Employee referral and recognition programs
* Professional development and learning support
* Inclusive, collaborative team culture
* Modern office spaces with team events and perks
* Retirement and statutory benefits as per Indian regulations

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, caste, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, national origin, or any other status protected by applicable laws in India or the country of employment.*

**Lead / Manager - Ground Systems Software Engineering**
to lead the architecture, development, integration, deployment, and lifecycle of mission-critical Ground Systems for command and control, telemetry, mission operations, situational awareness, monitoring, and data distribution.

The ideal candidate combines expertise in software engineering, systems integration, cloud-native and real-time distributed systems with strong delivery leadership, guiding multidisciplinary teams and cross-functional partners to build reliable, scalable, secure, high-performance solutions.

* Lead the architecture, design, development, and maintenance of Ground System software applications and services.
* Define technology roadmaps and software engineering best practices for Ground Systems.
* Drive architecture reviews, design governance, and technical decision-making across programs.
* Ensure software solutions meet performance, reliability, scalability, maintainability, and security requirements.
* Champion modern software engineering practices including DevSecOps, CI/CD, containerization, and microservices-based architectures.

title: IT&D Senior Manager SAP Integration
description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Information Technology & Digital
  
  
In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.
  
  
Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
  
  
Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
  
  
**About The Role**
The SAP Integration Manager is responsible for leading the design, delivery, and governance of enterprise-wide integrations across SAP and non SAP applications using SAP Process Orchestration (PO) and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) Integration Suite. The role requires deep hands-on integration expertise, strong architectural thinking, and the ability to modernize integration landscapes using API-first and event-driven patterns. Success in this role depends on strong communication, stakeholder management, and the capability to guide global teams toward scalable, reliable, and future-ready integration solutions.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  
Leads the enterprise integration strategy across SAP PO and SAP BTP Integration Suite, ensuring a smooth transition from traditional middleware to cloud-first integration architectures.
  
  

* Designs and governs scalable integration patterns using APIs, events, EDI/IDocs, SAP CPI, and REST/OData services.
* Manages end-to-end delivery of integration solutions for ERP programs, including SAP S/4HANA transformations and key business-critical projects.
* Ensures integration solutions adhere to clean-core, reusable, secure, and modular design principles aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
* Oversees the operations, performance tuning, and lifecycle management of SAP PO (PI/PO), including message monitoring, error handling, and interface optimization.
* Leads the expansion and adoption of SAP BTP Integration Suite—Cloud Integration (CPI), API Management, Event Mesh, and Open Connectors.
* Enables integration modernization by driving API-first and event-driven architectural practices across global business functions.
* Works closely with business, application, and technology teams to translate integration requirements into high quality technical designs.
* Manages EDI integrations with internal and external partners, ensuring reliable data exchange and SLA compliance.
* Implements integration standards, naming conventions, documentation, test frameworks, and version-controlled repository-based development.
* Provides leadership to integration developers, ensuring skill development, code quality, and consistent technical excellence.
* Collaborates with Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, and Infrastructure teams to ensure compliance with audit, data protection, and cybersecurity policies.
* Establishes KPIs for interface uptime, message accuracy, end-to-end monitoring, and integration landscape health.
* Supports cutover planning, go-lives, and post-production hyper care for integration-related activities.
* Guides vendor teams, system integrators, and external partners to ensure high-quality integration deliveries.
* Communicates integration design concepts in simple business language to global stakeholders and senior leadership.
* Continuously evaluates new SAP BTP innovations, automation tools, and integration technologies to enhance the digital ecosystem.

The experience we're looking for
  
  
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
  
  

* 15-20 years of experience in SAP integration delivery and operations, with strong expertise in both SAP PO (PI/PO) and SAP BTP Integration Suite.
* Hands-on experience in building integrations using SAP CPI, API Management, Event Mesh, EDI/IDoc, SOAP/REST services, and cloud connectors.
* Strong experience designing integration architecture for SAP S/4HANA projects in global enterprise environments.
* Good understanding of modern middleware concepts including API-led integration, event-driven architecture, microservices, and cloud-native integration.
* Experience leading teams, managing developer workloads, and reviewing integration deliverables for quality and compliance.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices such as Git-based repositories, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and artifact versioning for integration artifacts.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work in matrix organizations and collaborate with cross-functional global teams.
* Ability to manage high-pressure integration cutovers, tight timelines, and multi-vendor coordination.
* Willingness to learn and stay updated on emerging SAP technologies like Joule, Business AI, and next-gen integration capabilities.
* Willingness to travel globally (5–25%).

The skills for success
  
  
Product Development, system development, Project Management, Programme Management, Design Thinking, Process Automisation, IT Service Management, Innovation Processes, Innovation, User Experience Design, Change Analyst, Change Management, Digital Transformation, Value Analysis, Change Management, Adoption, Technology Adoption Lifecycle, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Vendor Management, Outstanding Communication, stakeholder engagement, Digital Strategy, Product Solution Architecture, Cyber Security Strategy, Cyber Security, Data Privacy, Portfolio Management, Data Governance, Product Compliance, Media Analytics, advertising, Consumer Engagement, Market Value, Market Chain, Data Driven Practices, Advanced Analytics, Data Analytics, Governance.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Senior Salesforce Platform Engineer
description:
***Company Overview***

*AutoRABIT is an enterprise platform for Salesforce DevSecOps that enables organizations to manage AI-accelerated Salesforce development with greater security, governance, visibility, and control. Its integrated product suite supports the complete Salesforce DevSecOps lifecycle through* ***AutoRABIT ARM*** *for CI/CD and release management,* ***CodeScan*** *for static code analysis and application security,* ***Vault*** *for data backup and recovery, and* ***Guard*** *for security posture management. The platform helps enterprises automate deployments, improve code quality, protect critical Salesforce data, monitor access risks, and strengthen compliance.* ***AutoRABIT official website***  
  
*Purpose-built for complex enterprise Salesforce environments, AutoRABIT helps development teams increase productivity, accelerate delivery, and innovate without compromising security or reliability. Its metadata-aware capabilities, scalable platform, flexible hosting options, and integrations provide organizations with the structure and control required to manage Salesforce changes across teams, environments, and global operations. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, AutoRABIT serves customers worldwide and offers employees the opportunity to contribute to products at the intersection of Salesforce, DevSecOps, security, governance, and AI-enabled development.* ***AutoRABIT platform overview***

  
***Job Role***  
*We are looking for a hands-on Salesforce expert to help improve the quality and reliability of products built for complex Salesforce engineering environments.*  
  
*The role combines platform engineering, technical investigation, scenario design, and product validation. You will recreate real-world development and release challenges, establish technically correct outcomes, identify edge cases, and work with Product and Engineering teams to improve product behaviour.*  
  
*This role is suited to someone who understands how Salesforce behaves beyond the happy path.*  
  
***Key Responsibilities***

* *Design realistic Salesforce development, configuration, and release scenarios.*
* *Establish expected outcomes and clear technical acceptance criteria.*
* *Validate product behavior across metadata, code, security, integrations, and deployment workflows.*
* *Investigate incorrect, incomplete, or inconsistent results.*
* *Reproduce complex failures across orgs, sandboxes, API versions, and release configurations.*
* *Build reusable technical assets that improve product coverage and prevent regressions.*
* *Analyze dependencies, deployment sequencing, environment drift, and configuration differences.*
* *Partner with Product and Engineering to prioritize platform gaps and improve reliability.*
* *Track Salesforce platform releases and assess their impact on supported workflows.*
* *Responsibility to adhere to set internal controls*

***Pride of Ownership***  
*We value pride of ownership. Understand the customer, the product and the market need; form a clear, evidence-based opinion about how the product can improve; and work with others to turn that opinion into results. Strong coding skills and effective use of AI matter, but accountability continues after a feature is shipped. Be willing to challenge assumptions, listen to feedback and change your view when the evidence changes.*  
  
***Experience & Desired Skills***  
***Required Skills (Mandatory)***

* *5–8 years of hands-on Salesforce development or platform engineering experience.*
* *Strong experience with Apex, Triggers, LWC, SOQL/SOSL, Flows, validation rules, and asynchronous processing.*
* *Deep understanding of Salesforce metadata, dependencies, deployment behavior, and org configuration.*
* *Strong knowledge of profiles, permission sets, sharing, roles, record types, and field-level security.*
* *Hands-on experience with Salesforce CLI, Metadata API, Tooling API, Apex testing, and deployment troubleshooting.*
* *Strong Git skills, including branching, pull requests, merge-conflict resolution, and release promotion.*
* *Experience working across multiple Salesforce orgs and sandbox strategies.*
* *Ability to explain technical decisions through precise reasoning and evidence.*
* *Strong written communication and attention to detail.*

***Preferred Skills (Good to Have)***

* *Experience with CI/CD platforms or Salesforce DevOps products.*
* *Experience diagnosing complex metadata, packaging, or environment-specific failures.*
* *Exposure to REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth, Connected Apps, and Named Credentials.*
* *Experience with managed packages, unlocked packages, namespaces, or enterprise release processes.*
* *Experience defining technical test scenarios, review standards, or quality frameworks.*
* *Experience with one or more Salesforce industry or specialized clouds.*
* *Python or scripting experience is beneficial.*

***Salesforce Platform Exposure***  
*Strong Salesforce Core Platform expertise is required.*  
*Experience in one or more of the following is preferred:*

* *Sales Cloud*
* *Service Cloud*
* *Experience Cloud*
* *Revenue Cloud or CPQ*
* *Field Service*
* *Data Cloud*
* *Financial Services Cloud*
* *Health Cloud*
* *Manufacturing Cloud*
* *Salesforce Industries*
* *Agentforce*

*Depth in every cloud is not expected. We value candidates who understand how platform capabilities affect metadata, security, integrations, and releases.*  
  
***Certification***

* *Salesforce Platform Developer I, Platform Developer II, JavaScript Developer I, Application Architect, System Architect, or relevant DevOps certifications are preferred (not required)*
* *What is required is true experience in Salesforce development & implementations across verticals.*

***What success looks like***

* *Complex Salesforce scenarios are represented accurately and reproducibly.*
* *Platform-specific gaps and failure modes are identified early.*
* *Technical outcomes are supported by clear evidence.*
* *Product coverage expands across meaningful Salesforce use cases.*
* *Discovered issues become durable regression protection.*
* *Product and Engineering teams can make faster decisions with greater confidence.*

***Who Will Thrive Here***  
*You will thrive in this role if you:*

* *Enjoy investigating why the same change behaves differently across environments.*
* *Naturally look for dependencies, edge cases, and hidden assumptions.*
* *Can distinguish a valid alternative from a technically incorrect result.*
* *Turn difficult incidents into repeatable technical scenarios.*
* *Prefer evidence over intuition.*
* *Communicate complex Salesforce behavior clearly and precisely.*

***Why join AutoRABIT***  
*Your Salesforce expertise will directly influence how our products behave. You will have the opportunity to turn domain knowledge into better customer workflows and help teams prevent failures before customers encounter them.*  
  
***Experience:*** *5-8 Years*  
***Employment Type:*** *Contract for 6 months*  
***Compensation:*** *24 - 30 Lakhs per annum*  
***Location:*** *Hyderabad*  
***Work Mode:*** *Hybrid - 3 days Work from Office*  
***Work Timings****: IST timings - General Flexible Shift*

  .

Strong hands-on experience with
**React.js, Node.js, Express.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and REST APIs**
.

Strong understanding of:

* **HLD, LLD, scalable architecture, and microservices**
* Distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and asynchronous processing
* Database design, query optimization, and API architecture
* Concurrency, caching, load balancing, and horizontal scaling
* Authentication, authorization, security, and fault tolerance
* Performance optimization and architectural trade-offs

The candidate must be capable of
**converting business requirements into detailed, scalable technical designs and implementing them independently**
.

2. Microservices, Distributed Systems & AWS

Strong practical knowledge of
**microservices, distributed processing, asynchronous workflows, and event-driven system architecture**
.

Hands-on expertise with:

* **AWS Lambda:**
  Serverless development, deployment, concurrency, performance optimization, and scaling.
* **Amazon Bedrock:**
  Foundation model integration and production AI workflows.
* Working knowledge of
  **AWS S3, SQS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and IAM**
  .

Experience with
**Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, or similar messaging and caching technologies**
.

Understanding of
**worker concurrency, queue-based processing, retries, idempotency, rate limiting, failure recovery, observability, and cloud cost optimization**
.

Deep expertise across every AWS service is not required.

3. AI / LLM Engineering, OCR & Document Intelligence

Hands-on experience implementing production AI applications involving:

* LLM integration, prompt engineering, and context management.
* **OCR, Vision AI, multimodal models, and PDF/image processing**
  .
* Document classification, table/form extraction, and structured JSON outputs.
* Schema validation, error handling, and hallucination reduction.
* Multi-stage AI processing pipelines and model orchestration.
* Token optimization, AI latency management, and cost reduction.
* AI evaluation, accuracy improvement, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

The candidate should understand how to build
**reliable AI features beyond simply making LLM API calls**
.

4. RAG & AI Workflow Architecture

Hands-on experience designing and implementing
**Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**
systems, including:

* Document ingestion, chunking, and embeddings
* Vector databases, semantic/hybrid search, and metadata filtering
* Retrieval optimization, reranking, and context construction
* Response grounding and RAG evaluation

Working knowledge of
**AI agents, function/tool calling, agent orchestration, state management, and contextual memory**
.

Experience with
**LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks**
is preferred.

5. Scalability, Performance & Engineering Ownership

The candidate should be capable of:

* Designing architectures for high-volume document and AI processing.
* Performing capacity planning, throughput estimation, and load testing.
* Building scalable background workers and asynchronous pipelines.
* Optimizing APIs, databases, model calls, and infrastructure.
* Troubleshooting complex production issues.
* Making architectural decisions and explaining technical trade-offs.
* Independently owning complex technical modules from requirements to deployment.

Good to Have

* Experience with
  **US Healthcare, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), medical coding, insurance claims, or HIPAA-aware applications**
  .
* Advanced AI agents, multi-agent workflows, and agent orchestration.
* Knowledge graphs, graph-based retrieval, and advanced AI memory.
* Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized deployments.
* Experience with AI evaluation frameworks and feedback-driven improvement systems.

Experience Required

* **3–5 years of professional software development experience**
  .
* Strong full-stack development experience, particularly in backend engineering.
* Strong system design, microservices, and scalable architecture knowledge.
* Hands-on experience with
  **AWS Lambda and Amazon Bedrock**
  .
* Practical experience with
  **AI/LLM integration, OCR, and RAG**
  .
* Ability to independently design, implement, and own complex technical modules.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a
**hands-on engineer and strong system thinker**
who can take ownership of architecture, development, AI integration, scalability, and production reliability.

The ideal candidate should be able to design distributed architectures, implement production-ready modules, optimize high-volume AI processing workflows, and solve complex engineering challenges independently.

* **Our highest priorities are system design, scalable backend architecture, microservices, AWS Lambda, and practical AI implementation.**

You will own the decisions that shape how the platform is built, governed, and extended, and your work will directly influence how thousands of employees across the company plan, collaborate, and deliver. As HealthEdge moves fully to Atlassian Cloud Enterprise, the Architect will also shape the platform's AI readiness — ensuring the architecture supports Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo at enterprise scale.

You will serve as the technical authority for the Atlassian Products team – providing architectural guidance, mentoring Senior and regular Administrators, leading complex solution delivery, and acting as the primary point of escalation for problems that require deep platform expertise. You will also own strategic initiatives including instance governance, automation frameworks, API integrations, and migration or consolidation efforts.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Platform Architecture & Standards**
-------------------------------------

* Own the Atlassian platform architecture across Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Confluence, and Atlassian Access – defining how these tools are structured, governed, and extended at scale
* Establish and maintain technical standards for project design, workflow architecture, permission models, field configuration, and Confluence space taxonomy across the organization
* Design scalable, maintainable solutions that balance user needs with platform health – avoiding configuration sprawl and technical debt
* Evaluate new Atlassian capabilities, product roadmap changes, and Marketplace apps – assessing fit, risk, and adoption strategy
* Produce and maintain architectural documentation including design decisions, standards references, and solution blueprints

**Complex Solution Design & Delivery**
--------------------------------------

* Lead discovery and solution design for the most complex stakeholder requests – those that require cross-project thinking, advanced automation, or architectural changes
* Translate ambiguous business requirements from engineering, IT, product, and business functions into well-structured, scalable Atlassian solutions
* Deliver end-to-end implementation of high-complexity configurations, including multi-project workflow frameworks, advanced JSM service architectures, and cross-tool integrations
* Partner with the Manager, Atlassian Products to define and manage the platform improvement roadmap, sequencing initiatives by impact and feasibility

**Automation & Scripting**
--------------------------

* Design and implement advanced automation frameworks using native Jira/JSM automation and ScriptRunner (Groovy) for complex workflow logic, validators, post-functions, and listeners
* Build and maintain REST API integrations between Atlassian tools and external systems including identity platforms, ITSM tools, and business applications
* Establish automation standards and reusable patterns that the broader admin team can follow and extend
* Review and quality-assure automation and scripting work produced by Senior Administrators, providing technical guidance and improvement feedback

**Migrations & Consolidations**
-------------------------------

* Lead or architect Atlassian migration and consolidation projects, including instance-to-instance migrations, Server/Data Center to Cloud transitions, and post-merger platform integrations
* Perform pre-migration assessments including configuration audits, data mapping, and risk analysis
* Design migration runbooks and execute or oversee technical migration steps with appropriate rollback planning
* Ensure data integrity, permission continuity, and minimal disruption to end users throughout migration events

**Enterprise Governance & Security**
------------------------------------

* Own Atlassian Access configuration including SSO, SCIM provisioning, authentication policies, IP allowlisting, and audit log management
* Design and enforce the organization-wide governance model for Atlassian – covering project creation standards, permission scheme governance, license management, and app approval processes
* Lead license optimization efforts, identifying consolidation opportunities and ensuring spend is aligned with actual usage
* Support security and compliance requirements including access reviews, data residency considerations, and audit evidence related to Atlassian platforms
* Serve as the technical lead for any Atlassian-related security incidents, misconfigurations, or compliance findings

**Team Mentorship & Technical Leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Serve as the informal technical lead for the Atlassian Products team – the person Senior and regular Administrators bring their hardest problems to
* Mentor Senior Administrators on advanced configuration, automation, and solution design, actively developing their technical depth
* Conduct technical design reviews for significant platform changes proposed by team members
* Contribute to hiring by participating in technical assessments for Atlassian Administrator and Senior Administrator candidates
* Represent the Atlassian Products team in cross-functional technical forums and architecture discussions

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

**Required**
------------

* 7+ years of deep, hands-on Atlassian platform experience with expert-level proficiency in Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing Atlassian architectures for large, complex organizations (thousands of users, dozens of teams)
* Expert-level proficiency in ScriptRunner (Groovy) scripting for advanced workflow customization, automation, and platform extensions
* Strong REST API experience with Atlassian platforms — building integrations, automating administrative tasks, and extending platform capabilities
* Proven experience leading Atlassian migrations or consolidation projects, including Cloud migrations
* Deep understanding of Atlassian Cloud security and governance including Atlassian Access, SSO/SCIM, and enterprise-scale permission management
* Ability to communicate architectural decisions clearly to both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

**Preferred**
-------------

* Atlassian certifications strongly preferred – ACP-120, ACP-420, ACP-620, or Atlassian Certified Expert (ACE) designation
* Familiarity with how Atlassian platform architecture affects AI indexing quality and Rovo answer relevance
* Experience with advanced Marketplace apps at architectural scale (Insight/Assets, Advanced Roadmaps, ScriptRunner, Elements Connect, Tempo)
* Exposure to enterprise ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and applying them within JSM at an architectural level
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and DevOps tooling that integrates with Atlassian (AWS, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines)
* Experience in a healthcare, SaaS, or other regulated industry environment
* Background in post-merger IT platform integration or multi-instance Atlassian consolidation

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within 90 days, you have completed a thorough assessment of the current Atlassian environment, identified the top architectural gaps and technical debt priorities, and established yourself as the go-to technical authority on the team. Within six months, you have delivered at least one significant platform improvement, established or formalized key governance standards, and are actively mentoring the admin team. Within a year, the Atlassian platform at HealthEdge reflects clear architectural ownership — well-governed, well-documented, and built to scale — and you have meaningfully elevated the technical capability of everyone around you.

**About the Team**
==================

You'll join a dedicated Atlassian Products team that is central to how HealthEdge operates at scale. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role for someone who wants to be the definitive technical expert on a platform that touches every part of the business. You'll have the backing of an engaged manager, a growing team of administrators to mentor, and a real mandate to shape how the platform evolves. If you want to do the most technically interesting Atlassian work of your career, this is that role.

title: Lead Product Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Lead Product Engineer to drive our product from first idea to live release and beyond. You will combine hands-on engineering with product ownership: owning the requirements, leading several engineering teams, and making sure what we build is technically sound and matches what customers and the business need.  
This role sits at the centre of product and engineering. You will turn business goals into a clear roadmap and technical plan, shape the architecture, guide teams through design, development, testing and release, and stay hands-on where it matters, through code reviews, prototypes and solving the hardest technical problems. You are accountable for quality, timelines and outcomes.

Key responsibilities  
1. Product development from start to finish

* Shape the product vision and roadmap with leadership, based on business goals, customer feedback and market research.
* Lead each product or feature through its full lifecycle: discovery, requirements, design, development, testing, release and post-launch review.
* Define the minimum viable product (MVP) and plan releases in phases.
* Decide what gets built, what waits and what is dropped, using clear prioritisation (value, effort, risk).
* Review released features against goals and plan improvements.
* 2. Requirements ownership
* Act as the single owner of product requirements and the product backlog.

* Gather requirements from customers, sales, support, operations and leadership; resolve conflicts between them.
* Write clear epics, user stories and acceptance criteria that teams can build and test against.
* Keep the backlog refined, prioritised and ready at least two sprints ahead.
* Manage scope changes through a controlled change process and explain their impact on time and cost.
* Accept or reject completed work against the agreed acceptance criteria.

3. Managing multiple teams4. Technical oversight5. Delivery and stakeholder management

* Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams: development, QA, UI/UX, DevOps and business analysis.
* Plan sprints and releases across teams; manage dependencies, shared resources and handoffs.
* Run or oversee Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives.
* Set clear goals for each team, track progress, and remove blockers quickly.
* Coach team members, give regular feedback, and support hiring and onboarding.
* Build a culture of ownership, quality and open communication.
* Work with architects and tech leads on solution design, technology choices and technical debt.
* Make sure non-functional needs are planned in: performance, security, scalability and reliability.
* Understand APIs, integrations, databases and cloud basics well enough to judge trade-offs.
* Ensure quality through code review practices, test coverage and CI/CD standards.
* Own delivery timelines, budget and risks; raise issues early with options.
* Report progress, risks and results to leadership and stakeholders in plain language.
* Coordinate go-live with support, training, marketing and operations teams.
* Track product metrics and use data to guide decisions.Qualifications and skills

* Strong hands-on coding skills in at least one modern back-end stack (such as Java, Node.js) and working knowledge of a front-end framework (React or Angular).
* Experience designing scalable systems: microservices, REST or GraphQL APIs, relational and NoSQL databases.
* Practical experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP), Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines.
* Hands-on experience with Agile (Scrum or Kanban) and tools such as Jira, Confluence, ClickUp or Azure DevOps.
* Clear written and spoken communication in English; able to explain technical decisions to non-technical people.

Pay: ₹729,000.00 - ₹1,130,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. **Job Description**

  

We are creating a new Group People Technology function to provide clear ownership, expertise and direction across the technology that supports our global People services.

The People Technology Service & Experience Senior Product Specialist will work with business stakeholders to understand service challenges, user needs and desired outcomes, translating these into practical, scalable and supportable digital solutions across the People Service & Experience portfolio.

Reporting to the People Technology Service & Experience Product Manager, you will collaborate with Project Managers, People teams, business regions, IT, technical specialists and external delivery partners. You will bring strong knowledge of ServiceNow, particularly HR Service Delivery, across capabilities such as case management, service catalogue, knowledge, self-service, lifecycle events and workflow automation.

This is a hands-on product delivery role. You will lead discovery and requirements workshops, challenge solution-led requests, shape service and functional designs, complete authorised configuration, coordinate testing and releases, investigate incidents and defects and deliver service improvements. You will also help design joined-up People services and lifecycle journeys involving other functions, while those functions remain responsible for their own services and activities.

You will maintain the configuration, design, testing, release and operational documentation required for governance, auditability, service continuity and future change. Through direct delivery, partner challenge, knowledge transfer and continuous learning, you will strengthen internal capability and reduce unnecessary reliance on external partners.

Although primarily aligned to People Service & Experience, you may support other People Technology domains where demand, resilience, holiday cover or development priorities require.

Key responsibilities

* Work with global, regional and functional stakeholders to understand service challenges, business problems, user needs and desired outcomes, ensuring discussions remain focused on the need rather than a predetermined technology solution.

* Lead discovery, requirements and solution-shaping workshops, translating business and service requirements into clear options, service designs, functional requirements, workflow designs and acceptance criteria.

* Act as a senior subject-matter specialist for ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, bringing strong platform knowledge, leading practices and service insight into business and delivery decisions.

* Deliver authorised ServiceNow configuration, administration, enhancements, workflow improvements and optimisation within agreed access, security, data-protection, change-control and segregation-of-duties requirements.

* Take ownership of assigned changes from discovery through design, configuration, testing, release, operational handover and early-life support, maintaining appropriate traceability, documentation and evidence throughout the lifecycle.

* Analyse People services, processes, user journeys, case-management requirements, service-catalogue structures, knowledge needs, workflows, roles, permissions and integrations to shape effective end-to-end solutions.

* Support the development of consistent global People services and ways of working, simplifying, standardising and automating processes while recognising legitimate regional and regulatory requirements.

* Configure and improve Employee Centre and digital service experiences, service-catalogue, case-management, knowledge, employee and manager self-service and workflow capabilities, including forms, record producers, routing, assignment, approvals, notifications, service levels and supporting metadata.

* Design and configure HRSD lifecycle events, coordinating with other functions where journeys include activities such as IT provisioning, identity and access, equipment, Security, Facilities, Learning or background screening, while those functions remain accountable for their own services.
* + Apply service-design, journey-mapping and experience-design practices to simplify employee and manager interactions and improve end-to-end service outcomes.

  + Assess incidents, defects, service issues, enhancements and optimisation opportunities, investigating root causes and recommending appropriate resolutions or improvements.

  + Coordinate functional, regression and user-acceptance testing and support product and vendor-release cycles, including impact assessment, business readiness, deployment, operational handover and post-release review.

  + Create and maintain configuration workbooks, requirements, service and functional designs, workflow and service-catalogue records, test evidence, release artefacts, operating procedures and product knowledge, ensuring documentation remains aligned to the live platform and supports auditability, continuity and future change.

  + Monitor product health, service and workflow performance, adoption and usability, identifying opportunities to improve configuration, simplify services, increase automation and deliver greater business value.

  + Work confidently with support and implementation partners, reviewing and constructively challenging designs, configuration, testing, documentation and delivery outputs, while ensuring effective knowledge transfer and reducing unnecessary partner dependency.

  + Maintain and develop relevant ServiceNow expertise through product learning, release awareness, practical delivery and appropriate certification, sharing knowledge to improve resilience across the team.

  + Contribute to the Service & Experience People Technology Community, working with regional stakeholders, super users and champions to gather insight, strengthen adoption and improve effective use of the portfolio.

  + Support the future development of colleague-listening and experience-management capabilities, including Qualtrics, translating feedback and journey insight into actionable service and product improvements.

  + Partner with the Foundation team and architecture, security, data, integration and Microsoft product teams to support effective integration between ServiceNow, SAP SuccessFactors, OpenText, Microsoft products and other enterprise technologies.

  + Support other People Technology domains where demand, resilience, holiday cover or development priorities require, while maintaining accountability for assigned Service & Experience responsibilities.

  **Candidate Specification :**

  **Essential**

  + Strong hands-on experience with ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, including practical configuration, functional or service design, testing and controlled platform-change delivery.

  + Strong understanding of HR service delivery, case management, service catalogues, knowledge management, employee and manager self-service, workflow automation, lifecycle events and related People services.

  + Experience leading discovery, requirements and solution-shaping workshops, keeping stakeholders focused on business problems, service needs and desired outcomes rather than predetermined technology solutions.

  + Ability to translate business and service requirements into clear service designs, functional requirements, workflow designs, configuration decisions and acceptance criteria.

  + Experience taking ownership of ServiceNow changes from analysis and design through configuration, testing, release, operational handover and post-implementation review.

  + Experience configuring and improving HRSD capabilities such as case management, record producers, service catalogues, forms, routing, assignment rules, workflows, notifications, approvals, knowledge and lifecycle events.

  + Experience assessing incidents, defects, service issues, enhancements and optimisation opportunities, including impact analysis, root-cause investigation and recommendations, together with experience coordinating product and vendor-release cycles.

  + Experience producing and maintaining configuration workbooks, functional and service designs, workflow documentation, service-catalogue records, test evidence, release artefacts, operating procedures and product knowledge.

  + Confidence working with business stakeholders, Product Managers, Project Managers, technical specialists and third-party partners, including constructively challenging proposed designs, configuration, testing outputs and documentation.

  + Ability to deliver authorised configuration and improvements while observing security, access, data-protection, change-control and segregation-of-duties requirements.

Job Description

**Department:**

**Location:**

India – Bangalore (On-site)

**Level:**

People Manager – Mid/Senior

**About HealthEdge**
====================

HealthEdge is a leading healthcare SaaS company delivering modern, cloud-native solutions that transform how health plans operate. With a global workforce spanning the US, India, Philippines, Mexico, and the UK, our Business Technology team powers the tools and platforms that keep HealthEdge running at scale. Atlassian tools – Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence – sit at the center of how work gets planned, tracked, and documented across the entire organization.

**Role Overview**
=================

The Manager, Atlassian Products is a player-manager responsible for leading HealthEdge's Atlassian platform team while remaining technically engaged in the work. You will manage a globally distributed team of Atlassian Administrators – supporting thousands of users across engineering, IT, product, and business functions. Reporting to the Director, Business Technology, you are accountable for platform health, governance, stakeholder relationships, and team development.

This is a growth environment. The Atlassian team today spans approximately 14 people and is expected to grow toward 24 as HealthEdge's platform needs expand. You'll be responsible for hiring, onboarding, and developing talent for a 6-8 person group while ensuring the platform continues to meet the demands of a complex, fast-moving organization.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Team Leadership & Development**
---------------------------------

* Lead, manage, and develop a globally distributed team of Atlassian Administrators in India
* Drive hiring for open roles on the Atlassian Products team, partnering with HR and the Director, Business Technology to scale the team toward its target size
* Set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, conduct performance reviews, and support career development for all direct reports
* Build a high-performing team culture grounded in platform rigor, user focus, and continuous improvement
* Manage team capacity, workload distribution, and prioritization across the support queue and project backlog

**Platform Strategy & Governance**
----------------------------------

* Own the Atlassian platform roadmap in partnership with the Director, Business Technology – defining priorities, driving improvements, and aligning with organizational needs
* Establish and enforce governance standards for project structure, permissions, naming conventions, workflows, and Confluence space management across the organization
* Lead the evaluation and lifecycle management of Atlassian Marketplace apps — assessing fit, managing licenses, and governing usage
* Oversee Atlassian Access configuration including SSO, SCIM provisioning, security policies, and license management
* Drive platform hygiene initiatives and ensure the environment remains clean, well-documented, and audit-ready

**Technical Oversight & Solution Design**
-----------------------------------------

* Serve as the escalation point for complex platform issues and solution design decisions that exceed senior administrator scope
* Guide the design and implementation of advanced Jira, JSM, and Confluence configurations including complex workflows, automation frameworks, and cross-project solutions
* Oversee the development and maintenance of scripts and automation rules across the platform
* Ensure platform changes follow change management practices with appropriate testing, documentation, and rollback planning
* Stay current on Atlassian product developments, roadmap changes, and best practices, and translate these into team guidance

**Stakeholder Management**
--------------------------

* Serve as the primary business relationship owner for Atlassian products across IT, Engineering, Product, and business functions
* Partner with senior stakeholders to understand evolving platform needs and translate them into prioritized, scalable solutions
* Run regular stakeholder touchpoints, communicate platform changes and improvements proactively, and manage escalations professionally
* Partner with the ITSM team to ensure JSM is optimized for IT service delivery – SLAs, queues, automations, and reporting

**Operations & Reporting**
--------------------------

* Own the Atlassian support queue at a team level – ensuring SLA compliance, queue health, and consistent quality of delivery
* Produce and present regular reporting on platform health, team performance, license utilization, and open initiatives
* Manage the Atlassian vendor relationship including renewal negotiations, support cases, and TAM engagement
* Support audit and compliance activities related to Atlassian access, configuration, and data governance

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

**Required**
------------

* 5+ years of hands-on Atlassian administration experience, with deep expertise in Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence
* 2+ years of people management experience, including hiring, developing, and performance-managing technical team members
* Proven ability to lead a team in a global, distributed environment
* Strong platform governance experience – designing and enforcing standards across a large, complex Atlassian environment
* Experience with Atlassian Cloud administration including Atlassian Access, SSO/SCIM, and security policy management
* Hands-on experience with Jira automation (native) and advanced automation tooling
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate business requirements into platform solutions
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

**Preferred**
-------------

* Atlassian certifications (ACP-120, ACP-420, ACP-620, or equivalent) strongly preferred
* Experience managing Atlassian teams or platforms through growth, migrations, or consolidation projects
* Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and applying them within JSM for enterprise ITSM
* Experience with Atlassian Marketplace apps at scale (ScriptRunner, Insight/Assets, Advanced Roadmaps, Elements Connect, or similar)
* Exposure to REST API integrations with Atlassian platforms
* Experience in a healthcare, SaaS, or other regulated industry environment
* Background in post-merger IT integration or multi-instance Atlassian environments

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within 90 days, you have a clear picture of the current team, platform state, and stakeholder landscape, have identified the highest-priority gaps in governance and delivery, and have begun filling open roles. Within six months, the team is operating with clear standards, the support queue is consistently within SLA, and key stakeholders have a trusted partner in you. Within a year, the Atlassian Products team has grown toward its target size, platform governance is mature and well-documented, and you have established the function as a reliable, high-performing part of the Business Technology organization.

**About the Team**
==================

You'll lead a dedicated Atlassian Products team that is central to how HealthEdge operates. With Jira Software driving engineering and product delivery, JSM powering IT service management, and Confluence serving as the organization's knowledge backbone, the platform this team manages touches every function in the company. It's a high-visibility role with real impact — and a team and roadmap that reflect a serious, long-term investment in the Atlassian platform.

**About HealthEdge**

**Role Overview**
=================

The Atlassian Architect is the highest-level individual contributor on the Atlassian Products team, responsible for defining platform architecture, setting technical standards, and solving the most complex problems in HealthEdge's Atlassian environment. This is not an administration role – it is a design and engineering role. You will own the decisions that shape how the platform is built, governed, and extended, and your work will directly influence how thousands of employees across the company plan, collaborate, and deliver. As HealthEdge moves fully to Atlassian Cloud Enterprise, the Architect will also shape the platform's AI readiness — ensuring the architecture supports Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo at enterprise scale.

You will serve as the technical authority for the Atlassian Products team – providing architectural guidance, mentoring Senior and regular Administrators, leading complex solution delivery, and acting as the primary point of escalation for problems that require deep platform expertise. You will also own strategic initiatives including instance governance, automation frameworks, API integrations, and migration or consolidation efforts.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Platform Architecture & Standards**
-------------------------------------

* Own the Atlassian platform architecture across Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Confluence, and Atlassian Access – defining how these tools are structured, governed, and extended at scale
* Establish and maintain technical standards for project design, workflow architecture, permission models, field configuration, and Confluence space taxonomy across the organization
* Design scalable, maintainable solutions that balance user needs with platform health – avoiding configuration sprawl and technical debt
* Evaluate new Atlassian capabilities, product roadmap changes, and Marketplace apps – assessing fit, risk, and adoption strategy
* Produce and maintain architectural documentation including design decisions, standards references, and solution blueprints

**Complex Solution Design & Delivery**
--------------------------------------

* Lead discovery and solution design for the most complex stakeholder requests – those that require cross-project thinking, advanced automation, or architectural changes
* Translate ambiguous business requirements from engineering, IT, product, and business functions into well-structured, scalable Atlassian solutions
* Deliver end-to-end implementation of high-complexity configurations, including multi-project workflow frameworks, advanced JSM service architectures, and cross-tool integrations
* Partner with the Manager, Atlassian Products to define and manage the platform improvement roadmap, sequencing initiatives by impact and feasibility

**Automation & Scripting**
--------------------------

* Design and implement advanced automation frameworks using native Jira/JSM automation and ScriptRunner (Groovy) for complex workflow logic, validators, post-functions, and listeners
* Build and maintain REST API integrations between Atlassian tools and external systems including identity platforms, ITSM tools, and business applications
* Establish automation standards and reusable patterns that the broader admin team can follow and extend
* Review and quality-assure automation and scripting work produced by Senior Administrators, providing technical guidance and improvement feedback

**Migrations & Consolidations**
-------------------------------

* Lead or architect Atlassian migration and consolidation projects, including instance-to-instance migrations, Server/Data Center to Cloud transitions, and post-merger platform integrations
* Perform pre-migration assessments including configuration audits, data mapping, and risk analysis
* Design migration runbooks and execute or oversee technical migration steps with appropriate rollback planning
* Ensure data integrity, permission continuity, and minimal disruption to end users throughout migration events

**Enterprise Governance & Security**
------------------------------------

* Own Atlassian Access configuration including SSO, SCIM provisioning, authentication policies, IP allowlisting, and audit log management
* Design and enforce the organization-wide governance model for Atlassian – covering project creation standards, permission scheme governance, license management, and app approval processes
* Lead license optimization efforts, identifying consolidation opportunities and ensuring spend is aligned with actual usage
* Support security and compliance requirements including access reviews, data residency considerations, and audit evidence related to Atlassian platforms
* Serve as the technical lead for any Atlassian-related security incidents, misconfigurations, or compliance findings

**Team Mentorship & Technical Leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Serve as the informal technical lead for the Atlassian Products team – the person Senior and regular Administrators bring their hardest problems to
* Mentor Senior Administrators on advanced configuration, automation, and solution design, actively developing their technical depth
* Conduct technical design reviews for significant platform changes proposed by team members
* Contribute to hiring by participating in technical assessments for Atlassian Administrator and Senior Administrator candidates
* Represent the Atlassian Products team in cross-functional technical forums and architecture discussions

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

**Required**
------------

* 7+ years of deep, hands-on Atlassian platform experience with expert-level proficiency in Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing Atlassian architectures for large, complex organizations (thousands of users, dozens of teams)
* Expert-level proficiency in ScriptRunner (Groovy) scripting for advanced workflow customization, automation, and platform extensions
* Strong REST API experience with Atlassian platforms — building integrations, automating administrative tasks, and extending platform capabilities
* Proven experience leading Atlassian migrations or consolidation projects, including Cloud migrations
* Deep understanding of Atlassian Cloud security and governance including Atlassian Access, SSO/SCIM, and enterprise-scale permission management
* Ability to communicate architectural decisions clearly to both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

**Preferred**
-------------

* Atlassian certifications strongly preferred – ACP-120, ACP-420, ACP-620, or Atlassian Certified Expert (ACE) designation
* Familiarity with how Atlassian platform architecture affects AI indexing quality and Rovo answer relevance
* Experience with advanced Marketplace apps at architectural scale (Insight/Assets, Advanced Roadmaps, ScriptRunner, Elements Connect, Tempo)
* Exposure to enterprise ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and applying them within JSM at an architectural level
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and DevOps tooling that integrates with Atlassian (AWS, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines)
* Experience in a healthcare, SaaS, or other regulated industry environment
* Background in post-merger IT platform integration or multi-instance Atlassian consolidation

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within 90 days, you have completed a thorough assessment of the current Atlassian environment, identified the top architectural gaps and technical debt priorities, and established yourself as the go-to technical authority on the team. Within six months, you have delivered at least one significant platform improvement, established or formalized key governance standards, and are actively mentoring the admin team. Within a year, the Atlassian platform at HealthEdge reflects clear architectural ownership — well-governed, well-documented, and built to scale — and you have meaningfully elevated the technical capability of everyone around you.

**About the Team**
==================

You'll join a dedicated Atlassian Products team that is central to how HealthEdge operates at scale. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role for someone who wants to be the definitive technical expert on a platform that touches every part of the business. You'll have the backing of an engaged manager, a growing team of administrators to mentor, and a real mandate to shape how the platform evolves. If you want to do the most technically interesting Atlassian work of your career, this is that role.

**Job Description**

  

* We are creating a new Group People Technology function to provide clear ownership, expertise and direction across the technology that supports our global People services.

You will lead discovery and requirements workshops, challenge solution-led requests, shape functional designs, complete authorised configuration, coordinate testing and releases, investigate defects and deliver product improvements. You will ensure that stakeholders remain focused on the business problem and required outcomes, while People Technology brings the product expertise needed to determine the most effective solution.
* You will also create and maintain the detailed configuration, design, testing, release and operational documentation needed to support effective governance, auditability, continuity and future change. Through direct delivery, partner challenge, knowledge transfer and continuous learning, you will help strengthen internal capability and reduce unnecessary reliance on external partners.
* Although primarily aligned to People Foundation, you will also support other People Technology capability domains when concentrated demand, delivery priorities, holiday cover, business continuity or development opportunities require additional capacity.

* Deliver authorised configuration, product administration, enhancements and optimisation activity directly within agreed access, security, control and segregation-of-duties requirements.

title: Senior Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Tier 2 — Technical Support Engineer**

**Job Description**

**Additional CSR Qualifications / Requirements / Waivers**

**Tier 2 — Technical Support Engineer:**

* Proficient in Networking (Layer 2 & 3 topology, networking hardware, cabling, WAPs, routing protocols)
* Proficient in VoIP technologies (QoS, SIP Flow, Codec Negotiations, RTP, DTMF, SIP traces)
* Strong communication skills and a customer-first attitude
* High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple complex cases simultaneously
* Ability to:
* Independently develop solutions to complex technical, process, and systems problems
* Thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment
* Perform advanced root cause analysis and drive issues to resolution
* CCNA, Network+, or equivalent networking certification preferred

**Job Description**

**Why this role matters**
To customers, Tier 2 Technical Support Engineers are the escalation backbone of our support organization. When Tier 1 specialists encounter issues beyond initial troubleshooting, our Tier 2 engineers’ step in to own the resolution. We go deeper — into SIP traces, network captures, platform configurations, and engineering-level diagnostics — to deliver the answers our customers and teammates need. The Technical Support Engineer is a mid-level, high-impact position requiring strong technical aptitude and independent problem-solving.

IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU, CONTINUE READING BELOW…….

**What you will do**

* Serve as the primary escalation point for Tier 1 Technical Support Specialists, receiving and owning complex cases that require advanced technical investigation.
* Perform in-depth troubleshooting on call quality, call completion, SIP registration, call flow builds, features, and network-related issues across the platform.
* Analyze SIP traces, packet captures (PCAPs), and platform logs to diagnose and resolve voice and network issues.
* Independently resolve complex issues and collaborate with Tier 3 engineers, Voice Engineering, and Advanced Operations Support (AOS) on issues requiring escalated technical expertise.
* Manage and drive cases to resolution, ensuring timely updates to customers and adherence to SLA commitments.
* Follow up with customers and Tier 1 agents to confirm resolution and ensure a high level of satisfaction.
* Document customer issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions thoroughly within the ticketing system.
* Identify trends, recurring issues, and systemic problems; escalate patterns to management and Tier 3 for root cause analysis.
* Contribute to the development of internal knowledge base articles (IKBs) and training materials for Tier 1 upskilling.
* Participate in on-call rotation for after-hours and weekend support coverage.
* Mentor and coach Tier 1 team members on advanced troubleshooting methodologies and platform knowledge.

**What you will bring**

* Proficient knowledge of Networking (Layer 2 & 3 topology, networking hardware, cabling, WAPs, routing protocols such as OSPF/BGP).
* Strong working knowledge of VoIP technologies (QoS, SIP Flow, Codec Negotiations, RTP, DTMF, PCAP analysis).
* Experience troubleshooting within an IP/VoIP environment, including SIP registration, call routing, and call quality diagnostics.
* Familiarity with the Broad Works/BroadSoft hosted voice platform.
* Strong communication skills — both written and verbal — with the ability to manage difficult customer conversations professionally.
* Highly detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to:
* Manage multiple complex escalations simultaneously while maintaining quality and accuracy.
* Work independently and collaboratively across teams.
* Mentor junior team members and share knowledge proactively.
* Thrive in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment with tight SLA requirements.

**What is required for application?**

**Required**

* 2+ years of experience in technical support or network engineering role.
* CCNA, Network+, or equivalent networking certification, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* Hands-on experience with SIP, TCP/IP, VoIP, and LAN/WAN troubleshooting.

**Preferred**

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a technical field.
* Hands-on experience with Cisco and other networking equipment.
* Experience reading and interpreting SIP traces and PCAP files.
* Prior experience supporting enterprise-level customers in a tiered support model.

to serve as the first line of response across Vultr’s
**security signal surface — SIEM, threat, identity, and access alerts.**
This is a frontline security operations role for engineers who triage SIEM alerts, perform first-line containment, and preserve evidence in real time — and who want to grow into deeper SOC, threat-detection, or security engineering careers. You must be comfortable working a rotational shift model — including nights, weekends, and holidays — to sustain the coverage.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The
**Security Engineer**
is the entry point of the GIOC incident lifecycle for the security tower. You monitor security signals, acknowledge and triage alerts within
**defined first-response SLAs,**
execute documented runbooks to investigate and contain common security events, and escalate cleanly to Senior Security when an alert falls outside L1 scope. The role ensures f
**ast, accurate first response**
that protects customer data and platform security.
  
  
You operate from a consolidated
**single-pane-of-glass dashboard**
, classifying and routing incidents by severity and tower while owning accurate, complete documentation and chain-of-custody for every action. Success is measured by
**first-response SLA adherence, triage accuracy, and runbook resolution rate**
. The role runs on a
**rotational schedule**
to sustain 24x7 coverage.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Alert Monitoring & First Response**

* Monitor security signals — SIEM detections, authentication and access anomalies, threat-intel and endpoint alerts — from a consolidated single-pane-of-glass dashboard
* Acknowledge alerts and incidents within first-response SLA targets
* Perform initial review — validate the detection, rule out false positives, check recent changes, and review the CMDB before acting

**Triage & Severity Classification**

* Classify each alert by severity and potential impact, confirming the owning tower (Security / cross-tower)
* Route and assign tickets accurately to the correct tower or escalation path
* Sustain triage accuracy at or above the GIOC go-live standard
* Reassess severity as the investigation evolves, and declare higher when in doubt — treat suspected breaches as high-severity until ruled out

**Runbook-Driven Investigation & Containment**

* Match alert signatures to documented runbooks and execute permitted L1 actions
* Perform first-line containment within L1 scope (e.g., isolate, disable, or block per runbook) and preserve evidence for analysis
* Document every step taken, with supporting evidence and timestamps, in the incident ticket

**Escalation & Handoff**

* Escalate unresolved or out-of-scope alerts to the Senior Security Engineers with a clean, complete handoff (symptom
* evidence collected
* steps tried
* current state)
* Flag missing or ineffective runbooks and detection gaps for review and continuous improvement
* Initiate and support major-incident (Sev-0 / Sev-1) bridges per the escalation matrix; engage Security leads and incident response immediately on suspected breaches
* Track escalations to closure and confirm the threat is contained or ruled out before resolving the ticket

**Operational Documentation & Communication**

* Maintain accurate shift logs, ticket updates, and incident timelines with chain-of-custody for security evidence
* Provide clear, timely status communication to stakeholders per severity, following defined disclosure and confidentiality protocols
* Produce thorough shift-handover notes for seamless follow-the-sun continuity on active investigations

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify recurring alerts and false positives as candidates for detection tuning and automation
* Contribute to and improve runbooks, detection logic, and knowledge-base articles
* Participate in post-incident reviews (PIR) and trend reviews

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Graduate/Engineer in a relevant field (B.E./B.tech or equivalent)
* 3–5 years of experience in a SOC, security operations, or IT operations, including hands-on security monitoring and alert triage
* Working knowledge of security fundamentals — authentication and access, common attack types, logging, and endpoint/network telemetry
* Familiarity with SIEM and alert-triage concepts, log analysis, and basic threat investigation
* Understanding of incident-management fundamentals and severity-based triage
* Exposure to monitoring/observability tools and ticketing systems (SIEM consoles, alerting, ITSM)
* Strong written communication for accurate documentation and clean escalation handoffs; willingness and ability to work a rotational 24x7 shift model, including nights, weekends, and holidays
* Proficient in English verbal and written communication

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL V4 Foundation certification or equivalent ITSM knowledge
* Security certification (CompTIA Security+, CySA+, or equivalent)
* Scripting familiarity (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) for routine automation
* Exposure to cloud security and GPU / high-density infrastructure
* Prior experience in a 24x7 SOC or command-center environment, and tools such as JIRA, Confluence, PagerDuty, SIEM, and observability platforms

**Inclusion & Privacy**
We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
  
  
We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.
  
  
Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.
