title: UAV electronic system engineer
description:
Job Description – UAV Electronics & Communications Systems Engineer

Enhansafe India Pvt. Ltd.

**Position:**
UAV Electronics & Communications Systems Engineer
**Department:**
UAV / Unmanned Systems
**Location:**
Pune, Maharashtra (with travel across India and abroad)
**Experience:**
Minimum 3 years of hands-on UAV or related electronics experience

About Enhansafe

Enhansafe India Pvt. Ltd. is a deeptech defence and homeland security company building unmanned aerial systems and domestic drone platforms, alongside counter-drone, surveillance, perimeter security and unmanned surface vessel solutions. As a registered defence vendor, we work on mission-critical systems where reliability, security and discipline are non-negotiable.

Role Summary

We are looking for an electronics engineer who can own the electrical and communications backbone of our UAV platforms, from power distribution and battery management to RF links, telemetry, video and payload data, onboard networking and secure communications. You will design, integrate, test and field-support systems used in demanding operational environments.

Key Responsibilities

•      Design and validate power distribution architectures and battery management systems for multirotor and fixed-wing UAVs.

•      Develop and integrate communication, telemetry, and video and payload data links, including link-budget planning and range optimisation.

•      Design onboard networking and carry out end-to-end system integration of avionics, payloads and ground control systems.

•      Carry out RF engineering and antenna design, selection, placement and testing.

•      Implement communication security and resilience measures, including encryption, anti-jamming and fail-safe link behaviour.

•      Run bench, ground and flight tests; analyse data; troubleshoot and resolve electronics and RF issues in the field.

•      Prepare schematics, wiring harness documentation, test reports and technical SOPs.

•      Support demonstrations, customer trials and deployments across India and, when required, overseas.

Required Technical Expertise

The candidate must be well versed in all of the following areas, with project experience in each:

1.     Power distribution

2.     Battery management systems

3.     Communications and telemetry systems

4.     Video and payload data transmission

5.     Onboard networking and system integration

6.     RF engineering and antenna design

7.     Communication security and resilience

Qualifications and Experience

•      B.E./B.Tech (or higher) in Electronics, Electronics & Telecommunication, Electrical, Instrumentation or a related discipline.

•      Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in UAV, avionics, RF or embedded electronics.

•      Proven, hands-on involvement in projects covering the seven areas listed above.

•      Proficiency with schematic and PCB tools, RF test equipment (spectrum analyser, VNA, power meters) and standard lab instruments.

•      Good documentation and communication skills; able to work independently and in a team.

Selection Criteria

Past project experience in the listed areas is the key criterion for selection. Applicants must state their experience in
**each**
area separately in the application, naming the project, their role and the outcome.

Area

Applicant must mention

Power distribution

Projects, systems and your role

Battery management systems

Projects, systems and your role

Communications and telemetry

Projects, systems and your role

Video and payload data transmission

Projects, systems and your role

Onboard networking and system integration

Projects, systems and your role

RF engineering and antenna design

Projects, systems and your role

Communication security and resilience

Projects, systems and your role

Applications that do not address each area will not be shortlisted.

Location and Travel

•      Based in Pune, Maharashtra.

•      Travel across India is expected for projects, field trials and demonstrations.

•      Foreign travel may be required; a valid passport is mandatory.

How to Apply

Email your application to
**Directorops@enhansafe.com**
with the subject line "Application – UAV Electronics & Communications Systems Engineer". Include:

1.     Your CV and a covering note stating your experience in each of the seven technical areas.

2.     Salary slips (recent).

3.     Achievements and awards.

4.     White papers, publications or technical write-ups, if any.

5.     Copy of a valid passport.

Only applications with complete documents and area-wise experience statements will be considered.

title: Project Engineer – Electrical Hardware
description:
**Position Summary**
Husco International provides individuals with the opportunity to pursue a career within a fast-paced, industry-leading and entrepreneurial organization. This person works within an engineering team and is responsible for supporting the organization with the new and existing products, analysis, tools, and designs. This person collaborates internally and externally with multi-disciplined teams to help envision, create, modify, test, document, validate, design, debug and produce electrical hardware solutions. A person in this role enjoys developing elegant hardware/software solutions through understanding customer needs, industry standards, and existing and novel electrical approaches. They also have strong technical background in moving electrical hardware from concept to production and beyond.
  
  
Husco is committed to building a diverse environment for employees to be able:
  
  

* To have the flexibility to put a personal ‘stamp’ on their work
* To continuously expand and develop their professional skills, knowledge, and career
* To create a product for our customers that serves a greater purpose to communities around the world

**PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES:**- Rapid Learning and Skill Development: Embrace a steep learning curve to rapidly expand product knowledge, abilities, and toolkit (e.g., Altium Designer, Electrical SPICE simulation, industry standards (IPC, ISO, etc.), debugging, testing, Agile development methods) to apply to electrical hardware design and validations from concept to production.
- End-to-End Electrical Hardware Support: Utilize your expertise to efficiently turn engineering requirements into reality. Collaborate with PCB fabrication and assembly manufacturing, test labs, component suppliers, engineering labs, software engineers, and internal/external customers throughout the development process, from early development to production and beyond.
Expertise in Power Electronics Hardware: Demonstrate proficiency in PCB design for low power electronic hardware such as solenoid and motor control (<60V, <50A). This includes designing for EMC, ESD, thermal, noise, etc. Showcase experience in components selection and robust PCB layout. Design and select hardware suitable for automotive and off-highway markets. Utilize cutting-edge software (e.g., Altium, Ansys, Amesim, ICEPak). Conduct testing, validation, and documentation for production- Deep Understanding of Electrical power and communication systems. Utilize your knowledge of software, mechanical, and electrical domains to set up simulations, firmware, component tests, systems tests, and modifications of a PCBA. Leverage your expertise to break down electrical systems into underlying components and circuits, proposing, implementing, testing, writing software, and validating function/fit with respect to requirements.
- Strong Team Player and Contributor. Able to work well with colleagues and produce results within a fast-paced and high-pressure atmosphere. Combine a balance of attention to detail and complete work within project timelines while complying with process, quality, safety, and communication expectations.
**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor of Electrical Engineering major or equivalent
* 4+ years of work experience and demonstrated proficiency in embedded PCB power electronics, board design, board layout, testing, board rework/soldering, and debugging
* Demonstrated proficiency in simulation of electronic circuits
* Demonstrated proficiency in Altium Designer, including use of version control, libraries, templates, etc.
* Capability to interpret and create schematics, circuits, requirements documents, datasheets, test plans, and DFMEAs
* Understanding of Electrical requirements of mobile equipment (EMC, ESD, vibration, Load dump, etc..) and how to read, understand, design for, test, and validate conformity to applicable standards
* Strong oral, written and listening communication skills
* Ability to work independently and within a group.

**NICE TO HAVE:**

* Experience in C programming and MCU development tools writing embedded software, drivers, communication protocols (CAN, SPI, etc.) firmware, test infrastructure for embedded hardware
* Experience in working with stakeholders (internal, suppliers, test house, customer) to launch product
* Experience and interest in Siemens Simcenter Amesim Physical modeling product
* Interest in learning other coding languages and processes
* Experience in functional safety and security standards and processes
* Experience/interest in Electrical Hardware functional safety and security requirements / standards
* Experience/interest in working with Electrical component and assembly manufacturers from concept to test, to production and obsolescence
* Knowledge of the software development lifecycle
* Experience in writing software requirements, test plans, and documentation
* Comfortable with the analysis and able to break down large control systems into smaller component level systems
* Ability to understand and develop complex control systems in the mechatronics, robotics, hydraulic, or similar within an embedded system environment.
* Proficient in Git Version control system

**Who We Are:**
Imagine a place where your career can soar, where innovation meets excellence, and where your contributions truly matter. Welcome to Husco.
  
  
Here, you’ll find the freedom to shape your work and leave a lasting impact. We believe in empowering you to grow personally and professionally, continuously enhancing your skills and knowledge.
  
  
Your role at Husco goes beyond the ordinary – you’ll be at the forefront of supporting teams that develop innovative hydraulic and electro-mechanical systems that enhance efficiency and performance. These products make a real difference globally, building the communities we live in, growing the food that feeds us, and enhancing transportation around the world.
  
  
Join our vibrant, industry-leading team and experience a culture that values your creativity, dedication, and drive. Together, we’re not just achieving goals; we’re setting new standards and making a positive impact every day.
  
  
**HUSCO IS PROUD TO BE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.**

title: Associate Service Desk Analyst
description:
Overview:

**Service Desk Analyst – T1**

Job Description

**Department:**

Security & Corporate IT

**Reports To:**

IT Service Desk Team Lead

**Location:**

India (On-site)

**Level:**

Individual Contributor – Entry/Mid

**About HealthEdge**
====================

HealthEdge is a leading healthcare SaaS company delivering modern, cloud-native solutions that transform how health plans operate. With a global workforce spanning the US, India, Philippines, Mexico, and the UK, our Corporate IT team plays a critical role in enabling productivity, supporting our people, and ensuring every employee has the tools they need to do their best work.

**Role Overview**
=================

The Service Desk Analyst serves as the first point of contact for all IT support requests across HealthEdge's global employee base. In this role, you will triage, troubleshoot, and resolve a wide range of hardware, software, and connectivity issues through our ITSM platform (Jira Service Management), by phone, chat, and remote tools. You are part of a follow-the-sun support model, meaning your team's work directly enables colleagues around the world to stay productive regardless of time zone.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically curious, service-minded IT professional who wants to build a broad foundation across endpoint management, identity, M365, and ITSM — with clear growth paths into T2/T3 support, specialist, or team lead roles.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Incident Intake & Resolution**
--------------------------------

* Serve as the first point of contact for IT support requests via phone, chat, and email
* Triage and categorize incoming tickets, resolving T1-scope issues within defined SLA targets
* Troubleshoot common issues across Windows and macOS endpoints, M365 applications, printers, VPN, and peripherals
* Escalate unresolved or complex issues to T2/T3 with full documentation and context
* Follow established runbooks and knowledge base articles to deliver consistent, repeatable resolutions

**Identity & Access Management**
--------------------------------

* Process user onboarding and offboarding requests including account provisioning, deprovisioning, and access modifications
* Manage password resets, MFA enrollment, and basic Okta/Entra ID requests
* Ensure access requests are fulfilled within SLA and properly documented per security policies

**Endpoint & Device Support**
-----------------------------

* Assist employees with setup and configuration of laptops, desktops, mobile devices, and peripherals
* Support basic imaging, software installation, and configuration tasks as directed by T2/T3
* Coordinate hardware swap or depot processes with the EUC & Asset Management team when replacement is needed

**Documentation & Knowledge**
-----------------------------

* Log all interactions and resolutions accurately and completely in work tracking tools
* Contribute to the knowledge base by documenting new solutions and updating existing articles
* Follow ITIL-aligned processes for incident management, request fulfillment, and escalation

**Communication & Customer Service**
------------------------------------

* Provide clear, timely, and professional communication to end users at all stages of ticket lifecycle
* Set accurate expectations on resolution timelines and proactively communicate delays
* Represent the Corporate IT team positively as the most visible touchpoint for the broader employee base

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

**Required**
------------

* 1–3 years of experience in a help desk, service desk, or IT support role
* Hands-on experience supporting Windows 10/11 and macOS endpoints
* Familiarity with M365 applications (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
* Experience working in a ticketing system
* Basic understanding of Active Directory or Entra ID user and group management
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills
* Customer-first mindset with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience with SSO/MFA platforms
* Familiarity with remote support tools
* Exposure to ITIL frameworks or service management best practices
* CompTIA A+, Microsoft Fundamentals (MD-102), or equivalent certification
* Experience in a global or multi-region IT support environment

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

In your first 90 days, you will have completed onboarding and tool training, worked your first live ticket queue, and demonstrated the ability to independently resolve common T1 issues. Within six months, you are consistently meeting SLA targets, contributing to the knowledge base, and beginning to develop familiarity with escalation patterns to T2. Within a year, you are a reliable, trusted member of the team – handling a broad range of T1 issues with minimal escalation and actively contributing to team improvement efforts.

**About the Team**
==================

You'll join a growing global Corporate IT organization that is building out a structured, tiered support model across India, the Philippines, the US, Mexico, and the UK. The Service Desk Analyst role sits at the foundation of this model – and is the most important customer-facing function in the organization. We take pride in our follow-the-sun coverage model, our investment in tooling and knowledge management, and our commitment to creating clear career paths for team members who want to grow.

*HealthEdge commits to building an environment and culture that supports the diverse representation of our teams. We aspire to have an inclusive workplace. We aspire to be a place where all employees have the opportunity to belong, make an impact and deliver excellent software and services to our customers.*  
  
**Geographic Responsibility:**  
**Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent**  
**FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt**  
**Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:**

* **The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.**
* **Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.**
* **Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.**
* **May require travel dependent on company needs.**

*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. title: Microsoft 365 Support Engineer – L2/L3_3+yrs
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced Microsoft 365 Support Engineer to manage, administer, and troubleshoot Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft Entra ID, and related security and compliance solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in L2/L3 troubleshooting, Active Directory, MDM/MAM, identity and access management, and Microsoft 365 security administration.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Microsoft 365 Administration: Administer, manage, and troubleshoot Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and other Microsoft 365 services.
* Identity and Access Management: Manage Microsoft Entra ID, user and group administration, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Conditional Access policies, Single Sign-On (SSO), and access-related issues.
* Exchange Online Administration: Troubleshoot mailbox access, mail flow, transport rules, shared mailboxes, distribution groups, email delivery, Outlook connectivity, and Exchange Online migrations.
* Security and Compliance: Support Microsoft Purview, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), retention policies, eDiscovery, and Microsoft 365 security configurations.
* L2/L3 Troubleshooting: Handle escalated incidents, perform root-cause analysis, resolve complex technical issues, and coordinate with Microsoft Support for product-related escalations.
* MDM/MAM Management: Administer and troubleshoot Mobile Device Management (MDM) and Mobile Application Management (MAM), preferably using Microsoft Intune. Support device enrollment, compliance policies, application protection policies, and device configuration.
* Active Directory (AD) Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot Active Directory issues related to user accounts, groups, authentication, permissions, Group Policy, and directory synchronization with Microsoft Entra ID.
* Incident and Service Request Management: Manage incidents, service requests, and change requests in accordance with defined SLAs and IT service management processes.
* Monitoring and Reporting: Monitor Microsoft 365 service health, maintain technical documentation, prepare operational reports, and identify recurring issues.
* L1 Support Guidance: Provide technical guidance to L1 engineers, assist with complex escalations, and contribute to knowledge base documentation and process improvements.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting Microsoft 365 environments.
* Strong expertise in Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
* Practical experience with Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, Conditional Access, SSO, and identity management.
* Experience with Microsoft Intune, MDM/MAM, device compliance, and application protection policies.
* Working knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, authentication, and directory synchronization.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Purview, DLP, retention policies, eDiscovery, and security configurations.
* Strong L2/L3 troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
* Experience managing incidents, service requests, and changes within defined SLAs.
* Good communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Microsoft 365 administration or security certifications.
* Experience with PowerShell scripting for Microsoft 365 administration and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with ITIL-based service management processes.
* Experience coordinating with Microsoft Support and handling critical escalations.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
A technically strong Microsoft 365 professional who can independently manage escalated issues across messaging, collaboration, identity, endpoint management, security, and Active Directory while ensuring service availability and SLA compliance.

title: Exposure Management Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a cybersecurity professional with strong experience in vulnerability management, risk assessment, infrastructure security, security operations, and stakeholder engagement. The candidate should be comfortable communicating with both technical teams and executive leadership while driving measurable reductions in organizational cyber risk.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Vulnerability & Attack Surface Management**
Govern the end-to-end vulnerability lifecycle including identification, assessment, prioritization, remediation tracking, validation, and closure.
  
  
Perform vulnerability analysis using industry-standard tools.
  
  
Conduct risk-based prioritization using CVSS scores, exploitability data, business impact, threat intelligence, and asset criticality.
  
  
Track remediation activities and ensure adherence to established remediation SLAs.
  
  
Stay informed on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and industry best practices.
  
  
**Automation**
Develop and maintain automated security workflows to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual efforts.
  
  
Utilize SOAR platforms, existing tool capabilities, and integrations to streamline security operations.
  
  
**Risk & Exposure Management**
Evaluate newly disclosed vulnerabilities, zero-day threats, and critical security advisories.
  
  
Assess business risk associated with vulnerabilities and provide remediation recommendations.
  
  
Drive reduction of organizational attack surface and cyber exposure.
  
  
Manage vulnerability exception and risk acceptance processes.
  
  
Support incident response investigations involving exploited vulnerabilities.
  
  
**Reporting & Governance**
Develop executive-level dashboards and vulnerability metrics.
  
  
Prepare weekly and monthly reports highlighting risk posture, remediation trends, and SLA compliance.
  
  
Present vulnerability-related findings to technical leadership and business stakeholders.
  
  
Maintain vulnerability management policies, standards, procedures, and operational runbooks.

* Bachelor’s degree in information security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

* Working knowledge of scripting and API integration technologies such as PowerShell, Python, JSON, or XML.
* Experience with security platforms and tools including SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, NDR, and vulnerability management solutions.
* Experience working with any of the vulnerability management solution i.e.,
* Qualys VMDR, Tenable Nessus, Rapid7 InsightVM, CrowdStrike Exposure Management. (CrowdStrike Exposure Management is preferred)

title: Senior Platform Architect
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Platform Architect
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
**Overview**
The Infrastructure Engineering team is looking for a Senior Platform Architect to lead the design and evolution of secure, scalable, and resilient enterprise infrastructure platforms that power Mastercard's critical business services. The ideal candidate is a strategic technology leader with deep expertise in enterprise architecture, infrastructure engineering, and cloud technologies. They are highly collaborative, intellectually curious, and passionate about solving complex technical challenges while driving innovation, operational excellence, and platform modernization. This individual excels at partnering across engineering, security, and product organizations to deliver scalable solutions that enable business growth and provide exceptional customer experiences.
  
  
Role
  
  

* Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of highly available, scalable, and secure enterprise infrastructure solutions across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.
* Partner with Engineering, Network, Security, Cloud, Database, Middleware, Product, and Program Management teams to develop infrastructure solutions that support business and technology strategies.
* Drive infrastructure solution delivery from initial business engagement through architecture reviews, financial approvals, procurement, implementation, operational readiness, and production deployment.
* Design resilient networking, application delivery, and security architectures utilizing enterprise technologies including load balancing, web application firewalls, API gateways, and distributed infrastructure platforms.
* Lead infrastructure modernization initiatives focused on automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), platform standardization, performance optimization, resiliency, and operational excellence.
* Develop enterprise architecture standards, technical roadmaps, and infrastructure documentation while mentoring engineering teams and promoting engineering best practices.
* Ensure infrastructure solutions meet stringent requirements for security, compliance, availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and performance across mission-critical platforms.

**All About You**
Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience
  
  

* Deep expertise in enterprise infrastructure architecture across data center, hybrid cloud, and distributed computing environments.
* Advanced knowledge of enterprise networking, application delivery, and infrastructure security, including Zero Trust principles and modern network architectures.
* Experience designing and supporting enterprise platforms utilizing VMware, cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP), load balancing, web application firewalls, API gateways, and distributed infrastructure.
* Strong expertise in infrastructure automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible), CI/CD integration, and configuration management using tools such as Git, Bitbucket, and Jenkins.
* Demonstrated ability to architect and deliver highly available, resilient, and secure infrastructure solutions while collaborating effectively across cross-functional engineering and business teams.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence technical and executive stakeholders.

**Desirable Or Additional Capabilities**

* Expertise in infrastructure performance engineering, including capacity planning, scalability testing, and performance optimization.
* Advanced experience creating technical architecture documentation and executive presentations using Microsoft Visio.
* Experience supporting mission-critical financial services platforms with stringent availability, security, resiliency, and regulatory compliance requirements.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

* Responsible for assessing and improving security posture across systems, data, applications, and networks in line with industry standards, regulations, and best practices.

title: Zscaler Network Security-Principal engineer- Associate director
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Security Technology Services – Network Security Technology**
**EY Technology**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently and securely. We have more than 400,000 people in over 150 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to perform their jobs every day.
  
  
Everything we use as a firm depends on our security-first mindset. Our users, applications, cloud platforms, data centers, AI services, and business-critical systems all rely on modern security technologies to enable secure access, protect sensitive information, and reduce cyber risk.
  
  
Within Security Technology Services, our mission is to deliver world-class security engineering capabilities that enable Zero Trust, cloud transformation, attack surface reduction, and secure digital experiences. If you are passionate about building and engineering security solutions at global scale, we want to hear from you.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a
**Principal Engineer – Associate Director**
to join Security Technology Services as a senior hands-on engineering leader focused on Zscaler, Zero Trust and secure cloud networking integration.
  
  
This role is responsible for engineering, deployment, integration, automation, optimization and technical leadership of EY’s global Zscaler platform and associated network security capabilities.
  
  
The successful candidate will operate as a deeply technical, hands-on subject matter expert across core Zscaler cloud capabilities, ZPA, Zscaler Client Connector, workload segmentation, Azure secure networking concepts, hybrid data center connectivity, Zscaler AI Firewall, AI Guard and Zero Trust access patterns.
  
  
This role will lead strategic engineering initiatives focused on:
  
  

* Azure secure networking integration
* Hybrid cloud security
* VMware data center segmentation
* Enterprise AI security using Zscaler AI Firewall and AI Guard
* Secure access transformation

The role will work closely with Network Security, Cloud Engineering, Application Security, Identity, Infrastructure, Architecture, and Product teams to engineer and deploy scalable enterprise security solutions globally.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
The Zscaler and Zero Trust Engineering Lead will provide senior technical leadership for the deployment, integration, optimization and continuous improvement of EY’s global secure access and Zero Trust engineering platforms.
  
  
**Zscaler Engineering Leadership**

* Serve as the senior hands-on engineering lead for core Zscaler cloud capabilities, including ZIA, ZPA, Zscaler Client Connector, App Connectors, Private Service Edges, Workload Communications, Microsegmentation, Zscaler AI Firewall and AI Guard.
* Engineer, deploy, configure and optimize large-scale Zscaler solutions supporting global business operations.
* Lead onboarding of enterprise applications, cloud services and business workloads into Zero Trust architectures.
* Drive adoption of new Zscaler capabilities and engineering best practices.
* Develop reference configurations, reusable engineering patterns and deployment standards.

**Azure Secure Networking Integration**

* Bring deep working knowledge of Azure secure networking patterns to support Zscaler integration across EY Azure environments.
* Understand, validate and troubleshoot Azure networking components including Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, Front Door, Private Link and Private Endpoint.
* Work with EY Azure architects to integrate Zscaler capabilities with Azure-hosted applications, workloads, AI platforms and infrastructure services.
* Translate Azure secure networking requirements into Zscaler engineering patterns, connectivity models and deployment standards.
* Partner closely with EY Azure architecture and cloud engineering teams to drive secure Zscaler product integration across Azure environments.

**Zero Trust and Application Access Engineering**

* Lead migration of applications from traditional VPN and internet-facing architectures to Zero Trust models using ZPA.
* Engineer secure access models for internal users, external users, vendors, contractors and developers.
* Implement identity-aware access controls integrated with Entra ID, Conditional Access and device posture solutions.
* Engineer secure connectivity solutions for hybrid cloud and multi-cloud environments.
* Engineer application segmentation patterns that reduce attack surface and minimize lateral movement risk.

**Workload Segmentation Engineering**

* Implement workload segmentation solutions across Azure and hybrid environments.
* Deploy and manage Zscaler Workload Communications capabilities.
* Engineer workload-to-workload and application-to-application segmentation policies.
* Secure east-west traffic between business-critical applications and services.
* Develop segmentation models for production, non-production, shared services and management environments.

**Data Center and VMware Security Engineering**

* Engineer secure connectivity solutions across traditional data center environments.
* Deploy App Connectors and Private Service Edges in VMware-based infrastructure.
* Integrate Zscaler technologies with enterprise data center environments.
* Support migration of legacy applications into Zero Trust architectures.
* Support secure connectivity integration between on-premises data centers, Zscaler platforms and Azure cloud environments.

**Engineering Automation and Platform Optimization**

* Build and maintain automation solutions to improve security engineering efficiency.
* Automate deployment, configuration validation and policy management activities.
* Utilize Terraform, Python, PowerShell, APIs and Infrastructure-as-Code approaches.
* Improve platform scalability, consistency and operational effectiveness through automation.
* Participate in development of future-state security engineering roadmaps.

**Technical Leadership**

* Serve as the highest level engineering escalation point for complex technical issues.
* Lead troubleshooting of networking, routing, DNS, TLS, authentication and connectivity challenges.
* Mentor and coach engineers across Network Security Technology.
* Participate in architecture reviews, engineering governance and major transformation programs.
* Communicate complex technical concepts to engineering, architecture and executive stakeholders.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
We are interested in candidates who bring deep engineering experience from large global enterprise environments and can combine hands-on technical execution with practical leadership.
  
  
As a successful candidate, you will demonstrate:
  
  

* Strong hands-on engineering expertise across network security, cloud security and Zero Trust technologies.
* Deep troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to engineer and deploy security solutions at enterprise scale in partnership with platform architecture teams.
* Strong understanding of Azure secure networking, hybrid connectivity and cloud security integration patterns.
* Experience working across global teams and multiple technology disciplines.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Passion for automation, innovation and continuous improvement.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced and highly complex environments.

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering or equivalent experience.
* 15-20 years of Network Security and Security Engineering experience.
* 12-15 years of experience engineering, deploying or integrating cloud security and Zscaler technologies.
* 8-10 years leading engineering teams or large engineering initiatives.
* Expert-level experience with Zscaler technologies including ZIA and ZPA.
* Experience deploying and supporting enterprise-scale Zscaler environments.
* Experience implementing Zero Trust solutions and secure access architectures.
* Experience onboarding cloud-hosted and on-premises applications into ZPA.
* Experience supporting and troubleshooting Azure secure networking environments in partnership with Azure architecture teams.
* Experience deploying security solutions within VMware-based data centers.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, routing, BGP, PKI and enterprise networking concepts.
* Experience with automation technologies such as Python, Terraform, PowerShell and REST APIs.
* Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Deep expertise in Azure Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute, Azure Firewall Premium, Application Gateway, Front Door and Private Link.
* Experience deploying Zscaler Workload Communications and workload segmentation solutions.
* Experience reducing public IP exposure through Zero Trust architectures.
* Experience securing Azure IaaS, PaaS and AKS environments.
* Experience integrating Zscaler with Microsoft Entra ID and Conditional Access.
* Strong understanding of SASE and SSE security architectures.
* Experience securing AI, GenAI and cloud-native workloads using Zscaler AI Firewall and AI Guard.
* Zscaler Certifications focused on ZIA, ZPA, Client Connector, workload segmentation, AI Firewall, AI Guard or equivalent hands-on platform engineering credentials.
* Azure Network Engineer Associate or Azure Security Engineer certifications.
* CISSP, CCSP, CCNP or equivalent certifications.

**What We Look For**
We are looking for a highly technical engineering leader who remains hands-on, leads by example and is comfortable solving complex security challenges across global cloud, data center and Zero Trust environments.
  
  
The ideal candidate has successfully integrated and deployed Zscaler technologies across Azure, enterprise data centers, and hybrid cloud environments, possesses deep networking expertise, and can engineer scalable Zero Trust solutions in partnership with EY Azure architects and platform teams.
  
  
**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working, career development and benefits that support your personal and professional priorities.
  
  
Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from engaging colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
* Exposure to large-scale global technology and cybersecurity transformation programs.
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you.

EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service while supporting your career and personal priorities.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Job Summary**

You will partner with Customer Reliability Engineering (CRE) to bridge the gap between customer-facing teams and backend cloud infrastructure, providing escalation support and defining supportability requirements. You will thrive in this position if you excel in cloud-native environments and consistently seek to understand the "why" behind complex technical issues.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own critical incidents and technically complex Jira issues for Prisma AIRS, AI Gateway, and Cloud NGFW.
* Analyze complex packet captures, API transactions, cloud routing, and infrastructure logs to identify root causes.
* Partner with TSEs, SRE, DevOps, and backend Developers to define supportability, telemetry, and usability requirements.
* Leverage LLMs to create agentic workflows and innovate automated troubleshooting and remediation processes.
* Collaborate with CREs and SREs during P1/P2 incidents to investigate backend infrastructure and security policies.
* Develop troubleshooting playbooks and deliver advanced technical training on Prisma AIRS and Cloud NGFW architecture.
* Create tools and automation to solve support challenges at scale and improve the overall customer experience.
* Build and maintain complex multi-tenant, multi-cloud lab environments to replicate customer deployments and validate fixes.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum of MS with 12 years of professional experience, or BS with at least 14 years of experience. (Please confirm this inferred value with your Comp partner).
* Strong experience with enterprise SaaS application back-end systems, RESTful APIs, DevOps, SRE, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Solid grasp of AWS, Azure, and GCP networking constructs and fundamentals in TCP/IP, IPv6, and dynamic routing.
* Expertise in troubleshooting, API integrations, routing/switching, IPSec, SSL/TLS, and packet analysis using tcpdump and Wireshark.
* Proficiency with Python, REST APIs, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) to automate lab deployments and scripts.
* Strong communication skills to deliver highly technical presentations to Engineers and Executive teams.
* Ability and willingness to work flexible hours, including occasional weekends, evenings, and rotating on-call shifts.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proficiency with state-of-the-art AI models such as Claude and ChatGPT in coding and engineering workflows.
* Comfortable navigating Linux shells, understanding sockets, and monitoring resource consumption.
* Deep understanding of PAN-OS architecture, specifically dataplane packet flow, App-ID, Content-ID, and SSL Decryption.
* Hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks products, particularly Prisma AIRS.
* Experience with incident management tools such as PagerDuty or FireHydrant.

**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Staff Cloud Infra Engineer
description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
  
  
Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
  
  
At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
  
  
When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
  
  
**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
*This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office.*
**About The Role**
You'll own a significant area of our cloud platform end to end — the Kubernetes and IaC foundations, the reliability of what runs on them, or the security controls that wrap them — across cloud regions and out to edge sites co-located with our satellite gateways.
  
  
At Staff level we expect you to take a problem that's stated loosely, turn it into a plan, and deliver it without close supervision. You'll write the design doc, get it reviewed, build the thing, and then operate it. You're not expected to set direction for the whole org — but you are expected to shape it for your area, and to be the person others come to when that area is on fire. This is a hands-on role. The majority of your week is building.
  
  
What you'll own
  
  
**Platform and Kubernetes**

* Operate and improve our multi-cluster, multi-region Kubernetes platform: cluster lifecycle, upgrades, workload isolation, networking, and resource management.
* Build and maintain infrastructure as code as a real engineering artifact — reviewed, tested, versioned, no manual drift.
* Extend our developer platform so shipping a service is fast and boring: golden paths, progressive delivery, environments that don't require a ticket.
* Own CI/CD pipelines for workloads ranging from ordinary stateless services to network functions with strict latency and availability requirements.

**Reliability and observability**

* Instrument services against SLOs and build out the metrics, logs, and tracing needed to know whether we're meeting them.
* Participate in on-call, lead incidents in your area, and write postmortems that produce real changes rather than filed documents.
* Tune alerting so engineers trust it. Drive down toil through automation, deliberately and measurably.
* Contribute to capacity planning, failure-domain design, and DR testing for a network that can't take a casual maintenance window.

**Security and compliance infrastructure**

* Implement and maintain platform security controls: least-privilege IAM, secrets management, network segmentation, image scanning, and supply-chain integrity.
* Automate the evidence that compliance requires, so audits are a query rather than a project.
* Work with Security on the requirements that come with operating inside a carrier's network.

**Technical contribution**

* Write design docs for the systems you own and take them through review.
* Review code and infrastructure changes with an eye on operability, not just correctness.
* Mentor mid-level engineers and improve the team's practices by demonstrating them.

What we're looking for
  
  
**Required**

* 7+ years in infrastructure, platform, DevOps, or SRE roles, with clear ownership of production systems that mattered.
* Strong production Kubernetes experience — not just deploying to it, but operating it: upgrades, networking, resource limits, and debugging failures that aren't in the documentation.
* Hands-on depth in AWS or GCP. Exposure to a second cloud, or to hybrid and edge infrastructure, is a real plus — our footprint isn't uniform and we need people who don't stall when the environment gets irregular.
* Solid infrastructure as code practice (Terraform or equivalent), applied where discipline actually mattered.
* Proficiency in at least one systems or automation language — Go or Python preferred — enough to build tooling, not only scripts.
* Direct production reliability ownership: you've carried a pager for something important, run incidents, and changed systems as a result.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure security: IAM, secrets, network policy, container hardening.
* Clear written communication. Design docs and postmortems are core to how this team works.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Telecom or network infrastructure exposure — 5G core, cloud-native network functions, or carrier-grade availability requirements.
* Have some experience in managing databases and applications with High Availability of 99.999%.
* Edge or on-premises infrastructure alongside public cloud, particularly sites with constrained connectivity.
* Compliance-adjacent environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or carrier security requirements).
* FinOps Cost engineering — you've meaningfully reduced cloud spend without degrading reliability.
* Working across distributed teams and time zones.

**What This Role Is Not**

* Not a people-management role. This is an IC position and we intend to keep it one.
* Not a ticket queue. You'll be given problems, not tasks, and we expect you to scope them yourself.
* Not a greenfield rewrite. You'll be improving a system already carrying live traffic, which is harder and more interesting.

Why this role is worth your time
  
  
Satellite direct-to-device is a genuinely new category, and the infrastructure patterns for it are not settled. The team is small enough that what you build is in production within weeks and visibly yours. If you're strong technically and looking for scope that would take years to get at a larger company, that's the trade we're offering.
  
  
**What We Offer**
With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range of benefits such as:
  
  

* Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
* Comprehensive benefits plans
* Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
* A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
* Once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to be part of developing and running the world’s first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network and service
* Access to a world-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
* Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends Silicon Valley, Nordic and South Asia characteristics

**EEO Statement**
Skylo is an equal-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  
  
We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.

title: Systems Administrator, Hybrid Cloud and AI Infrastructure
description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.
  
  
Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).
  
  
This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
Lenovo seeks a Systems Administrator to own end-to-end deployment, support, and administration of hybrid cloud and AI infrastructure primarily for the Bangalore lab, across the network, compute, storage, operating system, and container orchestration (Docker and Kubernetes) layers, plus the NVIDIA technology stack.
  
  
You are a dedicated support resource for the Lab Operations Manager and you keep hybrid cloud and AI infrastructure operational in Bangalore at the scale the AI Lab Consolidation requires. You coordinate remotely with the Morrisville-based Systems Administrator, GPU/AI Infrastructure, Network Engineer on shared standards, escalations, and cross-site incident response, and you provide secondary technical support back to Morrisville. The role sits within Lenovo SSG’s Hybrid Cloud and AI Infrastructure Services (HCAIS) Offering Architecture Engineering organization.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Infrastructure Deployment and Administration
  
  

* Network: deploy, support, and administer lab networking for the Bangalore site.
* Compute: deploy, support, and administer physical and virtual compute infrastructure across the Bangalore lab.
* Storage: deploy, support, and administer lab storage systems across block and file tiers.
* Operating Systems: install, patch, and administer operating systems across Bangalore lab infrastructure.

Hybrid Cloud Platform Administration
  
  

* VMware: deploy, support, and administer VMware virtualization infrastructure (vSphere, ESXi, vCenter).
* Azure: support hybrid cloud integration and workloads extending Bangalore lab infrastructure to Microsoft Azure.
* Nutanix: deploy, support, and administer Nutanix hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI).
* Red Hat OpenShift: deploy, support, and administer Red Hat OpenShift container platform environments, extending the lab’s container orchestration footprint.

Container Orchestration
  
  

* Docker: deploy and administer Docker container runtime environments.
* Kubernetes: own full production Kubernetes administration, including cluster operations, role-based access control (RBAC), cluster networking, and version upgrades.

NVIDIA Platform Administration
  
  

* NVIDIA Technology Stack: administer NVIDIA drivers, the CUDA toolkit, InfiniBand fabric, Run:AI orchestration, and ClearML across the Bangalore lab’s GPU infrastructure.
* Configuration Validation: validate lab configurations against NVIDIA reference architecture (Lenovo Validated Design) certification requirements.

Lab Operations and Smart Hands
  
  

* Equipment Support: provide on-site, hands-on technical support for capital equipment requested by the Bangalore Professional Services / LMS team.
* Day-to-Day Support: provide day-to-day administration, support, and engineering functions for the network, compute, and storage layers in the physical Bangalore lab.
* Rack and Stack: perform rack-and-stack, structured cabling, imaging, and smart-hands support for lab hardware alongside higher-level administration duties.

Cross-Site Support and Coordination
  
  

* Morrisville Secondary Support: provide secondary technical support for NVIDIA technology stack capital equipment hosted in Morrisville.
* Remote Coordination: coordinate remotely with the Morrisville-based Systems Administrator, GPU/AI Infrastructure, Network Engineer, and Junior Systems Administrator on shared standards, escalations, and incident response across a roughly 12-hour time zone gap.
* NVIDIA Relationship: maintain a working relationship with NVIDIA field contacts, coordinating remotely with the Morrisville-based team.

**Required Qualifications**
Required Experience
  
  

* 4+ years of systems administration experience with hands-on breadth across network, compute, storage, and operating system layers, plus a GPU/AI infrastructure specialization.
* Hybrid Cloud Platforms: hands-on experience with hybrid cloud platforms such as VMware (vSphere/ESXi/vCenter), Microsoft Azure, Nutanix HCI, or Red Hat OpenShift.
* Hybrid Cloud or AI Certification: NVIDIA NCP-AI or equivalent in Microsoft or Red Hat OpenShift.
* Production Kubernetes Administration: demonstrated experience with cluster operations, RBAC, cluster networking, and version upgrades in a production environment.
* Docker: hands-on experience administering Docker container runtime environments.
* Hands-on NVIDIA administration: demonstrated experience administering NVIDIA drivers and the CUDA toolkit.
* Physical Infrastructure: comfortable with hands-on hardware work, including rack-and-stack, structured cabling, and smart hands, in addition to higher-level administration.

Core Professional Skills
  
  

* Incident Response: able to own after-hours incident response for a shared, multi-team infrastructure environment.
* Independent Ownership: comfortable working as the senior on-site infrastructure owner in Bangalore, remotely coordinating with the Morrisville-based team across a significant time zone gap.
* Physical Presence: this role requires physical, on-site presence in Bangalore and cannot be performed remotely from elsewhere.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Multi-Tenant Lab Experience: experience supporting a multi-tenant shared lab environment serving distributed teams.
* Experience with DCIM, IPAM, or monitoring tooling comparable to the lab’s stack (Hyperview-class DCIM, BlueCat / Infoblox-class IPAM, NVIDIA DCGM monitoring).
* InfiniBand Fabric: working familiarity with InfiniBand fabric in a multi-node GPU environment.
* GPU Orchestration: experience with Run:AI, ClearML, or a comparable GPU orchestration and MLOps toolset.

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.*

This role involves ensuring product quality and reliability through comprehensive testing and defect identification.Job Responsibilities*** Develop and implement detailed test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on product requirements and specifications.* Execute manual and automated tests across different platforms and environments.* Identify, document, and track software and hardware defects using appropriate bug tracking systems.* Collaborate with development teams to analyze and resolve identified issues.* Participate in review meetings for requirements, design, and test plans.* Perform regression testing to ensure previously fixed defects remain resolved and new features do not introduce new issues.* Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing processes and methodologies.* Generate test reports and communicate test results to stakeholders.* Set up and maintain test environments and equipment.Job Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.* 2+ years of experience in software or hardware testing.* Proficiency in designing and executing test cases and test plans.* Experience with defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, Bugzilla).* Familiarity with test automation frameworks and scripting languages (e.g., Python, Java, Selenium) is a plus.* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.* Knowledge of software development life cycle (SDLC) and various testing methodologies.

**Whats in it for you?**
  
At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you. 
  
 
  
As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day. 
  
 
  
Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars - Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.  
  
 
  
Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles -simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable. 
  
 
  
**Salary**
- Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment. 
  
 
  
**Leave & Time-off**
- Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy. 
  
 
  
**Making Retirement Tension-FreeSalary**
- In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF. 
  
 
  
**Health is Wealth**
- Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in-laws. 
  
 
  
**Mental Wellbeing**
- We offer mental health support through self-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face-to-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.  
  
 
  
**Financial Wellbeing**
- Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one-to-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.  
  
 
  
**Save As You Earn (SAYE)**
- Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3-year savings plan.  
  
 
  
**Physical Wellbeing**
- Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle. 
  
  
**About Us**
At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. 
  
 
  
 At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed. 
  
 
  
 We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.
