title: Manager, Quality Engineering (TCF)
description:
**Job Title**
Manager, Quality Engineering (TCF)
  
  
**Job Description**
We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.
  
  
The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent.
  
  
The Concentrix Technical Products and Services team is the driving force behind Concentrix’s transformation, data, and technology services. We integrate world-class digital engineering, creativity, and a deep understanding of human behavior to find and unlock value through tech-powered and intelligence-fueled experiences. We combine human-centered design, powerful data, and strong tech to accelerate transformation at scale. You will be surrounded by the best in the world providing market leading technology and insights to modernize and simplify the customer experience. Within our professional services team, you will deliver strategic consulting, design, advisory services, market research, and contact center analytics that deliver insights to improve outcomes and value for our clients. Hence achieving our vision.
  
  
Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.
  
  
Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.
  
  
***Role Overview***
*We are looking for an experienced Technical Manager – QA to lead QA delivery and Quality Engineering initiatives. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise across QA Automation, Functional Testing, AI-driven Testing, Agentic Automation, People Management, Client Management, and SOW/Delivery Management.
  
  
The candidate should be able to provide both technical leadership and delivery leadership, while driving the adoption of modern AI-powered and agentic automation approaches within QA.*
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead QA teams and provide technical and delivery leadership across projects.
* Define and drive QA strategy, test approach, automation strategy, and quality engineering practices.
* Strong experience in Functional Testing, System Testing, Integration Testing, Regression Testing, and End-to-End Testing.
* Strong experience in Test Automation, including designing, developing, and maintaining automation frameworks.
* Drive adoption of AI-powered testing and Agentic Automation to improve QA productivity, coverage, and efficiency.
* Design and implement Agentic Automation solutions where AI agents can understand requirements, generate/execute test scenarios, analyze results, identify defects, and support test maintenance.
* Evaluate and leverage Generative AI / LLM capabilities for test automation, test case generation, test data creation, defect analysis, and QA productivity.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to QA engineers and automation teams.
* Manage team performance, resource allocation, utilization, skill development, and career growth.
* Work closely with clients, business stakeholders, Product Owners, Developers, and other delivery teams.
* Own QA delivery and proactively manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and quality metrics.
* Participate in SOW preparation, effort estimation, resource planning, scope definition, milestones, and deliverables.
* Support SOW execution, change requests, project extensions, and scope-related discussions.
* Prepare and present QA status, metrics, risks, and delivery updates to senior stakeholders and clients.
* Drive continuous improvement and adoption of modern QA, AI, and automation practices.
* Support hiring, technical evaluation, onboarding, and capability development of QA resources.

***Must-Have Skills***

* 12+ years of experience in Software Testing / Quality Engineering.
* Strong experience in both Functional Testing and Test Automation.
* Proven experience in QA Team / People Management.
* Strong experience in Client and Stakeholder Management.
* Hands-on experience with SOW, estimation, resource planning, and delivery management.
* Strong understanding of STLC, SDLC, Agile/Scrum, and QA methodologies.
* Experience with UI and API automation.
* Good programming knowledge in Java, C#, TypeScript, or JavaScript.
* Mandatory experience/exposure to AI-driven QA / AI-based Test Automation.
* Mandatory exposure/experience in Agentic Automation, including AI agents or agent-based approaches for software testing and automation.
* Understanding of Generative AI / LLMs, AI-assisted test generation, test execution, defect analysis, or test maintenance.
* Experience using AI tools/platforms such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar AI/LLM-based solutions for QA/automation is preferred.
* Experience with CI/CD and version-control tools such as Jenkins, GitLab, Git, etc.
* Excellent communication, leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

title: Advanced Engineer, Audio System Validation
description:
**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive**
We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career.
  
  

* Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
* Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
* Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment

**What You’ll Be Part Of**
As a Advanced Engineer, Audio System Validation, you are responsible for safeguarding system trust across the technology development lifecycle.
  
  
You apply deep DSP and system-level expertise to validate algorithmic correctness, detect regression risks, and ensure that measurable performance standards are met throughout development and prior to release.
  
  
Operating within the EPIC Validation Team, you contribute primarily by embedding technical validation and automated guardrails directly into development workflows.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Perform white-box validation of DSP algorithms and system-level audio processing.
* Design and execute structured signal-based validation scenarios.
* Detect artifacts, performance regression, latency issues, and algorithmic instability.
* Define measurable validation criteria aligned with System Trust standards.
* Collaborate with developers to integrate repeatable validation checks into CI environments.
* Analyze complex technical findings and translate them into actionable engineering feedback.
* Support final validation by providing technical root-cause analysis when required.
* Contribute to the evolution of automated guardrails and regression protection strategies

**What Makes You A Strong Fit**

* Strong background (5+ years) in Digital Signal Processing (DSP), audio algorithms, or embedded audio systems
* Academic background with a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Sound Engineering / Electrical Engineering / Signal Processing or equivalent
* Solid understanding of software development workflows and integration environments
* Experience performing white-box technical validation and root-cause analysis.
* Ability to independently solve moderately complex technical problems.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured documentation skills
* Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to cross-functional teams

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* Experience integrating automated validation into CI/CD pipelines.
* Familiarity with performance testing in embedded systems
* Exposure to perceptual audio implications of DSP decisions
* Experience in automotive or resource-constrained systems.
* Knowledge of measurement tools and signal analysis environments
* Valid driver's license
* Proficiency in on site native language

**Things To Know**

* 10% travel might require.
* Willingness to work in a HARMAN office located in Bengaluru, India
* Successfully completing a background investigation and drug screen as a condition of employment

**What You Can Expect**

* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)
* Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs
* Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being
* Tuition reimbursement support
* Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development

**You Belong Here**
HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.
  
  
**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology**
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
  
  
Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.
  
  
If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!
  
  
**Important Notice: Recruitment Scams**
Please be aware that HARMAN recruiters will always communicate with you from an '@harman.com', ‘@careers.harman.com’ or ‘harmanglobal.avature.net’ email address. We will never ask for payments, banking, credit card, personal financial information or access to your LinkedIn/email account during the screening, interview, or recruitment process. If you are asked for such information or receive communication from an email address not ending in one of the above email domains about a job with HARMAN, please cease communication immediately and report the incident to us through: harmancareers@harman.com.
  
  
HARMAN is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. HARMAN strives to hire the best qualified candidates and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse marketplaces and communities of our global colleagues and customers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. HARMAN attracts, hires, and develops employees based on merit, qualifications and job-related performance.(www.harman.com)

title: ASIC Verification Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Hardware and Software Developer. The role is multifaceted - SoCV testbench Infrastructure, Bare-metal boot, Silicon Bringup Tools and CPU/SOC/GPU test frameworks. It involves a detailed understanding of the nVidia CPU, GPU, SOC system and boot architectures. The tools and technologies are complex and involve code that coordinates many IPs in the overall SOC. A key part of NVIDIA's strength is our development tools and environments that enable our incredible pace of delivering new technology to the market. We are looking for a creative and hardworking engineer who is passionate about joining a dynamic & agile SoCV/Emulation Infrastructure and test-frameworks team.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* The work includes building tools, infrastructure, and test frameworks used in RTL-simulations, c-simulations, Emulation, FPGA, and on Silicon.
* You will understand Tegra system architecture, with a focus on all IPs in the SOC that are involved in boot and security features.
* The tools that you build give Design and Verification teams the ability to access registers/memory/DMA engines and other features in their unit. The tools also enable test re-use across multiple platforms (RTL, models, Emulation, and Silicon). The gamut of tools is wide and you also develop features used for Silicon bring up (example: FUSE, ATE, Security, Flash/DMA, Board I2Cs, USB debug devices among others). We strive for the highest quality of test frameworks and tools that we deliver from this team.
* You would assess and build C-model or RTL-simulation capability that allows us to simulate the features before Silicon arrival in a pre-silicon environment.

**What We Need To See**

* BS or MS in Computer Science or Electronics Engineering or equivalent experience with 0-2 years of experience
* Strong programmer who is proficient with C, C++, Python.
* Understanding of SOC and System Architecture.
* Understanding of How the SOC Devices like DMA, interrupt-engines, CPU, boot-devices, MMU/IOMMU function.
* Operating System and Device-Driver concepts and ability to write no-OS test frameworks - i.e tests that run directly on the bare-metal SOC.
* A good programmer takes pride in building scalable and maintainable software.
* Understanding Hardware and/or Software development life cycle.

**Way To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Previous experience handling Silicon Bringup and in enabling Emulation/FPGA related test frameworks.
* Exposure to Testbench architectures (C++ testbenches, SV/UVM based testbenches).
* Verilog and System Verilog coding skills are a plus.

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our elite engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you! We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

description:

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. title: Software Product Assurance Engineer
description:
ReOrbit is looking for a motivated and detail oriented Software Product Assurance Engineer for Space Systems to join our growing team.
  
  
As our new Software Product Assurance Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and safety of software throughout the spacecraft development lifecycle. You will define and evolve software product assurance requirements, adapted to lean and agile development practices, while applying a criticality-based approach where the level of rigour is aligned with the safety and mission impact of each software item.
  
  
You will work closely with software, systems, hardware, AIT, Product Assurance and supplier teams to ensure that software development, verification, configuration management and change control activities meet the required quality and product assurance standards.
  
  
It's an exciting chance to join a dynamic start-up, with the opportunity to make a real impact, to reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and evolve software product assurance requirements across the development lifecycle, adapted to lean and agile development practices.
* Apply a criticality-based approach to software product assurance, scaling the level of rigour according to the safety and mission impact of the software item.
* Develop, implement, monitor and review Software Product Assurance (SW PA) plans.
* Oversee and participate in verification and validation (V&V) activities according to defined V&V plans.
* Support Independent Verification and Validation (IV&V) activities, working with IV&V personnel to mitigate software risks and enhance safety and quality.
* Help drive internal and external reviews of development plans and software designs to ensure seamless integration with the satellite system.
* Participate in the analysis and evaluation of software designs, including change impact analysis and regression testing, particularly for COTS software.
* Support Product Assurance activities across engineering and flight models and associated infrastructure, ensuring documentation and objective evidence are captured consistently.
* Contribute to estimating and tracking the expected reliability and availability of the satellite platform as part of Product Assurance reporting.
* Support Product Assurance follow-up on supplier discrepancies and defects, ensuring corrective actions are documented and tracked.
* Support engineering change control, including understanding the Class I / Class II concept and ensuring the required approvals are obtained.
* Be willing to travel to supplier facilities for audits when required.

**Skills And Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in aerospace, electronics, information technology, systems engineering and minimum 8 years of work experience in a similar relevant field.
* Knowledge of software development processes and lifecycles.
* Knowledge of software verification techniques, including testing and inspections.
* Knowledge of software configuration management fundamentals and related tools.
* Clear conceptual understanding of the difference between proactive Product Assurance and retrospective Quality Control.
* Familiarity with non-conformances, deviations, waivers, and corrective/preventive actions, including RCA and CAPA, at a basic level.
* Awareness of SW Product Assurance principles and the ECSS/Q Product Assurance philosophy.
* Ability to constructively challenge engineering decisions and ask, “What is the risk?”
* Comfortable working cross-functionally with systems, hardware, software, AIT and suppliers.
* Clear and effective technical writing and communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
* Previous exposure to satellite technologies through an internship, thesis, or student satellite project (e.g. CubeSat, nanosat or payloads), with an understanding of software Product Assurance concepts such as verification matrices, test coverage and configuration management.
* Introductory knowledge of risk management and single-point failure identification, with proficiency in C/C++ and Python and familiarity with NASA software assurance standards such as NASA-STD-8739.8 and NASA-GB-8719.13.

**What does ReOrbit do?**
ReOrbit builds the foundation for the next generation of space applications by transforming satellites into truly intelligent, interconnected platforms, defined by software. Our satellite design philosophy revolves around the idea that satellites must network, communicate with each other and thus improve mission efficiency. How can this be achieved? Thanks to a flexible software-first architecture, where all these aspects are dealt with upfront in the mission concept, as integrated functionalities.
  
  
ReOrbit’s top-notch team of software engineers and system architects develop in-house software, procure hardware from the best-in-class suppliers, and seamlessly integrate the components to create flexible and secure satellites. Today, we are a rapidly growing company building a very strong multidisciplinary team to support our activities. We are headquartered in Helsinki, Finland with a subsidiaries in Bristol, UK, Bariloche, Argentina and Bengaluru, India.
  
  
**Working at ReOrbit**
At ReOrbit, we are focused on building a strong team as we believe nothing can be accomplished without innovative, humble and curious minds working together on a common goal. We’re all about fostering an inclusive, dynamic environment where equality and diversity are our strength.
  
  
We offer
  
  

* Challenging but rewarding environment – you will thrive if you are always reflecting on how to make things better. Your ideas will be heard.
* Ambitious and supportive network of people, who are motivated to change the space industry, bringing expertise from both classic and new space .
* Benefits such as lunch vouchers, events, parties, occupational health care and additional health insurance - but most importantly a possibility to be a part of a unique and diverse team, connected by similar mindset and sense of humor.
* We like to spend time together! You can choose activities whichever is to your liking – runOrbit, climbOrbit; become ping pong or board games champion.

Join us in our journey of building software enabled satellites for secure communications
  
  
and, thus, creating the most compelling in space data flow company of the new space era.
  
  
The Company may require a security clearance for certain positions. Any such security clearance will be conducted in accordance with applicable law and the Company's relevant policies
  
  
*For agencies: We do not accept unsolicited CVs for our open vacancies. Any CV sent to our team unsolicited will reserve us the right to pursue a candidate without obligation to the sender. All candidate submissions must be conducted through our official channels and in accordance with our terms of engagement.*

+ x86 architecture

+ DDR4/DDR5 memory architecture
+ ECC mechanisms
+ Reliability and error-handling architectures
+ PCIe and advanced I/O subsystems

* Experience with silicon bring-up, platform enablement, and production-quality validation.
* Hands-on experience with system debug tools, error injection frameworks, and log analysis.
* Strong knowledge of Linux-based validation environments.
* Experience using Jira, source control systems, and validation automation frameworks.

Proficiency in Python or similar scripting languages for automation.

title: Renewable Energy/Solar Engineer
description:
Renewable Energy Engineer / Renewable Energy Project & Business Manager

**Location:** Kingdom of Bahrain  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Minimum Experience:** 10+ Years of Relevant Experience  
**Industry:** Renewable Energy, Solar PV, Electrical Contracting and Energy Solutions  
**Reporting To:** Management / CEO

1. Position Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced, technically competent and commercially oriented Renewable Energy Engineer / Manager to establish, develop and manage our upcoming renewable energy business in the Kingdom of Bahrain.

The ideal candidate must possess a minimum of 10 years of solid, hands-on experience and comprehensive knowledge of the entire renewable energy business lifecycle, particularly solar photovoltaic (PV) systems, electrical installations, engineering, procurement, construction (EPC), project management, operations and maintenance (O&M), and business development.

The candidate must be capable of independently managing the complete 360° cycle of renewable energy operations, from initial business development and feasibility studies through engineering, costing, tendering, regulatory approvals, procurement, installation, commissioning, customer handover and long-term maintenance.

The successful candidate will be responsible for establishing the technical and operational framework, developing the customer base, building supplier and contractor relationships, coordinating the relevant licensing requirements and ensuring sustainable business growth and profitability.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Renewable Energy Business Development — End-to-End Management**

* Lead the development and establishment of the company's renewable energy and solar power business in Bahrain.
* Identify and develop opportunities in residential, commercial, industrial, institutional and other suitable market segments.
* Develop relationships with customers, consultants, contractors, developers, facility management companies and government or private-sector stakeholders.
* Conduct customer meetings, site assessments, technical presentations and solution proposals.
* Develop annual business plans, sales strategies, revenue forecasts and project pipelines.
* Support management in evaluating market potential, competitor activities, pricing strategies and business expansion opportunities.

**B. Technical Engineering and System Design**

* Conduct site surveys, energy assessments, load analysis, feasibility studies and solar resource assessments.
* Design and develop grid-connected solar PV systems and, where relevant, hybrid and battery energy storage solutions.
* Prepare preliminary and detailed engineering designs, system layouts, single-line diagrams, cable sizing, protection schemes and equipment specifications.
* Select appropriate solar modules, inverters, mounting structures, cables, switchgear, protection devices and monitoring systems.
* Perform energy-yield estimates, generation forecasts, system performance calculations and financial feasibility assessments.
* Ensure that proposed systems meet applicable technical standards, grid-connection requirements, safety requirements and project specifications.

**C. Feasibility Studies, Costing, Tendering and Commercial Management**

* Prepare detailed BOQs, material take-offs, technical specifications, cost estimates and project budgets.
* Develop competitive customer quotations, tenders, commercial proposals and technical submissions.
* Evaluate project capital expenditure, operating expenditure, payback periods, return on investment and lifecycle costs.
* Assess project profitability, margins, payment terms, contractual risks and commercial viability.
* Coordinate with suppliers, manufacturers, distributors and subcontractors to obtain competitive prices and suitable technical solutions.
* Review customer contracts, tender documents, scope of work, exclusions, warranties and contractual deliverables.

**D. Regulatory Approvals, Licensing and Compliance in Bahrain**

* Coordinate with the relevant Bahrain authorities for CR activity amendments, electrical contracting licences and renewable energy contractor registration.
* Work closely with the Electricity and Water Authority (EWA), relevant engineering consultants and other authorities on applicable approval procedures.
* Coordinate solar PV contractor qualification, required technical personnel certifications, project submissions, inspections and grid-connection approvals.
* Ensure that project designs, installations and documentation comply with applicable Bahrain regulations, electrical codes, safety requirements and approved specifications.
* Maintain records of licences, approvals, technical certificates, inspection reports and compliance documentation.

The candidate must be capable of coordinating the approval process and identifying the technical and personnel requirements. Any regulated design, certification, approval or contracting activity must be undertaken by appropriately qualified and authorized personnel.

**E. Procurement, Supply Chain and Vendor Management**

* Develop and maintain a reliable supplier and subcontractor network for solar PV equipment and related electrical materials.
* Prepare procurement schedules aligned with approved project programmes and budgets.
* Evaluate technical compliance, pricing, delivery schedules, product quality and warranty conditions.
* Negotiate supplier terms and coordinate material availability, logistics, delivery and inventory planning.
* Verify material specifications, certificates, warranties and compliance with approved technical submissions.
* Manage supplier performance, material quality issues and procurement-related risks.

**F. Project Execution, Installation and Commissioning**

* Manage the complete project lifecycle from award and mobilisation through installation, testing, commissioning and handover.
* Prepare project execution plans, work schedules, resource plans, method statements and installation programmes.
* Supervise engineers, technicians, installation teams, subcontractors and site activities.
* Coordinate civil works, mounting structures, module installation, electrical cabling, inverters, protection systems, earthing and grid-interface works.
* Monitor project progress, quality, productivity, costs and deadlines.
* Coordinate inspections, testing, commissioning, performance verification and rectification of defects.
* Ensure that projects are delivered safely, within budget, on schedule and in accordance with approved specifications.

**G. Operations, Maintenance and After-Sales Service**

* Develop preventive and corrective maintenance programmes for installed renewable energy systems.
* Establish procedures for performance monitoring, fault diagnosis, troubleshooting and breakdown response.
* Monitor energy generation, system availability, inverter performance and overall plant efficiency.
* Coordinate warranty claims, spare parts, repairs, technical support and customer complaints.
* Develop annual maintenance contracts and long-term customer service arrangements.
* Prepare performance reports and recommend improvements to system reliability and energy yield.

**H. Team Leadership and Operational Management**

* Establish the technical, operational and project management procedures required for the new business.
* Recruit, train, supervise and develop engineers, technicians, project personnel and subcontractors.
* Allocate responsibilities, monitor performance and establish clear accountability.
* Implement standard operating procedures for engineering, estimation, procurement, execution, quality and maintenance.
* Coordinate with management, finance, procurement, sales and administration teams.
* Prepare periodic management reports covering sales pipeline, project status, costs, profitability, risks and operational performance.

**I. Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Compliance**

* Implement appropriate health and safety procedures for electrical and solar installation work.
* Ensure safe working practices for work at height, electrical isolation, testing, commissioning and other site activities.
* Prepare and review risk assessments, method statements, inspection plans and quality documentation.
* Monitor installation quality, workmanship, equipment compliance and corrective actions.
* Promote energy efficiency, environmental responsibility and continuous improvement throughout project delivery.

3. Essential Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Renewable Energy Engineering or an equivalent relevant discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of substantial, hands-on experience in renewable energy, with strong emphasis on solar PV systems and electrical contracting.
* Proven experience managing the complete 360° renewable energy lifecycle, including business development, feasibility, engineering, costing, procurement, installation, commissioning and maintenance.
* Demonstrable experience in managing solar PV projects from initial customer enquiry through final handover and after-sales support.
* Strong technical knowledge of solar modules, inverters, electrical protection, grid integration, system monitoring and energy storage where applicable.
* Extensive experience in BOQ preparation, estimation, tendering, project budgeting, supplier negotiation and commercial management.
* Proven ability to manage project teams, subcontractors, suppliers, customer relationships, budgets and project schedules.
* Strong knowledge of electrical safety, quality assurance, technical documentation and project risk management.
* Proficiency in relevant engineering and project management software, such as AutoCAD, PVsyst, PV\*SOL, Microsoft Excel and project scheduling tools, as applicable.

4. Preferred Qualifications and Experience

* Previous experience in the GCC, particularly Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Oman or Kuwait.
* Familiarity with EWA requirements and Bahrain's solar PV approval and grid-connection procedures.
* Experience working with solar EPC contractors, electrical contractors, renewable energy developers or energy service companies.
* Experience in commercial and industrial rooftop installations and larger ground-mounted solar projects.
* Exposure to battery energy storage systems, hybrid systems, energy audits, energy efficiency and power quality.
* Relevant professional registrations, technical certifications or renewable energy training.
* Experience developing new business units, establishing operational procedures and achieving commercial targets.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be assessed against measurable objectives, including:

* Successful establishment of the renewable energy business and completion of applicable licensing and approval requirements.
* Development of a qualified sales pipeline and achievement of agreed sales and revenue targets.
* Conversion rate of enquiries, tenders and quotations into profitable projects.
* Accuracy of project estimates and adherence to approved gross margins and budgets.
* On-time project delivery and compliance with approved technical specifications.
* Quality of installation, commissioning, documentation and customer handover.
* Customer satisfaction, repeat business and after-sales service performance.
* Development of reliable suppliers, subcontractors and technical resources.
* Effectiveness of operations and maintenance services and response to technical issues.
* Compliance with safety, quality, regulatory and reporting requirements.

Specific targets will be agreed with management based on the approved business plan, project pipeline and available resources.

6. Personal Competencies

The candidate must demonstrate:

* Strong technical judgement and practical problem-solving ability.
* Commercial awareness and a clear understanding of project profitability.
* Leadership, accountability and independent decision-making.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and customer management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
* A proactive approach to business development and market expansion.
* Strong organisational, analytical and reporting skills.
* Willingness to relocate to Bahrain and build a renewable energy business from its establishment stage.

7. Expected Outcome

The successful candidate will be expected to establish a technically sound, commercially viable and operationally efficient renewable energy business, capable of delivering solar PV and related energy solutions from initial customer engagement through engineering, procurement, installation, commissioning and long-term maintenance.

The candidate must function as both a senior technical professional and an operational business leader, taking ownership of project delivery, customer satisfaction, regulatory coordination, team performance and sustainable business growth.

8. Application Requirements

Interested candidates should submit:

* An updated CV detailing at least 10 years of relevant experience.
* Educational qualifications and relevant professional certifications.
* A list of major renewable energy projects handled, including capacity, scope, role and responsibilities.
* Details of experience in solar EPC, electrical contracting, tendering, project costing and commissioning.
* Details of GCC experience and familiarity with Bahrain or EWA requirements, where applicable.
* Current location, current compensation, expected monthly salary, notice period and availability to relocate to Bahrain.

**Candidates with proven end-to-end renewable energy project and business management experience will be prioritised.**

title: Sr. Solutions Architect - Workday
description:
**Company Overview**
At Zuora, we do Modern Business. We’re helping people subscribe to new ways of doing business that are better for people, companies and ultimately the planet. It’s an approach resulting from the shift to the Subscription Economy that puts customers first by building recurring relationships instead of one-time product sales and focuses on sustainable growth. Through our leading expertise and multi-product suite, we are transforming all industries and working with the world’s most innovative companies to monetize new business models, nurture subscriber relationships and optimize their digital experiences.
  
  
**THE TEAM & ROLE**
Zuora’s Corporate Operations organization serves as the backbone of our internal technology ecosystem, building digital experiences that connect teams, align business priorities, and strengthen collaboration company-wide. Taking a cloud-first, AI-enabled approach, we empower our global ZEOs with modern tools and self-service solutions that drive productivity, scalability, and agility - all while upholding the highest standards of security and compliance.
  
  
Within Corporate Operations, the G&A Business Applications team designs, implements, and optimizes the systems that power all of Zuora's core General & Administrative functions, including Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success (HR), and Legal. Reporting to the Senior Business Systems Manager of Digital Workplace Experience, this team works closely with system analysts, administrators, project managers, data architects, and developers to deliver robust, scalable business solutions.
  
  
The Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems is a senior technical expert and data architect responsible for designing, building, and securing enterprise-grade data structures and integrations across our corporate systems ecosystem. This role functions as a critical cross-functional data and system integration specialist, ensuring seamless data flow, robust security governance, and scalable automation across diverse business platforms (e.g., Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more).
  
  
You’ll join a collaborative, high-performing team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Your work will directly impact the efficiency, quality, and scalability of Zuora’s enterprise systems and digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION**
As a senior technical anchor supporting all G&A functions, the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems collaborates closely with leaders across Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal to establish a cohesive enterprise data architecture. You will build robust system integrations and leverage cutting-edge AI frameworks to drive efficiency, maximize data reliability, and enforce strict compliance across all internal platforms in alignment with strategic goals.
  
  
**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**
As the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems, you will play a vital role in the development, data architecture, and integration of Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal systems. Combining your expertise as a data architect and multi-platform integration specialist, you’ll ensure seamless data flow, scalable automation, and cross-system reliability without being tied to a single core vendor. You’ll work closely with functional BSAs to prioritize initiatives, refine user stories, and deliver enhancements through agile sprints, while supporting testing and deployment activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Lead integration support and comprehensive data architecture across core Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal business systems, ensuring cross-platform data consistency and process efficiency.
* Define and maintain end-to-end data models, data lineage, and integration patterns across all G&A applications, establishing a unified "single source of truth" bridging corporate finance, workforce analytics, and legal operations.
* Design, build, and optimize secure, high-performing API-based integrations, microservices, and file-based data flows (REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL) across Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more tools.
* Architect and implement AI-driven automation workflows; evaluate and integrate AI productivity tools and emerging standard frameworks—such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers—to safely expose internal tools and secure data layers to AI agents.
* Enforce strict data security policies, field-level encryption, masking, and access controls across integrated systems to protect sensitive workforce metrics (ZEO Success/PII), legal records, and financial data.
* Collaborate with cross-functional BSAs, business cross functional teams, and security teams using RACI frameworks to clearly map out data ownership, system accountability, and technical execution roles across different departments.
* Ensure configuration standards, technical architecture diagrams, and SOPs are up to date and fully compliant with internal controls, SOX, and global privacy standards (GDPR/CCPA).

**OUR TECH STACK:**
REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL, JavaScript/Python, Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, AI Automation Tools, and MCP Server frameworks.
  
  
**What You’ll Accomplish**

* Deliver Modern Data Architecture: Transition fragmented cross-system data points from disparate G&A tools into a beautifully mapped out, resilient, and highly secure enterprise data model.
* Excellence in System Integrations: Establish scalable, automated data connections that allow Finance, FP&A, Procurement, HR, and Legal tools to communicate without operational friction, keeping sync latencies low and reliability high.
* Next-Gen Tech Adoption: Successfully implement secure AI extensions or MCP servers to optimize everyday business workflows and scale manual reporting processes down to self-service models.
* Advance Automation & Data Reliability: Develop solutions that strengthen data accuracy, eliminate manual tasks, reduce operational overhead, and increase system reliability across end-to-end business workflows.
* Promote Secure & Compliant Operations: Collaborate with IT, Security, and Audit teams to uphold field-level data protection, access controls, and strict compliance (SOX/GDPR) across all integration data layers.
* Establish Sustainable System Practices: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and configuration standards to ensure long-term scalability and consistent cross-functional operational excellence.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Architecture, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 8+ years of experience in system integrations and backend development (Proficient in REST APIs, SQL, JavaScript/Python, OAuth, and web services).
* Deep hands-on exposure to data structures and integration patterns within modern G&A systems—specifically covering tools across Procurement (Coupa), HR/ATS (Workday, Lattice, Greenhouse), and ERP/Expense (NetSuite, Navan).
* Proven understanding of LLM application patterns, AI integration tools, and modular protocol concepts like Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Solid understanding of data security standards, encryption practices, access control models, and IT/SOX compliance frameworks required when handling sensitive employee, financial, and legal records.
* Strong familiarity with project governance frameworks, including using RACI matrices to clarify cross-team responsibilities.
* Exceptional cross-functional collaboration and communication skills; the ability to elegantly translate complex technical and data architecture blueprints to functional business partners across completely different business disciplines.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
About the role

You will be the architect who wins the technical deal. Before a contract is signed, you show enterprise customers that their AI agents will work, at their scale and under their rules. You build the demos and proofs of concept, answer the architecture questions, and hand delivery a plan they can execute. This is a hands-on engineering role in front of customers. You write code most weeks and spend the rest with CIOs, platform teams and risk officers. You report to the Co-Founder and CTO.

What you will do

• Discover: run technical discovery with CIOs, platform-engineering and risk teams at banks, insurers and asset managers. Map their systems, data and controls to the agent use cases that matter.

• Demo: build tailored demos of agent workflows, using the customer's own scenarios where you can.

• Prove: scope and deliver 2 to 6 week proofs of concept. Write the code, wire up integrations and measure results against agreed success criteria.

• Design: produce reference architectures for agent deployment on AWS, Azure or GCP, covering identity, data access, observability and guardrails.

• De-risk: answer security, compliance and model-risk questionnaires (SOC 2, data residency, audit logging, human-in-the-loop controls).

• Hand off: turn every won proof of concept into a delivery plan our forward-deployed engineers can run from day one.

• Feed back: bring field patterns to product and build reusable demo assets, templates and starter agents.

What we are looking for

• 8+ years in software engineering, solutions engineering, solutions architecture or forward-deployed engineering for enterprise customers.

• Hands-on experience building LLM applications or agents: prompt and tool design, RAG, evaluation, and at least one agent framework.

• Strong Python, plus working knowledge of APIs, containers and one major cloud.

• Comfort in regulated environments, where governance, auditability and access control decide the deal.

• Consulting experience: client-facing work, scoping engagements and running workshops with enterprise stakeholders.

• Understanding of tool calling and MCP, guardrails and policy controls, access management, observability and audit trails.

Nice to have

• Experience selling to, or working inside, financial services.

• Kubernetes, observability or AIOps tooling.

• AWS, Azure or GCP certifications.

• A public demo, repo, talk or post about something you built with agents.

Location: Chennai, India (Chennai office), hybrid 3 days on-site, with travel to customer sites as needed.

About Moring

Moring helps enterprises put AI agents into production safely.

description:

Solution design and architecture

title: Service Account Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**
As a Services Account Manager, you will manage assigned customer service requests and issues from initial quotation through to delivery and issue resolution. Your role ensures a seamless, high-quality customer experience across the full service lifecycle for the requests and accounts assigned to you. Your responsibilities include:
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Managing assigned customer service requests end-to-end — from initial inquiry and quotation through order fulfillment, delivery, and issue closure.
* Preparing and issuing accurate, timely quotations in response to assigned service requests, ensuring alignment with technical and commercial requirements.
* Managing the Inquiry to Order (ITO) process for assigned requests, including coordinating commercial and contractual details with internal stakeholders (engineering, operations, logistics, finance).
* Tracking assigned service requests and orders to ensure timely delivery, proactively communicating status updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Coordinating with internal teams (engineering, field service, supply chain) to resolve assigned customer issues, escalations, and technical queries efficiently.
* Ensuring service excellence by monitoring resolution times, quality, and customer satisfaction for assigned requests.
* Communicating clearly with customers throughout the lifecycle of assigned requests, setting expectations and managing follow-ups.
* Identifying recurring issues or service gaps within assigned accounts and escalating/collaborating with relevant teams (Marketing, Product Line, Engineering) to drive improvement.
* Applying Six Sigma analytical tools, including Root Cause Analysis (RCA), to support resolution of reliability issues and drive continuous improvement in service delivery.
* Maintaining accurate records of service requests, interactions, and resolutions within CRM/ERP systems.
* Supporting strong working relationships with customers on assigned requests to promote satisfaction and repeat engagement.
* Regularly reporting to the APAC Services Operations Manager on assigned request status, open issues, and service delivery performance.
* Staying informed on customer needs, product/service requirements, and regional market conditions relevant to assigned accounts.
* Collaborating with the Services Product Line team to relay customer feedback and support development of new/improved service offerings.
* If you are a detail-oriented, technically proficient professional passionate about delivering exceptional customer service in the Power Conversion sector across India/APAC, we encourage you to apply for this opportunity with GE Power Conversion.

**Qualifications/Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college/university in Electrical Engineering or allied Engineering discipline. (Master's degree a plus.)
* 5–10 years of relevant experience in customer service, account management, technical support, or service operations.
* Offshore industry experience and process knowledge in one or more of: Metal, Marine, Oil & Gas, Test Bench, Material Handling, or Power Plant sectors.
* Knowledge of Power Electronics, High Voltage Equipment, and PLC systems.
* Experience with quotation preparation and ITO (Inquiry to Order) processes.
* Willingness to travel across India/APAC region as required.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Prior experience with MV/LV drives, industrial automation systems, and large motors and generators.
* Proficient in both oral and written communication in English (additional regional languages a plus).
* Strong organizational and follow-through skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent service requests.
* Customer-centric mindset with a focus on responsiveness and issue resolution.
* Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, field service, and supply chain teams.
* Proactive problem-solver, comfortable working in high-pressure, matrix-based environments.
* Experience with CRM/ERP systems for tracking service requests and orders.
* Demonstrated technical proficiency coupled with strong customer service orientation

**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

description:

Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven
**SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant**
with
**5 to 12 years**
of expertise across SAP Customer Service (CS), Service Management (SM), and S/4HANA Service.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, and implementing end-to-end Service Management processes in an
**SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition (PCE) / RISE with SAP**
environment. You will bridge business requirements and functional architecture, manage cloud service governance, enable AI-driven service insights, and drive continuous optimization across the full service lifecycle.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Implementation
* Design, configure, and deploy S/4HANA Service Management processes across the entire service lifecycle: Engage, Sell, Contract, Plan, Schedule, Execute, Invoice, and Analyze.

* S/4HANA Private Edition (PCE) Governance
* Operate effectively within the SAP S/4HANA PCE Shared Responsibility Model between the client and SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS).
* Liaise with SAP for system-level operational tasks (e.g., infrastructure management, backups, maintenance, and upgrade administration).
* Lead client-side functional responsibilities, including business process configuration, functional validation, regression testing, and process governance based on SAP’s PCE Roles and Responsibilities framework.
* Service Order & Contract Management
* Configure and maintain service contract structures, recurring service billing plans, and auto-renewal mechanisms.
* Enable flexible billing scenarios, including Resource-Related Billing (RRB), Time & Material (T&M), and Fixed-Price billing models.
* Leverage modern platform features such as service contract template cloning and mass contract change capabilities.
* Service Planning, Execution & Logistics Integration
* Set up and optimize workforce planning, resource allocation, dispatching, and field service workflows.
* Configure plant and storage location parameters within service transactions to support multi-plant and multi-location service execution.
* Direct cross-module functional integration between service transactions and procurement (MM), inventory management, shipping, plant maintenance (PM), and follow-on financial postings.
* Data Migration, Testing & Integration
* Oversee data preparation, cleansing, transformation, and validation for service master data, active service contracts, and open service orders.
* Utilize the SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and standard transition tools tailored for service artifacts.
* Coordinate functional and technical integrations across CRM, SAP Field Service Management (FSM), SAP CS, core logistics, and Finance (FI/CO).
* AI, Analytics & Continuous Process Improvement
* Implement embedded AI capabilities (e.g., Joule-assisted summaries, intelligent confirmations, and predictive service insights).
* Design custom Fiori dashboards, operational reports, and KPIs to monitor service performance and profitability.
* Guide business stakeholders through continuous improvement initiatives and the adoption of periodic SAP release features.
* Stakeholder Management & Documentation
* Facilitate requirements-gathering workshops, author detailed functional specifications (FS), and map target-state business process flows.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams spanning Logistics, Procurement, Finance, and Sales.
* Create training collateral, deliver end-user training, and lead hypercare support during deployment phases.

**Required Skills & Technical Expertise**

* Experience: 5–12 years of hands-on experience in SAP CS / SM / S/4HANA Service functional consulting.
* Core Module Competency: Comprehensive knowledge of S/4HANA Service (PCE) core functionality (Service Orders, Service Contracts, Resource-Related Billing, Invoicing, and Execution Logistics).
* Cloud Architecture: Clear operational understanding of the SAP PCE operating model, RISE with SAP frameworks, and cloud service boundary matrices.
* User Experience & Extensibility: Proficiency with modern SAP Fiori apps, standard OData APIs, and functional extensibility options.
* Integration Touchpoints: Strong cross-functional integration experience with PM, SD, MM, FI/CO, and SAP FSM.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Practical project experience with RISE with SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition implementations or migrations.
* Hands-on knowledge of SAP upgrade governance and release management protocols in PCE environments.
* Official SAP Certification in S/4HANA Service or related SAP functional modules.

**Soft Skills**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

* Proactive problem-solving capabilities and experience leading cross-functional delivery teams.

title: Solar Digital Monitoring & IoT Systems - Roofsol Energy
description:
**Job Description – Solar Digital Monitoring & IoT Systems**

**Company:**
Roofsol Energy Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Department:**
Technology / Digital Solutions

**Experience:**
Approximately 10 years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About Roofsol Energy**

Roofsol Energy Pvt. Ltd. operates in the solar energy sector, developing and managing solar projects across India. The company has invested in multiple solar projects under the OPEX (CAPEX-free / RESCO) business model, where continuous monitoring of generation, plant performance, equipment health, and operational efficiency is essential.

As part of its technology development strategy, Roofsol Energy intends to establish its own end-to-end solar monitoring ecosystem, including proprietary data loggers, IoT-based data acquisition systems, cloud infrastructure, and a centralized solar generation monitoring platform. The objective is to develop and own the underlying technology and Intellectual Property (IP), while ensuring reliable monitoring and management of a large portfolio of distributed solar projects across India.

**Role Overview**

Roofsol Energy is looking for an experienced technology professional to lead the conceptualization, design, development, deployment, and maintenance of an in-house solar data logging and generation monitoring system.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Strategy and Technology Development**

·      Define the technology roadmap for Roofsol Energy’s proprietary solar monitoring and data acquisition ecosystem.

·      Lead the end-to-end development of the monitoring platform, from product architecture and prototype development to commercial deployment.

·      Evaluate appropriate hardware, communication protocols, software frameworks, cloud technologies, and system architectures.

·      Develop solutions suitable for both small rooftop solar installations and large distributed solar portfolios.

**2. Data Logger and IoT Hardware Development**

·      Lead the design, development, prototyping, testing, and deployment of in-house solar data logging equipment.

·      Develop expertise in integrating inverters, energy meters, weather sensors, and other plant equipment using protocols such as Modbus RTU/TCP, RS485, Ethernet, and MQTT, as applicable.

·      Ensure reliable data acquisition, local buffering, time synchronization, remote configuration, and recovery during network or power outages.

·      Establish hardware validation, field testing, quality assurance, and lifecycle management processes.

**3. Cloud Platform and Software Development**

·      Lead the architecture and development of a centralized cloud-based solar monitoring platform.

·      Establish scalable infrastructure for collecting, processing, storing, and analyzing data from hundreds of geographically distributed solar installations.

·      Oversee the development of dashboards, plant-level monitoring screens, portfolio-level reporting, alerts, notifications, and automated performance reports.

·      Ensure integration with existing business systems, maintenance workflows, and third-party equipment where required.

·      Establish high availability, disaster recovery, backup, cybersecurity, and system performance standards.

**4. Solar Generation Monitoring and Analytics**

·      Develop real-time and historical solar generation monitoring capabilities.

·      Establish monitoring of energy generation, plant availability, equipment health, communication failures, and performance deviations.

·      Enable automated alerts for generation losses, inverter faults, abnormal operating conditions, and data gaps.

·      Support performance analysis through relevant metrics such as specific yield, Performance Ratio (PR), plant availability, and actual-versus-expected generation, where applicable.

**5. Intellectual Property and Technology Ownership**

·      Build and maintain Roofsol Energy’s proprietary technology stack, including hardware designs, firmware, software source code, system architecture, technical documentation, and associated IP.

·      Establish appropriate IP ownership, confidentiality, source-code control, licensing, and third-party technology compliance practices.

**6. Team Leadership and Vendor Management**

·      Build and lead a multidisciplinary team covering embedded systems, electronics, firmware, IoT, cloud engineering, software development, and data analytics.

·      Evaluate and manage technology vendors, hardware manufacturers, system integrators, and development partners.

**Candidate Profile**

·      Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics & Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, IoT, or a related technical discipline.

·      Approximately 10 years of relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, industrial data acquisition, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, or related technology domains.

·      Demonstrated experience in developing and deploying connected hardware and software products, preferably from concept through production and field deployment.

·      Experience with cloud infrastructure, databases, APIs, cybersecurity, remote device management, and scalable system architecture.

·      Knowledge of solar PV systems, inverter communications, energy meters, generation monitoring, and renewable energy analytics will be highly advantageous.

**Why Join Roofsol Energy?**

This is an opportunity to establish a proprietary technology platform from the ground up and take ownership of a strategic digital initiative within the renewable energy sector. The selected professional will have the opportunity to shape the company’s technology roadmap, develop in-house IP, and build a scalable monitoring ecosystem supporting a growing portfolio of solar assets across India.

**Interested candidates may share their updated CV highlighting relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, and technology ownership.**

title: Active Directory Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Cyberaube is a cybersecurity services company based in Nagpur and Pune that focuses on practical, vendor-neutral solutions instead of product reselling. The team brings over a decade of hands-on experience with leading security platforms such as QRadar, Splunk, CyberArk, Okta, and Guardium, helping clients avoid costly implementation mistakes. Cyberaube supports organizations with security talent placement, SIEM and IAM operations, data protection, and compliance with India’s DPDP Act and SEBI requirements. The company works with a diverse range of clients, including banks, hospitals, e-commerce firms, government bodies, and SaaS startups across India and beyond.

**Role Description**

* Senior Active Directory Engineer (L3) – Multi-Forest Enterprise
* Location: Pune or Nagpur (WFO)
* Experience: 7+ years
* Notice: Immediate–30 days preferred

**About the role**

We are looking for an L3 Active Directory engineer who owns the directory, not just the tickets in it. You will be the final technical escalation point for a large, multi-forest, multi-domain, multi-site Active Directory estate. When replication breaks, SYSVOL drifts or a DC fails, you read the repadmin and dcdiag output, find the root cause and fix it yourself.

**What will you do**

- Design, build and extend multi-domain and multi-forest AD: new domains, forest and external trusts, selective authentication, SID filtering and cross-forest DNS.

- Own replication health across a multi-site topology: sites, subnets, site links, costs, bridgeheads and KCC/ISTG behaviour.

- Diagnose and resolve deep replication failures: lingering objects, USN rollback, tombstone lifetime issues, and errors such as 8606, 8614, 8524 and 1722, using repadmin, dcdiag, ntdsutil and PowerShell.

- Support SYSVOL on DFSR: backlog analysis, dirty shutdown recovery, authoritative and non-authoritative restores, and FRS-to-DFSR migration where legacy domains remain.

- Manage the full DC lifecycle: promotion, demotion, forced removal, metadata cleanup, FSMO transfer and seizure, Global Catalog placement and OS upgrades.

- Run proactive DC health monitoring: define checks and alert thresholds, review Directory Service, DFS Replication and DNS logs, and act before users notice.

- Lead AD incident response for P1/P2 events and write the RCA and problem records that remove the cause, not just the symptom.

- Maintain AD backup and disaster recovery: system state backups, DSRM, and forest recovery planning and testing.

- Mentor L1/L2 engineers, write runbooks, and raise and execute change requests to ITIL standards.

**What you must have:**

- 7+ years in Windows infrastructure, including 5+ years of hands-on L3 Active Directory engineering in a large enterprise.

- Production experience in multi-forest and multi-domain environments, including setting up and troubleshooting trusts.

- Command-line fluency with repadmin, dcdiag, ntdsutil, dfsrdiag, nltest, setspn and the PowerShell ActiveDirectory module.

- A track record of resolving replication and SYSVOL/DFSR failures yourself, not escalating them.

- Experience leading AD incidents end to end, including writing the root cause analysis.

- An active Microsoft certification: Windows Server Administrator Associate (AZ-802), Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate (AZ-800 + AZ-801), or legacy MCSA/MCSE: Windows Server.

**Good to have:**

- AD CS / PKI, ADFS, Entra Connect in a multi-forest topology

- AD security hardening: tiered administration, LAPS, Kerberos/NTLM hardening, privileged group control

- Domain migrations or consolidations with ADMT or Quest

- PowerShell automation for health reporting and remediation

**THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF...**

Your Active Directory experience is mainly user and group administration, password resets and lockouts, SSO/Okta onboarding, or Entra ID and Conditional Access. Those are valuable skills, but this role is about the infrastructure underneath: domain controllers, replication, SYSVOL, trusts and forest design.

Please apply OR you may also send your resume with other details such as your current CTC, your expected CTC and your tetative availability to join if offered at info[at]cyberaube[dot]com

description:
**Your role**
-------------

As a Research and Development Engineer, you will be at the forefront of advancing our organization's scientific and engineering capabilities. Your mission is to drive innovation by developing cutting-edge products and technologies that meet the highest standards of quality, safety, and performance. You will play a critical role in shaping the future of our industry through groundbreaking research, design, and development activities, ensuring our products and processes are not only efficient but also environmentally sustainable. Join us in exploring the natural world, pioneering new solutions, and making a lasting impact on both our organization and the broader community. You will report to the [add hiring manager title].

Lead Design Engineer - NPD is responsible for leading the development of oil-injected screw compressor products, delivering robust engineering solutions that improve Time-to-Market, On-time Delivery, and First Time Right performance. title: Resident Engineer
description:
**Desktop Support Engineer Job Description**

Now that we've covered who desktop support engineers are, let's explore in more detail the typical roles and responsibilities that make up their job description.

**1. Provide Technical Support**

The primary role of a desktop support engineer is to provide help desk support to users within the organization who are having problems with their IT equipment or systems. This includes:

* Receiving requests via phone, email, chat, or ticketing systems
* Asking questions to properly diagnose reported issues
* Resolving common problems like network connectivity, password reset, email access, printer jamming, etc.
* Tracking issues from initial report to final resolution

**2. Troubleshoot Issues**

When users experience more complex system failures, desktop support engineers leverage their technical expertise to troubleshoot and determine root causes. This involves:

* Investigating error messages
* Reviewing system and application logs
* Testing software and hardware to pinpoint faulty component(s)
* Escalating to a specialized team if unable to diagnose
* Documenting details to share with engineering/development teams

**3. Install & Configure Systems**

Desktop support techs handle a variety of installation, configuration and maintenance tasks to optimize computer systems throughout the organization, including:

* Formatting, partitioning and imaging hard drives
* Upgrading or replacing hardware components like memory, network cards, video cards
* Installing operating systems, software drivers and applications
* Setting up new devices, printers, scanners, etc.
* Configuring system settings, security tools, VPN access etc.
* Performing preventative maintenance activities

**4. Provide Orientation & Training**

With their specialized expertise, desktop support technicians frequently hold orientation workshops and provide informal assistance to teach users about utilizing technologies effectively, including:

* Demoing how to use devices, operating systems, software, printers etc.
* Developing training materials and quick-start guides
* Conducting one-on-one and group training sessions
* Answering usage questions
* Ensuring users optimize and properly handle equipment

**5. Manage Inventory & Purchase Equipment**

Desktop support techs also handle inventory management and equipment procurement for their organizations. Their responsibilities related to this include:

* Tracking computers, devices, peripherals, components, and software licenses
* Identifying needs for additional supplies and hardware
* Researching products and vendors to find optimal solutions
* Coordinating with finance/procurement teams on purchases
* Installing and retiring equipment according to refresh cycles

**Skills Needed for Desktop Support Engineers**

In order to handle such a wide variety of critical responsibilities - providing tech support, troubleshooting complex issues, configuring systems, training users, and managing inventory - desktop support engineers need a diverse set of technical and interpersonal skills.

**Technical Skills**

* **Operating Systems:** Extensive knowledge of operating systems like Windows, macOS and Linux distributions
* **Hardware:** Understanding of computer components, mobile devices, printers, networks
* **Software:** Familiarity with productivity software, collaboration tools, security programs, etc.
* **Diagnostics:** Ability to review logs, run monitoring tools, conduct testing to pinpoint issues
* **Scripting:** Write scripts to automate tasks using languages like PowerShell
* **Networking Concepts:** Solid grasp of how LANs, WANs, Wi-Fi, VPNs etc. function

**Interpersonal Skills**

* **Communication Skills:** Ability to interact with users clearly, politely and patiently
* **Collaboration:** Work with team members to solve issues and implement improvements
* **Training Abilities:** Skills to educate non-technical users on utilizing technology
* **Documentation:** Note details clearly for future reference
* **Time Management:** Prioritize and handle high volumes of support requests
* **Problem Solving:** Apply logical thinking to tackle technical challenges

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* This job role requires immediate joining. Can you join immediately?

Experience:

* Desktop support: 2 years (Required)
* Active Directory: 2 years (Preferred)
* LAN: 1 year (Preferred)
* TCP/IP: 1 year (Preferred)

Location:

* Manesar, Gurugram, Haryana (Required)

Work Location: In person

* Experienced Security Architect role focused on strengthening the Bank’s and vendors’ security architecture, regulatory compliance, and ATM logical security.
* Responsible for assessing and improving security posture across systems, data, applications, and networks in line with industry standards, regulations, and best practices.

* Design and implement robust security architecture for cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.
* Conduct internal architecture reviews to validate design adequacy, security controls, and alignment with Bank standards before implementation, followed by annual or half-yearly reviews based on criticality.

* Conduct periodic ATM security assessments covering vulnerabilities, host security, and control effectiveness.

* Act as a security advisor to business, IT, vendors, partners, and application teams.
* Lead threat modeling and security reviews for new systems, projects, and services.

**Regulatory Reporting:**

* Ensure timely and accurate submission of regulatory returns and reports, including Quarterly Cyber KRI and Tranche I, II, and III submissions.
* Maintain records of regulatory submissions, approvals, and RBI correspondence.

* Conduct training and awareness on RBI regulations and compliance practices.
* Promote regulatory compliance and ethical conduct across the organization.

**Monitoring & Response:**

* Partner with Security Operations to enhance monitoring and incident response capabilities.
* Support security breach investigations and root cause analysis.

**Security Tools & Technologies:**

* Manage security solutions such as SIEM, EDR, WAF, and IAM.
* Track emerging cybersecurity trends, technologies, and threat landscapes.

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field; Master’s preferred.
* 10+ years of cybersecurity experience, including 5+ years in security architecture or engineering.
