We’re a proud industry pioneer with over 20 years of experience accelerating the ad technology evolution. Our proprietary tech is trusted by some of the world’s largest brands and media owners and plays a crucial role in keeping the internet open, accessible, and largely free.
  
We process more than 550 billion real-time auctions every day (in comparison, Google processes 8.5 billion searches per day) with ultra-low latency. Our platform is vertically integrated from servers to networks and runs primarily on our own metal and cloud infrastructure. This end-to-end infrastructure is designed to provide both stability and agility, enabling us to adapt quickly as the market evolves.
  
At the core of it all is our engineering-first culture. Our engineers tackle internet-scale problems across tight-knit, global teams. From moving petabytes of data and optimizing with AI to making real-time infrastructure decisions, Indexers have the agency and influence to shape the future of advertising. We move fast, build thoughtfully, and stay grounded in our core values.
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Staff Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to serve as a technical leader and quality champion across Index. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad cross-team and cross-divisional influence where you will define and drive modern quality engineering practices, build scalable automation, tools, test infrastructure, and enable teams to deliver high-quality, high-performance software with confidence.
  
You will operate at the intersection of architecture, quality, developer experience, and operations, ensuring quality is built into every stage of the software lifecycle. You will also leverage AI to improve testing efficiency and insights.
  
As a SDET champion on the engineering team, you will own the vision for test infrastructures, build frameworks that allow developers to easily write reliable tests, and invent new mechanisms for ensuring that every change we make can be deployed safely and quickly. You will help solve our most difficult challenges and will coach other engineers to foster a culture of relentless high standards.
  
This position reports directly to Senior Engineering Manager based in Bangalore and will work closely with members of the Quality and Delivery teams.
  
**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of experience in Software Quality Engineering/SDET role with a bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong software engineering skills, including proficiency in programming languages such as Golang, Java or C#.
* Proven experience building scalable, reusable, enterprise grade test frameworks, tools and infrastructure for large-scale distributed systems.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD (GitLab preferred), Containerization (Docker), and orchestration (Kubernetes).
* Experience with microservices architectures, APIs, and data-intensive systems, validating large datasets and pipelines.
* Deep expertise in test strategies, methodologies, and automation at scale.
* Have systems thinking and end-to-end accountability, proactively identifying risks and influencing cross-team quality without direct authority.
* Exceptional analytical skills and structured problem-solving to drive clarity and outcomes in ambiguous environments.
* A technical role model, guiding engineers and consistently raising the bar through design, reviews, and best practices.
* Proven ability to lead cross-team initiatives, align stakeholders, and drive engineering excellence at scale
* Demonstrates a learn-and-be-curious mindset, with a strong bias for ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement

**Here’s What You’ll Be Doing**
**Technical Leadership & Quality Strategy**

* Working on cutting edge programmatic ad tech that touches millions of users every single day.
* Collaborate with the Manager to define and evolve the quality engineering vision and strategy for Index’s high-scale distributed systems.
* Drive shift-left testing and quality-by-design principles, influencing system architecture for testability and reliability.
* Establish best practices across functional, integration, end-to-end, performance, and resilience testing.
* Assess current practices, tooling, and workflows to identify gaps and translate them into actionable plans that balance impact, feasibility, and organizational readiness.
* Bring clarity to complexity, probing assumptions, identifying quality risks, evaluating trade-offs, and optimization opportunities.

**Test Frameworks, Tooling & Infrastructure**

* Design and build scalable, reusable automation frameworks and test infrastructure.
* Develop tools that enable teams to independently own, measure, and continuously improve quality.
* Enhance and optimize CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab) to ensure fast, safe, and reliable releases.
* Enable data validation, observability-driven testing, and production validation strategies.

**Cross-Team Influence & Developer Enablement**

* Partner with Engineering, Product, Platform, and DevOps teams to ensure high-quality releases by enforcing quality standards and best practices.
* Influence design and architecture decisions to improve scalability, performance, and testability.
* Identify systemic gaps and drive across engineering improvements in testing practices and tooling.
* Standardize quality metrics, reporting, and release quality gates across teams
* Drive improvements in production quality, incident reduction, and system resilience

**Mentorship, Coaching & Hiring**

* Mentor and coach engineers on test design, automation, tooling and quality best practices.
* Raise engineering standards through code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance.
* Actively participate in hiring and bar-raising activities.
* Foster a culture of ownership, learning, and high engineering standards.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* Paid time off, health days, and personal obligation days plus flexible work schedules
* Competitive retirement matching plans
* Equity packages
* Company contribution to Provident Fund
* Monthly internet stipend

description:
**Summary of Position:**
The Senior Associate I – Electrical & Electronics (E&E) is responsible for sustaining engineering support for electrical and electronic systems for ophthalmic medical devices. This role ensures product continuity, compliance, and performance throughout the product lifecycle and acts as a technical interface with cross functional stakeholders including Software Lifecycle Management (LCM), Design Control, Manufacturing, Service, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Safety and Clinical teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support existing electrical and electronic products through board-level testing, troubleshooting, schematic review, failure investigation, and technical documentation updates. This role “does not” include new products or circuit/schematic design activities.
* Use knowledge of electronic boards, wiring, power supplies, sensors, and electrical interfaces to identify and resolve product issues.
* Review and assess engineering changes (ECOs/ECNs) impacting E&E scope, including risk, compliance, verification, and implementation readiness.
* Support design control activities related to E&E, including product requirements, risk analysis, verification, and traceability
* Perform root cause analysis and technical investigations for field, manufacturing, and service‑related electrical issues.
* Evaluate component changes, obsolescence, and supplier impacts and recommend technically sound solutions.
* Assess material compliance impacts (e.g., RoHS, REACH, and region‑specific regulations) associated with component and supplier changes.
* Ensure electrical and electronic product changes continue to meet quality and regulatory requirements.
* Collaborate effectively across mechanical, software, systems, manufacturing, quality, and regulatory teams to resolve complex issues.
* Provide engineering judgment and recommendations, proposing alternative solutions when required.
* Support Technical file reviews and updates, ensuring alignment with county specific regulatory requirement (e.g., US, EU, China), in collaboration with Regulatory Affairs.
* Support product complaint investigations and assess the need for updates to Risk Management Report (RMR), in collaboration with Complaints, Medical Safety and Design Control teams.
* Perform engineering assessments for sustaining activities, including equivalent component evaluations, electrical and thermal derating, tolerance analysis, signal integrity, manufacturability and assembly reviews, and EMC/EMI analysis.

**Key Requirements/Minimum Qualifications:**
**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE) or Electronics and Communication Engineering (E&C)
* 5+ years of experience in medical device sustaining engineering, product support engineering, or product development

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience supporting embedded electronic systems.
* Proficiency with PLM and requirements tools (e.g., Windchill, Polarion, Teamcenter)
* Working knowledge of systems engineering principles and interface management
* Exposure to surgical or ophthalmic medical devices.
* Familiarity with medical device standards such as ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and awareness of electrical safety and EMC requirements (e.g., IEC 60601 series)

**Knowledge, Skills & Behaviors**

* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills
* Ability to work independently with moderate autonomy while following defined processes
* Effective communicators in cross functional and global environments
* Collaborative team player with ownership mindset
* Product lifecycle and business awareness
* Quality driven, compliance focused approach

**Job Summary:**

Responsible for system engineering, requirements management, integration, and validation of Connected Car Services for Full Hybrid Vehicle programs. The role involves defining connected vehicle features, managing interfaces between vehicle ECUs, telematics, infotainment, and cloud platforms, and supporting the delivery of telemetry, remote services, diagnostics, and OTA update capabilities.

* Define and manage end-to-end requirements for connected vehicle services.

* Support OTA/FOTA deployment strategy and validation.
* Perform integration, debugging, and root-cause analysis using CANoe, CANalyzer, and Wireshark.
* Collaborate with software, cloud, validation, and powertrain teams throughout the development lifecycle.

* 6-9 years of experience in Automotive Systems Engineering, Connected Vehicles, Telematics & Infotainment.
* Strong experience in requirements engineering, system specification, interface management, and feature integration.
* Good understanding of Connected Vehicle architecture, including TCU, IVI, vehicle-to-cloud communication, telemetry, remote services, and OTA updates.
* Experience with automotive communication technologies such as CAN, CAN-FD, Automotive Ethernet, SOME/IP, and Diagnostics (UDS).
* Hands-on experience with CANoe, CANalyzer, Wireshark, or similar integration/debug tools.

* Strong understanding of Hybrid Vehicle architectures and vehicle data domains such as battery management, SOC/SOH, regenerative braking, and energy management.
* Experience working in Agile environments and ASPICE-based development processes.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and stakeholder communication skills.

title: Technical Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
Serve as a Technical Lead for Genesys Cloud solutions within a hybrid work model applying deep expertise in quality monitoring speech analytics and APIs to optimize contact center operations in auto claims and property and casualty insurance. Drive high impact technical initiatives that improve customer experience operational efficiency and compliance for a global organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead end to end technical design and implementation of Genesys Cloud solutions to support complex contact center workflows for auto claims and property and casualty insurance operations.
* Oversee configuration and optimization of Genesys Cloud quality monitoring features to ensure thorough evaluation of agent interactions and continuous service performance improvement.
* Drive development and integration of Genesys Cloud APIs to connect customer communication channels with policy systems and claims platforms in a secure and scalable manner.
* Provide hands on guidance in tuning speech analytics models to identify customer sentiment trends and claims related issues that inform business decisions and process enhancements.
* Coordinate with claims operations and underwriting teams to translate domain requirements from auto claims and property and casualty insurance into robust Genesys Cloud technical solutions.
* Implement monitoring and alerting mechanisms around Genesys Cloud services and APIs to ensure high availability low latency and rapid incident response in a day shift environment.
* Collaborate with cross functional stakeholders to design call flows routing strategies and interaction policies that improve claim handling efficiency and customer satisfaction.
* Execute structured code reviews configuration audits and documentation updates for Genesys Cloud components to maintain regulatory compliance and technical standards alignment.
* Analyze interaction data from quality monitoring and speech analytics to propose targeted improvements in claims handling scripts workflows and agent coaching programs.
* Guide junior engineers in best practices for Genesys Cloud development integration and troubleshooting while maintaining focus on customer and business outcomes rather than formal people management.
* Conduct impact assessments and proof of concept activities for new Genesys Cloud features or API integrations that can enhance automation in claims intake and policy servicing.
* Coordinate hybrid work collaboration using secure tools and standardized processes to ensure consistent progress across onsite and remote team members without travel requirements.
* Document solution designs technical decisions and operational runbooks clearly so that support teams can manage Genesys Cloud environments effectively during day shifts.

**Qualifications**

* Apply extensive experience of seven to ten years in enterprise contact center technologies with a focus on Genesys Cloud platforms quality monitoring and speech analytics to deliver reliable solutions.
* Demonstrate strong proficiency in designing and consuming Genesys Cloud APIs including authentication data mapping and error handling patterns for insurance domain integrations.
* Bring solid understanding of auto claims processes and property and casualty insurance lifecycles to shape technical configurations that align with regulatory expectations and customer service goals.
* Utilize practical experience in hybrid work models to manage time communication and collaboration effectively across distributed technical and business teams.
* Exhibit proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues in Genesys Cloud environments using logs metrics and analytic insights to restore service quickly and prevent recurrence.
* Apply knowledge of contact center metrics and key performance indicators to interpret quality monitoring and speech analytics outputs into actionable recommendations.
* Show comfort working with enterprise change management and release processes ensuring that Genesys Cloud updates and API changes are deployed in a controlled and documented manner.

**About Carrier**

**About The Role**

* May propose changes in design or formulation to improve system and/or process reliability.
* Builds and conducts dry running of basic qualification test set ups.
* sCompiles and analyzes performance reports and process control statistics; investigates and analyzes relevant variables potentially affecting product performance and processes.
* Liaises closely with other project team members in the areas such as stress, manufacturing, sourcing and configuration, with respect to new designs or design changes.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Reliability Modeling & Prediction**

* Perform reliability predictions for electronic assemblies and systems using industry-standard methodologies.
* Calculate:

+ MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures)
+ Failure Rate (FIT)
+ Product Useful Life
+ Service Life Estimates
+ Reliability Growth Metrics
+ Reliability Block Diagrams (RBD)
+ Mission Reliability

* Conduct reliability analysis using:

+ Telcordia SR-332
+ MIL-HDBK-217F
+ IEC 61709
+ FIDES methodologies

* Perform component-level and assembly-level reliability assessments

**System-Level Reliability Analysis**

* Develop and maintain system-level reliability models for complete products and platforms.
* Create reliability block diagrams — RBDs — for system architecture analysis.
* Evaluate reliability of complete systems considering:

+ PCB assemblies
+ Sensors
+ Power supplies
+ Communication modules
+ Displays
+ Relays/contactors
+ Motors/fans
+ Connectors and harnesses
+ Mechanical/electromechanical interfaces

* Analyze series, parallel, redundant, standby, and fail-safe architectures.
* Calculate system reliability, availability, maintainability, and probability of failure over mission time.
* Assess single-point failures and critical reliability contributors at system level.
* Support architecture trade-off studies to improve system robustness, redundancy, serviceability, and product life.
* Work with hardware, firmware, systems, mechanical, quality, compliance, and field teams to translate reliability risks into design actions

**Product Lifetime & Wear-Out Analysis**

* Estimate product useful life and service life based on operating profiles and field usage conditions.
* Perform lifetime calculations for wear-out-sensitive components such as:

+ Electrolytic capacitors
+ Relays
+ Power semiconductors
+ Fans
+ Connectors
+ Batteries
+ Displays
+ Electromechanical parts

* Apply appropriate models such as Arrhenius, Weibull, Coffin-Manson, thermal acceleration, voltage derating, and duty-cycle-based life models.
* Evaluate environmental impact including temperature, humidity, vibration, cycling, load profile, and power-on hours.
* Recommend design margins, derating guidelines, and component selection improvements

**Field Data Analytics**

* Analyze warranty claims, field returns, service records, and customer failure data.
* Develop reliability dashboards and reliability KPIs.
* Identify dominant failure modes and reliability trends.
* Establish failure-rate distributions and reliability growth plans.
* Generate actionable recommendations to improve product robustness.

**Reliability Testing & Validation**

* Define reliability validation plans for new product development and sustaining programs.
* Support HALT, HASS, accelerated life testing, temperature cycling, humidity testing, vibration testing, power cycling, and environmental stress testing.
* Correlate lab test results with predicted reliability and actual field performance.
* Define sample size, test duration, confidence level, and acceptance criteria for reliability demonstration tests.
* Support design verification and product qualification from a reliability perspective

**Failure Analysis & Root Cause Investigation**

* Support root cause investigations involving:

+ Field failures
+ Manufacturing defects
+ Component failures
+ Early-life failures

* Perform statistical analysis of failures.
* Work with hardware, firmware, component engineering, quality, manufacturing, and suppliers to implement corrective actions.

**Reliability Tools & Data Management**

* Utilize reliability prediction software and databases for analysis and reporting. Expertise in Relex, Reliasoft, Minitab, ITEM tool suite
* Maintain reliability calculation models, assumptions, and documentation.
* Develop automated reliability reporting tools and dashboards.
* Support design reviews with quantitative reliability assessments

title: Sr. Specialist Data Quality & Insights
description:
**Build our future together**
Regeneron is founded on the belief that the right idea, combined with the right team, can lead to significant transformations. Our growing global network is dedicated to inventing, developing, and commercializing medicines that change lives for people with serious diseases. In doing so, we are pioneering innovative approaches to science, manufacturing, and commercialization, while redefining our understanding of health.
  
  
At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking a Senior Specialist - Data Quality & Insights to join our Data Management team in Hyderabad. In this hands-on role, you will lead the reconciliation, validation, and quality oversight of external vendor data across multiple clinical data types. You will use Python, SQL, ETL tools, and data-quality reporting solutions to identify and resolve discrepancies, improve vendor data quality, strengthen inspection readiness, and support reliable clinical decision-making across the portfolio.
  
  
**When & where**
Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Discover your role**

* Perform end-to-end reconciliation of external vendor data, including Central Lab, Imaging, PK/PD, Cytokines, eCOA, and Biomarker data, against Medidata Rave and the Clinical Data Lake.
* Develop and maintain Python- and SQL-based reconciliation scripts, ETL pipelines, and automated data-quality checks for incoming external vendor datasets.
* Investigate, document, and coordinate the resolution of data discrepancies with Data Acquisition teams, vendors, and cross-functional partners, tracking issues through closure and CAPA processes where applicable.
* Execute study-specific data-quality timelines and checkpoints to ensure external data is validated and reconciled in line with protocol schedules and regulatory expectations.
* Implement and enhance Flask/Python-based reporting solutions used to publish data-quality reports and automated QC outputs for clinical and scientific stakeholders.
* Create and maintain vendor quality metrics and KPIs, including error rates, reconciliation timeliness, and protocol deviation trends, and communicate findings during vendor operational meetings.
* Develop data-quality dashboards and vendor scorecards that support inspection readiness, audit traceability, and continuous improvement.

* Familiarity with Service now ticket system
* Worked on Agile methodologies

title: Quality Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Jk Cable Altd is a growing manufacturer in the cable and electrical solutions industry, focused on delivering reliable products to a diverse range of clients. The company is committed to maintaining high production standards, continuous improvement, and strong customer satisfaction. Jk Cable Altd encourages collaboration between engineering, manufacturing, and quality teams to ensure consistent product performance. The organization supports professional development and provides opportunities to work with modern production technologies and quality systems.
  
**Role Description**
This full-time, on-site Quality Engineer role is based at Jk Cable Altd’s facility in Noida. The Quality Engineer will monitor and improve product quality across the production process, perform inspections and tests, and analyze data to identify trends and root causes of defects. The role involves developing and implementing quality procedures, supporting quality audits, and collaborating with production, design, and procurement teams to resolve quality issues. The Quality Engineer will create and maintain documentation such as control plans and test reports, ensure compliance with relevant standards, and support continuous improvement initiatives. The position also requires regular communication with internal stakeholders to drive corrective and preventive actions and maintain consistent quality performance.

* Strong foundation in Quality Engineering, including application of quality tools, methodologies, and data analysis.
* Experience in Quality Control activities such as inspections, testing, sampling plans, and in-process checks.
* Background in Quality Assurance, including procedure development, audits, and compliance with industry standards.
* Ability to oversee Product Quality, including specification adherence, performance validation, and defect reduction.
* Knowledge of Quality Management principles, including continuous improvement, root cause analysis, and corrective/preventive action planning.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related field) or equivalent practical experience.
* Familiarity with cable or manufacturing industry processes and standards is an advantage.
* Proficiency with quality-related software tools, MS Office, and basic statistical techniques.
* Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Ability to work on-site in Noida, manage multiple priorities, and contribute to cross-functional teams.

title: Senior Test Analyst
description:
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced
**Senior Finance Test Analyst**
with strong
**Oracle Fusion Finance testing expertise**
to join our testing team. This role will serve as the primary liaison between offshore testing teams and onshore Test Leads, combining hands-on test delivery with test coordination, governance, reporting, and stakeholder communication.
  
  
The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring offshore testing activities are planned, coordinated, executed, and reported effectively while maintaining high quality standards across all testing deliverables.
  
  
This role combines approximately
**80% hands-on testing and quality assurance activities**
with
**20% coordination, communication, and governance responsibilities**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Offshore-Onshore Coordination & Communication**

* Act as the primary point of contact between offshore test teams and onshore Test Leads.
* Participate in governance, status, and project meetings.
* Communicate testing priorities and requirements to offshore resources.
* Consolidate offshore progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and blockers.
* Provide clear and concise status updates to onshore stakeholders.
* Coordinate and track queries between offshore and onshore teams.
* Ensure agreed actions are understood and executed by offshore teams.
* Maintain efficient communication channels and minimize unnecessary escalations.

**Test Coordination & Governance**

* Support detailed planning and coordination of offshore testing activities.
* Break down testing scope into manageable work packages.
* Monitor progress against milestones and delivery timelines.
* Identify and escalate risks that may impact testing schedules.
* Coordinate test data, environment readiness, and testing dependencies.
* Ensure consistent quality standards across testing deliverables.
* Review and quality assure test cases and supporting evidence.
* Highlight resource and capacity constraints proactively.

**Test Analysis, Preparation & Execution**

* Execute and support complex Oracle Fusion Finance test scenarios.
* Review requirements and identify required test coverage.
* Develop, review, and maintain test cases and test scripts.
* Support end-to-end business process testing.
* Identify gaps and recommend additional testing where necessary.
* Ensure accurate documentation of testing activities and outcomes.

**Defect Management**

* Review defects before escalation to ensure completeness and quality.
* Ensure defects contain sufficient detail to support investigation.
* Participate in defect triage sessions and defect review meetings.
* Identify recurring issues and potential root causes.
* Escalate critical defects, risks, and blockers promptly.

**Reporting & Tracking**

* Maintain accurate test execution status in Azure DevOps (ADO).
* Consolidate and report offshore testing progress.
* Track defects, risks, dependencies, and blockers.
* Participate in daily stand-ups and status meetings.
* Provide visibility into resource utilization and testing capacity.

**Required Skills & Experience**
**Oracle Fusion Finance Testing**

* Professional testing qualification (ISTQB or equivalent preferred).
* Minimum 5 years of experience testing ERP Financials, preferably Oracle Fusion Finance.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end Finance processes and controls.
* Proven experience in functional system testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing support.

**Oracle Fusion Finance Modules**
**Experience Across Multiple Oracle Fusion Finance Modules, Including**

* General Ledger (GL)
* Accounts Payable (AP)
* Accounts Receivable (AR)
* Cash Management
* Fixed Assets
* Expenses
* Intercompany
* Tax
* Budgetary Control
* Financial Reporting

**Business Process Knowledge**
**Strong Knowledge Of End-to-end Finance Processes, Including**

* Procure-to-Pay (P2P)
* Record-to-Report (R2R)
* Order-to-Cash (O2C)

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**
This is a critical requirement for the role.
  
  
**The Successful Candidate Should Demonstrate**

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Experience working with UK-based or other international stakeholders.
* Ability to explain testing and technical issues to non-technical audiences.
* Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills.
* Ability to consolidate detailed testing information into concise management updates.
* Confidence in escalating risks, issues, and blockers appropriately.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in large-scale ERP transformation or Oracle Fusion implementation programs.
* Experience using Azure DevOps (ADO) for test management and defect tracking.
* Experience coordinating distributed offshore and onshore testing teams.
* Exposure to Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid delivery methodologies.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work on enterprise-scale Oracle Fusion Finance transformation programs.
* Collaborate with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
* Contribute to high-impact finance transformation initiatives.
* Opportunity to combine hands-on testing expertise with leadership and coordination responsibilities.

**Role Type:**
Full-Time

description:
**Job Description**
**Manager – Continuous Improvement & Process Discovery**
Kraft Heinz Global Business Services | Continuous Improvement
  
  
Six Sigma Green Belt | Process Discovery Lead | GBS Towers: ATR, AP, Commercial Ops, SCM & More
  
  
**Job Title**

GBS GCC Ahemdabad

Up to 20%
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Manager of Continuous Improvement & Process Discovery is a hands-on practitioner and team lead who drives process discovery and improvement initiatives across assigned GBS FnA towers. Reporting to the Senior Manager, this role owns the end-to-end execution of Six Sigma projects, facilitates process discovery workshops, produces high-quality process documentation, and coaches Analysts. The Manager bridges strategic direction with operational delivery, ensuring GBS towers continuously evolve toward leaner, more efficient models.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Process Discovery & Improvement Execution**

* Lead full-cycle DMAIC projects for assigned GBS towers (ATR, S2P, RTR, Commercial Ops, SCM), from charter definition through Control phase.
* Facilitate SIPOC, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), Swimlane, and Process Flow mapping workshops with tower SMEs and operations teams.
* Document current-state (as-is) processes and develop future-state (to-be) blueprints with gap analysis and improvement recommendations.
* Apply Lean tools (5S, Kaizen, FMEA, Root Cause Analysis) to identify and eliminate waste across transactional processes.
* Build and maintain the GBS process library (SOP-level documentation) in collaboration with tower leads.

**Data Analysis & Performance Measurement**

* Collect and analyze process performance data using statistical methods (control charts, Pareto analysis, Fishbone, hypothesis testing).
* Build and maintain KPI dashboards to track process health, improvement adoption, and project benefits realization.
* Partner with GBS Data & Analytics teams to leverage process mining tools and ERP data for baseline measurement.

**Team Leadership & Analyst Development**

* Supervise and develop 2–4 CI Analysts; assign workstreams, review deliverables, and provide structured coaching.
* Guide Analysts through process mapping assignments and quality-check documentation for accuracy and completeness.
* Support Analyst Yellow Belt and Green Belt certification journeys through project guidance and knowledge transfer.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Engage tower process owners, operations leads, and functional SMEs to gather inputs, validate findings, and drive buy-in for improvements.
* Prepare and present project updates, workshop findings, and improvement proposals to Senior Manager and tower leadership.
* Coordinate with IT/automation teams to align process redesigns with digitalization and RPA pipeline.

* Certified Six Sigma Green Belt (ASQ, IASSC, or equivalent) – mandatory.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in process improvement, operations, or business analysis.
* Minimum 2–3 years in a GBS, Shared Services, SSC, or BPO environment.
* Hands-on experience facilitating VSM, SIPOC, and Process Mapping sessions.
* Proficiency in process documentation tools (Visio, Lucidchart, ARIS, Signavio, or Bizagi).
* Strong data analysis skills; working knowledge of Minitab, Excel (advanced), or similar tools.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Six Sigma Black Belt certification or active pursuit.
* Exposure to process mining tools (Celonis, UiPath Process Mining).
* Experience with ERP platforms (SAP S/4HANA, Oracle) in an ATR or AP context.
* Lean certification or Kaizen facilitation experience.
* Experience in FMCG, CPG, or Kraft Heinz GBS environment.

**COMPETENCIES & BEHAVIORS**

* Strong facilitation skills – ability to lead structured workshops with diverse, cross-functional participants.
* Analytical mindset with a practical, results-oriented approach to problem solving.
* Clear written and verbal communication; able to translate process complexity into simple documentation.
* Collaborative team player who builds trust with operations teams and fosters a CI culture.
* Detail-oriented with high standards for documentation quality and process rigor.

title: Senior Suppliers Development Engineer
description:
The Supplier Development and Maturity Engineer plays a key and highly strategic role in improving the maturity of Arabelle Solutions’ suppliers. The mission is to sustainably elevate performance, quality, and nuclear safety standards of industrial partners to secure critical projects in a demanding environment.
  
  
This role focuses on the structural development of suppliers, addressing the core elements that determine supplier reliability:
  
  

* Excellence of the Quality Management System
* Strengthening of nuclear safety culture and requirements
* Organizational and documentation robustness, including sub-tier supplier
* management
* Continuous improvement capability and risk control

The role is suited for a structured and rigorous engineer with strong quality expertise, mastering the industrial production process from order intake to delivery. With excellent interpersonal skills, the individual acts as a true change driver, supporting suppliers through a Lean approach.
  
  
Working closely with internal experts, the Supplier Development Engineer assesses supplier maturity by conducting audits, analyzing organization, and identifying risks and weak signals. Supported by sourcing strategy, he/she develops and leads high-impact development plans (including operational aspects), supports suppliers in transforming their practices, and ensures the effectiveness of implemented actions.
  
  
**The Suppliers Covered Include**

* New Arabelle Solutions suppliers
* Current suppliers with quality performance issues
* Strategic suppliers for the company

This role directly contributes to supplier panel maturity, nuclear supply chain reliability, and the success of Arabelle Solutions projects.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**

* Contribute to and validate the global supplier selection strategy with sourcing teams
* Prepare, plan, and conduct assessment audits (ISO 9001, ISO 19443, customer requirements, internal standards) at supplier sites
* Evaluate and challenge suppliers’ organizational structure and processes to meet nuclear technical and administrative requirements; assess safety culture (organization, supply chain monitoring, competency management, process robustness, documentation control)
* Identify and mitigate gaps, weak signals, and risks affecting quality or safety
* Deliver structured and actionable reports
* Coordinate with internal technical experts for supplier-related actions
* Develop pragmatic and measurable supplier development plans (actions, deadlines, KPIs)
* Drive supplier maturity improvement through Lean coaching, follow-up, and effectiveness assessment
* Promote best practices while respecting confidentiality rules
* Develop and improve supplier qualification, maturity standards, and development programs, leveraging synergies within the EDF Group

**Required Skills**
**Technical Skills**

* Training or certification in nuclear safety / ISO 19443 is a plus
* Minimum 10 years of experience in quality, audits, or supplier development, ideally in regulated industries (nuclear, energy, rail, aerospace)
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes
* Strong command of Quality Management Systems (ISO 9001 required)
* Good understanding of nuclear safety culture
* Expertise in operational excellence in manufacturing
* Experience in QMS, organizational and process audits
* Strong knowledge of industrial production processes

**Behavioral Skills**

* Strong leadership and change management capability
* Excellent communication, listening, analytical and synthesis skills
* Rigor, autonomy, and initiative
* Strong interpersonal skills with diverse stakeholders
* Proactive mindset

**Profile And Requirements**

* Engineering degree or equivalent
* Fluent in English (written and spoken); French is a plus

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

* Willingness to travel to supplier sites

Join us and work with global teams to support global customers ! At Arabelle Solutions, we have team members of more than 49 nationalities spread across 16 countries.
  
  
At Arabelle Solutions, we know diversity makes teams and business stronger.

* Experience or strong interest in AI‑enabled solutions within enterprise systems
* Demonstrate ability to actively support application teams (internal / supplier), to work under pressure during bill cycles, accept multi-tasking and priority changes and be flexible and innovative in finding solutions and technical initiatives to adapt to the new context.
* Experience in Agile framework and ITIL processes and understanding of SDLC models and Azure DevOps practices would be a must.
* Knowledge of Unix shell scripting, Java development, and using REST APIs for testing.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively and confidently at all levels, i.e., in detail with technical staff/providers and in summary with senior management.
* University Software Engineering or Computer Science degree or equivalent.
* Fluent in English.

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. title: Technology Analyst
description:
About the Role Technology Analyst (IMP NOTE - This is not a Business Analyst or Data Analyst Role)  Introduction

Oxford University Press is seeking an Analyst, DPM to support the development, enhancement, and delivery of innovative digital products that help advance learning and educational outcomes. This is an excellent opportunity for a technology-focused professional who is passionate about digital product development and enjoys working in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.

As part of the Digital Product Management team, you will play an important role in supporting the development, customization, release, and maintenance of digital products. You will work closely with colleagues across Editorial, Marketing, Customer Services, and external technology partners, helping to deliver high-quality digital solutions that support OUP's mission of advancing knowledge and learning.

The role offers exposure to product management, agile delivery, digital content management, quality assurance, customer-focused product enhancements, and educational technology. It is ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems, building innovative solutions, and contributing to the ongoing growth of digital learning products.

  Opportunity

As Analyst, DPM, you will support the delivery of digital products throughout their lifecycle, ensuring high-quality user experiences and timely product releases.

Key responsibilities include:

* Supporting the development of new products, product features, and innovative ideas, including building quick MVPs to help stakeholders visualize product concepts.
* Developing feature backlogs and user stories, agreeing priorities with stakeholders, and supporting agile delivery of product enhancements within agreed timelines.
* Managing the sourcing, ingestion, and delivery of learning content for digital products.
* Enhancing digital content by enabling engaging digital interactions and learning experiences.
* Liaising with internal and external stakeholders to ensure quality, accuracy, and timely delivery of product releases.
* Supporting product development processes and ensuring adherence to quality standards.
* Coordinating Quality Assurance (QA) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities to ensure products meet performance and security requirements.
* Supporting the timely delivery of school updates, patches, installers, and software releases, including planning, testing, release note validation, and communication activities.
* Delivering product training sessions for Customer Services, Marketing, and other internal teams as required.
* Ensuring User Manuals, FAQs, Help Videos, and related support materials are maintained, updated, and of a high standard.
* Ensuring compliance requirements, NDA obligations, and third-party processes are followed in accordance with group guidelines.
* Coordinating effectively with Editorial, Marketing, Customer Support, Finance teams, and third-party vendor partners.

  Impact

This role is critical in ensuring OUP's digital products are delivered efficiently, maintained to high standards, and continually improved to meet customer needs. By supporting product development, content delivery, quality assurance, and stakeholder collaboration, you will help drive successful product launches, improved customer experiences, and operational excellence across OUP's digital portfolio.

  About You Essential Criteria

* B.Tech or MCA in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3-4 years of IT experience.
* At least 1 year of experience in product development, product management, or project delivery roles.
* Experience in digital product creation, development, implementation, and execution.
* Experience working within the EdTech, K-12, or Publishing domain.
* Experience supporting cloud-enabled and web-enabled solutions, including web and app-based products.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Proven ability to coordinate with third-party suppliers and delivery partners.
* Self-motivated, creative, dedicated, and able to work independently.
* High level of integrity and ownership.

Desirable Criteria

* Experience working within agile product development environments.
* Exposure to QA, UAT, release management, and product lifecycle management.
* Experience managing customer-facing digital products and implementations.
* Understanding of digital content workflows and learning technologies.
* Experience developing product documentation, training materials, and support resources.
* Knowledge of educational publishing and digital learning solutions.

title: Products & Platforms Lead – Insurance Technology
description:
**About Chubb**

Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: www.chubb.com.

**About Chubb India**

At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. We are proud to share that we have been officially certified as a Great Place to Work for the third consecutive year, a reflection of the culture at Chubb where we believe in fostering an environment where everyone can thrive, innovate, and grow.

With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we encourage a start-up mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution-driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape.

We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.

**Position Details**

**Job Title:**
Products & Platforms Lead – Insurance Technology

**Function / Department:**
Technology

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Location:**
Hyderabad / Bangalore

**Reports To:**
Head of Engineering – NA CI

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Products & Platforms Lead who understands insurance at its core and can translate that domain knowledge into technology platform decisions. You will lead the strategy, lifecycle management, and engineering delivery of Chubb's core insurance technology platforms — covering underwriting, rating, policy administration, and associated product engines. You sit at the intersection of insurance domain expertise and platform technology, owning how core insurance platforms are governed, evolved, and modernised to support Chubb's North America business. Internal candidates with deep Chubb platform knowledge are strongly encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the product and platform strategy for Chubb's core insurance technology platforms — underwriting, rating, policy administration, and product configuration engines.
* Define platform roadmaps aligned to business priorities: product launches, market expansion, regulatory changes, and technology modernisation.
* Lead vendor and partner management for insurance packaged platforms (e.g. Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco, or equivalent); govern upgrade cycles, licensing, and contractual obligations.
* Drive platform governance: version management, configuration standards, integration patterns, lifecycle controls, and technical debt management.
* Partner with underwriting, actuarial, product, and technology leaders to translate business requirements into platform capabilities and configuration.
* Identify and drive opportunities to leverage AI in core insurance platform operations — intelligent rating, automated underwriting assistance, data-driven product configuration, and claims triage.
* Govern platform integrations across the insurance technology estate: policy, billing, claims, reinsurance, and distribution systems.
* Build and lead a team of platform engineers and product owners; develop deep platform expertise and insurance domain knowledge within the team.
* Engage with global architecture and technology leadership to ensure platforms align with enterprise standards and modernisation strategy.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong insurance domain knowledge — underwriting, rating, policy administration, claims, and insurance product lifecycle across P&C, Specialty, or A&H lines.
* Experience managing or implementing core insurance technology platforms (Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco, FINEOS, or equivalent).
* Understanding of insurance product configuration, rating factors, underwriting rules engines, and actuarial data requirements.
* Technology leadership experience: ability to define platform strategy and govern complex, multi-system programmes across vendors and internal teams.
* Exposure to AI and analytics applications in insurance — intelligent underwriting, predictive rating, automated decisioning, and claims automation.
* Strong stakeholder management: ability to work effectively across underwriting, actuarial, product, and technology leadership at senior levels.
* Programme management and vendor governance experience in a regulated financial services environment.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 15+ years in insurance technology, with strong domain depth across underwriting, rating, or policy administration platforms.
* Internal candidates with deep Chubb platform and product knowledge are strongly encouraged to apply.

**Why Join Us?**

* Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry.
* Lead impactful initiatives that drive engineering excellence and customer outcomes.
* Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.

**Why Chubb?**

Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company! Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start-up-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results.

* Industry leader: Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence
* A Great Place to work: Chubb India has been recognized as a Great Place to Work for the years 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026
* Laser focus on excellence: At Chubb we pride ourselves on our culture of greatness where excellence is a mindset and a way of being. We constantly seek new and innovative ways to excel at work and deliver outstanding results
* Start-Up Culture: Embracing the spirit of a start-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter
* Growth and success: As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment

**Employee Benefits**

Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees' health, well-being, and professional growth. Employees enjoy flexible work options, generous paid time off, and robust health coverage, including treatment for dental and vision related requirements. We invest in the future of our employees through continuous learning opportunities and career advancement programs, while fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment. Our benefits include:

* Savings and Investment plans: We provide specialized benefits like Corporate NPS (National Pension Scheme), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP), Retiral Benefits and Car Lease that help employees optimally plan their finances
* Upskilling and career growth opportunities: With a focus on continuous learning, we offer customized programs that support upskilling like Education Reimbursement Programs, Certification programs and access to global learning programs.
* Health and Welfare Benefits: We care about our employees' well-being in and out of work and have benefits like Hybrid Work Environment, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Yearly Free Health campaigns and comprehensive Insurance benefits.

* Step 2: Engage with our recruitment team for an initial discussion.
* Step 3: Participate in HackerRank assessments/technical/functional interviews and assessments (if applicable).

**Join Us**

With you Chubb is better. Whether you are solving challenges on a global stage or creating innovative solutions for local markets, your contributions will help shape the future. Through direct delivery, partner challenge, knowledge transfer and continuous learning, you will help strengthen internal capability and reduce unnecessary reliance on external partners.
* Although primarily aligned to People Foundation, you will also support other People Technology capability domains when concentrated demand, delivery priorities, holiday cover, business continuity or development opportunities require additional capacity.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work directly with global, regional and functional stakeholders to understand business problems, requirements, user needs and desired outcomes, ensuring discussions remain focused on the need rather than a predetermined technology solution.
* Lead discovery, requirements and solution-shaping workshops, constructively challenging assumptions and translating business requirements into clear options, recommendations, functional designs and acceptance criteria.
* Act as a senior subject-matter specialist for SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and assigned Foundation capabilities, bringing relevant platform knowledge, leading practices and product insight into business and delivery decisions.
* Deliver authorised configuration, product administration, enhancements and optimisation activity directly within agreed access, security, control and segregation-of-duties requirements.
* Take ownership of assigned product changes from discovery through functional design, configuration, testing, release and early-life support, progressing work through established change and release controls with accurate status, traceability, decisions and evidence.
* Work with the Foundation Product Manager and Project Managers on larger initiatives, providing product expertise, detailed requirements, scope, estimates, dependencies, risks, decisions and delivery information.
* Analyse People processes, workforce data structures, business rules, roles, permissions, integrations and operational impacts to support effective end-to-end solution design.
* Assess Foundation-related incidents, defects, service issues, enhancements and optimisation opportunities, investigating root causes and recommending appropriate resolution or improvement routes.
* Assess SAP SuccessFactors release updates and product-roadmap changes, identifying relevant impacts, risks and opportunities and coordinating the testing, documentation, stakeholder readiness and adoption activity required.
* Create and maintain configuration workbooks, configuration records, requirements, functional designs, process documentation, solution decisions, test evidence, release artefacts, operating procedures and product knowledge, ensuring documentation remains aligned to the live product and supports auditability, operational continuity, supportability and future change.
* Define test scenarios and acceptance criteria, undertake or coordinate functional and regression testing, support user acceptance testing and ensure defects, decisions and test evidence are recorded appropriately.
* Monitor product health, data quality, recurring defects, adoption and operational performance, identifying and delivering opportunities to simplify processes, improve configuration, reduce manual activity and increase business value.
* Work confidently with support and implementation partners, leading or contributing to workshops, reviewing designs and deliverables, challenging recommendations and ensuring agreed documentation and knowledge transfer are completed.
* Maintain and develop relevant SAP SuccessFactors expertise through product learning, release awareness, practical delivery and appropriate certification.
* Share product knowledge, methods, documentation and lessons with colleagues, reducing single points of failure and increasing the resilience of the People Technology team.
* Contribute to the Foundation People Technology Community, working with regional stakeholders, super users and champions to gather insight, support adoption and improve the effective use of Foundation capabilities.
* Support other People Technology domains where demand and capacity require, providing flexible delivery capacity, holiday cover and broader development while maintaining accountability for assigned Foundation responsibilities.

title: Engineer II, Systems,
description:
**This is where**
your work makes a difference.
  
  
At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.
  
  
Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.
  
  
Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.
  
  
**Your Role At Baxter**
The role of Engineer II , Product Owner is to contribute in design and development of a product or solution, from conception to design and verification/validation. You will apply expert technical knowledge and engineering principles in the development of products and solutions. You will collaborate with cross functional team for technical issues, design changes, design reviews, and complex problem resolution
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Define and translate customer, business, regulatory, performance, usability, and safety requirements into clear system requirements and product specifications.
* Lead requirements engineering activities, including use case development, requirements decomposition, traceability, and change management using tools such as DOORS, Polarion, or equivalent platforms.
* Apply systems engineering principles to balance design trade-offs, identify risks early, and support informed technical decision-making.
* Execute and support risk management activities in accordance with ISO 14971, ensuring product safety and regulatory compliance throughout the development lifecycle.
* Partner with cross-functional engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and drive optimal technology solutions.
* Support Usability Engineering and Human Factors activities, ensuring compliance with IEC 62366 and relevant FDA guidance.
* Apply reliability and robustness engineering principles to enhance product performance, quality, and customer experience.
* Develop high-quality technical documentation that effectively communicates system architecture, requirements, design decisions, and development outcomes.
* Collaborate closely with software, hardware, and systems teams to support successful product integration and development testing.
* Work with Verification & Validation (V&V) teams to define comprehensive verification strategies and test plans that ensure thorough requirements coverage.
* Provide technical leadership and expertise to help projects achieve key objectives related to quality, cost, schedule, and regulatory compliance.
* Contribute to the successful delivery of innovative healthcare solutions by championing best practices in systems engineering, risk management, and product development.

**What You'll Brin**
g
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 3-6 years of experience in Systems Engineering, with a strong focus on electro-mechanical product development.
* Experience supporting the development of complex products within highly regulated industries, preferably medical devices.
* Working knowledge of FDA regulations, Medical Device Regulation (MDR), and applicable quality and regulatory standards.
* Experience with requirements management, systems engineering processes, and product lifecycle development.
* Familiarity with Usability Engineering and Human Factors Engineering methodologies.
* Understanding of design and development tools and methodologies such as QFD (Quality Function Deployment), Pugh Matrix, CTQ (Critical to Quality), Design for Reliability (DFR), and Design for Excellence (DFX).
* Knowledge of FDA, ISO, and IEC standards, including design controls, risk management, and product development best practices.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate complex technical challenges and recommend effective solutions.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and successfully deliver project objectives within quality, cost, and schedule expectations.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.

We are creating a new Group People Technology function to provide clear ownership, expertise and direction across the technology that supports our global People services.

title: Product Manager, WhatsApp - India
description:
More than 3 billion people in over 180 countries use WhatsApp to stay in touch with friends and family, anytime and anywhere. In India, it is also where a great deal of everyday life gets done - people message businesses, coordinate their families, and increasingly send money as easily as they send a message.We are building a new team to take WhatsApp further in that direction. The newly established WhatsApp Services team is focused on making WhatsApp more useful for more of what people already use it for, and on building what comes next. Payments on WhatsApp aren't a bet on paper: live in India since 2020 and growing; the existing WhatsApp payments team moves across as the pillar's foundation.WhatsApp Product Managers work with cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, data scientists, researchers and other partners to build products. * Lead a complex product area by defining its vision, strategy, and measures of success, while considering the wider WhatsApp and company context.

* Build alignment across adjacent product teams and partner functions, resolving divergent goals and creating shared strategies where needed.

title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, AHS
description:
**Description**
Join Amazon Health Services' One Medical team and shape the systems that determine how customer generated health data and third party health data drive better health outcomes for patients. You will define product strategy and drive execution for the platforms that ingest, normalize, and surface health data from diverse sources — wearables, connected devices, lab integrations, and patient reported inputs — turning fragmented signals into actionable clinical and consumer insights. These systems power experiences across the care continuum: enabling providers to make more informed decisions, helping patients engage meaningfully with their own health, and unlocking data driven personalization across Amazon Health Services.
  
  
Health data is unlike typical consumer data: it is governed by HIPAA and evolving state level privacy regulations, arrives in inconsistent formats (HL7, FHIR, proprietary device APIs), carries clinical significance that demands accuracy, and requires careful consent and access controls. Every product decision you define and measure operates under these constraints.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - Tech to own the product strategy for how One Medical ingests, reconciles, and leverages customer generated and third party health data to improve care delivery and patient outcomes. You will define the problems, shape the solutions, and drive outcomes across data ingestion pipelines, health record enrichment, data quality and normalization, and surfacing insights to clinicians and patients — working directly with engineers and scientists building the underlying data platforms and ML systems.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Define the product vision and multi year roadmap for customer generated health data systems: data ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and clinical surfacing
  
  
Translate complex health data and regulatory constraints (HIPAA, FHIR/HL7 interoperability, consent management, state privacy laws) into product requirements that engineering teams can build against
  
  
Design and own the end to end metrics framework for data quality, completeness, and clinical utility within your domain
  
  
Work with Clinical Operations, Provider Experience, Compliance, Privacy, and Platform Engineering partners to provide solutions and drive improvements
  
  
Partner with Applied Scientists and Engineers to define success criteria for data reconciliation models, insight generation algorithms, and automated triage systems
  
  
Influence without authority across multiple teams and organizations to drive outcomes in a matrixed environment
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in healthcare
* Experience with ML/AI product management — defining success criteria for models, managing model lifecycle, A/B testing ML systems
* Master's degree in a quantitative/technical field such as computer science, engineering, statistics

title: Sr. Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing global accounts to enterprise-level customers.
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
  
  
Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time-to-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes-based governance frameworks for AI-native builds, and steering multi-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
* Bachelor's degree in STEM field
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
* Experience in leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of delivering customer engagements in a professional services role experience
* active project management certification (e.g., APM, CSM, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2)
* AWS certification
* Experience in delivering customer engagements in a professional services role
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
* Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. description:

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact.
