title: Senior Project Manager
description:
**Strength in Trust**
OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
  
  
**The Challenge**
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager who is passionate about delivering software implementations and building excellent relationships with our customers. As an Implementation Project Manager you will own client engagements and be the internal advocate for your customers.
  
  
**Your Mission**
You will be responsible for key project factors like resources, scope, timeline, deliverables, budget, reporting, and customer satisfaction. You will collaborate across organizations including Implementation, Sales, Product Management, and Support throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
**As An Implementation Project Manager You Will**
Manage customer-facing professional service projects, responsible for tasks including requirements gathering, project planning, execution and status tracking, internal reporting and record keeping, customer reporting and stakeholder management
  
  
Engage with new and existing enterprise customers in a project management capacity, working with other OneTrust Consultants to deliver the solution as scoped
  
  
Build and manage customer-facing project plans and status reports. Manage project scope and customer expectations
  
  
Work collaboratively with other departments, including implementation, sales, support, engineering, and product management teams to ensure successful completion of customer implementations
  
  
Coordinate all aspects of a service offering for a client from inception to go-live
  
  
Manage internal hand-off to support by coordinating completion of all customer-facing and internal solution deliverables
  
  
Some travel required (15-20%)
  
  
**You Are**
You are a hard-working and determined individual used to working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. You are an independent worker who is able to problem-solve and process information quickly. You are able to gather client requirements and find a system-based solution that will address them and communicate with stakeholders, translate complex technical concepts into easy-to-understand terms with consultative approach.
  
  
**Your Experience Includes**
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, engineering, business or other related field
  
  
5+ years’ experience working in a client/customer-facing Professional Services role and/or 2+ years’ experience performing in a Senior Project Manager role
  
  
Previously experience working on implementing a SaaS solution
  
  
Exceptional communication (verbal and written) and presentation skills with a passion for technology
  
  
Strong leadership and project management skills
  
  
Where we Work
  
  
We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
  
  
Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.
  
  
**Benefits**
As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
  
  
Resources
  
  
Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:
  
  

* OneTrust Careers on YouTube
* @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data
  
  
You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview
**.**
You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.
  
  
Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.
  
  
**Our Commitment to You**
When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.
  
  
OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

title: Project Manager  (Corporate Interior Fit-Out)
description:
Zyeta is looking for a technically strong and execution-focused Project Manager with experience in corporate interior fit-out, commercial workplace, and large-scale office projects. The ideal candidate should be capable of independently managing end-to-end project delivery, including C&I , MEP coordination and execution, vendor management, project cost and schedule control, and direct client communication.

Candidates with experience in GCC offices and multinational corporate workplace projects will be preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage end-to-end project execution from project initiation and planning through construction, commissioning, and final handover.
* Lead C&I and MEP execution, ensuring seamless coordination across civil works, interior finishes, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire fighting, fire alarm, and ELV systems.
* Review and interpret architectural, interior, civil, and MEP drawings, specifications, BOQs, and shop drawings.
* Identify technical discrepancies, resolve site clashes, and coordinate with design and engineering teams to ensure constructability.
* Independently manage vendors, subcontractors, consultants, and site teams to achieve project milestones.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, managing technical discussions, progress reviews, project updates, and issue resolution.
* Prepare and monitor project schedules, resource plans, procurement timelines, and execution milestones.
* Track project costs, validate quantities and measurements, monitor variations, and control cost overruns.
* Coordinate with procurement teams to ensure timely material approvals, ordering, delivery, and site availability.
* Monitor workmanship, quality standards, safety compliance, and adherence to approved drawings and specifications.
* Identify project risks, resolve execution bottlenecks, and implement corrective actions to minimise delays and rework.
* Conduct regular site inspections, track project progress, and ensure timely snag closure and handover.
* Prepare project progress reports covering schedule, cost, quality, risks, vendor performance, and client requirements.
* Ensure completion of as-built drawings, testing and commissioning records, warranties, and handover documentation.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of C&I execution, including partitions, flooring, ceilings, joinery, glazing, painting, and interior finishing works.
* Good understanding of MEP systems, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire fighting, fire alarm, and ELV.
* Ability to read, interpret, and coordinate architectural, interior, civil, and MEP drawings.
* Experience in technical drawing reviews, shop drawing coordination, service clash identification, and resolution.
* Knowledge of BOQs, quantity take-offs, rate analysis, measurement verification, and variation management.
* Strong understanding of construction planning, critical path scheduling, project sequencing, and resource allocation.
* Experience in material submittals, technical approvals, method statements, inspection requests, and quality documentation.
* Knowledge of testing and commissioning, snagging, defect rectification, and project handover processes.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, MS Project, and Microsoft Excel.
* Exposure to BIM/Revit coordination and clash detection is an advantage.

**Required Experience and Competencies**

* 10–15 years of experience in project management and construction execution, primarily in corporate interior fit-out or commercial workplace projects.
* Proven experience independently handling both C&I execution and MEP coordination on commercial interior projects.
* Strong technical understanding combined with hands-on site execution capabilities.
* Demonstrated experience managing vendors, subcontractors, consultants, and cross-functional project teams.
* Experience handling direct client communication, technical reviews, project updates, and escalations.
* Strong commercial awareness, including budget monitoring, BOQ validation, variation management, and cost control.
* Excellent planning, leadership, negotiation, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

Candidates must demonstrate a combination of
**technical expertise, hands-on C&I and MEP execution, vendor management, project cost and schedule control, and direct client-handling experience**
.

title: Associate - Compliance and Ops Risk Test Senior Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
Join a team focused on strengthening the control environment through disciplined testing and clear documentation. In this role, you will evaluate control design and effectiveness, identify gaps, and help drive remediation to reduce risk. You will collaborate closely with process and control owners to plan walkthroughs, gather evidence, and deliver timely reporting. If you thrive on analytical problem-solving and improving testing methods, this role offers meaningful opportunities to make an impact.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As a
**Compliance and Operations Risk Test Senior Specialist**
within
**Testing Center of Excellence**
team, you will apply your knowledge of risk management and control evaluation to identify and mitigate compliance and operational risks. You will execute testing with precision and accountability to deliver high-quality outcomes aligned to the firm's highest-priority risks. You will assess the control environment, identify gaps, and drive remediation efforts to reduce risk. You will use analytical thinking and structured problem-solving to break down complex business objectives into actionable tasks and activities. You will help ensure a cohesive and efficient testing framework that supports consistent, high-quality delivery.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Evaluate the assigned function's control environment, including assessing the adequacy, effectiveness, and design of controls to support alignment with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) and other regulatory frameworks, as well as the firm's risk priorities.
* Execute testing processes with precision and accountability to assess the control environment, identify gaps, and prepare robust documentation (including process documents, process flows, and overview documents) that supports testing conclusions.
* Collaborate with process and control owners and cross-functional teams on the testing schedule; obtain walkthroughs; document process changes; gather evidence; analyze potential issues; and facilitate timely reporting.
* Support issue validation, action plan quality, and closure discipline by partnering with control owners to help ensure remediation aligns with risk acceptance and compliance expectations.
* Lead walkthroughs and other meetings with business owners, fostering collaboration across engagements with minimal oversight.
* Interpret policies, standards, and procedures to support accurate implementation of compliance requirements, while continuously improving control evaluation methodologies and interpreting control ratings and metrics to strengthen the compliance and operational risk management framework.
* Propose and implement improvements to current testing methods, contributing to the overall efficiency and effectiveness of the firm's risk management.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* Minimum of 4 years of experience in controls testing, audit, or operational risk management within a risk and control environment.
* Strong understanding of risk management and compliance.
* Demonstrated advanced analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, including analyzing large data sets to identify exceptions or patterns.
* Ability to evaluate multiple aspects of a situation to identify key information.
* Proven ability to build partnerships with key stakeholders and collaborate with business and functional experts to identify risks and gaps.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to remain flexible and productive through shifting priorities and deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence business leaders in a meaningful and actionable manner.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**

* Professional qualifications such as Chartered Accountant (CA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Finance, or Certified Internal Auditor (CIA).
* Audit and control testing experience.
* Experience using tools such as Alteryx or Tableau to support testing activities or metrics reporting.
* Ability to innovate, challenge the status quo, and identify automation opportunities.

**ABOUT US**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.
  
  
Control Management maintains a strong and consistent control environment through a joint accountability model that aligns managers with each function and region to mitigate operational risk. The team focuses on four areas: Control Design & Expertise, Risks & Controls Identification/Assessment, Issues & Control Deficiencies and Control Governance & Reporting.

title: Practicing Advocate
description:
⚖️
**HIRING: CORE LITIGATION ADVOCATE | BENGALURU | EXCLUSIVE PROFESSIONAL ENGAGEMENT**

**Jurisiti Legal LLP, a Delhi-based litigation law firm, is looking to engage an experienced Core Litigation Advocate in Bengaluru to lead and manage the firm's litigation matters across the region.**

We are expanding our regional presence and seeking a capable litigation professional who can independently handle court proceedings, develop effective case strategies, manage end-to-end litigation responsibilities, and represent the firm's professional interests within the agreed scope of engagement.

We are looking for someone who combines strong legal knowledge with practical courtroom experience, independent thinking, strategic judgment, professional discipline, and a commitment to delivering high-quality legal work.

With a team of
**12+ in-house advocates and a wider professional network**
, we aim to build a dependable regional litigation practice through long-term professional associations with capable advocates.

🔹 POSITION DETAILS

📍
**Location:**
Bengaluru, Karnataka

⚖️
**Position:**
Core Litigation Advocate

🤝
**Engagement Model:**
Exclusive, long-term professional engagement

💰
**Remuneration:**
Fixed monthly remuneration, commensurate with experience and capabilities

🏛️
**Firm Location:**
Delhi, with regional litigation operations

🔹 1. EXPERIENCE & ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS

The ideal candidate must possess:

* A minimum of
  **5–6 years of post-qualification experience (PQE)**
  in core litigation practice.
* An LL.B. degree and a Master's degree in Law (LL.M.).
* Both LL.B. and LL.M. qualifications from
  **Tier-1 law institutions**
  .
* Substantial practical exposure to court proceedings, legal drafting, filing procedures, case management, and oral advocacy.
* The ability to independently manage matters, take ownership of assigned responsibilities, and provide sound legal advice based on facts, evidence, applicable law, and judicial precedents.

🔹 2. PRACTICE AREAS

The candidate should have practical experience and professional exposure across the following areas:

* **Civil Litigation**
* **Commercial Litigation**
* Business and Contractual Disputes
* Consumer Litigation
* Labour and Employment Matters
* Arbitration and Dispute Resolution
* Criminal Litigation

**The primary focus will be Civil and Commercial Litigation.**

Applicants should have demonstrable experience in handling civil and commercial disputes, including the preparation of pleadings, interim applications, replies, written submissions, evidence-related proceedings, and oral arguments.

🔹 3. INDEPENDENT CASE STRATEGY & COURTROOM ADVOCACY

We are looking for an advocate who can think independently, analyse disputes critically, and develop a litigation strategy rather than merely execute instructions.

The selected candidate should be capable of:

* Analysing facts, documents, evidence, and legal issues to identify the strengths and weaknesses of a case.
* Designing a practical, well-researched, and legally sustainable litigation strategy.
* Conducting in-depth legal research and identifying relevant judgments, statutory provisions, and judicial precedents.
* Drafting high-quality petitions, plaints, written statements, replies, applications, affidavits, written submissions, and other pleadings.
* Independently managing filing procedures, procedural requirements, and court deadlines.
* Preparing for hearings, anticipating opposing arguments, and presenting persuasive oral arguments.
* Identifying appropriate interim remedies, procedural options, settlement opportunities, and further legal steps.
* Evaluating litigation risks and advising on the most effective course of action to pursue the client's legitimate interests.

**The expectation is to engage a professional who can take ownership of a matter from its initial assessment through the appropriate stages of litigation.**

🔹 4. COURT ORDER COMPLIANCE & END-TO-END MATTER MANAGEMENT

The advocate must be capable of independently managing judicial directions, procedural timelines, and post-hearing requirements.

Responsibilities will include:

* Reviewing and analysing court orders immediately after hearings.
* Identifying directions requiring action, documentation, filing, or compliance.
* Monitoring deadlines and ensuring timely procedural steps.
* Preparing and coordinating compliance documents, applications, and subsequent filings.
* Tracking hearing dates, case progress, orders, and future action points.
* Keeping the firm's central team informed of developments, risks, compliance requirements, and recommended next steps.
* Ensuring that assigned matters are managed systematically and that avoidable procedural delays are minimised.

We value professionals who understand that effective litigation requires not only courtroom advocacy but also meticulous preparation, follow-through, and accountability.

🔹 5. EXCLUSIVE PROFESSIONAL ASSOCIATION & MONTHLY REMUNERATION

This opportunity is intended for an advocate seeking a structured, stable, and long-term professional association with a growing litigation law firm.

The selected candidate will be engaged on a
**monthly remuneration basis under mutually agreed exclusive engagement terms**
.

The professional will be expected to devote the agreed capacity to the firm's assigned matters and regional responsibilities, maintain appropriate coordination with the Delhi team, and ensure consistent handling of the firm's litigation work in the region.

We are particularly interested in candidates who value continuity of work, professional stability, long-term collaboration, and the opportunity to contribute to the development of a regional litigation practice.

The precise engagement terms, responsibilities, exclusivity arrangements, and remuneration will be mutually agreed upon, subject to applicable professional regulations.

🔹 6. REGIONAL REPRESENTATION & PRACTICE DEVELOPMENT

The selected advocate will serve as the firm's principal litigation professional for Bengaluru and the surrounding region within the agreed scope of engagement.

The responsibilities will include:

* Managing and representing the firm's assigned matters before appropriate courts and tribunals, subject to applicable enrolment, practice, and procedural requirements.
* Independently handling matters while coordinating with the firm's central team in Delhi.
* Maintaining regular communication with clients and relevant stakeholders in a professional and confidential manner.
* Coordinating with briefing counsel and other legal professionals whenever required.
* Preparing timely matter updates, hearing reports, case status summaries, and recommendations.
* Maintaining proper documentation and ensuring continuity in the management of each assigned matter.
* Helping establish and strengthen the firm's regional litigation operations through dependable execution and professional conduct.

We seek someone who can operate independently while remaining aligned with the firm's standards, systems, and client-service expectations.

🔹 7. LOCAL LANGUAGE & REGIONAL COURT FAMILIARITY

Familiarity with
**Kannada and English**
, local court procedures, regional litigation practices, and the ability to communicate effectively with clients and other stakeholders in Karnataka will be an added advantage.

An understanding of the local legal environment and practical experience appearing before courts and tribunals in the region will also be valuable.

🔹 8. THE PROFESSIONAL WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

* Strong analytical and legal reasoning skills.
* Excellent legal research, drafting, and oral advocacy capabilities.
* Independent judgment and strategic thinking.
* A high degree of responsibility and professional integrity.
* Discipline in managing deadlines, court orders, and procedural compliance.
* Clear communication and effective coordination with a central legal team.
* The ability to manage assigned matters with minimal supervision.
* A collaborative approach to building a long-term professional association.

We are looking for someone who is serious about litigation, confident in their abilities, committed to high standards of legal work, and prepared to take meaningful responsibility for the matters entrusted to them.

🔹 HOW TO APPLY

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated résumé through either of the following channels:

📧
**Email:**
contact@jurisiti.com

📱
**WhatsApp:**
+91 97173 29850

Please mention
**“Core Litigation Advocate – Bengaluru”**
in the email subject line or WhatsApp message.

Candidates are encouraged to include a brief overview of their post-qualification experience, educational qualifications, principal practice areas, courts and tribunals regularly appeared before, and representative litigation experience, subject to client confidentiality.

**We look forward to connecting with a capable litigation advocate who can take ownership of assigned matters, represent the firm professionally, and help build a strong regional litigation practice in Bengaluru.**

**Build. Represent. Strategise. Litigate. Grow.**

title: Director Product Management
description:
**About Target:**

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.

Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Servicing organization well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target.

**About Team & Role:**

Target Enterprise Services (TES) is a globally integrated organisation focused on delivering operational excellence and enterprise transformation through service operations, procurement, finance, product, analytics, automation, and AI. Operating through a highly collaborative, cross-functional model, TES partners across the enterprise to simplify processes, improve experiences, reduce friction, create scalable capabilities and unlock business value for Guests, team members, vendors, and business partners.

Product Teams at TES are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology, data science and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all products, technology and design work.

As a Director of Product Management, you will set the overall strategic vision for your product portfolio and lead the team in delivering measurable business outcomes. You will establish short- and long-term product goals, define quarterly Objectives and Key Results, prioritise investments, and manage product budgets and financials.

The Director of Product Management based in India is a strategic product leader responsible for accelerating Service Centre product capabilities and AI adoption, strengthening execution rigour, prioritising investments, enabling operational efficiency, and providing leadership across Product, Technology, Data, Design, and Operations teams globally and locally.

Further the role will be responsible for

* Driving day-to-day product excellence and velocity of Cross-functional teams
* Ensuring strong alignment between global product strategy and local execution, especially faster decision making
* Elevating product thinking, maturity, innovation, and data-driven decision-making leveraging Digital-first mindset.
* Serving as the site leader for product team functionally reporting to the US product leader

**Detailed Job Description:**

Success in this role requires balancing strategic thinking with execution excellence, fostering strong product and engineering practices, and building high-performing teams. This leader will transform servicing data into actionable enterprise insights, accelerate digital adoption, reduce friction across customer journeys, and create scalable, reusable platforms that strengthen loyalty, improve productivity, and unlock enterprise value.

You will build, coach, and mentor a strong team of Product Managers while fostering a culture of progress, transparency, accountability, and efficiency. You will elevate the team’s performance by providing insightful, motivating, and constructive feedback and by partnering with senior leaders and peers across pyramids to resolve execution-related barriers.

You will lead product discovery with key stakeholders, validating hypotheses and concepts with customers before committing engineering capacity. You will guide complex work across multiple pyramids and interrelated specialities. You will use data and analytics to assess market context, inform decisions, evaluate product health and effectiveness, understand P&L impact, and provide clear recommendations to key stakeholders.

You will possess or develop a strong understanding of servicing platforms and systems, including data flows, transaction sequences, relevant technologies, and design principles, to enable innovative and scalable solutions across Target.

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

**About you:**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of product management experience, including experience leading product teams, preferably within retail, consumer, or servicing environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading product-driven business transformation.
* Experience managing product portfolios, investment priorities, budgets, financials, and business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of technology, data, analytics, and digital product development.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and align stakeholders across complex, cross-functional organisations.
* Expertise in establishing product vision, outcome-based roadmaps, OKRs, and success measures.
* Demonstrated ability to build, coach, and lead high-performing product teams.
* Expertise in agile product-development practices, including iterative development, discovery, experimentation, and backlog management.

title: Product Manager
description:
Overview:

**Product****Manager**

**BASIC SUMMARY:**

We are seeking a forward-thinking Product Manager to shape and advance the strategy, development, and evolution of our healthcare claims administration platform. In this role, you will manage the product lifecycle from concept through release, driving initiatives that address complex business challenges and deliver measurable value to customers. You will partner across the organization to define requirements, prioritize features, and ensure solutions are aligned with market trends, regulatory needs, and our long-term product vision.  
  
The ideal candidate blends healthcare industry expertise with strong product management skills, bringing a data-informed, customer-centric approach to decision-making. Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools to accelerate requirements definition, backlog management, and analysis is a plus.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Product Strategy & Roadmap Execution**

* Contribute to the product roadmap in partnership with senior product leadership, ensuring alignment with market needs, business priorities, and strategic objectives
* Identify and evaluate opportunities to enhance product competitiveness through emerging technologies, regulatory changes, or evolving customer needs
* Collaborate with engineering, design, and quality assurance teams to deliver features that meet scope, quality, and timeline commitments
* Develop clear, value-driven epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria informed by market insights and stakeholder input
* Actively participate in Agile ceremonies and ensure delivery plans remain on track and adaptable to shifting priorities

**Market Insight & Requirements Leadership**

* Gather and synthesize insights from customers, market research, and internal teams to inform product decision
* Translate complex business requirements into actionable development items, leveraging AI-enabled tools for efficiency and consistency
* Prioritize backlog items based on business impact, market urgency, and customer value
* Partner with compliance teams to ensure product features meet healthcare regulations and security standards

**Cross-Functional Influence & Collaboration**

* Serve as a bridge between technical and non-technical teams, ensuring shared understanding of product goals and constraints
* Work closely with UX/UI to advocate for user-centered design and optimal user experiences
* Partner with customer success, support, and marketing to enable effective go-to-market strategies, adoption, and customer education
* Engage with leadership to provide visibility into progress, risks, and product performance metrics

**Product Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Analyze product usage data, KPIs, and customer feedback to identify enhancements and drive continuous optimization
* Support impact analysis for proposed changes and contribute to release planning to ensure seamless delivery
* Maintain awareness of industry shifts, competitive offerings, and payer/provider needs to inform future iterations and long-term vision

* Working knowledge of healthcare claims workflows, medical billing, and reimbursement models
* Familiarity with healthcare regulatory frameworks (HIPAA, HITECH) and data standards (HL7, X12, FHIR)
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Detail-oriented with excellent organization and documentation abilities
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities
* Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Pragmatic Institute, or equivalent certification
* Experience supporting AI-driven or data-intensive product initiatives

-------------------

At EY, we develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We empower you in a flexible environment and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

We work together across our full spectrum of services and skills, powered by technology and AI, so that business, people and the planet can thrive together.

We’re all in, are you?

Join EY and shape your future with confidence.

  

**The opportunity**

The Strategy & Execution team in EY-Parthenon recognizes that CEOs and business leaders are tasked with achieving maximum value for their organizations’ stakeholders in a transformative business environment. We challenge assumptions to design and deliver strategies that improve profitability, strengthen competitiveness and create long-term value.

We are looking for an experienced strategy consulting professional to join EY-Parthenon GDS India as an Associate Director within the Consumer Products and Retail sector.

You will be based in EY GDS India and work as an integrated member of the Singapore Strategy & Execution team, primarily supporting client engagements across Singapore and the wider ASEAN region.

This is a client-facing consulting and leadership role. You will work closely with EY-Parthenon teams and clients across ASEAN to develop and deliver strategic opportunities, drawing on market, competitor and customer insights and incorporating commercial, operational, financial and implementation perspectives.

The role provides the opportunity to work on complex, cross-border engagements, develop relationships with senior stakeholders and contribute to building EY-Parthenon’s Consumer Products and Retail capabilities across Singapore, ASEAN and GDS India.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

**Client engagement and delivery**

* Lead client engagements, major workstreams or independent modules across strategy, commercial transformation and operational transformation assignments.
* Structure complex business problems, develop hypotheses and define robust approaches to address clients’ strategic and operational priorities.
* Lead the collection and analysis of quantitative and qualitative information, translate findings into insights and formulate practical recommendations.
* Take ownership of the quality, timeliness and commercial relevance of project deliverables.
* Work directly with client stakeholders to understand their priorities, align on project objectives and communicate emerging findings and recommendations.
* Lead or contribute to client discussions, working sessions, presentations and senior stakeholder meetings.
* Develop clear, compelling and evidence-based presentations and reports for senior client audiences.
* Work effectively with geographically dispersed engagement teams, coordinating closely with colleagues in Singapore, GDS India and other ASEAN markets.

**Strategy and transformation**

You will work across a range of strategy and transformation engagements, which may include:

* Market entry and growth strategy
* Go-to-market strategy
* Revenue growth management
* Commercial transformation
* Digital and AI-led transformation
* Commercial due diligence
* Post-merger integration
* Divestment strategy and execution
* Cost and organization transformation
* Supply chain and procurement transformation
* Sales and operations planning
* Retail commercial and operational transformation
* Turnaround strategy and rapid value creation

**Team leadership and capability development**

* Lead, coach and develop teams working across GDS India, Singapore and the wider EY-Parthenon network.
* Provide clear direction, constructive feedback and day-to-day support to team members.
* Contribute to building a strong Consumer Products and Retail capability within EY-Parthenon GDS India.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, learning and broader capability-development initiatives.
* Help strengthen collaboration and knowledge sharing between the Singapore and GDS India teams.
* Promote an inclusive, high-performing team environment focused on development, quality and client impact.

**Business and practice development**

* Support the development of ASEAN-focused proposals, credentials and other business-development materials.
* Contribute sector insights and subject-matter expertise to pursuit teams and client discussions.
* Help identify opportunities to deepen existing client relationships and support the development of new relationships.
* Contribute to the continued growth of the Strategy & Execution practice and its Consumer Products and Retail portfolio across ASEAN.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

To succeed in this role, you should be able to:

* Lead complex strategy and transformation workstreams with limited supervision.
* Combine rigorous analysis with sound commercial judgment and practical recommendations.
* Communicate complex ideas clearly and confidently to senior internal and client stakeholders.
* Build trusted working relationships across different organizations, markets and cultures.
* Manage multiple priorities and maintain high standards in a fast-paced, project-based environment.
* Lead, motivate and develop diverse teams operating across locations.
* Collaborate effectively with Singapore-based and wider ASEAN engagement teams.
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of the strategic, commercial and operational issues affecting Consumer Products and Retail businesses.
* Adapt your working approach to different client, cultural and market contexts.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor’s degree from a recognized institution. A master’s degree or MBA is preferred.
* At least six years of relevant professional experience, including significant experience in a strategy consulting firm or a closely related consulting environment.
* Demonstrated experience in the Consumer Products and Retail sector.
* Experience leading substantial workstreams, project modules or client engagements.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical and financial analysis skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing and presenting materials for senior stakeholders.
* Experience managing and developing consulting teams.
* The ability to work effectively with colleagues and clients across locations, functions and cultures.
* A willingness and ability to travel internationally in line with client and engagement requirements.

  

**Relevant Consumer Products and Retail experience**

Relevant experience should include one or more of the following areas:

* Corporate, portfolio, market entry or growth strategy
* Go-to-market strategy and commercial transformation
* Revenue growth management
* Digital and AI-led business transformation
* Cost reduction and operating-model transformation
* Supply chain and procurement transformation
* Sales and operations planning
* Retail commercial or operational transformation
* Commercial due diligence, post-merger integration or value creation

  

**Ideally, you will also have**

* Previous experience working with clients or consulting teams in Singapore, ASEAN or other international markets.
* Experience operating as part of a cross-border or globally integrated consulting team.
* Familiarity with the business environment, consumer trends and market dynamics of Singapore and the wider ASEAN region.
* Experience supporting consulting proposals, business development and client pursuits.
* Experience building sector capabilities, coaching teams or contributing to recruitment and learning initiatives.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to establish credibility with senior client stakeholders.

  

**Regional exposure and ways of working**

* The role requires close collaboration with colleagues and clients across ASEAN, with reasonable flexibility to accommodate regional engagement requirements.
* Periodic travel to Singapore and other ASEAN markets will be required, depending on client and engagement needs. This may include short-duration on-site assignments at different stages of an engagement.
* The successful candidate should be comfortable working in an integrated regional team, building relationships remotely and in person, and adapting to the requirements of cross-border client engagements.
* Strong performers may be considered for future international mobility opportunities, subject to business requirements, performance, immigration requirements and applicable firm policies.

  

**What we offer you**

We will fuel your ambition and potential with future-focused skills development that equips you with state-of-the-art methodologies and technology-enabled solutions. With more than 25,000 people in 150 countries, you will join an inclusive and empowering culture that values your uniqueness, prioritizes your wellbeing, and immerses you in the diverse thinking and cross-cultural experiences necessary to help deliver impact to clients across the globe and help build a better working world.

**EY | Building a better working world**

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Refund, Loan & Dispute Operations Executive - Customer Support
description:
**Role Overview:** We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and ownership-driven Refund, Loan & Dispute Operations Executive to manage refund calculations, loan/EMI-related cases, non-starter loan cases, financial disputes, transaction reconciliation, and customer resolutions. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with Customer Support, Sales, Finance, Escalation teams, and external loan/financial partners to ensure that every assigned case is accurately analyzed, properly coordinated, and taken to end-to-end closure.

This is a numbers, data, and ownership-driven role. The candidate should be comfortable working with financial data, Excel/Google Sheets, transaction records, and customers.

**Position Details**

* **Employment Type:** Full-Time
* **Department:** Customer Support
* **Experience:** 1–3 years
* **Qualification:** B.Com / M.Com / BBA / Finance-related qualification preferred
* **Location:** Kolkata

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Refund Calculation & Processing:**
* Calculate refund amounts accurately as per the refund policy, payment mode, programme access, and applicable deductions.
* Validate refund eligibility by checking payment records, enrolment details, and supporting documents.
* Verify payment proofs, transaction IDs, and invoices before any refund is initiated.
* Manage the complete refund lifecycle from request → verification → approval → payout → closure.
* Ensure refunds are processed only after obtaining the required approvals.
* Follow up on failed, delayed, or reversed refunds until the amount is credited to the customer.
* **Loan & EMI Case Management:**
* Handle loan/EMI-related cases for customers who have purchased programmes through loan or financing partners.
* Verify and provide accurate information on EMI amount, EMI deduction history, EMI commencement date, tenure, outstanding amount, and payment/loan status.
* Manage loan cancellations, incorrect deductions, and loan closure/foreclosure-related requests in coordination with the loan partner.
* Analyse and manage non-starter loan cases, and coordinate with the loan partner to resolve them as per the agreed process.
* Proactively connect with learners/customers in non-starter loan cases to understand the reason for non-start, provide clarity on loan/EMI status and next steps, and ensure the learner understands the resolution.
* **Financial Dispute Resolution:**
* Handle payment disputes, chargebacks, double debits, and failed transactions where the amount was debited.
* Investigate each case using transaction records, payment gateway data, bank references, and customer communication.
* Prepare the required documents and evidence to respond to disputes raised through payment gateways, banks, or partners within timelines.
* Own the dispute end-to-end after raising it with the concerned POC, including regular follow-ups, TAT monitoring, escalation of delays, validation of the resolution, and formal closure of the case.
* Escalate complex, high-value, or suspicious cases for appropriate review.
* **Transaction Reconciliation:**
* Reconcile transactions across payment gateway reports, bank statements, sales/CRM records, and loan partner reports.
* Identify mismatches, duplicate payments, unmapped payments, and pending settlements.
* Coordinate with the Finance team to resolve discrepancies and close open items.
* **Customer Resolution & Case Closure:**
* Communicate with customers on refund, loan, and dispute cases in a clear, professional, and empathetic manner.
* Explain refund calculations, loan status, and expected timelines to customers in simple terms.
* Prioritize cases based on financial impact, customer impact, ageing, defined TAT, and escalation severity, ensuring that high-value and critical cases receive timely attention.
* Resolve escalated customer cases within the defined TAT.
* Reconnect with the learner/customer after internal resolution wherever required and provide clear closure, including the action taken, final outcome, and any further steps expected from them.
* **Stakeholder & Partner Coordination:**
* Coordinate with Customer Support, Sales, Finance, Escalation teams, and external loan/financial partners.
* Follow up on pending approvals, partner responses, payouts, and documentation.
* Identify recurring issues and process gaps, and recommend improvements for better control, speed, and transparency.
* **Reporting & Record Management:**
* Maintain tracking sheets of refunds, loan cases, and disputes using Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.
* Prepare regular MIS reports on case volumes, refund value, pending cases, and closure rates for management review.
* Ensure all records and supporting documents are properly organized and readily available for review.
* **Confidentiality & Financial Control:**
* Maintain strict confidentiality of customer and company financial information.
* Handle bank details, loan information, and transaction data responsibly.
* Support controls that minimize errors, duplicate refunds, misuse, and unauthorized payouts.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* B.Com / M.Com / BBA / Finance-related qualification preferred.
* 1–3 years of experience in refund operations, loan/EMI operations, payment disputes, reconciliation, finance operations, or a similar role.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIF/COUNTIF, filters).
* Good understanding of payment flows, EMIs/loans, refunds, chargebacks, and transaction records.
* Experience handling loan/EMI queries (EMI deductions, tenure, outstanding amount, foreclosure) will be a strong advantage.
* Ability to perform accurate financial calculations and analyze transaction data.
* Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for customer and partner interactions.

**Key Personal Attributes**

* Good organizational, coordination, and follow-up skills.
* Comfortable coordinating with customers, internal teams, and external partners.
* High integrity and strong ethical standards.
* Analytical and detail-oriented.
* Strong ownership and accountability till case closure.
* Calm and patient while handling escalated customers.
* Process-driven with good judgment.
* Comfortable handling sensitive financial information.
* Ability to work independently and maintain accurate records.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work closely with the Customer Support, Finance & Operations teams.
* Hands-on exposure to refund operations, loan/EMI processes, payment disputes, and reconciliation.
* Opportunity to build and improve refund and dispute resolution processes.
* Growth opportunity within a fast-paced organization.

**About be10X**

At be10X (Goenka Kachave LLP), we don't just teach AI – we turn it into a career weapon. We're an AI upskilling platform built to help working professionals unlock faster promotions, bigger salary hikes, sharper productivity, and career breakthroughs they didn't think were possible yet. Founded by IIT Kharagpur alumni Aditya Goenka and Aditya Kachave, we've rewritten the career trajectories of over 5 million learners through cutting-edge programs spanning AI, Finance, Data, Product, and Business.

And we're not just growing – we're scaling fast. A profitable, fully bootstrapped organization with INR 500+ crore in annual recurring revenue, a 2,500+ member team, and 15 offices across Pune, Bengaluru & Kolkata, we're one of India's – and the globe's – fastest-growing EdTech organizations.

**Answer Engine Optimization (AEO):** Optimize website content to improve visibility across answer engines and AI-powered platforms by creating concise, authoritative, question-led content, FAQs, structured answers, and relevant schema markup. Focus on capturing featured snippets, People Also Ask results, voice search queries, and AI-generated answers to strengthen brand visibility and drive qualified organic traffic.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
As a Software Engineering Manager within MS TECH Order Fulfillment, you will provide strategic product and technical leadership, along with hands-on expertise, to build industry-leading products. You are a systems thinker capable of driving large-scale transformations that maximize value for Ford, our Dealers, and our customers. The role combines high-level strategy, including product vision, AI/ML use-case portfolio, data strategy, and technical roadmaps, with disciplined execution to deliver scalable, resilient, secure, explainable, and highly available solutions in a global environment.
  
  
**Technical Leadership & Vision**

* Serve as the primary technical authority for the Order Generation product suite, defining the evolution of the technology stack, data architecture, AI/ML capabilities, and architectural patterns.
* Lead cross-functional teams through complex integrations, managing dependencies across the broader Order Fulfillment ecosystem to ensure seamless data flow and system interoperability.
* Translate high-level business requirements into actionable technical strategies that align with Ford enterprise standards.

**AI/ML Product Strategy & Innovation**

* Define and execute an AI/ML and data analytics product strategy that converts priority business requirements into a sequenced portfolio of intelligent capabilities and measurable outcomes.
* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI/ML opportunities across forecasting, order generation, decision support, anomaly detection, optimization, and workflow automation using value, feasibility, risk, data readiness, and adoption criteria.
* Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of AI/ML products from discovery, business-case development, experimentation, and MVP validation through industrialization, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, Product, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Legal, Privacy, and business teams to ensure solutions are technically sound, usable, compliant, and aligned with responsible AI principles.
* Establish outcome-based product metrics, experimentation methods, model performance targets, and adoption measures; use evidence and customer feedback to guide investment and roadmap decisions.
* Monitor emerging technologies, including generative AI, agentic AI, foundation models, advanced analytics, optimization, and intelligent automation, and determine where they can create differentiated business value.
* Drive build, buy, or partner assessments and develop scalable patterns for reusable AI/ML services, data products, model APIs, and decision intelligence capabilities.

**Product Strategy & Delivery**

* Partner with business stakeholders to define and execute a multi-year product vision and roadmap focused on optimized order forecasting and generation.
* Champion an iterative, Agile delivery model, prioritizing the delivery of Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) and maintaining a high-velocity release cadence.
* Apply Human-Centered Design (HCD) principles to ensure technical solutions solve real-world problems for Dealers and customers.
* Create launch and adoption plans that include operational readiness, user training, change management, benefit tracking, and feedback loops.

**Data, Model & MLOps Excellence**

* Ensure AI/ML solutions are supported by trusted, governed, discoverable, and fit-for-purpose data, with clear ownership, lineage, quality controls, and access patterns.
* Guide the implementation of robust MLOps and LLMOps practices covering reproducible experimentation, model registry, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, rollback, and auditability.
* Define controls for model quality, explainability, bias and fairness evaluation, privacy, security, human oversight, and responsible use throughout the product lifecycle.
* Balance predictive accuracy with interpretability, latency, cost, reliability, and business usability when selecting models and architectures.

**Engineering & Operational Excellence**

* Enforce rigorous engineering standards, including Test-Driven Development (TDD), robust CI/CD pipelines, and DevSecOps practices.
* Drive a culture of Full Lifecycle Ownership, where the team is responsible for the design, security, deployment, and operational health of its services.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for system health, code quality, delivery velocity, model performance, data quality, adoption, and realized business value.

**Architectural Design**

* Architect and oversee the development of cloud-native, microservices-based systems designed for global scale, multi-tenancy, and high-performance transactional processing.
* Design interoperable data and AI architectures that support batch and real-time inference, event-driven workflows, APIs, observability, and secure integration with enterprise platforms.

**People Leadership & Talent Development**

* Cultivate a high-performing, diverse team of Software Engineers, Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and ML Engineers through active coaching, mentorship, and career pathing.
* Foster a culture of psychological safety and continuous learning, utilizing blameless retrospectives and regular feedback loops to drive team growth.
* Identify and close skill gaps within the team to keep pace with emerging technologies and industry trends.

**Strategic Collaboration**

* Act as a bridge between the product team and domain experts in Cloud Infrastructure, Data & AI, Cybersecurity, Responsible AI, SRE, and DevOps to reduce portfolio complexity.
* Influence stakeholders across the organization to adopt modern engineering practices, responsible AI controls, reusable data products, and standardized service contracts.

**Technical Execution (Hands-on)**

* Maintain deep technical fluency in the team’s primary languages, frameworks, cloud services, data platforms, and AI/ML toolchain, including Java, Spring Boot, GCP/Azure, Vertex AI, and modern MLOps platforms.
* Lead from the front by participating in architecture and code reviews, resolving complex technical blockers, reviewing model and data design decisions, and occasionally prototyping high-risk or emerging technology concepts.
* Experience: 10+ years of progressive software engineering, digital product, data, or AI/ML solution delivery experience, with a significant portion in engineering and product leadership roles.
* AI/ML Product Leadership: Demonstrated experience strategizing, developing, launching, and scaling AI/ML-based products that address business requirements and deliver measurable operational or customer outcomes.
* Product Strategy: Experience defining product vision, business cases, roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, MVPs, go-to-market or launch plans, adoption strategies, and value-realization metrics for data and AI products.
* Education: Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.
* Certifications: Industry certifications relevant to software engineering, cloud, data, or AI/ML, or a commitment to obtain them within 6 months. GCP Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Machine Learning Engineer, or equivalent certification is a plus.
* Cloud Expertise: 4+ years of experience delivering production solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including cloud-native application and data/AI services.
* Technical Depth: Expertise in microservices, cloud-native architectures, event-driven architectures, APIs, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), distributed systems, and secure enterprise integration.
* AI/ML & Analytics: Strong working knowledge of supervised and unsupervised learning, time-series forecasting, optimization, anomaly detection, feature engineering, model evaluation, experimentation, and production inference patterns.
* Data Engineering: Experience with data architectures, data pipelines, data quality, governance, metadata and lineage, feature stores, batch and streaming data, and analytics platforms.
* MLOps / LLMOps: Hands-on experience establishing or governing CI/CD/CT for models, experiment tracking, model registry, automated validation, deployment, observability, drift monitoring, retraining, and lifecycle controls.
* Responsible AI: Experience applying secure and responsible AI practices, including privacy, transparency, explainability, bias and fairness assessment, human oversight, access controls, risk management, and auditability.
* Technology Stack: Hands-on experience with Java, Angular, Python, SQL, Terraform, Postgres, APIGEE, Kubernetes, Docker, serverless technologies, and containerization. Experience with Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, or equivalent cloud services is strongly preferred.
* Engineering Excellence: Thorough knowledge of multi-threading, concurrency, parallel processing, DevSecOps, test automation, and monitoring tools such as Dynatrace or Google Cloud Monitoring.
* Developer Experience: Experience increasing developer productivity by integrating AI agents, coding assistants, reusable platform capabilities, or AI skills into the development lifecycle.
* Leadership Qualities: Proven ability to lead large-scale transformations, apply systems thinking, create psychologically safe teams, influence complex decisions, and earn the respect of strong individual technical talent through competence and mentorship.
* Communication & Business Acumen: Ability to communicate complex technical and AI concepts to executives and business partners, align diverse stakeholders, manage trade-offs, and connect product investments to business outcomes.

**Nice to Have**

* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.
* Experience with Vertex AI, BigQuery, Feature Store, Gemini or other foundation-model platforms, vector search, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, and evaluation frameworks.
* Experience building reusable enterprise platforms and underlying services for data, analytics, and AI capabilities.
* Experience with forecasting, supply chain, order fulfillment, demand planning, optimization, or decision intelligence products.
* Ability to translate product roadmaps into manageable features through quarterly scoping sessions and assist product teams directly with technical blockers.
* Proven ability to identify and mitigate delivery, data, model, security, adoption, and operational risks while assessing overall product health and prompting timely decisions.
* Strong understanding of business priorities and technical feasibility to prioritize platform backlogs and manage dependencies.
* Experience with Lean methodology, eXtreme Programming (XP), Agile product management, and Human-Centered Design.
* Experience championing modern software, data, AI/ML, product, and responsible AI practices within a large organization.

* Develop AI solutions that integrate with internal systems, including trading platforms, operations workbenches, and risk engines, to automate decision support, exception handling, and reporting.
* Establish standards for prompt engineering, AI guardrails, and evaluation frameworks, including offline evaluations, A/B testing, and automated regression testing.

**2. Azure Cloud and AI Platform Engineering**

* Lead the design, implementation, and management of AI/ML infrastructure on Microsoft Azure using Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Design scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient AI inference pipelines using caching, request batching, and token-budget optimization.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML models and AI agents, incorporating model versioning, controlled deployments, A/B testing, rollback mechanisms, and observability.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise cloud governance, data residency, and security requirements using Azure Private Endpoints, Managed Identity, Key Vault, and related security controls.

**3. AI Performance Optimization and Troubleshooting**

* Diagnose and resolve production AI performance issues, including inference latency, embedding drift, retrieval quality degradation, hallucinations, and context-window limitations.
* Monitor and optimize token consumption, API rate limits, throughput, and cost per query across production AI workloads.
* Establish AI observability through structured logging, distributed tracing across prompt processing, retrieval, and generation, and dashboards tracking latency (p50/p95/p99), retrieval recall, and answer relevance.
* Conduct root-cause analysis of AI system failures, including incorrect tool invocations, RAG retrieval failures, safety-filter false positives, and model regressions following version upgrades.

**4. Technical Leadership and Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of 4–6 AI/ML engineers, overseeing code reviews, architecture decisions, sprint planning, engineering standards, and professional development.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, data scientists, quantitative teams, and operations leaders to translate business requirements into scalable, production-ready AI solutions.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, model releases, fine-tuning techniques, agent frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, and CrewAI, and AI evaluation methodologies.
* Represent the AI engineering function in technical design reviews, architecture governance forums, and incident post-mortems.
* Drive engineering best practices and continuous improvement across AI solution design, development, deployment, monitoring, security, and operational support.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on AI/ML solutions in production environments.
* Deep hands-on experience with RAG architectures, including vector databases, embedding pipelines, chunking strategies, hybrid search (keyword + semantic), re-ranking, and retrieval evaluation.
* Proven track record of building Agentic AI systems, including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, planning loops, memory management, and fallback strategies.
* Strong proficiency in Azure Cloud services, including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search (formerly Cognitive Search), Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, AKS, and App Service.
* Experience troubleshooting AI performance issues, including inference latency optimization, token budgeting, embedding drift detection, hallucination mitigation, and cost management at scale.
* Proficiency in Python and at least one of the following: C#/.NET or TypeScript/Node.js.
* Experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or CrewAI.
* Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, including transformers, attention mechanisms, fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), RLHF, and evaluation metrics such as BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore, faithfulness, and relevance.
* Experience leading engineering teams of 4+ members in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and prepare clear technical documentation.

title: Drydock Manager
description:
Seaspan employees are goal-driven and thrive in a high-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.
  
  
**Position Description:**
This position is responsible for the end-to-end planning, execution, and financial oversight of vessel drydocking and major repairs including unplanned and retrofits across a global fleet. The position serves as the primary technical link between the company, shipyards, and classification societies to ensure the dry-dock projects are delivered safely and on schedule.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities:**
  
  

* Is familiar with the Health, Safety, Environmental Protection and Quality Policy (PL-005), and understands the responsibilities under the Environmental Management System (EMS). In keeping with this and other compliance policies, they understand their duty to report any environmental noncompliance and/or concern to their manager or members of the senior management team (including the highest level of management) either directly or through the open reporting system as per Management System guidelines.
* Project Planning & Preparation: Lead the pre-planning phase, including pre-docking inspections, developing detailed technical specifications (standard and non-standard), and coordinating with vessels and vessel managers to identify specific repair needs. Making sure Seaspan vessels are docked at the most suitable and economical shipyard, at the most appropriate time and in the most cost-effective manner. Liaising with the vessel to order spares and stores prior docking in a timely manner. Liaising with the procurement team and local agency to ensure timely and cost-effective delivery of spares required for project execution.
* Shipyard & Vendor Management: Review shipyard quotations for accuracy & include missing items in the bid sheet, conduct cost/availability comparisons, and provide recommendations. Manage relationships with paint suppliers, subcontractors, and service providers.
* On-site Supervision: With the support of Vessel Managers, oversee all stages of drydock execution at the shipyard to ensure high-quality workmanship, adherence to timelines & budgets, and compliance with safety and environmental standards (QSHE). Assist Vessel manager in resolving operational issues to minimize downtime and delays
* Financial Control: Along with the Vessel Manager, manage the overall repair budget, monitor project expenses in real-time, and lead final invoice negotiations with the shipyard to identify cost-optimization opportunities. Variations in docking scope to be documented and approvals sought from relevant stakeholders. Ensure Maximum value from allocated Dry-dock budgets and costs saving potentials are harvested. Preparing 5-year CAPEX rolling budget forecast for the fleet with Vessel Managers. Analyze docking costs and invoices to identify cost optimization opportunities. Follow up with service vendors for any variation in repair cost.
* Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all work meets the requirements of classification societies, flag states, and international maritime regulations.
* Process Improvement: Improve and maintain standardized drydock procedures, software, and databases to track historical costs and performance metrics in line with industry-wide best practices.
* Documentation & Reporting:

+ Maintain dry-dock records, inspection reports, and repair logs
+ Ensure document control and compliance with audit requirements

**Requirements:**

* Education: Degree in Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, or a related discipline.
* Professional Experience:

+ Minimum 5–8 years of experience in ship management, superintendency, or shipyard project management.
+ Proven track record of managing large-scale drydocking projects and retrofits
+ Sailing experience as a Senior Engineer (e.g., 2nd Engineer or higher) is preferred.
+ Technical Skills:

  
  

+ Proficiency in drydock management software, ERP systems, and project management tools. Technologically driven, comfortable working in a digital environment, logical process development.
+ Leveraging data and system functionality to improve decision-making and operational performance.
+ Focus on standardization, continuous improvement, and workflow optimization across technical and operational activities.

**Core Competencies:**

* Project Management: Ability to manage complex, multi-million-dollar projects under tight deadlines.
* Negotiation: Assertive skills for handling shipyard contracts and final settlements.
* Communication: Strong interpersonal skills to coordinate with cross-functional teams, including fleet operations, marine assurance, procurement, and accounts.
* Mobility: Readiness for frequent international travel on short notice and ability to conduct physical vessel inspections.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

* Drydocking Planning Performance: Percentage deviation from planned costs and duration.
* Budget Alignment: Preparing competitive budget. Total project spend versus allocated budget.
* Vessel Turnaround Time: Minimizing downtime and ensuring on-time or before-time delivery from the yard.
* Safety & Quality: Number of health, safety, and environment (HSE) incidents or quality findings during the project.
* Corrective Actions & Continuous Improvement: Demonstrates management commitment to continual improvement

About Stars N Celebs
  
  
Stars N Celebs (SNC) is building an Artist Identity Marketplace that helps actors, models, singers, dancers, influencers, and other creative professionals establish their identity, improve their visibility, and explore opportunities.
  
  
Our mission is to make talent more visible and accessible while helping artists build their presence in the entertainment and creator economy.
  
  
We are looking for a proactive, results-oriented individual to build and manage our Campus Ambassador Programme and expand Stars N Celebs' presence across colleges and universities.
  
  
About the Role
  
  
As Campus Ambassador Program Manager, you will lead the development and execution of our campus outreach initiative.
  
  
Your primary responsibility will be to build a network of campus ambassadors who can introduce Stars N Celebs to aspiring artists, performers, creators, and students interested in the entertainment industry.
  
  
You will be responsible for developing campus partnerships, coordinating ambassadors, implementing promotional initiatives, and driving relevant registrations and paid subscriptions on the platform.
  
  
We are looking for someone who can build a network, mobilise people, and deliver measurable growth—not simply coordinate activities.

- Identify and establish connections with colleges, universities, and student communities.
  
- Build relationships with student leaders, cultural societies, theatre groups, dance and music clubs, fashion societies, and college event organisers.
  
- Identify campuses with strong communities of aspiring artists, performers, models, and content creators.
  
- Develop a structured plan to expand SNC's reach across multiple colleges.
  
  
2. Campus Ambassador Recruitment & Management
  
  
- Recruit and onboard campus ambassadors across colleges and universities.
  
- Build and manage an active network of student representatives.
  
- Establish clear expectations, performance indicators, and engagement plans for ambassadors.
  
- Motivate ambassadors to promote the platform and generate relevant registrations and subscriptions.
  
- Monitor ambassador performance and identify opportunities to improve results.
  
  
3. Subscriber Acquisition & Platform Growth
  
  
- Develop campus-level strategies to generate artist registrations and paid subscriptions.
  
- Coordinate targeted promotional campaigns to introduce students and emerging artists to Stars N Celebs.
  
- Help prospective subscribers understand the platform's benefits, features, and subscription options.
  
- Identify effective ways to convert interested prospects into registered users and paying subscribers.
  
- Track the source of registrations and subscriptions to measure campaign effectiveness.
  
  
4. Campus Promotions & Partnerships
  
  
- Explore promotional opportunities through college festivals, talent showcases, cultural events, workshops, and student communities.

- Identify cost-effective opportunities to increase awareness and acquire subscribers.

- Establish measurable targets for ambassador recruitment, active campus participation, registrations, and paid subscriptions.
  
- Track campaign performance and subscription conversions.
  
- Maintain regular communication with ambassadors and review their progress.
  
- Recommend improvements based on results and feedback.
  
- Provide periodic reports on programme performance and growth.
  
  
Who Should Apply?
  
  
We are particularly interested in candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas:
  
  
- Campus ambassador programmes.
  
- College outreach and student community management.
  
- Sales, business development, or customer acquisition.
  
- Influencer marketing and community building.
  
- Partnerships, event management, or field marketing.
  
- Digital marketing and growth initiatives.
