- Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  
- Networking, negotiation, and persuasion.
  
- Team coordination and leadership.
  
- Sales orientation and an understanding of conversion-driven activities.
  
- Planning, execution, and problem-solving.
  
- Familiarity with social media and digital promotion.
  
- Ability to work independently and take ownership of results.
  
  
What We Offer
  
  
- An opportunity to build and lead a campus growth initiative from the ground up.
  
- Experience in business development, community building, and subscriber acquisition.
  
- Exposure to India's entertainment and creator ecosystem.
  
- The opportunity to develop a network of campus ambassadors across colleges.
  
- A performance-oriented environment where ideas and results matter.
  
  
Engagement Details
  
  
- Organisation: Stars N Celebs
  
- Position: Campus Ambassador Program Manager
  
- Function: Growth, Partnerships & Subscriber Acquisition
  
- Work arrangement: To be discussed.
  
- Engagement model and compensation: To be discussed based on the agreed scope, responsibilities, and experience.

title: SAP PM CS
description:
Job Description: SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven
**SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant**
with
**5 to 12 years**
of expertise across SAP Customer Service (CS), Service Management (SM), and S/4HANA Service.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, and implementing end-to-end Service Management processes in an
**SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition (PCE) / RISE with SAP**
environment. You will bridge business requirements and functional architecture, manage cloud service governance, enable AI-driven service insights, and drive continuous optimization across the full service lifecycle.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Implementation
* Design, configure, and deploy S/4HANA Service Management processes across the entire service lifecycle: Engage, Sell, Contract, Plan, Schedule, Execute, Invoice, and Analyze.
* Map end-to-end business requirements to standard S/4HANA Service capabilities, including service quotations, service orders, service contracts, spare parts logistics, resource planning, billing, and analytics.
* Drive adoption of the latest S/4HANA PCE release innovations (e.g., service team determination, advanced execution processes, Fiori applications, and AI-powered service intelligence).
* S/4HANA Private Edition (PCE) Governance
* Operate effectively within the SAP S/4HANA PCE Shared Responsibility Model between the client and SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS).
* Liaise with SAP for system-level operational tasks (e.g., infrastructure management, backups, maintenance, and upgrade administration).
* Lead client-side functional responsibilities, including business process configuration, functional validation, regression testing, and process governance based on SAP’s PCE Roles and Responsibilities framework.
* Service Order & Contract Management
* Configure and maintain service contract structures, recurring service billing plans, and auto-renewal mechanisms.
* Enable flexible billing scenarios, including Resource-Related Billing (RRB), Time & Material (T&M), and Fixed-Price billing models.
* Leverage modern platform features such as service contract template cloning and mass contract change capabilities.
* Service Planning, Execution & Logistics Integration
* Set up and optimize workforce planning, resource allocation, dispatching, and field service workflows.
* Configure plant and storage location parameters within service transactions to support multi-plant and multi-location service execution.
* Direct cross-module functional integration between service transactions and procurement (MM), inventory management, shipping, plant maintenance (PM), and follow-on financial postings.
* Data Migration, Testing & Integration
* Oversee data preparation, cleansing, transformation, and validation for service master data, active service contracts, and open service orders.
* Utilize the SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and standard transition tools tailored for service artifacts.
* Coordinate functional and technical integrations across CRM, SAP Field Service Management (FSM), SAP CS, core logistics, and Finance (FI/CO).
* AI, Analytics & Continuous Process Improvement
* Implement embedded AI capabilities (e.g., Joule-assisted summaries, intelligent confirmations, and predictive service insights).
* Design custom Fiori dashboards, operational reports, and KPIs to monitor service performance and profitability.
* Guide business stakeholders through continuous improvement initiatives and the adoption of periodic SAP release features.
* Stakeholder Management & Documentation
* Facilitate requirements-gathering workshops, author detailed functional specifications (FS), and map target-state business process flows.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams spanning Logistics, Procurement, Finance, and Sales.
* Create training collateral, deliver end-user training, and lead hypercare support during deployment phases.

**Required Skills & Technical Expertise**

* Experience: 5–12 years of hands-on experience in SAP CS / SM / S/4HANA Service functional consulting.
* Core Module Competency: Comprehensive knowledge of S/4HANA Service (PCE) core functionality (Service Orders, Service Contracts, Resource-Related Billing, Invoicing, and Execution Logistics).
* Cloud Architecture: Clear operational understanding of the SAP PCE operating model, RISE with SAP frameworks, and cloud service boundary matrices.
* User Experience & Extensibility: Proficiency with modern SAP Fiori apps, standard OData APIs, and functional extensibility options.
* Integration Touchpoints: Strong cross-functional integration experience with PM, SD, MM, FI/CO, and SAP FSM.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Practical project experience with RISE with SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition implementations or migrations.
* Hands-on knowledge of SAP upgrade governance and release management protocols in PCE environments.
* Official SAP Certification in S/4HANA Service or related SAP functional modules.

**Soft Skills**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong consulting mindset with a proven ability to translate business strategy into technical solution designs.
* Proactive problem-solving capabilities and experience leading cross-functional delivery teams.

**Description**
As a Power System Planning Engineer, you will be a key member of our Power Systems Energy & Utility Consulting- Transmission Planning team, contributing significantly to the growth of transmission and distribution activities. This role will require the application of advanced engineering techniques to solve complex problems in the transmission and distribution sectors.

* Perform advanced technical modeling and simulation of electrical power systems, including power flow studies, transient stability, dynamic studies, reactive compensation, and contingency analysis.
* Utilize power system analysis tools like PSS/E, ASPEN, PSLF, TARA, and MiPower to carry out studies.

* Conduct Interconnection Application Study

* Lead and execute power system planning and analysis projects, ensuring that deadlines and quality standards are met.
* Provide technical direction to other team members, including training and development of junior engineers.

**Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

* Stay updated with the latest technologies, trends, research, paper, policies and innovations in the energy and power systems sector.

**International Collaboration & Travel**

* Collaborate with international teams and clients, with the flexibility to work across multiple time zones.

title: Senior Project Engineer
description: ETAP empowers customers to make informed decisions throughout the life cycle of their projects with innovative software solutions for electrical systems. By applying ETAP solutions, customers experience continuous intelligence during design and engineering and into operations and maintenance using a unified electrical digital twin platform. ETAP supports customers in their digital transformation and sustainable energy transitions for a green and smart future, helping them to prioritize safety, maximize reliability, and stay resilient.Our employees' passion for excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction is our most-prized resource. If you share that passion — and want to be part of a company that leads the energy transition towards a cleaner and more resilient world for future generations — we invite you to join us!ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.Job Title: Senior Project EngineerLocation: MumbaiEmployment Type: full-timeThe job In this role, you will be responsible for power system modeling, engineering analysis, real-time power system applications, ADMS/OMS, power automation, project engineering, testing, and commissioning. You will develop and validate electrical network models, perform static and dynamic power system studies, configure real-time applications using field data, and support integration with SCADA, DCS, IEDs, gateways, and external systems.The role also involves preparing technical and project documentation, coordinating with customers and multidisciplinary teams, leading or supporting FAT and SAT activities, troubleshooting system and communication issues, demonstrating application functionalities, and conducting customer training.Key ResponsibilitiesDevelop, validate, maintain, and update electrical network models and digital twins using ETAP or equivalent power system analysis platforms. Perform power system studies including Load Flow, Short-Circuit, Protection/Relay Coordination, Harmonic Analysis, Transient Stability, Motor Acceleration, Voltage Stability, Arc Flash, and related studies. Review SLDs, equipment data, protection settings, network parameters, and operating philosophies; analyze study results and prepare engineering reports with recommendations. Configure and commission real-time power system applications using live field measurements, equipment status, and operational data. Configure and validate State & Load Estimation (SLE), network topology processing, observability, bad-data handling, and online power system analysis. Map and validate analog, digital, status, command, and calculated signals from SCADA/DCS/IED/gateway systems and troubleshoot model/data mismatches. Model and analyze distribution networks and configure ADMS functions including distribution load flow, state estimation, FLISR, switching analysis, Voltage/VAR Optimization (VVO), and network reconfiguration. Support Outage Management System (OMS) configuration, network tracing, outage identification, restoration workflows, and integration with SCADA, GIS, and enterprise systems. Engineer and configure power automation and SCADA interfaces, including points/tags, alarms, events, trends, measurements, statuses, commands, and HMI functions. Configure and troubleshoot communication using protocols such as IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3, Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC UA/DA, and ICCP/TASE.2. Support integration of IEDs, RTUs, PLCs, gateways, managed switches, and control-center interfaces. Perform basic IT/OT system and network configuration, including servers/workstations, IP addressing, managed switches, VLANs, remote access, redundancy, and connectivity troubleshooting. Prepare FAT/SAT procedures and lead or participate in internal testing, FAT, integration testing, site commissioning, SAT, and functional demonstrations. Investigate technical issues, perform root-cause analysis, close test observations and punch points, and support customer acceptance. Plan and monitor project engineering activities, schedules, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and technical interfaces. Prepare and review FDS, architecture documents, signal lists, interface documents, study reports, test procedures, commissioning records, user manuals, and as-built documentation. Coordinate with project management, engineering teams, software teams, vendors, EPC contractors, consultants, and customers. Prepare and deliver customer training covering system architecture, power system applications, operational workflows, troubleshooting, and routine system operation. Support technical knowledge transfer and mentor junior engineers where required.Essential RequirementsBachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related discipline. Minimum 5–6 years of relevant experience in power system studies, real-time power system applications, ADMS/SCADA, power automation, or related project engineering. Hands-on experience in electrical network modeling and power system analysis. Working knowledge of real-time power system applications, SCADA, communication protocols, and IT/OT environments. Experience in FAT, SAT, testing, commissioning, technical documentation, and customer interaction. Industry exposure in Oil & Gas, Industrial, Utilities / Transmission & Distribution, or Power Generation; Renewable/BESS experience is an advantage. Professional written and spoken English. Willingness to travel and mobilize to project sites within the GCC, including onshore/offshore locations and extended site stays when required.Desired SkillsPower System Modeling & Digital Twin Development Load Flow, Short-Circuit & Relay Coordination Harmonic & Transient Stability Analysis Motor Acceleration & Voltage Stability Studies ETAP Power System Analysis Real-Time Power System Analysis & SLE ADMS / OMS / FLISR / VVO SCADA Configuration & Integration IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3, Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC UA/DA & ICCP/TASE.2 Industrial Communication & IT/OT Networking FAT, SAT & Site Commissioning Technical Documentation & Report Preparation Project Engineering & Coordination Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis Customer Training & Technical Demonstration Leadership, Communication & Stakeholder Management Knowledge of PSS®E, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, PSCAD, CYME, ASPEN OneLiner, Hitachi Energy/ABB Network Manager, or equivalent platforms is advantageous.ETAP requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.ETAP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business.Come and join ETAP to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.

title: ROV Supervisor
description:
****Job Description****
**Who we are**
Do you want to join our Geo-data revolution? Fugro’s global reach and unique know-how will put the world at your fingertips. Our love of exploration and technical expertise help us to provide our clients with invaluable insights. We source and make sense of the most relevant Geo-data for their needs, so they can design, build and operate their assets more safely, sustainably and efficiently. But we’re always looking for new talent to take the next step with us. For bright minds who enjoy meaningful work and want to push our pioneering spirit further. For individuals who can take the initiative, but work well within a team.
  
  
****Job Purpose****
Oversees remotely operated vehicle operations at the worksite, ensuring safety, efficiency and precision. Leads the offshore ROV team through planning, execution and close-out of subsea projects, drives proactive maintenance and system administration, resolves technical issues and builds collaborative relationships with the client, vessel and onshore teams to deliver seamless project execution. Is accountable for compliance with IMCA R 004 minimum shift manning and for initiating a management of change and task risk assessment whenever manning or method deviates from the approved standard Aligns daily with the party chief, project managers, survey and engineering teams and safety officers to integrate operational goals with project timelines and safety protocols.
  
  
Liaises closely with the vessel Master, particularly on DP vessels, recognising the Master's legal responsibility for overall vessel safety. Interfaces with the client representative onboard, promoting Fugro capability and flagging operational or commercial opportunities to the onshore project manager. Coordinates with technical support and procurement on spares, defects and system readiness.
  
  
****Job Description****
**Operational Oversight and Worksite Focal Point**

* Direct and supervise ROV operations to ensure adherence to project goals, work scope and safety protocols.
* Prepare for each dive with accurate knowledge of forecast weather, concurrent vessel/diving/technical operations and data acquisition requirements.
* Conduct crew pre-dive briefings covering HSE rules, risk assessment, methodology, ROV route, data protocols, contingency actions and task assignment.
* Notify the OIM, vessel Master, superintendent, party chief, diving supervisor, deck foreman and client representative before operations commence.
* Take effective control of emergency situations, managing personnel and equipment towards a satisfactory outcome.
* Provide clear, complete shift handovers and keep onshore management updated on ongoing and future developments.

**HSE Leadership**

* Organize and manage the safety of the ROV team through safety briefings, risk assessments, toolbox talks, drills, hazard and incident reporting and permit-to-work compliance.
* Drive Fugro's no-blame culture and reinforce Stop Work Authority for every crew member and third party involved.
* Verify that personnel supervised are competent for the work required and that equipment is adequate, safe, properly certified and maintained, with checks documented.
* Engage with Fugro's quarterly safety focus and ensure the crew understand the standards expected.
* Investigate and report near misses and incidents in line with the company management system.

**Team leading and mentoring**

* Manage, motivate and mentor the ROV team to optimize performance, delegating within competence while allowing development.
* Train and formally assess ROV Senior Pilot Technicians and Pilot Technicians, collecting and judging evidence fairly against agreed criteria.
* Recognize crew strengths and weaknesses, set development goals and submit accurate, detailed appraisals and end-of-trip reports.
* Maintain an open-door policy and manage conflict to mutually acceptable outcomes.
* Lead multinational crews effectively, adapting communication style across nationalities, languages, and client cultures.
* Monitor fatigue and working hours, applying the contractual shift cap and recording daily fatigue checks.

**Technical Expertise**

* Act as subject matter expert on assigned ROV technologies, providing technical guidance to internal teams and stakeholders.
* Apply in-depth knowledge of ROV mechanical, electrical and hydraulic systems to troubleshooting and maintenance direction.
* Ensure the planned maintenance system is executed on schedule, that deferrals are logged and reported, and that technical bulletins are implemented.
* Propose improvements to maintenance practice and support evaluation of emerging technologies.

**Quality assurance and compliance**

* Ensure regulatory compliance and adherence to the company integrated/business management system throughout all operations. Maintain quality standards through inspections and audits, identifying and closing out deficiencies.
* Ensure the minimum documentation set is prepared, maintained and returned daily and weekly progress reports, PMS records, dive logs with pre/post-dive checklists, communication logs, risk assessments and toolbox talks, incident reports, mob/demob reports, appraisals, requisitions and the ROV daily logbook.
* Use standardised Fugro forms only; raise gaps with QHSSE rather than creating new forms.

**Client Interface and Commercial Awareness**

* Promote Fugro capability and identify client needs that Fugro engineering expertise can meet.
* Develop a thorough understanding of the project and the duties and obligations of all parties involved.
* Advise the onshore project manager of financial or operational opportunities arising from client discussions.
* Manage the contractual recording of downtime, maintenance periods, waiting on weather and equipment or vessel failure.

**Material and Resource Management**

* Complete inventory checks to identify shortfalls and liaise with procurement.
* Raise material requisitions for approval by the ROV Project Manager / Technical Manager and follow up on status and delivery.
* Plan and manage mobilisation and demobilisation, including lifting plans, load test verification, permits and third-party coordination.

****Skills And Qualifications****

* Bachelor's in Electrical, electronic, mechanical, hydraulic, or mechatronics engineering
* 5+ years of experience with work-class ROV
* Experience in offshore
* Team-leading experience is a must
* Qualified to train and formally assess ROV Senior Pilot Technicians and Pilot Technicians

****What We Offer****
Fugro provides a positive work environment as well as projects that will satisfy the most curious minds. We also offer great opportunities to stretch and develop yourself. By giving you the freedom to grow faster, we think you’ll be able to do what you do best, better. This should help us to find fresh ways to get to know the earth better. We encourage you to be yourself at Fugro. So bring your energy and enthusiasm, your keen eye and can-do attitude. But bring your questions and opinions too. Because to be the world’s leading Geo-data specialist, we need the strength in depth that comes from a diverse, driven team.
  
  
****Our View On Diversity, Equity And Inclusion****
At Fugro, our people are our superpower. Their variety of viewpoints, experiences, knowledge and talents give us collective strength. Distinctive beliefs and diverse backgrounds are therefore welcome, but discrimination, harassment, inappropriate behavior and unfair treatment are not. Everybody is to be well-supported and treated fairly. And everyone must be valued and have their voice heard. Crucially, we believe that getting this right brings a sense of belonging, of safety and acceptance, that makes us feel more connected to Fugro’s purpose ‘together create a safe and livable world’ – and to each other.
  
  
****HSE Responsibilities****
Responsible for ensuring safety of self and others at site. Prevent damage of equipment and assets Responsible for following all safety signs/procedures/ safe working practices Responsible for using appropriate PPE’s Responsible for participating in mock drills. Entitled to refuse any to undertake any activity considered unsafe. Responsible for filling up of hazard observation card, wherever hazard has been noticed at site. Responsible for safe housekeeping of his work place. To stop any operation that is deemed unsafe To be able to operate fire extinguisher in case of fire To report an incident as soon as possible to immediate supervisor and HSE manager To complete HSE trainings as instructed to do so.
  
  
****Disclaimer For Recruitment Agencies****
**Fugro does not accept any unsolicited applications from recruitment agencies. Acquisition to Fugro Recruitment or any Fugro employee is not appreciated**
**.**

title: Assistant Plant Manager
description:
**Company Description:**
Bhavi Plast Pvt Ltd is a long-established manufacturer of corrosion-resistant equipment for process plants across India and abroad. The company designs, builds, and commissions wet scrubbing systems, dust collection systems, high-efficiency blowers, and emission control ducting under a single accountable contract. It also provides FRP and dual-laminate chemical storage tanks, reactors, pressure vessels, and process tanks engineered to international standards and tested in-house at its plant in Mankoli, Bhiwandi. Registered and vetted by major engineering consultants, Bhavi Plast’s equipment operates in plants across India and in more than ten countries. The team frequently customizes solutions based on client process data, offering sized proposals and performance curves for specialized duties.

**Role Description:**
We are looking for an Assistant Manager – Plant Operations to run the Mankoli plant day to day and take ownership of what leaves it. You will be accountable for production, quality, maintenance, inventory, dispatch, safety and manpower: delivering every order on time, to specification and within cost. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who is comfortable on the shop floor, reads drawings with confidence, and can hold a team to a standard without needing

constant direction from management.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Plan and execute daily and weekly production schedules, allocating manpower, machines and materials across multiple concurrent jobs

- Track progress against delivery commitments, flag delays early and recover schedules proactively

- Supervise fabrication and assembly as per approved drawings, specifications and codes

- Ensure in-process and final inspection at every stage, and coordinate customer and third-party inspections

- Lead and train supervisors, fabricators, fitters, welders and contract workers, with clear accountability and discipline

- Ensure preventive maintenance of machinery, and monitor machine utilisation and OEE to reduce downtime

- Oversee inventory, stores, packing and dispatch, with accurate records and correct documentation

- Enforce safety protocols, PPE use, 5S and housekeeping, and ensure compliance with ISO and statutory requirements

- Control plant costs (material usage, scrap, overtime, idle time) and identify and plug leakages

- Drive lean manufacturing and process improvements to raise productivity and cut lead times

- Coordinate with Design, Planning, Purchase, Sales, Projects and Accounts, and support installation and commissioning teams with materials and site queries

- Track and report key metrics (OEE, on-time delivery, rework and rejection rates, productivity) and prepare production MIS for management

**Qualifications:**

**Must-have**

* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical or Production Engineering
* 5-7 years of experience in engineering or manufacturing, with at least 2-3 years in a similar Assistant Manager / Plant Operations / Production Head role
* Strong knowledge of fabrication and assembly processes, and the ability to read and interpret engineering drawings
* Working familiarity with ERP systems and with ISO and health & safety standards
* Proven experience leading and managing shop-floor teams

**Preferred**

* Experience in fabrication of process equipment, such as tanks, vessels, ducting, scrubbers or similar custom-engineered products
* Exposure to project-based or make-to-order manufacturing, where every order differs
* Experience with lean tools, 5S and structured problem-solving
* Experience coordinating customer inspections and client site support

**Attributes we care about most:**

- High ownership: treats the plant's output, quality and safety as their personal responsibility

- Ability to work independently: doesn't need constant direction, and can be handed a problem and trusted to solve it end to end

- Strong leadership and discipline: earns respect on the shop floor and sets and holds a standard

- Decisive under pressure: takes timely decisions and facilitates productivity to comply with deadlines or priorities clash

- Proactive, not reactive: spots delays, quality risks and cost leaks before they become problems

- Clear communicator: able to coordinate with Design, Purchase, Sales and management, and explain plant constraints plainly

- Integrity and trustworthiness: handles materials, costs and people matters honestly in a closely run, family-owned business

- Hands-on and process-minded: comfortable on the floor and equally comfortable with plans, data and MIS.

**What We Oﬀer:**

-The opportunity to lead a growing plant making critical, custom-engineered equipment

-Direct visibility to the management and real authority over plant decisions

-Varied, technically meaningful work across industries, with a team that has built this business since 1977

-A stable, collaborative work culture, and scope to introduce better systems and practices

-The chance to contribute to cleaner air and safer industrial operations

**Work Schedule:**

Day shift: 9:15 AM to 6:30 PM

Monday to Saturday

Occasional extended hours during project deadlines

title: Co-Founder
description:
About BookVidya

BookVidya is an early-stage learning venture built around one core belief: knowledge matters most when people can apply it.

We aim to help learners move beyond passive reading and book summaries towards understanding ideas, practising decisions, and applying what they learn in real-life situations.

Our vision is to make learning more practical, engaging, and useful beyond the page.

About the role

We are looking for a genuine
**Co-Founder – Growth & Distribution**
to help shape BookVidya's growth strategy, distribution systems, and go-to-market approach.

This is a founding partnership opportunity, not a conventional marketing position. You will work closely with the founding team to determine how BookVidya reaches its initial audience, earns trust, builds a learner community, and grows sustainably.

You will have meaningful input into strategic decisions and responsibility for turning growth ideas into experiments and repeatable systems.

Key responsibilities

* Develop BookVidya's growth and distribution strategy.
* Identify target audiences, user needs, and early-adopter communities.
* Design and execute organic acquisition strategies across relevant digital channels.
* Build a content distribution strategy that communicates BookVidya's value clearly.
* Explore partnerships, community-led growth, referrals, and other acquisition opportunities.
* Design experiments to acquire and retain engaged learners.
* Track relevant metrics, analyse results, and improve growth initiatives.
* Contribute to product positioning, go-to-market planning, and broader strategic decisions.
* Help establish sustainable processes for long-term growth.

What we're looking for

* Strong strategic thinking and a problem-solving mindset.
* Genuine interest in marketing, distribution, growth, or business strategy.
* Ability to move from ideas to execution and learn from experiments.
* Curiosity about user behaviour, learning, and community building.
* Initiative, ownership, consistency, and comfort with early-stage uncertainty.
* Willingness to collaborate, challenge assumptions constructively, and make decisions together.
* A genuine interest in building a venture over the long term.

Previous startup or growth experience is valuable, but we are open to candidates who can demonstrate strong thinking, initiative, and execution through projects or practical ideas.

A large personal following is not a requirement.

What this opportunity offers

* A genuine opportunity to help build BookVidya from an early stage.
* Shared strategic responsibility for growth and distribution.
* The opportunity to shape the venture's direction alongside the founding team.
* A founding partnership with equity and responsibilities to be discussed transparently and agreed upon.

**Important:**
This is an early-stage co-founder opportunity, not a guaranteed salaried position. Compensation, equity, time commitment, and other founding arrangements will be discussed with suitable candidates before any commitment is made.

How to express interest

Please share a brief introduction, relevant experience or projects, why BookVidya interests you, and how you would approach acquiring our first 100 genuinely engaged learners.

We are looking for a thoughtful partner who wants to build, experiment, and grow with us over the long term.

title: Technology Analyst
description:
About the Role Technology Analyst (IMP NOTE - This is not a Business Analyst or Data Analyst Role)  Introduction

Oxford University Press is seeking an Analyst, DPM to support the development, enhancement, and delivery of innovative digital products that help advance learning and educational outcomes. This is an excellent opportunity for a technology-focused professional who is passionate about digital product development and enjoys working in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.

As part of the Digital Product Management team, you will play an important role in supporting the development, customization, release, and maintenance of digital products. You will work closely with colleagues across Editorial, Marketing, Customer Services, and external technology partners, helping to deliver high-quality digital solutions that support OUP's mission of advancing knowledge and learning.

The role offers exposure to product management, agile delivery, digital content management, quality assurance, customer-focused product enhancements, and educational technology. It is ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems, building innovative solutions, and contributing to the ongoing growth of digital learning products.

  Opportunity

As Analyst, DPM, you will support the delivery of digital products throughout their lifecycle, ensuring high-quality user experiences and timely product releases.

Key responsibilities include:

* Supporting the development of new products, product features, and innovative ideas, including building quick MVPs to help stakeholders visualize product concepts.
* Developing feature backlogs and user stories, agreeing priorities with stakeholders, and supporting agile delivery of product enhancements within agreed timelines.
* Managing the sourcing, ingestion, and delivery of learning content for digital products.
* Enhancing digital content by enabling engaging digital interactions and learning experiences.
* Liaising with internal and external stakeholders to ensure quality, accuracy, and timely delivery of product releases.
* Supporting product development processes and ensuring adherence to quality standards.
* Coordinating Quality Assurance (QA) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities to ensure products meet performance and security requirements.
* Supporting the timely delivery of school updates, patches, installers, and software releases, including planning, testing, release note validation, and communication activities.
* Delivering product training sessions for Customer Services, Marketing, and other internal teams as required.
* Ensuring User Manuals, FAQs, Help Videos, and related support materials are maintained, updated, and of a high standard.
* Ensuring compliance requirements, NDA obligations, and third-party processes are followed in accordance with group guidelines.
* Coordinating effectively with Editorial, Marketing, Customer Support, Finance teams, and third-party vendor partners.

  Impact

This role is critical in ensuring OUP's digital products are delivered efficiently, maintained to high standards, and continually improved to meet customer needs. By supporting product development, content delivery, quality assurance, and stakeholder collaboration, you will help drive successful product launches, improved customer experiences, and operational excellence across OUP's digital portfolio.

  About You Essential Criteria

* B.Tech or MCA in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3-4 years of IT experience.
* At least 1 year of experience in product development, product management, or project delivery roles.
* Experience in digital product creation, development, implementation, and execution.
* Experience working within the EdTech, K-12, or Publishing domain.
* Experience supporting cloud-enabled and web-enabled solutions, including web and app-based products.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Proven ability to coordinate with third-party suppliers and delivery partners.
* Self-motivated, creative, dedicated, and able to work independently.
* High level of integrity and ownership.

Desirable Criteria

* Experience working within agile product development environments.
* Exposure to QA, UAT, release management, and product lifecycle management.
* Experience managing customer-facing digital products and implementations.
* Understanding of digital content workflows and learning technologies.
* Experience developing product documentation, training materials, and support resources.
* Knowledge of educational publishing and digital learning solutions.

with any queries relating to this role. To ensure a smooth application process, please submit your CV through this link than via email.

title: Senior eCommerce Growth Associate
description:
**Company:** Transverse Solutions

**Location:** Noida

**Work Mode:** Full-time | On-site / Hybrid

**Experience:** 2-4 years

**Compensation:** ₹25,000–₹40,000 per month + performance incentives

**About Transverse Solutions**

Transverse Solutions is an eCommerce consultancy helping brands build, launch and grow their businesses online.

We work with D2C brands across Shopify, Amazon, Flipkart and other digital commerce platforms - bringing together eCommerce strategy, technology, performance marketing and conversion optimisation.

We are looking for a hands-on Performance Marketing & Marketplace Manager who can take ownership of the digital growth of our clients and, most importantly, help turn marketing activity into measurable sales.

**The Role**

This is not a social media management role.

And it is not a role where success is measured by how many campaigns were launched or how many reports were prepared. You will be responsible for growing sales for assigned eCommerce brands across: Shopify + Meta Ads + Google Ads + Amazon + Flipkart + Other Marketplaces.

You will independently plan, execute, monitor and optimise campaigns and marketplace operations for your assigned clients.

You will typically own 4 major client accounts at a time, with the possibility of supporting a few additional accounts on smaller requirements.

Your core question every day should be: *“What can we do today to sell more profitably than yesterday?”*

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Performance Marketing - Meta Ads

* Independently plan and execute Meta advertising campaigns for D2C brands.
* Develop acquisition, retargeting and remarketing strategies.
* Manage campaign structures, audiences, budgets and bidding strategies.
* Analyse campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Test different audiences, creatives, offers and campaign approaches.
* Scale campaigns that demonstrate sustainable performance.
* Identify and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns.
* Monitor key metrics including ROAS, CAC, CTR, CPC, CPM, CVR and revenue.
* Manage and optimise campaigns based on agreed client objectives.

2. Google Ads

* Plan, launch and manage Google Ads campaigns.
* Work across Search, Shopping and Performance Max as relevant.
* Manage keyword strategy, search terms, budgets and bidding.
* Monitor product/feed-related issues in coordination with the relevant team.
* Optimise campaigns based on conversion and revenue data.
* Identify opportunities for profitable scaling.
* Track and analyse Google Ads performance alongside Shopify sales data.

3. Shopify eCommerce Growth

While you will not be responsible for Shopify development, you will be responsible for understanding the sales funnel and identifying where marketing performance is being affected. You should be comfortable analysing: Ad → Landing Page → Product Page → Add to Cart → Checkout → Purchase

You will:

* Monitor Shopify sales and conversion metrics.
* Identify funnel drop-offs.
* Analyse product-level performance.
* Identify products that should be promoted or deprioritised.
* Recommend improvements to offers, promotions and campaigns.
* Work closely with our eCommerce/Shopify team when website or CRO issues are identified.
* Connect advertising performance with actual business revenue.

4. Amazon & Flipkart Management

Take end-to-end ownership of assigned marketplace accounts. Responsibilities include:

Marketplace account management.

Product catalogue management.

Listing optimisation.

Keyword optimisation.

Search visibility improvement.

Sponsored Ads / marketplace advertising.

Product-level sales analysis.

Campaign optimisation.

Promotions and deal planning.

Pricing and offer recommendations.

Identifying high-potential SKUs.

Identifying underperforming products.

Monitoring account health and operational issues.

Monitoring inventory-related issues and coordinating with clients.

Regularly analysing marketplace reports and identifying growth opportunities.

**Data, Analytics & Reporting**

You should be comfortable working with numbers.

You will be expected to:

\* Monitor daily/weekly/monthly performance.

\* Analyse advertising and sales data.

\* Track ROAS, CAC, conversion rate and revenue.

\* Identify trends and anomalies.

\* Prepare concise performance reports.

\* Translate data into actionable recommendations.

\* Explain why performance changed, not simply report what changed.

We don’t want dashboards full of numbers.

We want someone who can look at the numbers and say:

*“Here’s the problem. Here’s why it’s happening. Here’s what I’m going to do about it.”*

**Working With Our Internal Team**

You will work closely with:

Head – Digital Marketing

For digital strategy, SEO, marketplace expertise and overall marketing direction.

eCommerce / Shopify Team

For website, CRO, tracking and technical requirements.

Creative & Content Team

For ad creatives, content and campaign briefs.

Founder / Leadership

For client strategy, commercial priorities and growth planning.

You will be responsible for translating strategy into execution and measurable performance.

**What We’re Looking For**

*Must Have*

\* 2-4 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing/eCommerce.

\* Proven experience managing client brands, preferably D2C/eCommerce.

\* Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads.

\* Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads.

\* Experience managing Amazon and/or Flipkart accounts.

\* Good understanding of Shopify and the D2C sales funnel.

\* Strong understanding of ROAS, CAC, CTR, CPC, CPM, CVR and other performance metrics.

\* Ability to independently launch and optimise campaigns.

\* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.

\* Comfortable taking ownership of client performance.

\* Ability to work with multiple stakeholders and manage deadlines.

*Strong Advantage*

\* Experience scaling D2C brands.

\* Experience managing meaningful monthly ad budgets.

\* Experience with Amazon Sponsored Ads.

\* Experience with Flipkart Ads.

\* Experience with Google Shopping / Performance Max.

\* Experience with GA4, Google Merchant Center and Meta Pixel/CAPI.

\* Experience with quick-commerce platforms.

\* Experience working with fashion, beauty, food, toys, lifestyle or other consumer brands.

**The Person We’re Looking For**

*You could be a great fit if you:*

\* Think about sales, not just campaigns.

\* Enjoy looking at data and figuring out what’s wrong.

\* Don’t need to be told what to optimise.

\* Can independently manage an account from strategy to execution.

\* Are comfortable experimenting and testing.

\* Know that a campaign being “live” doesn’t mean it is successful.

\* Can explain performance in simple business terms.

\* Take ownership when numbers aren’t working.

\* Are curious about why customers buy - and why they don’t.

*You may NOT be the right fit if:*

\* Your primary experience is social media posting/community management.

\* You have only executed campaigns based on someone else’s instructions.

\* You primarily create reports without taking action on them.

\* You have never independently managed ad accounts.

\* You consider “campaign launched” to be the end of the job.

\* You are uncomfortable being accountable for measurable performance.

**How We Measure Success**

Your performance will ultimately be evaluated on the growth and efficiency of the accounts you manage. Key metrics may include:

* Revenue Growth
* ROAS / CAC
* Conversion Rate
* Paid Traffic Quality
* Marketplace Sales Growth
* Marketplace Advertising Efficiency
* Account Health

Execution Quality & Timeliness

The exact targets will vary by client depending on their category, product, pricing, margins, inventory, website and stage of growth.

**Compensation**

₹25,000-₹40,000 per month, depending on experience and demonstrated capability.

Additional performance incentives may be offered based on account-level performance and achievement of agreed targets.

**Why Join Transverse Solutions?**

You’ll get the opportunity to work on real eCommerce businesses, not just isolated advertising campaigns.

You’ll work across:

Shopify → Meta → Google → Amazon → Flipkart → Quick Commerce

and understand how all these channels come together to build an actual eCommerce business.

If you’re someone who gets excited when a client’s numbers move from:

₹5L → ₹8L → ₹12L

rather than simply getting excited about a campaign going live… we’d like to meet you.

**Apply**

Please share your CV along with a brief note highlighting:

1. The eCommerce/D2C brands you’ve worked with.

2. The platforms you’ve managed.

3. Approximate monthly ad budgets you’ve independently handled.

4. One brand/account where you were directly involved in improving sales.

5. Your current/expected compensation.

Only candidates with genuine hands-on performance marketing experience will be considered.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: Media buyer - Google ads
description:
About vCommission Media

vCommission Media is a Leading Global Affiliate Marketing Network, delivering performance on web and mobile to worldwide advertisers through a growing network of over 100K+ affiliates. With presence in India, Singapore, UAE, UK, and USA, vCommission empowers meaningful digital growth across multiple verticals — Ecommerce, Travel, Utility, LeadGen IN, LeadGen & PPC US, and India COD Ecom.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Google Ads – E-commerce professional with 1–3 years of experience in managing and optimizing Google Ads campaigns for e-commerce businesses.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Google Search Ads, CPS campaigns, campaign optimization, keyword management, performance tracking, and conversion-focused advertising.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns for the E-commerce vertical.
* Plan, execute, monitor, and optimize Google Search Ads campaigns.
* Work extensively on CPS (Cost Per Sale) campaigns with a strong focus on conversions and revenue.
* Conduct keyword research, search-term analysis, negative keyword management, and keyword optimization.
* Monitor bids, budgets, CPC, CTR, conversion rate, CPS/CPA, revenue, and overall campaign performance.
* Analyse campaign data to identify opportunities for improving conversions and campaign efficiency.

* Ensure campaigns are launched and maintained accurately within defined operational timelines.
* Stay updated on Google Ads Search features, bidding strategies, e-commerce advertising trends, and performance marketing best practices.

Requirements

* Proven experience in media buying, specifically within the e-commerce sector.
* ​Strong understanding of various digital platforms, including Google Ads, Meta, and programmatic channels.
* Expertise in budget allocation, campaign optimization, and performance analysis.
* Ability to work with cross-functional teams and adapt to a fast-paced environment.
* Business Model: Drop shipping (Ecommerce) Industry: Ecommerce

Benefits **Performance-based incentives.​**

* Hands-on exposure to Google Ads and E-commerce performance marketing.
* Opportunity to work on CPS and Search Ads campaigns.
* Exposure to the global affiliate marketing ecosystem.
* Learning and growth opportunities within performance marketing.
* Cross-functional exposure across advertiser, affiliate, operations, and technology teams.

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

title: Google & Meta Ads Expert
description:
Job Description: Google & Meta Ads Expert

**Company:** NoctiX  
**Location:** Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh  
**Department:** Digital Marketing  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About NoctiX

NoctiX is an Indian light-wellness and biohacking brand focused on innovative products designed to support sleep, visual comfort, skincare, and overall wellness. We are looking for a performance-driven Google & Meta Ads Expert to manage, optimize, and scale our digital advertising campaigns while driving profitable growth for our e-commerce business.

Key Responsibilities

* **Meta Ads Management:** Plan, execute, and optimize advertising campaigns across Facebook and Instagram to generate sales, leads, and brand awareness.
* **Google Ads Management:** Manage Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Display, and YouTube advertising campaigns.
* **Performance Marketing:** Develop strategies to increase ROAS, reduce customer acquisition cost (CAC), and improve overall advertising profitability.
* **Campaign Optimization:** Monitor daily campaign performance, analyze key metrics, and make data-driven decisions to improve results.
* **Creative Strategy:** Collaborate with the creative team to develop high-converting ad creatives, videos, copy, and landing page concepts.
* **Audience Targeting:** Build and optimize prospecting, retargeting, lookalike, and remarketing audiences.
* **Analytics & Tracking:** Work with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and Conversions API to track campaign performance accurately.
* **E-commerce Growth:** Develop strategies to improve Shopify store conversions, average order value, and customer retention.
* **Reporting:** Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports covering spend, revenue, ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPC, and conversion rates.
* **Competitor Research:** Analyze competitors, market trends, and new advertising opportunities to identify scalable growth strategies.

Requirements

* 2+ years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads.
* Proven experience in performance marketing, preferably for D2C or e-commerce brands.
* Strong understanding of campaign structures, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and conversion tracking.
* Experience with Shopify, Google Analytics 4, Meta Business Manager, and advertising dashboards.
* Ability to analyze data, identify performance gaps, and implement effective optimization strategies.
* Strong understanding of creative testing, funnel optimization, and customer acquisition.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) and overall campaign profitability.
* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and Cost Per Purchase (CPP).
* Revenue generated through paid advertising.
* Conversion rate and advertising efficiency.
* Creative testing velocity and campaign scaling performance.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work with a growing Indian light-wellness and biohacking brand.
* Ownership of performance marketing strategy and campaign execution.
* A dynamic, growth-oriented work environment.
* Opportunity to experiment, test new strategies, and scale campaigns across domestic and international markets.

**How to Apply:** Share your updated resume along with your portfolio or campaign performance case studies demonstrating your experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹37,000.00 per month

title: Microsoft-Pure AI-Senior Manager
description:

* Experience with Power Platform.

* Experience working across multiple industries or complex business environments

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

description:

* Bachelor's degree in Fashion Design, Textile Design, Fashion Communication, Marketing, or a related field.

* Proficiency in Canva, Photoshop/Illustrator, and AI design tools.

* Creative mindset with strong branding and storytelling abilities.
* Passion for sustainable fashion and artisan-led businesses.

* Leave encashment

title: Internal Transformation Services - Assistant Director
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY ES – Internal Transformation Services**
**Assistant Director**
ITS (Internal Transformation Services) under EY’s Enablement Service, is a team of seasoned consulting professionals that operate globally on internal transformation programs which are critical to EY’s strategy and ambition. Our expertise is in the areas of Project Management, Strategy, Technology, Process Improvement, Organization Design, and Organizational Change Management.
  
  
**Job Description:**
We are seeking a highly experienced and knowledgeable Business Consultant to join our dynamic team. ITS professionals should be able to operate globally on internal programs that are critical to EY’s strategy and ambition. As a Business Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in providing strategic guidance and expert advice to our Executive Leadership in the areas of project management, change management, and design thinking. Your extensive experience in these fields will be invaluable as you collaborate with cross-functional teams, lead transformative projects, and drive organizational growth and innovation. The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of project management methodologies, change management principles, and design thinking frameworks, along with exceptional leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with Executive Leadership to understand their business objectives, challenges, and opportunities. Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence and guide teams toward successful outcomes
* Manage & engage senior stakeholder relationships at CxO, Partner, Functional Head levels
* Perform rapid assessment of landscape for stakeholders and provide insights to accelerate action towards refining their current state
* Bring diverse and thought-provoking perspective to transformations, including market trends, new and innovative ideas to drive data driven decision making
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a strategic mindset and attention to detail
* Drive and build upon a culture of continuous improvement by developing innovative idea
* Conduct comprehensive analyses of organization’s processes and systems
* Provide strategic recommendations and action plans to drive business performance and transformation
* Develop roadmaps for implementing project management, Organizational change management, and design thinking initiatives.
* Lead and manage complex projects from initiation to closure, ensuring timely delivery and quality outcomes
* Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and success criteria in collaboration with clients and stakeholders
* Monitor project progress, identify risks and issues, and implement mitigation strategies
* Foster effective communication and collaboration among project teams and stakeholders
* Develop and implement change management strategies to support organizational transformation initiatives
* Conducting Change Impact Analysis and Change Readiness / Gap Assessment and give recommendations that are actionable on immediate and long-term basis
* Build strong change network, drive change adoption, manage stakeholders with people centric approach, if needed work towards mindset shift and achieve cultural transformation
* Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of change management efforts and make adjustments as necessary
* Apply design thinking principles and methodologies to identify innovative solutions to complex business problems
* Conduct user research, gather insights, and define user personas and journeys.
* Advocate for design thinking principles and foster a culture of creativity and experimentation within client organizations
* Contribute to the development and enhancement of consulting methodologies and frameworks
* Mentor and coach junior consultants, providing guidance and support in their professional growth

**What will make you eligible for this role?**

* Master’s degree in business administration, management, or a related field
* 10+ Years of experience with at least 7+ years of management / business consulting experience
* Advance MS Suite skills – particularly, to develop engaging presentations and dashboards
* Professional certifications such as PMP (Project Management Professional), certification in Change Management or Design Thinking are highly desirable.
* Deep understanding of project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall) and their practical application in different contexts.
* Extensive knowledge of change management principles, models, and methodologies, with hands-on experience leading change initiatives.
* Proficiency in design thinking frameworks and tools, with the ability to apply them effectively to solve complex business problems.
* Awareness and experience of leveraging technology as enablers
* Exceptional communication, presentation skills with the ability to tailor messages to diverse audiences

**Good to have**

* Experience working in the Big 4 professional services firms and other global management consultancies is highly desirable
* MBA or equivalent advanced education is preferable
* Certification in Project Management, Organisational Change Management, Design Thinking, Facilitation will be an advantage

**What working at EY offers?**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you
* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Performance Marketing Executive
description:
We are looking for a results-driven **Performance Marketing & E-commerce Manager** to lead our digital growth initiatives. This role requires someone who can combine analytical thinking with creative marketing strategies to drive sales, optimize customer acquisition, and enhance the overall online shopping experience.

Key Responsibilities

* Plan, execute, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other digital platforms.
* Manage campaign budgets, bidding strategies, and ROI to achieve business objectives.
* Monitor and improve key performance metrics such as ROAS, CPA, CTR, conversion rate, and customer acquisition cost.
* Develop and execute brand marketing strategies to increase brand awareness and customer engagement.
* Ensure consistent brand identity across all marketing channels and customer touchpoints.
* Manage and optimize the company's e-commerce website for user experience, conversions, and sales growth.
* Coordinate with the design, content, SEO, and development teams to execute digital campaigns.
* Analyze website traffic, customer behavior, and sales data using Google Analytics and other reporting tools.
* Plan promotional campaigns, seasonal offers, and product launches.
* Improve conversion rates through landing page optimization and A/B testing.
* Track competitor activities and market trends to identify growth opportunities.

Required Skills

* Strong experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Performance Marketing.
* Hands-on experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, and Google Merchant Center.

* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and marketing attribution.
* Understanding of SEO, email marketing, and marketing automation.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills.
* Excellent communication and project management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously and meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Digital Marketing, or a related field.
* Google Ads, Meta Blueprint, or other digital marketing certifications are an added advantage.
* Experience in D2C, retail, fashion, lifestyle, or e-commerce brands is preferred.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary based on experience.
* Opportunity to work with a growing digital-first brand.
* Professional development and learning opportunities.
* Collaborative and innovative work environment.

title: DPDP Data Privacy Lead
description:
We are expanding our DPDP delivery team for upcoming implementation engagements and are looking for Two Data Privacy Leads. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will personally carry out discovery, mapping, RoPA and DPIA work, and you will lead the engagement end to end – from scoping through to hardening, consent and incident-readiness deliverables.

**Engagement Snapshot:**

**Role -**
**Data Privacy Lead (DPDP)**

**Engagement type - Contract**

6-month rolling; extension subject to project waves and performance

**Experience**

8–12 years overall, with at least 4 years in data privacy / data protection

**Location**

One position is based in Chennai and the Second position is based in Bengauru. Local candidates preferred.

Mostly On-site with some hybrid

**Reporting to**

Engagement Lead / Project Partner, PTS Consulting LLP

**Start**

November 1st Week; start date to be confirmed with shortlisted candidates

**Key Responsibilities:**

The Data Privacy Lead will be expected to perform the following personally and to a consulting-deliverable standard.

•    
**Process map review.**
Review business process maps and SIPOC documentation, identify where personal data is collected, used, shared, stored and disposed of, and validate findings with process owners.

•    
**Data discovery and classification.**
Independently plan and run data discovery across applications, databases, file shares and collaboration tools; classify personal data elements by category and sensitivity, using discovery tooling and manual techniques.

•    
**Data-to-process mapping and DPDP scope.**
Map discovered data to business processes and activities, and clearly articulate the scope of DPDP coverage for each activity – including applicability, legal basis, exemptions and the roles of data fiduciary and data processor.

•    
**Record of Processing Activities (RoPA).**
Prepare and maintain a complete, defensible RoPA linked to processes, systems, data elements, purposes, retention and third-party sharing.

•    
**DPIA and hardening.**
Conduct Data Protection Impact Assessments, and oversee the resulting privacy hardening and security hardening work – tracking recommendations, owners and closure through to verified completion.

•    
**Consent management.**
Oversee consent management design and rollout – notices, purpose-wise consent, preference and withdrawal handling, and records of consent – working with legal, product and technology teams.

•    
**Incident response and breach notification.**
Manage the personal data breach response lifecycle: triage, containment, assessment, notification to the Data Protection Board and affected Data Principals as required, and post-incident corrective action.

•    
**Engagement leadership.**
Lead the engagement team, own the work plan and quality of deliverables, and manage client stakeholders up to senior leadership.

**What we are looking for:**

**Essential:**

•    8–12 years of overall experience, including 4 or more years of hands-on data privacy or data protection delivery (DPDP Act).

•    Demonstrated, in-depth experience in every one of the responsibilities listed above – not a subset. You should be able to describe what you personally did on each.

•    Experience of independently running data discovery and classification and translating the output into process-level scope and a RoPA.

•    Experience of conducting DPIAs and taking the outcomes through to implemented privacy and security controls.

•    Practical experience of consent management and of handling a personal data breach including regulator and individual notification.

•    Proven record of leading a privacy engagement successfully with client leadership, a delivery team and defined deadlines.

•    Clear, structured written and verbal communication; strong, well-organised documentation.

**Preferred / nice to Have:**

•    Certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, DCPP (DSCI), ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor or Implementer, ISO/IEC 27701, CISA or CISSP.

•    Familiarity with data discovery, consent management or privacy management platforms.

•    Exposure to multi-entity corporate groups and to manufacturing, healthcare, financial services, technology or consumer-facing businesses.

•    Working knowledge of information security controls (access control, encryption, logging, retention and disposal).

**A note on Fit**

This is a delivery role. We are looking for practitioners who have done the work themselves. Candidates whose experience is primarily in policy drafting, awareness training or advisory review without hands-on discovery, mapping and assessment work may find the role is not the right fit.

**How to express Interest:**

Please send your CV and a short note (half a page) describing one privacy engagement in which you personally carried out data discovery, RoPA preparation and a DPIA, and what your role was in leading it.

**Apply to:**
[insert application email / LinkedIn application link]

*Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.*

description:
**Job Description – Solar Liaisoning Officer – Rooftop & Ground-Mounted Solar Projects**

**Company:**
Roofsol Energy Pvt. Ltd.

**Job Location:**
Tamil Nadu

**Department:**
Liaisoning / Project Coordination

**Experience:**
4–5 Years

**Reporting To:**
National Liaisoning Head

**Language Requirement:**
Fluency in Tamil and English; working knowledge of Hindi will be an advantage.

**About the Company**

Roofsol Energy Pvt. Ltd. operates in the solar energy sector, with business activities across solar EPC and renewable energy projects. The company is focused on delivering solar solutions for commercial, industrial, rooftop, and ground-mounted project requirements.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced and proactive
**Solar Liaisoning Officer**
to manage liaisoning activities, statutory approvals, documentation, and coordination with government departments, electricity distribution companies (DISCOMs), and other relevant authorities across Tamil Nadu. The candidate will support both rooftop and ground-mounted solar projects and ensure timely completion of approvals, inspections, grid connectivity, and commissioning-related formalities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Government & DISCOM Liaisoning**

·      Coordinate with TANGEDCO/TNPDCL and other relevant electricity authorities, as applicable, for solar project approvals and clearances.

·      Liaise with DISCOM officials, electrical inspectors, local authorities, and other statutory bodies for project-related permissions and documentation.

·      Follow up on applications, approvals, inspections, and pending cases to ensure timely resolution.

**2. Rooftop Solar Project Liaisoning**

·      Coordinate net-metering, grid connectivity, feasibility approvals, and other applicable permissions for rooftop solar projects.

·      Follow up on meter installation, testing, inspections, and commissioning-related approvals.

·      Coordinate with internal project teams and customers to resolve documentation gaps and approval delays.

**3. Ground-Mounted Solar Project Liaisoning**

·      Support land-related statutory coordination, electrical approvals, grid connectivity, and evacuation-related permissions, as applicable.

·      Coordinate with relevant authorities for connectivity, substation-related approvals, electrical inspections, and project commissioning.

·      Assist project teams with regulatory documentation and approval tracking.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

·      Graduate in any discipline; a diploma or degree in Electrical Engineering will be an advantage.

·      4–5 years of relevant experience in solar liaisoning, preferably involving both rooftop and ground-mounted solar projects.

·      Practical experience dealing with DISCOMs, electrical inspectors, government departments, and other statutory authorities in Tamil Nadu.

·      Knowledge of net-metering, grid connectivity, electrical inspections, solar project approvals, and commissioning procedures.

·      Strong understanding of documentation, regulatory follow-ups, and approval processes relevant to solar projects.

**Required Skills**

·      Fluency in Tamil is mandatory for effective coordination with local authorities.

·      Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.

·      Strong follow-up, coordination, and problem-solving abilities.

·      Ability to manage multiple project approvals and meet timelines.

·      Proficiency in MS Excel, email communication, and documentation management.

·      Willingness to travel within Tamil Nadu as required.

title: Vice President Controls
description:
Join Barclays as Vice President Controls where you'll play a pivotal role in managing and coordinating regulatory inputs to control reporting, briefings and relevant governance fora while acting as point of coordination and syndication of regulatory updates and engagements to ensure consistency. Your role will be responsible in supporting Assurance delivery for identified process areas and provide leadership throughout Design Effectiveness Assessments and Operational Effectiveness testing including identification and agreement of issues and associated remediation plans. You will have the opportunity to partner with 2nd Line of Defence (2LOD i.e., Compliance, Operational Risk) and 3rd Line of Defence (i.e., Barclays Internal Audit) colleagues to input on common areas of interest to provide an enriched controls advisory service.
  
  
**To Be Successful In This Role, You Should Have**

* Experience in Audit or control testing in Financial Services industry, preferably from assurance background.
* In-depth knowledge of risk and control with an ability to identify and document risks in complex processes.
* Understanding of the regulatory reporting landscape, specifically Prudential Regulatory Capital Reporting.
* Exceptional stakeholder management skills.
* Strategic thinking and ability to challenge status quo.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Formal accounting qualification like Chartered Accountant and certification like CIA (Certified Internal Audit) is preferred.
* Controllership experience.
* Extensive working knowledge of operational risk & control processes and practices, including experience in their application across functions.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in our Chennai office.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To partner with the bank, to provide independent insurance on control processes and advise on improvements to ensure the efficiency and effectiveness of the bank’s internal controls framework.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Collaboration across the bank to maintain a satisfactory, robust, and efficient control environment through the execution of ad-hoc assessments and testing on the design and operational effectiveness of the internal controls, aligned to control policies and standards.
* Development of detailed test plans and procedures to identify weaknesses in internal controls and other initiatives aligned to the bank’s control framework to mitigate any potential risks and issues, prioritised by its severity to disrupt bank operations, potential losses, and reputational impact.
* Communication of key findings and observations to the relevant stakeholders and business units to improve overall control efficiency and provide corrective actions to senior managers. Collaboration with other control professionals to resolve complex issues and ensure consistent testing methodologies across the bank.
* Development of a knowledge centre containing detailed documentation of control assessments, testing on design and operational effectiveness of procedures, findings, and the distribution of material on internal controls to train and upskill colleagues within the bank.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
