title: Senior Finance Consultant
description:
**Hiring: Senior Finance Consultant – Oracle NetSuite ERP Implementation & Finance Transformation**

📍
**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India

💼
**Employment Type:**
Contract

📅
**Duration:**
6–8 months, with a possibility of extension based on project requirements

💼
**Experience:**
10–15 years

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Finance Consultant to lead the finance and accounting workstream of an Oracle NetSuite ERP implementation and finance transformation project.

The candidate will work closely with Finance, IT, business stakeholders, and the implementation partner to streamline financial processes, ensure statutory compliance, strengthen financial controls, and support successful ERP implementation, integration, and go-live.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* **Finance Process Transformation:**
  Assess existing finance processes, document As-Is and To-Be workflows, identify gaps and manual activities, and drive process standardisation and automation.
* **Oracle NetSuite Implementation:**
  Gather business requirements, prepare functional specifications, validate system configurations, and support finance modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Banking, Taxation, and Financial Reporting.
* **Chart of Accounts & Master Data:**
  Lead Chart of Accounts standardisation, financial master-data rationalisation, and the definition of accounting structures, approval workflows, and governance controls.
* **Compliance & Financial Controls:**
  Ensure the finance solution supports applicable Indian statutory and taxation requirements, including GST, TDS/TCS, e-invoicing, and e-way bills. Review internal controls, approval matrices, segregation of duties, and audit requirements.
* **Business System Integration:**
  Define finance integration requirements between NetSuite and operational systems covering logistics, freight forwarding, CHA, 3PL, WMS, TMS, and related operations. Ensure accurate transaction mapping for job costing, billing, vendor invoices, accruals, collections, and profitability reporting.
* **Data Migration & Reconciliation:**
  Oversee financial data cleansing, mapping, migration, opening balance validation, and reconciliation of general ledger balances and outstanding receivables/payables.
* **Testing & Go-Live:**
  Coordinate UAT, validate financial transactions and reports, track defects, prepare finance SOPs and training materials, and support cutover, go-live, and post-implementation stabilisation.
* **Management Reporting:**
  Define reporting requirements for revenue, costs, profitability, working capital, cash flow, budgeting, and financial performance.
* **Stakeholder Coordination:**
  Work with the implementation partner, Finance, IT, business teams, auditors, and senior management to resolve issues, manage dependencies, and achieve implementation milestones.

**Must-Have Skills & Qualifications**

* 10–15 years of experience in finance and accounting, with relevant ERP implementation or transformation experience.
* Proven hands-on functional experience in
  **Oracle NetSuite implementation**
  , preferably as a Senior Functional Consultant or Finance Workstream Lead.
* CA, CMA, MBA in Finance, or a relevant postgraduate finance qualification with substantial ERP implementation experience.
* Strong knowledge of General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Fixed Assets, financial reporting, reconciliations, and month-end/year-end closing.
* Good understanding of Indian taxation, statutory compliance, and internal financial controls.
* Experience in Chart of Accounts design, financial master-data governance, data migration, UAT, and finance process documentation.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Industry Experience**

* Freight forwarding, logistics, CHA, third-party logistics (3PL), warehousing, and supply-chain management.
* Exposure to ICD, CFS, SEZ, FTWZ, and transportation operations.
* Experience in multi-branch, multi-entity, and multi-currency business environments.
* Understanding of operational job costing, revenue recognition, customer billing, vendor costs, accruals, collections, and profitability analysis.
* Exposure to finance transformation, audit readiness, consolidated reporting, or IPO-readiness initiatives would be an advantage.

035341 Senior Analyst, Global Lease Accounting & Administration (Open)
  
  
**Job Description**
The Senior Analyst, Global Lease Accounting & Administration is responsible for the day-to-day accounting, administration, controls and data integrity of Greif's global lease portfolio. The role serves as the primary day-to-day subject matter expert for the lease accounting platform and partners with Corporate Accounting, External Reporting, Shared Services and local Finance and Operations teams globally. The position will support the Lease Software and play a key role in evaluating and implementing the future lease platform, including data migration, testing, process redesign and integration with Infor LN.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer the global lease portfolio, including new leases, renewals, modifications, terminations, buyouts, payment changes, entity changes and other lease events.
* Review lease agreements and supporting documentation and accurately abstract key lease terms, payment schedules, options, commencement dates, asset information and accounting attributes.
* Apply ASC 842 requirements and support lease classification, modification accounting, lease-term assessments and other lease accounting analyses; escalate complex or judgmental matters as appropriate.
* Support SEC and local statutory GAAP reporting requirements
* Execute and document lease-related internal controls, including controls over completeness, accuracy, expiring/evergreen leases, system data and reconciliations.
* Act as main liaison for internal and external audit
* Proactively monitor upcoming expirations and outstanding submissions and work with business and Finance contacts to ensure lease activity is identified and recorded timely.
* Support monthly and quarterly close activities by validating lease-system output, investigating discrepancies and coordinating with the Budapest Shared Services team and Corporate Accounting.
* Reconcile and analyze lease-system information against relevant financial and operational data and drive identified differences to resolution.
* Maintain lease documentation, process procedures, control evidence and audit support; provide training and guidance to regional and local Finance teams on global lease processes.
* Serve as a key Finance SME for the lease-system RFP and implementation, including requirements definition, vendor evaluation, data cleansing and migration, user acceptance testing and implementation.
* Support the design, testing and ongoing monitoring of interfaces between the lease platform and ERP, including the future automation of lease balance-sheet and income-statement accounting.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate and strengthen the global lease process.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related discipline.
* 4-7 years of relevant experience in lease accounting, controllership, lease administration, shared services or a related accounting function.
* Strong working knowledge of ASC 842; knowledge of IFRS 16 is preferred.
* Experience with a lease accounting or administration platform such as LeaseAccelerator, Visual Lease, Nakisa, MRI ProLease, FinQuery, Yardi or similar.
* Experience with account reconciliations, financial close processes and internal controls.
* Experience working with ERP systems and financial-system interfaces; Infor LN experience is a plus but not required.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* CA, CMA, CPA-equivalent qualification or experience in a multinational public company, GCC/shared-services environment or Big Four organization is preferred.

**Knowledge And Skills**

* Ability to interpret lease contracts and translate commercial terms into lease-system and accounting requirements.
* Strong analytical, data-quality, reconciliation and problem-resolution skills with high attention to detail.
* Strong control discipline, including the ability to execute SOX controls and maintain complete audit evidence.
* Strong Excel skills and ability to work effectively with large datasets, system outputs and interface reconciliations.
* Experience with system implementations, data migration, UAT or finance-process transformation is preferred.
* Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, follow issues through resolution and escalate appropriately.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills across countries, functions and time zones.
* Experience with both equipment/fleet and real-estate leases is preferred.

**Other**

title: ESG Manager
description:
We are hiring for ESG Manager-

**Role:**
Manager – ESG

**Experience:**
5-7 years preferred

The Manager will lead the development and execution of the ESG and sustainability agenda across Redington Group and its subsidiaries. The role is accountable for translating strategic priorities into measurable program, strengthening governance and performance management, overseeing ESG reporting and ratings, advancing sustainable-finance opportunities, and embedding sustainability considerations into business decisions.

**Key Responsibilities**

Strategy, Governance & Business Integration

* Develop, maintain and operationalize the Group ESG strategy, multi-year roadmap, policies, governance mechanisms, targets and annual operating plan.
* Translate regulatory developments, stakeholder expectations and leading practices into practical priorities for Group functions, businesses and subsidiaries.
* Lead materiality, peer-benchmarking, ESG risk and opportunity assessments, and support integration of findings into enterprise risk, strategy and capital-allocation processes.

Reporting, Ratings, Standards & Assurance

* Own the annual ESG reporting and disclosure calendar, including BRSR, sustainability reporting and alignment with relevant frameworks such as GRI, IFRS S1/S2, CDP and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Lead ESG ratings, assessments and external submissions, including EcoVadis and CDP, and drive improvement plans based on feedback and performance gaps.

Climate, Sustainable Finance & Value Creation

* Lead evaluation and prioritisation of decarbonisation, renewable energy, energy efficiency, resource efficiency, circularity and other sustainability initiatives.
* Develop business cases that quantify investment, savings, payback, emissions impact, risk reduction and long-term value creation.
* Identify and progress green and sustainable-finance opportunities with banks, financial institutions and partners, including sustainability-linked structures where relevant.
* Monitor emerging climate, sustainability and finance regulations across relevant markets and assess implications for the Group.

Stakeholder Leadership & Programme Management

* Lead cross-functional ESG working groups and coordinate delivery across Finance, HR, Procurement, Operations, Supply Chain, Facilities, Legal, Secretarial, IT and Communications.
* Oversee sustainability communications, awards and recognition submissions in partnership with relevant functions, ensuring claims are evidence-based and consistent.
* Manage multiple projects, budgets, timelines, dependencies and risks; allocate work, coach team members and maintain high standards of delivery and documentation.

Digital Enablement & Continuous Improvement

* Strengthen ESG data and reporting systems, including effective use of sustainability platforms, dashboards and automated workflows.
* Use analytics and generative AI responsibly to improve research, data review, scenario analysis, reporting and executive decision support, with appropriate validation and confidentiality controls.
* Continuously improve ESG processes, controls and operating models to enhance efficiency, data quality, assurance readiness and stakeholder experience.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Sustainability, Environmental Management, Finance, Business, Economics, Engineering or a related discipline.
* 5-7 years of progressive experience in corporate sustainability, ESG consulting, reporting, sustainable finance, strategy or related roles, with demonstrated ownership of enterprise-level workstreams.
* Strong knowledge of ESG strategy, BRSR, GRI, IFRS S1/S2, climate and emissions management, ESG ratings, assurance and relevant ISO management systems.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional programmes, managing senior stakeholders and developing executive or board-level materials.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including business-case development, investment evaluation and value-creation analysis.
* Advanced project-management, analytical, writing, communication and people-management skills.
* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and ESG data or reporting platforms; experience with Power BI, workflow automation and responsible enterprise use of generative AI is preferred.

Relevant certifications such as GRI, climate risk, assurance, sustainable finance, ISO or project management are advantageous.

You will bridge the gap between customer delivery requirements, material availability, manufacturing capacity, and contract manufacturer readiness, ensuring project delivery while coordinating across partners and external partners.

* Ensure execution plans align with material availability and production capacity.
* Monitor project progress and escalate risks affecting delivery schedules.

**Material Planning & Supply Readiness**

**Production & Capacity Planning**

title: Construction Site Manager
description:
We are building two villa projects in Karjat - Trulife at Tadwadi and Goodlife at Kothimbe. We are looking for one person to run both sites: living at site, with real authority over execution, reporting directly to the founder.

**The work**

* Run day-to-day construction at both sites - manpower, material, sequence, quality, closure.
* Lead 10 to 15 engineers and supervisors, and 100 to 150+ workers across multiple contractors.
* Plan the week before it starts. Schedule, material indents, manpower, contractor commitments - fixed in advance, not decided on the morning.
* Send daily and weekly MIS to our head office in Vashi: progress against plan, manpower on site, material position, what is blocked.
* Hold quality. Check the work, and make it redone when it is not right.
* Meet customers who come to site. Villa buyers want to speak to someone senior and want a straight answer on their handover date. You will be that person.
* Keep contractors moving. Settle problems at site rather than escalating all of them.

**What we are looking for**

* 12 to 18 years on construction sites, with at least the last 5 running a project independently.
* Proven team size: 10+ engineers and supervisors, 100+ workers on site at peak.
* Experience at sites in Maharashtra.
* Diploma or degree in civil engineering.
* Fluent Hindi and Marathi. Able to hold a proper conversation with a customer in English.
* Someone who plans ahead rather than firefights, and who gets work finished on a date.

**What we provide**

* Stay and food at site.
* Rs 70,000 to Rs 1,20,000 per month, depending on what you have actually run.
* A direct line to the founder, and the authority to run the site your way.

**Being straight with you**

This is six days a week, long days, and you will live at site through the week, away from home. The sites are in Karjat, not in a city. If that does not suit you, this is not your job. If you have done it before and you enjoy running a site properly - planned, clean, on date - you will like it here.

**How to apply**

Apply here on LinkedIn. If we shortlist you, we will send you a short set of questions to answer in writing, then an online interview, then a visit to the site to meet us and walk the project.

title: Project Officer Group I in the Delegation’s Cooperation Section
description:
PRINT
  
  
Project Officer Group I in the Delegation’s Cooperation Section
  
  
16.06.2026 Expired
  
  
Teaser
  
  
**We are**
The European Union (EU) is an economic and political partnership between 27 European countries. It plays an
**important**
role in international affairs through diplomacy, trade, development aid and working with global organizations. Abroad, the EU is represented through more than 140 diplomatic representations, known also as EU Delegations, which have a similar function to those of an embassy.
  
  
The EU Delegation to India, New Delhi works in close coordination with the Embassies and Consulates of the 27 EU Member States. We are a fully-fledged diplomatic mission and represent the European Union in dealings with the Indian government in areas that are part of the EU’s remit.
  
  
**We offer**
The post of
**Project Officer**
Group I in the Delegation’s Cooperation Section, under a fixed-term employment contract of 2 years, with a possibility of renewal under reserve of budgetary availabilities and operational considerations. For internal candidates holding an indefinite-term contract, alternative contractual arrangements may apply in accordance with institutional policies. The team consists of 12 people and there are occasional atypical working hours.
  
  
Under this post, the recruited person will be attributed functions depending on the needs of the Delegation, and on the changes of these needs. The successful candidate
**will serve under the supervision and responsibility**
of the Head of Cooperation Section, providing support, expertise and assistance in coordinating, monitoring and reporting the implementation of projects funded under budget lines dedicated to Human Rights and Democracy (HR&D) as well Migration and Mobility and will provide support and back-up to the section as a whole on related matters. The jobholder will participate in ensuring coordination on cross cutting-matters concerning Human Rights -including Business and Human Rights-, Migration and the Sustainable Development Goals. The jobholder will also undertake similar responsibilities as above, for additional thematic areas, as assigned from time to time by Head of Cooperation. Currently these include: Disability, Youth, Employment, Labour & Decent work, Stability, Peace building & Conflict Prevention.
  
  
**Following Main Tasks And Duties Are Currently Required**
**Task 1: Policy development**

* To participate in conceptual reflections and assist in elaborating work programmes, strategic documents and new approaches to cooperation activities.
* To provide economic, statistical and analytical inputs for European Commission drafts, directives or communications concerning cooperation activities within related fields of expertise.

**Task 2: Project/programme-management**

* To assist in management of all phases of the project cycle, from preparation and launch of Call for Proposals Guidelines, to identification and selection of projects, to contracting, to monitoring and evaluation of project implementation.
* Under the authority of the HoC to represent the EU in meetings and events organised by projects and in other official meetings between the EU and programme partners, International Organisations etc.
* To undertake field visits and to monitor and report on progress, both operational and financial.
* To review and approve Annual Work Plans & Budgets, Progress reports, invoices, expenditure statements, requests for advance and reimbursement prior to submission to the Finance & Contracts Section.
* To maintain regular operational and financial-monitoring information on EU assisted projects and programmes through relevant contract management applications).
* To participate in tendering procedures and preparation of contracts, follow up of auditing requirements and other financial agreements with projects and programs.
* To initiate and ensure adherence to procedures of the European Commission in all matters of project implementation.
* To advise and assist the project implementing organisations, monitoring the performance of consultants, where relevant, and preparing terms of reference, contract addendas etc.
* To contribute to, develop and launch Terms of Reference as required, for the organisation of studies, policy briefs and events on thematic areas of competence.
* To follow up on Human Rights Defenders (HRDs) issues and provide support as HRD focal point.

**Task 3: Inter service Coordination and Information**

* To coordinate with EU Headquarters and, where required, with Indian authorities, and other relevant Departments/Organisations on program and policy aspects of EU-India cooperation, in thematic areas of competence identified above.
* To provide briefings and information on projects, within and outside the Delegation as appropriate.
* To liaise with EU Delegations in the region, where relevant matters to do with development cooperation in the fields of Human Rights and Democracy, Migration and Mobility, and SDGs.
* To contribute to the work of other sections, on matters related to human rights, migration, youth, labour and SDGs, particularly in the preparation of briefs for the Political section for human rights dialogue, HR country strategy paper, HRD support, visits etc.
* To contribute to preparation of terms of reference for launching studies, policy briefs.

**Task 4: Other tasks**

* To contribute to strategic communication within the section and the EU Delegation as a whole
* To ensure EU Visibility is appropriately done by partners
* To support to HQ or Head of Delegation visits/missions
* To represent the EU at relevant workshops/conferences/meetings

The starting salary step for this position is INR 231,790, however the final salary will be determined based on candidate's relevant and verifiable professional experience and is subject to approval by Headquarters. There is a competitive benefits package, subject to certain conditions, including personal leave days and public holidays, health insurances and a retirement savings plan.
  
  
The expected start date will be 01/10/2026.
  
  
**Minimum requirements / eligibility criteria (necessary for the application to be considered)**

* Minimum of Master’s level in International Law, Human Rights, Economic and Social Sciences, Political economy, Political science or equivalent;
* Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. The professional experience must be acquired after the date on which the qualification allowing access to the post was obtained. Work experience in India or Asia is an asset;
* Excellent knowledge (C2) of English. Knowledge of Indian languages is considered an asset.
* Digital literacy, good knowledge of Microsoft Office;
* Right to residence and work in India;
* Judicial Extract for good conduct;
* Pre-recruitment medical fitness certificate to carry out the tasks assigned.

**Assets/selection criteria (basis for awarding points to select the best applicant)**

* Asset relevant to Task 2 and 3: level of skills of time management, and interpersonal skills; capacity of organizing and coordinating meetings and agendas;
* Asset relevant to Tasks 2 and 3:, e.g] team work fluency, high flexibility, and capacity to work under pressure;
* Asset relevant to Task 2:, e.g] work history ) in the area of relations with external stakeholders, events and public relations;
* Asset relevant to Task 1: knowledge/experience of EU policies, of international relations and of India’s social policies, media environment and economy.

**How To Apply**
The applicant must apply by sending
  
  

* a cover letter, signed
* a Curriculum Vitæ (to include, at the minimum, exact job titles, employers’ names and detailed tasks descriptions) using one of the Europass templates available at:

https://europass.europa.eu/en
  
  
**All Documents To The Following Email Address**
eeasjobs-058@eeas.europa,eu
  
  
**And Mention In The Email’ Subject**
“Ref: 144191 –: Project Officer: Cooperation Section ”
  
  
**no later than 17:00 hrs. (IST) on 03/07/2026.**
**Caution:**
The applicant must verify that he/she fulfils all the conditions. For easy verification, the applicant must mark all the squares r relating to each document or application condition. The absence of one of these conditions or documents is a reason for the rejection of the application
  
  
**The process**
After the deadline for applications, the
**eligible**
applications will be admitted to the Selection by the Committee set up for this purpose.
  
  
Depending on the number of applications received, successive phases of Selection may include shortlisting of candidates-based assessment of the information provided in the cover letter, CV; practical testing and interviews. 5 best candidates will be invited to the final interview
  
  
Only candidates admitted to each successive selection phase will be contacted individually. The Delegation will not supply additional information or discuss the selection procedure. During the selection process, please do not contact the members of the Selection Committee, but address your questions and comments to the Delegation’s Administration.
  
  
[The successful candidate will be subject to a [medical check, background check, etc. whatever is relevant].
  
  
Candidates who wish to lodge a complaint regarding the recruitment process may submit a written communication to the functional mailbox to which they sent the initial application. Upon receipt, the Delegation will review the matter and, where appropriate, consult Headquarters before providing a response.
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
The European Union is committed to an equal opportunities policy for all its employees and applicants for employment. As an employer, the EU is committed to promoting gender equality, preventing discrimination on any grounds and ensuring a zero tolerance approach to any form of harassment. It actively welcomes applications from all qualified candidates from diverse backgrounds. We aim at a service which is truly representative of society, where each staff member feels respected, is able to give their best and can develop their full potential.
  
  
If pre-selected, candidates with disabilities are invited to contact the Delegation (functional mailbox to which the applications shall be sent) in order to accommodate any special needs and provide assistance to ensure equality of opportunities with other candidates.
  
  
If a candidate with a disability is selected and recruited, the EEAS is committed to appropriate measures in order to accommodate his or her special needs to the working place or working conditions in accordance with Art 4 of the Decision ADMIN(2025)13 of the Director-General for Resource Management of the European External Action Service on providing reasonable accommodation for local staff with disabilities working in Union Delegations.
  
  
**Data Protection Notice**
https://www.eeas.europa.eu/eeas/eeas-privacy-statement-data-protection-notice-purpose-processing-personal-data-related-recruitment\_en

title: Project Leader- ENR
description:
**ABOUT US:**

  

Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change-makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition, and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. Expert Client Delivery (ECD) is an integral unit of BCN. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutions across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence, and Bain intellectual property.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:**

This is an opportunity to be a part of Bain’s Energy and Natural Resources (ENR CoE) team, based out of Gurugram office, and specifically support BAIN ENR practice on live cases, client development and proposal support. The ENR CoE consists of 45+ team members, organized into ~10 teams, working across various sectors such as oil and gas, power and utilities, chemicals, mining, fertilizers and agri-business

As the ENR sector personnel, you will get exposed to case delivery and client development activities for our clients in Oil and gas, Power & Utilities, Renewables, Wastewater Recycling, etc. The primarily objective of the sector professionals is to collaborate with practice/ case teams on the development and deployment of industry specific analytical products and topic expertise to answer strategic questions of Bain’s ENR clients.

An Associate works as a team member/contributor on BCN cases, driving the analysis on complex cases with some direction from a Project Leader and occasionally leading simple cases independently. 

In addition, Associates help mentor and coach Analysts by providing regular guidance / feedback. The expectation is to eventually provide significant direction and support to resolve complex issues and effectively manage client and team meetings.

 

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

 

* Candidate should be currently working in strategy consulting/research-oriented set-up and possess acumen to  solve open-ended problems
* Able to quickly come up to speed on different ENR sub-sectors (Oil & Gas, Power & Utilities, Renewables, Petrochemicals, etc.)
* Proficient in research and analysis, as well as able to provide solid business judgment to derive answers in situations where  data is not easily available or explicitly published
* Able to interface with primary client contact (Bain case teams from ME offices)
* May have first-level team management responsibility, which involves allocating and reviewing work to a small team of  analysts and conducting performance / feedback discussions

title: Manager - BCG Vantage
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Topic Activation path within BCG's Principal Investors and Private Equity (PIPE) Practice Area you will work in a growing global team, providing industry/functional expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, analysis and expert advisory. The team uses a variety of number of AI and advanced data analytics tools; and you will be expected to develop expertise on those. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues.
  
  
You will support commercialization efforts for the topic/sector, in conjunction with business leaders, through contributing analysis and insights to proposals, client workshops and marketing materials. Additionally, as a Manager – BCG Vantage, you will help build, own and enhance AI-enabled products, tools and knowledge assets – taking them from problem definition through build, deployment on live cases, and adoption. You will work closely with case teams and business leaders to drive real usage and impact, while helping onboard, train and enable junior colleagues on your topic/sector and on new products.
  
  
BCG’s PIPE Practice Area works with the world’s largest investment firms, serving six client asset classes: Private Equity, Hedge Funds, Infrastructure & Real Estate Funds, Family Offices, Sovereign Wealth Funds and Pension Plans. Likewise, PIPE topics cut across not only these asset classes, but also across industries (e.g., Health Care, Consumer, Technology, etc.) and sub-topics (e.g., Tech Capital, Private Credit, Environmental, Social and Governance, etc.)
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  

* 3+ years consulting experience in PIPE required; candidates with consulting experience preferred
* In lieu of consulting experience, 4+ years minimum industry experience required; 6-10+ years of industry experience strongly preferred
* Bachelor's Degree required (advanced degree preferred)
* Fluency in English;
* Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills to interact with internal and external stakeholder while working in a global collaborative team environment
* Practical fluency with GenAI and modern development tools (e.g. APIs, custom GPTs / AI Skills, coding assistants such as Claude Code or Cursor, GitHub, cloud platforms) strongly preferred; comfort learning new tools as the landscape evolves
* Demonstrated experience managing product roadmaps, backlog prioritization, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment, with comfort in data-driven decision making and familiarity with agile/scrum delivery frameworks

Who You'll Work With
  
  
As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Topic Activation path, you will collaborate with global topic leads and colleagues across BCG to bring expertise and capabilities to the service of our internal and external clients.
  
  
Our team is made up of a diverse pool of BCG Vantage positions that allow us to pursue exciting, innovative BCG Vantage careers.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

* Solving complex client problems through relevant analytical approaches and customized solutions in one or more relevant PIPE topic areas
* Communicating with senior stakeholders, demonstrating the ability to engage your audience effectively
* Demonstrating rapid learning agility across emerging technologies and analytical assets to enhance analysis, develop products, and create scalable, repeatable research and knowledge frameworks
* Managing a portfolio of projects, with strong awareness of business priorities and commercial impact
* Owning the end-to-end lifecycle of AI-enabled products and analytics assets – from problem definition and roadmap through prototyping, build, deployment on live cases, adoption tracking, and ongoing enhancement
* Training, coaching, and mentoring junior team members
* Working in an ever changing and complex environment, and comfortable with ambiguity and navigating a fast-paced environment

**Additional Information**
BCG Vantage is a powerhouse of expertise, seamlessly embedded within Practice Areas and markets to drive extraordinary impact. It equips BCG case teams and clients with cutting-edge expertise, proprietary assets, actionable data, and transformative insights that empower our case teams and enable our clients to achieve their aspirations.
  
  
With global experts across 20 Practices, covering more than 100 topics, sectors and offers, plus four focused geographic markets, BCG Vantage delivers unparalleled depth and breadth of insight & expertise. BCG Vantage consists of three career paths, each playing a crucial role in delivering value to clients, case teams and practice teams.
  
  
***Client Focus (Embedded Expertise)***

* Integrates into client-facing teams to deliver direct client impact through expertise, know-how, and proprietary tools and assets

***Topic Activation (Sector Expertise with Proprietary Tool & Data Solutions)***

* Combines deep domain insights with our know-how and proprietary assets to address targeted challenges directly with clients and project teams; co-creates insights on industry trends and functional topics, proprietary data and tools, and teams to codify IP that all enables BCG to deliver excellent business value with its clients

***Research (Practice Topic and Sector-Aligned Research and Insights)***

* Delivers actionable research and insights tailored to the client project’s needs; works with qualitative and quantitative data, conducts research and provides synthesized results from sources including commercial data, public and open source, company and industry research, macro-economic, commodities and trade data.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

Work Mode: Hybrid
  
  
Relevant Exp: 10+ Years
  
  
Location: Pune, Noida, Bangalore, Chennai
  
  
**Job Description**
**Position Summary:**
We are seeking a seasoned SAP S/4HANA RTR Lead Consultant with SAP S/4HANA RTR functional & technical experience executing and delivering a complex migration project from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA. The candidate will be responsible for the configuration of SAP S/4HANA Target System to receive selected data migrated from a current SAP ECC system to ensure a seamless transition, while providing expert guidance and support to clients throughout the configuration build, testing and cutover activities of their journey to SAP S/4HANA.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities: Functional and Technical Consulting:**
Leading Workshops AS IS / TO BE Process to map requirements from business process understanding, cost management and reporting, integration with other modules and systems, overall business strategy.
  
  
Provide expert guidance and support in RTR workstream including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Cash Management, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, and Profitability Analysis including Margin Analysis. Work with SAP S/4HANA Core Team to configure and customize SAP S/4HANA functionalities to meet client requirements, ensuring adherence to best practices and industry standards.
  
  
Develop technical solutions and enhancements to support data migration, integration, and reporting requirements.
  
  
Provide guidance and support with S/4 HANA transformation project including configuration, Data Migration, providing functional Expertise, trouble shooting, User training.
  
  
Designs and optimizes controlling processes to meet the business needs.
  
  
**Business Process Analysis And Optimization**
Work closely with finance and control departments to understand their processes and needs.
  
  
Analyze existing financial processes and suggest improvements.
  
  
Ensure the SAP system is aligned with business financial operations and reporting requirements.
  
  
**Testing, Training, And Support**
Develop and execute test plans, scenarios, and scripts to validate SAP S/4HANA configurations and functionalities.
  
  
Conduct system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and regression testing to ensure system reliability, accuracy, and performance.
  
  
Collaborate with business users to resolve issues, address concerns, and implement solutions to meet project objectives.
  
  
Train end-users on the functionality of SAP S/4HANA RTR Workstream
  
  
Provide ongoing support and troubleshooting for SAP RTR Workstream issues.
  
  
**Integration And Data Migration**
Ensure seamless integration of the S/4 Finance Accounting with other SAP modules like Order to Cash, Sourcing & Procurement, Manufacturing, Supply Chain.
  
  
Oversee data migration from SAP ECC/legacy systems to SAP S/4HANA, ensuring data integrity and accuracy.
  
  
Work with the Selective Data/Bluefield Migration Team on the migration of data from Customer’s SAP ECC System target SAP S/4HANA System to ensure minimal business disruption and maximum efficiency.
  
  
Collaborate with data migration and technical teams on activities regarding data extraction, transformation, and loading into SAP S/4HANA during build, test and cutover phases of the project.
  
  
**Reporting And Analytics**
Develop and maintain financial accounting reports and dashboards using SAP tools.
  
  
Assist in the utilization of SAP S/4HANA's embedded analytics capabilities to provide actionable insights into financial data.
  
  
**Stakeholder Engagement And Communication**
Act as the primary point of contact for key business and IT stakeholders including business users, project sponsors, and IT teams, providing regular updates, progress reports, and presentations on project status and milestones.
  
  
Proactively engage with stakeholders to gather and validate requirements, address concerns, and obtain feedback throughout the migration and transformation process to SAP S/4HANA.
  
  
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, fostering trust and confidence in the migration process and deliverables.
  
  
Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Information Technology, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
  
  
**Skill & Experience Required**
10+ years of experience in RTR workstream including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Cash Management, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, and Profitability Analysis including Margin Analysis, implementation and support.
  
  
Strong analytical Skills to analyze complex business data, identify potential issues, business challenges, recommend and develop solutions implementing with SAP Best practices.
  
  
Should be well versed with end-to-end Product costing processes including Material Ledger functionality with integration points with other modules like Product Planning, Materials Management, Order to Cash etc.
  
  
Should have worked on reports and able to identify the requirement and integrate effectively with SAP BW/BI or other reporting tools.
  
  
Certification in SAP S/4HANA is required.
  
  
Strong leadership skills with the ability to lead customer engagements at an executive level.
  
  
Excellent interpersonal skills in areas such as teamwork, facilitation, and negotiation
  
  
Strong written, verbal communication and presentation skills to technical and non-technical audiences including the ability to present and discuss strategies and technical information in a manner that establishes rapport, persuades others, and establishes domain expertise.
  
  
Working knowledge of SAP Activate Roadmap for Central Finance
  
  
Primarily Remote with occasional onsite meetings
  
  
**Nice to Have**
Experience, knowledge in other SAP modules and migration tools, such as Data Migration Cockpit, Materials Management, Sales & Distribution, Production Planning, Inventory Management and Warehouse Management is a plus.
  
  
Prior experience with SAP RISE implementations.
  
  
Understanding of SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) applications and use cases.
  
  
Understanding and working knowledge of SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) and potential integration scenarios using MDG.
  
  
Relocation Supported: Yes

title: Service Delivery Manager - Payroll
description:
**Service Delivery Manager – Payroll**

*Global Process Owner, Payroll & Reward Operations (R2P)*

**Tower:**
Reward to Pay (R2P)

**Location:**
Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

**Reports to:**
HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

**Role type:**
People manager

**Scope:**
Multi-country payroll, benefits administration, compensation changes, payroll accounting and tax filings

**ABOUT THE HUB**

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

You own payroll and reward delivery end to end for every country moving into Noida. You will move payroll from dozens of local vendors and in-country teams to a controlled, consolidated model. Employees must be paid accurately and on time, in every cycle and in every country, throughout the transition and after it.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Transition and shared services set-up**

* Lead the payroll transition roadmap country by country, sequenced by risk, complexity, headcount and vendor contract dates.
* Run knowledge transfer from country payroll teams and vendors. This covers desk procedures, statutory calendars, pay elements and local exceptions.
* Plan and run parallel payroll runs for each country. Set clear go/no-go criteria based on variance thresholds, and use hypercare after cutover.
* Deliver the global payroll vendor consolidation programme. Rationalise the vendor portfolio, support selection, and manage exit and onboarding without disrupting pay.
* Design the target operating model for R2P, covering the split of work between hub, vendor and country HR, with RACI, handoffs and cut-off calendars.

**2. Process ownership and service delivery**

* Act as Global Process Owner for R2P. Own process standards, the global pay calendar, the design of allowed variations, and change control.
* Deliver zero critical payroll errors per cycle through pre-payroll reconciliations, input validation, dual approval and post-pay checks.
* Monitor data flows between the HRIS, time-and-attendance, payroll engines and the general ledger. Resolve interface breaks before cut-off.
* Manage payroll vendors against contractual SLAs, with monthly scorecards, quarterly business reviews and service credits where needed.
* Act as the escalation point for pay issues. Run root-cause analysis on every off-cycle payment and track the fix through to closure.

**3. Governance, risk and controls**

* Build and maintain the R2P control framework, including key controls, segregation of duties, access reviews and evidence standards.
* Lead annual and ad-hoc audit readiness with Internal Audit, Tax and Finance. Close findings within the agreed timelines.
* Track statutory and regulatory change in every in-scope country. Implement change before its effective date.
* Protect employee pay data in line with GDPR and local privacy law.

**4. Continuous improvement and digital**

* Standardise pay elements and processes across countries. Reduce local exceptions to the minimum required by law.
* Automate reconciliations, variance analysis and exception reporting using RPA and analytics.
* Drive employee self-service for payslips, tax documents and pay queries to reduce inbound contacts.

**5. People leadership, performance and culture**

* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.

****Job Description****
***3-5 bullet points of specific duties***
****About The Role:****

* Serve as the primary point of contact between clients, consultants, contractors, and internal teams, ensuring seamless communication and alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
* Lead project planning activities, including scope definition, budget development, scheduling, and resource allocation to establish a strong execution framework.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure project requirements, design inputs, and execution strategies are fully integrated and aligned with overall project goals.
* Conduct regular Project Review Meetings during Planning, Execution, and Close-out stages, ensuring timely resolution of issues, approval of deliverables, and adherence to project milestones.

****General Responsibilities****

* Evaluate project execution plans, schedules, cost estimates, and construction methodologies for feasibility, efficiency, and compliance with contractual and statutory requirements.
* Monitor and manage project progress against approved timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks, ensuring proactive identification and mitigation of risks.
* Lead procurement coordination, contractor onboarding, and contract administration to ensure smooth mobilization and effective execution on site.
* Conduct regular site visits to track progress, verify work quality, resolve on-ground challenges, and ensure alignment with approved drawings and specifications.
* Prepare and maintain project documentation—including progress reports, dashboards, and risk logs—to support informed decision-making and ensure audit-ready records.

***3-5 bullet points of key selection criteria***
****About You:****

* Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering (master’s in construction management or related field preferred).
* 6+ years of experience in project management for large-scale, mixed-use, Hospitality & Commercial projects within a PMC, developer, or consulting environment.
* Strong understanding of project planning, cost control, contract administration, construction methodologies, and regulatory compliance.
* Proficiency in project management software, scheduling tools (MSP/Primavera), and MIS/reporting systems.
* Excellent leadership, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive teams toward timely and quality project delivery.

We encourage continuous learning and development opportunities to develop personal, professional and technical capabilities, and we reward with a comprehensive employee benefits program.

Job Description

**Role Purpose**

The purpose of this role is to design the organisation s computer and network security infrastructure and protect its systems and sensitive information from cyber threats

͏

**Do**

1. Design and develop enterprise cyber security strategy and architecture

a. Understand security requirements by evaluating business strategies and conducting system security vulnerability and risk analyses

b. Identify risks associated with business processes, operations,

information security programs and technology projects

c. Identify and communicate current and emerging security threats and design security architecture elements to mitigate threats as they emerge

d. Identify security design gaps in existing and proposed architectures and recommend changes or enhancements

e. Provide product best fit analysis to ensure end to end security covering different faucets of architecture e.g. Layered security, Zoning, Integration aspects, API, Endpoint security, Data security, Compliance and regulations

f. Demonstrate experience in doing security assessment against NIST Frameworks, SANS, CIS, etc.

g. Provide support during technical deployment, configuration, integration and administration of security technologies

h. Demonstrate experience around ITIL or Key process-oriented domains like incident management, configuration management, change management, problem management etc.

i. Provide assistance for disaster recovery in the event of any security breaches, attacks, intrusions and unusual, unauthorized or illegal activity

j. Provide solution of RFP s received from clients and ensure overall design assurance

͏

i. Develop a direction to manage the portfolio of to-be-solutions including systems, shared infrastructure services, applications, hardware related to cyber risk security in order to better match business outcome objectives

ii. Analyse technology environment, enterprise specifics, client requirements to set a collaboration design framework/ architecture

iii. Depending on the client s need with particular standards and technology stacks create complete RFPs

iv. Provide technical leadership to the design, development and implementation of custom solutions through thoughtful use of modern technology

v. Define and understand current state solutions and identify improvements, options & tradeoffs to define target state solutions

vi. Clearly articulate and sell architectural targets, recommendations and reusable patterns and accordingly propose investment roadmaps

vii. Evaluate and recommend solutions to integrate with overall technology ecosystem

viii. Tracks industry and application trends and relates these to planning current and future IT needs

͏

a. Liaise with stakeholders in relation to cyber security issues and provide timely support and future recommendations

b. Provide assistance in maintaining an information security risk register and help with internal and external audits relating to information security

c. Support audit of security best practices and implementation of security principles across the organization, to meet business goals along with customer and regulatory requirements

d. Assist with the creation, maintenance and delivery of cyber security awareness training to team members and customers

e. Provide training to employees on issues such as spam and unwanted or malicious emails

Job Description: Senior SAP Controlling (CO) Consultant
  
  
Position Overview
  
  

* Position: Senior SAP Controlling (CO) Consultant
* Experience Required: 8 to 10+ years
* Location / Mode: PAN India / Hybrid
* Project Type: Implementation, Roll-outs, Support, Change Requests, and Enhancements

Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic
**Senior SAP Controlling (CO) Consultant**
with a strong track record of end-to-end implementations and business process re-engineering. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise across core and advanced SAP CO modules, exceptional stakeholder communication skills, and hands-on experience in SAP S/4HANA environments. You will lead requirement gathering, solution building, gap analysis, and month-end closing cycles while coordinating closely with technical teams.
  
  
**Mandatory Requirements & Core Skills**

* Experience: 8–10+ years of cumulative IT experience specializing in SAP Controlling (CO).
* Communication: EXCELLENT verbal and written communication skills with proven ability in client-facing roles, blueprinting, and user training.
* SAP S/4HANA Knowledge: Solid understanding of SAP S/4HANA differences compared to ECC (e.g., Universal Journal integration, Material Ledger enhancements, CO-PA architecture).
* Project Lifecycle: Hands-on participation in at least 2+ full-cycle implementations, roll-outs, or major support/enhancement projects from requirement gathering to Go-Live.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Core SAP CO Modules:

+ General Controlling, Cost Center Accounting (CO-OM-CCA), and Profit Center Accounting (EC-PCA).

title: Manager - Continuous Improvement
description:
**Job Description**
**Manager – Continuous Improvement & Process Discovery**
Kraft Heinz Global Business Services | Continuous Improvement
  
  
Six Sigma Green Belt | Process Discovery Lead | GBS Towers: ATR, AP, Commercial Ops, SCM & More
  
  
**Job Title**
Manager – Continuous Improvement & Process Discovery
  
  
**Department**
Global Business Services (GBS) – Continuous Improvement CoE
  
  
**Reports To**
Senior Manager – Continuous Improvement
  
  
**Location**
GBS GCC Ahemdabad
  
  
**Six Sigma Requirement**
Certified Green Belt (GB) – Required; Black Belt aspirant preferred
  
  
**Travel**
Up to 20%
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Manager of Continuous Improvement & Process Discovery is a hands-on practitioner and team lead who drives process discovery and improvement initiatives across assigned GBS FnA towers. Reporting to the Senior Manager, this role owns the end-to-end execution of Six Sigma projects, facilitates process discovery workshops, produces high-quality process documentation, and coaches Analysts. The Manager bridges strategic direction with operational delivery, ensuring GBS towers continuously evolve toward leaner, more efficient models.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Process Discovery & Improvement Execution**

* Lead full-cycle DMAIC projects for assigned GBS towers (ATR, S2P, RTR, Commercial Ops, SCM), from charter definition through Control phase.
* Facilitate SIPOC, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), Swimlane, and Process Flow mapping workshops with tower SMEs and operations teams.
* Document current-state (as-is) processes and develop future-state (to-be) blueprints with gap analysis and improvement recommendations.
* Apply Lean tools (5S, Kaizen, FMEA, Root Cause Analysis) to identify and eliminate waste across transactional processes.
* Build and maintain the GBS process library (SOP-level documentation) in collaboration with tower leads.

**Data Analysis & Performance Measurement**

* Collect and analyze process performance data using statistical methods (control charts, Pareto analysis, Fishbone, hypothesis testing).
* Build and maintain KPI dashboards to track process health, improvement adoption, and project benefits realization.
* Partner with GBS Data & Analytics teams to leverage process mining tools and ERP data for baseline measurement.

**Team Leadership & Analyst Development**

* Supervise and develop 2–4 CI Analysts; assign workstreams, review deliverables, and provide structured coaching.
* Guide Analysts through process mapping assignments and quality-check documentation for accuracy and completeness.
* Support Analyst Yellow Belt and Green Belt certification journeys through project guidance and knowledge transfer.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Engage tower process owners, operations leads, and functional SMEs to gather inputs, validate findings, and drive buy-in for improvements.
* Prepare and present project updates, workshop findings, and improvement proposals to Senior Manager and tower leadership.
* Coordinate with IT/automation teams to align process redesigns with digitalization and RPA pipeline.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, Operations, or Supply Chain.
* Certified Six Sigma Green Belt (ASQ, IASSC, or equivalent) – mandatory.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in process improvement, operations, or business analysis.
* Minimum 2–3 years in a GBS, Shared Services, SSC, or BPO environment.
* Hands-on experience facilitating VSM, SIPOC, and Process Mapping sessions.
* Proficiency in process documentation tools (Visio, Lucidchart, ARIS, Signavio, or Bizagi).
* Strong data analysis skills; working knowledge of Minitab, Excel (advanced), or similar tools.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Six Sigma Black Belt certification or active pursuit.
* Exposure to process mining tools (Celonis, UiPath Process Mining).
* Experience with ERP platforms (SAP S/4HANA, Oracle) in an ATR or AP context.
* Lean certification or Kaizen facilitation experience.
* Experience in FMCG, CPG, or Kraft Heinz GBS environment.

**COMPETENCIES & BEHAVIORS**

* Strong facilitation skills – ability to lead structured workshops with diverse, cross-functional participants.
* Analytical mindset with a practical, results-oriented approach to problem solving.
* Clear written and verbal communication; able to translate process complexity into simple documentation.
* Collaborative team player who builds trust with operations teams and fosters a CI culture.
* Detail-oriented with high standards for documentation quality and process rigor.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**
**KPI**
**Target**
DMAIC projects completed per year
  
  
≥ 4 closed projects / year
  
  
Process maps delivered (as-is + to-be)
  
  
≥ 10 per tower per year
  
  
On-time project milestone delivery
  
  
≥ 90%
  
  
Savings / efficiency contribution per project
  
  
> $100K average
  
  
Analyst performance rating (direct reports)
  
  
≥ Meets expectations, 100%
  
  
Stakeholder Satisfaction (Tower level surveys)
  
  
≥ 4.5 / 5

Ahmedabad - Venus Stratum GCC

description:
**Role Summary**

Ample Solar is looking for a Project Engineer to take ownership of the execution of commercial and industrial solar projects from post sales handover through planning, installation, testing, and commissioning.

The role involves close coordination with engineering, procurement, dispatch, installation, electrical and customer teams to ensure that projects are executed systematically, within the committed schedule, and as per the required quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Take ownership of end to end execution of commercial solar projects from sales handover to commissioning.
* Develop project execution schedules covering engineering, material readiness, dispatch, site installation, electrical works, testing and commissioning.
* Coordinate with Design, Liaisoning team, Procurement, Stores, Dispatch and Installation teams to ensure timely availability of resources and materials.
* Plan and coordinate deployment of installation teams based on project requirements and execution schedules.
* Monitor project progress against planned milestones and ensure timely completion of activities.
* Identify project constraints, site issues, and potential delays in advance and take appropriate corrective actions.
* Coordinate with customers, site representatives, vendors, and contractors for smooth project execution.
* Ensure execution is carried out in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, safety and quality requirements.
* Coordinate testing, commissioning, statutory/DISCOM activities wherever applicable, and final project handover.
* Maintain project status, execution records, and timely reporting to the management.

**Candidate Profile**

* 3–4 years of experience in Solar EPC/Project Execution, preferably handling commercial or industrial rooftop projects.
* Strong understanding of solar PV systems, electrical installation, and project execution.
* Experience in coordinating installation teams, contractors, vendors and multiple internal departments.
* Good knowledge of project planning, material coordination, and site execution.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and work towards strict project timelines.
* Strong communication, coordination, follow-up, and problem solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and project tracking/reporting tools will be an advantage.

**Key Requirement**

The ideal candidate should have a strong project ownership mindset, capable of planning the execution well in advance, coordinating all required resources and taking timely action to ensure that commercial solar projects are completed as committed, without avoidable delays.

**Compensation & Career Growth Opportunities:**

* The candidate will be offered a competitive cost to company (CTC) along with performance based incentives linked to the timely implementation of assigned projects and other governing parameters
* Company believes in company growth along with their employee growth, Strong opportunities for professional growth, career advancement, and long term leadership development.
* We rise together: your personal development fuels our corporate expansion in the solar industry.

**Company Overview:**

Ample Solar Private Limited is a Gujarat based solar company delivering scalable renewable energy solutions from rooftop systems, ground mounted solar projects to multi megawatt industrial solar projects. The company serves residential customers, MSMEs, and large industries with a strong focus on engineering quality and execution excellence.

With 3000+ operations completed and demonstrated capability in MW scale project execution, Ample Solar supports large industrial clients in achieving energy cost optimization and sustainability targets. Backed as an authorized Tata Group channel partner, the company brings good quality components, structured processes, and reliable delivery across all project sizes. Ample Solar is also entered a phase of strategic multi state expansion, strengthening its presence in key industrial corridors to support India’s clean energy transition.

title: Engineering Leader – Digital Enablement & Lifecycle Services
description:
**About Chubb**

Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: www.chubb.com.

**About Chubb India**

At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. We are proud to share that we have been officially certified as a Great Place to Work for the third consecutive year, a reflection of the culture at Chubb where we believe in fostering an environment where everyone can thrive, innovate, and grow.

With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we encourage a start-up mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution-driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape.

We offer an environment where you will be part of an organization that is dedicated to solving real-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.

**Position Details**

**Job Title:**
Engineering Manager – Digital Enablement & Lifecycle Services

**Function / Department:**
Technology

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Location:**
Hyderabad / Bangalore

**Reports To:**
Head of Engineering NA - CECI

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an Engineering Manager who leads the Digital Enablement pillar — the engineering foundation that powers automation, process transformation, integration services, and lifecycle management across Chubb's technology estate. You will build and lead teams that make digital transformation real: replacing manual processes with intelligent, automated workflows; enabling seamless service integration across complex systems; and ensuring the engineering delivery lifecycle is fast, reliable, and AI-augmented. Candidates from hi-tech product companies, BFSI, or enterprise software backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop a team of engineers building digital enablement platforms, automation services, and lifecycle management capabilities.
* Own the engineering roadmap for process automation, workflow orchestration, and digital transformation programmes within the NA CI estate.
* Drive AI-native engineering across the full SDLC — from requirements parsing and intelligent code generation to automated testing, deployment observability, and agentic automation.
* Deliver scalable integration and automation services connecting core insurance systems, third-party platforms, and digital channels.
* Partner with architects, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate transformation objectives into engineering outcomes with measurable business impact.
* Embed DevSecOps standards as default practice: CI/CD pipelines, security scanning, infrastructure-as-code, and automated release management.
* Own sprint quality, release cadence, and technical debt trade-offs across the digital enablement portfolio.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging AI engineering tools — coding assistants, intelligent test generation, agentic workflow frameworks — and embed them into team practice.
* Build and sustain a high-performance engineering team culture: psychological safety, ownership, and continuous learning.
* Hire, onboard, and develop engineering talent; contribute to the Chubb India Digital engineering brand.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong engineering background in Java, .NET, or equivalent enterprise stacks; comfortable reading and reviewing code across the stack.
* Demonstrated experience delivering digital transformation, process automation, or workflow orchestration platforms in complex enterprise environments.
* Hands-on AI tool adoption: GitHub Copilot, AI-assisted testing, or agentic workflow tools embedded into team practice — not experimented with.
* Cloud-native development expertise (Azure or AWS): microservices, event-driven architecture, API design, and containerization.
* Experience from hi-tech product companies, BFSI, or enterprise software environments with delivery at meaningful scale.
* 3+ years of engineering leadership experience in agile, high-velocity delivery environments.
* Exposure to integration platforms (MuleSoft, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent) and enterprise automation frameworks is a strong advantage.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.
* 18+ years in software engineering, with at least 3 years leading engineering teams.
* Strong AI-native SDLC practice and digital transformation delivery track record.

**Why Join Us?**

* Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry.
* Lead impactful initiatives that drive engineering excellence and customer outcomes.
* Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.

**Why Chubb?**

Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company! Our constant focus on employee experience along with a start-up-like culture empowers you to achieve impactful results.

* Industry leader: Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence
* A Great Place to work: Chubb India has been recognized as a Great Place to Work for the years 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026
* Laser focus on excellence: At Chubb we pride ourselves on our culture of greatness where excellence is a mindset and a way of being. We constantly seek new and innovative ways to excel at work and deliver outstanding results
* Start-Up Culture: Embracing the spirit of a start-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter
* Growth and success: As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment

**Employee Benefits**

Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees' health, well-being, and professional growth. Employees enjoy flexible work options, generous paid time off, and robust health coverage, including treatment for dental and vision related requirements. We invest in the future of our employees through continuous learning opportunities and career advancement programs, while fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment. Our benefits include:

* Savings and Investment plans: We provide specialized benefits like Corporate NPS (National Pension Scheme), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP), Retiral Benefits and Car Lease that help employees optimally plan their finances
* Upskilling and career growth opportunities: With a focus on continuous learning, we offer customized programs that support upskilling like Education Reimbursement Programs, Certification programs and access to global learning programs.
* Health and Welfare Benefits: We care about our employees' well-being in and out of work and have benefits like Hybrid Work Environment, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Yearly Free Health campaigns and comprehensive Insurance benefits.

**Application Process**

Our recruitment process is designed to be transparent and inclusive.

* Step 1: Submit your application via the Chubb Careers Portal.
* Step 2: Engage with our recruitment team for an initial discussion.
* Step 3: Participate in HackerRank assessments/technical/functional interviews and assessments (if applicable).
* Step 4: Final interaction with Chubb leadership.

**Join Us**

With you Chubb is better. Whether you are solving challenges on a global stage or creating innovative solutions for local markets, your contributions will help shape the future. If you value integrity, innovation, and inclusion, and are ready to make a difference, we invite you to be part of Chubb India's journey.

**Apply Now**

A place where you’ll get support putting your best ideas into practice. A place where you can feel secure, where you can learn and be challenged, and where you can succeed whoever you are, wherever you’re from and whatever makes you different.
  
  
We’re growing at a fast pace and are looking for people who are smart, free-thinking, curious and excited about working in a diverse global culture to do great work and make a meaningful impact.
  
  
**WHO YOU ARE**
We love different personalities at MiQ and strive to build teams constructed with diverse backgrounds and inclusive points of view. That said, we firmly believe that our values bring us together and we look for people who align with our values below.
  
  

* Passion – We love and live what we do
* Determination – We always find a way to ‘figure it out’
* Unity – We hold each other accountable. We win and lose as a team
* Agility – We anticipate the unexpected, embrace and adapt to change
* Courage – We dare to think unconventionally

**THE ROLE:**
MiQ is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the development teams that build its proprietary trading platform which powers the end to end advertisement campaign lifecycle for MiQ’s clients. Also lead the development and roll out of the next generation of this platform designed for the business to scale for billion dollar operations.
  
  
Balance exceptional delivery for customers on what matters, engaging team and colleagues, with the needs of the business.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to architect, design and develop end to end software products and systems from the ground up and have ownership of them. You will have the opportunity to utilize a variety of latest Web application frameworks and Big Data technologies. You will be leading Agile teams that utilizes the latest in CI/CD pipelines to speed up the products’ time to market.
  
  
Your key stakeholders would include the Product leads of various products, leads of various teams (traders, business analysts, data scientists). You will be supported by your peers and experts across many fields who will help you succeed. You will be the expert and often the first layer of management of people or projects.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead high performance technology teams.
* Lead from the front and lead by example
* Hire & develop talented leads & engineers.
* Own and drive business features into technology requirements.
* Work closely with Product Managers, Customers to align technology choices with business requirements.
* Ensure high quality and timely release & support of products
* Actively drive and contribute to architecture and design of products and APIs
* Stay updated on emerging technologies and apply them
