title: Staff Manager/Architect - Automotive, AI Assisted Testing, Automated Testing
description:
**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive**
We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career.
  
  

* Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
* Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
* Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment.

**What You’ll Be Part Of**
You are an expert in both software test engineering and AI‑enabled test architecture, with more than ten years of experience designing, implementing, and scaling advanced testing solutions. As part of this role, you will regularly visit Harman premises to collaborate directly with engineering and product teams. Leveraging your deep expertise in AI‑driven validation, automation frameworks, and large‑scale test architectures, you will guide software engineering teams in adopting modern, intelligent testing practices. You will play a central role in enabling AI‑based testing across the entire Intelligent Cockpit division, ensuring higher efficiency, improved coverage, and faster time to market.
  
  
Your technical leadership and ability to translate complex challenges into actionable solutions make you a key contributor to the success of Harman’s customer programs and a strategic asset for the Intelligent Cockpit organization.
  
  
**Your Team:**
You will lead a small testing team, plan their tasks, and bring them to closure.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Architect the test systems, validation strategy, and overall quality framework for the Intelligent Cockpit division.
* Provide technical leadership for the development of the testing framework used to design test cases and support automation across the product line.
* Collaborate closely with engineering leaders, architects, and cross‑functional teams to ensure alignment, technical coherence, and shared quality objectives.
* Proactively gather technical input from software engineering teams and drive the definition, evolution, and continuous improvement of software testing solutions.
* Design and implement automation, AI‑enabled validation, and DevOps solutions for the Software Product division.
* Support managers by clarifying technical issues related to software development, testability, integration, and system behavior.
* Communicate complex technical challenges in a clear, structured, and actionable manner to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
* Advocate for and promote the adoption of a common software testing framework across teams to ensure consistency and efficiency.
* Provide expert guidance on test architecture, automation strategy, and AI‑driven testing solutions, enabling scalable and future‑proof validation capabilities.
* As a senior Test Lead you will be responsible for translating business and system requirements (related mainly to Test, AI and process) into end-to-end technical solutions that are scalable, secure, and aligned with organizational standards.
* Test architect for future SDV solutions and entire Software product.
* You will ensure an efficient integration of cloud-based testing into the CICD pipeline in order to reduce the overall development lead time (commit to releasable software)
* You will focus to move majority testing of cockpit automotive software to cloud and automate it.
* In this role you will enable unique AI driven test solutions that will help accelerate testing and hence a quicker time to market. Today's biggest challenge is integration testing, which is primarily done on HW and causes major delays in the projects.
* Customers are also interested to see how Harman Intelligent cockpit is doing validation and would want to buy these solutions. You will architect a highly scalable and efficient testing solution for Software Products/Intelligent Cockpit.

**What Makes You A Strong Fit**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent; BE with MBA would be preferred.
* 15+ years of overall software validation experience
* 10+ years of experience as a technical leader in a QA or software automotive testing organization.
* 5+ years of experience in AI‑enabled testing and intelligent automation.
* Fluent English proficiency, both written and spoken.
* Expertise in AI‑enabled testing engineering, including model‑based and data‑driven validation approaches.
* Strong knowledge of testing frameworks, including Android and Linux test frameworks.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical issues to management and cross‑functional audiences.
* Ability to understand, analyze, and capture requirements from multiple engineering teams.
* Deep knowledge of existing software testing solutions within QA organizations.
* Strong understanding of test framework internals and hands‑on experience with Python, C++ development.
* Solid understanding of automotive software development methodologies, including Automotive SPICE and ISO 26262.
* Good understanding of Android architecture and its implications for testing and integration.
* At least 5-year experience in validating web-based SaaS applications.
* At least 5-year experience in validating automotive infotainment software.
* Experience in automating a test suite for web-based SaaS applications.
* Experience in automating a test suite for automotive infotainment software.
* Experience working with AWS public cloud.
* Experience in driving the test architecture starting from requirements to deployment.
* Exposure in Google Compliance Testing (CTS, VTS, STS, ACTS etc)
* Familiar with CDD , GAS and related test suites (like the Compatibility Test Suite)
* In-Depth understanding of -Requirement analysis - Test Case Creation - Test Case Execution - Sanity Test.
* Good understanding of development project cycle
* Good understanding of Continuous integration and deployment
* Good understanding of test Driven Development practices.
* Ability to solve the problem independently.
* Strong problem-solving skills and awareness of DevOps and Agile principles.

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* Testing knowledge of overall vehicle testing, that includes other domains like vehicle, chasis, powertrain, ADAS etc.
* Testing with Digital twin on cloud.
* Good experience in creating and generating testing data for testing scenarios that requires huge amount of data (like certain use cases of Autonomous driving)
* QNX experience is a bonus.
* Experience in developing Android middleware and applications
* Knowledge in embedded software engineering
* Experience in testing SaaS cloud solutions

**Things To Know**

* This role is based in Bengaluru and follows a hybrid schedule, with regular in-office collaboration alongside engineering, product, and customer program teams.

**What You Can Expect**

* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)
* Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs
* Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being
* Tuition reimbursement support
* Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development

-RD2
  
  
**You Belong Here**
HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.

Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.

title: Staff Engineer ( Java )
description:
Job ID: R-2026-27-Q01-0011

Department: ETPL AI

Designation: Staff Engineer

Experience: 6-9 years

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: Bangalore, India

**About ETPL**

eReleGo Technologies Private Limited (ETPL) is a Bengaluru-based technology company building scalable digital platforms across AdTech, EdTech, SaaS ERP, and FinTech domains. The company focuses on applying advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence and data-driven systems to solve real operational problems for businesses and educational institutions.

As ETPL scales into a firm of larger size, revenue, and complexity, it is investing deliberately in building strong internal capabilities across leadership, operations, technology, people, and culture. The objective is not just rapid growth, but sustainable, future-ready growth supported by structured systems, strong talent, and accountable teams.

**About Crafter**

Crafter is a comprehensive low-code / no-code Enterprise & SaaS platform that helps organizations build custom applications, automate workflows, and streamline core business processes without extensive technical expertise.

Designed for startups, SMEs, and large enterprises seeking agility and efficiency, Crafter’s visual drag-and-drop builder and modular solutions enable businesses to rapidly create applications, manage resources, and enhance customer engagement with minimal coding.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Staff Engineer with 6 to 9 years of hands-on experience in Java and Spring Boot to provide technical leadership across one or more products within the ETPL AI portfolio. This role sits within ETPL's engineering capability and carries responsibility for backend architecture, system design, engineering quality, and the technical development of delivery teams.

The Staff Engineer will be the senior technical authority within their product engineering context - owning architectural decisions, driving best practices, and ensuring that the systems they are responsible for are scalable, maintainable, and built to support enterprise-grade deployments. The role combines deep hands-on engineering with the influence and communication skills to lead other engineers and engage meaningfully with product and business stakeholders.

This is a role for an engineer who has moved beyond individual contribution and is ready to shape how systems are designed, how teams deliver, and how technical quality is defined and maintained across a product.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide technical leadership in the design, development, and evolution of backend systems and services built on Java and Spring Boot across assigned ETPL AI products
* Own system architecture decisions for assigned product areas - ensuring scalability, modularity, security, and performance across multi-tenant enterprise deployments
* Lead and mentor a team of engineers, conducting code reviews, architectural walkthroughs, and technical discussions that raise the capability and quality of the broader team
* Translate product requirements and business logic into well-structured, maintainable technical designs - collaborating closely with product managers and senior stakeholders to ensure alignment between technical decisions and product outcomes
* Define and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and engineering governance frameworks across the product codebase
* Conduct architectural reviews and deep code audits to identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and structural risks - and lead the resolution of findings in a structured manner
* Design and optimize data models, database schemas, and query performance across relational databases, particularly MySQL and PostgreSQL, to support high-volume, data-intensive operations
* Drive the adoption of RESTful API design standards, microservices principles, and service integration patterns appropriate to ETPL's platform architecture
* Own the technical quality of the software delivery lifecycle within the product team - including requirements validation, design reviews, testing governance, deployment oversight, and post-release monitoring
* Identify, evaluate, and integrate appropriate libraries, frameworks, and tools to improve engineering efficiency, system reliability, and long-term maintainability
* Act as the escalation point for critical technical issues and production incidents within the product, leading structured root cause analysis and resolution
* Champion a culture of engineering excellence, documentation discipline, and continuous improvement within the product engineering team

**Experience And Profile**

* 6 to 9 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with strong and sustained depth in Java and Spring Boot
* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering scalable, high-performance backend systems for enterprise or SaaS products
* Experience leading or mentoring other engineers within a structured delivery team
* Proven ability to make and communicate sound architectural decisions across backend systems, APIs, and data layers
* Experience with microservices architecture, RESTful API design, and distributed systems is expected
* Prior exposure to multi-tenant platform design or enterprise product engineering is an advantage

**Skills And Attributes**

* Deep mastery of Java and Spring Boot, with strong expertise in building modular, production-grade enterprise backend systems
* Solid understanding of Spring ecosystem components - Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud - and their appropriate application in enterprise contexts
* Strong database engineering skills across relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) including schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and performance tuning at scale
* Proficiency in RESTful API design and development, with a clear understanding of API contracts, versioning, and integration standards
* Experience with microservices architecture, service decomposition, and inter-service communication patterns including REST and message queuing (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent)
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes, and with CI/CD pipeline tooling for structured, automated delivery
* Proficiency with Git and structured branching strategies for collaborative development within multi-team engineering environments
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms - AWS / Azure - and the deployment and infrastructure considerations relevant to enterprise SaaS products
* Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and test-driven development practices, with a commitment to maintaining high automated test coverage
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with structured root cause analysis — particularly under production pressure
* Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical decisions and trade-offs to both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders
* A collaborative and mentoring disposition - genuinely invested in the growth of the engineers around them, not just personal technical output

**Recruitment Process**

ETPL follows a structured, assessment-led recruitment process focused on long-term fit and capability development. Shortlisted candidates will go through:

* ETPL Aptitude Test (EAT) - to assess analytical ability, reasoning, and problem-solving
* ETPL Psychometric Test (EPT) - to understand work style, behavioral tendencies, and role alignment
* Interview Rounds - including functional and culture-fit discussions

This process ensures fairness, transparency, and clarity for both the candidate and the organization.

**What do we offer**

* Exposure to senior educators, institutional leaders, and industry practitioners
* Opportunities to learn from internal capability-building initiatives and leadership programs
* A growing organization that is investing in better systems, clearer roles, and stronger people practices
* A work environment that values learning, ownership, and long-term career growth

As a scaling company, ETPL is evolving its processes, teams, and structures. This role suits individuals who are comfortable growing alongside the organization, contributing to improvement, and building strong foundations rather than expecting everything to be fully polished from day one.

To apply you can send your resume to prashant.musale@erelego.com or DM me on (LinkedIn or +91-9167464004).

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
As a Software Engineering Manager within MS TECH Order Fulfillment, you will provide strategic product and technical leadership, along with hands-on expertise, to build industry-leading products. You are a systems thinker capable of driving large-scale transformations that maximize value for Ford, our Dealers, and our customers. The role combines high-level strategy, including product vision, AI/ML use-case portfolio, data strategy, and technical roadmaps, with disciplined execution to deliver scalable, resilient, secure, explainable, and highly available solutions in a global environment.
  
  
**Technical Leadership & Vision**

* Serve as the primary technical authority for the Order Generation product suite, defining the evolution of the technology stack, data architecture, AI/ML capabilities, and architectural patterns.
* Lead cross-functional teams through complex integrations, managing dependencies across the broader Order Fulfillment ecosystem to ensure seamless data flow and system interoperability.
* Translate high-level business requirements into actionable technical strategies that align with Ford enterprise standards.

**AI/ML Product Strategy & Innovation**

* Define and execute an AI/ML and data analytics product strategy that converts priority business requirements into a sequenced portfolio of intelligent capabilities and measurable outcomes.
* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI/ML opportunities across forecasting, order generation, decision support, anomaly detection, optimization, and workflow automation using value, feasibility, risk, data readiness, and adoption criteria.
* Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of AI/ML products from discovery, business-case development, experimentation, and MVP validation through industrialization, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, Product, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Legal, Privacy, and business teams to ensure solutions are technically sound, usable, compliant, and aligned with responsible AI principles.
* Establish outcome-based product metrics, experimentation methods, model performance targets, and adoption measures; use evidence and customer feedback to guide investment and roadmap decisions.
* Monitor emerging technologies, including generative AI, agentic AI, foundation models, advanced analytics, optimization, and intelligent automation, and determine where they can create differentiated business value.
* Drive build, buy, or partner assessments and develop scalable patterns for reusable AI/ML services, data products, model APIs, and decision intelligence capabilities.

**Product Strategy & Delivery**

* Partner with business stakeholders to define and execute a multi-year product vision and roadmap focused on optimized order forecasting and generation.
* Champion an iterative, Agile delivery model, prioritizing the delivery of Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) and maintaining a high-velocity release cadence.
* Apply Human-Centered Design (HCD) principles to ensure technical solutions solve real-world problems for Dealers and customers.
* Create launch and adoption plans that include operational readiness, user training, change management, benefit tracking, and feedback loops.

**Data, Model & MLOps Excellence**

* Ensure AI/ML solutions are supported by trusted, governed, discoverable, and fit-for-purpose data, with clear ownership, lineage, quality controls, and access patterns.
* Guide the implementation of robust MLOps and LLMOps practices covering reproducible experimentation, model registry, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, rollback, and auditability.
* Define controls for model quality, explainability, bias and fairness evaluation, privacy, security, human oversight, and responsible use throughout the product lifecycle.
* Balance predictive accuracy with interpretability, latency, cost, reliability, and business usability when selecting models and architectures.

**Engineering & Operational Excellence**

* Enforce rigorous engineering standards, including Test-Driven Development (TDD), robust CI/CD pipelines, and DevSecOps practices.
* Drive a culture of Full Lifecycle Ownership, where the team is responsible for the design, security, deployment, and operational health of its services.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for system health, code quality, delivery velocity, model performance, data quality, adoption, and realized business value.

**Architectural Design**

* Architect and oversee the development of cloud-native, microservices-based systems designed for global scale, multi-tenancy, and high-performance transactional processing.
* Design interoperable data and AI architectures that support batch and real-time inference, event-driven workflows, APIs, observability, and secure integration with enterprise platforms.

**People Leadership & Talent Development**

* Cultivate a high-performing, diverse team of Software Engineers, Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and ML Engineers through active coaching, mentorship, and career pathing.
* Foster a culture of psychological safety and continuous learning, utilizing blameless retrospectives and regular feedback loops to drive team growth.
* Identify and close skill gaps within the team to keep pace with emerging technologies and industry trends.

**Strategic Collaboration**

* Act as a bridge between the product team and domain experts in Cloud Infrastructure, Data & AI, Cybersecurity, Responsible AI, SRE, and DevOps to reduce portfolio complexity.
* Influence stakeholders across the organization to adopt modern engineering practices, responsible AI controls, reusable data products, and standardized service contracts.

**Technical Execution (Hands-on)**

* Maintain deep technical fluency in the team’s primary languages, frameworks, cloud services, data platforms, and AI/ML toolchain, including Java, Spring Boot, GCP/Azure, Vertex AI, and modern MLOps platforms.
* Lead from the front by participating in architecture and code reviews, resolving complex technical blockers, reviewing model and data design decisions, and occasionally prototyping high-risk or emerging technology concepts.
* Experience: 10+ years of progressive software engineering, digital product, data, or AI/ML solution delivery experience, with a significant portion in engineering and product leadership roles.
* AI/ML Product Leadership: Demonstrated experience strategizing, developing, launching, and scaling AI/ML-based products that address business requirements and deliver measurable operational or customer outcomes.
* Product Strategy: Experience defining product vision, business cases, roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, MVPs, go-to-market or launch plans, adoption strategies, and value-realization metrics for data and AI products.
* Education: Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.
* Certifications: Industry certifications relevant to software engineering, cloud, data, or AI/ML, or a commitment to obtain them within 6 months. GCP Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Machine Learning Engineer, or equivalent certification is a plus.
* Cloud Expertise: 4+ years of experience delivering production solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including cloud-native application and data/AI services.
* Technical Depth: Expertise in microservices, cloud-native architectures, event-driven architectures, APIs, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), distributed systems, and secure enterprise integration.
* AI/ML & Analytics: Strong working knowledge of supervised and unsupervised learning, time-series forecasting, optimization, anomaly detection, feature engineering, model evaluation, experimentation, and production inference patterns.
* Data Engineering: Experience with data architectures, data pipelines, data quality, governance, metadata and lineage, feature stores, batch and streaming data, and analytics platforms.
* MLOps / LLMOps: Hands-on experience establishing or governing CI/CD/CT for models, experiment tracking, model registry, automated validation, deployment, observability, drift monitoring, retraining, and lifecycle controls.
* Responsible AI: Experience applying secure and responsible AI practices, including privacy, transparency, explainability, bias and fairness assessment, human oversight, access controls, risk management, and auditability.
* Technology Stack: Hands-on experience with Java, Angular, Python, SQL, Terraform, Postgres, APIGEE, Kubernetes, Docker, serverless technologies, and containerization. Experience with Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, or equivalent cloud services is strongly preferred.
* Engineering Excellence: Thorough knowledge of multi-threading, concurrency, parallel processing, DevSecOps, test automation, and monitoring tools such as Dynatrace or Google Cloud Monitoring.
* Developer Experience: Experience increasing developer productivity by integrating AI agents, coding assistants, reusable platform capabilities, or AI skills into the development lifecycle.
* Leadership Qualities: Proven ability to lead large-scale transformations, apply systems thinking, create psychologically safe teams, influence complex decisions, and earn the respect of strong individual technical talent through competence and mentorship.
* Communication & Business Acumen: Ability to communicate complex technical and AI concepts to executives and business partners, align diverse stakeholders, manage trade-offs, and connect product investments to business outcomes.

**Nice to Have**

* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.
* Experience with Vertex AI, BigQuery, Feature Store, Gemini or other foundation-model platforms, vector search, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, and evaluation frameworks.
* Experience building reusable enterprise platforms and underlying services for data, analytics, and AI capabilities.
* Experience with forecasting, supply chain, order fulfillment, demand planning, optimization, or decision intelligence products.
* Ability to translate product roadmaps into manageable features through quarterly scoping sessions and assist product teams directly with technical blockers.
* Proven ability to identify and mitigate delivery, data, model, security, adoption, and operational risks while assessing overall product health and prompting timely decisions.

description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
11
  
  
**The Role:**
Scrum Master
  
  
**The Team:**
Our Technology Governance & Delivery Enablement team at S&P Dow Jones Indices is responsible for establishing effective portfolio planning and execution patterns in order to drive operational excellence and fostering a culture of collaboration through lean portfolio management and enabling agile ways of working. As a member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in accelerating our technology delivery leveraging agile and lean principles.
  
  
**The Impact:**
We are looking for a motivated individual who is ready to take their career to the next level. This person will play a pivotal role in guiding the teams to adopt Agile practices and methodologies starting with mindset shift to deliver prioritized business value. This person will be responsible to facilitate one to two Scrum teams with focus on team dynamics, continuous learning and agile maturity across teams and ART(s). This person will be responsible for removing any impediments to help the teams achieve their iteration/sprint goals and PI objectives. Will work closely with the Product Manager, Product Owner, Tech leads, UI/UX, security, QE leads and other team members to make sure the product/solution/platform development meets the business needs, aligns with product roadmap and prioritization.
  
  
**The Career Opportunity:**
This role offers immense potential for growth and professional development in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment. You will enjoy the open, transparent culture and the opportunity to:
  
  

* Be part of global teams to deliver innovative solutions to the market
* Further enhance your agile, collaboration and delivery skills with focus on building team’s agility within a large organization
* Build relationships and engage with stakeholders across the organization, managing stakeholder expectations to deliver the best solution

**Responsibilities:**
  
  

* Coach teams on Agile, Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, and built-in quality practices.
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and PI Planning; guide the team through draft planning, backlog readiness, blocker identification, dependency coordination, risk resolution, and team objective alignment to broader OKRs in partnership with other Scrum Masters and the RTE.
* Remove impediments, proactively identify risks, manage dependencies, and improve team flow using Agile metrics; take accountability for timely escalation and resolution of risks, blockers, and bottlenecks that impact iteration goals and PI objectives.
* Drive continuous improvement, self-organization, decision-making, and conflict resolution.
* Create a trusted and safe team environment where team members can openly share inputs, surface concerns, and collaborate constructively while supporting effective decision-making and conflict resolution.
* Represent the team in Scrum-of-Scrums, ART Syncs, Value Stream Syncs, and other cross-team forums; coordinate with Scrum teams, ARTs, RTEs, Product Owners, Product Managers, and technical leads to communicate dependencies, improve transparency, and ensure delivery alignment.
* Partner with Product Managers, Product Owners, and Technical Leads to maintain a healthy backlog by ensuring MVPs, features, and user stories are clear, concise, prioritized, and aligned to business goals, product roadmap, and team readiness.
* Generate and maintain Agile dashboards and metrics that support data-driven decisions, transparency, predictability, and continuous improvement; promote adoption of AI/GenAI practices, including the effective balance of digital and human teams, use of AI agents in team ways of working, and application of GenAI across product and development lifecycles.

**What we are looking for:**
  
  

* 12–15+ years of industry experience, including 5–6 years as a Scrum Master across product teams.
* Experience working in SAFe, value streams, and Agile Release Trains.
* Strong facilitation, conflict resolution, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement skills.
* Ability to understand domain-specific and technical discussions to facilitate Agile events, dependency conversations, risk reviews, and team decision-making in a meaningful way.
* Proven ability to improve Agile execution, delivery predictability, quality, and business value.
* Proven track record of enabling teams to deliver prioritized business value efficiently with a focus on accelerated delivery, enhanced quality, measurable outcomes, and maximum ROI.
* Expertise in Agile metrics, Kanban practices, lean portfolio management, and enterprise software delivery lifecycle.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as Azure DevOps, Confluence, Power BI, MS Teams, SharePoint, JIRA, or VersionOne.
* Excellent organizational, statistical, analytical, problem-solving, written communication, and oral presentation skills.
* Exposure to AI capabilities in Scrum and SAFe practices.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in finance, business management, information technology, or a related field.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
  
  

* Financial industry experience preferred.
* SAFe Scrum Master 6.0 certification required; SASM, PSM, CSM, APM, or CTC certifications are a plus.
* Prior Agile Coach experience and familiarity with BDD, ATDD, TDD, CI/CD, pair programming, automation, and Kaizen preferred.

**Overall Characteristics:**
  
  

* Assertive, industry-aware, and confident in guiding teams on Agile/Scrum principles, SAFe 6.0, Scrum/Kanban with AI-enabled practices, and built-in quality; able to act as a voice of reason and authority, make tough calls, and ensure Agile principles are consistently applied.
* Self-starter who promotes strategic alignment and is methodical, detail-oriented, efficient, organized, and highly productive.
* Creates transparency by bringing the right level of disclosure to appropriate forums, stakeholders, and leadership to build trust and support timely decisions.
* Comfortable using AI to improve productivity, decision-making, and team/product outcomes.

title: Technical Consultant
description:
**Technical Consultant – Fraud & Security Intelligence**
**About The Role**
Help leading financial institutions across Asia Pacific solve complex Fraud and Financial Crime challenges through innovative analytics, AI, and enterprise technology.
  
  
As a Technical Consultant within SAS's Fraud & Security Intelligence practice, you'll work directly with customers to understand their business challenges, lead discovery workshops, design enterprise solutions, and deliver successful transformation programmes across the region.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to combine technical expertise with business consulting while building trusted customer relationships and delivering measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead customer workshops to understand business, functional, and technical requirements.
* Design, implement, and optimize Fraud, Financial Crime, and Compliance solutions that address customer business and regulatory requirements.
* Translate business requirements into scalable solution designs and implementation approaches.
* Deliver end-to-end solution implementation, from requirements analysis and solution configuration through testing, deployment, and post-production support.
* Lead technical workstreams and collaborate with customer business and technology teams to solve complex implementation challenges.
* Build trusted customer relationships by providing technical leadership and consulting throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop reusable delivery assets, best practices, and innovative approaches that improve delivery quality and efficiency.
* Mentor junior consultants and contribute to the growth of the regional consulting practice.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* 4–8 years of consulting, enterprise software implementation, or solution delivery experience. Strong candidates with slightly less experience may also be considered.
* Experience delivering enterprise Fraud, Financial Crime, or Compliance solutions within Banking, Financial Services, FinTech, or Payments organizations.
* Experience leading technical workstreams and working directly with customers, business stakeholders, and technology teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within regional and global delivery teams.
* Willingness to travel across Asia Pacific as required.

**Technical & Domain Expertise**

* Experience implementing enterprise Fraud, Financial Crime, or Compliance solutions.
* Experience with Financial Crime platforms such as SAS, NICE Actimize, Oracle FCCM, FICO, Quantexa, Symphony AI NetReveal, or equivalent enterprise solutions.
* Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, Linux/Unix, ETL, APIs, cloud technologies (including Kubernetes), and enterprise application integration.
* Understanding of Fraud and Financial Crime domains including Payment Fraud, Card Fraud, Digital Banking Fraud, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions Screening, Customer Due Diligence (CDD/KYC), and Financial Crime Investigations.

**Who You Are**
**You are someone who:**

* Enjoys solving complex business and technology challenges.
* Takes ownership and consistently delivers high-quality outcomes.
* Builds trusted relationships through professionalism, credibility, and collaboration.
* Communicates confidently with customers, business stakeholders, and technical teams.
* Has a growth mindset with a passion for continuous learning and mastering new technologies.
* Thrives in collaborative, multicultural consulting environments.
* Is passionate about helping customers combat fraud and financial crime.
* Aspires to become a Solution Architect, Consulting Manager, or Practice Leader.

**Career Growth**
At SAS, you'll work on some of the largest Fraud and Financial Crime transformation programmes across Asia Pacific while collaborating with industry experts and leading financial institutions.
  
  
This role provides an excellent opportunity to build deep expertise across Fraud & Security Intelligence solutions while progressing towards Solution Architect, Project Lead, Consulting Manager, or Practice Leader roles within SAS Professional Services.
  
  
You'll be encouraged to challenge conventional thinking, continuously develop your expertise, and contribute to the growth of one of Asia Pacific's leading Fraud & Security Intelligence consulting practices.

description:

**What You’ll Be Doing**
As a Senior Software Automation and Tools Engineer, you will play a key role in the technical design and implementation of tests for NVIDIA software products, with the goal of identifying defects as early as possible in the software development lifecycle. You will also build tools that accelerate execution workflows for the organization. In this role, you can expect to:
  
  

* Contribute and drive automation initiatives. Build innovative ways to automate and expand our software testing.
* Build tools, utilities, and frameworks in C#/Java/C++/ Python that automate and optimize testing workflows in the GPU domain.
* Leverage AI development tools to accurately create robust test plans and automate test case generation, accelerating test automation, increasing code coverage, and facilitating early detection and precise resolution of bugs.
* Develop automated end-to-end tests for NVIDIA device drivers and SDKs on the Windows platform. Execute automated tests, identify, report, and drive resolution of defects. Measure, analyse, and drive code coverage improvements.
* Stabilize and modularize existing frameworks to latest technologies. Develop applications and tools that bring data-driven insights to development and test workflows.
* Debug issues to identify root causes and provide peer code reviews, with feedback on performance, scalability, and correctness.
* Write maintainable, reliable, and well-documented code.
* Collaborate closely with leadership by generating clear, actionable and impactful progress reports.
* Address complex technical and process challenges with a problem-solving approach.
* Provide mentorship to interns and recently onboarded employees

* B.E./B. Tech degree in Computer Science/IT/Electronics Engineering with strong academics or equivalent experience.
* 5-8 years of programming experience in C#/Java/C++/ Python, including experience with Object-Oriented Programming concepts.
* Significant experience using AI development tools to:

+ Accurately create and automate test cases
+ Boost code coverage across products
+ Detect bugs early in the development lifecycle
+ Facilitate efficient and correct bug fixes

* Extensive knowledge of OS fundamentals, PC hardware, and resolving issues.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with multiple development teams to expand testing scope and improve coverage.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills as well as analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment as part of a high-performing engineering team.

* Prior knowledge of driver components and debugging the internals of driver code.

* Strong logic and problem-solving skills to effectively isolate and regress issues.
* Experience with sophisticated AI or machine learning-based test automation platforms.

title: Software Engineering Manager, Agentic Transformation for Graphics Systems
description:
Agents are changing how all software will be built. Agentic systems can perform substantial engineering work. It is still unproven whether they can be a reliable production capability at graphics systems' quality standards. Meanwhile, teams continue shipping new features, sustaining platforms, and meeting product commitments. Graphics drivers are a difficult proving ground. They involve large codebases, complex hardware-OS interactions, strict performance demands, broad application compatibility, and formal safety obligations in automotive.
  
  
NVIDIA seeks an engineering manager in India to develop a new framework for agentic software development. You will test this model against one of our most fast-paced production software stacks. You will lead a graphics systems team through this transition and continue delivering the necessary product roadmap. Afterwards, you will transform effective practices into a reusable engineering product for other teams. You will grow the people, technology, and operating model together, creating an ambitious, highly engaged team that uses agents to surpass typical capacity. Success goes beyond one team’s transformation; it establishes a production-proven system for software development in the agentic era at NVIDIA.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Develop and launch an end-to-end production model for agentic software development. Apply it to graphics systems, where agents perform engineering tasks from requirements and diagnosis to implementation, validation, review, and release.
* Define the technical strategy and transformation roadmap, turning fast paced agentic capabilities into dependable production execution and steadily growing the work agents complete end to end.
* Keep the team delivering its must-do graphics and display roadmap. This includes new features, platform enablement, performance, stability, and release commitments. At the same time, fundamentally evolve how that work gets done.
* Build an ambitious, highly engaged team that produces outstanding results, nurturing engineers and technical leaders alongside the technology and operating model.
* Transform the established agentic engineering system into a reusable product for other teams. Package its orchestration, skills, tools, evaluations, validators, and operating methods. Collaborate across NVIDIA to encourage adoption with measurable production outcomes.

**What We Need To See**

* Demonstrated experience developing and delivering production software via autonomous engineering systems that include planning, tool application, retrieval, memory, evaluation, and validation, with agents handling a significant portion of actual engineering tasks.
* Demonstrated ability to turn a fast paced and ambiguous technical opportunity into a clear strategy, roadmap, and measurable production system while keeping an existing product roadmap on track.
* 10+ overall years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of engineering management or technical leadership, with a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Strong technical foundations in complex production software, including systems architecture, debugging, validation, CI/CD, and release engineering.
* High-agency, results-focused leadership: you build an environment where people grow, enjoy doing their best work, and use technology to deliver results far beyond the team’s traditional capacity.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Acknowledged advancements in the field of agentic systems, shown through peer-reviewed publications, widely embraced open-source projects, public benchmarks, or other externally validated outcomes.
* Experience with graphics or display driver development and technologies such as Vulkan, OpenGL ES, EGL, SurfaceFlinger, HWC, Gralloc, UMD/KMD drivers, X11, or Wayland.
* Familiarity with NVIDIA DRIVE OS and experience developing safety-critical automotive software using standards such as ISO 26262 and ASIL.
* Meaningful contributions to the Linux kernel, graphics software ecosystem, developer tools, or other broadly adopted systems software.

NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working with us. If you are a creative and autonomous engineering leader who wants to invent how the most demanding production software will be built in the agentic era and prove it by helping real driver teams ship, we would love to hear from you.

title: Application Development Lead (Java) - Senior Vice President
description:
**Job Specification:**
We are seeking a Lead Java Engineer to head the XiP Compute Service (XCS) team — the engine room of Citi's enterprise-scale XiNG Platform (XiP), responsible for orchestrating and executing 1.5 billion risk calculations every day.
  
  
As the lead of the XCS team, you will own the design, development, and evolution of the most performance-critical component within XiP. XiP is Citi's unified risk calculation platform built on the XiNG quantitative libraries standard, and XCS sits at its core — providing the powerful compute paradigms and guardrails that enable calculations to run reliably at massive scale.
  
  
Your team is the engine that daily coordinates hundreds of thousands of pods, consumes tens of thousands of compute nodes, utilises hundreds of TB of memory, and distributes hundreds of millions of calculations across Citi's private cloud and Public cloud infrastructures. The platform is both highly performant and rapidly evolving, and your leadership will be central to driving it to its next generation of scale, efficiency, and capability.
  
  
You will work closely with other software engineers, DevOps, and our customers to define technical strategy and ensure the reliable, secure, and scalable operation of the platform.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Take a lead in defining the long-term strategic direction of the XiP Platform:**
Apply your experience and skills to develop the future versions of the calculation engine. This means making it faster, utilize resources better, and scale to even greater sizes. This means adding new features without impacting performance of the platform in an undesirable manner, as small changes multiplied by millions of calculations have a high cost. This means solving hard problems like transferring small amounts of data to a huge number of machines.
  
  
**Take on the day-to-day leadership of the development team:**
Lead the team's Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives, to ensure a smooth and effective development workflow. Manage the project backlog, prioritize tasks, and coordinate development efforts to align with the product roadmap and strategic goals. Provide hands-on technical leadership, guiding the team in architectural decisions and enforcing coding standards.
  
  
**Serve as advisor or coach to team members, allocating and overseeing work:**
Mentor and guide developers, providing technical advice, code reviews, and career development support. Allocate tasks based on skill sets and project priorities, ensuring balanced workloads and timely delivery. Foster a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment, encouraging best practices and continuous learning.
  
  
**Lead the implementation of changes and improvements to Citi's Risk Calculation Engine:**
Lead the design, development, and implementation of enhancements to the Risk Calculation Engine, focusing on optimizing its distribution mechanisms. Analyze current parallelization strategies, which regularly handle 250,000 hours of compute in a single 90-minute execution, and identify opportunities to further improve efficiency, scalability, and throughput.
  
  
**Plan, coordinate, and execute strategic changes to the engine to reach the next scaling milestone:**
Develop and manage strategic initiatives aimed at scaling the Risk Calculation Engine to meet future business demands. Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure that all scaling efforts are aligned with customer needs.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Should be a Graduate from a recognized University
* 10+ years of professional software development experience with Java.
* Solid experience with Java frameworks (e.g., Spring, Spring Boot, Quarkus).
* Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining large-scale, distributed systems.
* Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with RESTful API design and implementation.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming and design patterns.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments, preferably in a leadership capacity.
* Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and test automation frameworks (e.g., JUnit, Mockito).
* Exposure to NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra) is a plus.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices is a plus.

Looking for an Embedded Software Validation Engineer with expertise in MCAL device drivers, test automation, and automotive standards (ISO 26262/ASPICE). The role involves validating automotive software, driving quality improvements, developing innovative test solutions, and contributing to future technology initiatives on Infineon automotive microcontrollers.
  
  
Your role
  
  
Key responsibilities in your new role
  
  

* Perform software Validation of device drivers (Eg : FLS, FEE, FLSLDR, MCU, SPI, I2C, CAN, LIN, Ethernet, MEM, Timers, ADC, and PWM etc.) and safety software in an independent/ RTOS environment on Infineon's automotive microcontrollers
* Implement, institutionalize and maintain the verification and validation methods and infrastructure (e.g. automation to improve quality and efficiency in terms of cost and time )
* Drive innovation in the form of new advancements (test methods/tools, test automation, test infrastructure) in the team)
* Institutionalize software test processes compliant with Automotive standards (e.g. ISO26262, ASPICE)
* Accountable for overall quality of validation deliverables
* Ownership in reviews, Code /Test reviews.
* Plan and participate in future technologies and projects
* Generate new methods and techniques for better work models

Your profile
  
  
**Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed**

* A minimum of 3 years of experience in Device Driver software testing which includes a good know how of standard software development LifeCycle.
* Experience in AUTOSAR MCAL and exposure to ISO26262 [Expertise in other domains with embedded background more than welcome]
* Embedded system software development or Validation using C, assembly languages.
* Experience in the usage of LabView, NI FPGA, oscilloscopes, logic analysers, power benches etc.
* Experience in embedded system development tools such as compilers, debuggers, static analysers etc.
* Working experience in scripting languages such as Perl, python, C# etc.
* Experience in the development/ maintenance of the test automation and continuous integration frameworks
* Good knowledge of computer architecture (16/32bit), real-time systemS
* Working experience on multicore platforms
* Ability and willingness to work with multi- disciplinary teams.
* Additional skills like Estimation planning, tracking is required on need basis.

#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.

Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Company Description**
Stellar Wave is a brand-building partner focused on a structured yet human approach to positioning, perception, and purpose. The team works as an embedded extension of client organizations, thinking like founders and aligning as long-term partners rather than external vendors. Collaborations are centered on shared ownership, with Stellar Wave operating with the accountability of an in-house team. The company is best suited for organizations seeking genuine investment in their growth and lasting impact, not just transactional services.
  
**Role Description**
The Graphic Designer at Stellar Wave will create visual assets for brand identities, marketing campaigns, digital platforms, and print materials, maintaining consistency with each brand’s strategy and guidelines. Day-to-day responsibilities include designing logos, typography systems, and layout compositions, collaborating with strategists and copywriters, and refining concepts based on feedback. The role involves preparing production-ready files, working closely with clients during reviews, and contributing to the visual evolution of partner brands. This is a full-time, on-site position based in Chennai.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong core design skills in Graphics and Graphic Design, with a solid portfolio showcasing brand-focused work.
* Ability to develop and refine visual identities through Logo Design and Branding.
* Proficiency in Typography, including type selection, hierarchy, and readability for digital and print.
* Hands-on experience with industry-standard design tools (e.g., Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, Figma or similar).
* Attention to detail, ability to interpret brand strategy into visuals, and openness to iterative feedback.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with cross-functional teams and clients on-site in Chennai.
* Relevant academic background in Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or equivalent professional experience.

title: Lead Engineer - Operations & Maintenance Manuals
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Lead Engineer (LE) – Operation & Maintenance Manuals (OMM) will be responsible for ensuring on time delivery of OMM for all the customer projects of the assigned sub-business line within GE Vernova Gas power business; e.g. HDNU (Heavy Duty New Units), Aero Derivatives (Aero), Heavy Duty Services (HDS), SCS (Software & Controls Solutions). They will accomplish the stated objectives through teams of contractors while facilitating their work through establishment of processes, work instructions, Daily management (DM) routines and by leveraging Lean and AI. This role will also involve engaging with cross-functional teams within GE Vernova (e.g. project engineering, project management, vendoc CoE, Project Finance Manager etc.) to set up processes as well as for delivery of OMMs on customer projects.
  
  
The LE – OMM shall also be responsible for implementing OMM strategy in consultation with the OMM workstream leader and CMPD leadership. When asked upon, this position will also contribute to digitization of OMMs which might involve tools, templates, integration with other tools, data migration projects etc. Responsibilities further include developing KPIs and metrics towards OMM bowlers, organizing development of digital visual dashboards that facilitate daily management.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Ensure to capture all “Released” projects for OMM delivery tracking purpose
* Go to Gemba with OMM contractor teams and collect data points towards KPI/metric as well as for problem solving
* Determine need for OMM internal standard work as well as cross-functional QMS work instruction in alignment with OMM work stream leader and prepare a plan for revision/new release
* Create/revise process documents- maps/work instructions either by self or with the help of contractors and OMM workstream leader
* Come up with KPIs, metrics, leading/lagging indicators for OMM and finalize a bowler for assigned sub-business line, in coordination with OMM work stream leader
* Set up cadence for Daily/Weekly management as well as MOR (Monthly Operating Reviews) with relevant stakeholders
* Identify problems via Gemba walks as well as through Daily management/MORs and prepare a list of problems to solve, together with their prioritization
* Take up problem solving with help of relevant stakeholders, using Lean toolkit
* Conceive opportunities within the assigned OMM sub-area to leverage AI/Automation for waste reduction/elimination
* Digitization/Tools: Conceive ideas for challenges facing the current OMM tools and a tools landscape for future; contribute to implementation
* Apply lessons learned to continually improve OMM standard work documents
* Collaborates seamlessly with relevant functions teams for OMM topics

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering/sciences/Documentation/Digitization or equivalent with 8+ years of experience either in power generation industry or in documentation domain
* Prior experience in leading/establishing digital web-based tools for documentation or for other similar engineering usage
* Demonstrated ability to lead organizational initiatives (e.g. Lean- waste elimination or digital tools or similar) in small area of expertise
* Has fair knowledge either of:

+ GE Vernova power generation products (engineering domain)
+ Documentation standards, rules, tools

**Desired Characteristics**

* Ability to proceed with limited inputs/uncertainties; progress over perfection
* Team player; listening and influencing
* Prioritization to work on the items that have highest impact
* Challenges status quo in order to come up with better processes and systems/tools
* Focused on delivering on business imperatives with Safety, Quality, Delivery and Cost (SQDC) in that order
* One team: contributes and coordinates across teams towards business objectives
* Communicates with transparency and urgency as the situation demands
* Presentation skills: ability to articulate problem/context through data
* Work within the guidelines of applicable GE Vernova Policies and Procedures
* Contribute to fulfilling organizational KPIs and Initiatives
* Demonstrated ability in managing several projects across functions (New Product Introduction, New Units, Services, Cost Out, etc.), ensuring On-time Delivery, with high quality and on-budget.
* Strong team player with the ability to effectively work under pressure

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

title: Subject Matter Expert (SME) — Computer Science & Emerging Technologies
description:
**About Calizona Global**

Calizona Global is an education-focused organization dedicated to advancing learning and skills development in technology-driven fields. The company collaborates with academic institutions and industry partners to design contemporary curricula and learning resources that reflect current market needs. It emphasizes quality, innovation, and learner-centered solutions, aiming to bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical application. Team members are encouraged to contribute expertise, share insights, and support the creation of impactful educational experiences. Calizona Global offers opportunities to work on emerging topics and shape the future of technology education

**Role Description**

The Subject Matter Expert (SME) — Computer Science & Emerging Technologies will provide domain expertise to develop and review academic and training content in areas such as programming, data structures, software engineering, artificial intelligence, machine learning, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and other emerging technologies. Day-to-day responsibilities include researching current industry trends, designing course outlines and learning objectives, creating and validating assessment items, and ensuring technical accuracy and pedagogical clarity of all materials. The SME will collaborate with instructional designers, editors, and other stakeholders to align content with curriculum standards and industry expectations, and may participate in workshops or internal reviews to share specialist knowledge. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Chennai, requiring regular coordination with team members and adherence to organizational timelines and quality standards

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in core Computer Science areas, such as algorithms, data structures, operating systems, databases, and software engineering

* Expertise in one or more emerging technologies, for example artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, cloud computing, IoT, blockchain, or cybersecurity

* Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (such as Python, Java, C++, or JavaScript) and familiarity with relevant development tools and frameworks

* Experience in curriculum design, academic content development, technical writing, or instructional design for higher education or professional training

* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, structured, and learner-friendly explanations and assessment items

* Strong research skills, including the ability to stay current with industry trends, standards, and best practices in computer science and emerging technologies

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with careful attention to accuracy, consistency, and detail

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related discipline; relevant certifications in emerging technologies are an advantage

* Ability to work on-site in Chennai, manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

**Required Qualification & Skills**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or a related discipline

* Strong conceptual understanding of core Computer Science subjects and programming

* Demonstrated expertise in multiple technical domains, with the ability to review and validate content across additional subjects

* Experience in curriculum development, technical content creation, academic instruction, software development or technical training

* Strong analytical, documentation, communication and problem-solving skills

* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, structured learning material

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Teaching, mentoring, technical training or EdTech experience

* Experience designing project-based learning programmes for undergraduate students

* Familiarity with Git/GitHub, LMS platforms, coding assessment tools and AI-assisted learning tools

* Relevant industry projects, open-source contributions, technical publications or certifications

**What We Are Looking For**

* Someone who combines technical depth with academic thinking and understands that effective learning should go beyond theory and examinations

**Interested candidates:**
Apply through LinkedIn with your resume and relevant curriculum samples, technical content, project portfolio or GitHub profile, where available

title: System Engineer - Automotive
description:
Location: Chennai

Experience: 6 - 9 years

Work mode: Hybrid

**Job Summary:**

Responsible for system engineering, requirements management, integration, and validation of Connected Car Services for Full Hybrid Vehicle programs. The role involves defining connected vehicle features, managing interfaces between vehicle ECUs, telematics, infotainment, and cloud platforms, and supporting the delivery of telemetry, remote services, diagnostics, and OTA update capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and manage end-to-end requirements for connected vehicle services.
* Develop interface specifications across TCU, IVI, vehicle ECUs, and cloud platforms.
* Design and validate vehicle-to-cloud communication flows for telemetry, remote services, and OTA updates.
* Define signal mapping and communication architecture across CAN-FD, Automotive Ethernet, and SOME/IP networks.
* Manage requirements traceability using DOORS/Polarion.
* Support OTA/FOTA deployment strategy and validation.
* Perform integration, debugging, and root-cause analysis using CANoe, CANalyzer, and Wireshark.
* Collaborate with software, cloud, validation, and powertrain teams throughout the development lifecycle.

**Must Have**

* 6-9 years of experience in Automotive Systems Engineering, Connected Vehicles, Telematics & Infotainment.
* Strong experience in requirements engineering, system specification, interface management, and feature integration.
* Good understanding of Connected Vehicle architecture, including TCU, IVI, vehicle-to-cloud communication, telemetry, remote services, and OTA updates.
* Experience with automotive communication technologies such as CAN, CAN-FD, Automotive Ethernet, SOME/IP, and Diagnostics (UDS).
* Hands-on experience with CANoe, CANalyzer, Wireshark, or similar integration/debug tools.
* Experience with DOORS, Codebeamer, Polarion, or equivalent requirements management tools.
* Strong understanding of Hybrid Vehicle architectures and vehicle data domains such as battery management, SOC/SOH, regenerative braking, and energy management.
* Experience working in Agile environments and ASPICE-based development processes.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and stakeholder communication skills.

title: Assistant Mechanical Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Hindustaan Petroleum Oil and Gas is an energy company operating across the oil and gas value chain, with a focus on safe, reliable, and efficient operations. The organization emphasizes the use of modern engineering practices and technology to support sustainable growth and responsible resource utilization. Teams collaborate across disciplines to improve production processes, asset integrity, and environmental performance. The company offers opportunities for learning, development, and advancement for engineering professionals in a dynamic industrial environment.
  
**Role Description**
The Assistant Mechanical Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Chennai. The role involves supporting the design, analysis, and maintenance of mechanical equipment and systems used in oil and gas operations. Day-to-day tasks include preparing and reviewing mechanical drawings, assisting in equipment selection, coordinating with senior engineers on design calculations, and supporting installation, testing, and commissioning activities. The Assistant Mechanical Engineer will help monitor equipment performance, participate in troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, and assist in implementing preventive and corrective maintenance plans. The role also requires collaboration with cross-functional teams, adherence to safety and quality standards, and documentation of technical reports and project updates.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Mechanical Engineering knowledge and fundamentals tailored to industrial, oil and gas, or energy-sector applications.
* Candidates should possess skills in Machine Design and Computer-Aided Design (CAD) for creating, modifying, and reviewing mechanical components and assemblies.
* Candidates should possess Project Management capabilities to assist in planning, scheduling, coordination, and tracking of mechanical engineering projects.
* Candidates should possess Research and Development (R&D) skills to support process improvements, evaluation of new technologies, and optimization of mechanical systems.
* Relevant qualifications include a bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related field, familiarity with industry standards and safety regulations, and basic knowledge of reliability and maintenance practices.
* Beneficial skills include proficiency with engineering software tools, strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, effective written and verbal communication, and the ability to work in multidisciplinary teams.

title: Discipline Product Engineer (DPE) - Electrical Engineering
description:
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Discipline Product Engineer (DPE) to join our Product Portfolio Management team. The DPE will play a crucial role in managing the lifecycle, requirements, configuration, and roadmap for the solutions in the Electrical Engineering discipline. The DPE role has a specific focus on scale-up and reuse through cross-product platform thinking and discipline-wide consistency, complementing deep ownership within individual Electrical solutions.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Oversee the lifecycle of Discipline Solutions and internal Electrical Engineering tools, ensuring version control, updates, and business continuity, with an emphasis on reuse and scalability across products and applications.
* Translating market and engineering needs into Product Requirement Specifications and drive the Electrical roadmap in coordination with the Global Product Manager and Global Product Specialist, ensuring alignment across products to enable reuse and avoid solution lock-in.
* Maintaining and contribute to the development of Electrical Engineering Solutions and ensure documentation, including user guides and technical references, is current, accessible, and complete, with a focus on standardization of building blocks, tools, and processes for reuse.
* Promoting disruptive innovations including leveraging automation to streamline Electrical Engineering processes, reduce engineering hours, and enhance competitiveness, particularly in scale-up and high-volume scenarios.
* Collaborating with other experts to modularize methods and develop replicable tools that scale across projects, ensuring platform consistency and reuse between products such as Shunt and Series applications (Statcom, Series compensation).
* Monitoring Electrical Engineering performance in tenders, projects and coordinate feedback-driven improvements across teams, identifying systemic patterns and opportunities that strengthen the shared base solutions.
* Aligning with other disciplines and units to maximize solutions and ensure cross-product compatibility and governed deviations that feed learning back to the base.
* Tracking updates in design tools, engage with industry forums, and build networks to support discipline-wide scale-up readiness and reuse.
* Provide guidance in tenders and projects and ensure knowledge transfer across global teams, with focus on consistent application of the Electrical base solutions rather than local adaptations.
* Collaborating and coordinate with the technical area responsible and Subject matter experts to drive continuous improvement and adoption of reliable, product-based solutions.
* Collaborating with product management to establish and sustain the product lifecycle management system (PLM).
* Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

**Your Background**

* BE /M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering or similar experience gained in other business.
* 10 plus years of experience in Electrical Engineering, modularization or engineering products, standardization, design tools (E3 Zuken or similar), PDM system (Siemens team center or similar).
* Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership abilities.
* Experience working with diverse and cross-functional teams.
* Proven experience in product management is highly desirable.
* Strategic, operational, and solution-oriented mindset with a focus on business productivity and efficiency.
* Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required.

title: Service Account Manager

**Job Description**

* Managing assigned customer service requests end-to-end — from initial inquiry and quotation through order fulfillment, delivery, and issue closure.

* Managing the Inquiry to Order (ITO) process for assigned requests, including coordinating commercial and contractual details with internal stakeholders (engineering, operations, logistics, finance).
* Tracking assigned service requests and orders to ensure timely delivery, proactively communicating status updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Coordinating with internal teams (engineering, field service, supply chain) to resolve assigned customer issues, escalations, and technical queries efficiently.

* Communicating clearly with customers throughout the lifecycle of assigned requests, setting expectations and managing follow-ups.

* Applying Six Sigma analytical tools, including Root Cause Analysis (RCA), to support resolution of reliability issues and drive continuous improvement in service delivery.

* Supporting strong working relationships with customers on assigned requests to promote satisfaction and repeat engagement.
* Regularly reporting to the APAC Services Operations Manager on assigned request status, open issues, and service delivery performance.
* Staying informed on customer needs, product/service requirements, and regional market conditions relevant to assigned accounts.
* Collaborating with the Services Product Line team to relay customer feedback and support development of new/improved service offerings.

* Knowledge of Power Electronics, High Voltage Equipment, and PLC systems.
* Experience with quotation preparation and ITO (Inquiry to Order) processes.
* Willingness to travel across India/APAC region as required.

* Prior experience with MV/LV drives, industrial automation systems, and large motors and generators.
* Proficient in both oral and written communication in English (additional regional languages a plus).
* Strong organizational and follow-through skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent service requests.
