description:
We're Hiring | Marketing Head – Digital Marketing & Brand Strategy

**Company:**
Fitoverse Private Limited

**Location:**
Salem, Tamil Nadu (On-site)

**Experience:**
3–4 Years (Mandatory)

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

About Fitoverse

Fitoverse Private Limited is a growing sports infrastructure and management company specializing in the development of football turfs, basketball courts, pickleball courts, tennis courts, and complete sports facilities across India.

Our vision is to build a healthier community through sports and develop a strong sports infrastructure ecosystem.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Marketing Head who can independently lead our marketing department, develop marketing strategies, manage advertising campaigns, build brand visibility, and generate qualified business opportunities.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in performance marketing, SEO, branding, content strategy, and AI-powered marketing.

We are looking for someone who can combine strategic thinking with practical execution and take complete ownership of marketing performance.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Marketing Strategy & Leadership**

* Develop and execute marketing strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Lead and coordinate internal marketing teams, creative professionals, and external agencies.
* Plan marketing budgets, campaigns, and performance targets.
* Build Fitoverse's brand presence across digital platforms.

**2. Performance Marketing & Lead Generation**

* Plan, execute, and optimize Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
* Generate qualified B2B and B2C leads for high-ticket sports infrastructure projects.
* Build lead generation funnels and retargeting campaigns.
* Optimize cost per lead, lead quality, and customer acquisition costs.
* Work with the sales team to improve lead-to-customer conversion rates.

**3. SEO & AI Search Optimization**

* Develop technical, on-page, off-page, and local SEO strategies.
* Improve website traffic and Google search visibility.
* Implement AI SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).
* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and content optimization.

**4. Branding & Content Strategy**

* Develop brand positioning, campaign messaging, and content strategies.
* Manage social media content calendars and creative campaigns.
* Coordinate video production, photography, and advertising creatives.
* Develop case studies, customer testimonials, and brand-building campaigns.

**5. AI Marketing & Automation**

* Identify and implement relevant AI marketing tools.
* Use AI for content creation, creative development, marketing research, and analytics.
* Build AI-assisted marketing workflows and automation systems.
* Stay updated with emerging AI technologies and digital marketing trends.

**6. Analytics & Reporting**

* Monitor marketing performance using GA4, Google Search Console, and Looker Studio.
* Track CPL, CPA, conversion rates, qualified leads, and marketing ROI.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports.
* Make data-driven recommendations to improve marketing results.

Required Skills & Experience

* Minimum 3–4 years of experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, or growth marketing.
* Proven experience managing successful advertising campaigns.
* Hands-on expertise in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
* Working experience with YouTube Ads and LinkedIn Ads.
* Strong understanding of SEO, AI SEO, GEO, and AEO.
* Experience generating high-ticket B2B and B2C leads.
* Knowledge of Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Semrush, or Ahrefs.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Zoho CRM or HubSpot.
* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and AI creative platforms.
* Knowledge of marketing automation tools such as Make, Zapier, or n8n.
* Experience coordinating creative teams and managing marketing budgets.
* Excellent communication, presentation, analytical, and leadership skills.

Who We're Looking For

Someone who has already delivered successful marketing campaigns, understands customer acquisition, thinks creatively, works with data, and can independently manage the marketing department.

Experience in sports, construction, infrastructure, real estate, or other high-ticket industries is an added advantage.

**Candidates must be able to demonstrate previous campaign results, advertising budgets managed, and measurable marketing achievements.**

Why Join Fitoverse?

* Opportunity to lead the marketing department of a growing sports infrastructure company.
* Freedom to develop and implement innovative marketing strategies.
* Opportunity to work with AI-powered marketing technologies.
* Exposure to B2B and B2C marketing across multiple industries.
* Opportunity to contribute directly to the company's growth.

**To Apply:**
Send your resume and previous campaign portfolio to admin@fitoverse.com

title: Manager – Corporate Affairs, Internal Workplace Communications
description:
The Manager, Internal Workplace Communications, is a strategic employee communications partner who will help leaders of Corporate Functions teams translate their priorities, initiatives and employee experience commitments into communications to their teams. At Amgen, Workplace Communications represents Human Resources (HR) and the enterprise-enabling expertise that supports the people who make and deliver our medicines.
  
  
Working across functions and regions, this manager will lead development of communications, advise functional leaders and program teams, and develop audience-centered content that builds employee understanding, business confidence and change adoption.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**
**Internal Communication Strategy and Delivery:**

* Develop and deliver internal communications plans and strategies consistent with Amgen’s global, functional and local communications strategies and aligned with strategic objectives.
* Write, edit and oversee high-quality communications, including leader messages, talking points, intranet content, toolkits, FAQs and presentation materials.
* Partner with Corporate Affairs and functional communicators to align messages, milestones, audiences, channels and leader actions across the enterprise.
* Turn complex business and functional information into concise, employee-centered narratives that explain what is changing, why it matters and what people need to do.
* Manage communications projects and deliverables from intake through delivery, including timeline development, approvals, risk identification and assessment and implementation/publication.
* Proactively identify ongoing communications opportunities and capitalize on existing moments or milestones to further impact strategic communications activities and drive business outcomes.
* Make recommendations to improve enterprise communication tactics and internal channel effectiveness across email, intranet, community platforms, presentations, and similar.
* Maintain a consistent enterprise voice, clear editorial grammar and style standards, and appropriate coordination with Legal, Compliance, HR and other review partners.

**Communication Project Coordination:**

* Build and sustain cooperative relationships with team members across Law, Finance, Human Resources (HR) including Wellness and People, Culture and Engagement (PCE), Digital Technology & Innovation (DTI), Corporate Affairs, Business Development, World Compliance & Business Ethics (WC&BE), and the Results Delivery Office (RDO).
* Find opportunities to create collaboration, particularly between HR and other stakeholders.
* Lead assigned communications workstreams, including planning, tracking, stakeholder coordination and delivery.
* Partner with Corporate Functions teams to develop timelines, workback plans, presentation content and speaker talking points for All Staff meetings.
* Work with internal and external stakeholders (including consulting agency teams) to ensure timely and accurate communication.
* Analyze communication performance and feedback to improve content, channel choices and campaign design.

**Confidentiality & Professionalism:**

* Handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
* Advise and ensure alignment between communications and team leader priorities.
* Demonstrate sound judgment in making day-to-day communications recommendations and escalate high-risk, sensitive or cross-functional decisions appropriately.

**Note that the role and responsibilities may evolve as the business changes and priorities shift.**
**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* Master's of Bachelor’s degree and 8 - 12 years of experience, at least 6 years of direct experience

title: Senior Consultant - Veeva Safety - Managed Services (Remote)
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
  
  
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
  
  
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
  
  
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
  
  
The Role
  
  
**Managed Services**
is provided to our R&D customers after they go live with Veeva applications. We aim to be our customers' trusted partners and ensure they leverage the additional value Veeva applications offer.
  
  
Our
**Managed Services Team**
comprises 90+ consultants in Europe, of which 5+ are in the Safety Team. Due to the rapid growth of our client portfolio, we are growing our team every year and opening many career opportunities for our new and existing employees. We hire people from industry, tech, and consulting, which adds diversity to our team.
  
  
Veeva is looking for Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance consultants to join the Managed Services team and support our Vault Safety solution after implementation.
  
  
**As a Safety Consultant**
, you will support a group of biopharmaceutical customers assigned to you. Your task will be to understand their business processes, provide guidance, discuss Vault changes, and apply all the required configurations. You will also actively collaborate with other teams at Veeva, shape ideas, enhance our delivery model, and work closely with our product management team to communicate the customer’s requirements and meet the evolving needs of the industry.
  
  
**To thrive in this role**
, you are able to adapt and learn new technology. You have been configuring, supporting, or implementing software solutions. You enjoy working with customers, speak fluent English, and have strong communication and presentation skills. You enjoy working in fast paced environments, are a team player and fast learner .
  
  
This is a remote, full-time role with Veeva with occasional travel to the Veeva Hyderabad site.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Help to keep up to date and implement new features within the Veeva Safety suite
* Work closely with customer business and IT staff to understand their requirements
* Think critically to help design the solution your customers request as well as the solution they have not requested but may need
* Act as customer liaison, managing communication between implementation and maintenance teams, customer stakeholders, and internal Veeva Product teams
* Guide customers in adopting Vault and industry best practices as part of post-implementation programs focused on the holistic success of the customer
* Drive change management methodology for our customers switching from on-premises to SaaS solutions

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of life sciences industry experience, with the majority of time spent in the Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance domain and experience in a consulting function
* Knowledge of Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance processes and regulations
* Must have a decent experience writing complex SQL queries on safety data sets
* Should have worked on implementing safety systems like Aris / Argus / Emperica / Commonwealth / RxLogix / or any home-grown safety system
* Proven ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders and ensure delivery to a high degree of satisfaction
* Good to have experience building aggregate and analytical reports on safety data set
* Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal
* Must have worked in an individual contributor capacity in the previous employments
* Ability to act with speed to understand business requirements, create corresponding solution designs, and willingness to “roll up your sleeves” to design and deliver Vault Safety
* Exposure to life sciences compliance and computer systems validation requirements
* Ability to travel for about : 25% of the project time
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent required
* Has the right attitude and mindset to work towards customer success

****Nice to Have****

* Proven track record supporting high impact global system implementation programs as a consultant, business, or IT lead, and/or business sponsor
* Direct experience with Argus and/or other drug safety applications
* Life science, computer science, or related degree
* SaaS/Cloud experience
* Experience in services delivery management and/or systems implementation
* Locality to major life sciences customer hub (Bangalore, IN; Hyderabad, IN)

**Perks & Benefits**

* Health Insurance fully covered for family, including Employee’s parents
* Work anywhere culture which allows flexible work location
* Fitness benefits fully taken care by Veeva
* 1% Charitable giving program

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

title: Associate Manager GES DTS SNOW
description:
**Job title**
–
**Associate**
**Manager**
**GES DTS ServiceNow (SNOW Architect)**
**Location**
–
**Hyderabad, India**
At dsm-firmenich we strive to achieve a world where you don’t have to choose between taste, texture, or health - and can enjoy it all. Our innovative ingredients, expertise, and solutions bridge the gap between the delicious, the nutritious, and the sustainable.
  
  
In this role the ServiceNow Business Analyst/Technical Analyst/Technical Analyst is accountable for translating business needs, process requirements, and stakeholder priorities into clear, actionable requirements for the ServiceNow platform. This role ensures that ServiceNow enhancements, implementations, and platform changes are well defined, business aligned, user focused, and delivered in line with governance, SIAM operating models, and enterprise standards. Acting as a bridge between business stakeholders, process owners, platform teams, architects, and delivery partners, the Business Analyst/Technical Analyst/Technical Analyst drives requirement quality, process clarity, adoption readiness, and successful delivery of ServiceNow capabilities.
  
  
At dsm-firmenich, being a force for good is not optional. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion is a shared responsibility woven into our daily work, benefiting our People, Customers & Communities and driving business value. Equal access to opportunities is a given, belonging is a shared feeling, authenticity is celebrated.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Business Analysis & Requirements Management
* Partner with business stakeholders, process owners, product owners, and platform teams to capture and clarify business requirements for ServiceNow initiatives.
* Translate business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, and backlog items.
* Ensure requirements are complete, testable, prioritized, and aligned with platform standards and out-of-the-box ServiceNow capabilities wherever possible.
* Support demand intake, impact assessment, scope definition, and change prioritization across ServiceNow modules.
* Process Design & ServiceNow Solution Alignment
* Analyze current-state processes and support the design of future-state workflows on the ServiceNow platform.
* Work with architects and functional leads to ensure requirements are translated into practical, scalable, and maintainable ServiceNow solutions.
* Support solution design across modules such as ITSM, HRSD, CSM, SPM, CMDB, ITOM, GRC, Legal Service Delivery, and custom applications as applicable.
* Promote process simplification, standardization, automation, and reuse of platform capabilities.
* Backlog, Delivery & Testing Support
* Maintain and refine the product backlog in collaboration with product owners, scrum teams, and delivery partners.
* Support sprint planning, backlog grooming, requirement walkthroughs, build clarifications, and functional reviews.
* Define and support test scenarios, UAT planning, defect triage, and business validation to ensure delivered solutions meet agreed requirements.
* Track requirement traceability from demand through design, build, testing, deployment, and adoption.
* Governance, Controls & Change Readiness
* Ensure requirements and process designs comply with ServiceNow governance, security, data, audit, and compliance standards.
* Support impact assessments for platform changes, releases, integrations, and process changes.
* Prepare business stakeholders for adoption through process documentation, training inputs, communication support, and transition readiness activities.
* Identify risks, dependencies, open decisions, and requirement gaps early and drive timely resolution.
* Reporting, Insights & Continuous Improvement
* Use ServiceNow data, reports, dashboards, and stakeholder feedback to identify improvement opportunities.
* Support continual service improvement initiatives focused on user experience, automation, operational efficiency, and service quality.
* Contribute to roadmap inputs by identifying recurring pain points, process bottlenecks, and value opportunities.
* Promote data-driven decisions and measurable business outcomes from ServiceNow delivery.
* Stakeholder & Vendor Collaboration
* Build strong working relationships with business stakeholders, process owners, platform owners, architects, SIAM teams, and delivery partners.
* Facilitate workshops, requirement sessions, demos, and decision discussions with clear documentation and follow-through.
* Coordinate with system integrators and internal teams to clarify scope, resolve requirement questions, and validate delivery outputs.
* Act as a trusted functional advisor to stakeholders on ServiceNow process and requirement topics.
* Technical Architecture Requirements
* Define and maintain scalable ServiceNow technical architecture aligned with enterprise standards, platform governance, security requirements, and long-term product roadmap.
* Assess technical feasibility, solution options, integration patterns, data models, and platform impacts for new demands, enhancements, and transformation initiatives.
* Guide configuration versus customization decisions, promote reuse of out-of-the-box capabilities, and ensure solutions remain upgrade-safe, maintainable, and cost-effective.
* Provide technical oversight across integrations, workflows, automation, APIs, data quality, CMDB dependencies, access controls, and environment management.
* Review solution designs, technical specifications, release plans, and deployment readiness to manage risks, dependencies, performance, resilience, and compliance obligations.

**We bring**

* A supportive environment where you’re empowered to grow and share your ideas.
* An inclusive and multicultural team with respect for everyone
* A dynamic work environment with many challenges that give you the possibility to work autonomously and with a team in finding the right solutions.

**You bring**

* 6+ years of experience as a Business Analyst/Technical Analyst, Functional Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role in enterprise IT platforms.
* Strong experience working with ServiceNow implementations, enhancements, or platform operations.
* Good understanding of ITSM processes such as Incident, Request, Problem, Change, Knowledge, Service Catalog, and CMDB; exposure to HRSD, CSM, SPM, ITOM, GRC, or Legal Service Delivery is an advantage.
* Proven ability to write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business requirements, and functional specifications.
* Experience working in Agile delivery models, sprint ceremonies, backlog management, UAT, and release support.
* Strong stakeholder management, workshop facilitation, documentation, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to balance business value, user experience, process standardization, governance, and delivery practicality.

**About Dsm-firmenich**
At dsm-firmenich, we don’t just meet expectations – we go beyond them.
  
  
Join our global team powered by science, creativity, and a shared purpose: to bring progress to life.
  
  
  
  
From elevating health to making fortified food and sustainable skincare, the impact of your work here will be felt by millions – every single day. Whether it’s fragrance that helps you focus, alternative meat that’s better for the planet, or reducing sugar without losing flavor, this is where you help shape the future of nutrition, health, and beauty for everyone, everywhere.
  
  
And while you’re making a difference, we’ll make sure you’re growing too. With learning that never stops, a culture that lifts you up and the freedom to move across businesses, teams, and borders. Your voice matters here. And your ideas? They’re essential to our future.
  
  
Because real progress only happens when we
**go beyond, together.**
**Our Application Process**
Interested in this position? Please apply on-line by uploading your resume in English via our career portal (www. dsm-firmenich.com/careers).
**For further information, please contact Kanika Maloo, Talent Acquisition Partner (kanika.maloo@dsm-firmenich.com).**
**DEI and equal opportunity statement**

title: IT Quality-Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients
  
  
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
  
  
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will lead the execution of complex or novel assignments requiring strategic planning and development of new and/or improved validation techniques, deviations, and procedures. In this position you will supervise validation activities through internal audits and conduct risk assessments to identify the need for requalification and establish policies for computer system re-validation.
  
  
This individual will actively participate during all phases of qualification/validation of computerized systems: evaluate projects; provide guidance and technical information to others (lead qualification/validation activities); determine and establish requirements for qualification/validation of each individual system/equipment; formulate independent decisions related to qualification/verification activities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Review validation/qualification packages of computerized systems for completeness and accuracy, sound rationale, Regulatory expectations, compliance with validation policies and procedures, and accurate data analysis. Serve as Owner or QA Contact for Minor and Major Deviations. Compare results against acceptance criteria and work with appropriate departments to resolve exceptions and deviations. Bring critical exceptions or deviations to management’s attention and initiate and enforce necessary improvements and corrections to established systems and processes. Initiate, implement, and track completion of Change Control and deviation requests related to computer systems. Participation and support of regulatory inspections.
  
  
Validation
  
  

* Demonstrated expertise in risk-based validation (RBV) methodologies, providing execution and guidance to cross-functional teams on complex GxP projects while ensuring alignment with Computer Software Assurance (CSA) principles.
* Proven ability to serve as the QA point of contact for assigned GxP systems, ensuring timely review and approval of documentation in compliance with Amgen’s standard operating procedures and applicable regulatory standards.
* Change Control Management: Drive Change Request (CR) and Change Control processes, from initiation through approval, ensuring accurate system impact assessment and documentation. (e.g Trackwise/Veeva , ServiceNow)
* Validation Documentation: Review and approve all validation documentation, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and internal quality standards.
* Requirement Specifications & Test Protocols: Review and approve Requirement Specifications, Design Specifications, Test Protocols, Validation Plans, Summary Reports, and Requirement Traceability Matrices.
* System Life Cycle Documents: Review and approve System Life Cycle Documents (e.g., test protocols) prior to their use in production.
* Data Integrity Assessments: Review and approve Data Integrity Assessments to ensure data is accurate and complies with regulatory standards.

Periodic Review/Audit Trail
  
  

* System Periodic Reviews & Audit Trails: Review and approve periodic system reviews and audit trail reports to ensure system integrity and compliance.

**Supplier**
Management
  
  

* Supplier Evaluations: Provide support for supplier evaluations as needed, ensuring suppliers meet quality, compliance, and performance standards.

**Deviation & CAPA Management:**

* Initiate and manage deviations (major and minor) as required. Serve as the primary QA contact for deviations, ensuring proper investigation and resolution.
* Act as the quality reviewer and approve for problem records in ServiceNow, ensuring that all records meet internal quality standards.
* CAPA & Effectiveness Verification (EV): Serve as the QA contact or owner for Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) and Effectiveness Verification (EV) records, ensuring timely and effective resolution.

Responsible as a Business Owner for overseeing and managing specific GxP Computerized Systems programs and projects, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and alignment with business objectives. Independently develop solutions that are thorough, practical and consistent with functional objectives.
  
  
Review and approve operational and administrative Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions, ensuring alignment with regulatory and quality standards.
  
  
Apply analytical skills to evaluate complex problems, utilizing both qualitative and quantitative data, including trend analysis, to develop effective solutions.
  
  
Contributes to continuous improvement efforts and initiatives.
  
  
Assists with training initiatives and strategy as required.
  
  
Provides support for the Management Review Process when needed.
  
  
Supports the Integrated Systems Assessment (ISA) Process as necessary.
  
  
Participates in and aids with regulatory inspections as required.
  
  
The individual will be required to work from our office located in Hyderabad India (Amgen India-AIN). The candidate will be required to go into the office as dictated by the site policy.
  
  
**What We Expect From You**
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree with a minimum of 7 years experience in Software and Systems Quality assurance OR
* Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 10 years of Software and Systems Quality assurance experience

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Strong understanding of the regulations outlined in 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP standards.
* Proven experience in the validation of computerized systems (GxP).
* Strong understanding and application of GxP regulations (GMP, GLP, GCP, GPvP, GDP).
* Experience managing quality assurance processes, including Major and Minor Deviations.
* Demonstrated ability to handle and resolve complex quality issues using analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong decision-making abilities with the capacity to drive tasks to completion.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Leadership skills with experience leading projects, teams, or tasks.
* Experience with tools and systems such as HP ALM, Jira, Confluence, Track Wise , Documentation Management Systems, LIMS, SAP and Maximo.
* Broad technical expertise within specialty area and familiarity with industry standards.
* Ability to provide training, guidance, and contribute to team quality.
* Works closely with senior staff and external experts to extend capabilities and enhance performance.

**Data Analysis Skills (Good To Have)-**

* Perform data analysis to create impactful visuals and dashboards for informed decision-making.
* Design clear, engaging charts and graphics for presentations and reports.
* Utilize tools like Power BI, Smartsheet, or similar to develop interactive, data-driven visuals.
* Translate complex data into concise, compelling visual stories for diverse audiences.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align visual outputs with business goals.

**What You Can Expect Of Us**
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.
  
  
In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.
  
  
**Apply now**
**for a career that defies imagination**
Objects in your future are closer than they appear. Join us.
  
  
**careers.amgen.com**
As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.
  
  
Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Junior Engineer (JE) – Drone Integration & Testing
description:
**Company Description**
ASP Aerotech Private Limited is an Indian aerospace technology company specializing in the design, development, and manufacturing of unmanned aerial systems (UAS), drones, aerospace electronics, and embedded technologies. The organization focuses on advancing indigenous aerospace capabilities and contributing to India’s self-reliance in unmanned systems through mission-oriented innovation and reliable engineering. ASP Aerotech views unmanned systems as integrated platforms, combining airframes, flight computers, power and propulsion, payload integration, navigation, and secure data communication. Its technology spans from compact micro-drones to long-endurance fixed-wing systems for applications such as surveillance, inspection, mapping, and emergency response. The company emphasizes research, development, and practical mission requirements to deliver dependable, purpose-built solutions designed in India and engineered for the mission.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a hands-on Junior Engineer to build, integrate and test multirotor and fixed-wing drones. Working with our senior engineers, you will assemble airframes, configure flight controllers and ESCs, integrate sensors, create SolidWorks parts and support flight trials. This role suits an engineer who has already built and flown drones and wants to grow into full platform design.

**Position**

Junior Engineer (JE) – Drone Integration & Testing

**Department**

Engineering / Production & R&D

**Location**

Greater Noida – on-site, with field trials as required

**Employment type**

Full-time

**Experience**

0–2 years (freshers with strong hands-on drone projects are encouraged to apply)

**Salary**

As per industry standards

**Reports to**

Senior / Mid-Level Drone Engineer

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Build and integration**

•      Assemble, wire and integrate multirotor and fixed-wing drones on the production line and in R&D, following build standards and checklists.

•      Install and configure flight controllers, ESCs, motors, GNSS, telemetry radios and power systems.

•      Integrate payloads and sensors such as gimbal cameras, LiDAR and companion computers under senior guidance.

•      Solder, crimp and build harnesses to a production-quality standard; follow ESD practices.

**Design support**

•      Create and modify 3D parts, mounts and enclosures in SolidWorks; prepare drawings for 3D printing and CNC cutting.

•      Support propulsion and battery selection by running bench and thrust tests and recording results.

**Software and configuration**

•      Set up and tune ArduPilot parameters; use Mission Planner / QGroundControl for calibration, mission planning and log review.

•      Write and maintain Python scripts for testing, MAVLink communication and data logging.

•      Assist with companion-computer setup for edge-AI detection and tracking applications.

**Testing, QC and documentation**

•      Carry out pre-flight checks, hover-cage tests and field flight trials; analyse flight logs and report issues.

•      Perform quality checks on finished drones and maintain build, test and configuration records.

•      Troubleshoot and repair drones returned from the field.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

**Hardware**

1.    Hands-on experience building and flying at least one multirotor drone.

2.    Working knowledge of flight controller, ESC, motor and battery (LiPo / Li-ion) setup.

3.    Good soldering, wiring and electronics fault-finding skills; ability to use a multimeter and power supply.

4.    Basic understanding of sensors (GNSS, IMU, camera) and RF telemetry links.

**Software and design**

1.    Hands-on experience with ArduPilot (or PX4) and Mission Planner / QGroundControl.

2.    Programming in Python (mandatory); basic C/C++.

3.    SolidWorks (mandatory) and AutoCAD for parts and drawings.

4.    Basic understanding of MAVLink.

**Good to have**

•      Fixed-wing or VTOL build experience.

•      Lua scripting in ArduPilot.

•      Edge-AI experience on Jetson / Raspberry Pi (e.g., YOLO-based detection).

title: MES Executive – Implementation & Operations
description:

**PREWAL Studio Private Limited**

Gurugram, Haryana

Full-time | On-site

**Experience Required:**
0–2 Years

**Reporting to :**
Ojaswi Kumar (Founders Office)

About PREWAL Studio :

PREWAL Studio Private Limited is a garment manufacturing and export company based in Gurugram, India.

As part of our ongoing efforts to strengthen operational efficiency, transparency, and data-driven decision-making, we are implementing a
**Manufacturing Execution System (MES)**
across our organisation.

We are looking for a smart, technically capable, and proactive individual to help us successfully implement, manage, and optimise this system.

About the Role :

We are hiring an
**MES Executive – Implementation & Operations**
who will be responsible for coordinating the implementation, daily management, monitoring, and effective utilisation of our Manufacturing Execution System across different departments.

The selected candidate will work closely with the Founder's Office, department heads, production teams, and external technology partners to ensure the system functions smoothly and is effectively adopted across the organisation.

This is a hands-on role combining
**technology, manufacturing operations, data analysis, troubleshooting, and cross-departmental coordination**
.

**We are not looking for someone who merely enters data into software. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, understands how systems work, identifies problems, and ensures that technology is being used effectively.**

Key Responsibilities:-
  

**1. MES Implementation & System Management**

* Coordinate the implementation and rollout of the company's Manufacturing Execution System.
* Work closely with external technology partners to support system configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment.
* Understand existing manufacturing workflows and help integrate them into the MES.
* Assist in maintaining system master data, user accounts, access permissions, and configuration settings.
* Act as the primary internal point of contact for MES-related coordination and operational issues.

**2. Daily System Operations & Monitoring**

* Oversee the day-to-day functioning of the MES across relevant departments.
* Monitor whether employees are correctly and consistently using the system.
* Identify missing entries, incorrect data, process gaps, and operational discrepancies.
* Coordinate with department heads to ensure timely updates and accurate information.
* Verify that system records are aligned with actual manufacturing operations.

**3. Technical Support & Troubleshooting**

* Provide first-level technical support to employees using the MES.
* Troubleshoot basic software, login, connectivity, and system-related issues.
* Identify recurring technical problems and coordinate with external support teams for resolution.
* Maintain records of system issues, their status, and corrective actions.
* Follow up proactively to ensure that reported issues are resolved.

**4. Data Management, Analysis & Reporting**

* Monitor system dashboards, production data, and operational reports.
* Analyse information to identify discrepancies, delays, and potential operational bottlenecks.
* Prepare regular MIS reports and operational summaries for management.
* Use Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for data verification, reconciliation, and analysis.
* Highlight critical issues and provide actionable insights to improve operational efficiency.

**5. Training & Cross-Departmental Coordination**

* Assist in training employees on the correct usage of the MES.
* Coordinate with teams across production, cutting, sewing, finishing, quality, stores, merchandising, and other relevant departments.
* Ensure employees understand their respective responsibilities within the system.
* Support the adoption of standardised digital workflows.
* Work with department heads to resolve issues affecting system usage and data accuracy.

**6. Process Improvement & System Optimisation**

* Identify opportunities to improve system utilisation and operational workflows.
* Suggest improvements in data collection, reporting, and process efficiency.
* Help develop simple guidelines and documentation for employees.
* Monitor system adoption and recommend corrective actions wherever necessary.
* Support the company's broader digital transformation initiatives.

Required Qualifications & Skills :-
  

* **0–2 years of professional experience.**
  Smart fresh graduates with strong technical aptitude are encouraged to apply.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Applications, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, Operations, or a related field. Candidates with equivalent practical skills will also be considered.
* Strong computer proficiency and ability to quickly understand unfamiliar software applications.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, filters, lookups, and basic data analysis.
* Strong logical reasoning, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to troubleshoot basic software-related issues independently.
* Good communication, coordination, and follow-up skills.
* Strong attention to detail, organisational ability, and sense of ownership.
* Willingness to work in a manufacturing environment and coordinate regularly with factory-floor employees.

Preferred Qualifications :-
  

The following will be considered significant advantages but are
**not mandatory**
:

* Previous experience or internship exposure in garment manufacturing, apparel exports, textiles, or factory operations.
* Familiarity with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), or other business management software.
* Basic understanding of garment manufacturing processes, production tracking, inventory, and quality management.
* Experience in software implementation, technical support, or system administration.
* Experience preparing MIS reports, dashboards, or analysing operational data.
* Knowledge of advanced Excel, PivotTables, Power BI, SQL, or similar tools.
* Previous experience coordinating with software vendors or training employees on digital systems.

What We Offer :
  

* **Company-wide exposure:**
  Work on a technology initiative involving multiple business functions.
* **Direct management interaction:**
  Work closely with the Founder's Office and departmental leadership.
* **Hands-on learning:**
  Gain practical exposure to manufacturing operations, business systems, and process digitisation.
* **Meaningful responsibility:**
  Help manage a technology platform critical to the company's daily operations.
* **Professional growth:**
  Build valuable experience in manufacturing technology, operational analytics, and digital transformation.

Who Should Apply?

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

* Are naturally curious about technology and enjoy understanding how software works.
* Can learn new systems quickly and independently.
* Enjoy solving technical and operational problems.
* Are comfortable working with both computers and people.
* Are organised, proactive, and detail-oriented.
* Take responsibility for solving problems rather than simply reporting them.
* Want to build a career combining technology, analytics, and manufacturing operations.

**Prior MES experience is not mandatory. Strong technical aptitude, problem-solving ability, and willingness to learn are far more important.**

**LinkedIn Easy Apply**

title: Application Specialist - SAP PP, QM, Digital Manufacturing
description:
As an Application Specialist, you will help run, maintain and develop SAP-supported production processes across Production Planning (PP), Quality Management (QM) and Digital Manufacturing. You’ll focus on SAP S/4HANA and SAP Digital Manufacturing, helping ensure our production operations are robust, efficient and aligned with business needs.
  
  
You’ll work at the intersection of technology and business, collaborating with teams in India and internationally. You’ll also support the transition of activities from Denmark to India, sharing knowledge and helping build strong, sustainable ways of working.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Run, maintain and develop SAP-supported production processes using SAP S/4HANA and SAP Digital Manufacturing.
* Provide hands-on configuration and support for SAP PP, QM and Digital Manufacturing, taking a service-minded approach and maintaining clear solution documentation.
* Deliver and stabilise Topsoe’s production-supported processes, working with Global Process Owners (GPOs) to support alignment with global business processes.
* Manage minor projects and change requests independently, and contribute as a functional lead on larger initiatives.
* Support knowledge transfer and the transition of activities from Denmark to India.
* Develop deep expertise in the SAP production area, share knowledge with colleagues and drive continuous improvement in our SAP solutions.
* Keep stakeholders informed about solutions, progress and issues through clear verbal and written communication.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 5–7 years of relevant SAP experience in Production Planning, Quality Management and/or Digital Manufacturing.
* Hands-on experience as an SAP functional consultant, including practical experience with SAP S/4HANA. Experience with SAP Digital Manufacturing is an advantage.
* Experience working as an SAP consultant, including direct client interaction and project implementation. Experience supporting clients or delivering implementations in the European Union is an advantage.
* Strong SAP functional skills. Experience with middleware such as SAP PCo or SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), and technical skills in Java or JavaScript, will be an advantage.
* The ability to work collaboratively, share knowledge and contribute proactively to high-quality SAP consulting and support.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain solutions, progress and issues clearly to different audiences.

You’ll bring a self-driven, proactive approach and a commitment to making Topsoe’s SAP solutions as effective and reliable as possible. This is an opportunity to contribute to important production processes while working with diverse teams across locations.
  
  
**Why Join Us**
At Topsoe, you will join a team of passionate problem solvers dedicated to shaping a more sustainable future. Collaboration and respect are at the heart of our culture, where every idea is valued and can drive real change. As a global leader in advanced technology for the energy transition, we offer you the chance to make a direct impact, work on exciting international projects, and develop your leadership skills in a supportive and innovative environment. You will be part of a workplace that values high standards, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Your expertise will help us deliver meaningful solutions and drive progress together, while you enjoy opportunities for personal and professional development in a truly global setting.
  
  
**Your New Team**
You will join Global IT, Corporate Applications department, and sub-team of: Global Supply (GS) IT Services. The department is responsible for running and maintaining support for IT systems supporting Topsoe GS related processes across: Procurement, Production Planning, Manufacturing. Quality, Maintenance, Warehouse, Logistics, and HSE.
  
  
The IT system support is largely based on SAP technology. The target for the unit is to continuously serve Topsoe GS mission including supporting business productivity targets by offering secure and stable solutions, as well as continuously introduction new technology including AI, while adhering to the SAP roadmap. The SAP organization consists of ~20 deeply skilled SAP colleagues who are experts in functional and technical areas. The team is based in Denmark and India supporting the global organization.
  
  
**How You Can Apply**
If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English.
  
  
**Application deadline:**
08-11-2026.
  
  
You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying. Please also avoid the use of photos in your CV. Both of these measures are to ensure a fair and unbiased process
  
  
We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.
  
  
To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.
  
  
*To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding.*
As part of our recruitment activities, we engage an external recruitment agency located in Poland. In connection with its support of the recruitment process, the agency may process applicants’ personal data on our behalf and in compliance with applicable data protection laws, including GDPR where relevant.
  
  
**About Us**
Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.
  
  
Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.
  
  
We offer world-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.
  
  
We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, with around 2,500 employees serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com.

title: Knowledge Management Associate
description:
**Knowledge Management Associate**

**Location:**
Gurgaon, Haryana, India

**Experience:**
3–5 years

**About the Company**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global professional services firm known for entrepreneurial, action-oriented professionals who take a hands-on approach to solving complex client problems. Its culture is guided by Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity. In 2023, A&M established a Global Capability Center in India to expand specialized talent, accelerate delivery, enable automation, and support global business units across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. The Gurgaon-based center partners with consulting case teams on end-to-end delivery and thought leadership rather than operating as a traditional back-office function. It brings together consulting and industry professionals across sectors including Consumer & Retail, Healthcare, Software & Technology, Automotive & Industrials, Hospitality & Leisure, Energy & Natural Resources, and Financial Services. The center is growing rapidly and already has more than 900 team members.

**About the Role**

Own the quality, usability, and adoption of knowledge management content and SharePoint Online solutions supporting A&M’s consulting business. You will work within the Global AI and Knowledge Innovation Organization alongside KM Business Partners to translate business needs into structured sites, pages, lists, workflows, and user-facing documentation. The role combines SharePoint Online creation, development, and administration with content governance, document tagging, document sanitization, testing, rollout, and hypercare support. You will coordinate with stakeholders across business units, maintain clear action tracking, and ensure knowledge products remain accurate, discoverable, and aligned with evolving processes and platform capabilities. This is a hands-on role for a polished communicator who can work independently, manage competing priorities, and improve the way practitioners access knowledge and AI-enabled tools. Candidates must bring relevant experience from an MBB firm, Big Four organization, or another professional services environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own SharePoint Online site, page, and list creation, development, administration, and maintenance, applying consistent information architecture, navigation, permissions, usability, and visual standards.
* Govern knowledge content through accurate document tagging, sanitization, organization, metadata maintenance, and quality checks that improve discoverability, reuse, compliance, and practitioner confidence.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing for new KM tools and platform features by preparing test plans, tracking defects, consolidating feedback, and driving issues toward resolution.
* Enable successful rollouts through clear user guides, process documentation, stakeholder communications, and responsive hypercare support that increases adoption and reduces operational friction.
* Support KM Business Partners with stakeholder meetings by managing schedules, preparing materials, recording decisions, tracking actions, and maintaining transparent follow-through across initiatives.
* Build trusted relationships with consulting business units, senior stakeholders, and KM colleagues, translating requirements into practical solutions while keeping delivery risks, dependencies, and priorities visible.
* Contribute beyond immediate responsibilities when needed, adapting quickly to shifting timelines and helping the wider KM team deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Advanced hands-on capability in SharePoint Online creation, development, and administration is mandatory, including site and page design, list maintenance, navigation, structure, and content management.
* Practical experience with document tagging, metadata, document sanitization, content organization, quality assurance, user acceptance testing, process documentation, and rollout or hypercare support is required.
* Strong Microsoft 365 capability and polished English communication are essential, with the ability to explain information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences and engage senior stakeholders.
* Professional services experience from an MBB firm, Big Four organization, or comparable professional services employer is mandatory for this role.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, judgment, problem-solving, prioritization, and follow-through are required to manage multiple knowledge initiatives independently.
* Salesforce exposure and additional languages such as Portuguese, Mandarin, Cantonese, Japanese, or Korean would be beneficial but are not required.

**Additional Plus**

* Experience supporting AI-enabled knowledge tools, digital workplace platforms, or enterprise content initiatives would strengthen your ability to contribute to GAIKO’s innovation agenda.
* SharePoint information architecture, governance, permissions, workflow, or adoption-focused experience would help improve the consistency and scalability of KM solutions.
* Exposure to consulting case delivery, thought leadership, or cross-geography stakeholder environments would be useful when translating business needs into practical knowledge products.

**What You'll Bring**

* You bring three to five years of experience in knowledge management, content management, digital workplace administration, or a related professional services environment, ideally from an MBB firm, Big Four organization, or comparable professional services organization. SharePoint Online is a non-negotiable capability: you should be able to create, develop, administer, and maintain sites, pages, and lists rather than only update existing content.
* You have practical experience with document tagging, document sanitization, content organization, metadata, and quality assurance, and you understand how disciplined governance improves searchability, reuse, and trust. You are comfortable facilitating UAT, consolidating feedback, documenting processes, supporting launches, and providing structured hypercare.
* Your communication is polished, concise, and confident across technical and non-technical audiences, including senior stakeholders. You organize work rigorously, close actions reliably, surface risks early, and remain adaptable when priorities or timelines shift.
* A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Technology, Library Science, or a related field supports your ability to connect business requirements with practical platform solutions. You work independently while keeping collaborators informed and contributing positively beyond your immediate remit.

**Why Join Us**

* Join a growing global capability center where knowledge management directly supports consulting case delivery, thought leadership, AI enablement, and practitioner productivity across major markets.

title: Content Curation Specialist
description:
**Knowledge Management Associate / Content Curation Specialist**

**Location:**
Gurgaon, Haryana, India

**Experience:**
3–5 years

**About the Company**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global professional services firm known for entrepreneurial, action-oriented professionals who take a hands-on approach to solving complex client problems. Its culture is guided by Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity. In 2023, A&M established a Global Capability Center in India to expand specialized talent, accelerate delivery, enable automation, and support global business units across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. The Gurgaon-based center partners with consulting case teams on end-to-end delivery and thought leadership rather than operating as a traditional back-office function. It brings together consulting and industry professionals across sectors including Consumer & Retail, Healthcare, Software & Technology, Automotive & Industrials, Hospitality & Leisure, Energy & Natural Resources, and Financial Services. The center is growing rapidly and already has more than 900 team members.

**About the Role**

Own the quality, usability, and adoption of knowledge management content and SharePoint Online solutions supporting A&M’s consulting business. You will work within the Global AI and Knowledge Innovation Organization alongside KM Business Partners to translate business needs into structured sites, pages, lists, workflows, and user-facing documentation. The role combines SharePoint Online creation, development, and administration with content governance, document tagging, document sanitization, testing, rollout, and hypercare support. You will coordinate with stakeholders across business units, maintain clear action tracking, and ensure knowledge products remain accurate, discoverable, and aligned with evolving processes and platform capabilities. This is a hands-on role for a polished communicator who can work independently, manage competing priorities, and improve the way practitioners access knowledge and AI-enabled tools. Candidates must bring relevant experience from an MBB firm, Big Four organization, or another professional services environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own SharePoint Online site, page, and list creation, development, administration, and maintenance, applying consistent information architecture, navigation, permissions, usability, and visual standards.
* Govern knowledge content through accurate document tagging, sanitization, organization, metadata maintenance, and quality checks that improve discoverability, reuse, compliance, and practitioner confidence.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing for new KM tools and platform features by preparing test plans, tracking defects, consolidating feedback, and driving issues toward resolution.
* Enable successful rollouts through clear user guides, process documentation, stakeholder communications, and responsive hypercare support that increases adoption and reduces operational friction.
* Support KM Business Partners with stakeholder meetings by managing schedules, preparing materials, recording decisions, tracking actions, and maintaining transparent follow-through across initiatives.
* Build trusted relationships with consulting business units, senior stakeholders, and KM colleagues, translating requirements into practical solutions while keeping delivery risks, dependencies, and priorities visible.
* Contribute beyond immediate responsibilities when needed, adapting quickly to shifting timelines and helping the wider KM team deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Advanced hands-on capability in SharePoint Online creation, development, and administration is mandatory, including site and page design, list maintenance, navigation, structure, and content management.
* Practical experience with document tagging, metadata, document sanitization, content organization, quality assurance, user acceptance testing, process documentation, and rollout or hypercare support is required.
* Strong Microsoft 365 capability and polished English communication are essential, with the ability to explain information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences and engage senior stakeholders.
* Professional services experience from an MBB firm, Big Four organization, or comparable professional services employer is mandatory for this role.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, judgment, problem-solving, prioritization, and follow-through are required to manage multiple knowledge initiatives independently.
* Salesforce exposure and additional languages such as Portuguese, Mandarin, Cantonese, Japanese, or Korean would be beneficial but are not required.

**Additional Plus**

* Experience supporting AI-enabled knowledge tools, digital workplace platforms, or enterprise content initiatives would strengthen your ability to contribute to GAIKO’s innovation agenda.
* SharePoint information architecture, governance, permissions, workflow, or adoption-focused experience would help improve the consistency and scalability of KM solutions.
* Exposure to consulting case delivery, thought leadership, or cross-geography stakeholder environments would be useful when translating business needs into practical knowledge products.

**What You'll Bring**

* You bring three to five years of experience in knowledge management, content management, digital workplace administration, or a related professional services environment, ideally from an MBB firm, Big Four organization, or comparable professional services organization. SharePoint Online is a non-negotiable capability: you should be able to create, develop, administer, and maintain sites, pages, and lists rather than only update existing content.

You are comfortable facilitating UAT, consolidating feedback, documenting processes, supporting launches, and providing structured hypercare.
* Your communication is polished, concise, and confident across technical and non-technical audiences, including senior stakeholders. You organize work rigorously, close actions reliably, surface risks early, and remain adaptable when priorities or timelines shift.
* A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Technology, Library Science, or a related field supports your ability to connect business requirements with practical platform solutions. You work independently while keeping collaborators informed and contributing positively beyond your immediate remit.

title: I&P GN - SC&E – Analyst - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
description:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.
  
  
You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.
  
  
**THE WORK**
Utilize Relevant AI Tools Across All Tasks And Deliverable Creation, Including The Creation Of Agents And Other Tools To Help Facilitate
  
  
**Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development**

* Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states.
* Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context.
* Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools.
* Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives.

**Client Engagement & Advisory Support**

* Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions.
* Prepare client-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders.
* Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams.
* Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples.

**Data & AI Foundations**

* Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems.
* Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations.
* Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows.
* Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

title: Lead- Data Quality & Governance
description:
**OUR STORY**
**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**
**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**
**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**
**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**
**Role Overview**
STMicroelectronics is seeking a highly organized and proactive Data Governance & Quality Lead to drive enterprise-wide data quality, governance, and process documentation initiatives across People Function.
  
  
This role will be responsible for establishing and maintaining data governance frameworks, standardizing master and transactional data across regions and systems, defining data ownership and maintenance policies, and implementing robust data quality controls. In parallel, the role will ensure that global policies, procedures, and standard operating processes (SOPs) remain accurate, current, and aligned with evolving business requirements.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong project management capabilities with process excellence, stakeholder management, and data governance expertise to enable operational efficiency, compliance, and future-ready self-service capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and implement enterprise-wide data governance standards and frameworks for People Function
* Establish data ownership, stewardship, and accountability models across teams.
* Drive harmonization and standardization of master and operational data across regions and systems.
* Process Documentation & Knowledge Governance
* Develop and maintain data dictionaries, business rules, and data standards.
* Define data creation, modification, approval, and maintenance processes.
* Implement data quality monitoring mechanisms, KPIs, dashboards, and periodic audits.
* Identify data quality gaps and lead remediation initiatives with business and Digital Transformation & IT stakeholders.
* Ensure consistency and integrity of critical business data throughout its lifecycle.
* Partner with system owners and digital teams to embed governance controls into business applications and workflows.
* Own the governance framework for global policies, SOPs, work instructions, and process documentation.
* Ensure documentation remains current, accurate, compliant, and aligned with operational practices.
* Define review cycles, approval workflows, and document control standards.
* Drive continuous improvement of process documentation quality and usability.
* Establish standards for structured knowledge management and process repositories.
* Collaborate with process owners to simplify, standardize, and optimize documentation.
* Future-Ready Knowledge & Self-Service Enablement
* Develop frameworks that make policies and procedures easily searchable, consumable, and reusable.
* Ensure process documentation is structured to support digital self-service platforms, AI-enabled knowledge systems, and agent-assist capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and knowledge management technologies to improve user experience and operational effectiveness.
* Support the transformation toward self-service and intelligent support models.
* Project & Stakeholder Management
* Lead cross-functional governance and process improvement initiatives.
* Develop project plans, governance forums, milestones, and implementation roadmaps.
* Facilitate alignment among global stakeholders, regional teams, business owners, and IT organizations.
* Track progress, risks, dependencies, and outcomes across multiple initiatives.
* Provide regular reporting and executive-level updates on governance maturity, data quality, and documentation health.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Engineering, Operations Management, or related field.
* 15+ years of experience in Data Governance, Business Process Management, Shared Services, Operations Excellence, or related areas.
* Proven experience managing cross-functional projects in global organizations.
* Strong understanding of data quality management, governance frameworks, and process standardization.
* Experience defining policies, controls, workflows, and governance models.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Shared Services, Global Business Services (GBS) organizations.
* Knowledge of ERP and enterprise platforms such as SAP, ServiceNow, Oracle, People Soft, Workday, or similar systems.
* Experience with knowledge management platforms and self-service solutions.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled knowledge management and digital transformation initiatives.
* Certification in Project Management, Lean Six Sigma, Data Governance, or Process Excellence is a plus.

**Success Measures**

* Improvement in data quality KPIs and governance compliance.
* Reduction in data inconsistencies across systems and regions.
* Percentage of policies and SOPs reviewed and updated on time.
* Increased adoption of standardized processes and governance controls.
* Enhanced self-service effectiveness and knowledge base usability.
* Successful delivery of governance and process improvement projects.

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance.
  
  
At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.
  
  
To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Jk Cable Altd is a growing manufacturer in the cable and electrical solutions industry, focused on delivering reliable products to a diverse range of clients. The company is committed to maintaining high production standards, continuous improvement, and strong customer satisfaction. Jk Cable Altd encourages collaboration between engineering, manufacturing, and quality teams to ensure consistent product performance. The organization supports professional development and provides opportunities to work with modern production technologies and quality systems.
  
**Role Description**
This full-time, on-site Quality Engineer role is based at Jk Cable Altd’s facility in Noida. The Quality Engineer will monitor and improve product quality across the production process, perform inspections and tests, and analyze data to identify trends and root causes of defects. The role involves developing and implementing quality procedures, supporting quality audits, and collaborating with production, design, and procurement teams to resolve quality issues. The Quality Engineer will create and maintain documentation such as control plans and test reports, ensure compliance with relevant standards, and support continuous improvement initiatives. The position also requires regular communication with internal stakeholders to drive corrective and preventive actions and maintain consistent quality performance.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong foundation in Quality Engineering, including application of quality tools, methodologies, and data analysis.
* Experience in Quality Control activities such as inspections, testing, sampling plans, and in-process checks.
* Background in Quality Assurance, including procedure development, audits, and compliance with industry standards.
* Ability to oversee Product Quality, including specification adherence, performance validation, and defect reduction.
* Knowledge of Quality Management principles, including continuous improvement, root cause analysis, and corrective/preventive action planning.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related field) or equivalent practical experience.
* Familiarity with cable or manufacturing industry processes and standards is an advantage.
* Proficiency with quality-related software tools, MS Office, and basic statistical techniques.
* Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Ability to work on-site in Noida, manage multiple priorities, and contribute to cross-functional teams.
