title: Microsoft 365 Support Engineer – L1_2+yrs
description:
**Job Description**
: Microsoft 365 Support Engineer – L1
  
  
**Position:**
Microsoft 365 / O365 L1 Support Engineer
  
  
**Number of Openings:**
8 Resources
  
  
**Experience:**
1–3 Years (Preferred)
  
  
**Job Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for Microsoft 365 L1 Support Engineers to provide first-level technical support for Microsoft 365 applications and services. The ideal candidates should have basic knowledge of Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft Intune, along with strong troubleshooting, ticket management, and customer service skills.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Microsoft 365 Support: Provide L1 support for Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
* User and Access Management: Handle user account creation, password resets, license assignments, group management, and basic Microsoft Entra ID administration.
* Intune Support: Assist with device onboarding, enrollment, configuration, and basic Microsoft Intune-related issues.
* Outlook and Exchange Troubleshooting: Resolve basic Outlook connectivity, mailbox access, email delivery, and shared mailbox issues.
* Teams Support: Troubleshoot Microsoft Teams login issues, audio/video calling problems, and basic collaboration-related queries.
* SharePoint and OneDrive Support: Assist users with SharePoint access, OneDrive synchronization, file-sharing permissions, and basic application issues.
* Mailbox and Distribution List Management: Manage shared mailbox requests, distribution lists, and user access requests according to approved processes.
* Incident and Service Request Management: Log, track, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents and service requests within defined SLAs. Escalate complex issues to L2/L3 support teams.
* Ticket Documentation: Maintain accurate ticket updates, troubleshooting records, resolution notes, and knowledge-base articles.
* User Communication: Provide timely updates to end users, follow established support procedures, and ensure a positive user experience.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in IT helpdesk, service desk, or Microsoft 365 support.
* Basic hands-on knowledge of Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
* Understanding of user account management, password resets, license assignment, and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Intune and device enrollment processes.
* Familiarity with Outlook troubleshooting, mailbox access, email delivery, and Teams connectivity issues.
* Experience using ticketing tools and working within SLA-driven support environments.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and customer service skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of Active Directory fundamentals.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes and incident management.
* Microsoft 365 Fundamentals certification (MS-900) or equivalent knowledge.
* Experience working in a structured IT service desk or enterprise support environment.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
A customer-focused IT support professional capable of resolving routine Microsoft 365 issues, managing user access requests, documenting incidents accurately, and escalating complex technical problems to the appropriate support teams.
  
  
Skills: l1 support,troubleshooting,microsoft

* Must have completed multiple SAP projects and have excellent communication skills
* Confidence working within an offshore/onshore delivery model
* Proven expedience large stream of work across multiple locations
* Consulting experience advantageous
* Strong hands-on experience on FI-CA concepts:

+ Company Code Setup
+ Chart of Accounts and GL setup
+ Main / Sub Transaction Setup
+ Security Deposit Process
+ Incoming Payments (Real Time, Direct Debit, Cash Desk, etc.)
+ Outgoing Payments and Returns
+ Collection process using Collection Strategy
+ Collection Agency related process
+ Transfer Posting process
+ Escheatment process

* Strong knowledge of month-end and period-end closing and FICA to FICO GL integration.
* Implementation experience of BRF Plus.
* Experience and knowledge of using middleware technology to integrate SAP with third party systems for payments, collection agencies, etc.
* Experience in data migration.
* Can work under minimum supervision, good time management and work planning

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 5 to 8 years of experience in a functional role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* Prior SAP BRIM CI role is a must
* Should have worked on minimum 1 implementation from scratch as a lead consultant.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience on integration with third-party applications
* Knowledge of integration with SAP RAR, BRIM CI/SOM/CM
* Hands on experience in SAP S4 HANA Platform
* Experience on tools like JIRA or equivalent tool to maintain stories.
* SAP Utilities certifications are a plus:

+ Certification in SAP FICA (IUT240 / AC240 / BR240)
+ Certifications in SAP BRIM Convergent Invoicing (AC245 / BR245)

**Technologies and Tools**

* SAP FI-CA / FI-CAX
* SAP FIORI
* Jira or similar tools
* Azure DevOps or similar tools

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Utilities practices globally with leading businesses across a range of geographies

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Content Writer
description:
Job Description: Content Writer

**Company:**
Sapiogen AI Private Limited

**Department:**
Marketing & Growth

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Mode:**
On-site

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Experience:**
1–3 Years

About Sapiogen AI

Sapiogen AI is an
**AI-first software engineering company**
helping startups, scale-ups, and enterprises build intelligent software products, modernize technology, automate operations, and accelerate digital transformation.

Our capabilities include
**AI-powered product development, AI consulting, AI development, AI automation & RPA, conversational & voice AI, cloud engineering, data engineering, AI integration, and legacy modernization.**

We are building an international technology brand targeting clients across the
**USA, UK, Canada, Australia, and UAE**
.

About the Role

We are looking for a
**Content Writer**
who can create high-quality, technically credible, and conversion-focused content for Sapiogen AI.

The ideal candidate should be able to simplify complex topics such as
**AI, software engineering, cloud, automation, data, and digital transformation**
and turn them into content that attracts decision-makers, builds authority, supports SEO, and generates business interest.

This is not a generic blog-writing role. You will work closely with the
**SEO and marketing teams**
to create content designed for search engines, AI-powered search platforms, and real business audiences.

Key ResponsibilitiesContent Creation

* Write high-quality blogs, articles, website pages, service pages, landing pages, case studies, and thought-leadership content.
* Create content around AI, software engineering, automation, cloud, data, digital transformation, and emerging technologies.
* Write content that is informative, engaging, authoritative, and aligned with Sapiogen AI's positioning.
* Convert complex technical concepts into clear and easy-to-understand business content.
* Create content for international B2B audiences, particularly decision-makers, founders, CTOs, CIOs, and technology leaders.
* Develop content that communicates business outcomes rather than simply describing technical features.

SEO Content

* Work closely with the SEO Executive/Manager to create keyword-focused content.
* Conduct basic keyword and competitor research to understand search intent.
* Naturally incorporate primary, secondary, and long-tail keywords.
* Create SEO-friendly titles, headings, meta descriptions, FAQs, and content structures.
* Develop content around commercial, informational, and transactional search intent.
* Optimize existing content based on SEO performance and ranking opportunities.
* Support the creation of topic clusters and topical authority around AI and software engineering.

AI Search, AEO & GEO

* Create content optimized for emerging AI-powered search experiences.
* Understand
  **Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)**
  and
  **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**
  principles.
* Structure content to provide clear, direct, authoritative answers to relevant questions.
* Create FAQ, comparison, definition, use-case, and problem-solution content that can be useful in AI search experiences.
* Maintain strong factual accuracy and avoid producing generic AI-generated content.
* Use AI tools as productivity assistants while ensuring the final content demonstrates human judgment, originality, and expertise.

Website & Conversion Content

* Write and optimize service pages such as:
* AI Consulting
* AI Product Development
* AI Development
* AI Automation
* Conversational AI
* Voice AI
* Cloud Engineering
* Data Engineering
* Legacy Modernization
* Create industry-specific and use-case landing pages.
* Develop content that communicates Sapiogen AI's differentiation and encourages visitors to take action.
* Write website CTAs, headlines, value propositions, FAQs, and supporting copy.
* Ensure content aligns with Sapiogen AI's brand voice and premium positioning.

Research & Thought Leadership

* Research emerging trends, technologies, market developments, and customer challenges.
* Create thought-leadership articles and opinion-driven content around AI and software engineering.
* Analyze competitor content and identify content gaps and opportunities.
* Interview internal technical experts when necessary to develop technically accurate content.
* Support whitepapers, guides, reports, newsletters, and other long-form content initiatives.

Content Distribution

* Create content for LinkedIn and other relevant social platforms.
* Repurpose blogs and long-form content into LinkedIn posts, carousels, short-form content, and other marketing assets.
* Support email newsletters and campaign content.
* Collaborate with the design team to create content briefs for visual assets.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 1–3 years of experience in content writing, preferably in
  **B2B technology, SaaS, IT services, AI, or software engineering**
  .
* Excellent written English and strong grammar.
* Strong research and fact-checking abilities.
* Ability to explain technical concepts in simple business language.
* Understanding of SEO fundamentals and search intent.
* Familiarity with keyword research and content optimization.
* Basic understanding of Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Ahrefs, Semrush, or similar tools is an advantage.
* Understanding of AI, software development, cloud computing, automation, or digital transformation is preferred.
* Ability to write for international audiences, particularly US and UK markets.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.
* Ability to independently research topics and produce original content.

Preferred Skills

* Experience writing for technology companies or IT service companies.
* Knowledge of
  **AEO, GEO, AI search, and content marketing**
  .
* Understanding of B2B lead-generation content.
* Experience creating service pages and landing pages designed for conversions.
* Familiarity with WordPress or modern CMS platforms.
* Experience using AI writing/research tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity.
* Ability to collaborate with SEO specialists, developers, designers, and marketing teams.

What We Expect

We are looking for a writer who can move beyond generic "AI-generated" articles.

Your content should be:

**Research-driven → Technically accurate → Human-written → SEO-friendly → Business-focused → Conversion-oriented.**

You should be able to take a topic such as
**"AI Agent Development for Enterprises"**
and create content that not only ranks in search but also makes a CTO or business leader understand
**why they need it, where it can create value, what implementation involves, and why Sapiogen AI is the right engineering partner.**

Key Performance Indicators

* Quality and consistency of published content.
* Organic visibility and ranking improvement of content.
* Growth in organic traffic and relevant search impressions.
* Engagement and time spent on content.
* Contribution to qualified organic leads and enquiries.
* Number of high-quality content assets delivered on schedule.
* Improvement of existing underperforming content.
* Growth of Sapiogen AI's topical authority across AI and software engineering subjects.

Why Join Sapiogen AI?

* Opportunity to work with an
  **AI-first technology company**
  from an early stage.
* Exposure to AI, software engineering, cloud, automation, and emerging technologies.
* Opportunity to build content for international markets.
* Work closely with SEO, marketing, engineering, and leadership teams.
* Learn and work on emerging areas such as
  **AI Search, AEO, GEO, and AI-assisted content marketing**
  .
* Opportunity for career growth as the marketing organization expands.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a
**strong researcher and storyteller**
who understands technology and can turn complex technical subjects into compelling business content.

If you are passionate about technology, AI, SEO, and storytelling—and want to build content that contributes directly to the growth of an international technology company—we'd love to hear from you.

**Apply now to join Sapiogen AI and help us build the future of AI-first software engineering.**

This early-career role will support factory performance improvement initiatives across multiple wafer fabrication sites through capacity modeling, data analytics, reporting automation, cycle time reduction, and scheduling optimization. Working alongside experienced Industrial Engineers at local facilities, this position will contribute to the development of cross-site analytical tools and decision-support systems that maximize factory output and enable future expansion planning.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support development and maintenance of cross-site capacity models, factory loadings, and utilization analyses.
* Assist with cycle time improvement initiatives through bottleneck analysis, WIP management, and line balancing activities.
* Analyze factory performance data and identify opportunities to increase throughput, productivity, and equipment utilization.
* Develop and automate reports, dashboards, and analytical tools using SQL, Python, Power BI, and other business intelligence tools.
* Support validation of manufacturing scheduling data, forecasting models, and factory planning assumptions.
* Participate in scenario analysis and what-if modeling to evaluate capacity, output, and resource requirements.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, IT, and Equipment Engineering to support improvement projects.
* Document methodologies, analytical models, and standard work processes.
* Present findings and recommendations to technical and operations teams.
* Build knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing systems, Industrial Engineering methodologies, and factory scheduling concepts.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Systems Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Data Analytics, or related engineering discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Internship, co-op, or academic project experience in manufacturing, operations research, data analytics, or process optimization.
* Familiarity with SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytical tools.
* Coursework in statistics, simulation, optimization, data science, or manufacturing systems.
* Exposure to semiconductor manufacturing or other high-volume manufacturing environments.

**Work Experience**

* 0–2 years of Industrial Engineering or analytical experience.
* Demonstrated ability to work with large datasets and perform quantitative analysis.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively within geographically distributed teams.

*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. title: Client Outreach Executive
description:
**Company Description**
RSE (Red Smile Entertainments) is a white-label post-production house specializing in wedding and corporate video editing for studios worldwide. Founded in 2018, the company has grown from a single editor to a dedicated team of 10 professionals serving clients across the UK, US, Canada, Australia, and the UAE. RSE works under strict NDAs, delivering all files under each client’s branding so that end viewers never know a third party was involved. The team manages wedding films, highlight reels, event coverage, and corporate videos, helping studios stay focused on production while RSE clears their editing backlog. RSE also offers free 30–60 second trial edits, giving potential partners a risk-free way to experience the service.

**Role Description:**
This is a full-time hybrid role for a Client Outreach Executive based in Gandhinagar, with flexibility for some work-from-home tasks. The Client Outreach Executive will engage with existing and prospective studio partners, introduce RSE’s post-production services, and coordinate trial edits and onboarding. Day-to-day responsibilities include responding to inquiries, scheduling and conducting calls or virtual meetings, understanding client requirements, and ensuring smooth handover of projects to the editing team. The role involves maintaining accurate records of interactions, following up on leads, gathering feedback from clients, and supporting long-term relationship building. Collaboration with the operations and editing teams will be essential to align client expectations with delivery timelines and service quality.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Communication and Customer Satisfaction skills to build trust, clarify requirements, and deliver a positive client experience.
* Account Management and Consulting abilities to understand studio workflows, recommend suitable services, and support ongoing client relationships.
* Sales skills to identify opportunities, present RSE’s value proposition, and convert leads into long-term partnerships.
* Comfort with digital tools (CRM, email, video conferencing) and basic understanding of video production or post-production workflows.
* Proactive, organized, and detail-oriented approach, with the ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously.
* Prior experience in client-facing roles in media, creative services, or B2B environments is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Project Engineer–Commercial Solar Projects
description:
**Role Summary**

Ample Solar is looking for a Project Engineer to take ownership of the execution of commercial and industrial solar projects from post sales handover through planning, installation, testing, and commissioning.

The role involves close coordination with engineering, procurement, dispatch, installation, electrical and customer teams to ensure that projects are executed systematically, within the committed schedule, and as per the required quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Take ownership of end to end execution of commercial solar projects from sales handover to commissioning.
* Develop project execution schedules covering engineering, material readiness, dispatch, site installation, electrical works, testing and commissioning.
* Coordinate with Design, Liaisoning team, Procurement, Stores, Dispatch and Installation teams to ensure timely availability of resources and materials.
* Plan and coordinate deployment of installation teams based on project requirements and execution schedules.
* Monitor project progress against planned milestones and ensure timely completion of activities.
* Identify project constraints, site issues, and potential delays in advance and take appropriate corrective actions.
* Coordinate with customers, site representatives, vendors, and contractors for smooth project execution.
* Ensure execution is carried out in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, safety and quality requirements.
* Coordinate testing, commissioning, statutory/DISCOM activities wherever applicable, and final project handover.
* Maintain project status, execution records, and timely reporting to the management.

**Candidate Profile**

* 3–4 years of experience in Solar EPC/Project Execution, preferably handling commercial or industrial rooftop projects.
* Strong understanding of solar PV systems, electrical installation, and project execution.
* Experience in coordinating installation teams, contractors, vendors and multiple internal departments.
* Good knowledge of project planning, material coordination, and site execution.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and work towards strict project timelines.
* Strong communication, coordination, follow-up, and problem solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and project tracking/reporting tools will be an advantage.

**Key Requirement**

The ideal candidate should have a strong project ownership mindset, capable of planning the execution well in advance, coordinating all required resources and taking timely action to ensure that commercial solar projects are completed as committed, without avoidable delays.

**Compensation & Career Growth Opportunities:**

* The candidate will be offered a competitive cost to company (CTC) along with performance based incentives linked to the timely implementation of assigned projects and other governing parameters
* Company believes in company growth along with their employee growth, Strong opportunities for professional growth, career advancement, and long term leadership development.
* We rise together: your personal development fuels our corporate expansion in the solar industry.

**Company Overview:**

Ample Solar Private Limited is a Gujarat based solar company delivering scalable renewable energy solutions from rooftop systems, ground mounted solar projects to multi megawatt industrial solar projects. The company serves residential customers, MSMEs, and large industries with a strong focus on engineering quality and execution excellence.

With 3000+ operations completed and demonstrated capability in MW scale project execution, Ample Solar supports large industrial clients in achieving energy cost optimization and sustainability targets. Backed as an authorized Tata Group channel partner, the company brings good quality components, structured processes, and reliable delivery across all project sizes. Ample Solar is also entered a phase of strategic multi state expansion, strengthening its presence in key industrial corridors to support India’s clean energy transition.

title: Air Conditioning Trainer
description:
**Company Description**
Urban Company is a technology-driven platform that connects customers with vetted professionals for a wide range of home and beauty services, including repairs, cleaning, salon, and spa experiences. The company focuses on making urban living easier through reliable, high-quality, and transparent services. Operating across India, UAE, Singapore, and KSA, Urban Company also offers Native, its in-house brand of smart home solutions that enhance safety and convenience at home. Skill India–certified professionals, trained through comprehensive programs in partnership with NSDC, are at the core of the platform, ensuring consistent service standards and sustainable livelihoods for partners. Urban Company is committed to professional development, service excellence, and a supportive work environment for trainers and service experts alike.
  
**Role Description**
As an Air Conditioning Trainer at Urban Company in Kochi, you will conduct hands-on training sessions for air conditioning service professionals, covering installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair techniques. You will design and update training materials, curricula, and practical demos to align with current industry standards, safety regulations, and Urban Company quality guidelines. The role involves assessing trainees’ skills, providing constructive feedback, and supporting certification processes to ensure consistent service quality. You will collaborate with operations and quality teams to identify skill gaps, standardize best practices, and implement improvements across the service network. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Kochi, requiring regular classroom and workshop-based training interactions with service partners.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience in air conditioning systems, including installation, preventive maintenance, and fault diagnosis.
* Experience in delivering vocational or technical training, with the ability to design clear training modules, practice exercises, and assessment methods.
* Solid understanding of safety standards, electrical safety practices, and compliance requirements relevant to HVAC and home services.
* Effective communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in simple, practical terms to diverse learner groups.
* Ability to mentor and coach service professionals, providing structured feedback and supporting continuous skill improvement.
* Basic familiarity with digital tools (e.g., smartphones, learning platforms, and documentation software) to manage training schedules and records.
* Prior experience in HVAC, home services, or facilities management; certification or diploma in mechanical/electrical or HVAC disciplines is highly beneficial.
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to quality, customer satisfaction, and professional ethics.

title: Finance and Account Executive
description:
Experience:

3-5 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts, preferably in a manufacturing/plant

environment.

About the role:

We are looking for an experienced Finance & Accounts professional to manage the day-to-day

finance operations of the plant. The role involves month-end closing, plant P&L preparation,

vendor payments, customer collections, and inventory accounting.

The position will also be responsible for GST, TDS, and TCS compliance and timely coordination

with Head Office.

The candidate will act as a key finance contact for vendors, customers, auditors, and plant

management.

Software Skills

 SAP – Hands-on experience is preferred.

 Good working knowledge of MS Excel and other MS Office applications.

Key Responsibilities

1. Month-End Closing & Reporting

o Manage month-end closing activities for the plant and coordinate with Head

Office for timely closure of monthly books.

o Prepare and submit monthly Plant Profit & Loss (P&L) statements and related

financial reports.

o Ensure accuracy and timely completion of accounting entries and reconciliations.

2. Vendor & Customer Accounting

o Coordinate with vendors and customers regarding accounting, invoicing, payment,

and collection-related matters.

o Act as the single point of contact for resolving accounting and payment-related

issues.

o Coordinate with vendors to ensure timely availability and supply of materials.

3. Purchase & Invoice Accounting

o Verify invoices against purchase orders, GRNs, and supporting documents.

o Ensure proper accounting and documentation of all transactions.

4. Vendor Payments

o Prepare and maintain the vendor payment schedule based on due dates,

priorities, and available funds.

o Coordinate with HO/Finance for timely processing of vendor payments.

o Monitor outstanding vendor balances and resolve discrepancies.

5. Customer Collections

o Prepare the customer collection plan and monitor outstanding receivables.

o Follow up with sales team for timely collections and ensure adherence to agreed

payment terms.

o Coordinate with the sales/commercial team to resolve collection-related issues.

6. GST Compliance

o Prepare and file GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B on a monthly basis for three plants.

o Complete necessary GST reconciliations before filing returns.

o Coordinate with auditors for preparation and filing of GSTR-9.

o Ensure timely compliance with applicable GST requirements.

7. TDS & TCS Compliance

o Prepare and provide TDS and TCS-related details to Head Office within the

stipulated timelines.

o Coordinate with HO for necessary reconciliations and compliance requirements.

8. Petty Cash Management

o Maintain and manage petty cash for plant-related expenses.

o Ensure proper supporting documents, approvals, and timely accounting of petty

cash transactions.

o Conduct regular petty cash verification and reconciliation.

9. Plant Coordination & Administration

 Coordinate with the Plant Head on finance, HR, and administration-related matters.

 Support the plant management team in resolving financial and administrative issues.

 Coordinate with HO and other internal departments as required.

Key Skills & Competencies

 Strong knowledge of plant accounting and financial processes.

 Good understanding of GST, TDS, and TCS compliance.

 Hands-on experience in month-end closing, P&L preparation, vendor payments, and

customer collections.

 Strong analytical and reconciliation skills.

 Good communication and interpersonal skills.

 Ability to coordinate effectively with HO, vendors, customers, auditors, and plant teams.

 Strong attention to detail and ability to meet statutory and reporting deadlines.

 Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates with 3-5 years of experience in Finance & Accounts within a manufacturing/plant

environment will be preferred, particularly those with hands-on experience in SAP and GST

compliance.

* Flexible schedule

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
**An Amazing Career Opportunity for Solutions Engineer
  
  
Location: Remote Or Hybrid / Office
  
  
Job ID: 49282**
**Profile Summary**
HID Global’s Biometric Identity Technologies division is seeking a skilled Solutions Engineer with a strong presales orientation, capable of delivering compelling demonstrations, managing strategic tenders, and guiding customers—particularly national authorities such as Police forces, Ministries, and other government institutions—through complex solution evaluations.
  
  
In this role, you will collaborate closely with Sales to understand customer challenges, shape technical requirements, and identify opportunities for HID’s hardware, software, and professional services. While a solid architecture and development foundation is required, the emphasis is on customer-facing activities, including presentations, proof‑of‑concepts, and presales technical leadership.
  
  
You will help articulate HID Global’s value, support technical aspects of the sales cycle, and ensure smooth transitions from presales engagement into project execution. The position is designed for a motivated professional who excels in remote/hybrid environments and thrives in a role that blends technical expertise with high-impact communication.
  
  
You will support Sales across Middle East and India regions, including travel for on‑site demonstrations, workshops, and government stakeholder engagements.
  
  
**Ideal Qualifications:**

* Proven experience designing end-to-end identity verification, biometric enrollment, adjudication, or credentialing workflows involving sensitive biometric and personally identifiable information (PII).
* Experience creating solution architectures for large government agencies involving identity management, biometric matching, data integration, case management, or digital identity platforms.
* Proven experience working on AADHAR and related projects for biometric identity solutions (such as STQC, MOSIP, etc…)

**Who are we?**
HID Global Biometric Identity Technologies is trusted by governments and enterprises worldwide. We support everyday identity verification use cases where performance, accuracy and continuity are non-negotiable. HID Global’s mission is to power the trusted identities of the world’s people, places, and things, allowing people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely. We are a high-tech software company headquartered in Austin, TX, with over 4,000 worldwide employees. Check us out: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo
  
  
LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/hidglobal/mycompany/
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities include the following.**
Other duties may be assigned.
  
  

* Serve as a technical presales expert within the Sales team, strengthening customer engagements through tailored demonstrations, technical guidance, and structured tender support.
* Develop and deliver high-impact solution demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and presentations that clearly communicate HID Global’s value to government and enterprise customers.
* Prepare detailed proposals and tender documentation for complex opportunities, ensuring compliance with government procurement requirements and alignment with customer technical needs.
* Interpret and refine customer requirements in collaboration with regional Sales, Product Management, and Engineering teams, ensuring proposed solutions address national authority use cases such as law enforcement, civil ID, and border management.
* Provide complete technical content for RFPs, RFIs, and government tenders, ensuring accuracy, competitiveness, and clarity.
* Architect, validate, and document biometric and identity‑management solutions across HID’s portfolio, ensuring alignment with mission‑critical government environments.
* Act as HID Global’s primary technical liaison throughout presales and post-sales phases, ensuring consistent communication, clarity on deliverables, and alignment between customer expectations and internal teams.
* Maintain deep awareness of market trends, biometric technologies, and public-sector digital transformation initiatives.
* Represent HID Global's technical capabilities at trade shows, partner events, and government briefings, delivering professional demonstrations and solution walkthroughs.

**Primary Duties:**

* Collaborate weekly with an international presales and solutions engineering team, sharing best practices and supporting cross-regional opportunities.
* Support Sales across Middle East, and India regions, including travel for on‑site demonstrations, workshops, and government stakeholder engagements.
* Focus on presales activities for HID’s commercial and ABIS solutions, especially for small-to-medium national authorities, civil registry agencies, and security ministries.

**Essential Qualifications (Required)**
To perform this role successfully, candidates must meet the following requirements:
  
  

* Fluent in English and Hindi
* Bachelor’s degree in computer information systems or related fields
* Minimum 5 years of presales and customer-facing technical experience, including demonstrations, requirements analysis, and support
* Proven experience engaging with national authorities, such as Police agencies, Ministries of Interior/Justice, civil ID programs, or similar public-sector clients.
* Minimum 3 years of experience with a focus on server / client solution architecture
* Excellent presentation and communication skills, particularly for non-technical and government audiences
* Strong problem-solving aptitude with an ability to engineer customer-centric solutions that drive sales success
* Deep understanding of the hardware and software development lifecycle and technical solution delivery
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage several presales engagements simultaneously in a hybrid/remote environment

**Education and/or Experience:**

* Master’s degree or relevant technical certifications
* Experience drafting Statements of Work and technical proposals
* Experience of working as a liaison between Sales and an Engineering team
* Able to manage technical solutions by performing basic project management functions including but not limited to scope, tracking deliverables, providing meeting minutes and tracking action items
* Experience with scripting or programming languages for adapting or creating demo environments
* Hands-on experience with development platforms or compilers (Android Studio, Visual Studio, etc.)
* Proven ability to configure, test, and validate server/client systems
* Ability to work as part of a team
* Familiarity with biometric systems (fingerprint, facial)
* Familiarity with document validation and proofing technologies for Passports or national IDs
* Experience with Enterprise and distributed system architecture
* Experience with collaboration and productivity tools: Salesforce, Confluence, Jira, SharePoint, Git
* Strong teamwork abilities and proficiency with Microsoft Office applications
* Proficient in MS Office applications, such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.
* Solid experience working within an MS Windows 11 environment

**Why apply?**

* Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
* Innovation: You embrace challenges and want to drive change. We are open to ideas, including flexible work arrangements, job sharing or part-time job seekers.
* Integrity: You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves, to feel appreciated and accepted.

This opportunity may be open to flexible working arrangements.
  
  
HID is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – Minority/Female/Disability/Veteran/Gender Identity/Sexual Orientation
  
  
**We make it easier for people to get where they want to go!**
On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. HID technology is behind billions of interactions, in more than 100 countries. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.
  
  
When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Solutions Engineer (Manufacturing) - US Shift
description:
**About MISUMI Americas**
MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
  
  
What’s in it for you?
  
  
**Opportunity To Unlock Your Creativity**
Think of all the times you were held back from trying new ideas because you were boxed in by bureaucratic legacy processes or old school tactics. Having a growth mindset is deeply ingrained into our company culture since day 1 so Fictiv is an environment where you have the creative liberty and support of the team to try big bold ideas to achieve our sales and customer goals.
  
  
**Opportunity To Grow Your Career**
There are plenty of sales jobs out there. The question is whether any of them will help you grow in your career? Will you be challenged by teammates to achieve your potential? Or are they roles that will ask you to do more of what you've already mastered. At Fictiv, you'll be surrounded by supportive teammates who will push you to be your best through their curiosity and passion.
  
  
Impact In This Role
  
  
We bridge the gap between complex customer requirements and practical manufacturing solutions by accurately interpreting technical drawings, performing precise cost analysis, and ensuring manufacturability through DFM (Design for Manufacturability) reviews. We engage directly with customers to clarify requirements, address technical questions, and provide transparent guidance that balances cost, quality, and lead time.
  
  
We streamline quoting workflows by reducing manual touchpoints, standardizing processes, and enabling faster decision-making. We proactively identify risks whether in material sourcing, tolerance challenges, or production feasibility and work with cross-functional teams to resolve them before they impact delivery.
  
  
Our work enhances the customer experience by combining deep technical expertise with clear, timely communication. We act as the link between customer needs and manufacturing capabilities, ensuring quotes are accurate, timelines are realistic, and outcomes meet or exceed expectations.
  
  
You will report to the Global Solution Engineering Director.
  
  
What You’ll Be Doing
  
  

* Accurate & Timely Quoting

+ Provide cost estimates for CNC machining and other manufacturing processes with high precision.
+ Perform DFM (Design for Manufacturability) analysis to highlight risks, suggest design changes, and optimize for cost and lead time.
+ Apply process knowledge to quote complex parts confidently, even in challenging timelines.

* Technical Support & Expertise

+ Interpret engineering drawings, GD&T, and material requirements to ensure feasibility.
+ Provide alternatives for difficult-to-source materials or complex geometries.
+ Offer process guidance for machining, finishing, and assembly needs.
+ Deliver region-specific manufacturing expertise across the US, India, China, and Mexico. Optimized to match the customer’s unique requirements, budget constraints, lead time goals, and project priorities.

* Customer Engagement & Education

+ Direct communication with customers to clarify requirements, resolve design concerns, and ensure alignment on expectations.
+ Provide proactive updates during quoting or project execution to reduce uncertainty.
+ Educate customers on trade-offs between cost, lead time, and quality.

* Cross-functional Collaboration

+ Work with internal teams (Sales, Operations, Sourcing, Quality & Logistics) to ensure smooth project execution.
+ Engage with manufacturing partners to validate capabilities, pricing, and delivery timelines.

* Risk Identification & Mitigation

+ Detect potential manufacturing challenges early, reducing costly rework or delays.
+ Recommend alternative manufacturing processes, tolerances, or materials when required.

* Platform-driven Quoting Solutions

+ Leverage platform tools to automate portions of the quoting process for speed and accuracy.
+ Balance risk by determining when to quote on-platform vs. escalate to High Touch (HT) quoting.

title: Technical Solutions Consultant
description:
**Tier 2 Technical Solutions Consultant**
*GCC India | TreadNet and B2B Platform Support*
**Position Summary**
The Tier 2 Technical Solutions Consultant provides advanced customer and technical support for TreadNet and related B2B platforms. Based in the Bridgestone GCC India office, this role serves internal users and external customers across the United States and Canada, resolving complex access, functional, and technical issues that cannot be resolved through Tier 1 support. The consultant combines strong troubleshooting capability with clear, professional customer communication and owns issues through resolution or appropriate escalation.
  
  
This role is customer-facing and requires confident verbal and written English communication, including the ability to lead calls, communicate technical issues in business-friendly language, and build trust with U.S.-based customers and stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide high-quality Tier 2 support to internal users and external B2B customers across the United States and Canada.
* Investigate, diagnose, and resolve escalated issues involving TreadNet, supporting systems, user access, browser behavior, integrations, and functional workflows.
* Support user provisioning and access management in accordance with established user-management controls and procedures.
* Engage customers by phone, email, chat, and video conference to gather details, troubleshoot issues, communicate status, and confirm resolution.
* Provide technical assistance for common issues, including password resets, browser and cache clearing, account access, and basic platform navigation.
* Provide user guidance and basic training on TreadNet and supporting-system functionality.
* Follow established Incident Management, Problem Management, knowledge-management, and escalation processes.
* Document incidents accurately, including issue details, troubleshooting performed, customer communication, root cause where known, and resolution steps.
* Escalate unresolved or high-impact issues to Tier 3, Product, Engineering, Platform, or vendor teams; track progress through closure and keep customers informed.
* Identify recurring incident patterns, customer pain points, and enhancement opportunities; document and route feedback through established processes.
* Contribute to and maintain support guides, knowledge articles, troubleshooting playbooks, user instructions, and training materials.
* Participate in support triage, operational reviews, and continuous-improvement activities to improve service quality, resolution time, and customer experience.
* Maintain awareness of service-level expectations and support team metrics, including response time, resolution time, ticket quality, and backlog aging.

**Shift Coverage and Work Schedule**
The Tier 2 GCC India support team will provide coverage for the U.S. business day from 6:00 AM Central Time through 8:00 PM Central Time (UTC -6). Coverage will be split between two consultants, with planned overlap to support handoffs, triage, collaboration, and peak customer demand. Candidates must be willing and able to work assigned India-based shifts that align to this U.S. coverage window, including overlap hours as required.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* At least 4 years of experience in technical support, application support, service desk, customer support, or a related technology-support role.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to engage professionally and confidently with U.S.-based customers and stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot issues methodically, ask effective diagnostic questions, and explain solutions clearly to technical and non-technical users.
* Experience managing incidents and escalations through ticketing systems and following issues through to resolution.
* Strong analytical, diagnostic, problem-solving, time-management, and organizational skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, customer-focused, deadline-oriented environment.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively within a distributed team.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; ability to create clear support documentation.
* Ability to receive feedback constructively and apply it to improve individual and team performance.
* Willingness to work the assigned shift schedule supporting North American business hours.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting B2B commerce, customer portals, order-management, pricing, billing, or dealer/fleet-facing platforms.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Freshdesk, Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar ticketing and support delivery tools.
* Experience supporting users in the automotive, transportation, retail, distribution, or service industries.
* Knowledge of ITIL practices, including incident, problem, change, and knowledge management.
* Experience working with U.S.-based customers or global, cross-cultural teams.

**Core Competencies**

* Customer-first mindset and ownership through resolution
* Clear and concise written and verbal communication
* Technical curiosity and structured problem solving
* Professionalism, empathy, and sound judgment during escalations
* Collaboration across support, product, engineering, and business teams
* Attention to detail and disciplined documentation
* Adaptability and continuous-improvement mindset

Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven

with
**5 to 12 years**
of expertise across SAP Customer Service (CS), Service Management (SM), and S/4HANA Service.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, and implementing end-to-end Service Management processes in an
**SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition (PCE) / RISE with SAP**
environment. You will bridge business requirements and functional architecture, manage cloud service governance, enable AI-driven service insights, and drive continuous optimization across the full service lifecycle.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Implementation
* Design, configure, and deploy S/4HANA Service Management processes across the entire service lifecycle: Engage, Sell, Contract, Plan, Schedule, Execute, Invoice, and Analyze.
* Map end-to-end business requirements to standard S/4HANA Service capabilities, including service quotations, service orders, service contracts, spare parts logistics, resource planning, billing, and analytics.
* Drive adoption of the latest S/4HANA PCE release innovations (e.g., service team determination, advanced execution processes, Fiori applications, and AI-powered service intelligence).
* S/4HANA Private Edition (PCE) Governance
* Operate effectively within the SAP S/4HANA PCE Shared Responsibility Model between the client and SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS).
* Liaise with SAP for system-level operational tasks (e.g., infrastructure management, backups, maintenance, and upgrade administration).
* Lead client-side functional responsibilities, including business process configuration, functional validation, regression testing, and process governance based on SAP’s PCE Roles and Responsibilities framework.
* Service Order & Contract Management
* Configure and maintain service contract structures, recurring service billing plans, and auto-renewal mechanisms.
* Enable flexible billing scenarios, including Resource-Related Billing (RRB), Time & Material (T&M), and Fixed-Price billing models.
* Leverage modern platform features such as service contract template cloning and mass contract change capabilities.
* Service Planning, Execution & Logistics Integration
* Set up and optimize workforce planning, resource allocation, dispatching, and field service workflows.
* Configure plant and storage location parameters within service transactions to support multi-plant and multi-location service execution.
* Direct cross-module functional integration between service transactions and procurement (MM), inventory management, shipping, plant maintenance (PM), and follow-on financial postings.
* Data Migration, Testing & Integration
* Oversee data preparation, cleansing, transformation, and validation for service master data, active service contracts, and open service orders.
* Utilize the SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and standard transition tools tailored for service artifacts.
* Coordinate functional and technical integrations across CRM, SAP Field Service Management (FSM), SAP CS, core logistics, and Finance (FI/CO).
* AI, Analytics & Continuous Process Improvement
* Implement embedded AI capabilities (e.g., Joule-assisted summaries, intelligent confirmations, and predictive service insights).
* Design custom Fiori dashboards, operational reports, and KPIs to monitor service performance and profitability.
* Guide business stakeholders through continuous improvement initiatives and the adoption of periodic SAP release features.
* Stakeholder Management & Documentation
* Facilitate requirements-gathering workshops, author detailed functional specifications (FS), and map target-state business process flows.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams spanning Logistics, Procurement, Finance, and Sales.
* Create training collateral, deliver end-user training, and lead hypercare support during deployment phases.

**Required Skills & Technical Expertise**

* Experience: 5–12 years of hands-on experience in SAP CS / SM / S/4HANA Service functional consulting.
* Core Module Competency: Comprehensive knowledge of S/4HANA Service (PCE) core functionality (Service Orders, Service Contracts, Resource-Related Billing, Invoicing, and Execution Logistics).
* Cloud Architecture: Clear operational understanding of the SAP PCE operating model, RISE with SAP frameworks, and cloud service boundary matrices.
* User Experience & Extensibility: Proficiency with modern SAP Fiori apps, standard OData APIs, and functional extensibility options.
* Integration Touchpoints: Strong cross-functional integration experience with PM, SD, MM, FI/CO, and SAP FSM.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Practical project experience with RISE with SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition implementations or migrations.

* Official SAP Certification in S/4HANA Service or related SAP functional modules.

**Soft Skills**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong consulting mindset with a proven ability to translate business strategy into technical solution designs.
* Proactive problem-solving capabilities and experience leading cross-functional delivery teams.

**Position Summary**

title: DHS Technical Services Specialist
description:
**With a passion for life**
Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.

**Job Overview**
As a Digital Health Solutions (DHS) Technical Services Specialist for T-DOC and Tegris, your primary focus will be on managing project planning, installation, and aftersales services for hospital clients in Southeast Asia and India. You will deliver these activities directly or in collaboration with partners and distributors to ensure solutions are implemented in compliance with company standards and regulatory requirements, while achieving the highest level of customer satisfaction.
  
  
**Project Implementation**

* Manage project implementations from planning through installation, testing and commissioning (T&C), and final handover.
* Conduct comprehensive user training sessions following successful installation to ensure effective and proficient system utilization.
* Maintain thorough documentation for all project phases, including customer milestone sign-offs and acceptance records.

**After Sales Support**

* Perform system maintenance, software updates, and upgrades, either remotely or on-site as required.
* Provide timely and effective after sales support by identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving customer issues.
* Maintain detailed documentation of all ongoing service issues in the local system, including issue descriptions, resolutions, and follow-up actions.
* Carry out all activities in accordance with company protocols and regulatory requirements.

**Service Level Agreements (SLAs)**

* Prepare SLAs in line with company standards and customer requirements.
* Ensure customer requests are fulfilled within the agreed timelines and conditions defined in the SLAs.
* Support upselling opportunities with existing customers by identifying potential needs and providing consultative recommendations.

**Technical Support To Sales Team As And When Required**

* Provide technical support to the Sales team during quotation and tender phases by proposing cost-effective solutions that meet customer needs and requirements.
* Support the Sales team with technical presentations and product demonstrations, ensuring clear and effective communication of product and service features and benefits.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* At least 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in healthcare IT, network, or digital health solutions.
* Experience with healthcare integration projects and clinical workflows is highly desirable.
* Experience troubleshooting software, hardware, and network-connected systems.
* Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.

**Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Healthcare IT systems, digital health solutions, and hospital workflows
* Hospital Information Systems (HIS), Electronic Medical Records (EMR/EHR), and systems integration.
* Hospital interoperability standards and protocols.
* Experience working within CSSD (Central Sterile Services Department) and Operating Room (OR) environments.
* Networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, VPN, LAN/WAN).
* Server administration and SQL.
* Windows operating systems, software deployment, and system integration.
* Service management, SLAs, and regulatory/compliance requirements.

**Skills**

* Technical troubleshooting and problem resolution.
* Project management and implementation coordination.
* Customer training and technical presentations.
* Documentation, reporting, and stakeholder management.
* Strong communication and customer-facing skills.

**Abilities**

* Manage projects independently from planning through customer acceptance.
* Work collaboratively with sales teams, customers, distributors, and partners.
* Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Prioritize multiple tasks while maintaining high customer satisfaction.
* Identify service improvement and upselling opportunities.
* Ability to forge and maintain relationships with customers.

**About Us**
With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.

title: Technical Consultant
description:
**Technical Consultant – Fraud & Security Intelligence**
**About The Role**
Help leading financial institutions across Asia Pacific solve complex Fraud and Financial Crime challenges through innovative analytics, AI, and enterprise technology.
  
  
As a Technical Consultant within SAS's Fraud & Security Intelligence practice, you'll work directly with customers to understand their business challenges, lead discovery workshops, design enterprise solutions, and deliver successful transformation programmes across the region.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to combine technical expertise with business consulting while building trusted customer relationships and delivering measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead customer workshops to understand business, functional, and technical requirements.
* Design, implement, and optimize Fraud, Financial Crime, and Compliance solutions that address customer business and regulatory requirements.
* Translate business requirements into scalable solution designs and implementation approaches.
* Deliver end-to-end solution implementation, from requirements analysis and solution configuration through testing, deployment, and post-production support.
* Lead technical workstreams and collaborate with customer business and technology teams to solve complex implementation challenges.
* Build trusted customer relationships by providing technical leadership and consulting throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop reusable delivery assets, best practices, and innovative approaches that improve delivery quality and efficiency.
* Mentor junior consultants and contribute to the growth of the regional consulting practice.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* 4–8 years of consulting, enterprise software implementation, or solution delivery experience. Strong candidates with slightly less experience may also be considered.
* Experience delivering enterprise Fraud, Financial Crime, or Compliance solutions within Banking, Financial Services, FinTech, or Payments organizations.
* Experience leading technical workstreams and working directly with customers, business stakeholders, and technology teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within regional and global delivery teams.
* Willingness to travel across Asia Pacific as required.

**Technical & Domain Expertise**

* Experience implementing enterprise Fraud, Financial Crime, or Compliance solutions.
* Experience with Financial Crime platforms such as SAS, NICE Actimize, Oracle FCCM, FICO, Quantexa, Symphony AI NetReveal, or equivalent enterprise solutions.
* Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, Linux/Unix, ETL, APIs, cloud technologies (including Kubernetes), and enterprise application integration.
* Understanding of Fraud and Financial Crime domains including Payment Fraud, Card Fraud, Digital Banking Fraud, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions Screening, Customer Due Diligence (CDD/KYC), and Financial Crime Investigations.

**Who You Are**
**You are someone who:**

* Enjoys solving complex business and technology challenges.
* Takes ownership and consistently delivers high-quality outcomes.
* Builds trusted relationships through professionalism, credibility, and collaboration.
* Communicates confidently with customers, business stakeholders, and technical teams.
* Has a growth mindset with a passion for continuous learning and mastering new technologies.
* Thrives in collaborative, multicultural consulting environments.
* Is passionate about helping customers combat fraud and financial crime.
* Aspires to become a Solution Architect, Consulting Manager, or Practice Leader.

**Career Growth**
At SAS, you'll work on some of the largest Fraud and Financial Crime transformation programmes across Asia Pacific while collaborating with industry experts and leading financial institutions.
  
  
This role provides an excellent opportunity to build deep expertise across Fraud & Security Intelligence solutions while progressing towards Solution Architect, Project Lead, Consulting Manager, or Practice Leader roles within SAS Professional Services.
  
  
You'll be encouraged to challenge conventional thinking, continuously develop your expertise, and contribute to the growth of one of Asia Pacific's leading Fraud & Security Intelligence consulting practices.

title: Technical Sale Engineer
description:
**Technical Sales Executive – International**

**Company:**
Variety Innovation Venture Pvt Ltd

**Location:**
Gurgaon / Delhi NCR

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience:**

1–5 Years

**Salary: 3-6 LPA**

(Based on experience & technical Knowledge)

**Industry:**

Robotics, Automation & Industrial / Educational Products

**About Variety Innovation Venture Pvt Ltd**

**Variety Innovation Venture Pvt. Ltd**
. is a Gurugram-based group that has spent roughly a decade in industrial robotics and automation. It began in system integration, covering deployment and enterprise sales, and grew into two focused businesses:

**Unbox Industry**
is our robotics hardware distribution arm. It works with 150+ global brand partners and supplies robots, cobots, grippers and related automation hardware to industrial customers in India and abroad. It also handles after-sales support for the products it sells.

**Nferent AI**
is our physical AI data and deployment company, based in a Gurugram lab. We capture egocentric RGB-D, teleoperation, motion-capture and bimanual manipulation data for humanoid and robotics teams in the US and Europe. We are building toward a deployment layer for physical AI. Unbox's hardware relationships and factory access give Nferent something few AI teams have: direct access to real industrial environments and real robots.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a
**Technical Sales Executive – International Sales**

to drive
**export and overseas sales**

of our
**robotics, automation, and training product portfolio**

. The role involves managing international customers, channel partners, and distributors, focusing on product positioning, order closure, and long-term account growth.

* Drive sales of
  **robotics, automation, and training products**

  in international markets
* Identify and onboard

* Handle enquiries from overseas customers and partners
* Present product specifications, catalogs, and use-cases to international stakeholders

  **export quotations**

  , pricing, and basic commercial documentation
* Coordinate with internal teams for order processing, packaging, and dispatch
* Follow up on international leads, negotiations, and order closures
* Manage relationships with global OEMs, partners, and institutional buyers
* Track international sales pipeline, forecasts, and closures
* Monitor competitor products, pricing, and market trends in target regions

**Education Qualification**

* Graduate / Diploma in Engineering domain.
* International sales exposure or export experience will be preferred
* **Relevant experience and capability will be valued over academic qualification**

**Required Skills**

Product & Technical Understanding

* Basic understanding of robotics, cobot, humanoid robot, quadruped robot, amr, automation, or technical products
* Ability to clearly explain product features and specifications to global customers
* Experience with product catalogs, datasheets, and standard configurations

**International Sales & Communication**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
* Experience working with overseas customers across time zones
* Familiarity with international trade terms (Incoterms), export documentation, and pricing
* Ability to manage long-distance sales cycles and partner relationship.

**Experience**

* 1–5 years of experience in
  **international B2B product sales or export sales**
* Experience in robotics, automation, industrial equipment, or educational products preferred
* Prior experience working with distributors or channel partners overseas is a strong plus

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to build and scale
  **global markets**

* Exposure to international customers, OEMs, and distribution networks
* Ownership of regions and international accounts
* Performance-linked incentives and global growth opportunities

title: Transformation Delivery Consultant - LifeSciences
description:
**About Inizio Ignite:**
Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, encompassing connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion, and precision, we collaborate with clients to ignite impact, accelerate performance, and deliver lasting change for patients. By uniting strategy, insights, and innovation with a unique depth and breadth of expertise, we drive transformation and shape the future of health.
  
  
**Company Descriptor**
Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, encompassing connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion, and precision, we collaborate with clients to ignite impact, accelerate performance, and deliver lasting change for patients. By uniting strategy, insights, and innovation with a unique depth and breadth of expertise, we drive transformation and shape the future of health. Our Research Partnership healthcare market research team provides research and insights to inform and power healthcare decisions. Serving a variety of clients across the lifecycle, our expertise includes data, research & insights (proprietary syndicated and custom research) and brand tracking (ATU). Proudly part of Inizio – the market-leading commercialization partner for health and life sciences. From early-stage development to loss of exclusivity, we simplify complexity, unlock value, and make collaboration seamless at every pivotal moment – supporting confident, insight-driven decisions that move innovation forward.
  
  
**Role Overview**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Deliver High-Impact Solutions: Create and deliver high-quality project outcomes that align with client objectives, incorporating life science consulting principles to promote business excellence and scientific advancement.
* Project & Risk Management: Lead project plans or workstreams, proactively resolving issues, mitigating risks, and escalating concerns when necessary to ensure project success.
* Strategic Analysis & Recommendations: Systematically gather, analyze, and interpret scientific and business information, using a life science consulting lens to make confident, data-driven recommendations with urgency.
* Contribute to Vynamic's Growth: Dedicate time to enhancing Vynamic’s competencies by sharing life science consulting insights and contributing to the firm’s knowledge base and brand.
* Brand Representation: Act as a Vynamic brand ambassador, demonstrating a strong commitment to company values both internally and externally.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build authentic, trust-based relationships with stakeholders through partnership, effective communication, and delivering outcomes that exceed expectations.
* Team Development: Support team growth by identifying learning opportunities, mentoring colleagues, and integrating life science consulting practices into daily operations to achieve collective goals.
* Collaborative Leadership: Work closely with Navigators, Go-Tos, Account Managers, and self-selected Counselors to support personal and professional development journeys within Vynamic.
* Continuous Feedback & Growth: Proactively seek feedback, develop actionable personal growth plans, and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.
* Inclusive Leadership: Recognize and celebrate diverse perspectives, experiences, and cultures, ensuring all voices are heard and valued in decision-making processes.

**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, healthcare, or a related field with a minimum of 5+ years of experience in life science consulting, advanced degree (MS, MBA, PhD) preferred.
* Proven track record of managing collaborative teams or projects within dynamic, fast-paced environments.
* Strong understanding of relationship management principles, with a focus on fostering genuine connections within the life sciences ecosystem.
* Experience applying project management methodologies to oversee workstreams and complex initiatives.
* Familiarity with Vynamic’s sectors, services, and unique value proposition (preferred but not required).
* Strong presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively through written and verbal channels to diverse audiences, including scientific and executive stakeholders.
* Growth-oriented mindset, embracing challenges as opportunities for learning and personal development.

**Ideal candidate should be**

* You are proactive, dedicated and enthusiastic, with a ‘can do’ attitude and approach
* You demonstrate a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, as well as strengths in organisation and prioritisation
* You are a collaborative team player who works well with colleagues
* You communicate ideas and issues in an effective, straightforward fashion
* You are highly motivated and want to seize opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

***Artificial Intelligence***
*Inizio may use AI technologies to support certain aspects of our recruitment process, but all hiring decisions are made by our human recruiting team. We are committed to fair, inclusive, and human-led hiring practices. Don't meet every requirement? That's okay! We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.*
*Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.*
