title: Account Manager/Director
description: Account ManagerLocation: GurugramRole SummaryThe role drives sales growth of the Siemens Process Instrumentation portfolio through OEMs, the primary customer base. These include machine builders from industry as well as process side. The role also leverages the wider DI portfolio (automation, drives, digitalization) so that OEMs standardize on complete Siemens solutions. The candidate needs strong application knowledge of field instrumentation, an understanding of OEM business models, and the ability to get Siemens designed into OEMs' standard products for repeat, volume business. As a senior role, it involves independent ownership of key OEM accounts, contributing to regional OEM strategy.Key Responsibilities OEM Business Growth and Account ManagementDrive order intake and revenue for the Siemens Instrumentation portfolio through OEMs. The portfolio includes flow (SITRANS F: electromagnetic, Coriolis, ultrasonic), pressure (SITRANS P), temperature (SITRANS T), level (SITRANS L: radar and ultrasonic), valve positioners (SIPART), and weighing (SIWAREX, belt scales). Knowledge of Process Analytics is an advantage.Independently own key OEM accounts. Build account plans, map the key stakeholders (design, purchase, management) and develop long-term, strategic relationships.Target OEMs across different sectors.Identify and acquire new OEMs and grow share of wallet in existing OEM accounts.Contribute to regional OEM business planning, including annual targets, segment strategies and portfolio positioning. Share OEM feedback with product management for localization, pricing and portfolio development. Design-in and StandardizationWork with OEM design and engineering teams to get Siemens instruments designed into their standard products, drawings and BOMs, and to standardize on Siemens across product lines.Understand OEM applications and P&IDs, then do instrument sizing and selection, and optimize the BOQ for cost, performance and delivery.Negotiate and manage frame agreements, rate contracts and annual volume commitments with OEMs, so that business is repeatable and predictable.Support OEMs with end-customer approvals. This means engaging end users, consultants and EPCs so that Siemens instruments are accepted on OEM-supplied skids and packages. Solution Selling and PartnershipsCross-sell and up-sell the wider DI portfolio to OEMs: controllers (S7-1200, S7-1500), HMI, TIA Portal, drives and motors (SINAMICS, SIMOTICS, and PMA portfolio such as SIMOTION and servo motors where relevant), and industrial communication. Offer integrated, instrument-to-controller solutions that make OEM machines more competitive.Promote digitalization offerings such as device diagnostics, asset management (SIMATIC PDM), Industrial Edge and IoT-based remote monitoring. These help OEMs differentiate their equipment and build service revenue.Work with channel partners and system integrators to serve OEMs, including partner enablement and joint account planning.Conduct product presentations, technical workshops, demos and training for OEM design and service teams. Market Intelligence and Sales OperationsTrack OEM market trends, OEM expansion plans and competitor activity, particularly Endress+Hauser, KROHNE, Yokogawa, Emerson, ABB, VEGA, WIKA and IFM. Use this intelligence for value-based selling and competitive positioning.Maintain the opportunity pipeline, forecasts and win/loss analysis in CRM (Salesforce), and give regular updates to management.Coordinate with internal teams, including product management, the application/technical support center, order management, logistics and service. The aim is competitive pricing, reliable lead times and smooth support for OEMs.Technical Requirements Must haveStrong knowledge of process instrumentation: measuring principles, selection criteria, installation requirements and calibration.Ability to work with P&IDs, data sheets, GA drawings and BOMs of OEM skids and equipment.Understanding of hazardous area classification and certifications (ATEX, IECEx, PESO), SIL requirements, hygienic and sanitary requirements for pharma and F&B, and material selection for process conditions.Knowledge of field communication protocols: HART, IO-Link, PROFIBUS PA, PROFINET, Modbus.Working knowledge of PLC-based automation and how instruments integrate with OEM control panels. Qualifications and ExperienceB.E./B.Tech in Instrumentation, Electronics & Instrumentation, or Instrumentation & Control Engineering (preferred). Electrical/Electronics candidates with a strong instrumentation background may also be considered.10-14 years of experience in sales, business development or application engineering of process instrumentation, with instrumentation or automation OEMs or companies selling to them.At least 5 years in a customer-facing OEM sales or key account management role, with a proven record of design-in wins and volume business growth.Established network among OEMs in the assigned region. Familiarity with the related end-user and EPC community is an advantage. Key CompetenciesTechno-commercial acumen and value-selling skills, with an understanding of OEM cost structures and the price-volume balance.Strategic thinking and account planning.Strong customer relationship management and networking.Ability to influence OEM owners, design heads and purchase heads.Good communication, presentation and negotiation skills.Coaching and mentoring skills.Strong ownership and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.Self-driven, target-oriented, with a positive attitude and resilience.Willingness to travel within the assigned territory. #SL

title: Senior Associate - Deals Advisory - Deals Strategy
description:
**Job Description**
Job Overview:
  
  
This position is for a Senior Associate to be part of a fast-growing Strategy& practice within our Advisory Acceleration Centre.
  
  
Strategy& (S&) is our global strategy consulting business. It is a specialist team within PwC that combines strategy consulting capabilities with leading industry and sector insights and know-how. The team helps clients identify and build the capabilities essential to their advantage, and develop strategies based on these capabilities.
  
  
S& serves four main go-to-market channels: Deal Execution (M&A), Post-Deal Value Creation, Portfolio Companies, Corporate and Public Sector Clients (non-deals) across industries (including Technology, Media, Telco, Consumer Products, Retail, Industrials, Professional Services, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, Pharma).
  
  
The Deals channel is the largest channel for our UK team. Our work shapes the M&A landscape by supporting private equity (PE) and corporate clients in developing investment perspectives and value creation strategies that make a difference in the highly competitive M&A market.
  
  
We serve PE clients with over £2.5 trillion in assets under management, and publicly traded companies with a combined market capitalisation of over £4 trillion. From initial investment strategy development to commercial due diligence, value creation post-close and exit, we’re here to help our clients drive growth.
  
  
The S& Acceleration Centre in India is a specialist team within our broader PwC Kolkata Acceleration Centre that plays a critical role working with the UK team in project preparation and executing, including all responsibilities typically required of a UK-based team member from Experienced Associate to Manager. This includes analysis, research, output creation, presentation and discussion.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include**

* Help create and review delivery modules such as market analysis (sizing, forecasting, etc.), competitive analysis (benchmarking, differentiation, landscape analysis), business plan analysis, customer and financial analysis, survey analysis, website scraping, industry research, and more
* Conduct rigorous analysis in Microsoft Excel, and produce client-ready output in Microsoft PowerPoint
* Drive day-to-day deliverables within the Project team by helping in work-planning, problem solving, hypotheses generation and research tools, including reviewing your work and that of others for quality, accuracy, and relevance
* Work closely with the UK S& team to fully support client engagements
* Assist with KAC team onboarding and training programmes
* Contribute to the development of your own and team’s technical and functional acumen
* Demonstrate critical thinking, an ability to bring order to unstructured problems, and excellent commercial acumen
* Delegate to others to provide stretch opportunities, coaching them to deliver results
* Uphold the firm's code of ethics and business conduct

**Other Areas**

* Contribute to practice enablement and business development activities (proposal responses, client interactions, workshop preparation, etc.)
* Learning new tools and technologies including generative AI (genAI) as required
* Develop/implement automation solutions and capabilities that are aligned to clients’ business requirements
* Know how and when to use tools available for a given situation and explain reasons for this choice
* Develop internal relationships to build trust in an effort to develop and market the KAC brand
* Keep up to date with local and global business and economic issues
* Use feedback and reflection to develop self-awareness, personal strengths and address development areas
* Use straightforward communication, in a structured way, when influencing and connecting with others
* Provide others with examples of prior problem solving to help guide team members
* Staying in the loop and on top of the latest M&A trends

**Desired Experience And Skills**

* 4 to 7 years of industry experience with an emphasis on consulting services and project delivery
* Relevant experience in private equity, commercial due diligence, target screening and / or M&A advisory is an asset
* Ability to understand, contextualise, and solve commercial problems through independent analysis and research
* Ability to work as an integrated team member with the UK team in delivering client work, and to effectively take ownership and work on projects under stringent timelines while working both independently and in a team environment
* Effective written and excellent verbal business communication skills when interacting with team members and/or clients in a professional setting
* Ability to utilise project management skills to time-manage tasks
* Experience in creating clear and concise reports, including graphics and data visualisation and commentary for clients, and clearly presenting findings to others
* Relevant experience in conducting primary research (including desktop research, surveys and web scraping) and secondary research required
* Relevant experience in analysis of complex data (e.g. survey outputs, financial statements, business plans) required
* Relevant experience in creating client-ready deliverables including PowerPoint slides and reports required
* Experience in using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint is required, and experience with data visualisation tools like Power BI and other similar tools is an asset
* Multi-tasking and balancing time effectively, keeping a rapid pace without sacrificing quality

**Desired Soft Skills**

* Strong work ethic, proactive and professional behaviour
* Strategic and creative thinker, problem solver

**Educational Background**

* MBA from premier B-Schools (preferred)
* Strong academic credentials, analytical ability and leadership skills

**Additional Information**

* Time type: Full time
* Work timings: Work hours may vary for specific projects
* Travel requirements: None
* Past experience: Past experience in consulting and exposure to a multinational environment will be an added bonus.

title: AI Architect
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and consultative
**AI Architect**
to help clients understand, shape, and activate the potential of AI in their business. This role owns the architecture of the AI solutions we propose — across pursuits, not just within one — and is accountable for the technical credibility of what we commit to.
  
  
You will partner with sales, industry specialists, engineering, and client executives to turn priority AI use cases into architectures that are demonstrable in weeks and defensible at enterprise scale: secure, cost-aware, evaluable, and buildable by the delivery teams that inherit them.
  
  
It is deliberately a
**hands-on architect**
role. You will still open the IDE, still build the hard part of the prototype, and still debug an agent that reasons badly — while setting the patterns, guardrails, and reference architectures that everyone else builds on.
  
  
AI/Gen AI/Gen AI
  
  
Shape demand and executive conviction
  
  

* Lead discovery and architecture workshops with client business and technology leadership; set the agenda rather than respond to it.
* Identify pain points, value levers, and high-impact AI opportunities, and sequence them into a pragmatic AI roadmap (quick wins → platform investments).
* Translate ambiguous, complex client questions into solution hypotheses, target-state architecture, and a phased path to get there.
* Build AI scenarios and value frameworks that illustrate meaningful business transformation, with measurable outcomes and a defensible business case.

Own the architecture
  
  

* Own end-to-end architecture: LLM and model-portfolio selection, context engineering, retrieval and knowledge architecture, agent orchestration, microservices, integrations, data platform touchpoints, and UI.
* Set the non-functional bar and design to it — latency, throughput, unit cost per interaction, accuracy/eval thresholds, observability, safety, security, data residency, and auditability.
* Define reference architectures, agentic blueprints, and accelerator standards for the practice; govern their reuse so pursuits start at 40% rather than zero.
* Make and document build-vs-buy and platform decisions, including model routing, fine-tuning vs prompting vs retrieval, and open vs proprietary model strategy.

Prove it
  
  

* Build prototypes, storyboards, demos, accelerators, and reusable agentic blueprints — personally on the critical path, and through the FDE pod for the rest.
* Engineer and validate AI agents for reliability, reasoning, safety, and performance; establish the evaluation and red-teaming approach that lets us state quality claims with evidence.
* Lead PoCs, pilots, and phase-0 MVPs across industries, arbitrating scope so the proof lands inside the sales cycle.

Win and hand over
  
  

* Author and quality-gate client-ready content: architecture decks, SoWs, proposals, estimates, value frameworks, risk and assumption registers, and demo storylines.
* Lead technical deep-dives, security and architecture reviews, and competitive differentiation discussions; handle the hardest objections in the room.
* Refine solution narratives based on client feedback and market conditions.
* Oversee a seamless transition from sales to delivery — architecture decision records, working code, known risks, and continuity of the people involved.

Build the practice
  
  

* Create thought leadership and reusable IP; represent the firm externally at client forums, partner events, and in published material.
* Mentor AI Leads and engineering teams; grow the bench of people who can do this role.
* Collaborate with hyperscalers and product partners to craft next-generation AI-led experiences and co-funded initiatives.

**Must-have Skills And Experience**
**Architecture and platform depth**

* Proven track record architecting and shipping production-grade GenAI/agentic systems in enterprise environments — not only pilots.
* Deep command of LLM selection and evaluation, context engineering, model routing and cost control, and the trade-offs between prompting, retrieval, tool use, and fine-tuning.
* Strong microservices and integration architecture: event-driven and API-led patterns, identity and access, secrets, multi-tenancy, and integration with core enterprise systems.
* Enterprise concerns as first-class design inputs: security, privacy, data residency, model governance, responsible AI, and regulatory constraints.

**Agentic AI engineering (hands-on)**

* Hands-on working knowledge of defining and configuring prompts, instructions, tools, reasoning strategies, guardrails, memory, and orchestration in AI agent development.
* Design and debugging of multi-agent and long-horizon workflows, including failure modes, recovery, and human-in-the-loop control points.
* Strong experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, tokenization, and prompt engineering — including retrieval evaluation and knowledge-freshness strategy.

**Engineering craft (hands-on)**

* Hands-on experience creating and maintaining Python libraries; working command of LangChain (or equivalent orchestration frameworks), Hugging Face, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, and locally hosted open models.
* Very strong experience developing RESTful APIs in Python with FastAPI (or similar) and integrating third-party services, UI components, and APIs.
* Hands-on Docker-based deployment, CI/CD, and disciplined use of Git/GitHub for source control and review — mandatory.
* Working knowledge of modern data platforms and their GenAI surfaces (Databricks, Snowflake Cortex, lakehouse patterns).

**Model Provider And Hyperscaler GenAI Platform Know-how**
  
  

* Broad, current understanding of the GenAI offerings across the major frontier-model providers and hyperscalers, with deep, hands-on mastery of at least one — deep enough to design on it, defend it in a client architecture review, and know where it breaks:

+ Anthropic — Claude model family, Claude API, tool use and extended thinking, Claude Agent SDK, MCP (Model Context Protocol) as an integration standard, Claude delivered via Amazon Bedrock / Vertex AI, and enterprise deployment and governance patterns.
+ OpenAI — GPT model family, Responses/Assistants APIs, Agents SDK, function calling, structured outputs, fine-tuning, batch and realtime APIs, enterprise data-handling commitments.
+ AWS — Amazon Bedrock (multi-model access, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Agents/AgentCore), SageMaker, and integration with AWS data, identity and security services.
+ Google — Gemini model family, Vertex AI (Model Garden, grounding, agent tooling, evaluation), and Gemini enterprise offerings.
+ Microsoft Azure — Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, AI Agent Service, AI Search for retrieval, and Azure-native identity, networking and compliance patterns.

* Able to construct and defend a multi-provider model strategy: capability-to-task mapping, model routing and tiering, benchmark and eval evidence, context-window and latency envelopes, unit economics, rate limits and capacity planning, deprecation and version-migration risk.
* Fluent in the enterprise decision criteria that actually settle these choices — data residency and sovereignty, tenant isolation, IP and training-data commitments, certifications and auditability, regional availability, and the client's existing cloud and licensing commitments.
* Designs for portability where it matters: provider-abstracted interfaces, gateway/routing layers, and prompt and eval assets that survive a model or vendor change, without over-abstracting to the point of losing provider-specific capability.
* Keeps pace with a fast-moving field and translates new releases into concrete client opportunity, filtering hype from what is production-ready.

**Consultative and commercial ability**

* Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business problems into crisp AI use cases with clear value hypotheses and measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication and articulation skills; credible with a CIO/CDO and with a client's principal engineer in the same day.
* Commercial fluency: estimation, deal shaping, pricing implications of architecture choices, and the discipline to say no to a use case that will not survive contact with production.
* Hands-on prototyping mindset — able to quickly build functional demos, agent workflows, or LLM-powered interactions that accelerate client conviction.

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you
* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

CAIIHM operates college campuses in Chennai, Bangalore, and Hyderabad, along with admission offices in 16 cities across South India, supported by more than 300 faculty members and state-of-the-art infrastructure. The institute maintains industry partnerships with over 180 star hotels, enabling strong placement support and industrial exposure for students. Chennais Amirta is certified by multiple academic and professional bodies, including Bharathiar University, Alagappa University, Annamalai University, IPD–OUM Malaysia, London School of Business & Finance (Singapore), and Bharat Sevak Samaj.
  
**Role Description**
The Placement Manager is responsible for overseeing and coordinating all student placement activities, with a focus on building and maintaining strong partnerships with hospitality industry employers. This full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad includes identifying placement opportunities, organizing campus interviews, and aligning student profiles with suitable job openings. The role involves regular interaction with students to understand their career goals, provide guidance on interview preparation, and monitor placement outcomes. The Placement Manager will collaborate with faculty and administration to integrate industry requirements into training plans and ensure timely reporting on placement metrics and employer feedback.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong relationship management and networking skills to engage with hotel and hospitality partners.
* Experience in placement coordination, career services, or talent acquisition, preferably in education or hospitality.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to work effectively with students, employers, and internal teams.
* Organizational and planning abilities for managing placement drives, events, and employer outreach activities.
* Analytical skills to track placement data, generate reports, and improve placement strategies based on outcomes.
* Knowledge of the hospitality industry and current hiring trends; prior experience in hotel management or related fields is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related discipline.
* Proficiency in MS Office or similar tools for documentation, reporting, and communication.
* Ability to work on-site in Hyderabad and collaborate with multiple campuses and stakeholders.

title: Head of People Partnering, UK & Europe
description:
**About Tide**
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
  
  
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
  
  
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
  
  
**Tide Facts**

* Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

**About The Team**
The
**People Partnering team at Tide**
plays a pivotal role in driving business success by acting as strategic advisors and coaches to leaders at all levels. We provide expert guidance on organisational design, talent development, employee relations, and engagement, ensuring a positive and high-performance culture. Embedded within the business, we use data-driven insights to shape policies, pre-empt workforce challenges, and lead high-impact initiatives that enable Tideans to do work they love.
  
  
**About The Role**
As Head of People Partnering for UK & Europe, you will:
  
  

* Design and implement a People Partnering strategy for the Tide’s UK & Europe business that supports business objectives, enhances the employee experience, and fosters a high-performance culture.
* Act as a strategic partner and advisor to the CEO of Tide’s UK & Europe business and the UK & Europe management team, providing expert guidance on organisational design, workforce planning, performance management, and employee relations.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of People Partners, ensuring they are equipped to support leaders and teams across various markets. Foster a culture of collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
* Support business leaders in driving organisational change, equipping them with the necessary people management tools to ensure smooth transitions and sustained business performance.
* Partner with business leaders and the Director of People Experience to drive employee engagement, interpret survey insights, and implement targeted action plans to enhance team satisfaction, retention, and productivity.
* Ensure HR policies and programs align with relevant employment laws and industry best practices while managing cross-border employment complexities.
* Use HR analytics to inform people strategies, track key workforce metrics, and present actionable insights to business leaders.
* Oversee performance management, career development, and succession planning initiatives to build a strong talent pipeline and support internal mobility.
* Provide direct coaching to managers on complex employee relations matters, leadership development, and team effectiveness.
* Embed diversity, equity, and inclusion across all aspects of people partnering, ensuring it remains a core pillar of talent, engagement, and leadership strategies.
* Upholding and promoting the values of Tide in all interactions and decisions.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Progressive HR experience, including direct partnership with SVPs / C-Suite leaders.
* Extensive experience partnering with cross-cultural leadership teams.
* Experience with line management of both junior and senior People Partners.
* Good understanding of global HR practices and employment laws, particularly in India and various European countries.
* Strong client focus with outstanding judgement, critical thinking and analytical skills.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to align HR strategies with business goals.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Demonstrated ability to drive change at pace and foster a positive organisational culture.
* Ideally experience leading HR for a commercial and operations client groups (not essential).

**What You’ll Get In Return**
Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
  
  

* Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options.
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
* Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
* Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
* Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
* Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING
  
  
At Tide, we champion a
**flexible workplace**
model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.
  
  
While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
  
  
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
  
  
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
  
  
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
  
  
*At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.*
**Disclaimer**
It Has Come To Our Attention That Individuals Or Agencies Are Falsely Claiming To Represent Tide And Are Reaching Out To Candidates Regarding Job Opportunities. Please Be Aware That
  
  

* Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
* All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
* Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
* Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.

*If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
  
  
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.*
**Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.**

*.**

title: Service Delivery Manager - Talent Acquisition
description:
**BUREAU VERITAS | HR SHARED SERVICES HUB, NOIDA**

**Service Delivery Manager – Talent Acquisition**

*Global Process Owner, Talent Acquisition Operations (R2H)*

**Tower**

Recruit to Hire (R2H)

  

**Location**

Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

  

**Reports to**

HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

  

**Role type**

People manager

  

**Scope**

Requisition management, sourcing support, interview scheduling, offer management, pre-employment checks and onboarding

  

**Grade**

As per BV grading framework

**ABOUT THE HUB**

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

You own the recruitment and onboarding engine for every country moving into Noida. You will replace fragmented local practices with one standard, compliant and fast hiring process. Hiring managers should get the talent they need quickly, and every candidate should get a consistent, high-quality experience.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Transition and shared services set-up**

* Map current recruitment and onboarding practice in each country, including steps, tools, vendors, volumes and cycle times, and set the baseline.
* Design the R2H target operating model. Define what moves to the hub, what stays with in-country recruiters and business partners, and what goes to vendors or RPO partners.
* Lead country-by-country transition, covering knowledge transfer, template and offer-letter harmonisation, and stabilisation after cutover.
* Set up the hub's scheduling, offer and onboarding desks, with capacity models tied to hiring forecasts.

**2. Process ownership and service delivery**

* Act as Global Process Owner for R2H. Own the standard process from requisition to day one, including approval rules and local variations.
* Manage recruitment and background-check vendors across markets. Scorecard them on time-to-fill, quality of hire, diversity and cost.
* Map the candidate journey from end to end, remove friction points, and lift offer acceptance and employer-brand scores.
* Deliver a consistent onboarding experience. New joiners should have their systems, equipment and paperwork ready on day one.
* Act as the escalation point for hiring managers and TA partners on service issues.

**3. Governance, risk and controls**

* Work with Legal, Compliance and country HR to keep every step compliant with local labour law, right-to-work rules and data privacy law.
* Own controls over offer approvals, compensation within band, and the retention and deletion of candidate data.
* Embed BV's DEI standards in sourcing, shortlisting and vendor contracts, and report on them regularly.

**4. Continuous improvement and digital**

* Drive full ATS adoption and automate scheduling, offer generation and e-signature.
* Introduce AI-enabled tools for screening and scheduling, with fairness and privacy safeguards.
* Use funnel analytics to find where time is lost, and fix causes at their source.

**5. People leadership, performance and culture**

* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* First 90 days: TA baseline, R2H operating model and vendor strategy agreed.
* By go-live: scheduling, offer and onboarding desks live for the first wave of countries.
* Within 12–18 months: measurable cuts in time-to-hire and higher candidate NPS across the regions in scope.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

**KPI**

**Indicative target**

  

**Time to offer / time to fill**

Reduced against the country baseline

  

**Offer TAT**

* 95%

  

**Candidate NPS**

* +40

  

**Hiring manager satisfaction**

* 4.3 / 5

  

**Day-one readiness**

* 98% of joiners fully set up

  

**Vendor SLA adherence**

* 95%

  

**Cost per hire**

Reduced against baseline

*Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines.*

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* End-to-end recruitment operations at volume, including high-volume and multi-country hiring.
* Management of recruitment vendors, RPO partners and background-screening providers.
* ATS and onboarding platforms (Workday Recruiting, SuccessFactors RCM/ONB, iCIMS or similar).
* Candidate experience design, journey mapping and employer-brand metrics.
* Recruitment compliance covering labour law, right to work and GDPR for candidate data.
* Recruitment analytics and capacity forecasting.

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**

Customer-centric leadership • Builds teams from zero • Drives change and adoption • Sound judgement under pressure • Influences without authority across countries • Data-led decision making • Coaches and develops talent • Holds a high bar on control

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

**Essential**

* 15+ years in HR, including 8+ years leading talent acquisition operations.
* Has led a TA transition into shared services or an RPO model.
* Has managed hiring volumes of 3,000+ per year across several countries.
* Master's degree in HR, Business or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Experience in the testing, inspection and certification (TIC), engineering or professional services sectors
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt
* Experience deploying AI recruitment tools

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**

Hub Director, Global TA leadership, hiring managers, country HR, Legal and Compliance, recruitment and screening vendors, IT.

description:
Overview:

**Manager, Atlassian Products**

Job Description

**Department:**

Business Technology – Atlassian Products

**Reports To:**

Director, Business Technology

**Location:**

India – Bangalore (On-site)

**Level:**

People Manager – Mid/Senior

**About HealthEdge**
====================

HealthEdge is a leading healthcare SaaS company delivering modern, cloud-native solutions that transform how health plans operate. With a global workforce spanning the US, India, Philippines, Mexico, and the UK, our Business Technology team powers the tools and platforms that keep HealthEdge running at scale. Atlassian tools – Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence – sit at the center of how work gets planned, tracked, and documented across the entire organization.

**Role Overview**
=================

The Manager, Atlassian Products is a player-manager responsible for leading HealthEdge's Atlassian platform team while remaining technically engaged in the work. You will manage a globally distributed team of Atlassian Administrators – supporting thousands of users across engineering, IT, product, and business functions. Reporting to the Director, Business Technology, you are accountable for platform health, governance, stakeholder relationships, and team development.

This is a growth environment. The Atlassian team today spans approximately 14 people and is expected to grow toward 24 as HealthEdge's platform needs expand. You'll be responsible for hiring, onboarding, and developing talent for a 6-8 person group while ensuring the platform continues to meet the demands of a complex, fast-moving organization.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Team Leadership & Development**
---------------------------------

* Lead, manage, and develop a globally distributed team of Atlassian Administrators in India
* Drive hiring for open roles on the Atlassian Products team, partnering with HR and the Director, Business Technology to scale the team toward its target size
* Set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, conduct performance reviews, and support career development for all direct reports
* Build a high-performing team culture grounded in platform rigor, user focus, and continuous improvement
* Manage team capacity, workload distribution, and prioritization across the support queue and project backlog

**Platform Strategy & Governance**
----------------------------------

* Own the Atlassian platform roadmap in partnership with the Director, Business Technology – defining priorities, driving improvements, and aligning with organizational needs
* Establish and enforce governance standards for project structure, permissions, naming conventions, workflows, and Confluence space management across the organization
* Lead the evaluation and lifecycle management of Atlassian Marketplace apps — assessing fit, managing licenses, and governing usage
* Oversee Atlassian Access configuration including SSO, SCIM provisioning, security policies, and license management
* Drive platform hygiene initiatives and ensure the environment remains clean, well-documented, and audit-ready

**Technical Oversight & Solution Design**
-----------------------------------------

* Serve as the escalation point for complex platform issues and solution design decisions that exceed senior administrator scope
* Guide the design and implementation of advanced Jira, JSM, and Confluence configurations including complex workflows, automation frameworks, and cross-project solutions
* Oversee the development and maintenance of scripts and automation rules across the platform
* Ensure platform changes follow change management practices with appropriate testing, documentation, and rollback planning
* Stay current on Atlassian product developments, roadmap changes, and best practices, and translate these into team guidance

**Stakeholder Management**
--------------------------

* Serve as the primary business relationship owner for Atlassian products across IT, Engineering, Product, and business functions
* Partner with senior stakeholders to understand evolving platform needs and translate them into prioritized, scalable solutions
* Run regular stakeholder touchpoints, communicate platform changes and improvements proactively, and manage escalations professionally
* Partner with the ITSM team to ensure JSM is optimized for IT service delivery – SLAs, queues, automations, and reporting

**Operations & Reporting**
--------------------------

* Own the Atlassian support queue at a team level – ensuring SLA compliance, queue health, and consistent quality of delivery
* Produce and present regular reporting on platform health, team performance, license utilization, and open initiatives
* Manage the Atlassian vendor relationship including renewal negotiations, support cases, and TAM engagement
* Support audit and compliance activities related to Atlassian access, configuration, and data governance

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

**Required**
------------

* 5+ years of hands-on Atlassian administration experience, with deep expertise in Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence
* 2+ years of people management experience, including hiring, developing, and performance-managing technical team members
* Proven ability to lead a team in a global, distributed environment
* Strong platform governance experience – designing and enforcing standards across a large, complex Atlassian environment
* Experience with Atlassian Cloud administration including Atlassian Access, SSO/SCIM, and security policy management
* Hands-on experience with Jira automation (native) and advanced automation tooling
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate business requirements into platform solutions
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

**Preferred**
-------------

* Atlassian certifications (ACP-120, ACP-420, ACP-620, or equivalent) strongly preferred
* Experience managing Atlassian teams or platforms through growth, migrations, or consolidation projects
* Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and applying them within JSM for enterprise ITSM
* Experience with Atlassian Marketplace apps at scale (ScriptRunner, Insight/Assets, Advanced Roadmaps, Elements Connect, or similar)
* Exposure to REST API integrations with Atlassian platforms
* Experience in a healthcare, SaaS, or other regulated industry environment
* Background in post-merger IT integration or multi-instance Atlassian environments

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within 90 days, you have a clear picture of the current team, platform state, and stakeholder landscape, have identified the highest-priority gaps in governance and delivery, and have begun filling open roles. Within six months, the team is operating with clear standards, the support queue is consistently within SLA, and key stakeholders have a trusted partner in you. Within a year, the Atlassian Products team has grown toward its target size, platform governance is mature and well-documented, and you have established the function as a reliable, high-performing part of the Business Technology organization.

**About the Team**
==================

You'll lead a dedicated Atlassian Products team that is central to how HealthEdge operates. With Jira Software driving engineering and product delivery, JSM powering IT service management, and Confluence serving as the organization's knowledge backbone, the platform this team manages touches every function in the company. It's a high-visibility role with real impact — and a team and roadmap that reflect a serious, long-term investment in the Atlassian platform.

**Geographic Responsibility: This position is located in Bangalore**
  
**Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent**  
**FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt**  
**Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:**

* **The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.**
* **Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.**
* **Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.**

title: HR Technology – Workday Reporting and Analytics
description:
Carrier is the leading global provider of healthy, safe, and sustainable building and cold chain solutions with a world-class, diverse workforce with business segments covering HVAC, refrigeration, and fire and security. We make modern life possible by delivering safer, smarter, and more sustainable services that make a difference to people and our planet while revolutionizing industry trends. This is why we come to work every day. Join us and we can make a difference together.

**About this role**

The ideal candidate will deliver on the Workday reporting priorities. The work will directly support Carrier's Human Resources Strategy in delivering actionable insights to HR and People Leaders.

**Specific Responsibilities:**

* Provide expertise on Workday reporting best practices and standards. This includes creating reports, dashboards, and analytics that deliver actionable insights to support strategic HR decision-making.
* Have hands on experience on WD Studio and integrations
* Determine Workday Analytics Suite solutions as questions/needs arise from Carrier’s HR business and COE (Center of Excellence) stakeholders.
* Serve as a Workday Prism expert with deep knowledge of current functionality, design concepts, touchpoints with relevant functional areas and in consideration of future product direction.
* Develop Prism solutions, Discovery Boards, reports, dashboards, and analytics to align with customer requirements.

* Develop and deliver training on Workday PRISM reporting functionality and other Workday Analytics tools, as needed.
* Have good knowledge of business objects and should be able to identify along with reporting needs.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of progressively responsible experience in data reporting and/or management.
* Workday reporting and PRISM experience required.
* Expertise with data architecture and business processes in a global organization.
* Advanced knowledge of Workday calculated fields and business objects.
* Strong background in dashboards, data analytics, reporting and change management.
* Building relationships and big-picture thinking, strong problem solving, and strategic communication skills with both business and technical teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* A degree in Computer Systems, Information Technology, Analytics, or related business area.
* Working knowledge of other Workday Analytics tools such as Discovery Boards is strongly preferred.
* Intermediate knowledge of Workday Security implications to Workday reporting.

title: Service Delivery Manager - Payroll
description:
**Service Delivery Manager – Payroll**

*Global Process Owner, Payroll & Reward Operations (R2P)*

**Tower:**
Reward to Pay (R2P)

**Location:**
Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

**Reports to:**
HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

**Role type:**
People manager

**Scope:**
Multi-country payroll, benefits administration, compensation changes, payroll accounting and tax filings

**ABOUT THE HUB**

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

You own payroll and reward delivery end to end for every country moving into Noida. You will move payroll from dozens of local vendors and in-country teams to a controlled, consolidated model. Employees must be paid accurately and on time, in every cycle and in every country, throughout the transition and after it.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Transition and shared services set-up**

* Lead the payroll transition roadmap country by country, sequenced by risk, complexity, headcount and vendor contract dates.
* Run knowledge transfer from country payroll teams and vendors. This covers desk procedures, statutory calendars, pay elements and local exceptions.
* Plan and run parallel payroll runs for each country. Set clear go/no-go criteria based on variance thresholds, and use hypercare after cutover.
* Deliver the global payroll vendor consolidation programme. Rationalise the vendor portfolio, support selection, and manage exit and onboarding without disrupting pay.
* Design the target operating model for R2P, covering the split of work between hub, vendor and country HR, with RACI, handoffs and cut-off calendars.

**2. Process ownership and service delivery**

* Act as Global Process Owner for R2P. Own process standards, the global pay calendar, the design of allowed variations, and change control.
* Deliver zero critical payroll errors per cycle through pre-payroll reconciliations, input validation, dual approval and post-pay checks.
* Monitor data flows between the HRIS, time-and-attendance, payroll engines and the general ledger. Resolve interface breaks before cut-off.
* Manage payroll vendors against contractual SLAs, with monthly scorecards, quarterly business reviews and service credits where needed.
* Act as the escalation point for pay issues. Run root-cause analysis on every off-cycle payment and track the fix through to closure.

**3. Governance, risk and controls**

* Build and maintain the R2P control framework, including key controls, segregation of duties, access reviews and evidence standards.
* Lead annual and ad-hoc audit readiness with Internal Audit, Tax and Finance. Close findings within the agreed timelines.
* Track statutory and regulatory change in every in-scope country. Implement change before its effective date.
* Protect employee pay data in line with GDPR and local privacy law.

**4. Continuous improvement and digital**

* Standardise pay elements and processes across countries. Reduce local exceptions to the minimum required by law.
* Automate reconciliations, variance analysis and exception reporting using RPA and analytics.
* Drive employee self-service for payslips, tax documents and pay queries to reduce inbound contacts.

**5. People leadership, performance and culture**

* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* First 90 days: R2P operating model, country wave plan and control framework signed off.
* By go-live: first wave of countries live in Noida after successful parallel runs.
* Within 12–18 months: vendor consolidation on track, zero critical errors sustained, and a clean audit outcome.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

**Indicative target**

**Payroll accuracy:**
≥ 99.5% of payslips error-free; zero critical errors

**On-time payment:**
100% of payrolls paid on the scheduled date

**Off-cycle payments:**
Reduced quarter on quarter; every case root-caused

**Statutory compliance:**
Zero penalties; 100% filings on time

**Vendor SLA adherence:**
≥ 98% against contracted SLAs

**Cost per payslip:**
Year-on-year reduction against baseline

**Audit outcome:**
No high-rated findings

*Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines.*

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* Deep multi-country payroll expertise covering gross-to-net, statutory deductions, tax and social security, and year-end.
* Payroll vendor and aggregator management (for example ADP, Ramco, Alight, or in-country providers), including contract and SLA governance.
* Payroll controls, SOX-style frameworks and audit management.
* Integration of HRIS (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors) with time and payroll systems, including interface monitoring.
* Payroll accounting, GL reconciliation and working knowledge of benefits administration.
* Parallel-run design, cutover planning and hypercare.

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**

• Builds teams from zero

• Customer-centric leadership

• Drives change and adoption

• Sound judgement under pressure

• Influences without authority across countries

• Data-led decision making

• Coaches and develops talent

**Tower:**
Query to Resolution (Q2R)

**Location:**
Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

**Reports to:**
HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

**Role type:**
People manager

**Scope:**
Multi-channel HR contact centre (Tier 0–2), case management, knowledge management and employee self-service

**ABOUT THE HUB**

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

You own the front door of HR. You will turn country help desks, shared inboxes and informal routes into one-tiered, multilingual service desk. Employees will get fast, accurate answers, and every query will be tracked, measured and used to improve how HR works.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Transition and shared services set-up**

* Map each country's current query channels, volumes, query types and resolution paths, and set the baseline.
* Design the Q2R tiered model: Tier 0 self-service and chatbot, Tier 1 hub desk, Tier 2 hub specialists, and Tier 3 CoE or country HR, with clear handoff rules.
* Set up the service desk for each transition wave, covering language coverage, time-zone rostering, channel setup and routing rules.
* Build the knowledge base before each go-live so that every in-scope query type has approved content from day one.

**2. Process ownership and service delivery**

* Act as Global Process Owner for Q2R. Own case categorisation, priority and SLA matrices, and escalation paths.
* Own the central knowledge base and keep it current. Target 95%+ coverage of Tier 1 queries and track content accuracy.
* Run weekly triage and trend reviews with HR business partners and GPOs. Turn repeat queries into process fixes in other towers.
* Plan workforce needs using volume forecasting and real-time management to meet service levels.
* Handle sensitive and VIP cases with discretion. Apply clear routing for ER, grievance and wellbeing matters.

**3. Governance, risk and controls**

* Run a quality assurance framework covering random case audits, calibration sessions, customer-feedback sampling and SLA scoring.
* Enforce data-privacy controls on case content, access and retention.
* Maintain a service catalogue and SLA agreements with each receiving country and CoE.

**4. Continuous improvement and digital**

* Increase self-service and chatbot deflection through better content and design.
* Use case and sentiment analytics to find the top drivers of contact and remove them at source.
* Deploy generative-AI agent assist and knowledge tools, with human quality control.

**5. People leadership, performance and culture**

* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* First 90 days: tier model, service catalogue, and case taxonomy with SLA matrix signed off.
* By go-live: service desk live for the first wave, with the knowledge base and QA framework running.
* Within 12–18 months: rising self-service deflection, FCR and CSAT at target, and falling repeat contacts.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

**Indicative target**

**First contact resolution:**
≥ 75% at Tier 1

**Employee CSAT:**
≥ 4.3 / 5

**SLA adherence (response and resolution):**
≥ 95%

**Self-service / chatbot deflection:**
Increased quarter on quarter

**Knowledge base coverage:**
≥ 95% of Tier 1 query types

**QA score :**
≥ 90%

**Repeat contact rate**
Reduced against baseline

*Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines.*

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* HR service delivery and case management platforms (ServiceNow HRSD, Salesforce, Workday Help or similar, preferably Zendesk).
* Knowledge management covering content governance, article lifecycle and search optimisation.
* Contact-centre operations, including workforce management, forecasting, real-time management and multi-channel routing.
* ITIL v4 service management practices.
* Quality assurance and speech/text analytics.
* Conversational AI and chatbot design.

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**

• Customer-centric leadership

• Builds teams from zero

• Drives change and adoption

• Sound judgement under pressure

• Influences without authority across countries

• Data-led decision making

• Coaches and develops talent

• Holds a high bar on control

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

**Essential**

* 15+ years in HR or employee services, including 7+ years leading a multi-country HR service desk.
* Has set up or transitioned an HR contact centre into shared services.
* Has led multilingual, multi-time-zone service operations.
* Master's degree in HR, Business or a related field.

**Preferred**

* ITIL v4 Foundation or higher
* COPC or similar contact-centre certification
* Experience implementing Zendesk HRSD

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**

Hub Director, other tower GPOs, HR business partners, CoEs, country HR, HR technology team, employee representatives where relevant.

You are the hub's performance and improvement engine. You will build the Intelligent Command Centre that gives leaders one real-time view of service health across every tower. You will also run the continuous improvement system that moves the hub from stable operations to best-in-class service.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Transition and shared services set-up**

* Design the hub's performance framework: a KPI tree, SLA definitions, data sources and a reporting cadence shared by all towers.
* Capture and certify the pre-transition baselines for each country, so the hub can prove its value against the starting point.
* Support the transition PMO with readiness scorecards, go/no-go dashboards and hypercare tracking for every wave.
* Set up the Intelligent Command Centre, covering architecture, data pipelines, dashboards and alerting.

**2. Process ownership and service delivery**

* Run the ICC day to day, with real-time SLA, volume, backlog and escalation monitoring across R2P, R2H, Q2R and A2W.
* Lead the hub's governance rhythm: daily stand-ups, weekly tower reviews, monthly service reviews and quarterly business reviews with stakeholders.
* Own the hub-wide customer voice programme, including CSAT and NPS surveys, closing the loop with respondents, and reporting insight.
* Run hub-level capacity and productivity analytics to support resourcing decisions.

**3. Governance, risk and controls**

* Own the hub quality management system, covering process documentation standards, internal quality audits and control testing across towers.
* Maintain the hub risk register and the tracking of issues and actions.
* Build data governance for performance reporting so that there is one version of the truth.

**4. Continuous improvement and digital**

* Build and govern the hub-wide continuous improvement backlog. Prioritise by value and effort, and agree ownership with each GPO.
* Lead improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma and process mining. Track benefits through to realised savings.
* Run the hub's automation and AI pipeline, from idea intake to business case, delivery and benefits tracking.
* Build a continuous improvement culture through training, recognition and a simple way for every employee to raise ideas.

**5. People leadership, performance and culture**

* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* First 90 days: hub KPI framework, baseline method and ICC design signed off.
* By go-live: ICC live with real-time dashboards for the first transition wave, and the governance rhythm running.
* Within 12–18 months: continuous improvement portfolio delivering measurable, validated benefits, with hub-wide dashboards trusted by global stakeholders.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

**KPI**

**Indicative target**

  

**Hub-wide SLA adherence**

* 95% across towers

  

**Validated CI benefits**

Annual savings and hours released against target

  

**Automation hours released**

Increased year on year

  

**Reporting timeliness and accuracy**

100% on schedule

  

**Hub CSAT / NPS**

At or above target

  

**Audit and quality findings**

Closed within agreed timelines

  

**CI participation**

% of employees who submitted or delivered an improvement

*Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines.*

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* Performance management and command-centre design for multi-tower shared services.
* Lean Six Sigma methods, including DMAIC, value-stream mapping and root-cause analysis.
* Data analytics and visualisation (Power BI or Tableau). SQL or data-modelling skills are an advantage.
* Process mining (Celonis, Signavio or similar) and automation pipeline management (RPA, AI).
* ITIL service level management and quality management systems.
* Benefits realisation and business case development.

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**

Customer-centric leadership • Builds teams from zero • Drives change and adoption • Sound judgement under pressure • Influences without authority across countries • Data-led decision making • Coaches and develops talent • Holds a high bar on control

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

**Essential**

* 15+ years of experience, including 7+ years in shared services performance, excellence or transformation roles.
* Has built and run an ICC, command centre or equivalent governance function.
* Has deployed continuous improvement frameworks across multi-tower shared services centres.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt.
* Master's degree in Business, HR, Engineering or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Transition PMO experience
* Process mining certification
* Change management certification (Prosci or equivalent)

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**

Hub Director, all tower GPOs, Global HR leadership, HR technology and data teams, Finance, Internal Audit, transformation partners.

title: Branch Manager
description:
**Company Description**
The Eye Foundation is a leading eye specialty hospital network in South India with nearly three decades of experience in delivering advanced eye care. The organization has treated millions of patients through its multi-specialty hospitals located in Coimbatore, Bangalore, Tirupur, Nilgiris, and surrounding regions. title: Customer Service Manager
description:
At ALS, we encourage you to dream big.
  
  
When you join us, you’ll be part of a global team harnessing the power of scientific testing and data-driven insights to build a healthier future.
  
  
**Customer Service Manager**
**Department:**
Food Testing Laboratory
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Reports to:**
Sales Director
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  

* Position Summary

The Customer Service Manager will lead the customer service function for the ALS Food Testing Laboratory and will be responsible for managing the complete customer journey—from enquiry and quotation through sample receipt, registration, testing coordination, reporting and invoice sharing.
  
  
The role will serve as the primary coordination point between clients, sales, laboratory teams, finance and other internal stakeholders. The position will ensure timely communication, effective follow-up, resolution of customer queries and smooth movement of samples through the laboratory workflow.
  
  
The Customer Service Manager will also lead, train and mentor the customer service team to improve operational efficiency, responsiveness and overall customer satisfaction.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* End-to-End Customer Support
* Manage customer requirements from initial enquiry through completion of testing and invoice submission.
* Act as the key point of contact for clients regarding:

+ Sample submission requirements
+ Test scope and service details
+ Sample status
+ Turnaround time
+ Test reports
+ Invoicing and commercial documentation

* Ensure customers receive timely, accurate and professional responses.
* Monitor customer requests and ensure appropriate follow-up until closure.
* Maintain clear records of all client communications and commitments.
* Sample Registration and Workflow Coordination
* Coordinate the complete sample registration process, including:

+ Receipt and verification of samples
+ Sample details and documentation
+ Chain-of-custody requirements
+ Tests requested
+ Special instructions
+ Sample condition and quantity

* Ensure samples are registered accurately and promptly in the laboratory information management system or applicable internal system.
* Follow up on missing information, documentation, approvals or payment requirements.
* Monitor samples placed on hold and coordinate with clients and laboratory teams to clear them at the earliest opportunity.
* Track sample progress from receipt through testing, technical review and report release.
* Identify delays or workflow issues and escalate them to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Coordination with Laboratory Teams
* Liaise closely with laboratory teams to ensure testing is initiated and completed within the agreed turnaround time.
* Follow up on pending analyses, technical clarifications, deviations and delayed results.
* Coordinate responses to customer queries requiring laboratory or technical input.
* Ensure client-specific requirements and special instructions are communicated accurately to the relevant laboratory personnel.
* Support the laboratory in obtaining missing information or clarifications required to proceed with testing.
* Escalate recurring operational issues and recommend corrective actions.
* Coordination with Sales and Commercial Teams
* Work closely with the sales team to ensure a smooth transition from enquiry to order execution.
* Support sales colleagues with customer information, test requirements, sample status and operational updates.
* Prepare and issue quotations based on client requirements, approved price lists and laboratory capabilities.
* Coordinate with the laboratory and technical teams for non-routine or customised testing requirements.
* Follow up with clients for quotation acceptance and purchase orders.
* Ensure purchase orders are received on time and are aligned with the agreed quotation and scope of work.
* Highlight potential commercial opportunities, additional testing requirements and scope expansion opportunities to the sales team.
* Customer Enquiries and Business Development Support
* Respond to new enquiries and coordinate internally to provide timely quotations and technical information.
* Follow up with existing clients regarding upcoming testing requirements, repeat samples and new projects.
* Proactively contact customers to understand their satisfaction, future needs and potential testing opportunities.
* Capture and communicate customer feedback to management, sales and laboratory teams.
* Identify opportunities for cross-selling and additional services, while ensuring that technical recommendations are appropriately validated.
* Maintain strong and professional relationships with key customers.
* Test Reports and Invoicing
* Coordinate the timely release and sharing of approved test reports with clients.
* Ensure reports are sent to the correct recipients and in accordance with client-specific requirements.
* Coordinate report revisions, clarifications and amendments with the relevant laboratory or quality personnel.
* Share invoices and related commercial documents with clients in a timely manner.
* Follow up on billing information, invoice queries and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate with finance and sales teams to resolve invoice-related issues.
* Team Management and Development
* Lead and manage the customer service team responsible for:

+ Sample registration
+ Quotation preparation
+ Client communication
+ Sample follow-up
+ Report sharing
+ Invoice coordination
+ Hold-sample clearance
+ Customer query management

* Allocate work effectively and monitor individual and team performance.
* Establish clear processes, responsibilities and service-level expectations.
* Train and mentor team members on:

+ Customer communication
+ Laboratory workflows
+ Sample registration
+ Quotation preparation
+ Use of internal systems
+ Escalation procedures
+ Documentation and data accuracy

* Conduct regular reviews, coaching sessions and knowledge-sharing activities.
* Identify training needs and support the professional development of team members.
* Promote a customer-focused, collaborative and accountable work culture.
* Ensure adequate backup and continuity for critical customer service activities.
* Quality, Compliance and Process Improvement
* Ensure customer service activities comply with ALS procedures, quality requirements and applicable laboratory accreditation standards.
* Maintain accurate and complete records relating to samples, quotations, purchase orders, customer communications and reports.
* Support the investigation and resolution of customer complaints and service deviations.

title: Strategic Builder
description:
**Description**
**The Experience**
Customer impact from day one. Strategic clarity and Execution that sticks.
  
  
Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists — Strategic Builders who are customer-facing advisors, who define AI strategy, shape agentic solutions, and drive measurable adoption for enterprise customers. You'll work as part of a delivery team alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, translating complex business challenges into agentic AI deployments that go live and generate real value.
  
  
Engagements are focused and time-bound — typically 12 weeks or less — and may span a single strategic account or multiple customers simultaneously. Your impact isn't just getting to deployment. It ensures customers realise lasting, scalable value from the solutions your team builds.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Full Lifecycle Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer engagement across the complete value lifecycle — Identify → Commit → Deploy → Consume — owning outcomes at every stage, not just discovery or deal closure
* AI Strategy & Architecture: Define the customer's Agentic AI strategy and roadmap. Lead design workshops, agent design sessions, and jobs-to-be-done analysis. Architect solutions spanning Salesforce's agentic AI platform, Data Cloud, and enterprise systems, with responsible AI governance baked in from the start.
* Deployment Oversight & Program Management: Manage engagement delivery end-to-end timelines, stakeholder communication, risk escalation, and progress reporting. You are the operational backbone of your delivery team, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
* Adoption & Consumption: Own adoption, consumption, and expansion metrics within your engagement scope. Identify blockers early and develop strategies to drive measurable value realization
* Delivery Team Coordination: Partner closely with the Forward Deployed Engineers on your team to align strategy with technical execution. Keep the team focused, unblocked, and on track to hit delivery milestones.
* AI-Supported Development: You'll be developing real customer solutions supported by leading-edge AI tools: Including
* Cursor, Claude, and our coding products like Vibes, to accelerate development.
* Customer Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary customer-facing contact, building trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders and present proposals, decisions and outcomes in terms of business value, not just technical detail.
* AI Readiness: Assess customer readiness for AI adoption and guide change management and process transformation to maximise the benefits of intelligent agents
* Product Feedback Loop: Synthesise field insights and translate them into actionable product feedback that influences Salesforce's Agentic AI platform roadmap.

**You're Our Person If...**

* 10-15 years of total experience with relevant 5 years into Data & AI in strategic solutioning, technical advisory, or delivery leadership or program management for enterprise cloud or SaaS technology
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* Prior customer-facing delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or technical advisory) - this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have
* Demonstrated understanding of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including Agentic AI capabilities and Data Cloud
* Working knowledge of one or more programming languages: Python, JavaScript, Java, or Apex
* Proven ability to lead and own complex, ambiguous engagements end-to-end — from discovery through to measurable outcomes
* Experience leading AI/LLM solution design, including agentic AI strategy, conversation design, and responsible AI practices
* Strong project and program management skills — ability to run multiple workstreams, manage stakeholder expectations, and keep delivery on track in ambiguous environments
* Ability to travel 25% of the time to customer sites

**Even Better If...**

* Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce platform, and Salesforce CRM (Sales, Service, Marketing)
* Experience designing and deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., public sector, financial services, healthcare)
* Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Data Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist, Application Architect) or similar platform certifications such as Microsoft, Oracle, or similar platforms.
* Background in change management, organisational design, or enterprise transformation
* Experience with AI/ML concepts beyond LLMs, including NLP, RAG architectures, and model evaluation frameworks
* A get-things-done mindset with strong bias for action — comfortable operating in unstructured fast moving environments
