title: Sr. Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing global accounts to enterprise-level customers.
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
  
  
Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time-to-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes-based governance frameworks for AI-native builds, and steering multi-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

Diverse Experiences

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
* Bachelor's degree in STEM field
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
* Experience in leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements

title: Senior Partnerships Manager - India
description:
Sprinto is an
**Autonomous Trust Platform**
that centralizes trust requirements across
**security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**

**raised**
**$31.8M**
in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
**4,000 organizations across 75 countries**
, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With
**300+ native integrations**
and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports
**200+ global security standards natively**
, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
  
  
**Founded in 2020**
by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
  
  
**Life as a Sprinter -**
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
  
  
We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
  
  
Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.
  
  
We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
  
  
And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
  
  
**The mission -**
We're hiring a
**Partnership Manager**
to build and scale Sprinto's partner ecosystem. This role is about creating long-term revenue through strategic partnerships, not just managing existing relationships.
  
  
You'll identify, recruit, and enable consulting firms, channel partners, resellers, system integrators, and managed service providers who can take Sprinto to new customers and markets. From building the partner pipeline to driving joint go-to-market initiatives and co-selling opportunities, you'll own the partner journey end to end.
  
  
We're looking for someone who understands that successful partnerships are built on mutual growth. Someone who can influence senior stakeholders, create repeatable partner programs, and turn relationships into predictable pipeline and revenue.
  
  
**Where you'll leave your mark?**

* Build and scale Sprinto's partner ecosystem by recruiting consulting firms, MSPs, MSSPs, system integrators, resellers, and channel partners
* Own the end-to-end partner lifecycle, from prospecting and qualification to onboarding, enablement, and long-term success
* Design and execute joint go-to-market strategies, including co-selling, co-marketing, and partner-led growth initiatives
* Develop partner enablement assets, business plans, sales collateral, and value proposition decks to help partners sell Sprinto effectively
* Partner closely with Sales teams on strategic opportunities and participate in customer conversations alongside partners
* Track partner health through pipeline generation, deal registrations, win rates, deal velocity, and overall revenue contribution
* Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to align on business goals, performance, and growth opportunities
* Own partner operations, including CRM and PRM hygiene, partner tiering, deal registration processes, and reporting
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams to launch partner programs and campaigns that accelerate growth

**The kind of builder we're looking for -**

* 5–8 years of overall experience, including 3+ years in SaaS partnerships, alliances, channel sales, or ecosystem roles
* Experience building and scaling partner programs across multiple markets
* Strong understanding of partner-led GTM motions, channel sales, and indirect revenue models
* Proven ability to recruit, enable, and grow strategic partners that contribute measurable pipeline and revenue
* Strong commercial acumen with experience supporting or participating in enterprise sales cycles
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills across executive and operational stakeholders
* Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams
* Highly organized, self-driven, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

This Role Is Ideal For Someone Who
  
  
  

* Enjoys building partnerships from scratch instead of simply managing existing accounts
* Thinks beyond partner recruitment and focuses on long-term partner success and revenue generation
* Can balance strategic relationship-building with operational excellence
* Loves collaborating across teams to create scalable GTM programs
* Is energized by building new markets and expanding partner ecosystems
* Measures success by partner-generated pipeline, revenue, and long-term business impact

**How we care for our Sprinters?**

* Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
* We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
* We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
* Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
* Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you

**Inclusion & Diversity -**
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
  
  
We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Analyst, Client Success
description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Client Success Analyst is an individual contributor responsible for managing a portfolio of Pismo clients predominantly in card issuing and ensuring they achieve their desired business outcomes from the Pismo platform. Acting as the primary day-to-day customer contact, the Analyst drives customer satisfaction, customer health, product adoption, revenue realization, and overall client success.

This role will be based in Bangalore, India.

The role combines customer relationship management, technical coordination, operational oversight, and business consulting. The Customer Success Analyst works independently to manage customer engagements while collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Support, and Commercial teams to deliver customer outcomes. For complex situations, strategic opportunities, and executive escalations, the Analyst will partner with Customer Success leaders and management.

The ideal candidate is customer-focused, technically competent, commercially aware, and capable of building trusted relationships with both operational and management-level stakeholders within client organizations and Pismo.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Customer Ownership & Business Outcomes**

* Serve as the primary owner for an assigned portfolio of customer accounts.
* Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business objectives, operating model, and strategic priorities.
* Ensure customers achieve their desired outcomes through effective use of Pismo's card issuing platform.
* Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders across operational, technical, and management levels.
* Lead regular operational reviews and governance discussions with customers.
* Act as the customer's advocate within Pismo and ensure commitments are delivered.

### **Customer Health, Satisfaction & NPS**

* Own and continuously improve Customer Health Scores for assigned customers.
* Drive customer satisfaction and Net Promoter Score (NPS) improvements through proactive engagement.
* Monitor customer sentiment, platform usage, service performance, and support trends to identify success opportunities and risks.
* Establish and execute action plans for customers showing signs of declining health.
* Drive proactive communication and follow-up to prevent escalations and strengthen customer confidence.

### **Revenue Realization & Growth**

* Ensure customers realize the value of their investment in the Pismo platform.
* Drive adoption of contracted products, features, and capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to increase platform utilization and business value.
* Support account planning activities by identifying expansion opportunities and revenue realization initiatives.
* Partner with Commercial and Account Management teams to contribute to revenue growth and retention objectives.

### **Technical Coordination & Issue Management**

* Develop strong knowledge of Pismo's card issuing platform, payment processing flows, APIs, product capabilities, and operational processes.
* Act as the coordination point between customers and internal Product, Engineering, SRE, Operations, and Support teams.
* Manage customer-reported issues through investigation, follow-up, communication, and resolution.
* Translate customer business requirements into actionable internal discussions.
* Ensure timely customer communication during incidents, enhancements, and platform changes.

### **Stakeholder Management**

* Build productive relationships with customer operational teams, program managers, product owners, and business leaders.
* Engage confidently with middle-management stakeholders and participate in discussions with senior leadership when required.
* Coordinate effectively across multiple internal teams to drive customer outcomes.
* Escalate risks, opportunities, and customer concerns appropriately to Customer Success leadership.

### **Reporting & Insights**

* Monitor and analyze customer performance metrics, health indicators, and adoption trends.
* Prepare customer scorecards, operational reports, governance materials, and business reviews.
* Identify trends, risks, and opportunities through data-driven analysis.
* Provide recommendations to improve customer experience, adoption, and operational efficiency.

**Success Measures**
--------------------

The Customer Success Analyst will be accountable for:

* Customer Health Score improvement
* Net Promoter Score (NPS)
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
* Revenue realization against contracted commitments
* Product adoption and engagement metrics
* Customer retention and renewal readiness
* Reduction in customer escalations
* Timely resolution and management of customer issues
* Delivery of customer success plans and agreed outcomes
* Positive customer and stakeholder feedback

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree or an Advanced Degree
* 3-6 years of experience in Customer Success, Client Services, Technical Account Management, Program Management, Payments Operations, Consulting, or related fields.
* Experience within payments, card issuing, fintech, banking, SaaS, or technology industries.
* Strong understanding of customer lifecycle management and customer success principles.
* Ability to independently manage customer relationships and workstreams.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and manage competing priorities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of card issuing, authorization processing, disputes, settlement, digital wallets, and payment network ecosystems.
* Experience working with API-based platforms and modern cloud technologies.
* Familiarity with Visa and Mastercard issuing environments.
* Experience managing customer health programs, adoption tracking, and business reviews.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1751744

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Associate Director, Strategy & Execution, Consumer Products and Retail, EY-Parthenon GDS India**

At EY, we develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We empower you in a flexible environment and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

We work together across our full spectrum of services and skills, powered by technology and AI, so that business, people and the planet can thrive together.

We’re all in, are you?

Join EY and shape your future with confidence.

  

**The opportunity**

The Strategy & Execution team in EY-Parthenon recognizes that CEOs and business leaders are tasked with achieving maximum value for their organizations’ stakeholders in a transformative business environment. We challenge assumptions to design and deliver strategies that improve profitability, strengthen competitiveness and create long-term value.

We are looking for an experienced strategy consulting professional to join EY-Parthenon GDS India as an Associate Director within the Consumer Products and Retail sector.

You will be based in EY GDS India and work as an integrated member of the Singapore Strategy & Execution team, primarily supporting client engagements across Singapore and the wider ASEAN region.

This is a client-facing consulting and leadership role. You will work closely with EY-Parthenon teams and clients across ASEAN to develop and deliver strategic opportunities, drawing on market, competitor and customer insights and incorporating commercial, operational, financial and implementation perspectives.

The role provides the opportunity to work on complex, cross-border engagements, develop relationships with senior stakeholders and contribute to building EY-Parthenon’s Consumer Products and Retail capabilities across Singapore, ASEAN and GDS India.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

**Client engagement and delivery**

* Lead client engagements, major workstreams or independent modules across strategy, commercial transformation and operational transformation assignments.
* Structure complex business problems, develop hypotheses and define robust approaches to address clients’ strategic and operational priorities.
* Lead the collection and analysis of quantitative and qualitative information, translate findings into insights and formulate practical recommendations.
* Take ownership of the quality, timeliness and commercial relevance of project deliverables.
* Work directly with client stakeholders to understand their priorities, align on project objectives and communicate emerging findings and recommendations.
* Lead or contribute to client discussions, working sessions, presentations and senior stakeholder meetings.
* Develop clear, compelling and evidence-based presentations and reports for senior client audiences.
* Work effectively with geographically dispersed engagement teams, coordinating closely with colleagues in Singapore, GDS India and other ASEAN markets.

**Strategy and transformation**

You will work across a range of strategy and transformation engagements, which may include:

* Market entry and growth strategy
* Go-to-market strategy
* Revenue growth management
* Commercial transformation
* Digital and AI-led transformation
* Commercial due diligence
* Post-merger integration
* Divestment strategy and execution
* Cost and organization transformation
* Supply chain and procurement transformation
* Sales and operations planning
* Retail commercial and operational transformation
* Turnaround strategy and rapid value creation

**Team leadership and capability development**

* Lead, coach and develop teams working across GDS India, Singapore and the wider EY-Parthenon network.
* Provide clear direction, constructive feedback and day-to-day support to team members.
* Contribute to building a strong Consumer Products and Retail capability within EY-Parthenon GDS India.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, learning and broader capability-development initiatives.
* Help strengthen collaboration and knowledge sharing between the Singapore and GDS India teams.
* Promote an inclusive, high-performing team environment focused on development, quality and client impact.

**Business and practice development**

* Support the development of ASEAN-focused proposals, credentials and other business-development materials.
* Contribute sector insights and subject-matter expertise to pursuit teams and client discussions.
* Help identify opportunities to deepen existing client relationships and support the development of new relationships.
* Contribute to the continued growth of the Strategy & Execution practice and its Consumer Products and Retail portfolio across ASEAN.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

To succeed in this role, you should be able to:

* Lead complex strategy and transformation workstreams with limited supervision.
* Combine rigorous analysis with sound commercial judgment and practical recommendations.
* Communicate complex ideas clearly and confidently to senior internal and client stakeholders.
* Build trusted working relationships across different organizations, markets and cultures.
* Manage multiple priorities and maintain high standards in a fast-paced, project-based environment.
* Lead, motivate and develop diverse teams operating across locations.
* Collaborate effectively with Singapore-based and wider ASEAN engagement teams.
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of the strategic, commercial and operational issues affecting Consumer Products and Retail businesses.
* Adapt your working approach to different client, cultural and market contexts.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor’s degree from a recognized institution. A master’s degree or MBA is preferred.
* At least six years of relevant professional experience, including significant experience in a strategy consulting firm or a closely related consulting environment.
* Demonstrated experience in the Consumer Products and Retail sector.
* Experience leading substantial workstreams, project modules or client engagements.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical and financial analysis skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing and presenting materials for senior stakeholders.
* Experience managing and developing consulting teams.
* The ability to work effectively with colleagues and clients across locations, functions and cultures.
* A willingness and ability to travel internationally in line with client and engagement requirements.

  

**Relevant Consumer Products and Retail experience**

Relevant experience should include one or more of the following areas:

* Corporate, portfolio, market entry or growth strategy
* Go-to-market strategy and commercial transformation
* Revenue growth management
* Digital and AI-led business transformation
* Cost reduction and operating-model transformation
* Supply chain and procurement transformation
* Sales and operations planning
* Retail commercial or operational transformation
* Commercial due diligence, post-merger integration or value creation

  

**Ideally, you will also have**

* Previous experience working with clients or consulting teams in Singapore, ASEAN or other international markets.
* Experience operating as part of a cross-border or globally integrated consulting team.
* Familiarity with the business environment, consumer trends and market dynamics of Singapore and the wider ASEAN region.
* Experience supporting consulting proposals, business development and client pursuits.
* Experience building sector capabilities, coaching teams or contributing to recruitment and learning initiatives.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to establish credibility with senior client stakeholders.

  

**Regional exposure and ways of working**

* The role requires close collaboration with colleagues and clients across ASEAN, with reasonable flexibility to accommodate regional engagement requirements.
* Periodic travel to Singapore and other ASEAN markets will be required, depending on client and engagement needs. This may include short-duration on-site assignments at different stages of an engagement.
* The successful candidate should be comfortable working in an integrated regional team, building relationships remotely and in person, and adapting to the requirements of cross-border client engagements.

title: Director Product Management
description:
**About Target:**

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.

Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Servicing organization well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target.

**About Team & Role:**

Target Enterprise Services (TES) is a globally integrated organisation focused on delivering operational excellence and enterprise transformation through service operations, procurement, finance, product, analytics, automation, and AI. Operating through a highly collaborative, cross-functional model, TES partners across the enterprise to simplify processes, improve experiences, reduce friction, create scalable capabilities and unlock business value for Guests, team members, vendors, and business partners.

Product Teams at TES are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology, data science and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all products, technology and design work.

As a Director of Product Management, you will set the overall strategic vision for your product portfolio and lead the team in delivering measurable business outcomes. You will establish short- and long-term product goals, define quarterly Objectives and Key Results, prioritise investments, and manage product budgets and financials.

The Director of Product Management based in India is a strategic product leader responsible for accelerating Service Centre product capabilities and AI adoption, strengthening execution rigour, prioritising investments, enabling operational efficiency, and providing leadership across Product, Technology, Data, Design, and Operations teams globally and locally.

Further the role will be responsible for

* Driving day-to-day product excellence and velocity of Cross-functional teams
* Ensuring strong alignment between global product strategy and local execution, especially faster decision making
* Elevating product thinking, maturity, innovation, and data-driven decision-making leveraging Digital-first mindset.
* Serving as the site leader for product team functionally reporting to the US product leader

**Detailed Job Description:**

Success in this role requires balancing strategic thinking with execution excellence, fostering strong product and engineering practices, and building high-performing teams. This leader will transform servicing data into actionable enterprise insights, accelerate digital adoption, reduce friction across customer journeys, and create scalable, reusable platforms that strengthen loyalty, improve productivity, and unlock enterprise value.

You will build, coach, and mentor a strong team of Product Managers while fostering a culture of progress, transparency, accountability, and efficiency. You will elevate the team’s performance by providing insightful, motivating, and constructive feedback and by partnering with senior leaders and peers across pyramids to resolve execution-related barriers.

You will lead product discovery with key stakeholders, validating hypotheses and concepts with customers before committing engineering capacity. You will guide complex work across multiple pyramids and interrelated specialities. You will use data and analytics to assess market context, inform decisions, evaluate product health and effectiveness, understand P&L impact, and provide clear recommendations to key stakeholders.

You will possess or develop a strong understanding of servicing platforms and systems, including data flows, transaction sequences, relevant technologies, and design principles, to enable innovative and scalable solutions across Target.

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

**About you:**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of product management experience, including experience leading product teams, preferably within retail, consumer, or servicing environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading product-driven business transformation.
* Experience managing product portfolios, investment priorities, budgets, financials, and business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of technology, data, analytics, and digital product development.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and align stakeholders across complex, cross-functional organisations.
* Expertise in establishing product vision, outcome-based roadmaps, OKRs, and success measures.
* Demonstrated ability to build, coach, and lead high-performing product teams.
* Expertise in agile product-development practices, including iterative development, discovery, experimentation, and backlog management.

title: Senior People Development Partner
description:
At SolarWinds, we're a people-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions.

The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We're looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world-class solutions in a fast-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you're looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you've come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us!

The Senior People Development Partner designs and delivers practical, scalable talent development solutions that build capability, strengthen performance, and support employee growth. This role partners with business leaders and People Partners to diagnose capability needs and translate business priorities into engaging learning experiences.

This hands-on role combines instructional design, facilitation, consulting, and project leadership. The Senior People Development Partner independently leads initiatives from needs analysis through implementation and evaluation, contributes to enterprise Talent Development programs, and uses AI and emerging technologies to improve learning effectiveness and efficiency.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Design and facilitate engaging learning programs, workshops, and blended experiences using adult learning, instructional design, and behavior-change principles.
* Create practical learning assets, including facilitator guides, participant materials, job aids, e-learning, microlearning, and pre-work.
* Partner with business leaders and People Partners to identify capability gaps, understand root causes, and recommend targeted development solutions.
* Serve as a trusted advisor, translating business needs into clear learning strategies and practical actions.
* Lead end-to-end People Development projects, including needs assessment, scoping, planning, stakeholder alignment, content development, delivery, evaluation, and sustainment.
* Contribute to enterprise programs across onboarding, career development, performance management, manager development, leadership development, and succession planning.
* Build scalable solutions and resources that can be deployed globally while allowing for appropriate local context.
* Collaborate with stakeholders, subject-matter experts, and vendors to ensure solutions are relevant, inclusive, accurate, and aligned to intended outcomes.
* Support adoption through clear communication, manager enablement, change management, reinforcement, and on-the-job application.
* Define success measures and use feedback, learning analytics, talent data, and business indicators to evaluate impact and improve programs.
* Support the effective use of learning technologies, including the LMS and digital learning platforms, and apply generative AI to improve content development, personalization, accessibility, and efficiency.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 5-8 years of experience in Talent Development, Learning & Development, Organizational Development, or a related field.
* Experience designing, developing, and facilitating learning for employees, managers, and leaders.
* Strong knowledge of adult learning, instructional design, facilitation, and behavior-change principles.
* Experience leading end-to-end learning or Talent Development projects and partnering with leaders and People Partners to develop solutions.
* Strong consulting, communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, and project management skills.
* Experience with learning management systems, digital learning platforms, and content development tools.
* Practical proficiency using generative AI to improve learning design, content creation, or workplace productivity.
* Ability to use data and feedback to assess effectiveness, make recommendations, and improve learner experiences.
* Strong critical thinking, organization, adaptability, and ability to work effectively with globally distributed teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a global SaaS, software, cybersecurity, or technology organization.
* Experience supporting manager development, leadership development, career development, performance management, or onboarding programs.
* Familiarity with talent management platforms, learning analytics, digital authoring tools, and virtual learning technologies.
* Experience designing scalable learning solutions for geographically distributed audiences.
* Familiarity with change management, organizational effectiveness, capability building, and content curation.

Campaign Planning & GrowthOwn the commercial success of every major campaign spanning Meta Ads, Google Ads, performance marketing, CAC, ROAS, CTR, conversion, creative testing, audience segmentation, landing-page conversion, remarketing, and WhatsApp marketing. title: Payroll Vendor Manager, Amazon Global Payroll team
description:
**Description**
The Amazon Payroll team within Amazon Finance Operations (FinOps) is a fast-paced, team-focused, dynamic environment. Our mission is to pay employees accurately and on time, every time, whilst keeping our costs controlled and complying with all regulatory requirements. The Amazon Payroll team is looking for an energetic, enthusiastic relationship manager with outstanding analytical, negotiation, and project management skills to join our Vendor Management team.
  
  
The Payroll Vendor Manager is responsible for payroll vendor selection, and vendor management across all countries. This position will help oversee the performance of payroll service providers (vendors) and keep all agreements current. The incumbent is required to build strong relationships with Legal, Finance Operations, Tech, Compliance, HR, and regional payroll operations teams.
  
  
This broad role is not only a relationship management role, it also focuses on Operational Excellence by partnering with Lean Six Sigma Black Belt team members to support continuous improvement of Amazon processes, aligning them with customer requirements, and delivering positive impacts in controllership, quality, and cost savings. This role may expand beyond the payroll space to support internal partners in FinOps and HR as needed. This position will initially have no direct reports.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To**

* Supporting the management of payroll vendor selection.
* Supporting market research activities.
* Supporting the negotiation and maintenance of contracts, ensuring reduction of cost per pay slip and alignment with Amazon's compliance and control requirements.
* Assisting and participating in vendor meetings as required.
* Analyzing and developing vendor performance data to support vendor governance.
* Analyzing vendor cost and cost improvement opportunities, monitoring monthly spending patterns, and identifying exceptions and areas for potential improvement.
* Deep diving customer pain points in a country and making recommendations for scalable solutions.
* Responding to escalations in a timely manner
* Supporting continued development of materials, techniques, and metrics to identify opportunities to improve VM tools, systems, and processes.
* Building and maintaining knowledge management tools such as wikis and shared drives.
* Training and mentoring stakeholders in vendor-related processes.

**Key Skills Required**

* Experience in payroll, HRO, or BPO services, account management, process improvement, procurement, contract negotiation, and creation. Ability to invent and simplify processes, adopt AI tools to drive efficiency, and willingness to learn the payroll cycle and collaborate across multiple teams.
* Communication, problem-solving, process improvement, stakeholder management, negotiation skills, and experience leveraging AI tools for operational improvement.

description:
***Company Overview***  
*AutoRABIT is an enterprise platform for Salesforce DevSecOps that enables organizations to manage AI-accelerated Salesforce development with greater security, governance, visibility, and control. Its integrated product suite supports the complete Salesforce DevSecOps lifecycle through* ***AutoRABIT ARM*** *for CI/CD and release management,* ***CodeScan*** *for static code analysis and application security,* ***Vault*** *for data backup and recovery, and* ***Guard*** *for security posture management. ***Job Role***  
*Own the technical direction and delivery outcomes of a major product area or substantial cross-team initiative. This is a hands-on individual contributor role combining deep engineering ability with customer understanding and product judgment. You will shape solutions with Product and Engineering, implement critical components and remain accountable for how they perform after release.*  
  
***Key Responsibilities***

* ***Product and technical direction.*** *Understand customer workflows, adoption barriers and relevant market alternatives with Product and customer-facing teams. Develop evidence-based recommendations on what to improve, simplify or avoid building. Translate agreed priorities into architecture, delivery increments and measurable outcomes.*

Make trade-offs explicit and help teams deliver secure, maintainable software rather than leaving execution at the design stage.*
* ***Production AI judgment.*** *Develop AI-enabled capabilities where they offer meaningful customer value. Define evaluation cases, security boundaries, human approvals where needed, failure handling and acceptable cost and latency. Select conventional engineering approaches when they solve the problem more reliably.*

Address technical debt through staged investments linked to customer or delivery impact. Resolve systemic causes of production problems and improve prevention.*

Partner with Product on priorities, Engineering Managers on delivery capacity and the Distinguished Engineer or CTO on company-wide architecture. Document decision ownership and escalate unresolved cross-product trade-offs.*
* *Responsibility to adhere to set internal controls.*

***Pride of Ownership***  
*We value pride of ownership. Understand the customer, the product and the market need; form a clear, evidence-based opinion about how the product can improve; and work with others to turn that opinion into results. Strong coding skills and effective use of AI matter, but accountability continues after a feature is shipped. Be willing to challenge assumptions, listen to feedback and change your view when the evidence changes.*  
  
***Experience & Desired Skills***

* *12+ years delivering enterprise software, with demonstrated Principal-level ownership of significant initiatives; scope and outcomes carry more weight than tenure alone.*

* *Evidence of influencing product decisions, leading cross-team implementation and mentoring senior contributors.*
* *Clear communication with technical and business stakeholders across regions.*

***Preferred Skills (Good to Have)***

* *Salesforce metadata, APIs or release workflows; DevSecOps, CI/CD, data protection or developer-tool products.*
* *Modernisation of complex enterprise platforms and work in regulated or security-sensitive settings.*
* *Significant proprietary product achievements, open-source contributions, publications or patents demonstrating technical influence.*

***What success looks like***

* *Within 90 days, understand the assigned product area, agree outcome measures and identify its most consequential technical constraints.*
* *Within six months, deliver agreed milestones for a substantial initiative and demonstrate improvement against its baseline.*
* *Build durable capability in the team through reusable components, documented decisions and mentoring.*

***Why join AutoRABIT***  
*You will shape important product decisions while remaining close to implementation. This role offers ownership of meaningful customer outcomes and the opportunity to strengthen the technical foundations of AutoRABIT products.*

title: Key Account Manager - Mumbai
description:

At Cytiva, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.
  
  
You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.
  
  
Working at Cytiva means being at the forefront of providing new solutions to transform human health. Our incredible customers undertake life-saving activities ranging from fundamental biological research to developing innovative vaccines, new medicines, and cell and gene therapies.
  
  
At Cytiva you will be able to continuously improve yourself and us – working on challenges that truly matter with people that care for each other, our customers, and their patients. Take your next step to an altogether life-changing career.
  
  
Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.
  
  
The
**Key Account Manager**
is responsible for will manage and grow relationships with strategic customers in the bioprocessing and life sciences sectors. You will be responsible for driving business growth, managing account relationships, and positioning Cytiva’s innovative solutions to meet customer needs.
  
  
This position reports to the Strategic Accounts Manager and is part of the BioProcess Commercial Organization located in
**Mumbai**
and will be working remotely to cover the assigned customers. At Cytiva, our vision is, to advance future therapeutics from discovery to delivery.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Account Growth & Market Share: Drive market share growth through effective territory planning, account management, and value-based selling. Achieve sales targets and contribute to the broader company goals by promoting Cytiva’s portfolio of bioprocess and life sciences solutions. Drive the identification and generation of demand for new technologies, products, and services within assigned accounts. Focus on expanding Cytiva’s footprint in both existing and new customer organizations.

* Sales Expertise: Ability to manage and close sales cycles, forecast accurately, and achieve sales targets. Experience in leveraging CRM tools (Salesforce.com) for customer relationship management and sales forecasting is a plus.

Cytiva, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.

title: Head - Marketplaces & Quick Commerce
description:
Marketplaces and quick commerce are two of the largest growth channels this role owns both end to end: the revenue, the profitability, the operational health, and the team that runs them day to day.

**Marketplace & Quick Commerce Revenue Growth**

* Own and grow marketplace revenue across platforms (Amazon, Flipkart, and similar)
* Own and grow quick-commerce revenue to across platforms (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, and similar)
* Set and track platform-wise revenue targets, adjusting strategy as performance data comes in

**Channel Profitability**

* Keep every channel CM2-positive; track contribution margin by platform monthly
* Own retail media and ad spend on marketplace and quick-commerce platforms (Amazon Ads, Flipkart Ads, Blinkit/Zepto sponsored placements) with ROAS targets that protect CM2
* Monitor competitive pricing and promotional activity on each platform, adjusting strategy to protect margin and market share

**Operational Health Metrics**

* Track and sustain RIS%, PO fill rates, and on-shelf availability — with particular focus on quick commerce OSA
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Warehouse on demand forecasting and inventory allocation

**Team Building & Leadership**

* Recruit, onboard, and manage a team of Key Account Managers, with all KAMs reporting into this role
* Allocate platforms and accounts across the team, and set individual targets that ladder up to overall channel goals
* Build the team's capability so KAMs can independently manage platform relationships and day-to-day operations

**Platform & Cross-Functional Relationship Management**

* Own strategic relationships with marketplace and quick-commerce platform category/account teams
* Coordinate new SKU listings and launches across all platforms
* Coordinate with Regulatory & Compliance on marketplace listing compliance before SKUs go live

**Reporting**

* Report revenue, CM2, and operational metrics to leadership on a regular cadence, with a clear read on what's driving hits or misses

**Requirements:**

* 6-10+ years of experience in marketplace, e-commerce, or quick-commerce roles, including at least 2-3 years directly managing a team
* Proven experience owning contribution margin (CM1/CM2) or channel profitability, not just topline revenue
* Direct, hands-on experience managing retail media and ad spend on marketplace platforms (Amazon Ads, Flipkart Ads) and/or quick-commerce sponsored placements
* Track record of scaling marketplace or quick-commerce revenue at a D2C or e-commerce brand — real numbers, not just "grew revenue" claims
* Experience building or managing a team of Key Account Managers or similar account-owning roles
* Comfortable with operational metrics (fill rate, OSA, return rate) and coordinating with Supply Chain/Warehouse to hit them
* Strong analytical and Excel/dashboard skills

title: Service Delivery Manager - Performance & Continuous Improvement
description:
**BUREAU VERITAS | HR SHARED SERVICES HUB, NOIDA**

**Service Delivery Manager – Performance & Continuous Improvement**

*Intelligent Command Centre (ICC) & Transformation Lead – all towers*

**Tower**

Cross-tower: Performance, Governance & Continuous Improvement

  

**Location**

Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

  

**Reports to**

HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

  

**Role type**

People manager

  

**Scope**

Intelligent Command Centre, SLA and KPI governance, continuous improvement portfolio, transition PMO support and hub quality management

  

**Grade**

**ABOUT THE HUB**

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

You are the hub's performance and improvement engine. You will build the Intelligent Command Centre that gives leaders one real-time view of service health across every tower. You will also run the continuous improvement system that moves the hub from stable operations to best-in-class service.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Transition and shared services set-up**

* Design the hub's performance framework: a KPI tree, SLA definitions, data sources and a reporting cadence shared by all towers.
* Capture and certify the pre-transition baselines for each country, so the hub can prove its value against the starting point.
* Support the transition PMO with readiness scorecards, go/no-go dashboards and hypercare tracking for every wave.
* Set up the Intelligent Command Centre, covering architecture, data pipelines, dashboards and alerting.

**2. Process ownership and service delivery**

* Run the ICC day to day, with real-time SLA, volume, backlog and escalation monitoring across R2P, R2H, Q2R and A2W.
* Lead the hub's governance rhythm: daily stand-ups, weekly tower reviews, monthly service reviews and quarterly business reviews with stakeholders.
* Own the hub-wide customer voice programme, including CSAT and NPS surveys, closing the loop with respondents, and reporting insight.
* Run hub-level capacity and productivity analytics to support resourcing decisions.

**3. Governance, risk and controls**

* Own the hub quality management system, covering process documentation standards, internal quality audits and control testing across towers.
* Maintain the hub risk register and the tracking of issues and actions.
* Build data governance for performance reporting so that there is one version of the truth.

**4. Continuous improvement and digital**

* Build and govern the hub-wide continuous improvement backlog. Prioritise by value and effort, and agree ownership with each GPO.
* Lead improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma and process mining. Track benefits through to realised savings.
* Run the hub's automation and AI pipeline, from idea intake to business case, delivery and benefits tracking.
* Build a continuous improvement culture through training, recognition and a simple way for every employee to raise ideas.

**5. People leadership, performance and culture**

* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* First 90 days: hub KPI framework, baseline method and ICC design signed off.
* By go-live: ICC live with real-time dashboards for the first transition wave, and the governance rhythm running.
* Within 12–18 months: continuous improvement portfolio delivering measurable, validated benefits, with hub-wide dashboards trusted by global stakeholders.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

**KPI**

**Indicative target**

  

**Hub-wide SLA adherence**

* 95% across towers

  

**Validated CI benefits**

Annual savings and hours released against target

  

**Automation hours released**

Increased year on year

  

**Reporting timeliness and accuracy**

100% on schedule

  

**Hub CSAT / NPS**

At or above target

  

**Audit and quality findings**

Closed within agreed timelines

  

**CI participation**

% of employees who submitted or delivered an improvement

*Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines.*

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* Performance management and command-centre design for multi-tower shared services.
* Lean Six Sigma methods, including DMAIC, value-stream mapping and root-cause analysis.
* Data analytics and visualisation (Power BI or Tableau). SQL or data-modelling skills are an advantage.
* Process mining (Celonis, Signavio or similar) and automation pipeline management (RPA, AI).
* ITIL service level management and quality management systems.
* Benefits realisation and business case development.

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**

Customer-centric leadership • Builds teams from zero • Drives change and adoption • Sound judgement under pressure • Influences without authority across countries • Data-led decision making • Coaches and develops talent • Holds a high bar on control

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

**Essential**

* 15+ years of experience, including 7+ years in shared services performance, excellence or transformation roles.
* Has built and run an ICC, command centre or equivalent governance function.
* Has deployed continuous improvement frameworks across multi-tower shared services centres.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt.
* Master's degree in Business, HR, Engineering or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Transition PMO experience
* Process mining certification
* Change management certification (Prosci or equivalent)

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**

Hub Director, all tower GPOs, Global HR leadership, HR technology and data teams, Finance, Internal Audit, transformation partners.

Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high-performance logistics operations.

We work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology where we solve complex, real-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end-to-end supply chain execution.

Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time-to-value and reduce delivery risk.

**Role Overview:**

The Linux System and Hardware Administrator is the hands-on owner of day-to-day operations for Fulfillment IQ’s Linux servers and for the laptops and hardware used by our India-based team. The role sits in the Corporate Technology team within FIQ Group Shared Services, which supports both our services and product businesses. You will run routine server administration, set up and recover devices across Linux, Windows, and macOS, and resolve support tickets, working from the runbooks, policies, and security controls set by the Head of Corporate Technology and alongside colleagues based mainly in Canada.

**Mandate:**

* Keep laptops and hardware for India-based staff set up, tracked, and working
* Handle routine Linux server administration using defined runbooks
* Resolve support tickets quickly and escalate what you cannot fix with clear notes
* Keep documentation, asset records, and ticket history accurate

**Must-Have Qualifications:**

* 3 to 5 years of system administration experience, including hands-on hardware and end-user support
* Strong Linux administration from the command line (Ubuntu or RHEL family): users and permissions, file systems, services, packages, and logs. Linux is non-negotiable for this role
* Experience setting up and troubleshooting web servers (Apache or Nginx) on Linux, with Bash scripting for routine tasks
* Comfort working across Windows 11 and macOS alongside Linux. Strong Linux plus one of the other two is acceptable
* Experience administering a directory and identity platform, such as Microsoft 365 and Entra ID or an on-premise Windows Active Directory domain
* Hardware troubleshooting and component replacement, plus networking fundamentals: IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, and VPN

**Nice to Have:**

* Active Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104) certification. Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) is a strong advantage
* An active Linux certification, such as CompTIA Linux+, RHCSA, or LFCS
* Microsoft Intune administration (device enrolment, compliance policies, app deployment)
* Exposure to DevOps tooling such as Docker, cloud virtual machines (Azure or AWS), or CI/CD runners
* PowerShell or Python scripting
* Any certification listed on your resume must be active.
* Successful candidates who do not yet hold AZ-104 and AZ-305 will be expected to complete both after joining.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Hardware & Device Support**

* Set up, image, and configure Windows 11 laptops and Mac devices for new joiners, and enrol them in device management
* Collect, wipe, and reissue devices from leavers within agreed timelines
* Troubleshoot hardware issues and coordinate repairs and warranty claims with OEMs and local vendors
* Maintain the asset register for every device, linked to the employee it is assigned to
* Support Bengaluru office equipment, including network devices, Wi-Fi, printers, and meeting room technology

**Linux System Administration**

* Perform routine Linux server administration: user accounts, permissions, service restarts, disk space, and log checks
* Apply OS updates and patches following the schedule and runbooks set by Corporate Technology
* Monitor server health alerts and escalate issues to senior team members with clear notes
* Run scheduled backup checks and report any failures

**User Support**

* Respond to and resolve support tickets for hardware, software, accounts, and access
* Support Microsoft 365 account setup, password resets, and MFA enrolment
* Escalate issues you cannot resolve to the right owner in Corporate Technology or DevOps, with the steps already taken
* Give staff practical guidance on using their devices safely

**Security & Compliance**

* Confirm endpoint protection, disk encryption, and required updates are active on every device
* Follow the access, device, and data handling policies set by Corporate Technology
* Report suspected security incidents immediately
* Support license and subscription tracking by assigning and reclaiming seats for joiners and leavers

**Documentation & Improvement**

* Keep tickets, asset records, and runbooks current
* Document recurring issues and their fixes so the team can resolve them faster next time
* Write simple scripts to automate repetitive tasks, reviewed by senior team members

**What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days:**

**30 Days In**

* Learn FIQ’s systems, tools, ticketing process, and runbooks
* Set up devices for new joiners independently
* Reconcile the India asset register against active headcount
* Build working relationships with the Corporate Technology and DevOps teams

**60 Days In**

* Resolve support tickets within agreed response and resolution times
* Handle routine Linux administration and patching independently using runbooks
* Own joiner and leaver device workflows from start to finish

**90 Days In**

* Be the go-to contact for hardware and device support in India
* Add runbook entries for the most common recurring issues
* Deliver at least one script that removes a manual step from a routine task

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* Ticket response and resolution times
* New joiner devices ready on Day 1, and leaver devices recovered on time
* Asset register accuracy
* Patch compliance on assigned servers and devices
* Internal customer satisfaction

**Interview Process:**

* Screening call with our Talent Acquisition team
* A 90-minute in-person technical assessment at our Bengaluru office with the Head of Corporate Technology. The first part is scenario-based Q&A. The second part is hands-on at a computer: you will work in a Linux environment, set up a web server, and troubleshoot basic operations on that server, and you will be questioned on networking and typical hardware issues

**Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

At Fulfillment IQ, we don’t just build supply chain solutions; we build long-term careers.

We believe in giving our people real ownership, real influence, and meaningful responsibility. Whether you’re leading a client relationship, shaping a solution, or building internal capability, your decisions have a visible impact.

title: Senior Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Tier 2 — Technical Support Engineer**

**Job Description**

**Additional CSR Qualifications / Requirements / Waivers**

**Tier 2 — Technical Support Engineer:**

* Proficient in Networking (Layer 2 & 3 topology, networking hardware, cabling, WAPs, routing protocols)
* Proficient in VoIP technologies (QoS, SIP Flow, Codec Negotiations, RTP, DTMF, SIP traces)
* Strong communication skills and a customer-first attitude
* High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple complex cases simultaneously
* Ability to:
* Independently develop solutions to complex technical, process, and systems problems
* Thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment
* Perform advanced root cause analysis and drive issues to resolution
* CCNA, Network+, or equivalent networking certification preferred

**Job Description**

**Why this role matters**
To customers, Tier 2 Technical Support Engineers are the escalation backbone of our support organization. When Tier 1 specialists encounter issues beyond initial troubleshooting, our Tier 2 engineers’ step in to own the resolution. We go deeper — into SIP traces, network captures, platform configurations, and engineering-level diagnostics — to deliver the answers our customers and teammates need. The Technical Support Engineer is a mid-level, high-impact position requiring strong technical aptitude and independent problem-solving.

IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU, CONTINUE READING BELOW…….

**What you will do**

* Serve as the primary escalation point for Tier 1 Technical Support Specialists, receiving and owning complex cases that require advanced technical investigation.
* Perform in-depth troubleshooting on call quality, call completion, SIP registration, call flow builds, features, and network-related issues across the platform.
* Analyze SIP traces, packet captures (PCAPs), and platform logs to diagnose and resolve voice and network issues.
* Independently resolve complex issues and collaborate with Tier 3 engineers, Voice Engineering, and Advanced Operations Support (AOS) on issues requiring escalated technical expertise.
* Manage and drive cases to resolution, ensuring timely updates to customers and adherence to SLA commitments.
* Follow up with customers and Tier 1 agents to confirm resolution and ensure a high level of satisfaction.
* Document customer issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions thoroughly within the ticketing system.
* Identify trends, recurring issues, and systemic problems; escalate patterns to management and Tier 3 for root cause analysis.
* Contribute to the development of internal knowledge base articles (IKBs) and training materials for Tier 1 upskilling.
* Participate in on-call rotation for after-hours and weekend support coverage.
* Mentor and coach Tier 1 team members on advanced troubleshooting methodologies and platform knowledge.

**What you will bring**

* Proficient knowledge of Networking (Layer 2 & 3 topology, networking hardware, cabling, WAPs, routing protocols such as OSPF/BGP).
* Strong working knowledge of VoIP technologies (QoS, SIP Flow, Codec Negotiations, RTP, DTMF, PCAP analysis).
* Experience troubleshooting within an IP/VoIP environment, including SIP registration, call routing, and call quality diagnostics.
* Familiarity with the Broad Works/BroadSoft hosted voice platform.
* Strong communication skills — both written and verbal — with the ability to manage difficult customer conversations professionally.
* Highly detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to:
* Manage multiple complex escalations simultaneously while maintaining quality and accuracy.
* Work independently and collaboratively across teams.
* Mentor junior team members and share knowledge proactively.
* Thrive in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment with tight SLA requirements.

**What is required for application?**

**Required**

* 2+ years of experience in technical support or network engineering role.
* CCNA, Network+, or equivalent networking certification, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* Hands-on experience with SIP, TCP/IP, VoIP, and LAN/WAN troubleshooting.

**Preferred**

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a technical field.
* Hands-on experience with Cisco and other networking equipment.
* Experience reading and interpreting SIP traces and PCAP files.
* Prior experience supporting enterprise-level customers in a tiered support model.

title: Advanced Operations Technician (AOT)
description:
**Job Description — Advanced Operations Technician (AOT)**

**Role Summary**

The Advanced Operations Technician (AOT) is the critical first line of escalation within the Advanced Operations Support (AOS) organization. When Customer Care teams encounter carrier-related voice issues that cannot be resolved at the front line, the AOT steps in to investigate, engage directly with carriers, and drive issues toward resolution. This role is the connective tissue between Customer Care and carrier partners — ensuring customers experience reliable, high-quality voice services. When issues require deeper platform or engineering-level investigation, the AOT escalates to the Advanced Operations Engineering (AOE) team, ensuring the right expertise is applied at every step.

**What You Will Do**

* Serve as the primary escalation point of contact for front-line Customer Care teams for carrier-related voice issues, including inbound/outbound call completion, call quality, and Caller ID/CNAM problems.
* Receive, triage, prioritize, and manage escalation tickets submitted via ticketing system across all lines of business.
* Investigate carrier-side issues by analyzing call samples, SIP responses, PCAP files, and routing data using tools such as Spearline, Empirix, and VoIP Monitor.
* Open and manage external carrier escalation tickets, communicate with carrier NOC/support teams, and drive issues to resolution.
* Update all assigned tickets at a minimum of every 24 hours; escalate carrier tickets that require deeper investigation or routing changes.
* Identify ticket trends — when multiple customers report similar issues, flag for Epic creation and notify the AOS team for coordinated response.
* Escalate issues requiring Development, Product, or Engineering team involvement to the Advanced Operations Engineering (AOE) team, including a clear summary of the issue, steps taken, and outstanding questions.
* Follow all AOS Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for ticket handling, case statuses, Epic management, improper ticket identification, and carrier escalation workflows.
* Maintain awareness of active incidents and monitor relevant communication channels to ensure real-time coordination with Care teams.
* Participate in holiday and weekend coverage rotation as required by the AOS team schedule.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing and after-action reviews when complex issues are resolved, to support continued team learning and process improvement.

**What You Will Bring**

* Working knowledge of VoIP technologies including SIP, RTP, inbound/outbound call flows, and Caller ID/CNAM.
* Familiarity with carrier operations, routing principles, and the carrier escalation process.
* Ability to read and interpret call samples, SIP error responses (e.g., 503, 404), and basic routing data.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for interacting with carrier partners and internal teams.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage a high volume of concurrent tickets while maintaining SLA compliance.
* Ability to:
* Work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, 24/7 operations environment.
* Identify patterns across tickets and escalate systemic issues appropriately.
* Follow structured SOPs and contribute to continuous process improvement.

**Requirements**

**Required**

* 1–2 years of experience in a technical support, network operations, or telecommunications role.
* Familiarity with VoIP/SIP technologies and inbound/outbound call flows.
* Experience using ticketing systems (JIRA, Salesforce, or equivalent) for case management.

**Preferred**

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a technical field.
* Network+ or equivalent certification.
* Experience working with telecom carriers or in a carrier operations/NOC environment.
* Familiarity with tools used for VoIP monitoring or routing platforms.
* Prior experience in a tiered support model with defined escalation paths.
