title: Associate Service Desk Analyst
description:
Overview:

**Service Desk Analyst – T1**

Job Description

**Department:**

Security & Corporate IT

**Reports To:**

IT Service Desk Team Lead

**Location:**

India (On-site)

**Level:**

Individual Contributor – Entry/Mid

**About HealthEdge**
====================

HealthEdge is a leading healthcare SaaS company delivering modern, cloud-native solutions that transform how health plans operate. With a global workforce spanning the US, India, Philippines, Mexico, and the UK, our Corporate IT team plays a critical role in enabling productivity, supporting our people, and ensuring every employee has the tools they need to do their best work.

**Role Overview**
=================

The Service Desk Analyst serves as the first point of contact for all IT support requests across HealthEdge's global employee base. In this role, you will triage, troubleshoot, and resolve a wide range of hardware, software, and connectivity issues through our ITSM platform (Jira Service Management), by phone, chat, and remote tools. You are part of a follow-the-sun support model, meaning your team's work directly enables colleagues around the world to stay productive regardless of time zone.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically curious, service-minded IT professional who wants to build a broad foundation across endpoint management, identity, M365, and ITSM — with clear growth paths into T2/T3 support, specialist, or team lead roles.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Incident Intake & Resolution**
--------------------------------

* Serve as the first point of contact for IT support requests via phone, chat, and email
* Triage and categorize incoming tickets, resolving T1-scope issues within defined SLA targets
* Troubleshoot common issues across Windows and macOS endpoints, M365 applications, printers, VPN, and peripherals
* Escalate unresolved or complex issues to T2/T3 with full documentation and context
* Follow established runbooks and knowledge base articles to deliver consistent, repeatable resolutions

**Identity & Access Management**
--------------------------------

* Process user onboarding and offboarding requests including account provisioning, deprovisioning, and access modifications
* Manage password resets, MFA enrollment, and basic Okta/Entra ID requests
* Ensure access requests are fulfilled within SLA and properly documented per security policies

**Endpoint & Device Support**
-----------------------------

* Assist employees with setup and configuration of laptops, desktops, mobile devices, and peripherals
* Support basic imaging, software installation, and configuration tasks as directed by T2/T3
* Coordinate hardware swap or depot processes with the EUC & Asset Management team when replacement is needed

**Documentation & Knowledge**
-----------------------------

* Log all interactions and resolutions accurately and completely in work tracking tools
* Contribute to the knowledge base by documenting new solutions and updating existing articles
* Follow ITIL-aligned processes for incident management, request fulfillment, and escalation

**Communication & Customer Service**
------------------------------------

* Provide clear, timely, and professional communication to end users at all stages of ticket lifecycle
* Set accurate expectations on resolution timelines and proactively communicate delays
* Represent the Corporate IT team positively as the most visible touchpoint for the broader employee base

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

**Required**
------------

* 1–3 years of experience in a help desk, service desk, or IT support role
* Hands-on experience supporting Windows 10/11 and macOS endpoints
* Familiarity with M365 applications (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
* Experience working in a ticketing system
* Basic understanding of Active Directory or Entra ID user and group management
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills
* Customer-first mindset with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience with SSO/MFA platforms
* Familiarity with remote support tools
* Exposure to ITIL frameworks or service management best practices
* CompTIA A+, Microsoft Fundamentals (MD-102), or equivalent certification
* Experience in a global or multi-region IT support environment

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

In your first 90 days, you will have completed onboarding and tool training, worked your first live ticket queue, and demonstrated the ability to independently resolve common T1 issues. Within six months, you are consistently meeting SLA targets, contributing to the knowledge base, and beginning to develop familiarity with escalation patterns to T2. Within a year, you are a reliable, trusted member of the team – handling a broad range of T1 issues with minimal escalation and actively contributing to team improvement efforts.

**About the Team**
==================

You'll join a growing global Corporate IT organization that is building out a structured, tiered support model across India, the Philippines, the US, Mexico, and the UK. The Service Desk Analyst role sits at the foundation of this model – and is the most important customer-facing function in the organization. We take pride in our follow-the-sun coverage model, our investment in tooling and knowledge management, and our commitment to creating clear career paths for team members who want to grow.

*HealthEdge commits to building an environment and culture that supports the diverse representation of our teams. We aspire to have an inclusive workplace. We aspire to be a place where all employees have the opportunity to belong, make an impact and deliver excellent software and services to our customers.*  
  
**Geographic Responsibility:**  
**Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent**  
**FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt**  
**Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:**

* **The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.**
* **Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.**
* **Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.**
* **May require travel dependent on company needs.**

*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.*  
  
*HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.*

title: MES Executive – Implementation & Operations
description:
MES Executive – Implementation & Operations
  

**PREWAL Studio Private Limited**

**Location :**
Gurugram, Haryana

**Employment Type :**
Full-time | On-site

**Experience Required:**
0–2 Years

**Reporting to :**
Ojaswi Kumar (Founders Office)

About PREWAL Studio :

PREWAL Studio Private Limited is a garment manufacturing and export company based in Gurugram, India.

As part of our ongoing efforts to strengthen operational efficiency, transparency, and data-driven decision-making, we are implementing a
**Manufacturing Execution System (MES)**
across our organisation.

We are looking for a smart, technically capable, and proactive individual to help us successfully implement, manage, and optimise this system.

About the Role :

We are hiring an
**MES Executive – Implementation & Operations**
who will be responsible for coordinating the implementation, daily management, monitoring, and effective utilisation of our Manufacturing Execution System across different departments.

The selected candidate will work closely with the Founder's Office, department heads, production teams, and external technology partners to ensure the system functions smoothly and is effectively adopted across the organisation.

This is a hands-on role combining
**technology, manufacturing operations, data analysis, troubleshooting, and cross-departmental coordination**
.

**We are not looking for someone who merely enters data into software. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, understands how systems work, identifies problems, and ensures that technology is being used effectively.**

Key Responsibilities:-
  

**1. MES Implementation & System Management**

* Coordinate the implementation and rollout of the company's Manufacturing Execution System.
* Work closely with external technology partners to support system configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and deployment.
* Understand existing manufacturing workflows and help integrate them into the MES.
* Assist in maintaining system master data, user accounts, access permissions, and configuration settings.
* Act as the primary internal point of contact for MES-related coordination and operational issues.

**2. Daily System Operations & Monitoring**

* Oversee the day-to-day functioning of the MES across relevant departments.
* Monitor whether employees are correctly and consistently using the system.
* Identify missing entries, incorrect data, process gaps, and operational discrepancies.
* Coordinate with department heads to ensure timely updates and accurate information.
* Verify that system records are aligned with actual manufacturing operations.

**3. Technical Support & Troubleshooting**

* Provide first-level technical support to employees using the MES.
* Troubleshoot basic software, login, connectivity, and system-related issues.
* Identify recurring technical problems and coordinate with external support teams for resolution.
* Maintain records of system issues, their status, and corrective actions.
* Follow up proactively to ensure that reported issues are resolved.

**4. Data Management, Analysis & Reporting**

* Monitor system dashboards, production data, and operational reports.
* Analyse information to identify discrepancies, delays, and potential operational bottlenecks.
* Prepare regular MIS reports and operational summaries for management.
* Use Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for data verification, reconciliation, and analysis.
* Highlight critical issues and provide actionable insights to improve operational efficiency.

**5. Training & Cross-Departmental Coordination**

* Assist in training employees on the correct usage of the MES.
* Coordinate with teams across production, cutting, sewing, finishing, quality, stores, merchandising, and other relevant departments.
* Ensure employees understand their respective responsibilities within the system.
* Support the adoption of standardised digital workflows.
* Work with department heads to resolve issues affecting system usage and data accuracy.

**6. Process Improvement & System Optimisation**

* Identify opportunities to improve system utilisation and operational workflows.
* Suggest improvements in data collection, reporting, and process efficiency.
* Help develop simple guidelines and documentation for employees.
* Monitor system adoption and recommend corrective actions wherever necessary.
* Support the company's broader digital transformation initiatives.

Required Qualifications & Skills :-
  

* **0–2 years of professional experience.**
  Smart fresh graduates with strong technical aptitude are encouraged to apply.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Applications, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, Operations, or a related field. Candidates with equivalent practical skills will also be considered.
* Strong computer proficiency and ability to quickly understand unfamiliar software applications.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, filters, lookups, and basic data analysis.
* Strong logical reasoning, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to troubleshoot basic software-related issues independently.
* Good communication, coordination, and follow-up skills.
* Strong attention to detail, organisational ability, and sense of ownership.
* Willingness to work in a manufacturing environment and coordinate regularly with factory-floor employees.

Preferred Qualifications :-
  

The following will be considered significant advantages but are
**not mandatory**
:

* Previous experience or internship exposure in garment manufacturing, apparel exports, textiles, or factory operations.
* Familiarity with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), or other business management software.
* Basic understanding of garment manufacturing processes, production tracking, inventory, and quality management.
* Experience in software implementation, technical support, or system administration.
* Experience preparing MIS reports, dashboards, or analysing operational data.
* Knowledge of advanced Excel, PivotTables, Power BI, SQL, or similar tools.
* Previous experience coordinating with software vendors or training employees on digital systems.

What We Offer :
  

* **Company-wide exposure:**
  Work on a technology initiative involving multiple business functions.
* **Direct management interaction:**
  Work closely with the Founder's Office and departmental leadership.
* **Hands-on learning:**
  Gain practical exposure to manufacturing operations, business systems, and process digitisation.
* **Meaningful responsibility:**
  Help manage a technology platform critical to the company's daily operations.
* **Professional growth:**
  Build valuable experience in manufacturing technology, operational analytics, and digital transformation.

Who Should Apply?

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

* Are naturally curious about technology and enjoy understanding how software works.
* Can learn new systems quickly and independently.
* Enjoy solving technical and operational problems.
* Are comfortable working with both computers and people.
* Are organised, proactive, and detail-oriented.
* Take responsibility for solving problems rather than simply reporting them.
* Want to build a career combining technology, analytics, and manufacturing operations.

**Prior MES experience is not mandatory. Strong technical aptitude, problem-solving ability, and willingness to learn are far more important.**

Interested candidates can apply through
**LinkedIn Easy Apply**
.

title: NetSuite Suite Projects Pro System Administrator
description:
Location: New Delhi, India
  
  
Reporting to: Kate Fisher, Senior IT Associate
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
**About CPI**
CPI is an analysis and advisory organization with deep expertise in finance and policy. Our mission is to help governments, businesses, and financial institutions drive economic growth while addressing climate change.
  
  
With a team of experts across seven international offices, including a strong presence in emerging markets and developing economies, CPI is a leader in tracking sustainable investment trends, identifying innovative business models, and supporting the solutions that can drive the transition to a low-carbon, climate-resilient, inclusive economy. This role will provide day-to-day system support, manage user access and configuration, and work closely with Operations, Finance, and IT teams to ensure smooth system adoption across the organization.
  
  
The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, enjoys working with data and systems, and has a strong service mindset to support staff queries and drive efficient system usage.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Manage and maintain the NetSuite SuiteProjects Pro (Formerly Net Suite OpenAir) system, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
* Configure, test, and update system settings, workflows, and permissions as required.
* Provide first-line user support, resolving issues and queries in collaboration with the Operations and IT teams.
* Monitor and maintain project, resource, and timesheet data, ensuring consistency across departments.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytics to support operational decision-making.
* Coordinate with the vendor (Xero/Oracle NetSuite/OpenAir) for upgrades, enhancements, and troubleshooting.
* Managing large data imports and updates manually and via integration manager.
* Manage a SuiteProjects pro system where financial data is not held in NetSuite and integrates with CPI’s
* Conduct user training and onboarding sessions, ensuring consistent use of the platform.
* Create and maintain management processes in the system including data checking and validation.
* Create and maintain system documentation, SOPs, and data dictionaries.
* Identify opportunities to improve system efficiency and user experience.

About You: Competencies and Experience
  
  

* Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science/IT systems Management and/or Business Administration, Engineering, and/or relevant certifications or professional experience.
* Overall, 6 years of relevant experience in system administration or operations roles with ERP, PSA, or project management tools such as NetSuite Suite Projects Pro, NetSuite, SAP, or Oracle.
* Demonstrated experience in data management, reporting, and workflow configuration.
* Strong Excel skills particularly for data transformation, cleaning and validation, including formulas, text formulas, XLookup and pivot tables.
* Experience working in small set up and managing projects independently with limited supervision.
* Experience working in multi-country or global organizations preferred.
* Experience creating documentation, and training users in IT Systems and processes.
* Familiarity with reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.) is a plus.

About You: Personal Attributes
  
  

* Confidence to engage with a wide range of stakeholders and explain technical concepts to non-technical users.
* Excellent organizational skills and a proactive, organized, and innovative approach to problem solving.
* Customer-service orientation with the ability to manage queries efficiently.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within timelines.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

Position Details
  
  
CPI is recruiting for one full-time position of NetSuite Suite Projects Pro System Administrator (40 hours) to be based in our New Delhi office.
  
  
CPI India has adopted a flexible working policy whereby staff are able to mix working remotely with days in the office.
  
  
CPI offers an excellent and competitive compensation and benefits package.
  
  
Applicants must be eligible to work in India – we are unfortunately unable to offer any visa sponsorship for this role.
  
  
To Apply
  
  
As part of your application please upload your resume and cover letter, both documents must be submitted in English and respond to the application questions by Monday, November 2, 2026.
  
  
We do not recommend the use of AI to complete your application.
  
  
Applications will be assessed on a rolling basis, so we encourage applicants to submit at the earliest opportunity.
  
  
Only short-listed applicants will be contacted.
  
  
Please be sure to add notifications@app.bamboohr.com to your contact list to ensure delivery of all correspondence from us.
  
  
CPI Commitment
  
  
CPI’s mission is to create economic opportunity while protecting our environment. This worldview—grounding opportunity in something more fundamental that we all share and must protect—permeates our organization, and forms the foundation of our approach to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI).
  
  
CPI’s approach to DEI mirrors our mission: within a culture that values transparency and dialogue, we strive to improve equity within our organization as well as in the communities in which we work. Internally and externally, we seek to remove inequitable barriers regardless of their origin, whether it be class, race, religion, nationality, region, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation or physical ability. We are proactive in identifying and removing biases in our processes, seeking fairness in hiring, working conditions, and professional development.
  
  
If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of application. We will then work with you to identify the best way to assist you through the recruitment process.

title: Digital Systems Lead – Construction Site Apps
description:
About us

KV Developers is part of ReaRCo, a restructuring and turnaround group that works on practical solutions to real-world problems. We are building a technology-driven construction company and are developing a range of in-house digital tools for our projects, starting at our residential project in Greater Noida West.

About the role

Our site already runs on in-house mobile apps for snagging and de-snagging of flats, daily monitoring of works, labour and contractors, and reports for management, built on Google Workspace and AppSheet with scripted automation. More tools will follow.

We are looking for one person to own the day-to-day running of these apps: making changes, keeping the data clean, testing before release, training site staff and contractors, and making sure the apps are actually used on site. You will work directly with the founder and the project leadership. Most technical design and coding is prepared with AI tools; your job is to turn decisions into working, well-tested tools quickly and get them adopted on site.

What you will do

- Configure and release changes to the apps (AppSheet) and their data (Google Sheets); keep a change log.

- Own master data: users and logins, roles, contractors, locations, work items and assignments.

- Test every change on a test copy before release, and run field tests with site teams.

- Train engineers, foremen, contractors and vendors in Hindi and English, and follow up until the apps are used daily.

- Track adoption and data quality, and send a short written summary each evening.

- Collect feedback from site and management into one list, and prepare specifications with AI tools for decisions.

- Act as second administrator for Google Workspace and related accounts; keep access, backups and documentation in order.

- Support a planned move of the data to a SQL database with a senior technical reviewer.

What we are looking for

- 4 to 8 years in residential or commercial construction as a civil, QA/QC or planning engineer, or a no-code developer with real site exposure.

- Confident with Google Sheets and at least one no-code or low-code tool (AppSheet preferred); able to read simple scripts.

- Comfortable working with AI tools (for example ChatGPT or Claude) to draft, check and document work.

- Methodical about testing, data and documentation.

- Fluent in Hindi and English; able to train site staff and hold contractors to a routine.

- Discreet with confidential data and systems.

Good to have: Apps Script or JavaScript, SQL, Looker Studio, MS Project or Primavera, experience rolling out a site app or ERP module.

Location and hours: at our site in Greater Noida West, Monday to Saturday; hybrid once the rollout settles.

Reports to: the founder, working closely with the project head on site and the planning head.

Compensation: competitive, in line with experience.

To apply: please include one example of a tool, app, sheet or process you built or rolled out, and what changed as a result.

title: Service Technician
description:
Job Description: IT Hardware Service Technician1. Job Details
  

* **Job Title:**
  IT Hardware Service Technician
* **Department:**
  IT / Technical Support
* **Reports To:**
  IT Support Manager / Service Manager
* **Employment Type:**
  Full-Time
* **Work Location:**
  Kochi
* **Experience:**
  1–3 years preferred

2. Job Summary
  
The IT Hardware Service Technician is responsible for diagnosing, troubleshooting, repairing, maintaining, and installing IT hardware and related equipment. The role involves providing technical support to customers or end users, ensuring timely resolution of hardware issues, and maintaining high standards of service quality and customer satisfaction.3. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Hardware Installation and Maintenance
  

* Install, configure, and maintain desktop computers, laptops, printers, scanners, monitors, and other IT peripherals.
* Assemble, upgrade, and replace hardware components, including RAM, hard drives, SSDs, power supplies, and motherboards.
* Perform preventive maintenance and routine hardware inspections.
* Diagnose and repair hardware failures and performance-related issues.
* Install and configure operating systems, drivers, firmware, and essential software as required.

B. Troubleshooting and Technical Support
  

* Identify and resolve hardware, connectivity, and basic software issues.
* Troubleshoot desktop and laptop startup failures, display issues, overheating, power problems, and peripheral malfunctions.
* Perform hardware diagnostics and determine whether components require repair or replacement.
* Support basic LAN, Wi-Fi, printer connectivity, and other peripheral-related issues.
* Escalate complex technical problems to senior technicians or the relevant technical team.

C. Service Calls and Customer Support
  

* Attend customer service requests at the service centre or customer locations, as assigned.
* Provide on-site and remote technical assistance where applicable.
* Explain technical issues and repair solutions clearly to customers.
* Maintain professional communication and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Complete service requests within agreed turnaround times and service-level targets.

D. Service Documentation and Inventory
  

* Record service requests, fault descriptions, diagnostic findings, repairs, and parts replaced.
* Maintain accurate service reports, job sheets, and equipment maintenance records.
* Track spare parts, tools, and replacement components used during repairs.
* Coordinate with the service or inventory team for spare parts availability.
* Follow warranty procedures and maintain records of warranty repairs and equipment handovers.

4. Required Qualifications
  

* Diploma or ITI in Computer Hardware, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Relevant technical certifications or practical training in computer hardware and troubleshooting will be an advantage.
* Candidates with equivalent hands-on experience m2y also be considered.

5. Required Skills and Competencies
  

* Good knowledge of desktop and laptop hardware components.
* Practical experience in diagnosing and repairing computer hardware.
* Familiarity with Windows operating systems, drivers, and device configuration.
* Basic knowledge of networking, LAN, Wi-Fi, IP addressing, and printer configuration.
* Ability to use hardware diagnostic tools and standard repair equipment.
* Good problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong customer service and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple service requests and meet deadlines.
* Willingness to travel to customer locations, if required.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a technical support team.

6. Experience Requirements
  

* 1–2 years of experience in computer hardware servicing, IT support, or a similar role is preferred.
* Freshers with relevant technical qualifications and strong practical skills may also apply.
* Experience in a computer service centre, IT service provider, or field service environment will be an advantage.

title: Travel Manager
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced
**Travel Head**
to lead and manage the company's end-to-end corporate travel operations. The role will be responsible for managing domestic and international travel, travel vendors, employee travel requirements, travel policies, cost optimization, and ensuring a seamless travel experience for employees, leadership, and business stakeholders.

The ideal candidate should have strong vendor management, negotiation, operational, and problem-solving skills, along with the ability to manage high-volume and time-sensitive travel requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Corporate Travel Management**

* Own end-to-end corporate travel operations for employees, leadership, and business stakeholders.
* Manage domestic and international air travel, hotel bookings, ground transportation, visas, travel insurance, and other travel-related requirements.
* Coordinate travel arrangements for business meetings, conferences, events, factory visits, market visits, and official trips.
* Ensure smooth travel planning and execution from booking to completion of travel.
* Handle urgent and last-minute travel requirements effectively.

**2.Travel Policy & Process Management**

* Develop, implement, and continuously improve the company's corporate travel policy.
* Establish clear guidelines for flight, hotel, cab, local conveyance, and other travel expenses.
* Ensure travel bookings are made in accordance with company policies and approval matrices.
* Establish standard processes for travel requests, approvals, bookings, cancellations, and reimbursements.
* Monitor policy adherence and identify areas for improvement.

**3.Vendor Management**

* Identify, onboard, and manage travel agencies, airlines, hotels, cab operators, visa consultants, and other travel partners.
* Negotiate competitive rates, corporate deals, contracts, and service-level agreements.
* Regularly evaluate vendor performance, service quality, responsiveness, and pricing.
* Build strong relationships with key travel partners.
* Resolve vendor-related escalations and service issues.

**4.Cost Management & Optimization**

* Drive cost optimization across flights, hotels, transportation, and other travel expenses.
* Negotiate corporate rates and preferential pricing with travel vendors.
* Monitor travel spends and prepare periodic MIS and cost reports.
* Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary travel expenses without compromising business requirements.
* Track budget versus actual travel expenditure.

**5.Leadership & Executive Travel**

* Manage travel requirements for founders, senior management, and leadership teams.
* Handle confidential and high-priority travel arrangements with accuracy and discretion.
* Coordinate complex itineraries involving multiple destinations and tight schedules.
* Ensure premium travel requirements are managed seamlessly.

**6.Visa & International Travel**

* Manage visa documentation and coordination for international business travel.
* Coordinate with visa consultants, embassies, and relevant agencies wherever required.
* Ensure employees have all necessary travel documents before departure.
* Track visa validity, passport requirements, travel insurance, and other documentation.

**7.Employee Travel Support**

* Act as the primary point of contact for employee travel-related queries and escalations.
* Ensure timely resolution of booking, cancellation, rescheduling, hotel, cab, and other travel issues.
* Provide travel support during emergencies or unexpected changes.
* Ensure employees receive clear and timely communication regarding their travel arrangements.

**8.Travel Technology & Systems**

* Evaluate and implement travel management platforms/tools wherever required.
* Improve automation of travel requests, approvals, bookings, and reporting.
* Maintain accurate employee travel records and vendor databases.
* Use data and analytics to monitor travel trends and identify cost-saving opportunities.



**9.Compliance & Documentation**

* Ensure proper documentation and compliance related to corporate travel.
* Maintain contracts, vendor agreements, invoices, travel records, and other relevant documentation.
* Coordinate with Finance and HR teams for travel expense reconciliation and reimbursements.
* Ensure timely verification and processing of travel invoices.

**10.Team Management**

* Lead and mentor the travel/admin team.
* Allocate responsibilities and ensure timely execution of travel requirements.
* Set performance standards and monitor team productivity.
* Build a responsive and service-oriented travel support function.

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of corporate travel management.
* Excellent knowledge of domestic and international travel processes.
* Strong vendor negotiation and relationship management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong cost-management and analytical skills.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities and urgent requirements.
* Strong problem-solving and crisis-management skills.
* Good knowledge of travel policies, booking systems, and travel documentation.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and travel management systems/tools.
* High level of confidentiality and discretion, especially while handling leadership travel.

**Eductaion**

Graduate degree in
**Travel & Tourism, Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field**
.

Experience

* **7–8 years**
  of relevant experience in corporate travel management, travel operations, or a similar role.
* Experience managing travel for a growing organization or large employee base will be preferred.
* Experience in managing senior leadership/executive travel is an added advantage.
* Experience in vendor negotiations, travel cost optimization, and policy implementation is preferred.



Key Performance Indicators(KPIs)

* Travel cost savings and optimization
* Vendor performance and service levels
* Travel booking turnaround time
* Policy compliance
* Employee satisfaction with travel services
* Reduction in travel-related escalations
* Accuracy of travel bookings and documentation
* Timely closure of travel invoices and reconciliations
* Successful management of urgent/last-minute travel requirements
* Effectiveness of travel processes and systems

title: Head of Core Client Reporting, AB India
description:
**Company Description**
As a leading global investment management firm, AB fosters diverse perspectives and embraces innovation to help our clients navigate the uncertainty of capital markets. Through high-quality research and diversified investment services, we serve institutions, individuals and private wealth clients in major markets worldwide. Our ambition is simple: to be our clients’ most valued asset-management partner.
  
  
With over 4,400 employees across 51 locations in 25 countries, our people are our advantage. We foster a culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration to create an environment where everyone can thrive and do their best work. Whether you're producing thought-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business or providing thoughtful advice to clients, we’re looking for unique voices to help lead us forward. If you’re ready to challenge your limits and build your future, join us.
  
  
**Ops Group Description**
The Institutional Client Reporting Team is responsible for the production of monthly, quarterly, annual and ad-hoc accounting and investment reports for institutional clients. These reports cover the full range of the firm’s investment capabilities, including Fixed Income, Equity, Index / Enhanced, as well as Alternative Investments, Blend, Multi-Asset strategies, with an expanding range of derivative content.
  
  
There are extensive interactions and exposure to many functions of the AB business, notably Client Relationship Management, the Portfolio Management Team, Global Product Development team along with Operations and Information Technology.
  
  
In addition to the production support, the team also works on projects related to new report development and automation.
  
  
**Ops Job Description**
We are seeking a Vice President, Head of Core Client Reporting, AB India, to lead the Core Client Reporting team within the Institutional Investment Management Operations Team located in Pune, India. This role will provide strategic, operational, and people leadership for a critical reporting function that supports institutional client outcomes, strengthens control discipline, and enables scalable delivery across global stakeholders. The successful candidate will be expected to operate as a senior leader who executes against functional priorities, drives commercial and client-focused impact, develops talent, influences reporting strategy, and reinforces AB’s inclusive culture. People of color, women, and LGBTQ people are encouraged to apply. AB does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, ancestry, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, citizenship status, sexual orientation. Gender identity, military or veteran status or any other basis that is prohibited by applicable law. AB’s policies, as well as practices, seek to ensure that employment opportunities are available to all employees and applicants, based solely on job-related criteria.
  
  
**Describe The Role**
The Head of Core Client Reporting is a senior leadership role responsible for the day-to-day and strategic management of AB India’s Core Client Reporting function. The role requires strong knowledge of institutional client reporting, investment operations, data governance, performance and portfolio reporting concepts, risk management, and operational controls. The leader will oversee multiple reporting workstreams, manage escalations, partner with global stakeholders, and drive continuous improvement across process, technology, training, quality assurance, and operating model design.
  
  
**Describe the applications and business or enterprise functions the role supports:**
This role supports global Institutional Client Reporting and related Investment Management Operations functions, including report production, data validation, exception management, controls, workflow oversight, stakeholder service, and reporting platform improvement. The role will partner closely with onshore and offshore reporting teams, portfolio management support functions, client service, technology, data teams, compliance, risk, and other operations partners to ensure a consistent, scalable, and controlled client reporting environment.
  
  
**The key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Lead the AB Core Client Reporting team, including oversight of daily, monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc reporting deliverables, quality controls, issue resolution, and service-level performance.
* Become Subject Matter Expert in Client Reporting and have ability to make real time and time critical decisions on reporting issues.
* Execute against agreed functional priorities and hold team members accountable for timely, accurate, and controlled delivery of client reporting outputs.
* Oversee strategic direction for reporting production, workflow management, exception handling, and control routines to ensure client satisfaction and operational resiliency.
* Represent Client Reporting/Global Operations in setting agenda for conversion of existing functionality from internal systems over to new SimCorp driven processes.
* Partner with global reporting leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to identify market practices, address reporting gaps, manage escalations, and implement scalable reporting solutions.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on standardization, automation, data quality, process simplification, control strengthening, and reduction of operational risk.
* Develop and maintain strong working relationships with internal clients, including client service, portfolio management support, technology, compliance, risk, and global operations partners.
* Chair meetings of the Global Client Reporting Steering Committee to prioritize enhancements, changes, and updates to the reports and infrastructure.
* Provide leadership oversight for escalated reporting issues, ensuring appropriate root-cause analysis, remediation, stakeholder communication, and prevention of recurrence.
* Establish and maintain documentation, procedure guides, training materials, quality-control frameworks, and evidence-based oversight routines for the team.
* Recruit, manage, motivate, coach, and develop staff to maximize individual contributions, professional growth, collaboration, and effective teamwork.
* Set leadership direction for functional training, cross-training, succession planning, and knowledge management across Core Client Reporting.
* Actively identify opportunities to control or reduce firm costs through improved operating model design, capacity management, automation, and efficient use of resources.
* Influence reporting strategy by bringing forward innovative ideas, anticipating downstream impacts, and aligning team priorities with broader SBU and firm objectives.
* Promote an inclusive, respectful, and high-accountability culture that encourages collaboration, constructive challenge, and continuous learning.

**What makes this role unique or interesting (if applicable)?**
This role offers the opportunity to lead a critical client-facing operations capability from India while partnering with global stakeholders across the institutional investment management platform. The successful candidate will shape how Core Client Reporting scales, modernizes, and strengthens control discipline. The role combines people leadership, operational execution, client service orientation, data and technology partnership, and strategic influence, making it an important leadership position for both local team development and global reporting effectiveness.
  
  
**What is the professional development value of this role, i.e. what learning and professional growth does the role offer the candidate?**
The role provides significant professional development through exposure to senior global stakeholders, complex institutional reporting requirements, reporting platform evolution, operational risk management, and enterprise-wide process improvement. The candidate will build deeper leadership capability in strategy execution, stakeholder management, talent development, controls, automation, data governance, and client outcome management.
  
  
**Job Qualifications (The Ideal Candidate Should Have The Following)**

* Performance Leadership: Drives execution of core reporting responsibilities, prioritizes high-impact initiatives, demonstrates resilience through operational challenges, and holds the team accountable for timely, accurate, and controlled delivery.
* Commercial Leadership: Creates positive internal and external client outcomes by improving reporting quality, strengthening stakeholder confidence, reducing operational friction, and identifying opportunities to lower cost and mitigate risk.
* People Leadership: Grows talent through coaching, performance management, training, feedback, and active participation in recruitment, development, change management, and team engagement activities.
* Thought Leadership: Influences reporting strategy through expertise, innovation, process improvement, automation opportunities, and an understanding of how local decisions impact the broader firm.
* Cultural Leadership: Sets the standard for respect, inclusion, accountability, collaboration, and recognition of behaviors that reflect AB’s values.

**Qualifications, Experience, Education**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience required; business, finance, accounting, economics, or related discipline preferred.
* Approximately 10+ years of relevant experience in investment operations, institutional client reporting, performance reporting, portfolio reporting, data operations, or a related financial services function.
* Demonstrated people management experience, ideally including leadership of multiple workstreams or teams in a global operating model.
* Strong understanding of institutional client reporting lifecycles, data dependencies, quality-control routines, operational risk, and service-level management.
* Experience leading process improvement, automation, workflow redesign, or operating model initiatives.
* Experience managing stakeholder relationships across regions, functions, and seniority levels.
* Exposure to investment data, portfolio holdings, transactions, performance, benchmarks, client deliverables, or related reporting concepts preferred.
* Working knowledge of SQL or data-querying tools preferred, with the ability to partner effectively with technology and data teams to investigate data issues, improve reporting controls, and support scalable reporting solutions.

**Skills**

* Strong leadership, coaching, performance management, and team development skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with senior stakeholders and global partners.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, prioritization, and decision-making skills.
* Exceptional attention to detail with a control-oriented mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, escalations, and transformation initiatives simultaneously.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with workflow, reporting, data visualization, or automation tools preferred.
* Knowledge to query, analyze, and validate data using SQL or comparable tools preferred.
* Ability to influence without direct authority and build strong partnerships across business, operations, technology, compliance, and risk teams.
* High level of professionalism, sound judgment, ownership, and resilience.

**Special Knowledge (if Applicable)**

* Data quality, workflow management, reporting platforms.
* Experience with SimCorp Coric or Vermilion reporting products preferred.

title: Head of Product Business Unit
description:
**About Us**
**HEAD OF PRODUCT BUSINESS UNIT**
Anchanto | Pune, India | Reports to the Chief Executive Officer | Unit of 12 to 45 people
  
  
**About Anchanto**
Anchanto is an e-commerce and supply chain technology company headquartered in Singapore, with offices in twelve countries across Asia Pacific, the Middle East and Europe and its largest engineering center in Pune. Brands, retailers and logistics service providers use our purpose built SaaS products to run and scale their e-commerce and omnichannel operations: Order Management, Warehouse Management, Anchanto Grid with more than 200 ready integrations to marketplaces, carriers and enterprise systems, Parcel Tracking, Control Tower and Operations Experience, with Vantage AI as the data and insights layer across all of them. Our AI enabled agentic services, launching soon, help customers run their commerce operations with less manual work and faster decisions. More than 360 enterprise customers, including L'OrÃ©al, Panasonic, EstÃ©e Lauder, DKSH, Toll and Bosch, process over 200 million orders a year through Anchanto across more than 700 warehouses. Anchanto is an Asendia portfolio company.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
A Product Business Unit (PBU) is Product Management and Engineering for one product, brought together as a single threaded organization with one head, one backlog and one set of priorities. The head owns the product's market position, strategy, roadmap, engineering, quality, reliability and business results, and leads the engineers who build it. This is how the leading software companies are organized today: Amazon's single threaded leaders and two pizza teams, the autonomous product units at Spotify and Atlassian, the product clouds at Salesforce and Adobe each run as a business. It removes the handoffs, competing priorities and diffused accountability of separate product and engineering functions, and puts one leader in charge who decides and answers for the result.
  
  
This is not a pure product management role. You lead the engineering team as well as the product team, you own the technical quality of what ships, and you are measured on outcomes, not activities. It is the role of building a product business that leads its category: you set where the product goes, build it with your own engineering team, put it in front of the market with the revenue teams, and answer for what it earns and how customers experience it.
  
  
**WHAT YOU OWN: PRODUCT STRATEGY, ROADMAP, ENGINEERING, DECISIONS AND RESULTS**

* Product strategy. You know your market and competitors better than anyone in the company, set the product strategy and the positioning ambition with the industry research leaders, keep the product's gaps against the Gartner, Forrester and IDC criteria on your roadmap with dates, and give the CROs your input on pricing and packaging.
* Roadmap and priorities. One backlog covering the roadmap, customer commitments, innovation and tech debt, with the trade offs made by you within the portfolio allocation the CEO sets. Customer priorities and asks come to you from the Delivery team, your internal customer; you deliver against them and do not overwrite them.
* Decisions. What gets built, in what order and how; technical design within the architecture and security standards the CTO sets; release decisions; and whether your product can meet a scope and a date. No scope or date is committed on your product without your confirmation, and once committed you deliver it.
* The way we build. Specs based, AI assisted engineering is the standard way of working in every unit. You own the spec standard for your product and the readiness gate that stops work starting before decisions, credentials and test windows are in place. Quality is owned by the people who build.
* Results. Product P&L, growth, margin and contribution; reliability, incident response and customer satisfaction for your product; and the people: unit structure, hiring, promotions and a standing innovation and AI sub pod that explores adjacent capabilities.
* Ecosystem. Alignment with the other PBUs on the shared roadmap, the blueprint and joint commitments, and working in step with Product Marketing.

**COMMERCIAL INVOLVEMENT**
This is not a sales role and carries no quota. The CROs set market priorities, the go to market and what and how your product is sold; the revenue teams (existing customers, Global Strategic Accounts, Key Account Management) own the customer connect. You help them sell: you step into strategic, complex or at risk deals when asked, and you are the final word on what your product can commit to and when. You do not override or bypass them to reach customers directly.
  
  
**How You Manage Your People**

* Every person in the unit has written objectives and two or three KPIs for the quarter, reviewed monthly; nobody is without them thirty days after joining.
* Feedback is direct, factual and given within the week, in writing when it matters.
* You represent the company to your team, not the team to the company. Management debt, wrong decisions, undelivered feedback and unaddressed interpersonal issues, is fixed within thirty days of knowing about it.
* Performance is measured against objectives, not effort or tenure. An underperformer gets a written plan and a date; if it passes you take the decision yourself, including exit. Interns are confirmed and people are promoted only after a documented assessment and a direct conversation.
* The unit reports in numbers, weekly in writing and monthly in the outcome review.
* You talk to your N-1, your N-2 and every individual contributor, with skip level one to ones at least quarterly; you do the final interview of every person joining the unit; and the unit runs on a written meeting cadence you publish in your first thirty days and keep.

**OWNING CUSTOMER ESCALATIONS**
An escalation on your product is yours from the moment it is raised until the customer confirms it is closed. You do not trivialize it, and you do not expect the CEO or the CROs to lead it. You own the fix and the communication: first written update within the hour, a fixed written cadence until closed, root cause and corrective action within five working days after. You put proactive monitoring in place so the unit knows before the customer does.
  
  
**Who Decides What**

* Decision: Roadmap, prioritization, trade offs, what gets built and how, technical design within architecture guardrails, release decisions within standards.

Decides: You
  
  

* Decision: Whether your product can meet a scope and a date; unit structure, hiring and promotions within policy; spend within the approved budget.

Decides: You
  
  

* Decision: Customer priority, customer asks, revenue delivery and the external customer commitment and timeline.

Decides: Delivery, with your confirmation on scope and date
  
  

* Decision: Pricing and packaging; market priorities; go to market; what and how your product is sold; customer connect.

Decides: CROs and revenue teams, with your input on pricing
  
  

* Decision: Portfolio allocation, the blueprint, headcount and total investment, cross PBU priority collisions.

Decides: CEO
  
  

* Decision: Technology standards, security and compliance, architecture guardrails, CICD, infrastructure, data and AI platform.

Decides: CTO
  
  
**How You Are Measured**
You own outcomes, not activities. Story points, releases and features shipped are not on this scorecard. You are judged on the outputs below, and you run the unit on five to eight controllable input metrics that you propose, prove move the outputs, and review every week. Numbers are baselined in your first month and verified by Finance.
  
  

* Product led revenue enablement

What we look at: Adoption and usage depth of the modules we sell, share of customers on the current version, deals unblocked or lost on product capability, referenceable customers, time to go live
  
  

* Retention and unit margin

What we look at: Net revenue retention for your product, churn and its reasons, and the unit's contribution margin after people, infrastructure and delivery cost
  
  

* Reliability and customer satisfaction

What we look at: Availability, incidents and time to resolve, escaped defects, escalations by count, root cause and time to close, NPS or CSAT, and whether the unit found the problem before the customer did
  
  

* Planned versus actual

What we look at: Execution against the quarterly plan and the annual plan: objectives met, committed deliveries on date, say to do ratio, and variances explained in writing
  
  

* Market position

What we look at: Where the product stands against the Forrester Wave, Gartner Magic Quadrant and IDC MarketScape criteria for its category, gaps closed each quarter, and analyst recognition over time
  
  

* AI leverage and AI first approach

What we look at: Share of work built specs based and AI assisted, automation percentage by activity, cost and cycle time per delivered item falling every quarter, new work designed AI first
  
  

* Team EPS and health

What we look at: Team EPS score, attrition and regretted attrition, skills coverage, and whether the unit runs without you in the room
  
  
**PLANNING AND CADENCE**
You write the multi year product plan, the annual plan each October as a six page narrative with targets and resource scenarios, and, four weeks before each quarter, a ninety day plan derived from both, presented to and aligned with the leadership team; execution is measured against it. Weekly unit review on the inputs in writing, monthly outcome review with the CEO, quarterly review on the two or three CEO goals for your unit.
  
  
**Skills And Prior Experience**
Must haves for every candidate. Candidates without all of these will not be shortlisted.
  
  

* At least fifteen years of industry experience, with at least five of them running a product, product line, business unit or operation with accountability for its results.
* Global experience. Has worked in, and built or run operations outside India, with customers or teams in more than one country. India only experience does not qualify.
* Education. Engineering from IIT or NIT, or an MBA from IIM or a top ranked global business school.
* Domain. Commerce, logistics, supply chain or marketplace software, or the operations they serve, with enterprise customers.
* Decides and manages directly. Makes the call quickly, takes the trade off and answers for the outcome. Has set objectives for every person, given hard feedback in time, taken exit decisions personally and owned the communication in a customer crisis. Comfortable making AI assisted, specs driven engineering the default way of working.

Career paths we are open to. The role needs product, technology and business skills together; nobody arrives with all three at the same depth, so we hire from four paths and test for the second skill in each.
  
  

* Technology leader with product skills. Director of Engineering, CTO, CIO or equivalent, with deep experience in building, releasing and commercializing software systems, who has also owned a roadmap, met the market and made product trade offs, not only delivered what product handed over.
* Product management leader with technology depth. Head of Product Management or commercial product management in B2B SaaS, with technology skills to a good extent: has led or closely directed engineering teams, can hold an architecture review, and has shipped and commercialized what they defined.
* Operations practitioner from a large 3PL, retailer or brand. Has run e-commerce, fulfilment or supply chain operations as a business at scale, with deep domain knowledge of how the work is actually done, and has specified, bought or built the systems behind it well enough to direct a product team.
* Consultant or transformation leader. Head of consulting, transformation or a consulting practice in commerce or supply chain, with deep consulting and domain expertise, who has delivered systems and operating models for clients end to end rather than advised from the side.

In every path the second skill must be shown with specific examples. This role is not a Head of Engineering with a product manager reporting in, a delivery manager promoted up, a product leader who hands execution to someone else, a second sales channel to the customer, or a union leader for the team. Compensation: fixed salary, variable pay tied to the scorecard, and long term incentives; details shared with shortlisted candidates.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Global Exposure: Work with diverse teams, customers and stakeholders across international markets and gain experience in a global B2B SaaS environment.
* Learning & Development: We invest in our people through sponsored learning, certifications and development opportunities aligned with your professional growth.
* International & Onsite Opportunities: Client-facing roles may offer opportunities to travel and work onsite with customers across our global markets.
* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive medical insurance coverage to support to you and your family health and well-being.
* Comprehensive Leave Benefits: Maternity, Paternity, Marriage and Bereavement leave, along with Comp Off and flexibility to support important personal commitments.
* Recognition for Long-Term Contribution: Tenured employees are eligible for additional monetary benefits, extra paid leave and company-sponsored paid vacations as part of our commitment to recognising long-term contribution.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: A supportive and flexible work environment that enables employees to manage professional responsibilities alongside personal priorities.
* Meaningful Career Growth: Take ownership of challenging, high-impact work and contribute to products and solutions that serve global brands, retailers and logistics businesses.

title: Head of Solutions & Delivery
description:
**About the Company**

Fineshift is a founder-led technology services company helping enterprise customers solve complex engineering challenges across
**DevSecOps, Monitoring & Observability, and AI**
.

As an independent, bootstrapped company, we prioritise customer outcomes, delivery accountability, and fast decision-making. We are authorised partners of GitLab, IBM, JFrog, Snyk, and AWS, working with large enterprises across banking, financial services, and manufacturing.

We are at a stage where the leaders we hire will shape our next phase of growth. This is an opportunity to build and scale a technology practice, not simply inherit one.

**About the Role**

This is the senior technology leadership position in the company, reporting directly to the CEO.

You own what we propose to our customers and what we deliver to them. That means owning the technical solution end to end — understanding the requirement, designing the approach, preparing the proposal, defending it in front of the customer, and then standing behind it when it goes into delivery.

It also means owning the commercial outcome of the technology business and deciding how the technology organisation should be structured as it grows. You will have the mandate to shape the team, the practices, and the technical standards we hold ourselves to.

We are looking for someone who wants that level of ownership, not someone who wants a defined scope.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own technical solutioning for customer requirements across all three service lines, from discovery and requirement analysis through to the final solution.
* Prepare the technical proposal in line with the solution — architecture, approach, effort estimate, assumptions, and risks.
* Review and approve any technical proposal prepared by others before it reaches a customer.
* Present and defend the solution to the customer — solution walkthroughs, demonstrations, architecture discussions, and workshops.
* Act as the senior technical presence in customer conversations, including steering meetings, quarterly reviews, and escalation discussions.
* Own customer escalations end to end, including containment, resolution, and written root cause analysis.
* Define the right structure for the technology organisation — how solutioning, delivery, and support are organised — and evolve it as the business grows.
* Set technical direction for each service line and define the standard engagements are delivered to.
* Build and mentor the technical team, including senior technical staff responsible for solution design, estimation, and customer communication.
* Grow existing accounts through upsell and cross-sell, and grow the number of engineers deployed at customer sites.
* Own the technology P&L — margin per engagement, revenue per deployed engineer, and cost of unassigned capacity.

**Must Have**

* 12+ years in technology, including at least 3 years leading a delivery or solutions practice in an IT services or systems-integration company.
* Deep expertise in one of DevSecOps, Monitoring & Observability, or AI, with working credibility in the other two.
* Strong hands-on solution design and estimation ability — able to architect an engagement and size it accurately before it is sold.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD, release management, containers and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure).
* Working knowledge of observability tooling — IBM Instana, Prometheus, Grafana, Nagios, or Icinga — along with incident management and root cause analysis.
* Familiarity with AI engagement patterns — LLM and agent applications, RAG, on-premise versus cloud trade-offs — enough to scope an engagement without a specialist in the room.
* Experience carrying a P&L or a practice margin number, not only a delivery target.
* Experience building and leading a technical team across multiple concurrent customer engagements.
* Ability to hold a technical discussion with a CIO or customer architect directly, and to handle escalations without escalating them further.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in a partner or reseller model, working alongside product vendors.
* Enterprise customers in banking, financial services, or manufacturing in India.
* Experience growing a technical practice from a small team into a larger one.
* Exposure to presales in a services environment — RFP responses, solution defence, and competitive positioning.

title: Manager, Operational Risk & Controls - Europe
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Manager, Operational Risk & Controls - Europe
  
  
Manager, Operational Risk & Controls - Europe
  
  
Location: Pune, India
  
  
**Overview**
The Manager, Operational Risk & Controls– Europe strengthens Mastercard Europe’s (MCE) risk posture by providing independent 2LoD oversight and challenge across high operational risk processes spanning both technology and non-technology domains. The role drives consistent application of the ORC framework (risk identification & assessment, control identification & evaluation, and ongoing management & monitoring), and supports MCE’s regulatory obligations (i.e. SIPS, PISA, CROE).
  
  
Role
  
  
**Scope**

* Regional coverage: Mastercard Europe S.A. (MCE)
* Risk domains: Operational (incl. tech, process, people), legal & regulatory, third-party/outsourcing interfaces, and other topics relevant to European supervision.
* Regulatory context: Role contributes to ongoing readiness against regulatory expectations to comply with SIPS, PISA and CROE requirements, supporting alignment with supervisory themes (e.g., cyber/operational resilience expectations).
* Key relationships: ORC (Operational Risk and Controls) Global Function, 1LoD business and technology owners; 1LoD and 2LoD Tech Risk and Corporate Security; TPRM; Finance/Controllership; Regulatory Affairs; Internal Audit; MCE risk governance committees (TRC/BRCC/Board Risk Committee).

**Key Responsibilities**
Framework execution & oversight
  
  

* Champion application of the ORC Framework’s three pillars (Operational Risk Identification & Assessment; Controls Identification & Evaluation; Risk & Controls Management and Monitoring) across Europe; provide independent oversight, challenge, and guidance to 1LoD.
* Facilitate/oversee RCSAs (Risk and Control Self Assessments) and risk & control register for high operational risk processes (HORPs); ensure risks, controls, issues, risk events and treatments are captured and maintained to ORC standards.
* Review control designs, effectiveness assessment and control testing results; escalate significant control gaps and delays, and track remediation through closure.
* Support the maintenance of a Europe tech and non-tech control framework including control testing, in partnership with Group ORC and first line teams, including tech risk management and Corporate Security functions, that meet EU regulatory expectations

Technology & non-technology coverage
  
  

* Provide 2LoD oversight across technology risk and control domains (e.g., change management, availability, security, access, data) and nontech operational risks (e.g., process, people, financial operations), ensuring consistent control expectations across domains.

Regulatory enablement & external expectations
  
  

* Produce ORC content to European Risk Governance packs (TRC/BRCC/ Board)
* Provide support as needed in regulator interactions on topics related to Operational Risk and Controls.
* Support MCE’s efforts to address CROE-related remediation actions by assessing whether security and technology control gaps are adequately identified, prioritized, and remediated in line with supervisory expectations.

Risk events, issues & insights
  
  

* Review high/very high rated risk events for accurate rating, high-quality root cause analysis, and adequacy of remediation.
* Produce clear Management Reporting for governance forums; identify trends and emerging risks to inform priorities and controls evolution.
* Monitor issue/treatment plan milestones and challenge closure evidence for sufficiency and durability.

Ways of working & tooling
  
  

* Oversee completeness of operational risk data (e.g., OpenPages entries, risk registers, control assessments, remediation evidence).
* Ensure documentation meets regulatory, audit, and Europe governance expectations — including CROE aligned evidence standards.

**All About You**
Experience: 6-8 years in operational risk, internal controls, or assurance in financial services/payments; proven work across both technology and business/non tech processes.
  
  
Risk Management practices and frameworks: Strong working knowledge of ORC/ERM policy constructs (RCSA, risk & control registers, control evaluation & testing, issues/incidents/loss events, risk appetite).
  
  
Regulatory familiarity: Practical understanding of EU regulator expectations with ability to translate requirements into control objectives and testing criteria.
  
  
Skills: Analytical judgment; ability to challenge constructively; crisp writing for senior audiences; stakeholder management in a matrix.
  
  
Tools: Experience with risk GRC-applications (e.g., OpenPages, Archer)
  
  
Languages: Fluent English
  
  
Education/Certifications: Bachelor’s degree required; relevant certifications (e.g., CRISC, CISA, CIA) welcome.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Manager - HSE- Pune
description:

title: Global Category Manager
description:

**Location for this role is flexible between China (Shanghai, Wuxi, Xi'an) and India (Pune)**
In this role, you will (1) lead Valmet assigned categories within Global Supply Scope for Pulp, Energy & Circularity, Packaging and Tissue and Performance Parts. Also, you will (2) develop and maintain category strategies with the company's overall business objectives in close collaboration with the Business Areas as well as (3) build and lead cross-functional category teams, and (4) collaborate with key stakeholders to ensure cost-effective supply base of products and services through optimal supplier performance.
  
  
**Your Main Responsibilities**

* Development and execution of category strategies together with BA stakeholders in alignment with growth targets keeping enhanced focus on Cost Competitive Countries Sourcing (CCC)
* Coordination of an international matrix category team with a balanced mix of commercial, technical, legal & compliance, and regional expertise.
* Conducting supplier, industry, and market research to inform sourcing strategies and decisions.
* Collaborating with internal stakeholders across different countries/continents to identify category needs and opportunities.

**Supplier Development & Management**

* Ensuring that selected supplier base can develop quality, delivery, cost (QDC) as well as capacity and demand challenges for category.
* Managing Partner and Key suppliers, acting as the main commercial contact.
* Sharing supplier and cost information transparently across functions.

**Category Management Excellence**

* Conducting competitive tenders and negotiations to achieve cost savings and favorable contractual terms with the leverage of group purchasing volumes, and focus on world-wide supplier base, and Cost Competitive Countries (CCC)
* Active collaboration with international procurement and sourcing teams and business areas for category strategy execution.
* Ensuring quality of Category Management master data in all relevant systems and environments to support accurate reporting and development of category KPIs.

**Risk Management & Compliance**

* Identification and mitigation of supply chain risks proactively.
* Ensuring compliance with sourcing policies, approval processes, and ISO standards

**Leadership & Continuous Improvement**

* Driving continuous improvement in sourcing processes and tools.

**What do we expect from you?**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering, economics or related fields.
* Min. 5 years’ experience in Category Management or Sourcing in the industrial sector in international organizations.
* Expertise and experience in metal fabrication industry and processes.
* Experience in supplier consolidation programs.
* Experience in contract development, negotiation and supplier relationship management.
* Strong interpersonal skills including knowledge in managing matrix teams and stakeholders with geographically and culturally diverse setup.
* Excellent communication, problem solving, and decision-making skills.
* Fluent in English, both written and verbal.
* Strong analytical skills, strategic acumen and cost rationalization mindset with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions to drive cost-efficient procurement activities.

We are looking for a self-motivated, engaged, innovative, passionate individual who is comfortable working with diverse cross functional teams. **We offer**
Competitive pay, comprehensive insurance, and a vibrant workplace culture filled with team-building events and employee clubs. Plus, take advantage of our flexible internal mobility program to grow your career your way!
  
  
You will step into an inspiring, team-oriented international environment where innovation thrives. We support your professional growth with modern tools, learning opportunities, and flexible working arrangements that blend office and remote work – helping you maintain a healthy work-life balance while working on impactful global projects.
  
  
**When everything works together**
Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.
  
  
Join the team -- and lead the way with us!
