title: Partnership Manager-Pune
description:
Partner Account Manager (PAM)
  
  
*Treat the partner portfolio like a business unit. Own revenue, pipeline, growth and profitability across your named partners.*
**Role**
Partner Account Manager (PAM)
**Level**
Manager / Senior Manager
**Experience**
6–10 years
**Reports to**
Associate Director — India Partnerships
**Compensation**
Competitive, commensurate with experience
  
  
**About Keka & The Partner Organization**
Keka is one of India's fastest-growing modern HR-tech companies, serving 10,000+ businesses across HR, payroll, performance, hiring and finance. The Keka Partner Organization is a strategic growth lever — operating a partner ecosystem across distributors, resellers, technology / ISV partners, and referral partners (CAs, HR consultants, payroll bureaus, advisors).
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The PAM owns a named book of Keka partners end-to-end — program rules, pipeline, co-sell, operations, GTM, cross-functional alignment and the partner relationship. You are responsible for maximizing your partners’ revenue impact while delivering an exceptional experience with Keka.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Program & Partner Mechanics**

* Own program rules — tier criteria, certifications, MDF usage, branding, incentives, rebates and commissions.
* Maintain clean partner data in CRM/PRM ( certifications, contacts, opportunities);
* Oversee deal registration, contract renewals, SLA and MDF claim validation.

**Pipeline, Co-Sell & GTM**

* Drive pipeline creation, co-sell support, negotiation, margin discussion and conflict resolution with each partner.
* Build partner sales plans, joint customer-success plans, reference-customer development and upsell/cross-sell motions.
* Run joint GTM — campaigns, key plays, enablement milestones, co-marketing strategy and execution.

**Operations, Reviews & Cross-Functional**

* QBR / MBR / weekly reviews, forecasting accuracy, pipeline hygiene and partner scorecard management.
* Coordinate Sales, Marketing, Ops, Finance, Legal, CS, Presales and Channel Leadership on partner needs.
* Resolve commercial, operational and support escalations; manage budgets and deal-desk for partner investments.

**Strategic Relationship & Lifecycle**

* Executive alignment with VP/C-level at top partners; annual business reviews and multi-year growth roadmaps.
* Partner health-score monitoring, journey mapping, NPS, advisory-board participation.
* Voice-of-partner programs, partner community building, and clean exit/offboarding when required.

How Success Is Measured
  
  

* Partner-sourced + partner-influenced revenue against quota.
* Active partners %, pipeline coverage, win rate, forecast accuracy.
* Tier-progression of partners, certification compliance, partner NPS.

Must-Have
  
  

* 6–10 years in channel / alliances / partner-account management at a B2B SaaS or enterprise-tech company; carried a partner-sourced number.
* Strong commercial instincts — margin, incentives, deal economics and conflict resolution.
* CRM/PRM hygiene discipline and structured QBR / forecasting cadence.
* Senior stakeholder presence — comfortable with VP / C-level conversations at partners.

Nice-to-Have
  
  

* HR-tech, fintech, or payroll-adjacent industry exposure.
* Experience scaling a partner book from a handful to 50+ active partners.

title: Design Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced
**Design Manager**
to lead the engineering and design activities for water treatment and dosing systems projects.

o  Job Responsibilities

* Lead the complete design and engineering of WTP, STP, ETP, RO, UF, dosing systems and other water treatment systems.
* Review and approve process design calculations, PFDs, P&IDs, hydraulic calculations, equipment sizing, and technical specifications.
* Manage multidisciplinary engineering teams covering process, mechanical, piping, civil, electrical, and instrumentation.
* Ensure compliance with project requirements, applicable engineering standards, and statutory regulations.
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, vendors, procurement, project management, and site execution teams.
* Monitor design schedules, engineering deliverables, quality, and project budgets.

**o  Educational Qualifications**

title: Construction Site Manager
description:
We are building two villa projects in Karjat - Trulife at Tadwadi and Goodlife at Kothimbe. We are looking for one person to run both sites: living at site, with real authority over execution, reporting directly to the founder.

**The work**

* Run day-to-day construction at both sites - manpower, material, sequence, quality, closure.
* Lead 10 to 15 engineers and supervisors, and 100 to 150+ workers across multiple contractors.
* Plan the week before it starts. Schedule, material indents, manpower, contractor commitments - fixed in advance, not decided on the morning.
* Send daily and weekly MIS to our head office in Vashi: progress against plan, manpower on site, material position, what is blocked.
* Hold quality. Check the work, and make it redone when it is not right.
* Meet customers who come to site. Villa buyers want to speak to someone senior and want a straight answer on their handover date. You will be that person.
* Keep contractors moving. Settle problems at site rather than escalating all of them.

**What we are looking for**

* 12 to 18 years on construction sites, with at least the last 5 running a project independently.
* Proven team size: 10+ engineers and supervisors, 100+ workers on site at peak.
* Experience at sites in Maharashtra.
* Diploma or degree in civil engineering.
* Fluent Hindi and Marathi. Able to hold a proper conversation with a customer in English.
* Someone who plans ahead rather than firefights, and who gets work finished on a date.

**What we provide**

* Stay and food at site.
* Rs 70,000 to Rs 1,20,000 per month, depending on what you have actually run.
* A direct line to the founder, and the authority to run the site your way.

**Being straight with you**

This is six days a week, long days, and you will live at site through the week, away from home. The sites are in Karjat, not in a city. If that does not suit you, this is not your job. If you have done it before and you enjoy running a site properly - planned, clean, on date - you will like it here.

**How to apply**

Apply here on LinkedIn. If we shortlist you, we will send you a short set of questions to answer in writing, then an online interview, then a visit to the site to meet us and walk the project.

title: Buyer & Sourcing Manager
description:
The Sourcing Manager will be responsible for leading and driving sourcing activities for the PIP India
  
  
organization. This role reports directly to the India ISC Head and can be based in Pune, Mumbai, or
  
  
Delhi. The position requires strong leadership in supplier management, cost optimization, and strategic
  
  
sourcing to support business growth and operational excellence.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* New Product Development (NPD):
* Prepare RFQs, identify suppliers, analyze quotations and commercial proposals.
* Conduct cost evaluations, negotiate with suppliers, finalize agreements, and oversee

PPAP approvals.
  
  

* Bill of Materials (BOM):
* Collaborate with engineering teams to finalize BOMs.
* Evaluate and validate costing for each part.
* Direct & Indirect Procurement Focus:
* Procure finished goods to support customer demand requirements.
* Procure services, MRO items, facilities-related purchases, IT equipment, professional

services, and other indirect spend categories.
  
  

* Procurement Activities:
* Manage end-to-end procurement activities for direct materials and indirect

goods/services to support business operations.
  
  

* Source, evaluate, and negotiate with suppliers to achieve optimal cost,

quality, delivery, and service performance.
  
  

* Create, process, and manage purchase orders while ensuring compliance

with procurement policies and approval requirements.
  
  

* Monitor supplier delivery performance and proactively resolve supply,

quality, and operational issues.
  
  

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Operations, Supply Chain,

Finance, HR, IT, and Business Functions to understand purchasing
  
  
requirements and drive timely execution.
  
  

* Conduct market analysis and identify opportunities for cost savings, supplier

consolidation, and process improvements.
  
  

* Maintain accurate procurement records, supplier master data, contracts, and

purchasing documentation.
  
  

* Support supplier relationship management, contract renewals, and

performance reviews to ensure continuity of supply and service excellence.
  
  

* Commodity & Cost Management:
* Monitor commodity price trends and conduct supplier cost negotiations.
* Drive cost reduction initiatives through value analysis and value engineering (VAVE).
* Vendor Management:
* Conduct supplier risk analysis, evaluation, and rating based on QCD parameters.
* Develop and implement supplier improvement plans.
* Manage supplier relationships and resolve grievances effectively.
* New Vendor Development:
* Assess vendor capacity, production cycle times, and readiness for new product setups.
* Support localization initiatives and vendor consolidation.
* Operational Excellence:
* Set and achieve annual targets for cost reduction, program launches, and supplier

performance.
  
  

* Negotiate tooling costs, manage amortization/recovery, and draft tooling agreements.
* Ensure productivity improvements, rejection control, and business assurance.
* Benchmark costs and monitor cost walk trends over time.
* Capacity & Material Planning:
* Align supplier capacity with production schedules to meet material requirements.
* Monitor raw material planning and procurement schedules.
* Expedite materials to support fast ramp-up of NPIs and ensure timely customer

deliveries.
  
  

* Technology & Systems:
* Support acquisition of new manufacturing technologies to maintain competitiveness.
* Demonstrate proficiency in ERP/SAP systems.
* Negotiate stocking agreements and vendor-managed inventory (VMI).
* Manage IOS compliance internally and at supplier sites.
* Collaboration & Due Diligence:
* Work closely with cross-functional teams (CFT) and design engineering.
* Support ISC due diligence processes for supplier partnerships and key players.
* Conduct quarterly supplier visits to strengthen relationships and address

capacity/quality issues.
  
  

* Communication:
* Exhibit strong communication skills to interact with global suppliers and internal

teams.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or MBA (Master’s degree preferred).
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in strategic sourcing.
* Proven track record in successfully managing new projects.
* Strong knowledge of vendor management, procurement and strategic sourcing practices.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel up to 25%.
* Understanding of local market opportunities.
* Six Sigma Green Belt; Lean Expert/Black Belt certification is an added advantage.

**Other Requirements**

* Entrepreneurial mindset with agility and flexibility.
* Demonstrated contribution to business growth.
* Strong financial and business acumen.
* High integrity and strong value systems.
* Experience in setting up new business operations is an added advantage.

title: Lead, Support Operations Excellence
description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
  
  
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
  
  
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
  
  
The Trust and Safety Operations team is focused (ok, maybe obsessed) on scaling Roblox's Operations organization and transforming our customer experience through our multi-year vision and strategy execution. The team provides support to Roblox's global players, developers, and advertisers. As a Lead, Product Support Ops on our Safety Ops Team, you’ll be mentor and lead the team that is focused on Escalations, Product Reliability, Process Improvement and Design and plays a critical role in managing and resolving escalations and high-impact incidents affecting our Roblox users and platform. Your team will be responsible for identifying trends, enhancing support processes, improving agent efficiency, and reducing operational costs while maintaining high reliability and service quality.
  
  
You will be reporting to the Trust & Safety India Operations Manager and leading the Support Operations Excellence team, providing coverage across billing, accounts, creator, and adjacent domains. This is a player-coach role, weighted toward leadership. You'll still go deep on the hardest problems and stay close enough to the work to be a genuine execution expert, but your primary leverage is the team, and you'll be measured on what they collectively deliver.
  
  
The Product Support Management (PSM) team is your most important partner. You and your team supply the synthesis, evidence, and prioritization that enable PSM and engineering to fix problems at the source, and you are accountable for the quality of what reaches them.
  
  
**You Will**
**Lead and develop the team**

* Manage, coach, and grow a team of four Product Support Specialists (Process Excellence team), owning onboarding, performance, and career development. You’ll set direction and hold the quality of output for the team. Coach them to grow their scope and operate with independence.
* Set clear standards for what good looks like at each level, and give direct, specific, and frequent feedback against them.
* Represent the team's work, constraints, and priorities to leadership and to cross-functional partners.

**Partner with the Product Support Management team**

* Serve as the primary point of contact between the Product Support Specialists team and Product Support Managers (PSM's), ensuring the issues your team surfaces arrive with the synthesis, evidence, and recommendation needed to act on them.
* Own the quality bar for what your team escalates into the PSM and engineering prioritization process.
* Ensure RCAs are completed, documented, socialized with the right stakeholders, and work with the PSM team to ensure they are translated into changes that prevent recurrence.
* Step in personally on the highest-stakes and most ambiguous problems, and partner with the PSM team to make the call when the path forward is unclear.

**Drive support health and operational excellence**

* Co-own the health of product support across your domains: contact drivers, resolution rates, reopen and escalation rates, deflection performance, CSAT, and where users are getting stuck.
* Turn patterns into prioritized action: recurring issues, missing coverage, misleading documentation, and product gaps get surfaced with a recommendation.
* Hold the line on quality standards, tighten workflows and handoffs between support, engineering, and product, and eliminate manual toil through better process and tooling.
* Support Launches:

+ Get ahead of launches: make sure upcoming product and policy changes are pressure-tested from a support perspective, and that content, tooling, and agent readiness are in place before users feel the change.
+ Contribute to the successful launch of new support streams and initiatives by providing subject matter expertise, process guidance, and team capacity.

* Partner closely with the PSM team to establish a regular feedback loop on support health proactively identifying areas of strength, flagging degrading performance, and driving actionable mitigation plans.
* Vendor & Escalation Quality: Partner with vendor operations (BPO/Tier 1) to establish feedback loops that improve first-contact resolution, reduce bad escalations, and ensure frontline agents are enabled on critical product changes.

**Knowledge & Support ContentOwn knowledge and scaled support**

* Co-own the accuracy/ information within support content that agents depend on along with PSMs, ensuring workflows, policies and guidance are accurate and up to date. Ensure support content which includes but is not limited to, troubleshooting guides, decision trees, structured resolution paths, policy interpretations are clear, current, and reliable for the support agents who use it.
* Partner with Knowledge Management, Training, and Quality teams to align documentation, agent enablement, and quality control with what the data says users actually need.

**You Have**

* 8+ years in technical support, product support, or a comparable operational role, including significant time at a senior or escalation tier.
* Direct people management experience, including ownership of performance and career development, with a track record of developing individuals and raising the collective performance of a team.
* A demonstrated track record of independent root cause analysis on complex technical issues, and the judgment to know when to go deep yourself and when to delegate.
* Experience owning incident response for high-severity issues, including coordinating cross-functional teams under time pressure.
* Breadth across multiple support domains, or clear evidence you can get up to speed on an unfamiliar one quickly.
* Excellent written communication. You can explain a nuanced technical failure to an engineer, to a frustrated user, and to leadership, and all three come away clearer.
* Strong cross-functional influence without authority.
* Comfort with ambiguity. You set direction for your team when the problem space is not yet well defined.
* Willingness to participate in on-call support when needed.

**You Are**

* A Leader: Your team does better work because of you, and that shows up in their output and their growth.
* Analytical: Excited to investigate large, ambiguous problems, and to measure both the problems and the solutions.
* A proactive problem solver: You anticipate problems and take decisive action rather than waiting for them to escalate to you.
* Team-oriented: You lift up your peers and find ways to make the wider organization stronger, not just your own team.
* Data-driven: You use data to identify trends, measure results, and drive decisions.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience owning support content at scale, with real evidence that content changed outcomes (deflection, handle time, resolution quality).
* Experience building or scaling a support team through a period of significant growth or change.
* Prior experience supporting a developer, creator, or partner audience alongside a general consumer base.
* Experience working with BPO or outsourced support partners.

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
  
  
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
  
  
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

description:
**Job Description:**
**About us\***
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting & Reconciliations, Management Reporting & Analysis, Research & Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support & Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.

This person would serve in an execution role to support business with new and emerging tools used in process optimization efforts and driving Operational Excellence.

title: Head - Project Commercial (GM/AVP)
description:
**Job Title:**
GM / AVP – Project Commercial (Corporate Role)

**Job Objective:**

To manage the commercial and procurement functions for a new project or any major renovation/expansion of an existing unit. This includes the commercial oversight of OPEX/CAPEX purchases, procurement of various commodities, equipment, and other project-related requirements while ensuring cost efficiency, risk management, and compliance as per laid processes & guidelines. Manage all vendor contracts and commercial agreements, maintain excellent professional relationships with service providers, and optimize cost, quality, and timelines for project execution.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Drive the commercial strategy and manage the end-to-end procurement and contract lifecycle from planning to execution, ensuring alignment with the project budget and financial objectives.
* Conduct a comprehensive commercial evaluation of the scope, quantity & quality, ensuring an optimized procurement and sourcing strategy. Have the entire requirement document (RFP) in place to initiate bid management.
* Evaluate responses from bidders, shortlist and negotiate with vendors/service providers, and finalize cost-effective contracts with optimal quality and service levels (SLA’s, timelines, and performance standards).
* Ensure timely and cost-efficient procurement & availability of all items while mitigating risks related to price fluctuations, supplier performance, and regulatory compliance.
* Manage and oversee commercial contracts, procurement policies, and governance frameworks to ensure alignment with organizational goals and compliance.
* Implement robust cost-control mechanisms to track budgets, expenditures, and cost variances while ensuring adherence to financial approvals and governance norms.
* Oversee vendor risk assessment and ensure that all contractual obligations are met, including adherence to quality standards, delivery timelines, and service-level agreements.
* Manage inventory & distribution/indenting process, forecasting future consumption loads for an optimum inventory level.
* Track all service orders, receipts, invoices, and payments with a strong focus on commercial efficiency and financial tracking in collaboration with the Finance team.
* Excellent collaboration with cross-functional teams like Finance, Legal, Projects, construction partners, and other stakeholders to ensure commercial objectives are met.
* Manage all documentation requirements related to procurement, contracts, and compliance, ensuring adherence to legal and regulatory standards.
* Plan for department manpower requirements and utilize all team members efficiently.
* Continuously identify cost-saving opportunities through vendor negotiations, alternate sourcing, and process optimizations.

**Key Skills & Competencies:**

* **Commercial Acumen:**
  Strong understanding of procurement, vendor management, contract negotiations, and financial control.
* **Project Procurement & Sourcing:**
  Expertise in sourcing CAPEX/OPEX materials, equipment, and services while optimizing costs.
* **Contract Management:**
  Experience in handling legal contracts, vendor agreements, and service-level negotiations.
* **Financial & Budget Management:**
  Ability to track and control costs, budget adherence, and financial forecasting.
* **Risk Management & Compliance:**
  Expertise in mitigating procurement risks, supplier risks, and regulatory compliance.
* **Stakeholder & Vendor Management:**
  Strong relationship management with internal and external stakeholders, including suppliers and service providers.
* **Negotiation & Cost Optimization:**
  Ability to drive cost efficiencies, negotiate best-value contracts, and manage supplier performance.
* **Process Improvement & Governance:**
  Implementing best practices for procurement, inventory control, and contract management.
* **Analytical & Decision-Making Skills:**
  Strong data-driven approach to procurement, project cost analysis, and vendor selection.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Ability to work closely with Finance, Legal, Projects, and Operations teams.

Gurgaon (Corporate Office)

**Work days:**
6 Days from Office

title: Managing Director, Global Head of Portfolio Management Services Engineering , Aladdin
description:
**About This Role**
**About the Role**
We are seeking an exceptional engineering executive to lead Portfolio Management Services Engineering globally and serve as Head of PM Engineering India, to drive a modernization program to unlock 10x improvement of Scale, Resilience and Performance in the portfolio management capabilities in Aladdin, used by over 10k professional investors every day to manage in excess of $20Tn of financial assets. This leader will be responsible for the strategy, architecture, delivery, operational excellence, and talent development of a portfolio of mission-critical investment technology services, frameworks, and API products - that power Portfolio Management capabilities at scale. The role combines large-scale engineering leadership, organizational leadership, technical vision, and investment domain expertise. The successful candidate will lead globally distributed teams responsible for highly scalable shared services and platforms that enable portfolio construction, analytics, investment workflows, automation, and client-facing capabilities across the investment lifecycle. This individual will play a critical role in shaping the future architecture of Portfolio Management in Aladdin while building world-class engineering teams and helping engineers achieve their full potential.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Enterprise Technology Leadership**

* Define and execute the technology strategy for Portfolio Management Services Engineering.
* Lead the modernization and evolution of critical shared platforms and services supporting portfolio management workflows.
* Drive architectural direction across large-scale distributed systems with a focus on high scalability, stability, resilience, performance, observability, and operational excellence.
* Partner closely with product, architecture, SRE, data, and business stakeholders to align technology investments with strategic outcomes.

**Build World-Class Engineering Teams**

* Lead, coach, and develop engineering managers, architects, and senior technical leaders.
* Create an environment where engineers can grow their careers and reach their full potential.
* Build strong succession pipelines and leadership depth across the organization.
* Foster a culture of mentorship, continuous learning, innovation, and inclusion.

**Deliver Business Outcomes**

* Own execution and delivery of a complex global portfolio of initiatives.
* Establish a culture of accountability, ownership, predictability, and operational excellence.
* Balance long-term platform investments with near-term business commitments.
* Drive measurable outcomes for clients, portfolio managers, and internal stakeholders.

**Technical Excellence**

* Provide executive oversight and guidance on architecture and engineering decisions.
* Champion engineering excellence across software architecture, development, testing, security, reliability, and operations.
* Drive adoption of modern engineering practices, cloud-native architectures, AI-enabled development, automation, and platform engineering principles.
* Ensure systems meet demanding standards for scale, resiliency, availability, and performance.

**Investment Technology Leadership**

* Partner with investment professionals and product leaders to deliver capabilities that improve investment decision making and portfolio management outcomes.
* Develop strong understanding of portfolio construction, risk, analytics, order generation, trading workflows, investment automation, and related investment processes.
* Translate complex investment requirements into scalable engineering solutions.

**Head of PM Engineering India**

* Provide senior leadership for the India PM Engineering organization.
* Develop talent, strengthen leadership capability, and build a high-performance engineering culture.
* Act as a key representative of the India engineering organization within the broader enterprise.
* Drive organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, hiring, engagement, and leadership development.

**Innovation & Change Leadership**

* Lead organizational and technology transformation initiatives.
* Leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve developer productivity and product outcomes.
* Challenge the status quo and drive continuous improvement across people, process, and technology.

**Required Experience**

* 15+ years of software engineering experience with significant experience leading large global engineering organizations.
* Proven success leading organizations in highly demanding environments such as:

+ Asset Management
+ Investment Banking
+ Capital Markets
+ FinTech
+ Large-scale Technology Platforms

* Track record of leading multiple teams and managers and growing engineering leaders across multiple locations and time zones.
* Experience managing mission-critical platforms operating at significant scale.

**Leadership Capabilities**

* Enterprise-first mindset with the ability to influence across organizational boundaries.
* Strong people leader with a passion for developing talent and building future leaders.
* Outcome-oriented with relentless focus on execution and delivery.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Collaborative team player who operates effectively across business, product, and engineering functions.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through complexity, ambiguity, and change.

**Technical Capabilities**

* Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture.
* Expertise in scalability, resiliency, reliability, observability, security, and performance engineering.
* Strong SDLC and software engineering discipline.
* Experience with Agile at scale and modern engineering operating models.
* Ability to engage deeply in architecture reviews and guide senior technical leaders.

**Domain Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of investment management, portfolio management, trading, analytics, market data, risk management, or related financial technology domains.
* Ability to connect business strategy, investment workflows, and technology execution.

**Leadership Characteristics**

* People-first while maintaining a high-performance bar
* Obsessed with client and business outcomes
* An AI-first leader and innovator
* Technically credible with strong architectural judgment
* A collaborative leader
* A builder of teams, culture, and future leaders
* A champion of operational excellence and engineering quality
* Comfortable operating at global scale with executive-level visibility

**Measures Of Success**

* Delivery of strategic product and business outcomes.
* Strength of the leadership bench and talent pipeline.
* Reliability, scalability, and performance of PM Services platforms.
* Organizational health and employee engagement.
* Technology modernization and platform simplification.
* Effective partnership across PM Engineering, Product, Architecture, SRE, and Investment teams.
* Ability to accelerate innovation while maintaining world-class operational excellence.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: New Product Development Manager
description: We are looking for a highly driven, commercially minded NPD Lead who understands the beauty and personal care industry and can take a product from an initial idea to a finished product on the shelf.This is an end-to-end product ownership role. You will be responsible for identifying the right products to launch, understanding consumer needs, researching the market, developing product concepts, sourcing ingredients and packaging, coordinating with manufacturers and R&D teams, managing costs and margins, deciding pricing and pack sizes, and ensuring every product is ready for launch on time.You should understand both the creative and commercial sides of product development. You need to know what consumers want, what is trending in the market, what competitors are launching, which ingredients and formulations make sense, which packaging options are viable, what consumers are willing to pay, and whether a product can deliver attractive gross margins.You will work closely with founders, manufacturers, formulation labs, packaging suppliers, procurement partners, and marketing teams to bring new products to market.We are looking for someone who takes complete ownership, moves quickly, has excellent attention to detail, and can balance product quality, consumer appeal, commercial viability, and speed to market.1. Market Research, Consumer Insights & Product Opportunity IdentificationConduct in-depth market research across beauty, skincare, fragrance, body care, and personal care categories.Track emerging trends in product formats, ingredients, formulations, fragrances, packaging, textures, claims, and consumer preferences.Study leading Indian and international brands to understand their product portfolios, positioning, price points, pack sizes, launches, and differentiation.Identify gaps in the market, underserved consumer needs, and opportunities to create differentiated products.Analyse competitor products, customer reviews, social media conversations, marketplace reviews, and consumer feedback to understand what customers like, dislike, and want improved.Translate consumer insights into clear product concepts with a defined target audience, core benefit, product proposition, and reason to buy.Evaluate new product opportunities based on demand, competitive intensity, differentiation, market size, feasibility, and commercial potential.Build and maintain a prioritised product innovation pipeline.Recommend which products to develop, which to postpone, and which opportunities are not commercially attractive.2. End-to-End New Product Development: From Concept to ShelfDevelop detailed product briefs covering the product concept, target consumer, benefits, sensory experience, ingredients, formulation expectations, fragrance profile, packaging, pricing, and competitive positioning.Translate product ideas into actionable briefs for manufacturers, formulation labs, and R&D partners.Identify suitable manufacturers and development partners based on technical capabilities, category expertise, quality standards, minimum order quantities, costs, and lead times.Coordinate formulation development, sample creation, evaluation, feedback, and refinement.Manage multiple rounds of product sampling until the formulation meets the desired quality, performance, sensory experience, and commercial requirements.Establish product specifications and ensure that the final product matches the approved brief.Coordinate stability testing, compatibility testing, microbiological testing where applicable, and other required quality and safety assessments.Track every stage of development through clear timelines, milestones, owners, dependencies, and approval checkpoints.Identify potential delays or technical issues early and resolve them proactively.Ensure products are commercially, technically, and operationally ready before moving into mass production.3. Formulation, Ingredients & Product QualityResearch and evaluate ingredients based on their function, performance, safety, stability, cost, availability, and relevance to the target consumer.Source suitable ingredients and work with formulation chemists and manufacturers to develop the desired product experience.Understand the role of active ingredients, emollients, humectants, surfactants, preservatives, fragrance materials, solvents, and other relevant formulation components.Develop clear formulation requirements around texture, spreadability, absorption, moisturisation, fragrance intensity, longevity, washability, finish, and overall consumer experience, depending on the category.Evaluate ingredient alternatives when cost, availability, performance, or formulation stability becomes a constraint.Review formulation samples critically and provide structured feedback to R&D teams.Ensure ingredient selection supports product claims and complies with applicable Indian regulations and relevant quality requirements.Work with technical partners to investigate issues such as separation, leakage, colour changes, fragrance instability, packaging interactions, or inconsistent product performance.Maintain clear documentation of approved formulations, specifications, test results, and product changes.4. Packaging Development, Sourcing & Design ExecutionResearch and source suitable packaging formats, materials, components, and suppliers.Identify packaging options relevant to each product.Evaluate materials based on compatibility, durability, aesthetics, functionality, and cost.Work with designers and suppliers to translate the desired product experience into production-ready packaging.Manage packaging samples, moulds where required, colour matching, finishes, printing, decoration, labels, and artwork approvals.Evaluate packaging options based on visual appeal, consumer usability, product protection, manufacturing feasibility, and logistics.Conduct or coordinate packaging compatibility.Source alternative vendors and components to improve quality, reduce cost, or shorten lead times.Ensure packaging specifications, dimensions, materials, and artwork are approved before mass production.Coordinate with design, regulatory, and production teams to ensure packaging is attractive, practical, compliant, and ready for launch.5. Sourcing, Vendor Management & ManufacturingIdentify, evaluate, and onboard manufacturers, contract manufacturers, formulation labs, ingredient suppliers, packaging vendors, and other development partners.Obtain and compare quotations, minimum order quantities, payment terms, lead times, tooling costs, and production capabilities.Negotiate pricing, commercial terms, production timelines, and quality expectations.Develop strong vendor relationships while maintaining competitive sourcing standards.Coordinate product development, sampling, purchase orders, production planning, and delivery schedules.Track raw material availability, packaging readiness, manufacturing capacity, and production dependencies.Monitor production progress and address delays, quality deviations, or supply issues proactively.Establish clear quality specifications and acceptance criteria with vendors.Maintain backup suppliers for critical components wherever commercially practical.Ensure production quantities, packaging components, and finished goods are aligned with launch plans and inventory requirements.6. Product Costing, Pricing & Gross Margin OwnershipBuild detailed product cost sheets covering formulation, ingredients, packaging, components, manufacturing, filling, assembly, labels, cartons, testing, tooling, and other relevant costs.Calculate landed product costs and identify opportunities to optimise the bill of materials without compromising product quality.Evaluate different formulation, packaging, pack size, and manufacturing options to improve commercial viability.Recommend the right MRP, selling price, promotional pricing, and pack architecture based on consumer willingness to pay, competitor benchmarks, brand positioning, and target margins.Model gross margins at different price points, order quantities, and cost scenarios.Evaluate the financial implications of different pack sizes, bundle configurations, refill options, and product variants.Understand how discounts, channel commissions, marketplace fees, GST treatment, and other relevant costs affect net realisation and profitability.Work with leadership and finance to establish margin targets and minimum acceptable commercial thresholds.Negotiate with vendors to improve costs and protect margins as volumes scale.Identify products that are commercially unviable before significant development or inventory investment is made.7. Pack Size, Product Architecture & Commercial StrategyRecommend the right pack size, quantity, format, and price point for the target consumer.Evaluate trial sizes, standard sizes, premium sizes, multipacks, bundles, and refill formats where relevant.Assess how pack size affects perceived value, purchase intent, repeat purchase, consumption frequency, shipping economics, and gross margin.Develop product variants and fragrance or formulation extensions based on genuine consumer demand and operational feasibility.Determine whether a concept should launch as a standalone product, a bundle, a kit, or part of a wider product range.Essential Requirements3–6 years of experience in new product development, product innovation, sourcing, or product management.Relevant experience in beauty, skincare, fragrance, body care, cosmetics, or personal care.Demonstrable experience taking products through multiple stages of development, ideally from initial concept to commercial launch.Strong understanding of manufacturers, contract manufacturing, formulation development, packaging sourcing, and supplier management.Strong AdvantagesExperience launching products in the Indian D2C beauty and personal care market.Existing relationships with Indian cosmetic manufacturers, fragrance houses, formulation labs, and packaging suppliers.📍Full time role in Gurgaon, Haryana

description:
Join our team and you will have an opportunity to work in a collaborative and dynamic work environment. Our Group Treasury Integrated Control Monitoring (GT ICM) team is a team within Group Finance that partners with ANZ & EMEA Regulatory Reporting (GTRR) to support risk management, governance, and control activities.
  
  
We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.
  
  
**What role will you play?**
In this role, you will support the governance, risk management, and control environment for Group Treasury (GT), partnering with Reporting, Risk, Data, Finance and Change teams to strengthen controls and deliver risk and control uplift initiatives.
  
  
**What You Offer**

* Support operational risk management across Group Treasury regulatory reporting, including risk identification, control assessment, issue management, and remediation tracking.
* Assist in the design, implementation, maintenance, and continuous enhancement of the regulatory reporting control framework.
* Conduct Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs) and control effectiveness reviews to ensure controls remain fit for purpose.
* Maintain control inventories, control libraries, and OpenPages records, while identifying opportunities to standardize and simplify controls.
* Coordinate audit, assurance, and regulatory review activities, including remediation of findings and preparation of governance and management reporting materials.

We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**What We Offer**
**Benefits**
At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:
  
  

* 1 wellbeing leave day per year
* 26 weeks’ paid maternity leave or 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of paid transition leave upon return to work and 6 weeks’ paid leave for secondary caregivers
* Company-subsidised childcare services
* 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
* Benefits to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing including comprehensive medical and life insurance cover, the option to join parental medical insurance plan and virtual medical consultations extended to family members
* Access to our Employee Assistance Program, a robust behavioural health network with counselling and coaching services
* Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
* Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role
* Reimbursement for work from home equipment

**About Financial Management, People and Engagement**
Financial Management, People and Engagement (FPE) provides a single interface for Macquarie’s businesses across key areas of people, strategy, communications and financial management. Comprising two pillars – Financial Management, and People and Engagement – it is responsible for managing the Group’s financial, tax and treasury activities and strategic priorities, fostering our culture through people and community engagement strategies, and engaging with stakeholders to protect and promote Macquarie’s reputation globally.
  
  
**Inclusion at Macquarie**
We are committed to providing an inclusive environment for all, where different experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected. Macquarie provides access to opportunities for all individuals regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, marital status, gender identity or any other characteristic or circumstance.
  
  
We provide reasonable adjustments to individuals who may need support during the recruitment process and employment. If you require an adjustment, please let us know during the application process.

title: AGM Architecture
description:

**Job Role:**
Architecture

**Designation:**
Assistant General Manager

**Job Location:**
Head Office, Saket, New Delhi

**Role Purpose**

Lead architectural design management across projects by translating business and product

requirements into compliant, buildable and cost-effective design solutions. The role will partner with internal teams and external consultants to ensure design quality, timely delivery and seamless execution from feasibility through project launch.

**How you can make an impact**

• Translate business and product requirements into clear design inputs and comprehensive briefs for external architects and consultants.

• Lead cross-functional design coordination and ensure timely, accurate flow of drawings, decisions and information across business teams.

• Review sanctioned drawings and inputs from approval authorities, including Municipality,

Environment Clearance (EC), RERA and Airport Authority, to verify compliance with statutory

requirements and approval conditions before final submission or release.

• Conduct architectural feasibility studies for new land parcels in line with applicable local byelaws,

development regulations and Ashiana's internal design standards.

• Manage external consultants and design schedules to ensure the timely release of concept, working and GFC drawings to the Engineering and execution teams.

• Oversee the design and on-site execution of sales galleries, show apartments and other customer facing spaces to support successful and timely project launches.

• Ensure that design solutions and specifications are aligned with project budgets, quality standards, customer requirements and constructability objectives; drive value engineering wherever appropriate.

• Resolve design queries, drawing discrepancies and site-related issues in coordination with

consultants, Engineering, Projects and other stakeholders.

• Drive research, innovation and standardization to improve products, SOPs, drawings, detailing and design practices, and ensure that approved changes are communicated to all relevant teams.

• Lead, coach and develop the Architecture team by setting clear priorities, reviewing outputs and

building a culture of ownership, collaboration and design excellence.

**What are we looking for?**

• A full-time bachelor’s degree in architecture (B.Arch.) from a recognized institution, with 11-15

years of relevant experience in architecture and design management; experience with a residential

real-estate developer will be preferred.

• A minimum of 5-7 years of hands-on site visit and design coordination experience across multiple locations is mandatory.

• Strong experience in design development, consultant management, working/GFC drawings, design reviews and coordination with project execution teams.

• Sound understanding of local byelaws, statutory approvals and compliance requirements, including RERA, Environment Clearance and Airport Authority norms, as applicable.

• A strong eye for quality and detailing, along with the ability to balance design intent, functionality, customer experience, budget and execution requirements.

• Proven ability to hire, coach and build teams, lead people with purpose, and manage senior internal and external stakeholders effectively.

• A customer-centric mindset with high ownership, learning agility, sound judgement and the ability to take timely action while consistently striving for excellence.

title: Senior Leadership Role – Energy Transition & Industry Transformation
Senior Manager / AVP – Growth (International)
description:
**Take Stefto global. Build the international business from the ground up, with a direct line to the CEO.**

**About Stefto**

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Gurugram, Stefto is a technology-enabled Business Process Management (BPM) company delivering customer care, engagement and debt management solutions at scale. We run inbound and outbound support, sales and retention programs for leading brands, and manage collections and debt resolution for India’s largest banks and Asset Reconstruction Companies (ARCs). Powered by AI, automation and analytics, we help clients deliver faster, smarter and more personalised customer experiences. With a strong presence across major Indian cities, Stefto is now taking its proven model to international markets.

**The Opportunity**

This is a builder’s role. You’ll own Stefto’s international revenue agenda end to end: choosing the markets, opening the doors, closing the deals and growing the accounts, backed by a delivery engine that already serves India’s top banks and ARCs.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build and execute the international growth strategy across priority markets (US, UK, Middle East, APAC)
* Win new clients for Stefto’s customer care, CX, collections and debt management services
* Run the full sales cycle: prospecting, solutioning, RFPs, pricing, negotiation and closure
* Build CXO-level relationships with banks, lenders, fintechs, debt buyers and enterprise brands overseas
* Leverage Stefto’s track record with large Indian banks and ARCs to win global BFSI and collections mandates
* Partner with operations and delivery teams to design winning solutions and ensure smooth transitions
* Develop channel partners, alliances and advisor networks to speed up market entry
* Own the pipeline, forecasts and revenue reporting to the CEO
* Represent Stefto at global industry events and client meetings
* Build and lead a growth team as the function scales

**Who Should Apply**

This role is specifically for professionals who have
**sold BPO/BPM services to international clients**
. You’re a strong fit if you have:

* 10–15 years in business development, with
  **at least 5–6 years in international BD within the BPO/BPM/CX industry**
* A proven record of winning and growing offshore contracts with clients in the US, UK, Middle East or APAC
* Hands-on experience selling customer support, CX, collections or back-office services
* Exposure to BFSI clients, debt collection agencies, debt buyers or ARCs (strong advantage)
* An active network of decision-makers in overseas markets
* Sharp commercial skills in pricing, deal structuring and contract negotiation
* CXO-level presence with excellent communication and presentation skills
* An entrepreneurial mindset and the drive to build something new
* Willingness to travel internationally; MBA preferred

**Please note:**
Profiles with only domestic sales experience, or international sales outside the BPO/BPM space, will not be considered for this role.

**Why Stefto**

* Direct reporting to the CEO with a high-visibility, high-impact mandate
* The chance to build and lead the international business from day one
* A proven delivery platform trusted by leading banks and ARCs

**Ready to take Stefto global? Send your CV to**
**careers@stefto.com**
**with the subject “AVP – Growth (International)”.**

title: Service Delivery Manager - Payroll
description:
**Service Delivery Manager – Payroll**

*Global Process Owner, Payroll & Reward Operations (R2P)*

**Tower:**
Reward to Pay (R2P)

**Location:**
Noida, India (HR Shared Services Hub)

**Reports to:**
HR SSC Regional Hub Director, Noida

**Role type:**
People manager

**Scope:**
Multi-country payroll, benefits administration, compensation changes, payroll accounting and tax filings

**ABOUT THE HUB**

Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

You own payroll and reward delivery end to end for every country moving into Noida. You will move payroll from dozens of local vendors and in-country teams to a controlled, consolidated model. Employees must be paid accurately and on time, in every cycle and in every country, throughout the transition and after it.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Transition and shared services set-up**

* Lead the payroll transition roadmap country by country, sequenced by risk, complexity, headcount and vendor contract dates.
* Run knowledge transfer from country payroll teams and vendors. This covers desk procedures, statutory calendars, pay elements and local exceptions.
* Plan and run parallel payroll runs for each country. Set clear go/no-go criteria based on variance thresholds, and use hypercare after cutover.
* Deliver the global payroll vendor consolidation programme. Rationalise the vendor portfolio, support selection, and manage exit and onboarding without disrupting pay.
* Design the target operating model for R2P, covering the split of work between hub, vendor and country HR, with RACI, handoffs and cut-off calendars.

**2. Process ownership and service delivery**

* Act as Global Process Owner for R2P. Own process standards, the global pay calendar, the design of allowed variations, and change control.
* Deliver zero critical payroll errors per cycle through pre-payroll reconciliations, input validation, dual approval and post-pay checks.
* Monitor data flows between the HRIS, time-and-attendance, payroll engines and the general ledger. Resolve interface breaks before cut-off.
* Manage payroll vendors against contractual SLAs, with monthly scorecards, quarterly business reviews and service credits where needed.
* Act as the escalation point for pay issues. Run root-cause analysis on every off-cycle payment and track the fix through to closure.

**3. Governance, risk and controls**

* Build and maintain the R2P control framework, including key controls, segregation of duties, access reviews and evidence standards.
* Lead annual and ad-hoc audit readiness with Internal Audit, Tax and Finance. Close findings within the agreed timelines.
* Track statutory and regulatory change in every in-scope country. Implement change before its effective date.
* Protect employee pay data in line with GDPR and local privacy law.

**4. Continuous improvement and digital**

* Standardise pay elements and processes across countries. Reduce local exceptions to the minimum required by law.
* Automate reconciliations, variance analysis and exception reporting using RPA and analytics.
* Drive employee self-service for payslips, tax documents and pay queries to reduce inbound contacts.

**5. People leadership, performance and culture**

* Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state.
* Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings.
* Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots.
* Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day.
* Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* First 90 days: R2P operating model, country wave plan and control framework signed off.
* By go-live: first wave of countries live in Noida after successful parallel runs.
* Within 12–18 months: vendor consolidation on track, zero critical errors sustained, and a clean audit outcome.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

**Indicative target**

**Payroll accuracy:**
≥ 99.5% of payslips error-free; zero critical errors

**On-time payment:**
100% of payrolls paid on the scheduled date

**Off-cycle payments:**
Reduced quarter on quarter; every case root-caused

**Statutory compliance:**
Zero penalties; 100% filings on time

**Vendor SLA adherence:**
≥ 98% against contracted SLAs

**Cost per payslip:**
Year-on-year reduction against baseline

**Audit outcome:**
No high-rated findings

*Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines.*

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* Deep multi-country payroll expertise covering gross-to-net, statutory deductions, tax and social security, and year-end.
* Payroll vendor and aggregator management (for example ADP, Ramco, Alight, or in-country providers), including contract and SLA governance.
* Payroll controls, SOX-style frameworks and audit management.
* Integration of HRIS (Workday / SAP SuccessFactors) with time and payroll systems, including interface monitoring.
* Payroll accounting, GL reconciliation and working knowledge of benefits administration.
* Parallel-run design, cutover planning and hypercare.

**LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES**

• Builds teams from zero

• Customer-centric leadership

• Drives change and adoption

• Sound judgement under pressure

• Influences without authority across countries

• Data-led decision making

• Coaches and develops talent

• Holds a high bar on control

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

**Essential**

* 15+ years in HR operations, including 8+ years leading multi-country payroll.
* Has led at least one payroll transition or vendor consolidation into a shared services centre.
* Has run payroll for 10,000+ employees across several jurisdictions.
* Master's degree in HR, Finance, Business or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Payroll certification (CPP, FPC, CIPP or equivalent)
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or above
* Experience across Europe, Middle East, Africa or APAC payroll

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**

Hub Director, Global Reward and Payroll leadership, Finance and Tax, Internal Audit, country HR leads, payroll vendors, HRIS team.

title: People Services Digital Learning Experience Lead
description:
**OUR STORY**

**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**
**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**
**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Learning Technology Leadership**

* Own the overall learning technology experience across the LMS/LXP ecosystem, ensuring a seamless and user-friendly learner journey.
* Act as the primary point of contact for learning technology governance, standards, and process control.
* Partner with HR Innovation, HRMS, IT, and global/regional HR stakeholders to define system enhancements and digital learning priorities.
* Evaluate and recommend learning technology improvements, automation opportunities, and digital adoption initiatives.
* Support the rollout of new learning technologies, features, and tools, ensuring business readiness and stakeholder alignment.

**Governance and Process Control**

* Define, maintain, and enforce governance standards for LMS processes, content lifecycle, user access, workflows, and data quality.
* Ensure process consistency across countries, regions, and business units while accommodating local compliance requirements.
* Maintain documentation for learning technology processes, controls, SOPs, and user support procedures.
* Monitor adherence to global learning processes and identify gaps, risks, and control breakdowns.
* Drive continuous improvement by simplifying workflows, reducing manual interventions, and standardizing operations.

**Stakeholder and Vendor Management**

* Act as the escalation point for learning technology and governance-related issues.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and vendors to resolve system, process, and access issues in a timely manner.
* Support system testing, user acceptance testing, and defect resolution for LMS-related changes or enhancements.
* Coordinate with vendors and technical partners to ensure service levels and issue resolution targets are met.

**Leadership Management**

* Lead, coach, and develop team members supporting learning operations, reporting, or systems administration.
* Allocate responsibilities, monitor workload, and ensure service continuity and quality.
* Conduct performance reviews, regular check-ins, and development planning for direct reports.
* Build capability within the team on learning systems, governance standards, and process excellence.

**Reporting and Insights**

* Oversee the quality and reliability of learning data, dashboards, and management reporting.
* Track platform usage, adoption, learner engagement, completion rates, and system/data issues.
* Provide insights to support leadership decision-making and identify improvement areas.

**Opportunities**

* Shape the transformation of learning services through automation, analytics, and digital user experience.
* Influence global learning governance standards and service model design.
* Contribute to the maturity of the L&D function as a digitally enabled service.

**Qualifications**

* Over 6 years’ experience in HR Services, L&D operations, learning technology, or HR systems roles.
* Strong experience with LMS/LXP platforms and learning operations governance.
* Proven ability to manage cross-functional stakeholders and lead process improvement initiatives.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and control discipline.
* Experience working with HR systems such as Oracle, Workday, CSOD, SuccessFactors, or SAP.
* Familiarity with service management tools such as ServiceNow.
* Advanced Excel/reporting skills and experience with dashboards or learning analytics.
* Experience leading people and/or coordinating multi-country workstreams.
* Lean Six Sigma or equivalent process improvement certification preferred.

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance.

title: Assistant Sourcing Manager
description:
To manage the end-to-end sourcing process for apparel products, including but not limited to fabrics, trims, and finished garments. OTIF is the primary KRA for this role along with identifying and developing supplier relationships, negotiating contracts, ensuring quality standards, and optimizing costs to meet the company's apparel production needs. The Sourcing Manager plays a critical role in maintaining the quality and profitability of our apparel business.

Key Responsibilities:

* Supplier Management:

o Identify, evaluate, and establish relationships with suppliers who can meet the company's quality, cost, and capacity requirements.

o Develop and maintain strong partnerships with existing suppliers to ensure reliability and consistent product quality.

o Monitor supplier performance, conduct regular audits, and address any issues or non-compliance.

* OTIF Management :

o On time in fulfilment – Primary KRA for this role. Ensuring to launch all products on the launch date in fulfilment. This will involve capacity planning and production planning with suppliers along with ensuring all levers for timely inspection are in place.

o To conduct the annual review of supplier performance with QA.

o To pursue and recover all money due from vendors as a result of performance penalties or markdown and promotional contributions.

o Ensures timely delivery of samples by vendors where the product can go through a first-time right approval.

* Cost Optimization:

o Negotiate pricing and terms with suppliers to achieve cost savings while maintaining product quality.

o Analyze market trends and work with suppliers to identify opportunities for cost reduction and value enhancement.

o Continuously review and optimize the supply chain to improve cost-efficiency.

Quality Control:

o Set and maintain strict quality standards for all apparel products.

o Work closely with suppliers to ensure that products meet quality specifications and conduct inspections when necessary.

o Develop and implement quality improvement initiatives in collaboration with suppliers.

* Procurement Strategy:

o Develop and execute a strategic sourcing plan for the apparel business in alignment with overall company goals.

o Monitor market dynamics and global trends to make informed decisions about sourcing locations and strategies.

o Manage lead times, inventory levels, and order quantities to meet demand.

* Risk Management:

o Identify potential risks in the supply chain and develop contingency plans to mitigate disruptions.

o Stay updated on global trade regulations and compliance requirements for the apparel industry.

o Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to ensure adherence to international standards.

title: SAP PM CS
description:
Job Description: SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven
**SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant**
with
**5 to 12 years**
of expertise across SAP Customer Service (CS), Service Management (SM), and S/4HANA Service.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, and implementing end-to-end Service Management processes in an
**SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition (PCE) / RISE with SAP**
environment. You will bridge business requirements and functional architecture, manage cloud service governance, enable AI-driven service insights, and drive continuous optimization across the full service lifecycle.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Implementation
* Design, configure, and deploy S/4HANA Service Management processes across the entire service lifecycle: Engage, Sell, Contract, Plan, Schedule, Execute, Invoice, and Analyze.
* Map end-to-end business requirements to standard S/4HANA Service capabilities, including service quotations, service orders, service contracts, spare parts logistics, resource planning, billing, and analytics.
* Drive adoption of the latest S/4HANA PCE release innovations (e.g., service team determination, advanced execution processes, Fiori applications, and AI-powered service intelligence).
* S/4HANA Private Edition (PCE) Governance
* Operate effectively within the SAP S/4HANA PCE Shared Responsibility Model between the client and SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS).
* Liaise with SAP for system-level operational tasks (e.g., infrastructure management, backups, maintenance, and upgrade administration).
* Lead client-side functional responsibilities, including business process configuration, functional validation, regression testing, and process governance based on SAP’s PCE Roles and Responsibilities framework.
* Service Order & Contract Management
* Configure and maintain service contract structures, recurring service billing plans, and auto-renewal mechanisms.
* Enable flexible billing scenarios, including Resource-Related Billing (RRB), Time & Material (T&M), and Fixed-Price billing models.
* Leverage modern platform features such as service contract template cloning and mass contract change capabilities.
* Service Planning, Execution & Logistics Integration
* Set up and optimize workforce planning, resource allocation, dispatching, and field service workflows.
* Configure plant and storage location parameters within service transactions to support multi-plant and multi-location service execution.
* Direct cross-module functional integration between service transactions and procurement (MM), inventory management, shipping, plant maintenance (PM), and follow-on financial postings.
* Data Migration, Testing & Integration
* Oversee data preparation, cleansing, transformation, and validation for service master data, active service contracts, and open service orders.
* Utilize the SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and standard transition tools tailored for service artifacts.
* Coordinate functional and technical integrations across CRM, SAP Field Service Management (FSM), SAP CS, core logistics, and Finance (FI/CO).
* AI, Analytics & Continuous Process Improvement
* Implement embedded AI capabilities (e.g., Joule-assisted summaries, intelligent confirmations, and predictive service insights).
* Design custom Fiori dashboards, operational reports, and KPIs to monitor service performance and profitability.
* Guide business stakeholders through continuous improvement initiatives and the adoption of periodic SAP release features.
* Stakeholder Management & Documentation
* Facilitate requirements-gathering workshops, author detailed functional specifications (FS), and map target-state business process flows.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams spanning Logistics, Procurement, Finance, and Sales.
* Create training collateral, deliver end-user training, and lead hypercare support during deployment phases.

**Required Skills & Technical Expertise**

* Experience: 5–12 years of hands-on experience in SAP CS / SM / S/4HANA Service functional consulting.
* Core Module Competency: Comprehensive knowledge of S/4HANA Service (PCE) core functionality (Service Orders, Service Contracts, Resource-Related Billing, Invoicing, and Execution Logistics).
* Cloud Architecture: Clear operational understanding of the SAP PCE operating model, RISE with SAP frameworks, and cloud service boundary matrices.
* User Experience & Extensibility: Proficiency with modern SAP Fiori apps, standard OData APIs, and functional extensibility options.
* Integration Touchpoints: Strong cross-functional integration experience with PM, SD, MM, FI/CO, and SAP FSM.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Practical project experience with RISE with SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition implementations or migrations.
* Hands-on knowledge of SAP upgrade governance and release management protocols in PCE environments.
* Official SAP Certification in S/4HANA Service or related SAP functional modules.

**Soft Skills**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong consulting mindset with a proven ability to translate business strategy into technical solution designs.
* Proactive problem-solving capabilities and experience leading cross-functional delivery teams.

title: Manager - Continuous Improvement
description:
**Job Description**
**Manager – Continuous Improvement & Process Discovery**
Kraft Heinz Global Business Services | Continuous Improvement
  
  
Six Sigma Green Belt | Process Discovery Lead | GBS Towers: ATR, AP, Commercial Ops, SCM & More
  
  
**Job Title**
Manager – Continuous Improvement & Process Discovery
  
  
**Department**
Global Business Services (GBS) – Continuous Improvement CoE
